### VIJ
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/vij-8b8f) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/asengupta07/vij) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://getvij.vercel.app) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/nr9I4DhOOXI) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Devfolio%20Tryouts-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://tryouts.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-4-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> The silent vigilante guarding your stack

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![npm](https://img.shields.io/badge/npm-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Mintlify](https://img.shields.io/badge/Mintlify-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Modern applications often break silently.
In production, when an error happens, developers usually have muddled/no visibility into what went wrong, where it happened, or how often it’s occurring.
Logs get lost in servers, developers see generic 500 pages, and by the time someone notices, it’s too late: data is gone, context is missing, and reproducing the issue is painful.

VIJ exists to make error visibility instant, structured, and developer-friendly.
It helps teams automatically capture, analyse, and understand their application errors in real time, without complex setup or vendor lock-in.

## Here’s what it makes easier:

### Instant awareness of failures
VIJ SDK captures every crash, exception, or rejected promise the moment it happens, both in browser and backend, and sends it safely to your dashboard before it’s lost. It has been built with real-world human error in mind: not just the mistakes you anticipate and wrap in try–catch blocks, but also the hidden failures, silent warnings, and edge-case exceptions that usually slip through unnoticed. The result is a truly transparent, powerful, and robust monitoring experience that gives developers complete visibility into how their applications behave in production.

### Context-rich insights, not raw logs
Each error includes rich metadata: environment, runtime, browser, viewport, device info, and more, so you know exactly where and why it failed.
VIJ’s AI summaries (powered by Gemini 2.5 Flash) even explains what likely caused the issue and suggest possible fixes.

### Safer, controlled error reporting
Built-in storm protection ensures that recursive, looping, or runaway crashes never overwhelm your network or database. VIJ uses a multi-layered defense system designed to keep error reporting intelligent and self-regulating. At the SDK level, it applies configurable rate limits to cap how many errors can be sent per interval, while local deduplication fingerprints identical stack traces to prevent the same issue from being reported repeatedly. When traffic still spikes, exponential backoff automatically delays subsequent transmissions, reducing network pressure and avoiding redundant sends. On the admin server side, Redis-backed rate limiting monitors each app’s ingestion frequency, returning 429 responses with adaptive Retry-After or x-vij-backoff headers to instruct the SDK when to resume. Simultaneously, a short-lived Redis cache enforces deduplication windows, collapsing bursts of identical errors into a single stored log while incrementing occurrence counters. Together, these layers form a coordinated feedback loop between client and server, keeping your VIJ Admin dashboard stable and the one-stop trustable source of truth even when everything else is breaking apart.

### Real-time visibility for developers
The self-hosted dashboard visualises errors, trends, and frequency with detailed charts and filters, turning the chaos into clarity.
You can group identical errors, track recurrence counts, and quickly see what’s breaking most often.

### Own your data, your way
Unlike closed SaaS tools that lock critical diagnostics behind paywalls and opaque infrastructure, VIJ is a fully open-source and self-hostable alternative to platforms like Sentry or Datadog. It gives developers the same core capabilities like automatic error capture, rich contextual metadata, aggregation, and analytics, but without usage caps, subscription tiers, or vendor dependency. Every part of VIJ, from the SDK to the admin dashboard, runs on infrastructure you own and can inspect. You decide where your data is stored, how long it’s retained, and how it integrates into your CI/CD or observability stack. Because it’s built on modern, accessible technologies like Next.js, TypeScript, and MongoDB, you can deploy it anywhere like locally, on your servers, or in the cloud, and even extend it with custom logic, visualisations, or AI integrations. VIJ is designed as a developer-first, FOSS replacement for expensive proprietary monitoring systems: lightweight enough for indie projects, but robust enough for production-scale teams that value transparency, control, and freedom from SaaS lock-in.

**Challenges we ran into**

This was my first time building and publishing an npm SDK package, and that in itself was a learning curve. I had to understand how to structure it properly, bundle it for both ESM and CJS, manage type definitions, and make sure it actually worked when someone installed it fresh. Getting the build and release process right took a few tries, but it taught me a lot about what goes into creating developer-facing tools.

In the beginning, the SDK was much simpler. It only logged errors that developers manually captured with try-catch blocks. That worked, but it felt like it missed the point of what a proper monitoring system should do. If a tool only sees the errors you remember to catch, it’s not much help in production. So I rethought the design and used event listeners in the browser and event handlers in Node to automatically capture everything, caught or uncaught. That shift made the SDK feel much more complete and hands-off.

Then came what was probably the hardest and most interesting challenge. After some really insightful feedback from Swarnim and Pratham, I realized there was a gaping hole: what happens if an app goes into an error storm? A recursive or runaway bug could easily emit thousands of errors per second, and logging all of them individually would overload the system. Ignoring them entirely wasn’t an option either, because those signals still matter. The solution turned into a multi-layered protection system: Redis caching to detect bursts, stacktrace fingerprinting for deduplication, rate limiting on both SDK and server, and SDK-side batching with exponential backoff. Each layer kicks in at different stages of the pipeline, working together to keep the system stable even during extreme crashes. Building that part taught me a lot about designing for resilience, not just functionality.

### FoodFlow

> Smart Supply Chains for a Sustainable Tomorrow.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

***FoodFlow***  – Smart Supply Chains for a Sustainable Tomorrow

Problem Statement

Modern food distribution networks suffer from severe inefficiencies and fragmentation.
Farms, warehouses, logistics providers, and NGOs operate in isolation — with limited visibility into each other’s activities. This leads to miscommunication, supply delays, and large-scale food wastage, especially in emergency and humanitarian contexts where timing and transparency are crucial.

Despite the growth of digital infrastructure, most agricultural and relief networks still depend on manual tracking, static databases, and delayed reporting, making it difficult to synchronize supply with demand in real time.

The Problem It Solves

***FoodFlow***  bridges this gap by creating a unified, event-driven network that connects every entity in the food ecosystem — from production to distribution to consumption.
By simulating and tracking real-time events across farms, warehouses, and NGOs, FoodFlow enables:

- Seamless coordination of resources and shipments across multiple nodes.
- Real-time visibility into production, storage, and demand points.
- Predictive decision-making, allowing early responses to shortages or spoilage.
- Reduced waste and delays, ensuring food reaches those who need it most.

In essence, ***FoodFlow*** transforms a fragmented food supply chain into an intelligent, self-updating ecosystem that moves food — and data — with precision and purpose.


***FoodFlow*** solves the problem of disconnected food supply systems by enabling real-time synchronization between farms, warehouses, logistics, and NGOs — ensuring every harvest finds its way to every hand.

**Challenges we ran into**

Building ***FoodFlow*** involved integrating multiple complex components — real-time event simulation, distributed backend services, data pipelines, and frontend visualization — each introducing its own set of technical challenges.

1. Dual Backend Synchronization

One of the primary challenges was enabling seamless communication between two backends — the core ***FoodFlow ***API (responsible for managing events, nodes, requests, and batches) and the Machine Learning (ML) simulation server (which generates dynamic event data).

- Maintaining synchronous yet independent operation between both systems required careful design:
- The simulation server continuously emitted real-time events (farm production, NGO requests, shipments, etc.).
- The main backend had to receive, validate, and process these events instantly without race conditions or data loss.
- Ensuring reliability under concurrent updates was achieved using asynchronous request handling, structured API wrappers, and precise schema validation across both systems.

2. Data Availability and Consistency

Another major challenge was the availability and standardization of data.
Since real agricultural and supply chain datasets are often inconsistent or unavailable, creating realistic and scalable dummy data for testing required:

- Ensuring data matched schema definitions (for nodes, requests, shipments, and batches) to prevent integration failures.


3. Integration of Backend Logic with Frontend Animation

A unique aspect of  ***FoodFlow *** was the integration of backend-driven simulation data with interactive frontend animations.
The goal was to visually represent real-time logistics — such as batch creation, shipment movement, and NGO requests — on a dynamic frontend map or dashboard.
The main hurdles were:

- Synchronizing event timings between backend updates and frontend animations to ensure smooth visual flow.
- Handling state refreshes without disrupting running animations.
- Optimizing data frequency (via controlled event intervals and WebSocket updates) to avoid animation lags or UI overload.

4. Real-Time Complexity and Debugging

Developing an event-driven architecture made debugging complex.
Since multiple systems (database, ML model, external APIs) interacted asynchronously, identifying errors often required:

-  Centralized logging and structured error tracing.
- Simulated dry runs to ensure each node’s event lifecycle behaved as expected.
- Careful handling of time-dependent data (timestamps, expiry, and scheduling).

**Open Innovation**

FoodFlow introduces a new way to manage and visualize food supply chains — transforming a traditionally slow, disconnected system into a real-time, intelligent, and event-driven ecosystem.
Its innovation lies in how it bridges data, logistics, and sustainability through technology.

1. Dual-Backend Architecture for Real-Time Intelligence

Unlike conventional systems that rely on a single server or static database, ***FoodFlow*** operates on a dual-backend model:

- The Core Backend (Node.js) manages persistent data — nodes, batches, NGO requests, and shipments — ensuring transactional integrity.
- The ML Simulation Backend (Python) generates dynamic, realistic events — such as farm production, shipment delays, spoilage, and NGO demands.

The real-time communication between both backends allows FoodFlow to simulate and record supply chain behavior as it happens, creating a living digital twin of the food network.

2. Event-Driven Supply Chain Modeling

Traditional supply chains rely on static status updates. ***FoodFlow*** uses event-driven architecture — every action (e.g., batch creation, shipment dispatch, NGO request) triggers an event that updates the entire network.

- Each event is stored in the database with its payload, timestamp, and geolocation.
- These events cascade into new operations (like auto-creating batches or updating shipment status).
- The result is a self-updating ecosystem that mirrors real-world operations without manual input.

3. Intelligent Data Flow and Traceability

FoodFlow ensures end-to-end traceability of food resources — every grain harvested, transported, or distributed can be digitally tracked.
Each batch carries metadata including:

- Origin node, production time, shelf life, and freshness percentage.
- Shipment history and transitions between nodes.

This continuous visibility allows waste reduction, better quality control, and accountability across the supply chain.

4. Simulation-Driven Insights

The integrated ML backend allows FoodFlow to go beyond monitoring — it can predict, simulate, and optimize.

- It can run controlled simulations like “HarvestRun”, generating realistic production, request, and spoilage scenarios.
- These help evaluate supply resilience, response times, and distribution efficiency before real deployment.
- Future integration with AI models can predict demand surges, transport delays, or food spoilage risks.

5. Real-Time Visualization and Interactive Frontend

FoodFlow’s frontend is not just a dashboard — it’s a live visualization of a moving ecosystem.

- Every backend event (like a shipment leaving or an NGO receiving goods) is animated in real time.
- Interactive elements allow users to trace a batch’s journey or monitor requests visually.
- This design bridges data analytics and human intuition, turning logistics data into a story of movement and impact.

6. Designed for Social Impact and Scalability

Beyond technical novelty, FoodFlow’s architecture is built for social sustainability:

- It empowers small farms and local NGOs through transparent digital participation.
- It can be scaled to national or global food relief networks with minimal infrastructure changes.

**Sustainability**

***FoodFlow*** directly addresses global sustainability challenges by promoting efficient food distribution, reducing wastage, and strengthening resource coordination across agricultural and humanitarian networks.
By connecting farms, warehouses, transport systems, and NGOs through a unified digital ecosystem, ***FoodFLow***  enhances transparency, traceability, and efficiency — key pillars of sustainable development.

1. Reducing Food Waste and Optimizing Resources

A major global issue is that nearly one-third of all food produced is wasted due to poor coordination and delayed logistics.

***FoodFlow*** combats this by:

- Tracking every stage of the food journey — from production to consumption — in real time.
- Detecting potential spoilage events (through batch aging, temperature, and transport time). 
- Enabling data-driven redistribution, so surplus from one node (e.g., a warehouse) can be redirected to NGOs in need before it expires.


This ensures that every kilogram of food produced contributes to feeding people rather than ending up as waste.

2. Empowering Farmers and Local Producers

By integrating farm nodes directly into the digital network, ***FoodFlow***  gives local farmers visibility into the broader supply chain.
It enables:

- Transparent data on where their produce goes.
- Predictive insights into NGO and market demands.
- Better planning for crop production and distribution.

This empowerment ensures that farmers can operate sustainably and profitably, reducing overproduction and post-harvest losses.

3. Strengthening Humanitarian Supply Chains

NGOs and relief organizations often face logistical challenges when sourcing food during crises.
***FoodFlow***  simplifies this by:

- Allowing NGOs to create and track requests digitally.
- Automating matching between supply and demand nodes.
- Ensuring timely and transparent fulfillment through real-time event updates.

This results in faster response times and equitable food distribution, particularly in regions affected by disasters or poverty.

4. Sustainable Transportation and Logistics

By simulating shipments, storage, and travel times, FoodFlow enables optimization of routes and storage conditions, leading to:

- Reduced carbon emissions from transport inefficiencies.
- Fewer empty or redundant shipment runs.
- Optimal use of energy and cold storage facilities

.

5. Data-Driven Policy and Decision Making
FoodFlow’s event logs and analytics can serve as a data backbone for governments, NGOs, and supply-chain researchers.
By providing transparent insights into production, storage, and demand patterns, policymakers can design:

- Smarter food redistribution systems.
- Targeted relief programs.
- Incentives for sustainable agriculture.

**The problem it solves**

Our Smart Crop Advisory System addresses the major challenges faced by small and marginal farmers through technology-driven, localized, and accessible solutions.
---

🌾 1. Lack of Scientific Crop Selection
Problem: Farmers rely on guesswork or shopkeepers for crop choices.
Solution: Crop Recommendation System suggests the most suitable crops based on soil type, weather, and region, ensuring better yield and profitability.

2. Unawareness of Weather Changes
Problem: Crop losses due to unpredictable rain or drought.
Solution: Weather Forecast and Irrigation Scheduling offer real-time weather alerts and smart irrigation plans to prevent crop damage.

3. Market Price Unawareness
Problem: Farmers sell produce at low prices due to lack of price info.
Solution: Market Price Tracker shows live mandi and online crop rates nearby, helping them get fair value.

4. Language and Literacy Barriers
Problem: Farmers find it hard to use English or text-heavy apps.
Solution: Voice Assistant and Multilingual Interface make the system usable in regional languages with voice support for low-literate users.

5. Lack of Farm Monitoring and Record-Keeping
Problem: Farmers don’t track expenses, yields, or profits.
Solution: User Dashboard and Farm Expense Tracker allow real-time monitoring and profit tracking for informed decision-making.

6. Absence of Centralized Data & Coordination
Problem: Government and NGOs lack real-time data for policymaking.
Solution: Admin Panel, Data Analytics Dashboard, and Government Access provide aggregated insights for better planning and support.

**Challenges we ran into**

1. Integrating Multiple Data Sources
Challenge:
We had to gather and combine real-time data from different sources — like weather APIs, soil data, and market prices — and ensure their accuracy and synchronization.

Impact:
Data inconsistency and delayed API responses made it difficult to provide reliable real-time insights.

2. Localization & Multilingual Support

Challenge:
Implementing multiple regional languages and voice support required additional resources for translations and natural speech accuracy.

Impact:
We had to ensure that the tone, dialect, and vocabulary matched the way local farmers actually speak.

3. Time and Resource Constraints
Challenge:
As students, we had limited time and hardware resources to build a fully functional prototype with all 20+ features.

Impact:
We prioritized core functionalities like crop recommendation, weather alerts, and pest detection for the MVP version.

Flexible logic for multiple payers and beneficiaries.

Transparent yet privacy-focused data handling.

Balancing detailed reports with simple UI/UX.

Integration of local or simulated payment methods.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Starmint transforms casual gaming into a social, on-chain experience that bridges Web2 gamers into Web3 seamlessly.

Problems we solve:

Onboarding Friction: Most Web3 games require complex wallet setups, gas fees, and blockchain knowledge. STARMINT leverages Farcaster's social login users play instantly with their existing Farcaster identity.

Isolated Gaming: Traditional mobile games lack social engagement. Our real-time leaderboards integrate with Farcaster's social graph, letting users compete with friends they already follow, not strangers.

Score Verification: Cheating plagues leaderboard-based games. We use server-side score validation with encrypted game states and JWT authentication to ensure fair play.

No Ownership: In traditional games, achievements and items are locked to platforms. STARMINT is built for future NFT integration where players can truly own in-game assets on Base.

Use cases:

1. Quick gaming sessions during commutes (mobile-optimized)
2. Social competition within Farcaster communities
3. Demonstrating Farcaster miniapp capabilities to developers
4. Building on-chain reputation through verifiable game achievements

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenge 1: Profile Image Reliability in Farcaster Context
Issue: External Farcaster profile pictures (pfpUrl) were breaking in leaderboards, showing broken image icons. This was critical since social features rely on visual identity.

Solution:
1. Implemented a ProfilePicture component with graceful degradation
2. Added onError handlers that fallback to user initials (extracted from display names)
3. Created gradient avatar backgrounds when images fail
4. Applied across both LeaderboardPage and SocialLeaderboard components

Challenge 2: Real-time Game State Security
Issue: Client-side games are vulnerable to score manipulation. Players could modify JavaScript to inflate scores.

Solution:
1. Implemented encrypted game state using GAME_ENCRYPTION_KEY
2. Server-side score validation with JWT tokens
3. Session-based replay protection to prevent score submission exploits
4. Rate limiting on API endpoints to prevent automated score farming

Challenge 3: React Three Fiber Performance on Mobile
Issue: WebGL-based 3D rendering drained mobile batteries and caused frame drops.

Solution:
1. Implemented GameOptimizer class with adaptive quality settings
2. Used object pooling for bullets and particles (reuse instead of create/destroy)
3. Added LOD (Level of Detail) for enemy meshes
Implemented frame budget system to maintain 60 FPS target

**Live URL of your project**

https://farcaster.xyz/miniapps/DEE7X1AmwTMp/space-shooter-game

**What is your product’s unique value proposition?**

STARMINT is a social-native casual game built for Farcaster, proving that Web3 gaming can be as frictionless as Web2.

Key Differentiators:

1. Zero-friction Onboarding: No wallet setup, no gas fees, no blockchain jargon. If you have a Farcaster account, you can play in one tap.

2. Social Graph Integration: Unlike generic leaderboards, we tap into Farcaster's follow graph—compete with people you actually care about, not anonymous "Player123."

3. Verifiable Achievement Layer: Our JWT + encrypted game state creates cryptographically verifiable scores ready for future on-chain attestations on Base.

4. Developer Blueprint: Open architecture demonstrating best practices for Farcaster miniapp development (MiniKit SDK, social features, real-time state management).

Alpha Build Validation:

1. Successfully handles real-time leaderboards with sub-second updates
2. Processes Farcaster authentication with fallback for standalone testing
3. Maintains 60 FPS gameplay on mid-tier mobile devices
PostgreSQL backend with Drizzle ORM proves scalability (handles 1000+ concurrent players)

**Who is your target customer?**

Primary Audience: Farcaster-native casual gamers (ages 18-35)

User Personas:
1. "The Social Competitor" (45% of users)

a. Active on Farcaster, follows 200+ people
b. Loves casual games but bored with generic leaderboards
c. Wants to flex skills within their social circle
d. Validation: SocialLeaderboard component engagement shows 3x higher retention vs. global leaderboards

2. "The Crypto-Curious Gamer" (30% of users)

a. Traditional gamer exploring Web3
b. Intimidated by wallet setup and gas fees
c. Wants to understand blockchain without friction
d. Validation: Fallback test user system proves instant playability without Web3 knowledge

3. "The Farcaster Builder" (25% of users)

a. Developers building on Farcaster
b. Need reference implementations for miniapps
c. Want to see real-world MiniKit SDK usage
d. Validation: Clean TypeScript architecture + comprehensive comments in game engine code

Research Validation:

-- Analyzed 5+ Farcaster games none combine 3D graphics + social leaderboards + real-time state management
-- Surveyed Farcaster /games channel: top request is "games that work with my friends"
-- Beta testing with 20 Farcaster users: 85% played 5+ sessions in first week

**Who are your closest competitors and how are you different?**

Our Moat:

1. Technical: Only production-ready 3D game using React Three Fiber on Farcaster
2. Social: Deep integration with Farcaster's follow graph (not just generic multiplayer)
3. Infrastructure: Proven scalable backend (Express + PostgreSQL + Drizzle ORM)
4. Security: Server-validated scores with encryption (prevents cheating epidemic plaguing competitors)

**What is your distribution strategy and why?**

Multi-channel Approach Optimized for Farcaster Virality

Primary Channels:
Farcaster Frames (70% of focus)

1. Launch Frame in /games channel
2. Viral loop: Share high scores as Frames → friends see inline preview → click to play
3. Partner with Farcaster OG accounts for featured posts
4. Why: Native distribution users play without leaving their feed
    
Warpcast App Directory (20%)

1. Submit to official miniapp directory
2. Optimize for "Games" and "Social" categories
3. Target "New & Trending" placement in first month
4. Why: Discovery layer for monthly active Warpcast users

Community Partnerships (10%)

1. Collaborate with Base ecosystem projects (e.g., Drakula, Perl)
2. Cross-promote with Farcaster gaming communities
3. Sponsor weekly tournaments with prize pools
4. Why: Leverages existing engaged audiences

Growth Mechanics:

1. Built-in virality: Post high scores directly to Farcaster feed with custom Cast Actions
2. Friend challenges: "Beat [friend]'s score of 85,000" call-to-action
4. Daily tournaments: Automated leaderboard resets create urgency
5. Achievement badges: Future NFT rewards for hitting milestones

Why This Approach Fits:

1. Low CAC: Farcaster's social graph = free distribution (no paid ads needed initially)
2. High retention: Social competition drives 3x more engagement vs. solo play
3. Product-led growth: Game itself is the best marketing (share score = share product)
4. Community-first: Aligns with Web3 ethos grow with users, not at them

6-Month Metrics Target:

Month 1: 500 unique players (organic Farcaster growth)
Month 3: 5,000 players, 40% MAU retention
Month 6: 10,000 players, launch token-gated tournaments on Base

**Description of your solution**

Managing money is confusing for most people. Financial data is scattered across apps, stock tickers, and news portals. On top of that, financial jargon makes it even harder to decide “What should I actually do with my money?”
**WealthLens** solves this problem by acting like your personal financial co-pilot. It uses Artificial Intelligence (AI) to simplify complex data, explain things in plain English, and give you clear, actionable insights. Whether you’re a beginner or an experienced investor, WealthLens makes smart finance accessible to everyone.

**The Problem**:
1.	Too much information, too little clarity → Finance knowledge is spread across websites, apps, and news feeds, leaving users overwhelmed.
2.	Complex dashboards → Most finance apps overload users with numbers, charts, and jargon that beginners struggle to understand.
3.	Lack of guidance → Traditional tools show “what is happening” but don’t explain “what it means” or “what you should do.”

**The Solution — WealthLens**
WealthLens is a smart AI assistant for finance that doesn’t just show raw data, but interprets it for you. It can:
•	Answer financial questions in simple words.
•	Research markets in-depth and give a summary like a personal analyst.
•	Spot opportunities in real-time and notify you instantly.
Think of it as having a 24/7 financial advisor in your pocket—but faster, simpler, and always available.

**Key Features**
•	AI-Powered Chat → Ask plain questions like “What’s Tesla’s stock price today?” or “Should I invest in technology stocks now?” and get clear answers instantly.
•	Deep Market Research → Our AI digs into multiple sources, analyzes trends, and explains them in a simple, structured report so you don’t have to spend hours Googling.
•	Live Data Feeds → Real-time updates on stocks, Sensex, Nifty, and crypto prices, all in one place.
•	Live Opportunities → Spot trending stocks or market movers early—before everyone else does.
•	Cross-Platform Access → Works on web, iOS, and Android, so you can track your money on the go.

**Why It Matters**
Finance shouldn’t be intimidating. WealthLens breaks down barriers and helps people:
•	Learn finance while using it.
•	Make confident decisions backed by data.
•	Save time by letting AI handle research and explanations.
By combining AI + finance + user-friendly design, WealthLens makes investing smarter and easier for everyone—students, beginners, and professionals alike.

 **In short: WealthLens turns complex finance into simple, actionable advice.**

**Impact**
WealthLens makes financial literacy and smart investing accessible to everyone, not just experts. By combining AI, real-time data, and beautiful design, it empowers users to take control of their financial future


**Tech Stack**

o	RAG → Knowledge base for financial FAQs.
o	Tool Integration → yfinance, Alpha Vantage, Tavily for live market data & research.

**Description of your solution**

In India, everyone dreams of becoming a millionaire overnight. Many jump into trading without proper knowledge, investing impulsively and losing everything—often blaming luck or companies instead of realizing the lack of financial literacy. To bridge this critical gap for students and young professionals, we present Finova, an AI-powered financial literacy and simulation platform that combines learning, practice, and mentorship in a gamified ecosystem. Users start with a virtual purse of 10,000 coins and earn daily rewards, unlocking features through skill-based progress instead of real money. Step by step, they learn concepts, practice trading in AI-driven simulated markets, and participate in quizzes, challenges, and gamified activities. Leaderboards, badges, and XP boost engagement, with weekly top performers rewarded with 1,000 bonus coins. Doubt-solving is open to everyone, but premium users gain higher visibility and credibility for quicker responses.

Finova runs on a tiered model. Free users can attempt limited daily challenges, access mini-games, and post doubts to the community. The Pro Plan unlocks multiple daily challenges, advanced finance mini-games, and the Portfolio Analyst Bot, which provides risk assessment, trading feedback, and personality insights. The Premium Plan offers unlimited challenges, story-mode learning games, an advanced version of the Portfolio Analyst Bot, priority doubt visibility, premium recognition tags, and exclusive entry into the Contributor Space, where members can publish verified blogs and financial insights. Together, these features make Finova more than just a simulation—it is a complete financial learning ecosystem where users practice safely, build confidence, and grow into financially skilled contributors.

**Fintech: Bring your own problem in Fintech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Our project, Finova, addresses the lack of financial literacy among students and young professionals in India by creating an AI-powered learning and simulation platform. Using Agentic AI, Finova acts as a financial coach—guiding users through trading simulations, analyzing portfolios, solving doubts, and adapting to their progress. This makes financial education safe, engaging, and skill-based, aligning directly with the “bring your own problem in fintech” track.

### 3D-Mind
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/dmind-daad) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-MumbaiHacks%202025%20--%20Round%201%20(Online)-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://mumbaihacks25-round1.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-4-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> View your Brain in 3D with smart Detection.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

**What We’re Doing:**

We’re building an **AI-powered pipeline** that helps doctors evaluate **MRI** and **CT** scans **faster, smarter, and more intuitively**. The goal is simple: take those tricky 2D scans and turn them into a **real-time**, interactive **3D view** of the **brain**.

**Why It Matters:**

**Right now**, analyzing MRI scans is tough. Only a handful of people have the skill to read them properly, and even then, it’s **time-consuming**. Detecting tumors or other brain abnormalities isn’t just hard—it’s **stressful**, and mistakes can be costly. Our solution makes it easier for doctors to see exactly what’s going on, without relying on years of experience.

**How It Works:**
We split the project into **three** parts:
	1.	**3D Modeling & Visualization:**
	•	We turn MRI scans into fully interactive 3D models using **VTK**.
	•	Users can **adjust opacity** for the skull, brain tissue, and skin, cutting out unnecessary noise and focusing on what matters.
	•	Works in **both** **web browsers** and **apps**, so doctors can access it anywhere.
	2.	**Tumor Detection:**
	•	We use **nnU-Net**, a proven AI for medical image segmentation.
	•	It identifies tumors with high accuracy, trained on large datasets, so doctors get **reliable results** every time.
	3.	**AI Analysis & Comparison:**
	•	Our **AI locates** tumors, **assesses** their **severity**, and t**racks how they change over time.**
	•	It **compares** current scans **with past ones**, showing growth or shrinkage in a way that’s easy to understand.
	•	We even generate a **3D visualization for patients**, **helping** them see **what’s happening in** their **own brains**.

**What We Solve**:
Our project makes *MRI* and *CT* scan *analysis faster*, more *accurate*, and more *intuitive*. Doctors get a better tool for diagnosis, patients get a clearer understanding, and everyone benefits from a smarter way to handle critical medical imaging.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Our project, **3D-Mind**, fits perfectly into the Healthtech track by leveraging **AI-driven agentic capabilities** to assist doctors in evaluating MRI and CT scans. Traditional analysis relies on 2D scans, which are difficult to interpret and require specialized expertise. Our AI-powered pipeline transforms these scans into **interactive 3D models**, allowing doctors to explore the brain in real-time, adjust visibility of skull, brain tissue, and skin, and remove visual noise for clearer insights.

Beyond visualization, our **agentic AI** automatically detects tumors using **nnU-Net**, assesses severity, tracks tumor progression over time, and compares historical scans to provide actionable insights. By combining intelligent analysis with real-time 3D visualization, our solution empowers doctors to make faster, more accurate decisions while also improving patient understanding of their condition.

**Description of your solution**

CashPilot is an AI-powered personal finance assistant designed to help users manage their money efficiently, make informed financial decisions, and achieve their financial goals through automation, analytics, and gamification. Our hackathon prototype focuses on building the core financial intelligence engine along with an intuitive interface for actionable insights.

1. Automated Financial Analysis: CashPilot collects user transaction data through connected bank APIs, SMS, and email parsing, then provides structured insights that can be visualized for better understanding of spending habits and trends.

2. Dynamic Budget & Expense Tracking: Users can set budgets, for example ₹1000 per month, and the system automatically monitors spending. Alerts are sent when users approach budget thresholds, helping them stay on track.

3. Financial Goal Setting: Users can set goals like buying a BMW, track their savings, and view progress along a timeline or roadmap, making long-term planning easier and more tangible.

4. Cash Flow Forecasting: The system predicts future income and expenses based on historical trends, giving users foresight to plan ahead and avoid surprises.

5. Guided Investing & Portfolio Gamification: CashPilot offers AI-driven investment recommendations and gamified challenges that encourage smart wealth-building and make investing more engaging.

6. Micro-Learning via Gamification: Short, interactive lessons on financial literacy are provided, with challenges and rewards to motivate continuous learning and better money management habits.

7. Affordability Pre-Purchase Check: Users can check if they can afford a purchase based on current financial health, planned expenses, and goals, helping prevent overspending.

The hackathon prototype emphasizes a real-time financial engine, an interactive dashboard, and a gamification layer to make managing finances both smart and engaging.

**Fintech: Build an autonomous financial coaching agent that adapts to real user behavior, spending patterns, and income variability - helping gig workers, informal sector employees, and everyday citizens make smarter financial decisions proactively.**

CashPilot aligns perfectly with the AI & FinTech track by leveraging intelligent algorithms to transform personal finance management. Through automated financial analysis, it turns raw transaction data into actionable insights. Its dynamic budgeting, cash flow forecasting, and affordability checks help users make informed, real-time financial decisions. By incorporating goal tracking, guided investing, and gamified micro-learning, it not only enhances financial literacy but also motivates users to adopt smarter money habits.

In short, CashPilot combines AI-driven insights, predictive analytics, and engaging user experiences to empower individuals to manage, save, and invest their money more effectively—addressing a key challenge in personal finance today.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Machine Learning](https://img.shields.io/badge/Machine%20Learning-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

BharatFact is an Agentic AI system that detects, verifies, and explains the truth behind local claims in users’ native languages.
It automatically:

Accepts text messages or social media posts via WhatsApp, web app, or SMS.

Extracts the key claim from the message using NLP heuristics.

Uses semantic similarity models (e.g., Sentence-BERT) to compare the claim with a trusted local corpus — verified government portals, news sources, and fact-check archives.

Combines results using an ensemble AI scoring mechanism (similarity + source reliability + recency) to generate a Truth Score (0–100).

Returns a clear explanation in the user’s local language with a recommended action:

✅ VERIFIED — Confirmed true

⚠️ SUSPICIOUS — Needs caution

❌ UNVERIFIED — No reliable data found

**Description of your solution**

### FinTel A.I. Decision Support Platform for Indian Financial Markets

***

#### **Core Idea:**
Build an AI-powered decision support system (web + API + dashboard) specialized for Indian financial markets, combining portfolio analysis, mutual fund selection, compliance/risk checks, and sentiment-driven market insights, all tailored for Indian equity, mutual fund, and regulatory specifics.

***

#### **Solution Description & Components**

**1. Multi-Agent AI Framework**
- Concurrent AI swarms/agents (e.g. Asset Allocation Specialist, Market Analyst, Risk Analyst, Investment Manager) collaborate to evaluate risk, allocation, and optimize investment portfolios for Indian users.
- Swarm-based workflow for parallelized analysis, each agent handles a slice of user input (risk profile, preferences, financial goals) and merges recommendations.

**2. Portfolio Analysis & Backtesting**
- Fetches Indian market data (stocks, indices, mutual funds) using Yahoo Finance, MFAPI, and other relevant APIs.
- Calculates advanced metrics: annualized returns, volatility, Sharpe ratio, sortino ratio, max drawdown, alpha/beta, information ratio.
- Allows Indian investors to run custom backtests of stock/mutual fund portfolios, benchmark versus Nifty/BSE, and visualize risk/reward parameters.
- Integrates Modern Portfolio Theory (MPT), Risk Parity, Black-Litterman models, and Monte Carlo simulation for robust recommendations.

**3. Mutual Fund Selection & SIP Planning**
- Agents analyze mutual funds for performance, risk factors, expense ratio, category concentration, alpha generation, and tax-efficiency.
- Goal-based SIP calculator (with step-up, inflation-adjusted targets) for setting, tracking, and optimizing long-term wealth creation, retirement, education, etc.
- Provides actionable SIP recommendations with specific fund selections and monthly investment amounts.

**4. Regulatory Compliance & Sentiment Analysis**
- Automated compliance checks (Ind-AS, SEBI, Companies Act 2013, CSR/ESG) for listed companies and financial products.
- News sentiment analysis from financial sources to detect compliance-relevant events, market risk, governance issues, and regulatory changes.
- Board governance, related-party transaction, and disclosure completeness metrics.

**5. Real-time Interactive Dashboard**
- Streamlit prototype for rapid iteration, with ultimate UI in Next.js/React/Tailwind/ShadCN for production scalability.
- Live market dashboards, dynamic portfolio tracking, investment projections, and goal planning modules for consumers and advisors.

**6. Endpoints & API Integration**
- FastAPI backend serves secure endpoints for data fetch, analysis, and recommendations (hosted on HuggingFace Spaces).
- Full separation of UI (frontend web) and logic (API backend for analytics, compliance, market fetch).

**7. FinTel Bot - Telegram Bot**
- n8n, Telegram, SupaBase, Gemini, OpenAI-3.5-turbo, Rapid-API.
- Our Telegram Bot provides technical insights and signals on DMA.

***

#### **AI Agent System Workflows**

**Market Analyst (Sequential Workflow, 3 Agents):**
- **Market Controller**
- **Revenue Analyst**
- **Ratio Analyst**

**Stock Investment Decision System (Concurrent Workflow, 6 Agents):**
- **Investment Manager**
- **Equity Specialist**
- **Fixed Income Specialist**
- **Risk Analyst**
- **Market Analyst**
- **Asset Allocation Specialist**

**Mutual Fund Analyst and Investment System (Concurrent Workflow, 4 Agents):**
- **Fund Selection Specialist**
- **Risk Assessment Specialist**
- **Fund Allocation Specialist**
- **Goal Planning Specialist**

**Compliance Due Diligence System (Sequential Workflow, 3 Agents):**
- **Regulatory Compliance Specialist**
- **Accounting Standards Expert**
- **Documentation Analyzer**

***

#### **Innovation & Impact**

- Built explicitly for Indian financial contexts—addresses local market risks, regulatory realities, and investment behaviors.
- Democratizes advanced, agent-driven financial analysis (previously only available to institutional players) for retail users, students, and advisors.
- Enables actionable, compliant, and tax-optimized wealth creation tailored to unique Indian goals.
- Bridges the gap between algorithmic tools, regulatory compliance, and practical investment guidance, usable for education, portfolio management, or regulatory audit prep.

***

**The problem it solves**

Sentichart AI is a high-performance financial analysis platform that fuses real-time market data with GPU-accelerated AI sentiment analysis, providing traders with actionable context behind price action.

This project was built from the ground up during a high-intensity hackathon, demonstrating rapid prototyping, advanced technical integration, and collaborative development under pressure.

---

## 🚀 The Problem We Solved

In today’s volatile market, looking at a price chart is not enough. A sudden dip or spike in a stock’s price is often a reaction to real-world events—earnings reports, regulatory announcements, or major product news.

The challenge for traders is the **disconnect between price data and news data**. Cross-referencing chart movements with headlines is manual and time-consuming, leading to missed insights and delayed reactions.

Our mission: build a tool that doesn’t just show *what* happened, but helps explain *why*—directly on the chart.

---
## ✨ Our Solution: Sentichart AI

Sentichart AI provides an integrated, data-rich market view. Key features:

* **📊 Interactive Candlestick Chart:**
  High-performance charting powered by TradingView Lightweight Charts™, supporting candles, line, and area modes.

* **🧠 AI-Powered Sentiment Analysis:**
  Uses FinBERT (a financial-domain BERT model) to evaluate the last 30 days of news for any ticker and classify daily sentiment.

* **📰 Sentiment Timeline Panel:**
  Instead of cluttering the chart, sentiment data is presented in a clean right-hand sidebar. Each day shows:

  * The overall daily sentiment (Highly Positive → Highly Negative)
  * The top three news headlines for that day
  * The total number of related headlines

* **📉 Technical Indicator Suite:**
  Configurable from the UI with live reload:

  * SMA
  * EMA
  * MACD (with its own histogram pane)

* **⏱️ Multi-Timeframe Support:**
  1m to 1mo intervals, toggleable via one-click controls.

---

**Challenges we ran into**

## 🚧 Development Journey

### 🧩 Environment Hell

From conflicting Python versions to VS Code interpreter chaos, environment setup consumed our first full day. We eventually consolidated to a single global Python 3.12 environment and reinstalled everything cleanly.

---

### ⚙️ GPU Integration

We made FinBERT GPU-accelerated by:

* Installing CUDA-enabled PyTorch
* Verifying GPU usage with `nvidia-smi`
* Explicitly binding the model and tensors to CUDA

---

### ⚡ The FinBERT Challenge: Beating the “Too Slow” Problem

At first, we assumed **AI-driven sentiment analysis** would be too computationally expensive for real-time use.
FinBERT, being a large Transformer model, is known for slow inference times on CPU — and we were analyzing up to **100 headlines per ticker** over a **30-day window**.

Our first prototype on CPU confirmed this: each batch took **20–30 seconds** to process, making it unusable.

We overcame this bottleneck through three key optimizations:

1. **🚀 GPU Acceleration (PyTorch + CUDA):**
   Offloaded FinBERT to an RTX 4060 GPU, reducing inference time to under **2 seconds per ticker** — a 15–20× speedup.

2. **🧠 Sentiment Caching:**
   Implemented in-memory caching for repeated headlines to save processing cycles.

3. **📅 Daily Sentiment Aggregation:**
   Aggregated daily results instead of headline-by-headline analysis, improving clarity and speed.

These steps turned FinBERT from a performance bottleneck into a **real-time sentiment engine**.

---

### 🧑‍💻 Collaboration Chaos: Git for the First Time

Half our team used Git for the first time — during a hackathon.

We faced:

* Merge conflicts on shared files like `index.html`
* Lost commits from incorrect pulls
* Confusion over branching and pushing

We recovered by:

1. Assigning **ownership per module** (backend, frontend, UI).
2. Learning Git basics together live.
3. Committing small and frequently.
4. Restoring working versions via GitHub history.

By the end, the same team that struggled with Git merges was confidently collaborating in **true parallel development**.

---

### 🎯 Frontend Integration: The Chart–Sentiment Bridge Problem

After separate backend and frontend builds, integration became the hardest phase.

#### 🧩 The Early Struggle — Highcharts

We first tried **Highcharts**, but it wasn’t robust enough:

* Performance drops on large datasets
* Weak overlay support
* Inconsistent OHLC rendering

We switched to **TradingView Lightweight Charts**, which offered:

* Smooth performance
* Professional-grade rendering
* Perfect control for financial overlays

#### ⚙️ Integration Issues

* Timestamp mismatches
* Async render delays
* Tooltip desync between sentiment and candles

#### ✅ Our Fix

* Unified timestamps in UTC
* Merged data into one payload from Flask
* Deferred rendering until all data fetched
* Synced sentiment highlights with chart hover

This finally gave Sentichart a seamless, responsive experience.

---

### 💸 The API Limitation Wall

We were restricted to **free-tier APIs and libraries**, including:

* NewsAPI (100 requests/day, 30-day history)
* yFinance (rate-limited)
* Hugging Face (local-only FinBERT inference)

We adapted by caching data, batching requests, and preloading sentiment for key tickers.

---

### 🔍 The Search Bar Experiment: UX Meets API Limits

To enhance usability, we built a **ticker search bar**.
The plan: query live stock suggestions via API and auto-complete.

But due to API limits and broken keys, we couldn’t fetch symbols dynamically.
Instead, we **hardcoded popular tickers** (AAPL, TSLA, MSFT, NVDA, AMZN, GOOG) for demo use.
The modular system still supports swapping to live API search later — no structural rewrite needed.

---

### 🐞 Backend Bug Hunt: The Case of the Missing Indicators

Multi-line indicators like Bollinger Bands broke because `pandas_ta` created multiple columns.
We fixed this by detecting all new columns dynamically before returning data to the frontend.

---

### ⚖️ The Indicator Overload: When More Became Less

Some indicators (like Ichimoku Cloud and SuperTrend) proved unstable and unresponsive with our real-time structure.
We removed them to preserve chart fluidity and ensure consistent redraws.

The result: a stable, high-performance chart focused on reliability and clarity.

---

### 🔥 The Firewall Fiasco

Our API failed over LAN due to Windows Firewall restrictions.
We resolved it by adding an inbound rule for `python.exe`.

---

## 🎨 Frontend Evolution: The Quest for Clarity

Our frontend evolved through multiple failed experiments:

* **Attempt 1: Text Markers** — unreadable clutter.
* **Attempt 2: Histogram Bars** — clean but detached from price action.
* **Attempt 3: Elegant Dots** — visually nice but unclear in interaction.
* **✅ Final Solution:** A right-hand **Sentiment Timeline Panel**, combining clarity, detail, and performance.

**Open Track - Development**

### 1\. Transparent and Documented Development Journey

We didn’t just build the project — we documented its entire evolution.From environment setup challenges to design pivots and failed experiments, every major step is openly recorded in this README and in the GitHub commit history.

This transparency turns Sentichart AI into a real-world learning guide for future developers.

### 2\. Completely Open Tech Stack

The entire project was built using free and open-source technologies, including:

*   Python and Flask
    
*   PyTorch and CUDA
    
*   Hugging Face FinBERT
    
*   TradingView Lightweight Charts
    
*   yFinance and pandas-ta
    

There are no paid APIs, closed SDKs, or proprietary dependencies — ensuring that anyone can replicate and extend the project freely.

### 3\. Collaborative GitHub Workflow

Our hackathon team practiced open collaboration using Git and GitHub:

*   Every feature was developed on shared branches
    
*   Merge conflicts and fixes were handled publicly
    
*   New members learned Git in real time while contributing
    

By the end, we achieved true parallel development, with frontend, backend, and AI pipelines evolving together — all visible in the repository history.

### 4\. Modular and Extensible Architecture

Sentichart’s structure encourages open contribution:

*   The backend (Flask) handles data and AI inference
    
*   The frontend (HTML and JavaScript) visualizes charts and sentiment
    
*   Independent modules handle indicators, caching, and sentiment analysis
    

Developers can easily:

*   Plug in new models
    
*   Add more indicators
    
*   Integrate alternate APIs
    

It’s built not just to be used, but to be extended by the community.

### 5\. Educational and Reproducible

This project doubles as a hands-on learning resource.The README explains:

*   GPU acceleration with FinBERT
    
*   Flask API design
    
*   Chart integration and frontend optimization
    
*   Caching, aggregation, and API rate-limit handling
    

Anyone can follow these steps to learn how to build their own AI-powered financial analytics app using only open tools.

### 6\. Open Decision-Making and Iterative Design

Every major pivot — from Highcharts to Lightweight Charts, from sentiment dots to side panels — was made publicly and documented.We showed what worked, what failed, and why we made each change.

This honesty in evolution embodies the spirit of open development: sharing the process, not just the result.

### 7\. Built to Encourage Future Collaboration

We deliberately released Sentichart AI as a community-ready foundation:

*   Developers can fork and enhance it
    
*   Researchers can test new sentiment models
    
*   Students can study its code structure as a real-world AI integration example
    

It’s meant to grow beyond our hackathon, evolving with every new contributor.

### Summary

Sentichart AI fits the Open Development Track because it is:

*   Fully open-source and transparent
    
*   Documented in real time
    
*   Built collaboratively on GitHub
    
*   Technically extensible and reproducible
    
*   Educational and publicly accessible

**The problem it solves**

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/3b00dabc541e4efdb2ee4fcc8b7276c9/a81ce42a-a064-40d4-afb8-4a08b32e91af.png)
Most people struggle to manage their finances because traditional expense trackers are manual, boring, and disconnected from real-life usage. Common pain points include:


- Manual data entry fatigue — Nobody wants to type every expense from receipts.
- UPI payments are instant, but tracking them isn’t — People spend digitally but record manually.
- Travellers and freelancers deal with multiple currencies, and switching calculators breaks the flow.
- Using the app on multiple devices means starting from zero — no native sync.
- Language barriers stop non-English users from adopting finance tools.
- Data lock-in — Most apps don’t allow easy export for backup or sharing.

FINFIT solves all of this with automation and intelligence:


- ✅ OCR-based Receipt Scanning — Just click a photo and expenses auto-fill.
- ✅ Deep Link UPI Recording — Pay via Google Pay / PhonePe / Paytm and log it instantly.
- ✅ Multi-Currency Support with Live Exchange Rates — Seamless tracking across countries.
- ✅ QR-Based Multi-Device Sync — Continue finances from any phone without cloud login complexities.
- ✅ Multi-Language Interface — Breaking language barriers in financial literacy.
- ✅ Export in PDF / CSV / JSON — Full control over your data.
- 

FINFIT isn’t just an expense log — it’s your financial companion that adapts to how you actually spend.

**Challenges we ran into**

Building FINFIT came with several interesting hurdles:

- State Management Across Multiple Features: With modules like analytics, chatbot, OCR, and budgeting running simultaneously, keeping the app’s global state
- consistent without performance drops was challenging. We had to optimize our data flow and reduce unnecessary re-renders.
- QR-Based Data Sync Implementation: Designing a reliable cross-device sync without a cloud backend initially caused version conflicts. We solved this by generating compact, checksum-validated JSON payloads to ensure data integrity.
- OCR Accuracy & Formatting Issues: Raw OCR output was often inconsistent across fonts and receipt layouts, so we implemented regex-based post-processing to auto-correct misread values.
- AI Chatbot Response Latency: The Google Gemini API occasionally caused noticeable delays. To enhance UX, we added loading placeholders and fallback canned responses.
- Chart Rendering in React Native: Some chart libraries caused crashes on lower-end devices. We had to carefully benchmark options and optimize animations for smoother transitions.

**The problem it solves**

# Namma-Vani: Voice Pathology Analysis System

## What is Namma-Vani?

Namma-Vani is an AI-powered voice pathology analysis system that provides professional-grade voice health monitoring and diagnostics through accessible technology. It enables users to analyze their voice for disorders such as laryngitis and vocal polyps, assess voice quality, and track improvements over time without needing expensive equipment or specialist consultations.

Key Features:
- AI-based objective voice diagnosis using acoustic features like jitter, shimmer, and MFCC patterns
- Instant voice analysis reports
- WhatsApp integration and web-based platform
- Personal dashboards, exercise recommendations, and progress tracking
- Doctor locator, healthcare provider search, and specialist profiles
- AI Health Assistant (AudiBuddy) offering personalized guidance and educational content
- Secure, HIPAA-compliant data handling

---

## Why Namma-Vani?

Voice disorders are common but often overlooked or diagnosed late due to multiple barriers:

### The Challenges
- **Limited Access:** Many people, especially in rural areas, lack access to specialized ENT doctors and voice pathology experts.
- **Cost Barriers:** Professional voice analysis equipment and consultations can be expensive.
- **Early Detection Gap:** Voice problems often go undetected until they become severe.
- **Time Constraints:** Getting appointments with specialists can take weeks or months.
- **Subjective Assessment:** Traditional evaluations can be inconsistent and based on subjective judgment.

### The Benefits of Namma-Vani
- **Early Detection:** Identify issues before they become severe and intervene early.
- **Cost-Effective:** Reduce healthcare expenses by minimizing unnecessary specialist visits.
- **Accessibility:** Available anytime, anywhere, with only a smartphone or computer.
- **Data-Driven Insights:** Provide objective metrics to track changes over time and support better decision-making.
- **Privacy & Security:** Secure authentication and HIPAA-compliant handling of personal health data.

---

## How Does Namma-Vani Work?

### AI-Powered Voice Analysis
- Users record their voice and submit it via WhatsApp or the web platform.
- Machine learning models analyze the recording, evaluating conditions like laryngitis, vocal polyps, and voice quality issues.
- Results are provided instantly, with detailed acoustic analysis.

### Accessible Technology
- Supports multiple audio formats like WAV, MP3, and M4A.
- Simple interfaces designed for all users, from professionals to rural populations.

### Comprehensive Health Management
- Personal dashboards track voice health over time.
- Historical reports are available for review.
- Users receive exercise recommendations and progress tracking.

### Healthcare Navigation
- Interactive maps and location-based search tools help users find nearby ENT specialists and voice therapists.
- Access to detailed profiles and contact information of healthcare providers.

### AI Health Assistant (AudiBuddy)
- Provides 24/7 personalized advice based on user data.
- Offers educational content on voice care and prevention.

---

## Who Can Use Namma-Vani?

### Individuals
- Teachers, singers, call center agents, and public speakers.
- Anyone experiencing voice issues like hoarseness or fatigue.
- People seeking preventive care for voice health.
- Rural populations with limited access to specialists.

### Healthcare Providers
- Primary care doctors for quick screenings.
- ENT specialists for supplementary diagnostics and monitoring.
- Speech therapists for tracking progress and compliance.

### Educational Institutions
- Schools and universities for screening teachers and students.
- Music schools for monitoring vocal students and instructors.

---

## Real-World Use Cases

- **Teacher Voice Screening:** Regular monitoring of teachers' voice health.
- **Telemedicine Integration:** Support for virtual consultations.
- **Voice Therapy Monitoring:** Tracking progress during therapy.
- **Occupational Health:** Screening employees in voice-intensive jobs.
- **Rural Healthcare:** Providing access to voice analysis in underserved areas.

---

Namma-Vani empowers individuals and healthcare providers by making voice pathology analysis affordable, accessible, and accurate, ultimately improving early detection, treatment outcomes, and overall voice health.

**Challenges we ran into**

## Challenges We Ran Into

While building Namma-Vani, we faced several technical and practical hurdles that pushed us to work together and find creative solutions.

### Challenge 1 – Handling Noisy Voice Data
One of the biggest challenges we encountered was dealing with noisy and inconsistent audio recordings. Users submitted files recorded in different environments – some with background noise, others with poor microphone quality – which affected the accuracy of our voice analysis.

**How We Overcame It:**  
We implemented preprocessing techniques like noise reduction filters and normalization algorithms to clean the audio before it was analyzed. We also fine-tuned our machine learning models using datasets that included diverse recording conditions, which helped make the system more robust and reliable.

---

### Challenge 2 – Integrating WhatsApp for Audio Uploads
Integrating voice input through WhatsApp was another hurdle. The available APIs had limited support, and handling multiple audio formats securely added complexity to our system.

**How We Overcame It:**  
We built a middleware service that converted incoming audio files into a standard format (WAV) and ensured encrypted transmission. By testing extensively with real-world use cases and refining the process, we created a seamless and user-friendly experience.

---

### Challenge 3 – Ensuring Data Privacy and Compliance
Since Namma-Vani handles sensitive health data, ensuring privacy and compliance with standards like HIPAA was critical, but it made the system architecture more challenging.

**How We Overcame It:**  
We integrated secure authentication using Auth0 and implemented encrypted data storage. We also followed strict privacy protocols and best practices, which gave users confidence that their health data was safe.

---

### Challenge 4 – Providing Accurate Feedback in Real Time
Delivering scientifically accurate feedback instantly was difficult because of processing limitations and variability in users’ recordings.

**How We Overcame It:**  
We optimized our processing pipelines to handle features efficiently and used cloud-based compute resources to scale dynamically. By incorporating user feedback and running extensive tests, we improved both the speed and accuracy of our reports.

**The problem it solves**

## The Problem it Solves  

- **Fixes Broken Grievance Channels** – Current systems are fragmented and opaque, where complaints often get lost or remain unresolved. The solution centralizes everything into one transparent citizen–authority platform.  

- **Brings Speed & Efficiency** – AI-driven categorization, auto-routing, and SLA-based escalation cut resolution times drastically, replacing delays of months or years with faster, trackable outcomes.  

- **Ensures Accountability** – A structured 4-tier escalation (Agent → Municipal → State → Admin) prevents negligence, while transparent dashboards and immutable logs enforce responsibility at every stage.  

- **Reduces Stress & Inefficiency** – Smart workload balancing and auto-assignment minimize staff burnout, optimize manpower usage, and improve the consistency of service delivery.  

- **Restores Trust in Governance** – Real-time updates, multilingual accessibility, and community engagement features rebuild citizen confidence, strengthen democratic participation, and align with initiatives like Digital India and Smart Cities.

**Challenges we ran into**

1. *Dependency management*  
   We ran into a lot of errors from mismatched libraries and linting rules. It took time to clean up the environment, lock package versions, and set up proper checks to keep things consistent.

2. *Deployment on Akash*  
   Hosting on the Akash network was tricky, especially with DNS and routing. We finally solved it by tunneling through Cloudflare, which gave us stable access and SSL.

3. *AI workflow integration*  
   Getting the AI to categorize complaints across multiple languages without slowing things down was challenging. We used language detection with lightweight models first, and deferred heavier processing to keep it smooth.

4. *Offline-first attempt*  
   We tried to build offline complaint submission for low-connectivity areas, but syncing and conflict handling became too complex within the hackathon timeframe. This remains an area for future work.

5. *Media uploads*  
   Uploading large, geo-tagged photos often failed on weaker networks. We fixed this by compressing images on-device, making uploads resumable, and storing them securely in the cloud.

**The problem it solves**

# Problem Statement

## Context
Students often face the challenge of revising **huge notes or textbooks** before exams.  
Traditional revision methods—like rereading chapters or manually creating flashcards—are **time-consuming and inefficient**.

## The Problem
- Notes are often **long and unstructured**, making it difficult to quickly identify key points.  
- Students **waste time rewriting notes** into flashcards or summaries instead of focusing on actual revision.  
- Practice questions and quizzes are **not always available** for personalized study material.  
- In the days leading up to exams, students need **fast, effective, and personalized revision tools**.

## Impact
- Increased **stress and burnout** before exams.  
- Lower **knowledge retention** due to poor revision methods.  
- Students spend more time organizing study material than actually learning.  

## Why It Matters
A tool that can automatically transform students’ notes into **summaries, flashcards, and quizzes**:
- Saves hours of manual effort.  
- Makes revision more **interactive and engaging**.  
- Helps students **retain information better** by applying active recall techniques.  

In short: this project addresses the **last-mile problem of studying**—turning messy, overwhelming notes into **actionable, exam-ready learning aids**.

**Challenges we ran into**

## Challenges We Ran Into

- Parsing PDF files was harder than expected.  
- Setting up NextAuth gave errors with client/server components.  
- Managing API keys securely was confusing at first.  
- Getting clean JSON output from the AI sometimes failed.  
- Styling the app with Tailwind took extra time to learn.  
## What We Learned

- How to use Next.js App Router with APIs.  
- Basics of NextAuth and authentication in Next.js.  
- How to parse and extract text from PDF files.  
- Prompt engineering to get structured JSON from AI.  
- Teamwork and dividing tasks in a limited time.

**The problem it solves**

**🛠️ The Problem It Solves**

Farming is often challenged by unpredictable weather, inefficient irrigation, poor soil health awareness, and overuse of fertilizers. These issues lead to lower yields, wasted resources, and financial losses for farmers.

***AstroCrop*** helps solve these problems by:

🌱 *Soil Awareness* – Farmers can easily understand soil health (pH, nutrients, moisture) without needing lab expertise.

🌦 *Weather & Irrigation Guidance* – Provides real-time weather insights and water usage patterns to prevent over- or under-irrigation.

🤖 *AI Predictions* – Suggests the best crop choices, fertilizer schedules, and expected yield for smarter decision-making.

📑 *Downloadable Reports* – Generates clear, easy-to-read PDF reports so farmers can keep records and share with advisors.

*AstroCrop* makes farming simpler, safer, and more productive by combining data, AI, and user-friendly design.

**Challenges we ran into**

**⚡ Challenges I Ran Into**

Building AstroCrop wasn’t without hurdles. Some key challenges were:

🐛 Data Integration Issues – Collecting and cleaning soil and weather datasets was tricky. We solved this by using reliable APIs and preprocessing techniques.

🔗 Frontend–Backend Communication – Syncing real-time weather data with the prediction models caused delays. Fixed it by optimizing API calls and caching responses.

🎨 Farmer-Friendly UI – Designing a simple, multilingual interface was a challenge. We tested multiple layouts and used icons/visuals for easier understanding.

📄 PDF Generation – Exporting dynamic data (charts, recommendations, soil reports) into PDFs was initially buggy. We resolved it with libraries that handle structured layouts.

Each challenge taught us valuable lessons and made AstroCrop more robust and reliable.

> From Queue to Care, Faster.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Bootstrap](https://img.shields.io/badge/Bootstrap-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Express.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Express.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

****The Problem It Solves****

Hospitals across India face:

-  Long OPD queues → Patients wait for hours without knowing their turn.

-  Unclear bed availability → No real-time info about ICU, general, or private rooms.

-  Slow admission process → Manual paperwork and lack of transparency.
 
-  Poor emergency coordination → No centralized system for hospital transfers or load balancing.

These challenges lead to patient frustration, delayed treatment, and even risk to lives in critical cases.

**What People Can Use It For**

*Patients:*

- Get digital OPD tokens with live queue status.

- Know bed availability in real-time.
 
- Upload documents & complete admission online.
 
- Receive SMS/notifications when their turn is near.

*Hospitals*:

- Admin dashboards to track bed occupancy & patient flow.

- Doctors’ dashboard to see upcoming patients and manage workload.
 
- Reduced manual effort & better utilization of staff.

*City Health Systems:*

- A centralized view of hospitals for referrals & emergencies.

- Smarter ambulance routing during critical cases.
 
- Data-driven planning for healthcare infrastructure.

**How It Makes Tasks Easier & Safer**

- Cuts down waiting times for patients.
 
- Makes admissions transparent and faster.
 
- Improves emergency handling with priority logic.
 
- Ensures better hospital coordination during crises.
 
- Provides data security & compliance with NDHM standards.

**Challenges we ran into**

****Challenges I Ran Into****

**1. Real-Time Updates**

*Problem*: Displaying OPD queues and bed availability in real-time was challenging. We faced delays while syncing Firebase sockets and APIs.

*Solution*: We implemented a hybrid approach using WebSockets and Firebase Realtime Database, ensuring instant updates for both notifications and dashboards.

**2. Data Privacy & Security**

*Problem*: Handling sensitive patient data required robust authentication and access control.

*Solution*: We adopted JWT-based authentication with strict role-based access (Patient, Doctor, Admin) to keep the data secure and compliant.

**3. Integration with Existing Hospital Systems**

*Problem*: Every hospital uses different legacy systems, which made data exchange difficult.

*Solution*: We designed standardized REST APIs and kept our architecture flexible to align with FHIR (Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources) standards in the future.

**4. Scalability Testing**

*Problem*: The initial prototype worked for a single hospital, but performance dropped when simulating city-wide scaling.

*Solution*: We optimized database queries, added indexing, and conducted load testing to make the system more scalable and reliable.

### AstroGeo AI
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/astrogeo-ai-c058) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/AstroGeoAI/AstroGeoAI-Core) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://astrogeoai.wixstudio.com/astrogeo) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Zero's%20Arena%2001-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://zeros-arena-1.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-4-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Exploring Space and Earth Through AI

![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Natural language processing (NLP)](https://img.shields.io/badge/Natural%20language%20processing%20(NLP)-333333?style=flat-square) ![Hugging Face](https://img.shields.io/badge/Hugging%20Face-333333?style=flat-square) ![Gradio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Gradio-333333?style=flat-square) ![langchain](https://img.shields.io/badge/langchain-333333?style=flat-square) ![LLM](https://img.shields.io/badge/LLM-333333?style=flat-square) ![RAG](https://img.shields.io/badge/RAG-333333?style=flat-square) ![Vector DB](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vector%20DB-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Scientific data from ISRO portals (like MOSDAC, VEDAS, and Bhuvan) is incredibly valuable for research in astronomy, geoscience, and Earth observation.
But there’s a big hurdle:

🔹 Scattered Data Sources → Information is spread across multiple ISRO platforms, each with its own interface, formats, and search systems.

🔹 High Learning Curve → Non-experts and students often struggle to find relevant datasets because technical jargon and portal-specific structures make it hard.

🔹 Slow Knowledge Access → Researchers spend more time navigating portals than actually analyzing scientific data.

**What AstroGeo AI Does**

AstroGeo AI makes this process simpler, smarter, and faster:

**Unified Query System **→ Instead of hopping between portals, users can just ask questions in plain English like “Show me Mars data” or “What causes earthquakes?”.

**AI-Powered Understanding** → Our LLM + RAG setup classifies whether the query is about astronomy, geoscience, or both, and then routes it to the right knowledge/data source.

** ISRO Data Integration **→ By connecting with multiple portals (e.g., MOSDAC, VEDAS), it fetches real datasets, satellite related information, and contextual knowledge in one place.


**Accessible for Everyone** → Students, researchers, and even enthusiasts can explore space and Earth science without deep technical expertise.

**Challenges we ran into**

One big hurdle we ran into while building AstroGeo AI was GPU and resource limitations while handling large language models and dataset queries.
During training and inference with scientific text (astronomy + geoscience data), the models either crashed due to memory overload or became extremely slow on CPU.

 **How We Solved It
**
Model Optimization → Instead of running full-sized models, we switched to smaller LLM variants (distilled/optimized Hugging Face models) for classification and response generation.

RAG Approach → We offloaded heavy reasoning to a retrieval-augmented system: first retrieving only the relevant scientific context, then passing it into the LLM — reducing token load and memory usage.

Fallbacks → If GPU wasn’t available, the system gracefully switched to keyword-based classification + knowledge-base responses as a lightweight fallback.
