**The problem it solves**

“OPTRA: Turning surgical stress into smart success.”
OPTRA is an AI-powered, all-in-one surgery management platform designed to simplify hospital operations and reduce surgical stress. It combines a Smart Dashboard, AI Scheduler, and OptraBot assistant to optimize surgery planning, staff allocation, and equipment management—even during festivals, epidemics, or sudden surges in patient load.

With features like patient management, real-time notifications, inventory tracking, emergency mode, and predictive analytics, OPTRA ensures seamless coordination between doctors, staff, and patients. Additional modules such as ambulance tracking, government scheme integration (Ayushman Bharat), teleconsultation portals, and hospital analytics make healthcare more accessible, efficient, and patient-centric.

By automating routine tasks, predicting high-demand periods, and providing actionable insights, OPTRA truly turns surgical stress into smart success, improving outcomes for hospitals, staff, and patients alike.

**Challenges we ran into**

While developing OPTRA: Turning Surgical Stress into Smart Success, our team faced a few key challenges:

Data Collection & Simulation:
Getting real-time stress data from surgeons was impossible due to privacy and medical restrictions.
🔧 Solution: We used simulated physiological data (heart rate, pulse, body temperature) and built a synthetic dataset using Python to train our model.

Model Accuracy:
Initially, our stress prediction model gave inconsistent results because of limited data variety.
🔧 Solution: We applied data normalization, feature scaling, and tested different ML algorithms (Logistic Regression, Random Forest) to improve accuracy.

Team Coordination:
Working remotely made it tough to merge our individual parts (UI, ML model, presentation).
🔧 Solution: We used GitHub for version control and held short daily sync calls to stay aligned.

Time Constraint:
We had limited time to develop a working prototype for the hackathon.
🔧 Solution: We divided tasks smartly — data & ML (me + teammate A), UI/UX (teammate B), documentation & presentation (team lead).

**Link to the GitHub Repo of your project**

https://github.com/Tadashya/Optra

**Live URL of your project**

https://rb.gy/vwf4z5

**What is your product’s unique value proposition?**

Optra transforms chaotic and stressful surgical management into a smart, data-driven, and coordinated system using AI.
It acts as an all-in-one intelligent assistant for hospitals — integrating AI scheduling, real-time dashboards, patient data, doctor-staff coordination, and emergency automation under one unified platform.

By predicting needs, automating workflows, and ensuring seamless communication, Optra minimizes surgical delays, human errors, and stress, leading to smarter decisions, faster operations, and safer outcomes.

**Who is your target customer?**

1. Hospitals & Healthcare Institutions

Especially multi-specialty hospitals and surgical centers that manage multiple operations daily.

They need a system to optimize scheduling, resource use, and communication among teams.



2. Doctors & Surgeons

Professionals who want efficient scheduling, instant patient data access, and real-time coordination during surgeries.



3. Hospital Administrators & Management Teams

They benefit from real-time dashboards, AI insights, and automated reports for better hospital operations and decision-making.



4. Emergency Response Units (Ambulance Services)

They can use Optra’s emergency and ambulance tracker for faster coordination and patient handling.



5. Patients

Indirect users who gain from better-managed surgeries, faster responses, and transparent billing & consultation.

**Who are your closest competitors and how are you different?**

Closest competitors:
LeanTaaS — iQueue (Operating Rooms / Surgical Clinics) — AI/ML platform focused on predictive analytics and prescriptive scheduling to boost OR utilization and reduce cancellations. 


Qventus — AI-driven hospital operations automation (patient flow, OR utilization, throughput). Focuses on real-time automation to reduce bottlenecks and staff workload. 


Epic (OpTime / OR Capacity) — Enterprise EHR vendor with a mature OR management/scheduling module integrated into the hospital EHR; strong on case documentation, analytics, and institutional integration. 


Cerner / Other EHR OR modules — Traditional large-system EHR suites that include surgical scheduling & perioperative workflows; enterprise-grade but often monolithic and complex to customize.

How Optra is different:
End-to-end surgical lifecycle (clinic → ambulance → OR → discharge)
Optra ties ambulance tracking + emergency mode, inventory readiness and OR scheduling together — not just analytics for scheduling. (Competitors mainly focus on OR utilization or EHR workflows).

Emergency-first automation & ambulance tracker
Automatic ambulance activation + live location feeding into the OR prep workflow (reduces handoff delays). This fills a real gap versus scheduling-only platforms.

Clinician-centric AI browser + lightweight UX
A fast, mobile/desktop AI interface for surgeons and staff (smart notifications, assistant, chat/notes) designed to reduce stress and cognitive load — instead of bulky EHR screens.

Patient-facing real-time consultation + transparent billing
Teleconsult + integrated billing with scheme handling (government schemes) — helps patient experience and financial transparency, a feature set not the primary focus of LeanTaaS/Qventus.

Inventory + emergency resource orchestration
Automatic supply/equipment checks and pre-op resource allocation (so the OR is ready when the ambulance arrives). This combines logistics + scheduling.

Modular & affordable for small→medium hospitals / ASCs
While Epic/Cerner target large enterprise hospitals and LeanTaaS/Qventus sell to large systems, Optra can be positioned as a modular, lower-friction solution that small hospitals and surgical centers can adopt quickly.

**What is your distribution strategy and why?**

1. Target Users:

Surgeons, surgical trainees, and hospital administrators.

Medical institutions aiming to reduce surgical stress and improve efficiency.

2. How We Plan to Reach Users:

a. Direct Sales / B2B Outreach

Approach hospitals, clinics, and surgical centers directly.

Demo OPTRA’s platform to show stress reduction and efficiency improvements.

Why it fits: Surgeons and hospitals are decision-makers who prefer hands-on demonstrations for clinical tools.

b. Partnerships with Medical Institutions & Training Centers

Collaborate with medical colleges and surgical training programs.

Integrate OPTRA as a complementary tool for training and stress management.

Why it fits: Trusted institutions can endorse OPTRA, giving credibility and faster adoption.

c. Community-driven Engagement

Build a network of early adopters (surgeons & trainees) who can share their success stories.

Use webinars, forums, and social media groups for medical professionals.

Why it fits: Surgeons value peer recommendations and case studies over generic advertising.

d. Paid Acquisition (Optional / Targeted)

Run targeted ads on professional networks like LinkedIn or medical journals.

Focus on regions with high concentration of surgical centers.

Why it fits: Helps reach hospitals or surgeons who may not be in the immediate network.

3. Why This Approach Works:

Combines trust-building (via partnerships and community) with direct influence (direct sales demos).

Efficient for a B2B healthcare product where credibility and proof of efficacy are key.

Minimizes wasted marketing spend while ensuring adoption by key decision-makers.

**Description of your solution**

**DhanSaathi-** Empowering Earners with Smarter Money

**1. What We Plan to Build**

We are developing DhanSaathi, an AI-powered autonomous financial coaching app designed specifically for gig workers, informal sector employees, and individuals with irregular incomes. DhanSaathi integrates an advanced Agentic AI agent that continuously learns from users' spending behavior, income variability, and financial goals by securely aggregating data from banking, digital wallets, and gig platforms. The AI agent proactively delivers personalized budgeting advice, savings nudges, risk alerts, and financial goal tracking through conversational chat and app notifications, helping users optimize their finances in real time despite unstable cash flows.

**2. What Specific Pain Points Does It Address**

- **Irregular Income Volatility:** Gig and informal workers face unpredictable earnings, making budgeting and saving very challenging.
- **Lack of Personalized Guidance:** Existing financial tools offer static advice that doesn’t adapt to changing cash flows.
- **Financial Uncertainty and Stress:** Missed payments, overdraft fees, and insufficient emergency savings are common problems.
- **Behavioral Barriers:** Difficulty planning, inconsistent saving habits, and reactive spending habits increase financial vulnerability.
- **Limited Financial Literacy:** Many lack easy-to-understand, actionable financial coaching tailored to their unique situations.

**Who Is the Target Audience?**

- Gig economy workers: delivery riders(Ola, Swiggy, etc.), rideshare drivers, freelancers.
- Informal sector employees: contract laborers, artisans, daily wage earners.
- Everyday earners managing multiple income streams or seasonal earnings with limited access to financial services.
- Especially focused on urban, semi-urban, and regional Indian populations.

**4. GTM (Go-To-Market) & Revenue Streams**
**Go-To-Market Strategy:**

- Build partnerships with gig economy platforms and fintech startups to embed DhanSaathi AI within existing apps.
- Collaborate with government welfare schemes and NGOs to enhance financial inclusion in underserved communities.
- Launch direct-to-consumer apps with vernacular language support targeting Tier 2/3 cities.
- Use community referral programs and financial literacy campaigns for wider adoption.

**Revenue Streams:**

- Freemium subscription model with basic coaching free and premium advanced features (goal automation, investment tips).
- B2B SaaS licensing to gig platforms, fintech, and financial institutions for scalable integration.
- Referral commissions from regulated financial products (loans, insurance) with user consent.
- Anonymized data analytics to financial ecosystem partners supporting product development and targeting.

**5. Technologies Used and Leveraging Agentic AI**

- **Agentic AI Architecture:** Implements observe–reason–plan–act loops enabling autonomous, adaptive financial coaching. The AI agent perceives changing user data, reasons about risks and opportunities, plans personalized actions, and executes nudges or recommendations automatically.

- **Reinforcement Learning (RL):** Continuously improves coaching strategies by learning from user interactions, financial outcomes, and feedback signals, enabling a dynamic, personalized experience that evolves over time.

- **Explainable Machine Learning:** Provides transparent and interpretable recommendations, increasing user trust and meeting regulatory compliance by explaining the rationale and confidence behind advice.

- **Natural Language Processing (NLP):** Powers conversational interfaces allowing users to interact naturally with the AI agent via chatbots and voice assistants for intuitive guidance.

- **Secure API Integrations:** Connects securely with banking APIs, digital wallets, and gig platforms for real-time ingestion of financial transaction data under strict user consent and encrypted channels.

- **Cloud-Native Backend:** Scalable, serverless cloud infrastructure hosted on AWS with microservices architecture supporting AI workloads and seamless updates.

- **Mobile-First Frontend:** React Native app delivering a responsive, user-friendly interface optimized for diverse device capabilities and regional languages.

- **Robust Privacy & Compliance:** End-to-end encryption, GDPR and local data protection compliance, role-based access controls, and audit logging uphold user privacy and security.

DhanSaathi addresses core challenges faced by millions of gig workers, informal sector employees, and everyday earners in India who manage highly irregular and unpredictable incomes. The Fintech track focuses on innovative financial solutions that promote inclusion, resilience, and smart money management—exactly what DhanSaathi delivers through cutting-edge AI technology.

Our project leverages Agentic AI to build an autonomous, continuously learning financial coaching agent that transforms dispersed financial data into personalized, proactive advice. This goes beyond traditional budgeting apps and static tools by adapting in real time to unique income flows and spending behaviors, delivering explainable, trustworthy guidance.

By integrating securely with banking, digital wallets, and gig economy platforms, and focusing on underserved segments, DhanSaathi fosters greater financial inclusion, reduces financial stress, and promotes sustainable money habits. ![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

Envesto: A Personal Finance AI Coach for Freelancers

In freelance work, daily earnings can be earned here and there- here a little and there a little more. Inconsistent pay does not have the same results as a steady paycheck. Thinking of saving here and there and investing in the future is not only intimidating but also seems impossible.

Envesto solves this.

Envesto is a web-based AI financial coach that operates on a conversational bot. Instead of using complex apps, users are able to utilize simple chat. An income report can be submitted by stating: "I earned ₹900 today." From that point, Envesto analyzes habits, predicts cash flow, and recommends amounts to save or invest that are secure.

After completing a brief risk assessment, it creates an investment profile customized to the user's needs, communicated with simple, jargon-free English. Envesto’s AI uses market data to simulate small investments and keeps updating the user’s simulated portfolio daily. When the markets go down, instead of worrying, it encourages and teaches users, using the situation as a lesson.

Envesto humanizes financial management by turning it into a daily dialogue, which helps gig workers from anywhere in the world to effortlessly manage and grow their finances.

**Fintech: Build an autonomous financial coaching agent that adapts to real user behavior, spending patterns, and income variability - helping gig workers, informal sector employees, and everyday citizens make smarter financial decisions proactively.**

The income is never steady for gig workers and employees in the informal sector. There's a possibility of earning a lot on one day, and the next day there is practically nothing to show for. Expenses are consistent. Such persistent unpredictability is not accounted for by traditional financial apps, which assume the presence of a standard salary. Envesto looks at the problem from a fresh angle.

Through its conversational web bot, users can input earnings and expenses as if talking with a friend: “Earned ₹900 today,” or “Spent ₹200 on fuel.” Envesto captures the information instantly, analyzes the old records, and makes cash flow projections. Elasto gently encourages users to invest safely during periods of high income; during low income, it shifts the user’s attention to expense control and protection. Its Smart-Save algorithm balances a safety buffer with micro-investment recommendations, while its mock investment engine familiarizes users with portfolio behaviour in real markets.

Through its ability to adjust to seasonally varying income and spending patterns, as well as to changing user behaviour, Envesto epitomizes the essence of this track—a self-driven, virtual guide that enables gig workers and the general public to take a more informed and anticipatory approach to personal finance.

**Description of your solution**

**Our Solution – FactGuard AI**

An Agentic-AI powered misinformation early-warning and fact-checking platform that autonomously detects, verifies, and explains misinformation in real time, with a focus on India-specific challenges.

**Core Features**

**Continuous Multi-Source Monitoring**

- Scans **news portals, social media** (Twitter/X, YouTube transcripts), and **WhatsApp** forwards (via crowdsourcing).
- Real-time ingestion and analysis of text, images, and video content.

**Multilingual Support**

- Coverage across  **English, Hindi, Marathi, Gujarati, Tamil, and other Indian languages**.
- Automatic translation and response generation to make fact-checks accessible nationwide.

**Emerging Misinformation Detection**

- Uses **NLP** and trend analysis to identify suspicious, fast-spreading claims.
- Detects anomalies in virality and **linguistic patterns** (e.g., sudden spikes in “garlic cures COVID”).

**Fact Verification Engine**

- Cross-references claims with trusted authorities: **WHO, ICMR, PIB Fact Check, Election Commission**.
- Employs **knowledge graphs, stance detection**, and media forensics (reverse image search, deepfake checks).

**Credibility Score (0–100)**

- Each claim is assigned a trust score based on **evidence strength**, source reliability, and propagation anomalies


**Contextual Citizen-Friendly Updates**

- Generates clear explanations of why a claim is false instead of just labeling it.
- **Example**: During COVID-19, could flag “garlic cures coronavirus” claims, verify against ICMR advisories, and issue corrections in Hindi/English.
- **Example**: During elections, flags fake images/quotes of candidates circulating in Marathi or Hindi, pushing factual context within minutes.

**Human-in-the-Loop Verification**

- Analysts get an **internal dashboard** to review AI outputs, adjust scores, and approve public updates.
- Feedback loop ensures continuous learning and accuracy improvement.



**Prototype Website Features**

- **Public Dashboard** – trending rumors, real-time credibility scores, and crisis alerts.
- **Fact-Check Feed** – searchable archive of claims with evidence and verdicts.
- **Ask/Report Interface** – citizens can submit suspicious claims for AI verification.
- **Subscription Alerts** – users receive push/email/WhatsApp notifications for critical misinformation debunks.
- **Admin Dashboard** – fact-checker tools for claim review, knowledge-base management, and analytics. 



**Vision**

Our long-term vision is to build an “information radar” for society — where autonomous AI agents continuously track and neutralize misinformation as fast as it spreads. By ensuring multilingual coverage, explainable AI outputs, and citizen-friendly alerts, FactGuard AI aims to strengthen public trust, safeguard communities, and make truth travel as fast as falsehoods.

**Misinformation: Create an Agentic AI system that continuously scans multiple sources of information, detects emerging misinformation, verifies facts, and provides easy-to-understand, contextual updates to the public during crises.**

**FactGuard AI** directly addresses the challenge of misinformation by acting as an Agentic AI system that autonomously scans diverse information sources — **news portals, social media, and WhatsApp** forwards — in multiple Indian languages. It detects emerging rumors and false claims using NLP and trend analysis, verifies them against trusted authorities (**WHO, ICMR, PIB Fact Check, Election Commission**), and then generates easy-to-understand, contextual updates for citizens. With features like a **credibility score** (0–100), multilingual alerts, and citizen-friendly explanations, it ensures that truth travels as fast as misinformation, fulfilling the track requirement of continuous scanning, detection, verification, and clear communication during crises.

**Description of your solution**

CareDose is an AI-powered medicine management system designed to ensure patients take the right medicine at the right time. The solution uses OCR to scan pill bottles or prescriptions, automatically extracting medicine names, dosages, and schedules to eliminate manual entry errors.

It then provides AI-driven reminders and alerts to prevent missed doses. If a patient misses multiple reminders, the agentic AI takes proactive action by notifying caregivers or doctors. CareDose also checks for dangerous drug interactions, flagging risky combinations before they cause harm.

The system maintains a complete history of medications taken or missed, helping patients and doctors track adherence and recovery progress. Based on this data, CareDose can estimate recovery timelines and suggest appropriate times for follow-up doctor visits.

This end-to-end approach makes CareDose more than just a reminder app — it is an intelligent, proactive agent that actively safeguards patient health and improves outcomes.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

CareDose fits this HealthTech track because it tackles one of the most common and dangerous problems in healthcare: medication mismanagement. Patients often forget their doses, take the wrong medicine, or mix drugs that cause harmful side effects. CareDose solves this with OCR-powered input — patients simply scan a pill bottle or prescription, and the system automatically extracts the name, dosage, and frequency to create a personalized schedule with no manual effort. Beyond reminders, CareDose uses agentic AI to take proactive action: if multiple doses are missed, it immediately alerts caregivers or doctors through SMS, WhatsApp, or email. It also runs continuous drug interaction checks, warns about risky combinations, and suggests refills before stock runs out. With built-in history tracking, it records every dose taken or missed and analyzes progress over time. Based on this data, CareDose can estimate how much recovery is possible within specific months for a given medicine range and recommend when the patient should visit their doctor for follow-up. This combination of OCR automation, proactive AI actions, safety checks, recovery insights, and intelligent doctor visit suggestions makes CareDose a complete, impactful, and demo-ready solution that demonstrates the true potential of agentic AI in healthcare.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

SmartJar: Agentic Financial Stability for Delivery Riders
Core Problem: Delivery riders (e.g., Zomato, Swiggy, Uber Eats) face severe, daily income volatility. They often manage their finances entirely through cash or immediate transfers, lacking the structure, discipline, and personalized tools needed to transition from immediate earnings to long-term stability. Traditional finance apps are irrelevant because they cannot handle the daily, unpredictable cash flow and often assume a fixed income schedule.

Solution Overview
SmartJar is a proactive, AI-driven financial wellness application designed exclusively for delivery riders. It leverages real-time income tracking and a suite of specialized agents to automate the creation of savings, ensuring riders build financial safety nets despite their volatile daily earnings.

Key Features and Functionality
1. Seamless Income Tracking & Allocation

Screenshot-to-Data Parsing (Gemini Vision): Riders upload payout screenshots from delivery apps. The Gemini Vision API processes the image, extracts the exact income amount and source, and automatically structures the data.

Technical Detail: This eliminates manual entry, feeding critical, real-time data directly into the MERN backend.

Dynamic 3-Jar System: Income is instantly and automatically split across three dedicated jars: Salary, Emergency, and Future, based on a personalized percentage determined by the Initial Budget Allocation Agent.

2. Two-Tiered Agent Architecture

SmartJar's intelligence is defined by its segregated agent roles:

Tier 1: Proactive Fund Manager Agents (Python Backend)
These agents are built in Python for complex logic and run scheduled checks, operating as automated, specialized fund managers for each jar.

Initial Budget Allocation Agent: Calculates the optimal initial 3-Jar percentage split based on the rider's onboarding goals and financial stress points.

Salary Fund Manager Agent (Automated Sweep):

Role: Manages the daily spending jar.

Action: If a spending surplus is detected for consecutive days, the agent automatically executes a fund sweep, transferring a portion of the excess balance into the Emergency and Future Jars.

Emergency Fund Manager Agent:

Role: Manages the safety net target.

Action: If the fund is critically low, the agent identifies large incoming payments and proactively nudges the user to make a one-time bonus contribution to the safety net.

Future Fund Manager Agent:

Role: Manages long-term goal projections.

Action: If a long-term goal is projected to be missed, the agent recommends increasing the jar's allocation percentage for a defined period.

Tier 2: Conversational General Agent (Gemini Pro)
This is the user-facing interface for advice and education.

AI Financial Coach (General Agent): Powered by Gemini Pro, this agent handles all conversational queries. Its primary focus is explaining the 3-Jar system, budget optimization, and behavioral finance. It provides context-aware advice using analogies familiar to delivery work (e.g., "Bike Maintenance Buffer," "Rainy Day Fund").

3. Gamification and Habit Formation

Streaks and Badges: Integrated into the React frontend to reward consistent income logging and saving behavior (e.g., "Daily Streak Champion").

**Fintech: Build an autonomous financial coaching agent that adapts to real user behavior, spending patterns, and income variability - helping gig workers, informal sector employees, and everyday citizens make smarter financial decisions proactively.**

We’ve built a lightweight AI financial coaching agent called SmartJar that learns from user data like income frequency, savings behavior, and goal-setting habits. It parses manual and visual data (screenshot uploads), analyzes risk (e.g., depleted emergency funds), and proactively nudges the user through a friendly, gamified chat interface. Powered by GPT-4o, it delivers personalized, culturally-aware financial advice — like a coach in their pocket.

**Description of your solution**

Track: Misinformation

Problem Statement Type: Bring Your Own Problem Statement
Title: AgriTruth – Cultivating Truth, Harvesting Trust

AgriTruth is an agentic AI platform designed to protect Indian farmers from the growing problem of fake agricultural advice circulating on WhatsApp, YouTube, and regional forums. Millions of farmers encounter misleading recommendations such as “spray cola for pests” or “miracle fertilizers,” which often result in crop loss, financial damage, and reduced yield. Existing fact-checking tools are either slow, non-localized, or inaccessible to rural communities. Our solution leverages AI agents that continuously scan digital channels, automatically identify misinformation, and verify claims against trusted agricultural databases like ICAR, Krishi Vigyan Kendra, and Agmarknet. Once misinformation is detected, AgriTruth sends verified guidance in farmers’ native languages via WhatsApp, SMS, or a lightweight mobile app, ensuring accessibility even for low-literacy users. AgriTruth’s AI learns over time, detecting new misinformation patterns and adapting to regional crops, local pests, and trending myths, providing actionable, science-backed recommendations that reduce crop failure and financial loss. The platform also generates valuable insights for government agencies, NGOs, and agri-tech startups to design proactive interventions. AgriTruth addresses key pain points, including the rapid spread of fake agricultural advice, low digital literacy, the absence of real-time verification tools, economic risks due to misinformation, and limited access to expert advisory support. Its primary audience is Indian farmers, with secondary beneficiaries including agricultural officers, Krishi Vigyan Kendras, NGOs, and extension workers, and tertiary audiences such as agri-tech companies and research institutions. The GTM strategy focuses on district-level pilots in collaboration with KVKs, WhatsApp, and mobile app deployment for accessibility, partnerships with government departments and NGOs, and awareness campaigns via local radio and community groups, ensuring the service is completely free for farmers. Sustainability comes from government and NGO grants, CSR sponsorships, enterprise analytics on anonymized data, and public-private partnerships, while maintaining farmer privacy and free access. By combining multilingual NLP, LLM-powered explanation agents, and structured agricultural knowledge bases, AgriTruth is technically feasible, scalable nationwide, and has the potential to transform rural India’s agricultural decision-making, empowering millions of farmers with trusted, actionable information.

**Misinformation: Bring your own problem in Misinformation, leveraging Agentic AI.**

AgriTruth directly addresses the spread of misinformation in agriculture, a critical but underexplored problem affecting millions of farmers in India. By leveraging agentic AI, the platform continuously monitors social media, WhatsApp, YouTube, and regional forums to detect misleading farming advice, verify claims against trusted agricultural databases like ICAR and Krishi Vigyan Kendra, and provide accurate, science-backed guidance in farmers’ native languages. This aligns perfectly with the Misinformation track’s goal of building AI agents that identify, verify, and correct false information, while creating a real-world, high-impact solution that protects livelihoods, reduces economic loss, and empowers rural communities. AgriTruth is not just a fact-checking tool; it is a proactive, learning agent designed to detect emerging misinformation patterns and deliver actionable insights, embodying the essence of the Misinformation track and satisfying the hackathon’s requirement for agentic AI-driven solutions.

**Problem Statement:**
Many patients performing physiotherapy at home make incorrect movements or stop due to pain, since physiotherapists cannot monitor them constantly. These errors slow recovery and can cause complications. We need an agentic AI system that can observe patient movements through a camera, detect posture deviations, communicate corrective feedback in real time, and adapt exercise difficulty based on the patient’s real-world condition.

**Proposed Solution:**
PhysioMind is an AI-driven rehabilitation companion designed to enhance the physiotherapy and recovery experience through intelligent, empathetic, and personalized care. It bridges the gap between patients and healthcare professionals by offering continuous monitoring, real-time feedback, and motivation — all powered by artificial intelligence.

**Core Features & Functionality**

1. Integrates Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing (NLP), and Predictive Analytics to deliver individualized therapy guidance.

2. Observes and analyzes patient movements to detect errors in exercise execution.

## A Multi-Agent AI System for Predictive ICU and Oxygen Demand Management in Emerging Cities


**MedLyf** is an AI-powered predictive healthcare platform designed to forecast ICU and oxygen demand across hospitals in Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities of India. The system addresses the critical oxygen shortage challenges exposed during COVID-19 by transforming reactive crisis management into **proactive predictive healthcare.**
By forecasting demand **up to 7 days** in advance, optimizing resource allocation and coordinating multilingual logistics, MedLyf ensures healthcare systems can anticipate and respond to surges before they become crises.

# The Problem
During COVID-19, Tier-2 and Tier-3 Indian cities faced catastrophic oxygen shortages due to reactive crisis management instead of predictive planning. Preventable deaths occurred when resources remained unused at some hospitals while others faced critical shortages.

# The Solution
MedLyf forecasts ICU bed requirements and oxygen demand up to 7 days in advance using autonomous AI agents, enabling proactive resource allocation before crises develop.

# System Architecture: Six Autonomous Agents
Built with CrewAI Multi-Agent Framework

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/d9c3d26770d348b4b89469f681c27f6b/d6660bd0-67ad-4bc2-9b57-41dd14243230.png)

1. Data Ingestion Agent

• Purpose: Monitors hospital systems, vendor APIs, weather data, and disease reports; detects data drift and triggers retraining.
• Tech Stack: Python workers with PostgreSQL for storage, scipy for statistical drift detection.

2. Forecasting Agent

• Purpose: Predicts ICU occupancy and oxygen demand (liters/minute) at hospital, district, and city levels 5-7 days ahead.
• Tech Stack: Prophet for time-series forecasting, scikit-learn for baseline models, TimescaleDB for time-series data.

3. Resource Optimization Agent

• Purpose: Calculates optimal patient transfers, staff reallocation, and oxygen redistribution across hospital networks.
• Tech Stack: scipy.optimize for linear programming, OR-Tools for constraint solving.

4. Logistics Coordination Agent

• Purpose: Schedules oxygen deliveries, tracks GPS locations, reroutes ambulances dynamically, and issues supply chain alerts.
• Tech Stack: Node.js with Express for vendor API integrations, Mapbox for routing, WebSocket connections for real-time GPS tracking.

5. Communication Agent

• Purpose: Generates multilingual advisories (Hindi, Marathi, English) and sends them via WhatsApp, SMS, and email when thresholds are crossed.
• Tech Stack: Node.js with Twilio API for SMS, WhatsApp Business API, Jinja2 template engine for message generation.

6. Feedback & Learning Agent

• Purpose: Compares predictions vs. actuals, calculates error metrics (RMSE, MAE, MAPE), and triggers retraining cycles to maintain confidence scores.
• Tech Stack: scikit-learn for metrics calculation, PostgreSQL for logging, automated retraining pipeline triggers.

# Real-World Impact

• Proactive Planning: 5-7 day advance warnings enable preemptive resource reallocation before capacity breaches.

• 70% Less Manual Work: Automated logistics coordination reduces phone calls and spreadsheet management.

• Multilingual Access: Hindi, Marathi, and English advisories reach rural frontline workers.

• Continuous Improvement: Self-learning system improves accuracy with every forecast cycle.

• Scalable Architecture: Pilots with 10-50 hospitals, scales to state-level deployments.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/d9c3d26770d348b4b89469f681c27f6b/0498c6a3-132e-43ad-8f23-73cfc685f24b.png)

# Bottom Line
MedLyf uses CrewAI's role-based multi-agent framework to autonomously orchestrate demand forecasting, resource optimization, logistics dispatch, and stakeholder communication. The system prevents oxygen crises through predictive planning rather than reactive firefighting, ensuring optimal resource distribution across hospital networks before emergencies develop.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

MedLyf solves India's oxygen crisis in Tier-2/3 cities, where reactive management during COVID-19 cost thousands of lives from unpredicted ICU and oxygen tank shortages.

Heavily leverages Agentic AI:

Six autonomous agents independently perceive, reason and act without waiting for human prompts:​

• Data Ingestion Agent: Monitors real-time hospital/vendor data, detects drift, self-triggers retraining​

• Forecasting Agent: Predicts ICU/oxygen demand 5-7 days ahead, auto-tunes models​

• Optimization Agent: Uses reinforcement learning to autonomously compute staff reallocation and oxygen redistribution before capacity breaches​

• Logistics Agent: Independently schedules deliveries, tracks tankers, reroutes ambulances, issues alerts​

• Communication Agent: Autonomously generates multilingual advisories when thresholds cross​

• Learning Agent: Continuously compares predictions vs. actuals, triggers retraining to self-improve​

Agents operate goal-driven and autonomously—not prompt-based. They coordinate via event bus (Kafka), triggering each other's actions. The system self-improves through feedback loops.​

Real-world impact: Transforms oxygen management from reactive chaos to proactive prediction - forecasting shortages before they occur and autonomously orchestrating multi-hospital logistics.

**Description of your solution**

FinCoach AI is a digital financial companion designed for individuals with unstable incomes, particularly India's gig and informal workforce, which constitutes over 90% of the labor market. This group struggles with financial stability due to irregular and unpredictable income. Existing financial tools fail them because they assume fixed salaries.

**The Solution and Key Features:**
FinCoach AI combines data-driven insights with conversational AI to simplify money management. It transforms complex financial data into personalized actions, such as saving tips, investment suggestions, and risk forecasts.

**Core features include:**

1. Adaptive AI Coach: This continuously learns from user behavior to deliver tailored financial advice and spending nudges.
2. Proactive Risk Alerts: The system detects income dips, overspending, or tax liabilities and provides early warnings.
3. Personalized Simulations: Users can explore "what-if" financial scenarios, such as investment plans or loans.
4. Seamless User Access: The app is available across devices with an integrated chatbot, ensuring intuitive, multilingual, and voice-enabled financial assistance.
5. Privacy-First Integration: The solution uses consent-based APIs (like Account Aggregator and NPCI) with tokenized, user-controlled data.

**Methodology and Data Flow:** 

- The process starts with user onboarding where a gig worker or student logs in and creates a profile, entering their income and expense details.
- The user grants permissions for SMS reading and connects their UPI/bank account via an Account Aggregator. 
- The system then fetches the last three months' transaction data or accepts manual input. 
- The AI analyzes messages and transactions for credit/debit patterns and spending habits. 
- Finally, the results are presented in dashboards with personalized tips, and user feedback refines future suggestions, improving personalization over time.


**Conclusion:**
FinCoach AI empowers users to make informed financial decisions, build savings habits, and achieve stability despite unpredictable earnings. It bridges the gap between financial literacy and accessibility, offering true financial coaching for everyday earners.

## The Problem

Indian hospitals face recurring crises during festivals, pollution spikes, and disease outbreaks:
- **Unpredictable Surges:** Hospitals can't anticipate patient influx during Diwali, monsoons, or epidemics
- **Isolated Operations:** One hospital runs out of ventilators while another nearby has spares—no coordination
- **Fragmented Records:** Patients carry paper files that get lost; doctors treat without complete medical history
- **Reactive Response:** Every surge is handled in panic mode instead of being prepared

**The Cost:** Lives lost, resources wasted, staff burnout, and preventable medical errors.

---

## **The Solution: Two Pillars, One Platform**
---
### Pillar 1: Hospital Intelligence SaaS (B2B)
Smart operations platform that helps hospitals predict, prepare, and collaborate.

**What It Does:**
- **Predicts Patient Surges** 5-14 days ahead using AI agents analyzing weather, pollution, events, and disease patterns
- **Recommends Actions** like increasing staff, ordering supplies, or preparing ICU beds
- **Enables Resource Sharing** between hospitals in real-time (beds, oxygen, ventilators)
- **Integrates Seamlessly** with existing hospital systems via HL7 FHIR standards

### Pillar 2: Patient EHR Vault (D2C)
Secure, portable digital health records owned and controlled by patients.

**What It Does:**
- **Stores Everything** – Lab reports, prescriptions, X-rays, doctor notes in one encrypted vault
- **Instant Sharing** – Generate QR code or OTP for hospitals to access your records
- **You Control Access** – Grant, revoke, or limit access anytime; automatic expiry after treatment
- **Auto-Sync Updates** – Hospital notes automatically added to your vault post-discharge

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

**Samruddhi** is a dual-pillar healthcare platform that connects hospitals and
patients in one intelligent ecosystem. 
We combine predictive hospital
management with patient-owned health records to create a resilient, prepared
healthcare network.

**The Vision in One Line**
Hospitals predict demand and share resources intelligently, while patients own
and control their complete medical history digitally.

**Description of your solution**

**VitalsKare AI :** Real-Time Vitals, Lifesaving Care, Your AI Doctor

**Problem Statement**
Hospitals face critical challenges in inpatient care: delayed interventions due to infrequent doctor check-ins, overburdened staff, and missed early warning signs of patient deterioration. These issues increase risks of adverse outcomes, such as sepsis or cardiac events, with studies showing up to 30% of ICU patients experience preventable complications. Traditional systems lack real-time analysis and autonomous decision-making, leading to slower responses and heightened patient risks, especially in resource-constrained settings.

**Solution: VitalsKare AI**
VitalsKare AI is a revolutionary app/software that transforms inpatient care by acting as a partial doctor. It leverages AI to monitor patient vitals and test results in real time, delivering instant care recommendations and proactive alerts to reduce risks and improve outcomes. By automating routine assessments and prioritizing critical cases, VitalsKare AI ensures faster interventions, eases staff workload, and prevents patient conditions from escalating.
Key Features

**Real-Time Vital Monitoring  **
Continuously collects data from IoT devices (e.g., heart monitors, pulse oximeters) and EHRs, tracking vitals like heart rate, SpO2, blood pressure, and temperature.  
Displays trends on an intuitive dashboard for quick staff insights.


**Comprehensive Test Result Analysis**  
Analyzes diagnostic tests, including blood tests (e.g., CBC, lactate levels), X-rays, CT scans, and MRIs, using AI image recognition and data processing.  
Identifies abnormalities (e.g., pneumonia on X-rays, elevated white blood cell count) to support early diagnosis.


**AI-Driven Decision Support (Partial Doctor)  **
Integrates vitals, lab results, and imaging data to provide doctor-like recommendations (e.g., “Start IV antibiotics for suspected sepsis” or “Order chest CT for pulmonary concerns”).  
Incorporates evidence-based clinical guidelines for accurate, personalized suggestions.


**Proactive Alert System  **
Detects anomalies (e.g., SpO2 < 90%, abnormal blood test results) and assigns dynamic risk scores to prioritize patients.  
Sends tiered alerts: low-priority to nurses, high-priority to doctors via push notifications, SMS, or in-app alerts.

**User-Friendly Interface  **
Offers a mobile/web dashboard with real-time vital trends, test result summaries, and AI recommendations.  
Includes voice mode for hands-free queries (e.g., “Show Patient X’s latest blood test”) and multilingual support.


**Data Privacy and Security**  
Uses end-to-end encryption and HIPAA/GDPR-compliant role-based access to protect sensitive data.


**Visualization and Reporting  **
Provides real-time charts of vital trends and test result patterns (e.g., X-ray anomaly highlights).  
Generates automated shift reports summarizing patient status and actions.

**Technical Overview**
Architecture: Cloud-based with microservices on AWS/Azure, using WebSocket for real-time updates.  
AI Models: Employs XGBoost/LSTM for predictive analytics, CNNs for imaging analysis, and NLP for unstructured data (e.g., doctor’s notes).  
Data Integration: Supports HL7/FHIR standards and APIs (e.g., xAI API, see https://x.ai/api) for EHRs, labs, and IoT devices.  
Frontend: Built with React Native for cross-platform access.  
Real-Time Processing: Uses Apache Kafka for low-latency data handling.

**Sample Workflow**
Data Input: VitalsKare AI receives real-time vitals (e.g., heart rate: 120 bpm, SpO2: 89%) and test results (e.g., high lactate, abnormal X-ray).  
AI Analysis: Detects sepsis risk based on vitals, blood tests, and imaging.  
Action: Displays a warning, recommends blood cultures and antibiotics, and sends a high-priority alert to the doctor.  
Outcome: The doctor approves the recommendation, preventing deterioration.

**Impact**
Speed: Cuts response time to critical events by 50%.  
Safety: Reduces deterioration rates via early detection.  
Efficiency: Decreases doctor check-ins by 40%, freeing staff for complex cases.  
Scalability: Supports hospital-wide deployment.

**Why VitalsKare AI Stands Out**

# ⚙️ ProcureSmart – Agentic AI for Automated RFP & Pricing Intelligence  

---

## 🔹 Overview  
**ProcureSmart** is an **Agentic AI-powered B2B platform** that automates the entire **RFP (Request for Proposal)** cycle for industrial manufacturers.  
It streamlines discovery, spec matching, and pricing using a **multi-agent system**:  

- **Sales Agent** – Scans procurement portals for new RFPs & deadlines.  
- **Technical Agent** – Matches RFP specs with OEM SKUs via a *Spec Match %* algorithm.  
- **Pricing Agent** – Computes material & testing costs using synthetic pricing data.  
- **Master Agent** – Orchestrates all tasks & generates a structured RFP response report.  

A live **prototype UI** (linked in project resources) showcases RFP detection, spec-match tables, and auto-generated pricing summaries.  

---

## 🔹 Pain Points & Solutions  

| Problem | ProcureSmart Fix |
|----------|------------------|
| Missed or late RFP detection | Automated alerts from Sales Agent |
| Slow manual spec matching | AI Spec Comparator computes match % instantly |
| Sequential handoffs cause delays | Parallel multi-agent system reduces turnaround by **70%** |
| Inconsistent pricing estimation | Pricing Agent ensures accuracy using validated data |

---

## 🔹 Target Audience  
- B2B manufacturers & OEM vendors (wires, cables, FMEG)  
- Sales & tender management teams  
- Enterprise procurement departments & distributors  

---

## 🔹 GTM & Revenue Model  
- **B2B SaaS Subscription:** ₹5,000 – ₹15,000 / user / month  
- **Pay-per-RFP Report:** ₹50 – ₹200 per response  
- **Enterprise API Integration:** White-labeled for ERP/CRM systems  
- **Analytics Add-ons:** Win/loss tracking & pricing insights  

---

## 🔹 Tech Stack  

| Layer | Tools |
|-------|-------|
| **Agent Logic** | OpenAI API, PyPDF2, Selenium |
| **Backend / API** | Python, Flask / FastAPI |
| **Frontend (Prototype UI)** | React + Tailwind CSS (hosted on Vercel) |
| **Data & Reports** | Pandas, ReportLab, SQLite, Flask-AlchemySQL |

---

## 🔹 Why It Stands Out (USP)  
🧠 **Agentic Automation** replaces manual listing.  
⚙ **Real-time Dashboard** for RFP matches & pricing.  
📊 **AI-Generated PDF Reports** with analytics.  
⏱ **End-to-End Workflow** — from RFP discovery to response.  
💻 **Live Prototype UI** available for judges to explore.  

---

## 🔹 Impact  
- ⏳ **RFP turnaround time ↓ 70%**  
- 💼 **Manual effort ↓ 60%**  
- 📈 **Bid success rate ↑ 25–30%**  
- 💡 Creates **data-driven financial intelligence** for B2B sales.  

---

![PyTorch](https://img.shields.io/badge/PyTorch-333333?style=flat-square) ![scikit-learn](https://img.shields.io/badge/scikit--learn-333333?style=flat-square) ![Dart](https://img.shields.io/badge/Dart-333333?style=flat-square) ![MySQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/MySQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flutter](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flutter-333333?style=flat-square) ![FastAPI](https://img.shields.io/badge/FastAPI-333333?style=flat-square) ![RestAPIs](https://img.shields.io/badge/RestAPIs-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

In a world where financial decisions are increasingly delegated to algorithms, investors face a growing **trust gap** — powerful AI models can predict, trade, and optimize, yet their reasoning remains hidden inside a **black box**. Our solution bridges this divide with an **Autonomous, Human-Supervised Financial AI Agent** that combines **explainable intelligence**, **human oversight**, and **behavioral correction** to make investing both smarter and safer.

The system addresses a critical problem in modern AI finance: the **“black box” dilemma**, where autonomous models make high-stakes financial decisions without transparent reasoning. For instance, an AI may label a portfolio as “high risk” without clarifying that correlated exposure across assets or volatility surges caused the flag. This opacity creates barriers to **trust**, **compliance**, and **ethical deployment**.

To overcome this, we integrate a hybrid **Explainable AI (XAI)** and **Human-in-the-Loop (HITL)** architecture:

- The **XAI** layer decomposes AI reasoning into interpretable components, **showing why a decision was made, what alternatives were considered, and which data features influenced the outcome.**

- The **HITL** layer embeds human supervision, allowing analysts or users to **validate, override, or refine actions in real time** — maintaining human accountability and regulatory alignment.

Functionally, the agent continuously **monitors market and user behavior data to detect risk patterns or cognitive biases** (like panic selling or overexposure). When deviations occur, it triggers **adaptive “nudges”** or **action recommendations** aligned with the investor’s stated utility function and long-term goals. Every decision is logged in a tamper-proof audit trail to ensure full transparency and compliance.

Our solution transforms autonomous finance from a black box into a **transparent, auditable, and ethically governed decision system** — **combining machine precision with human judgment** to create **safer, smarter, and more trustworthy investment automation**.

**Fintech: Bring your own problem in Fintech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

**Plutus** directly addresses a fundamental challenge in fintech: leveraging technology to enable **safer**, more **intelligent**, and more **transparent** retail investment. It is designed around the three main pillars of the fintech industry—**regulatory compliance, investor behavior correction, and financial risk management**. By focusing on **explainable, autonomous AI agents that operate under human supervision**, Plutus advances digital wealth management and strengthens investor protection.

The AI agent continuously monitors **user portfolios** and **market data**, assesses risks, and can **execute or recommend real-time financial operations** such as trades or portfolio rebalancing. To help users stay aligned with their long-term objectives, it detects risky investor behaviors—such as panic selling or excessive risk-taking—and responds with timely, understandable prompts. By providing clear, human-readable explanations for every action, the agent builds **user trust** and meets regulatory requirements for **transparency**. Operating within a **human-supervised framework**, it ensures that all autonomous actions are **accountable** and **safe**—key principles for compliance in financial environments.

Thanks to its AI-driven architecture, the system can serve thousands of users simultaneously, delivering personalized, **real-time risk management and financial guidance**.

By applying sophisticated, **explainable AI agents** to address **real-world challenges in retail investing**, this project aligns closely with the **FinTech** track. It ensures efficiency and accountability throughout the investment process by integrating **automation**, **transparency**, and **human oversight**—producing **safer** and **more** **intelligent financial outcomes**.

Dhan-AI is an intelligent financial co-pilot designed for gig workers, freelancers, and low-salaried individuals in India who face irregular or unpredictable income streams. Millions of people working in delivery, ride-hailing, and contract-based jobs struggle with conventional financial tools that assume steady salaries.

Dhan-AI continuously learns from a user’s real-time income patterns, spending habits, and upcoming financial obligations. It uses this data to forecast cash-flow gaps and deliver personalized, proactive financial guidance. Through dynamic “what-if” simulations and Monte Carlo-style risk modeling, the system helps users plan ahead with actionable suggestions such as:

“Reduce discretionary spending today to avoid a shortfall next week.”

“Save ₹50/day to build an emergency buffer.”

By turning uncertain earnings into structured, goal-driven financial journeys, Dhan-AI empowers individuals to avoid cash crunches, plan for emergencies, and build long-term financial resilience — all through intuitive, human-like AI interactions.

**Description of your solution**

MisinformAI is an autonomous AI-powered fact-checking agent designed to combat misinformation during global or local crises. It continuously monitors multiple content streams — including news articles, social media platforms like Twitter/X and Reddit, and online blogs — to detect trending false or misleading information. Using advanced NLP models such as BERT, RoBERTa, and DistilBERT, the system identifies potential misinformation and clusters emerging topics. Each flagged claim is then cross-verified against trusted sources like WHO, IPCC, BBC, FactCheck.org, and Google FactCheck API to ensure accuracy.

Once verified, MisinformAI generates clear, human-readable explanations and contextual corrections using large language models (LLMs) like GPT API and LangChain. The agent is proactive and self-learning: it autonomously fetches data, identifies patterns, provides timely alerts, and improves its accuracy through user feedback. A user-friendly dashboard (built with Streamlit or React) visualizes verified facts, confidence scores, and trending misinformation topics, enabling journalists, NGOs, students, and the general public to navigate online information confidently and act on reliable insights.
![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/76d595433944492981b1701d749e85ab/954802f3-ec1d-4aea-834e-804cd93b18bd.png)

**Misinformation: Create an Agentic AI system that continuously scans multiple sources of information, detects emerging misinformation, verifies facts, and provides easy-to-understand, contextual updates to the public during crises.**

MisinformAI directly addresses this challenge by building an autonomous, proactive AI agent that:

1. Scans Multiple Content Streams: It actively monitors news articles, social media platforms, and online discussions in real-time, aligning with the track’s requirement for handling information overload.

2. Detects Emerging Misinformation Trends: Using NLP models, it identifies patterns of false or misleading content, addressing the core challenge of tracking misinformation as it arises.

3. Verifies Claims Against Trusted Sources: The project cross-references information with reputable databases and fact-check repositories, fulfilling the track’s emphasis on accuracy and reliability.

4. Provides Accessible Explanations: It generates human-readable summaries and contextual corrections, making verified information understandable for diverse audiences, which matches the track’s goal of educating and guiding users.

5. Demonstrates Agentic AI Behaviour: The system is autonomous, proactive, and capable of reasoning, fulfilling the agentic AI requirements of the track by acting independently to detect and explain misinformation.

In short, MisinformAI is a fully aligned solution for the Misinformation Track: it autonomously identifies, verifies, and explains false information, helping citizens, journalists, and organisations make informed decisions during high-misinformation periods.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![Whisper](https://img.shields.io/badge/Whisper-333333?style=flat-square) ![Twilio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Twilio-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Razorpay API](https://img.shields.io/badge/Razorpay%20API-333333?style=flat-square) ![AI4Bharat](https://img.shields.io/badge/AI4Bharat-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

We are building Aarogya Saathi, India's most accessible health guardian. It changes how healthcare is delivered through a voice-first, multi-modal platform that anyone can access with a simple missed call. This directly addresses the critical issues faced by 500 million Indians who struggle with health literacy, medication adherence, costly primary care, and medical misinformation. Arogya Rakshak serves as a daily AI health companion, remembering users' medical histories, providing guidance in local languages, and coordinating care through an intelligent group of specialized agents.

Our main audience is the large rural and elderly population who cannot read or afford regular doctor visits. We also aim to reach urban family members who are concerned about their parents' health back home. Our innovative go-to-market strategy avoids costly digital marketing. Instead, we will embed our service within India's existing trusted health infrastructure. We'll partner with local pharmacies as distribution points, train ASHA workers as community ambassadors, and collaborate with radio stations in regional languages to build trust at the grassroots level.

Our revenue model keeps the core service free for users while creating sustainable income in several ways. Urban children will pay ₹49-99 per month for detailed health reports and emergency alerts about their parents. Government departments will pay ₹199 per month for each pro user using our productivity tools, which can triple their efficiency. Local pharmacies will provide us with commissions for referred medicine sales. Corporations will pay ₹150-300 per employee annually to extend this health safety net to their employees' rural families.

We built everything on an ultra-lean open-source tech stack, keeping our costs ten times lower than competitors. This approach allows us to scale rapidly through network effects, making our service more valuable with each new user. Ultimately, we aim to create a powerful health movement that benefits both social impact and business sustainability.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

We are building a voice-first, agentic AI-powered health platform called Aarogya Saathi that operates via simple missed calls, functioning as a proactive health guardian with a multi-modal approach including SMS health reports, QR code health IDs, and visual dashboards for community health workers, all built on a lean, open-source tech stack to minimize costs.
• Pain Points Addressed: We directly tackle India's core healthcare crises including mass health illiteracy, chronic medication non-adherence, inaccessible and unaffordable primary care, dangerous medical misinformation, and fragmented family care for the elderly—solving what we call the "last mile problem" in Indian HealthTech.
• Target Audience: Our primary users are rural populations, the elderly, and the illiterate/semi-literate masses who cannot use app-based solutions, while our secondary paying customers are their urban family members, corporations implementing CSR health programs, government health departments, and local pharmacy networks.
• GTM & Revenue Streams: Our zero-cost marketing strategy leverages existing trusted networks, local pharmacies, and regional radio, while our multi-pocket revenue model keeps the service free for end-users but generates recurring revenue through urban family subscriptions (~₹99/month), government SaaS licenses for health workers, pharmacy referral commissions, and corporate health plans for employees' rural families—creating a sustainable ecosystem that scales through network effects rather than capital injection.

> Shop together, even when you’re apart

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Firebase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Socket.IO](https://img.shields.io/badge/Socket.IO-333333?style=flat-square) ![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-333333?style=flat-square) ![Express.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Express.js-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

TwinCart is a simple and easy-to-use collaborative shopping cart app. It helps groups of people shop together without confusion. Everyone can add, remove, and see items in real-time, so there’s no need to send long messages or keep track manually. The app keeps track of who added each item and when, which makes shopping transparent and organized. You can join a cart using a unique ID or a shareable link, and you can also add custom items if they are not already in the popular list. Since it’s web-based, it works on any device, making it convenient for families, roommates, or teams to shop together from anywhere.

**Challenges we ran into**

During development, I encountered several technical challenges. Implementing real-time synchronization for multiple users required leveraging WebSockets with Socket.IO to ensure state consistency across clients. Managing role-based actions, such as allowing only the user who added an item to remove it, required secure and consistent backend validation. Integrating the frontend and backend as separate deployments introduced cross-origin communication and environment configuration challenges, which were resolved through careful CORS policy management and environment variable setup. Additionally, ensuring scalability and minimal latency while pushing updates to all connected clients was a critical aspect that required optimizing data structure design and event handling logic. Overall, debugging asynchronous operations and maintaining atomicity in cart updates were the primary hurdles, which were overcome through structured testing and incremental deployment.

**Open Track - Development**

This project falls under Open Track Development as it demonstrates a full-stack, real-time web application that enables collaborative cart management. It combines frontend and backend technologies with cloud-based database integration to provide a seamless, multi-user experience. The system is designed for extensibility, allowing other developers to integrate additional features such as user authentication, analytics, or third-party API support.

### AR Anatomy
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/ar-anatomy-6f73) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/rudy-rawat/AR-Anatomy.git) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1cEVSzPUAlzs_8rpBBDL43hHjdOx6VbB8/view?usp=sharing) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/aSP0qM5WCwc?si=74VsIJSun4_hraW8) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Syntax%20Error%202025-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://syntax-error-2025.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-3-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> AR Anatomy: Where Science Meets Immersion

![Unity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Unity-333333?style=flat-square) ![Augmented Reality](https://img.shields.io/badge/Augmented%20Reality-333333?style=flat-square) ![Vuforia](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vuforia-333333?style=flat-square) ![C#](https://img.shields.io/badge/C#-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Traditional biology education relies heavily on 2D textbook diagrams that often fail to help students grasp the spatial structure and function of human organs. Many learners struggle to visualize how different organ parts connect and operate in real life.

AR Anatomy bridges this gap by transforming static textbook images into interactive 3D AR models that students can explore in real space. It makes anatomy learning:

 1. More intuitive: Students can see organs from all angles and explore detailed cross-sections.

 2. More engaging: Real-time AR visualization replaces passive reading with active discovery.

 3. More effective: Built-in quizzes test understanding and reinforce key concepts instantly.

 4. More accessible: Works directly with NCERT textbooks using simple image scanning — no extra hardware needed.

In short, AR Anatomy turns flat textbook diagrams into living, interactive classrooms, making complex anatomy concepts easier, safer, and more enjoyable to learn.

**Challenges we ran into**

Developing AR Anatomy involved combining real-world AR tracking, interactive 3D models, and dynamic UI systems — which came with several interesting challenges during implementation:

**1. Properly Anchoring the Spawned Organ Models**

One of the first challenges was ensuring that the 3D organ models were correctly anchored to the detected textbook images. Early versions caused models to drift or misalign when the camera moved.

I solved this by fine-tuning Vuforia’s target tracking and aligning the model’s local transform relative to the tracked plane to maintain stability in real-world space.

**2. Creating and Anchoring Dynamic Labels**

Labeling anatomical parts dynamically was tricky. Initially, labels would overlap or intertwine, especially when viewed from different angles.

I built a custom LabelManager system that automatically detects anchor points on the model, assigns alternating label sides (+X / -X), and updates positions every frame so labels remain clear, organized, and facing the camera.

**3. Handling Multiple Organ Spawns**

When multiple organs were recognized or re-tracked, models sometimes overlapped or failed to refresh properly.

I added a centralized clearing mechanism that destroys all existing organ instances and resets UI states before spawning a new model — ensuring only one active organ at a time.

**4. Reducing Memory Usage with a Central Registry**

To prevent performance drops, I created a central OrganRegistry script that stores references to all organ prefabs, descriptions, and quiz data.

This avoided repeatedly loading assets and reduced memory overhead while keeping retrieval fast and efficient.

**5. Implementing Randomized Quizzes per Organ**

Each organ needed a unique quiz with five randomized questions without repetition.

I achieved this by shuffling question arrays using LINQ-based randomization, ensuring a fresh quiz experience every time while maintaining fairness and accuracy.

**6. Contextual UI Management**

Having all buttons visible all the time cluttered the screen and confused users.

I restructured the UI logic so that certain buttons (like Toggle, Labels, Info, and Quiz) only appear when an organ is successfully recognized in AR. This improved usability and maintained immersion.

**7. Gesture-Based Rotation and Scaling**

Handling smooth finger-based rotation and pinch-to-zoom controls was challenging due to varying device sensitivities.

I integrated a custom gesture handler that normalizes input speed and scales models proportionally, giving users precise control without breaking the AR tracking.

**Open Track - Development**

AR Anatomy fits perfectly into the Open Track – Development category as it represents a complete end-to-end software solution that combines Augmented Reality, 3D visualization, and interactive learning systems.

The project focuses on innovative development rather than a single domain — it brings together:

Computer Vision & AR (through Vuforia SDK for real-world image recognition)

3D Rendering & Object Management (using Unity’s scene handling and prefab system)

User Interface Design & Interactivity (custom UI toggles, dynamic label systems, and quiz panels)

Optimized Architecture (central data registry, modular scripts, and memory-efficient prefab management)

It demonstrates strong software engineering principles, UX-focused AR development, and educational technology innovation — all of which fall under the Open Development umbrella.

In essence, AR Anatomy is a well-rounded technical project that showcases problem-solving, code architecture, and creative application of development tools to build a meaningful real-world solution for interactive learning.

### FOSSWay
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/fossway-1cda) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/IshuSinghSE/fossway) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://fossway.vercel.app/) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://vimeo.com/1124515173?share=copy) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackAura-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackaura.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-3-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> “Your Smart Path to Open Source Success”

![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Vercel](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vercel-333333?style=flat-square) ![React.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/React.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![GitHub API](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub%20API-333333?style=flat-square) ![Supabase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Supabase-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The primary problem FOSSWay solves is the high barrier to entry for new contributors to Free and Open Source Software (FOSS). Aspiring developers are often overwhelmed by the vast FOSS ecosystem, find it difficult to identify suitable entry points, and may abandon their efforts before making their first contribution. 
FOSSWay is an AI-powered platform that makes the task of starting an open-source journey easier and more accessible by addressing these specific challenges:
- Combating Information Overload: With over 420 million repositories on GitHub, finding the right project is like searching for a needle in a haystack. FOSSWay simplifies this by transforming the chaotic process into a simple, personalized experience with a curated dashboard of recommended issues.
- Overcoming the 'First Issue' Hurdle: It is challenging for newcomers to find beginner-friendly tasks. FOSSWay uses a skill-based matching algorithm to connect developers with issues that are perfectly matched to their skills and interests.
- Providing Deep Personalization: Existing tools are often generic, offering simple lists filtered by programming language. FOSSWay creates a unique experience by analyzing a user's GitHub profile to understand their specific skills, interests, and experience level, resulting in far more relevant recommendations.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/b8bec2c71b0f49269781ca80b7a59984/c4ec5fbb-082f-4bad-98c7-e4c59efa3616.png)
- Reducing Imposter Syndrome: The fear of not being "good enough" prevents many talented people from contributing. By guiding users to suitable, entry-level issues, FOSSWay helps build confidence and encourages that first crucial contribution.

**Challenges we ran into**

💻 1. Responsive Layout Breaks:
While converting the Figma design to code, several sections misaligned on smaller screens.
Fix: Used CSS Grid and Flexbox with media queries to ensure components adapted smoothly across all devices.
🔗 2. Dynamic Content Integration:
Fetching live project and contributor data from APIs caused layout shifts and slow rendering.
Fix: Implemented lazy loading and optimized API calls to reduce page load time.
🔐 3. Authentication Glitches:
GitHub OAuth login occasionally failed due to redirect URI mismatches during deployment.
Fix: Reconfigured environment variables and verified callback URLs to ensure a secure and consistent login flow.
🧩 4. Design–Code Mismatch:
Minor inconsistencies appeared between the Figma prototype and the implemented UI (like padding, colors, and spacing).
Fix: Used Figma Inspect and component tokens in Tailwind to match values directly from the design system.
🚀 5. Performance Optimization:
Initial load time was high due to large images and animations.
Fix: Compressed media assets, used SVGs where possible, and added lazy loading for non-critical visuals.

**The problem it solves**

🚦 The Problem It Solves

Everyday we see people riding bikes without helmets or even three people squeezed on one bike.
These violations don’t just break rules — they risk lives.

Right now, traffic police rely mostly on manual monitoring. That’s tiring, inconsistent, and honestly not scalable in a busy city.

💡 How Our Solution Helps

Our Smart Traffic Violation App* makes this whole process automatic:

🏍️ Detects helmet-less riding & triple riding from images or videos.
🔴 Highlights violations with red boxes so it’s super clear.
☁️ Stores results in the cloud (Supabase) for record-keeping.
📊 Dashboard view makes it easy for authorities to check violation history.


 ✨ Why It’s Useful

* Saves police time — no need to manually scan every video feed.
* Reduces human error.
* Works in real-time or with uploaded footage.
* Ultimately makes roads safer and helps cities move towards smart surveillance & safer traffic systems.

**Challenges we ran into**

Yeah, it wasn't all smooth sailing. We definitely hit a few key challenges.

Our main headaches were basically threefold. First, just getting the **frontend, backend, and the AI model to actually talk to each other** was a real puzzle. Then, we had the AI making some weird mistakes—like **spotting violations that weren’t actually there**—which was mostly due to the quality of the training data. And finally, we realized that **making it run fast enough** for real-time use is a whole other beast.

Our plan to fix this is pretty straightforward: we're going to **improve the dataset and retrain the model** to make it way more accurate. To tackle the speed issue, we'll focus on **GPU optimization** and eventually move it to a more powerful cloud setup.

**$300(Open): Cash Prize**

So, we built this thing called the **Smart Traffic Violation App**. At its core, it's a full-stack app that **uses AI to automatically spot and record traffic violations** from a video or a picture.

We picked the Open track because, honestly, we just wanted to build something **genuinely useful that solves a real-world problem**. Road safety is a huge deal, and we figured we could use some cool tech to help out. It's a **complete project, from start to finish**, that mashes up a few different technologies:

* We're using a really powerful AI model, **YOLOv8**, to do the actual detection. It’s great at spotting stuff in real-time.
* The brains of the operation is a backend we built with **Python and Flask**. It handles all the uploads and does the heavy lifting.
* All the evidence, like the annotated pictures and videos, gets sent up to **Supabase**, so everything is stored safely in the cloud.
* And of course, we put a simple frontend on it, so it's super easy for anyone to actually use it.

The best part is that **this thing actually works. It's not just a concept**. We think it could be a massive help for law enforcement or city planners by **automating a super time-consuming job**. We're pretty proud of it and think it has a real shot at **making the roads a little safer** for everybody.

**The problem it solves**

**🛑 The Problem It Solves**

🕒 Shopping takes too much time in big malls.

💸 People overspend without live budget tracking.

🏬 Hard to find items inside large stores.

🔔 Shoppers miss discounts & offers.

📦 Product info (expiry/nutrition) is hard to read.

**💡 Our Solution**

🎤 Voice-powered smart list → Add/remove items by speaking.

🛒 Aisle-sorted list → Saves walking time.

💰 Live budget tracker → Alerts before overspending.

🕶️ AR navigation → Guides inside malls step by step.

📷 Instant product scan → Shows expiry, price, and nutrition.

🔔 Discount notifications → Find the cheapest store nearby.

**Challenges we ran into**

**AR Navigation Accuracy 🕶️**
We planned AR-based in-store navigation, but accuracy was a hurdle without hardware beacons.

**Our Fix ✅**
We built an alternative grid-based mapping system.

Store layout divided into rows & columns.

Items mapped to coordinates.

**Dijkstra’s Algorithm ** used to calculate the shortest path from entry to product location.

Even if AR fails, app can still give step-by-step text/voice guidance.

👉 This made our solution robust and practical, no extra hardware needed.

Career Path Finder helps students and professionals make smart career decisions by mapping out possible career paths based on interests, skills, and education. Choosing a career can be confusing 😵, and finding reliable guidance is often time-consuming ⏳.

Guiding Career Decisions 🎯: Explore career options that match your skills and passions.
