**Challenges we ran into**

While building Career Path Finder, I faced several challenges:

Integrating Multiple Data Sources 📊: Combining career data from different APIs and databases was tricky due to inconsistent formats.

Solution: I standardized all incoming data into a single format before processing, which simplified filtering and recommendations.

Dynamic Career Recommendations 🔄: Creating an algorithm that accurately matches skills and interests to careers was challenging.

Solution: I iteratively tested the matching logic, fine-tuning the weight of each skill and interest until recommendations felt relevant and meaningful.

UI/UX Responsiveness 🖥️📱: Ensuring the app looked good on both desktop and mobile was initially a struggle.

Solution: I used responsive design principles and tested across multiple devices to fix layout issues.

Handling Large Data Efficiently ⚡: Some queries slowed down the app when exploring many career options.

Solution: I implemented caching and optimized database queries to improve performance.

Despite these hurdles, tackling them improved both the functionality and user experience of the project, making it more robust and reliable.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Vue.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vue.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

# 🚀 ScoutLead

### Never miss the right conversation online.

---

## 🔍 Problem
- Businesses don’t know where their customers are already talking (Reddit, blogs, AI spaces, etc.).
- They miss valuable opportunities to engage in real, high-intent conversations.
- Searching manually wastes time and effort.
- Relying only on ads or cold outreach feels spammy and expensive.
- It’s hard to know what topics or keywords actually matter.

---

## 💡 Solution
**ScoutLead** helps businesses discover and join the conversations that count.

- 🎯 **Conversation Discovery** – Tracks keywords and topics across Reddit, blogs, and AI-powered platforms.  
- ⚡ **Instant Alerts** – Notifies you when someone is talking about what you care about.  
- ✍️ **AI-assisted Replies** – Suggests natural, brand-friendly responses so you can engage fast.  
- ⏱️ **Time Saver** – Focus only on high-value conversations instead of endless searching.  
- 🌱 **Organic Growth** – Build authentic visibility and trust without relying just on ads.  

---

## 🌍 Use Case Example
Imagine you sell sneakers 👟.  
- Someone posts on Reddit: *“What’s the best shoe for basketball?”*  
- **ScoutLead** instantly spots it and alerts you.  
- You jump in with a helpful response (with AI assistance if you want).  
- The person discovers your sneakers — and you’ve earned a potential customer.  

---

## 🛠️ Tech Stack
- Backend: Node.js / Express  
- Frontend: React + Tailwind  
- Database: PostgreSQL  
- AI: GeminiAPI for response generation  
- Monitoring: Reddit & Blog APIs, Webhooks  
---

## 📈 Impact
- Helps businesses find customers where they already are.  
- Saves marketing teams hours of manual work.  
- Builds authentic, long-term brand presence through genuine conversations.

**Challenges we ran into**

## 🧩 Challenges I Ran Into

- **LinkedIn Data API**:  
  Accessing and working with LinkedIn data was tricky due to strict API limitations and compliance requirements.  
  - Faced issues with authentication and limited access to conversation/engagement data.  
  - Had to explore alternative approaches (e.g., scraping was off-limits, so we looked at official API endpoints and 3rd-party integrations).  
  - Ended up focusing on open platforms (like Reddit and blogs) first, while designing for LinkedIn integration later.  

- **AI Response Quality**:  
  Making AI-generated replies sound natural and brand-safe was a challenge. We had to fine-tune prompts and add human review loops.  

- **Keyword Noise**:  
  Some keywords triggered irrelevant results. Solved this by experimenting with better filtering and context-based matching.

**Best Use of Gemini API**

## 🤖 How Gemini Helped

- **Smarter Conversation Discovery**  
  Gemini can analyze posts/comments beyond just keyword matching — it understands context.  
  Example: Instead of flagging every post with the word *"sneakers"*, it distinguishes *"looking for best running sneakers"* (high intent) vs *"sneakers are cool"* (low intent).  

- **AI-Assisted Responses**  
  We used Gemini to draft natural, human-like replies that match the brand’s tone of voice.  
  This reduces the risk of spammy or robotic responses and saves time for the team.  

- **Summarization & Prioritization**  
  When many conversations pop up, Gemini summarizes threads and highlights the ones with the **highest opportunity** (e.g., questions vs casual mentions).  

- **Multi-platform Adaptation**  
  Gemini helps reframe the same core response differently for Reddit, blogs, or LinkedIn — so the reply fits the platform’s culture.  

- **Continuous Learning**  
  By analyzing which replies perform well (upvotes, clicks, responses), Gemini can fine-tune future recommendations.

> De-risking ventures, amplifying returns

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**The Problem That's Eating $150 Billion Every Year**
**Every 12 minutes, another venture-backed startup dies.**
Not because their technology was bad. Not because the market wasn't big enough. But because they spent 18 months and $2.3M building something nobody wanted—while their investors watched helplessly from the sidelines.
Here's the insane part:

**73% of startups** pivot at least once before finding product-market fit
**Average time to pivot: 14 months** (after burning through most of their runway)
**What investors see before the pivot:** Fake growth metrics and founder optimism
**What they don't see:** That the core business model was doomed from day one

The $150B blind spot:
VCs are pouring record amounts into early-stage ventures, but they're essentially **gambling in the dark**. They fund based on:

**Charismatic founders who can spin a story
Vanity metrics that mean nothing** (downloads, signups, beta users)
Market size projections pulled from thin air
Zero insight into whether the actual business model works

Meanwhile, the best founders are quietly running experiments, testing assumptions, and systematically proving their ventures work. But there's no way for investors to identify these diamonds in the rough.
**The brutal math: 
$684,000 = Average amount VCs lose per failed startup
2.5 years = How long it takes to realize a startup is doomed
$150 billion = Total VC money wasted annually on preventable failures**


**Solution:
Inspired by Top management thinker's book series Strategyzer, We measure and reduce risk across every block of the Business Model Canvas — so investors know exactly when a venture is desirable, viable, and feasible enough to fund**
The solution is a Agentic AI driven platform that makes startup risk visible, measurable, and actionable across every building block of the **Business Model Canvas (BMC)**.
Instead of vague progress updates, founders and intrapreneurs can:
1. **Map critical hypotheses in each BMC building block with BMC Agent and Hypothesis Agent.**
2. **Design and run targeted experiments to test those assumptions using Experiment Agent.**
3. **Measure evidence of risk reduction in the three dimensions that matter:**
     **Desirability → Do customers want it?
     Viability → Will the business make money?
     Feasibility → Can it be built and delivered?** 
4. Quantify residual risk at any point in time.
For VCs and corporate innovation leaders, this means:
* Live risk dashboards for every venture in the portfolio.
* Evidence-based comparability across startups.
* Confidence to invest only when risks in key BMC blocks are systematically reduced.
**In short: our platform operationalizes hypothesis testing across desirability, viability, and feasibility — turning startup risk into measurable investment intelligence with the hep of Agentic AI**

**Challenges we ran into**

While using **Lovable** to generate an MVP, the codebase quickly became messy and **hard to maintain**. For example, adding **new features broke old ones** because the generated code lacked structure and consistency. **Debugging felt like working in a black box** since I didn’t write the logic myself. I solved this by **treating Lovable as a prototyping** tool instead of a full production environment. Once the MVP was validated, I exported the GitHub repo, refactored the architecture, and layered clean coding standards on top. This way, Lovable gave me speed at the idea stage, and I still maintained long-term scalability with proper dev practices.

In case of **Windsurf**, as my AI-powered IDE, I faced **instability and repeated crashes during larger projects**. Sometimes the **AI ignored context**, repeated code loops, or **froze mid-task**. It was unreliable for big, multi-file coding work. I **solved this by breaking problems into smaller coding tasks** and using Windsurf primarily for boilerplate generation, refactoring, and debugging suggestions rather than end-to-end builds. Special **Thanks for windsurf for providing Credits, without which, it would be impossible to crack this out.**

**Basically, we used Lovable for initial prototype, and then build on top with Windsurf. Finally Used CodeRabbit for code view.**

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/couplewatch-9f6f) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://preview--couplewatch-cw.lovable.app/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-mosAIc:%20AI%20in%20action%20with%20The%20Product%20Folks-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://mosaicbytpf.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-3-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Together even miles apart

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Redux](https://img.shields.io/badge/Redux-333333?style=flat-square) ![Socket.IO](https://img.shields.io/badge/Socket.IO-333333?style=flat-square) ![WebRTC](https://img.shields.io/badge/WebRTC-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

In today's world, couples in long-distance relationships or with busy schedules often struggle to maintain a sense of shared experience and connection. While texting and video calls are great, they are active forms of communication that require scheduling and full attention.

CoupleWatch solves this by providing a platform for passive togetherness. It allows partners to effortlessly share the feeling of watching movies or TV shows "side-by-side" even when they are miles apart.

Here’s how it makes this easier and better:

Eliminates Complicated Setup: There's no need to manually sync videos by counting down "3, 2, 1, play!" The platform handles synchronization automatically, creating a seamless, theater-like experience.

Integrated Communication: The built-in chat and video call features mean partners don't have to juggle between multiple apps like Zoom, Discord, and a streaming tab. Everything needed for a shared movie night is in one place.

Accessibility & Convenience: It works directly in the web browser. There are no downloads or installations required, making it incredibly easy for anyone to start using it immediately on any device.

Fosters Intimacy: By simulating a shared activity (watching the same thing at the same time), it helps bridge the physical gap, reducing feelings of distance and fostering a stronger emotional connection through shared moments.

In short, CoupleWatch makes the simple act of watching a movie together online as easy, natural, and connected as possible.

**Challenges we ran into**

Building a real-time synchronization application like CoupleWatch comes with significant technical hurdles. The core challenge is ensuring a flawless experience that feels magical to the user, which involves complex behind-the-scenes engineering.

The Specific Hurdle: Real-Time State Synchronization & Latency

The biggest technical challenge was keeping the video players on two different clients (in different locations) in perfect sync. This is harder than it sounds because of:

Network Latency: Data takes time to travel between users. A simple "play" command sent from one user could arrive at the other user's browser milliseconds later, causing a de-sync.

Different Processing Speeds: The two users might be on different devices (a powerful laptop vs. a slower phone), which can decode and play video at slightly different rates.

I didn't just rely on simple event-based commands (e.g., "User A pressed play, tell User B to play"). This naive approach is highly susceptible to the latency and de-sync issues mentioned above.

Implemented a State Management System: Instead of just forwarding commands, the application constantly synchronizes the exact state between all users. This includes:

The current playback time (in seconds)

The playback state (paused, playing, buffering)

The currently loaded video URL

Used a Robust Real-Time Engine: The project leverages Socket.IO, a powerful library built on WebSockets. This provides a persistent, low-latency connection between the server and all clients, which is essential for instant updates.

Built Resilience for Poor Connections: The application likely includes logic to handle minor de-syncs. For example, if a user's connection lags, the system can periodically re-sync the playback time from the "host" user to the "client" user to correct any drift, ensuring both videos stay aligned within a barely perceptible margin of error.

Overcoming this hurdle was key. The solution transformed the project from a simple concept into a reliable and polished application that delivers on its core promise: a truly synchronized watching experience.

**Top 100 Participants**

1. Primary Focus on Human Connection and Emotion:

The core problem CoupleWatch solves is not a technical or business efficiency one, it's an emotional and social one. the feeling of distance and disconnect in relationships.

The goal is to create a sense of togetherness and shared experience, which are fundamental human emotional needs. This aligns perfectly with a track named "Lovable" which implies a focus on positive user feelings and experiences.

2. Creating a Delightful and "Magical" User Experience:

A "Lovable" product feels seamless and almost magical. CoupleWatch achieves this by automating the frustrating process of manually syncing video streams.

The integration of chat and video calls within the same interface creates a frictionless, all-in-one environment for a date night, removing the need to juggle multiple apps. This thoughtful integration is a key marker of a lovable user experience.

3. Designing for Intimacy and Joy:

The choice of a dark theme is directly reminiscent of a movie theater, setting the right mood.

Features are built for shared moments: watching a movie together, reacting simultaneously to a plot twist via chat, or sharing a laugh over a video call. These micro-interactions are designed to spark joy and strengthen bonds, which is the essence of a lovable product.

4. Empathy-Driven Development:

Building a product for the "Lovable" track requires deep empathy for the user's situation understanding the loneliness that can accompany long distance and the yearning for normal, shared activities.

Every feature in CoupleWatch from the synchronized player to the integrated chat is built with the explicit goal of alleviating that pain point and replicating the feeling of being together.

**In summary, CoupleWatch fits the "Lovable" track because it prioritizes emotional value over pure utility. It’s not just a tool, it’s a digital bridge for relationships. Its success is measured not just in its technical performance but in the smiles, connection, and warmth it creates for its users, making it a product that is truly lovable.**

# JARVIS

A AI researcher and personal assistant, give him any task and he will crush it

If you like assistants that are helpful, fast, and just a little sarcastic, welcome home.

**Jarvis is a helpful AI assistant that can make easy researching and perhaps automating life flawlessly, Best for researchers, Students or working professionals looking for a cool side kick.**

**Challenges we ran into**

# Build & Integration Challenges

A concise log of the gnarly bits we hit building JARVIS and how we tackled them.

## Resolved challenges (fixed)

- Multi‑agent framework complexity (routing, tool schema drift, recursion)
	- Symptoms: Confusing tool dispatch, occasional double‑self errors, YAML/JSON param drift, and loops when agents messaged each other.
	- Fix: Standardized on UnisonAI `Single_Agent` instances in `backend/agents.py`; unified tool schema via `create_tools(...)`; robust param parsing with `_ensure_dict_params`; fuzzy agent name matching to reduce misroutes; corrected tool dispatch to avoid passing `self` twice; added `pass_result`/`send_message` flows; in `brain.py` normalized function‑call parsing and fed tool outputs back using `role="tool"` + `function_response`.

- Function‑call parsing and concurrency with Gemini
	- Symptoms: Mis‑unpacked `(name, args)` tuples; empty results dropped on the floor; blocking behavior.
	- Fix: Rewrote `handle_function_calls(...)` to unpack correctly; `execute_function(...)` branches UI vs backend tools; concurrent `asyncio.gather` across calls; guard empty results and loop until final text.

- UI thread safety with Eel
	- Symptoms: Cross‑thread UI updates froze the app.
	- Fix: All background threads post commands to `ui_update_queue`; only the main loop calls Eel. UI widgets (e.g., `create_text_widget`) are queued (`'create_widget'`) and handled centrally.

- Camera resource leaks and first‑frame black
	- Symptoms: Webcam remained locked; first capture black; crash on re‑open.
	- Fix: `VisionSystem.initialize_camera()` warm‑up and one‑time init; destructor releases camera; explicit error messages and recovery.

- Drag‑and‑drop file handling and preview leaks
	- Symptoms: Object URL leaks; UI/file queue out of sync for large drops.
	- Fix: Preview `Map` with URL revocation; backend signals front‑end to clear via `clearFrontendFileList`; thread‑safe `GLOBAL_FILE_QUEUE` with a lock.

- Packaging completeness with PyInstaller
	- Symptoms: Missing UI assets/hidden imports; icon errors.
	- Fix: Custom spec includes `ui`, `backend`, `history`, README; hidden imports for TTS/GenAI; temp favicon; frozen‑path UI resolution in `main.py`.

> The Legacy Guardian

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![React Router](https://img.shields.io/badge/React%20Router-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Virasat serves as a comprehensive digital solution for individuals who want to carefully organize, manage, and secure their financial and digital legacy. Instead of relying on scattered paperwork, manual records, or unsecured digital notes, users can centralize all critical information—such as bank accounts, insurance policies, property deeds, digital accounts, and legal documents—into one secure, encrypted platform.

With its guided onboarding process and intuitive dashboard, Virasat simplifies the complex task of legacy planning by helping users systematically add asset locators, upload important documents, and assign trusted Nominees and Co-Verifiers with tiered access permissions. The platform’s Security Heartbeat ensures ongoing data protection by regularly confirming the user’s status, preventing premature access to sensitive information.

**Challenges we ran into**

While integrating OAuth for secure third-party logins and API authorizations, we encountered a major challenge around token expiration and refresh workflows.
Specifically, when using OAuth to let users link digital accounts (e.g., Google Drive, financial APIs, etc.), we had to handle cases where the access token expired after a short duration (typically 1 hour), and refresh tokens sometimes failed due to provider-specific limitations or revocation policies.

One significant hurdle we faced during the development of Virasat was implementing field-level encryption in the PostgreSQL database while maintaining smooth performance and seamless application functionality. Storing highly sensitive data (like asset locators, document metadata, and personal information) in encrypted form was crucial for security, but it introduced complexity when querying and updating records without exposing sensitive information.

During development, we encountered a major challenge with the Secure Unlock Protocol, specifically around designing a reliable multi-factor verification process for Nominees. The goal was to ensure that no unauthorized person could access the sensitive vault, but at the same time, the process needed to remain simple and empathetic, especially considering the user’s emotional state during a loss.

### Genova-AI
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/genovaai-b614) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/ayushkumar1991/Genova-AI) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://frontend-jet-five-27.vercel.app/) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XI7_-4uyXzo) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackOdisha%205.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackodisha-4.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-3-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Variant effect predictor with Evo2

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![PyTorch](https://img.shields.io/badge/PyTorch-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**1. The Problem It Solves:**
**Genetic testing** has become widespread, but interpreting DNA mutations to **understand their impact** remains a major **challenge in medicine**:

⏰**Long Wait Times:** Traditional variant interpretation often takes 2-4 weeks, delaying critical treatment decisions.

💰 **High Costs:** Expert analysis per variant can range from $200 to $500, making it inaccessible for many.

🌍 **Limited Access:** Advanced genomic interpretation is mostly available only in major medical centers, excluding underserved regions.

❓ **Uncertain Results:** Around 40-50% of tested variants are classified as "Variants of Uncertain Significance," leaving patients and clinicians without answers.

🔄 **Inconsistent Interpretations:** Different laboratories sometimes provide conflicting pathogenicity classifications, causing confusion.

This delay and uncertainty in interpreting genetic variants can be **life-threatening for patients** who require immediate, precise treatment plans.


**2. What It Can Be Used For**
Our project **"Genova-AI"**, Variant Effect Predictor with Evo2, is a powerful AI-driven tool that transforms the genetic analysis workflow by:

- Providing real-time pathogenicity predictions of DNA mutations in under **30 seconds**.
- Enabling easy access to precision medicine for **researchers, clinicians, and patients globally via a web platform**.
- Offering interactive **gene browsers** for exploratory variant discovery and **visualization**.
- Generating evidence-based, **downloadable clinical reports** that integrate AI predictions alongside trusted databases like **ClinVar**.
- Supporting diverse genome assemblies to seamlessly fit into existing workflows.
- Facilitating **quality education** by serving as a genomic learning tool for **students and researchers**.

**3. How It Improves Existing Tasks**
Compared to traditional genetic interpretation tools, this AI-powered system:

⚡ Drastically reduces turnaround time from weeks to (<30)seconds, accelerating diagnosis and treatment.

💸 Lowers costs by automating complex variant analysis through GPU-accelerated deep learning.

🌏 Democratizes genomics by removing infrastructure barriers with serverless, cloud-native deployment.

🔍 Provides more consistent and accurate classifications, resolving 60% of previously uncertain variants(VUS's).

🚀 Uses a breakthrough language model (Evo2) that interprets DNA like natural language, understanding complex genomic patterns beyond statistical or conservation scores.

📊 Enhances decision-making with confidence scores and side-by-side clinical validation, improving reliability and trust in results.


***For **HackOdiha 5.0**, this project represents a cutting-edge fusion of AI and healthcare, showcasing the power of deep learning to solve critical real-world problems. On a national level, it addresses **India's** healthcare challenges by democratizing access to advanced genomic diagnostics, reducing the burden on an overstretched medical system and paving the way for a future of personalized medicine for all citizens.***

**Summary**
*By revolutionizing genetic variant interpretation with AI, the Variant Effect Predictor with Evo2 empowers faster, cheaper, and more accessible precision medicine, supporting clinicians, researchers, and patients worldwide.*

**Challenges we ran into**

**1.🧠 GPU Memory Management**
**Challenge**: Evo2's 7 billion parameters required >24GB VRAM, causing out-of-memory errors.
**Solution**: Used Modal Labs serverless GPU deployment with model sharding and lazy loading to optimize memory usage.

**2.🌐 CORS Issues**
**Challenge**: Frontend-backend communication blocked by cross-origin policies.
**Solution**: Configured comprehensive CORS middleware in FastAPI with proper preflight request handling.

**3.📊 External API Integration**
**Challenge**: UCSC Genome Browser and ClinVar APIs had different formats, rate limits, and occasional downtime.
**Solution**: Built retry logic with exponential backoff, data validation pipelines, and fallback mechanisms.

**4.⚡ Performance Optimization**
**Challenge**: Initial predictions took around 2 minutes; users expected <30 seconds.
**Solution**: Implemented batch processing, caching strategies, and GPU warm-up to achieve real-time performance.

**5.🧪 Model Validation**
**Challenge**: Ensuring clinical accuracy and handling edge cases for regulatory variants.
**Solution**: Built validation pipeline against ClinVar, implemented confidence scoring, and added statistical metrics.

*Key Learning: These challenges taught our team large-scale AI deployment, genomic data processing, and building production-ready bioinformatics applications.*

**Participation prize**

My project, Genova-AI, is a data-intensive application with a complex user interface, making a well-thought-out design process—the kind championed by Balsamiq—absolutely essential for its success.

The interface includes several key components that required careful planning: an interactive gene browser, a multi-step form for variant input, and a dashboard for displaying complex side-by-side data comparisons. Before diving into development with Next.js and Tailwind CSS, it was crucial to first map out the user flow and component layout to ensure the application was intuitive for researchers and clinicians.

Balsamiq would have been the ideal tool for this phase, allowing me to rapidly create low-fidelity wireframes to iterate on the structure and functionality without getting distracted by visual details. The philosophy of prioritizing usability and structure first is central to Balsamiq's product, and my project is a clear example of an application that benefits immensely from that design-first methodology.

**🏆 Internship Opportunities at Threeway Studio**

My project, Genova-AI, directly demonstrates my ability to build and deploy complex, full-stack AI applications, making me a strong fit for the internship at Threeway Studio.

Genova-AI is an AI-powered tool that predicts the pathogenicity of genetic variants in real-time. The core of the project is the integration of the Evo2 Large Language Model, for which I built a high-performance API using FastAPI and PyTorch. This backend is deployed on a serverless GPU infrastructure with Modal, showcasing my experience in creating scalable and efficient AI systems.

This project taught me how to handle complex data, implement machine learning models for real-world problems, and manage the end-to-end lifecycle of an AI product—from data processing with Pandas to delivering predictions through a user-friendly interface. I am confident that my practical skills in AI/ML and backend development would allow me to quickly contribute to your team.

**The Problem It Solves**

Crop selection challenges - Farmers struggle to decide which crop to grow based on soil, weather, and market demand.

Low income & high risks - Wrong crop choices often lead to low yield and financial losses.

Generic advisory services - Existing solutions are one-size-fits-all and don’t provide personalized guidance.

Language barriers - Most platforms are only in English, making them hard to use for local farmers.

Connectivity issues  Many rural areas have poor internet access, leaving farmers without timely advice.


**How It Helps**

Provides personalized crop recommendations using AI models trained on soil, weather, and market data.

Gives 7-day market price forecasts with Sell/Hold advice.

Detects crop diseases from images, enabling early treatment.

Supports multiple languages (English, Hindi, Odia, etc.), and even voice-to-text chatbot.

Works in offline mode, so farmers get access even with low or no connectivity.

**The problem it solves**

Background: Why IPOs Are Hard for Retail Investors

An Initial Public Offering (IPO) is the gateway for a private company to raise capital from the public. On paper, it looks simple: a company issues shares, investors subscribe, and trading begins. But behind the scenes, there is an information overload problem that most retail investors struggle with.

Every IPO comes with a prospectus — a regulatory disclosure document that typically runs 400+ pages. This document contains:

Detailed business models

Financial statements (balance sheets, P&L, ratios)

Risk factors and disclaimers

Legal obligations and compliance notes

Future growth plans and IPO objectives

For professional analysts, these documents are standard. But for retail investors (the everyday individual who invests ₹5,000–₹2,00,000), they are overwhelming.

The Current Problems

Information Overload → Retail investors cannot realistically read 400+ pages before deciding.

Complex Financial Jargon → Terms like “dilution,” “ROE,” or “promoter pledge” are difficult for non-finance people.

Hidden Risks → Risks are often buried deep in legalese; investors miss them.

Decision Time → Reading and analyzing takes 6+ hours, discouraging participation.

Dependence on Third Parties → Investors rely on news articles, YouTubers, or biased brokers instead of doing their own due diligence.

Trust Gap → Even if they find summaries online, they cannot verify whether those are authentic or manipulated.

The result? Retail investors either invest blindly, skip IPOs, or regret their decisions later.

![Uploading  The Solution: Smart IPO Explainer

Smart IPO Explainer directly addresses these challenges with a two-layered solution:

AI/ML Layer (Understanding & Simplification)

Automatically parses IPO prospectus PDFs.

Summarizes business model, risks, and financial health in plain language.

Creates visual dashboards (charts, ratios, peer comparisons).

Provides an AI-driven Q&A assistant where users can ask: “What are the top risks?”, “How is debt compared to peers?”

Blockchain/BlockDAG Layer (Trust & Transparency)

Every AI-generated summary is hashed and stored on blockchain/BlockDAG.

Ensures tamper-proof information — investors know it matches the official SEBI filing.

Supports future extensions like tokenized IPO participation, BDAG-powered subscriptions, and DeFi-based secondary trading.

 Who Can Use It?
1. Retail Investors

Get a 2–5 page explainer instead of 400 pages.

Save 6+ hours of reading → make decisions in 15 minutes.

Access regional language support (Hindi + local languages).

See risks clearly with color-coded severity heatmaps.

Compare IPOs with peer benchmarks before investing.

 Example: A first-time investor in Tier-2 city can now understand “Debt-to-Equity” in plain words: “The company has 3x more loans than savings. This is considered risky compared to peers.”

2. Financial Advisors & Brokers

Use simplified IPO summaries to educate clients faster.

Scale advisory services to 100s of clients without manually reading documents.

Build trust by showing tamper-proof blockchain verification.

3. Regulators (SEBI, Exchanges, Depositories)

Monitor whether companies are making disclosures in an investor-friendly manner.

Use blockchain hashes to audit summaries and ensure transparency.

Increase investor protection, aligning with SEBI’s goals.

4. Fintechs & EdTech Platforms

Integrate Smart IPO Explainer into trading apps or learning platforms.

Enhance financial literacy with simplified, visual IPO insights.

 How It Makes Tasks Easier & Safer
 1. Eliminates the “400-Page Barrier”

Instead of reading 400 pages, investors get the essence in 15 minutes:

What the company does

Why it is raising money

Key risks (legal, financial, regulatory)

Financial health snapshot

Comparison with industry peers

This improves engagement — more retail investors actually understand IPOs.

 2. Plain-Language Explanations

Complex jargon becomes easy-to-read insights. Example:

“EBITDA margin declined from 20% to 15%” → “The company’s profit efficiency reduced; it is earning less from its revenue compared to before.”

“Promoter pledge 40%” → “The promoters have given 40% of their shares as collateral for loans, which increases risk.”

This builds confidence in decision-making.

 3. Risk Transparency (Safer Decisions)

Instead of hidden risks, users see:

Severity levels → High / Medium / Low

Probability factors

Heatmaps with colors (Red = high risk, Green = safe)

This reduces post-investment regret and improves risk awareness.

 4. Faster, Smarter Decisions

Current IPO process → 6+ hours of reading, or skipping entirely.

With Smart IPO Explainer → 15 minutes of review is enough.

Outcome → More participation, less confusion.

 5. Tamper-Proof Information (Blockchain/BlockDAG)

Each summary is hashed on blockchain/BlockDAG.

Investors can click “Verify on Blockchain” to ensure the summary wasn’t manipulated.

Regulators can trace every insight back t

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges I Ran Into
1. PDF Parsing Nightmare: Complex Table Extraction

Challenge: Extracting structured financial tables from messy PDFs with merged cells, nested headers, and inconsistent formats.

Failure: PyPDF2 completely destroyed table structures.

Solution: Adopted a hybrid pipeline — pdfplumber + Tabula-py + custom post-processing. Final breakthrough came from computer vision (OpenCV) to detect table boundaries before extraction.

2. AI Hallucination Crisis: Wrong Financial Numbers

Challenge: LLMs fabricated financial data (e.g., showing profits instead of actual losses).

Failure: Zomato prospectus test — AI claimed ₹1200cr profits vs. actual ₹816cr losses.

Solution: Built a source citation system, fact-checking pipeline, and confidence scoring (High = direct quote, Medium = derived, Low = inferred). Ensured every number had a verifiable page reference.

3. Blockchain Integration Bottleneck: Gas Fees & Speed

Challenge: Ethereum mainnet verification was too slow (2–5 min) and costly ($15–30 per summary).

Failure: Batch transactions and IPFS + Ethereum hybrid proved unreliable.

Solution: Switched to Polygon Layer 2 for $0.001 gas fees and 2–3 second confirmations, while retaining Ethereum as a premium track for high-value IPOs.

4. Language Translation Disaster: Financial Context Lost

Challenge: Google Translate ruined financial meaning (e.g., “Equity dilution” → “पानी में मिलाना”).

Failure: Retail investors confused by literal translations.

Solution: Built a financial concept dictionary, contextual translation engine, and cultural analogies (e.g., Debt-to-Equity = “loan vs savings ratio”).

5. Performance Catastrophe: 10-Minute Processing Time

Challenge: Processing 400+ pages took 8–12 minutes, causing user drop-offs.

Failure: Single-pass summarization was too slow and memory-heavy.

Solution: Implemented smart chunking + parallel processing, intelligent section detection (only ~50 relevant pages processed), and progressive loading on frontend. Result: reduced processing time from 10 minutes → 90 seconds.

6. Demo Day Crisis: Live Failure 24 Hours Before Pitch

Challenge: Memory crashes, blockchain transaction failures, and PDF parsing errors the night before demo.

Emergency Fixes:

Memory optimization: chunked processing + forced garbage collection.

Backup plan: pre-generated summaries as fallback mode.

Testnet top-up at 3 AM to ensure blockchain transactions worked.

Outcome: Delivered a successful live demo with Paytm IPO prospectus under pressure.

**The problem it solves**

**TrackGuard** provides **pre-collision detection** and hazard awareness using AI-powered monitoring. It helps:

✅ Enhance situational awareness for safer train operation.
🧠 Use of AI reduces human error in monitoring railway tracks.
🛡️ Improve passenger and cargo safety, making railways safer overall.


Essentially, it makes train operations safer and more reliable by giving proactive, real-time alerts, reducing risks that would otherwise go unnoticed.

**Challenges we ran into**

During the development of TrackGuard , we faced several challenges:

🛰️ Lack of real-time data: Collecting live satellite or track sensor data was not possible due to permissions and practical limitations. To overcome this, we used simulated data and test scenarios to demonstrate the AI’s capabilities.

🐛 Integrating frontend and backend: Initially, the frontend and backend were in separate setups, making it tricky to connect the live data streams. We solved this by carefully configuring API endpoints and testing locally with npm run dev and the backend server running simultaneously.

⚡ Smooth scrolling and button navigation: Making multiple buttons navigate to the same section while keeping hot reload functional was challenging. We resolved it by using document.getElementById('demo')?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' }) in the button onClick handlers.

🔧 Keeping dependencies compatible: Some packages required newer Node versions than what we had installed. We updated Node and reinstalled packages to avoid version conflicts.

🎨 Dynamic frontend rendering: Since the homepage text and UI were rendered via React components, it took some time to find the right files to modify (HeroSection.tsx, Header.tsx). Using VS Code’s search feature helped us locate them quickly.

Overcoming these hurdles helped us understand React + Vite structure, API integration, dynamic UI handling, and practical challenges in working with limited real-time data, making the project more robust and user-friendly.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![PyTorch](https://img.shields.io/badge/PyTorch-333333?style=flat-square) ![Machine Learning](https://img.shields.io/badge/Machine%20Learning-333333?style=flat-square) ![WebSockets](https://img.shields.io/badge/WebSockets-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![FastAPI](https://img.shields.io/badge/FastAPI-333333?style=flat-square) ![Face Recognition](https://img.shields.io/badge/Face%20Recognition-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**Project Overview: Monitr – Advanced Security System Management**
Security system management is traditionally a costly and resource-intensive process. With the rapid rise in urban populations worldwide, the demand for efficient, accurate, and reliable security solutions has grown significantly.  

Our project, **Monitr**, is designed to address this challenge by providing a next-generation safety and surveillance system that makes monitoring safer, easier, and far more reliable for households, businesses, and large organizations.  

**Limitations of Conventional Systems**  

- Traditional safety systems are often limited to motion detection, notifications, and alarm triggers.  
- Such methods prove insufficient for long-term surveillance and effective security management, as they lack precision, adaptability, and the ability to distinguish between different individuals.  

**Our Approach**  

- **Object Tracking:** Monitr employs the SORT algorithm to track individuals across video frames.  
- **Dynamic Identification:** Each individual is assigned a unique ID, dynamically updated using our custom facial recognition model.  
- **Accuracy & Efficiency:** This ensures precise, real-time identification, enabling users to monitor people consistently without the confusion of false alarms or duplicate detections.  

**Key Advantages**  

- **Incremental Learning:** The model supports incremental learning, avoiding lengthy recomputations when new individuals are introduced.  
- **Proven Performance:** Evaluated on the *Labeled Faces in the Wild* dataset, our system achieved an accuracy of **99.3%**. (See table image for detailed metrics.)  
- **Practical Use Cases:**  
  - **Households:** A reliable home security solution that recognizes family members and alerts homeowners about unknown visitors.  
  - **Small and Large Businesses:** Enhanced access control, employee monitoring, and visitor management without relying only on ID cards or manual checks.  
  - **Institutions and Enterprises:** Scalable surveillance for offices, campuses, and other facilities, helping distinguish between authorized personnel and strangers in real time.  
- **Confidence-Based Identification:** Easily distinguish between known and unknown people using the model’s confidence score, with thresholds that can be set as needed.  

**Conclusion**  
By integrating state-of-the-art tracking, facial recognition, and incremental learning, **Monitr** provides a robust, scalable, and cost-effective solution that simplifies surveillance tasks while making them significantly safer and more dependable for households, companies, and institutions alike.

**Challenges we ran into**

**Implementation Challenges and Solutions**

**1. Real-Time Communication with WebSockets**
- Getting WebSockets to work for real-time communication was honestly pretty tough.  
- After a lot of effort (and a few headaches), we finally managed to get over the hurdles and make it stable.  

**2. Video Processing and Playback**
- Making the video player work in the **"VideoProcess output"** wasn’t straightforward either.  
- At first, there didn’t seem to be any errors, which made it even more confusing.  
- Turns out the problem was with the **encoding format**. The <video> tag just wouldn’t play MP4 in our setup, so we had to re-encode everything into **H.265** to get it running smoothly.  

**3. Machine Learning Model Development**
- The hardest part by far was building an ML model that was **fast, accurate, and supported partial fitting**.  
- First, we needed a way to represent faces as numbers. Using the **face-recognition** library, we converted each face into a **128-dimensional vector** — basically the mathematical version of someone’s face.  
- With that, we still had to figure out how to:  
  - Classify people correctly  
  - Decide if someone is a known person or a stranger (using a threshold)  
  - Keep it efficient enough for real-time use  
  - Allow updates without retraining everything from scratch  

**Our Solution:**
- After trying out different options, we ended up with the **SGDClassifier**.  
- It might look simple at first, but it checked all the boxes:  
  - Very fast  
  - Supports partial fitting (so we can keep adding new faces)  
  - Outputs confidence scores (logits) that let us set thresholds for unknown vs known people  
- When tested on the **Labeled Faces in the Wild** dataset, it reached an **accuracy of 99.3%**, which is super solid — even better than the human average.

**The problem it solves**

Library Management System – Problem It Solves
✅ What Is It Used For?

A Library Management System (LMS) is a software solution designed to automate and simplify the process of managing a library’s day-to-day operations, including book lending, returns, cataloging, and member management.

⚡ Problems It Solves
1. 📊 Manual Record-Keeping Is Inefficient

Before LMS, most libraries managed books, members, and transactions using pen & paper or simple spreadsheets. This leads to:

Time-consuming data entry

High chance of human errors

Difficulty in tracking books or overdue returns

2. ⏱ Time Wastage in Searching and Lending

Without a system, searching for a specific book takes a long time as staff must manually check physical records or shelves.
An LMS allows instant search by:

Book title

Author

ISBN

Category

3. ❌ Loss of Data Integrity

Manual systems are prone to lost records, duplicate entries, or inconsistent data.
An LMS maintains:

Accurate inventory

Consistent member information

Precise transaction history

4. 📉 Difficulty In Managing Large Collections

As the number of books and members grows, managing the library manually becomes almost impossible.
An LMS helps by providing:

Scalable databases

Advanced filtering and reporting

Automated notifications

5. 🔔 Reminder for Returns and Fines

Often, members forget return deadlines leading to overdue books and uncollected fines.
LMS automates:

Return due-date reminders via email or SMS

Automatic fine calculation

Notifications for pending dues

6. 🛡 Security & Controlled Access

Manual systems allow anyone to tamper with records.
An LMS provides:

Secure login for staff

Role-based access control (Admin, Librarian, Member)

Audit trail of all actions

🌟 Overall Benefits

Saves time and effort

Reduces errors

Provides real-time inventory status

Improves member satisfaction

Ensures data security

Easy to scale and maintain

**Challenges we ran into**

1. Issue: Database Design Confusion

At the beginning, I struggled with designing an efficient database schema.
Specifically:

How to model the relationship between books, members, and transactions

How to track multiple copies of the same book

✅ How I Solved It

I researched best practices for relational database design

Decided to use separate tables:

Books (with attributes like title, author, category)

BookCopies (each copy of a book has a unique ID)

Members (user info)

Transactions (lend/return history with timestamps)

This helped avoid data duplication and made tracking easier.

🐞 2. Issue: Handling Concurrent Access

Problem:
When multiple librarians or members were using the system at the same time, race conditions occurred — for example, two users tried to issue the same book copy at once.

✅ How I Solved It

Implemented database transactions with proper locking mechanisms.

Used constraints to prevent issuing the same book copy twice.

Validated availability at the server-side before confirming the transaction.

🐞 3. Issue: Automated Notification System Not Working

Initially, scheduled email reminders for overdue books didn’t trigger properly.

✅ How I Solved It

I learned about cron jobs (or scheduled tasks) to run periodic checks.

Built a background task that runs every day, checks for overdue books, and sends email/SMS reminders.

Debugged by adding proper logging to track which part was failing.

After fixing misconfigurations in the email service, it worked reliably.

🐞 4. Issue: User Authentication Security

I was worried about implementing secure login without exposing sensitive data.

✅ How I Solved It

Used hashed passwords (bcrypt) for storing user credentials.

Implemented session management to prevent unauthorized access.

Followed security best practices: input sanitization, HTTPS, CSRF protection.

🎯 Key Takeaway

Every bug or design hurdle taught me how important it is to think ahead in system design, validate every assumption, and follow industry best practices.

> #SmartSurveysForIndia

![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Express.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Express.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Google Translate API](https://img.shields.io/badge/Google%20Translate%20API-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

1. Challenge of Manual Survey Creation

Traditional survey creation is time-consuming. Admins or researchers often spend hours writing questions, structuring forms, and ensuring relevance for different respondent groups. This makes the process inefficient and often repetitive.

Our Solution:

The application uses AI-driven question generation. By simply giving a prompt (text or voice), the system automatically creates a complete, relevant survey. This reduces the time needed to prepare surveys from days to minutes, ensuring higher productivity and creativity.

2. One-Size-Fits-All Problem in Surveys

Most surveys ask the same questions to every respondent, ignoring the respondent’s background or context. This leads to irrelevant responses and low engagement.

Our Solution:
We implement dynamic question branching. Based on a user’s previous answer, the system automatically tailors the next set of questions. For example, if a respondent says their occupation is “Farmer,” the upcoming questions adapt to farmer-specific contexts, making surveys more personalized and meaningful.

3. Poor Data Quality and Spam Responses

Surveys often get spammed with meaningless responses — like selecting the same option for all questions or typing random characters. This skews data analysis and makes results unreliable.

Our Solution:

Our system has anti-spam validation checks. It detects suspicious patterns (like one-option spamming) and validates user-input answers against available metadata (location, language, age, etc.). This ensures only high-quality responses are recorded for analysis.

4. Lack of Rich Insights

Most survey tools provide only raw results (counts, percentages). They lack advanced analysis like sentiment detection or user behavior insights. This makes decision-making harder for administrators.

Our Solution:
We integrate AI/ML models for data analysis. The system generates insights such as:

1. Response rates by demographics or regions
2. Average completion time per user
3. Sentiment analysis of text responses (positive/negative/neutral)
4. Patterns and trends across survey data
5. These insights give administrators not just numbers but actionable intelligence.
6. Difficulty in Distribution and Reach

Sharing surveys is often manual and platform-limited, which reduces participation rates.

Our Solution:
We provide easy sharing links for social media platforms, email, or SMS. This makes it possible to reach wider audiences quickly, boosting response rates.

Overall Impact

By combining AI, personalization, and smart analytics, this application transforms the way surveys are created, distributed, and analyzed.

- It saves time in survey creation.
- It improves data quality with intelligent checks.
- It delivers richer, actionable insights instead of plain numbers.
- It makes surveys more engaging and context-aware for respondents.

In short, the project bridges the gap between traditional rigid surveys and modern intelligent feedback systems, empowering organizations to make better, data-driven decisions.

**Challenges we ran into**

1. Dynamic Question Flow

Designing the survey so that questions adapt based on previous answers was tricky. It required creating a flexible database model and conditional logic that could handle multiple branching paths without breaking the survey flow.

2. AI Question Generation

Integrating AI for auto-generating meaningful questions was challenging. Ensuring that the generated questions were contextually correct, relevant, and in varied formats (MCQs, scale, text) needed extra fine-tuning and fallback handling.

3. Spam Detection & Data Validation

Building logic to filter out spammy responses wasn’t straightforward. The difficulty was in setting rules that were strict enough to block invalid inputs but not so strict that they rejected genuine responses.

4. Authentication & Security

Securing the APIs with authentication tokens and handling permissions for different users (admin, survey owner, respondents) created complexities, especially when testing through Postman.

5. Data Insights & Visualization

Generating insights like sentiment analysis, demographic splits, and response patterns involved integrating multiple Python libraries and handling large datasets efficiently. Presenting this data in a clear, visual way was another layer of challenge.

6. Database Design Decisions

Choosing the right database was initially confusing (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or SQLite). The challenge was balancing scalability with ease of setup during development.

7. Frontend–Backend Communication

Ensuring smooth communication between Django (backend) and React (frontend) required careful API design, versioning, and handling CORS issues.

**The problem it solves**

The following are the real life problems that our idea is solving

**1.Early Disease Detection in Crops**
-Farmers often struggle to identify crop/leaf diseases quickly.
-Manual detection requires expert knowledge (plant pathologists), which is not                    always avialable.
**2.Late detection → yield loss, reduced quality, economic damage**.
-Lack of Accessible Guidance
-Even if farmers detect the disease, they may not know the right remedies or preventive measures.
-This can lead to overuse/misuse of fertilizers and pesticides, harming soil, crops, and the environment.
**Time & Cost Inefficiency**
-Farmers may spend money on lab tests, agricultural officers, or trial-and-error remedies.
-This delays treatment and increases costs.


 ![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/7d9754cacb6f4ec6aaf4f9cc16f89fbd/a58571ac-06c1-4a53-a34b-d732bf5ffeb0.png)

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/7d9754cacb6f4ec6aaf4f9cc16f89fbd/a267dafe-5cf5-4c21-9e9a-a97362214adc.png)

**Challenges we ran into**

1.Model Training Limitations

-Finding a good quality dataset of diseased crop/leaf images was difficult.
-Limited dataset size sometimes affected the accuracy of predictions.
Balancing between model complexity and speed (so it runs smoothly in the browser) was a challenge.

2.Model Integration Issues

-Converting a trained Keras/TensorFlow model into a format (TensorFlow.js) -usable in the frontend was tricky.
-Faced difficulties while connecting backend (Flask) with frontend due to API and CORS issues.
-Large model size made it slow to load in the browser initially.

3.Prediction Accuracy & Performance

-Some diseases have similar visual symptoms, which confused the model.
-Model sometimes misclassified healthy leaves as diseased, requiring fine-tuning.
-Ensuring real-time performance (fast predictions without lag) was challenging.

4.Mapping Diseases to Remedies/Preventions

-Collecting reliable agricultural knowledge for remedies and preventive measures required research.
-Ensuring remedies are scientifically valid and practical for farmers was an extra effort.

5.Frontend & User Experience

-Designing a user-friendly interface so even non-technical users (like farmers) can use it easily.
-Handling different image qualities (blurred, poor lighting, different camera angles).

**Participation prize**

1.Farmer-Friendly Interface

-Many farmers may not be very tech-savvy.
-A clean, simple interface with large buttons, icons, and clear language makes our tool accessible.
-Balsamiq can be used to sketch and test these layouts before coding.

2.Prototype & Validate Quickly

-Instead of directly coding, we can make wireframes (like: upload image → prediction → remedies page).
-This helps us think about user journey: “How will a farmer interact with the system?”

3.Improves Communication in Team

-Wireframes made in Balsamiq give a visual blueprint for  teammates, so we developers know exactly what to build.

> Fearless voices, hidden identities

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![AWS](https://img.shields.io/badge/AWS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

When reporting sensitive incidents (bullying, harassment, fraud, threats, or unsafe situations), people often hesitate because:

**Fear of Exposure** → Risk of their identity being leaked.

**Lack of Anonymity** → Existing tools don’t guarantee privacy.

**No Integrity** → Reports can be deleted, altered, or ignored.

**Slow Response** → Traditional systems are inefficient, with delayed action.

**Limited Reach** → Many solutions fail to adapt to different languages, cultures, or legal standards.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges I Ran Into

**AI Assistant**: Initial AI analysis slowed the app; fixed with async processing + GPU on Akash.

**Workflow**: Linear flow caused delays; solved by modular, parallel microservices.

**Deployment**: Hard to sync containers on Akash; fixed with Docker Compose + iterative testing.

**Desktop Work**: UI broke across devices; solved with responsive layouts & cross-platform testing.

**Best Use of Akash**

SentinelX isn’t just about reporting safely — it’s about doing it fast, globally, and without dependency on centralized servers. This is where Akash Network becomes a game-changer.

***Integration with Akash :***

- **GPU-Accelerated AI Processing:**

Akash provides decentralized GPU compute power to run our threat detection, sentiment analysis, and risk scoring models at scale.

This ensures sub-2-second response times, even under heavy reporting loads.

- **Permissionless Deployment:**

SentinelX can be deployed as a containerized, multi-service architecture on Akash.

This makes the platform censorship-resistant — no single entity can shut it down or alter reports.

- **Cost-Efficient Scaling:**

Instead of relying on expensive centralized cloud providers, Akash’s decentralized marketplace allows affordable on-demand scaling whenever reporting spikes occur (e.g., during emergencies).

- **Global Reach:**

Since Akash nodes are distributed worldwide, SentinelX automatically benefits from low-latency access and regional compliance, supporting our multi-language, global-first mission.

***Why It Fits the Track***

- **Showcasing Decentralized Cloud Strength** : SentinelX demonstrates how a critical real-world application (secure threat reporting) can run reliably on a fully decentralized infrastructure.

- **Real-World Use Case** : Tackles pressing issues like bullying, fraud, harassment, and whistleblowing — scenarios where privacy, trust, and uptime are non-negotiable.

- **Versatility of Akash** : We’re not just hosting a static app we’re running AI inference, blockchain verification, and global APIs on Akash’s permissionless cloud.

### Eduverse
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/eduverse-83e8) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://eduverse-fe-sa6y.vercel.app/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackOdisha%205.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackodisha-4.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-3-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Your Career GPS

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

What is Eduverse?

Eduverse is your personal career navigator. Whether you dream of becoming a Data Engineer, Software Developer, AI Specialist, or Cybersecurity Expert, Eduverse gives you a step-by-step roadmap to reach your goal with the right skills, resources, and guidance.

What Can People Use Eduverse For?

Explore Career Paths → Find out what skills and tools are required for careers like Data Engineer, Software Engineer, or AI Engineer.

Learn with Clarity → No more confusion about “what to learn next” — Eduverse breaks it down into clear stages.

Track Your Progress → Mark milestones as completed and see how far you’ve come.

Access Curated Resources → Get hand-picked tutorials, courses, and projects — all in one place.

Build Real Projects → Gain hands-on experience with project ideas at every stage.

Stay Motivated → Earn badges, streaks, and share your progress with peers.

How Eduverse Makes Learning Easier & Safer

Removes Overwhelm → Instead of wasting hours searching for random tutorials, Eduverse shows you the exact next step.

Trusted Content → Resources are curated and verified, so you avoid low-quality or unsafe material.

Time-Saving → One platform with all the roadmaps, tools, and resources you need.

Guided & Structured → No jumping blindly between topics — Eduverse acts like a career GPS.

Community Driven → Learn safely with peers, ask questions, and avoid misinformation.

Future Progress Tracking → Soon, Eduverse will help you automatically track your learning progress and suggest personalized next steps.

**Challenges we ran into**

While building Eduverse, we faced a few key hurdles:

Structuring Dynamic Roadmaps

Challenge: Each career path (Data Engineer, Software Engineer, etc.) needed a different roadmap structure, and initially our design became repetitive and hard to scale.

Solution: We refactored the roadmap logic into a dynamic system where the same structure can handle multiple career paths by just updating the data source.

API Integration Issues

Challenge: While fetching AI-generated roadmaps, we faced inconsistent API responses that sometimes returned incomplete data.

Solution: We added input validation, fallback defaults, and a retry mechanism to make the system more reliable.

Page Reload on Enter Key

Challenge: When entering a goal in the input field, pressing Enter caused the page to reload instead of generating the roadmap.

Solution: We fixed this by adding a proper event listener (keydown with event.preventDefault()) to ensure Enter triggers the roadmap generation without refreshing.

Managing State and Progress

Challenge: Tracking user progress across multiple stages was tricky since the app started with static data only.

Solution: We introduced local storage to persist progress, and in the future we plan to expand this into full backend-linked progress tracking.

### Maternova
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/maternova-a3ca) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/SSangita8/Maternova) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1I4MRXhyi4Y9vDJZlOce7h2FnCscDJQp8/view?usp=drive_link) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackOdisha%205.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackodisha-4.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-3-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Guidance, Care & Support every step of Motherhood

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Machine Learning](https://img.shields.io/badge/Machine%20Learning-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Many expectant and new mothers face significant challenges during pregnancy and postpartum, ranging from limited access to reliable healthcare guidance to difficulties in tracking both their own well-being and their baby’s growth. In many communities, barriers such as high healthcare costs, distance from facilities, and a shortage of professionals make quality support hard to reach. At the same time, the abundance of scattered or misleading online content leaves mothers without trusted, practical advice, often leading to confusion or anxiety. Beyond physical health, many women also struggle with emotional isolation, lack of reassurance, and limited tools to stay informed and connected throughout their journey. These gaps not only affect mothers but also impact their families and communities, as inadequate maternal care can hinder healthy childhood development and overall family well-being.

**Challenges we ran into**

One major hurdle we encountered while building Maternova was ensuring that the app remained lightweight and functional even in areas with poor or unstable internet connectivity, which is a common challenge in rural India. Since our primary users may not always have access to high-speed internet, relying heavily on online data could limit the app’s usability and impact.

How We Overcame It

To solve this, we implemented:

Offline-first design: Critical health information and resources are stored locally on the user’s device, so mothers can still access guidance without internet.

Optimized data usage: We compressed resources and used lightweight file formats to minimize storage requirements and data consumption.

Smart syncing: When internet connectivity is available, the app automatically updates its content in the background without disrupting the user experience.

This approach allowed us to make Maternova more inclusive and reliable, ensuring it serves its purpose even in low-resource settings.

**The problem it solves**

Pollution is one of the most pressing issues in the world today, yet awareness about its severity remains limited, especially in India. Our project addresses this gap by creating an interactive website designed to educate and engage people about different forms of pollution. Through interactive features, users can better understand the scale of the problem, explore its impacts, and build greater awareness—ultimately encouraging more responsible actions toward a cleaner environment.

**Challenges we ran into**

- Lack of Diversity: Datasets that do not represent the full range of variations (e.g., lighting, angles, occlusions) the model might encounter in real-world scenarios can result in poor generalization.

- Data format mismatches (backend sends JSON, frontend expects array/object differently).

- CORS errors when frontend and backend are on different domain

- Different local vs production behavior

- Classification & Identification Errors

- Class imbalance leading to biased predictions.

- Mislabelled training data.

- Visualization & Analysis Bugs

**The problem it solves**

# Mock.AI - Revolutionizing Career Preparation Through Artificial Intelligence

## 💡 The Vision Behind Mock.AI

The job market presents unique challenges for both job seekers and hiring professionals. Candidates often lack access to realistic interview practice environments, while recruiters struggle to efficiently evaluate technical competencies and soft skills. Mock.AI emerged from recognizing these pain points and leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to create a comprehensive solution that transforms how people prepare for careers and how companies assess talent.

## 🎯 What Mock.AI Delivers

Mock.AI is a sophisticated AI-driven career preparation ecosystem that combines interview simulation, resume optimization, and skill assessment into one unified platform. The system creates personalized learning experiences through intelligent question generation, provides comprehensive resume analysis using advanced natural language processing, and offers interactive career guidance through adaptive quizzing mechanisms.

### Core Capabilities

**Intelligent Interview Simulation Engine**
Our platform generates contextually relevant interview questions based on job roles, company requirements, and individual candidate profiles. The system incorporates voice recognition technology and real-time response evaluation to create authentic interview experiences that help candidates build confidence and improve their communication skills.

**Advanced Resume Intelligence**
Using Google's Gemini AI, Mock.AI transforms traditional resume review processes by automatically parsing PDF documents, extracting structured career data, and providing detailed compatibility analysis against specific job requirements. The platform offers actionable feedback and scoring mechanisms that help candidates understand their market positioning.

**Adaptive Learning Through Assessments**
The quiz system delivers role-specific technical evaluations that adapt to user performance, providing personalized learning paths and identifying areas for skill development. This creates a comprehensive understanding of candidate capabilities beyond traditional screening methods.

**Comprehensive User Experience**
The platform integrates seamlessly with modern authentication systems, maintains detailed progress tracking, and provides intuitive dashboards for both individual users and organizational stakeholders.      



## 🏆 Key Achievements & Impact

### Technical Milestones
- Successfully integrated multiple AI models for different use cases within a single platform
- Developed a comprehensive resume parsing system that handles various document formats and structures  
- Created an adaptive interview system that personalizes questions based on user profiles and job requirements
- Implemented real-time voice processing with high accuracy speech recognition

### User Experience Innovations
- Designed intuitive interfaces that make advanced AI capabilities accessible to users with varying technical backgrounds
- Created comprehensive feedback systems that provide actionable insights for career development
- Developed progress tracking mechanisms that help users monitor their improvement over time

### Platform Capabilities
- Built a scalable architecture that supports concurrent users across multiple services
- Established robust data management systems that maintain user privacy while enabling personalized experiences
- Created flexible assessment frameworks that adapt to different industries and job roles

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the major challenges I encountered was integrating multiple frameworks like React, Flask, and Express into a single workflow. Each framework had its own structure, dependencies, and way of handling requests, which made achieving smooth interoperability and maintaining consistency across the stack quite difficult.

Another challenge was ensuring real-time speech recognition accuracy. Achieving low latency while still maintaining high transcription quality required experimenting with different APIs, handling background noise, and optimizing the pipeline to avoid delays or mismatches.

I also faced difficulties in designing an effective ATS scoring system. The challenge was to go beyond surface-level keyword matching and create a scoring mechanism that could evaluate candidates more meaningfully—factoring in skill relevance, experience, and overall fit without introducing bias.

Lastly, implementing secure role-based access control (RBAC) posed its own hurdles. Balancing security with usability was tricky, as I had to ensure that sensitive data remained protected while still allowing candidates, recruiters, and admins to access the right features without friction.

- **AI-Generated Questions**: Questions tailored to user’s role or tech stack.
- **Instant Feedback**: Receive AI feedback on your answers immediately.
- **Authentication & Security**: Built with Firebase for secure user sessions and role-based privacy.

**Challenges we ran into**

# Challenges We Ran Into

While building **HatchWayss**, a few hurdles stood out:

1. **Integrating AI for Realistic Interviews**  
   - Challenge: Getting the AI to generate contextually relevant and role-specific interview questions, instead of generic outputs.  
   - Solution: Iterated prompts, fine-tuned how context was passed into the AI, and added structured templates for different roles/skills.

2. **Voice/Realtime Interaction**  
   - Challenge: Making interviews feel natural with voice features introduced latency and sync issues.  
   - Solution: Optimized API calls, reduced unnecessary re-renders in the frontend, and cached responses to keep interactions smoother.

3. **Authentication & Security (Firebase)**  
   - Challenge: Handling role-based access while ensuring smooth sign-in/sign-up. Initially ran into session handling bugs where users were randomly logged out.  
   - Solution: Switched to Firebase’s recommended persistence strategies and added clear separation of user states (student vs. admin).

4. **State Management in Next.js**  
   - Challenge: With multiple interview states (questions, responses, feedback), managing everything got messy.  
   - Solution: Adopted React Context + custom hooks to simplify state flow across components.

5. **Deployment Issues (Vercel)**  
   - Challenge: Some APIs worked locally but broke after deploying to Vercel due to environment variables and serverless timeouts.  
   - Solution: Centralized all environment configs and optimized long-running requests by offloading them to background functions.

---

###  Takeaway
Each challenge forced me to dive deeper into **AI prompt engineering, Next.js optimization, and secure authentication flows**. Overcoming them not only fixed the bugs but also made the platform more **robust, scalable, and user-friendly**.

**The problem it solves**

Over the course of many months a farmer grows some crops but due to some natural deficiency in the soil or unfavorable weather conditions the yield of those crops diminishes. If only which crop will provide the best yield in the soil and based on the forecasts of coming months is planted the farmers benefits will increase. This app uses the power of artificial intelligence to solve this problem by suggesting what might be the best crop to be shown in the given soil now.

**Challenges we ran into**

In creating this app the major problem we faced was that how to reach to all the different farmers all over the country who are less educated and have diverse languages of conversation. We designed our app to keeping it simplistic by just 3 click generation system and multiple language support for inclusion of all. In just three clicks(photo upload of soil, input of area of land, and submit), the minimum you can get the best crops to grow in your own language.
