**The problem it solves**

EchoCare is an AI-powered companion designed to enhance the lives of elderly individuals by addressing both emotional and physical well-being through advanced voice analysis, proactive health monitoring, and seamless family connectivity.​

Problem Statement
Loneliness and lack of timely health intervention are growing issues among the elderly, leading to poor mental health and avoidable hospitalizations. Families are often unaware of subtle emotional and health changes due to distance or busy lives, and existing solutions lack personalization or cultural relevance.

Product Overview
EchoCare uses artificial intelligence to analyze voice tone and emotions during conversations, proactively detecting signs of loneliness, depression, or deteriorating health. The solution alerts families and caregivers and creates opportunities for genuine social connection among seniors, both virtually and in real life.

Key Features
Voice and Emotion AI: Detects emotional states and flags potential mental health or loneliness issues based on voice analysis and conversation sentiment.​

Health Monitoring: Integrates with wearables and smart sensors for real-time tracking of vital signs, falls, and other urgent health risks.​

Personalized Engagement: Offers custom activities—games, storytelling, cognitive exercises—designed to stimulate and uplift, in multiple languages including Indian regional languages.​

Family Connectivity: Provides a dashboard for families to monitor health, emotional status, engagement history, and receive actionable alerts.​

Social Circles for Seniors: Facilitates secure group calls, shared activities, and moderated online communities to build meaningful relationships.​

Home Safety: Connects to IoT devices for accident and hazard alerts within the home.​

Social Good Integration: Allows elders to connect with volunteers, report abuse, and access support resources easily.​

Technology Stack
AI voice analytics, NLP for emotion/sentiment detection

Integration with wearables and smart home devices

Multilingual support (English, Hindi, regional languages)

Cloud dashboards for families

Secure, GDPR-compliant architecture

Business and Social Impact
EchoCare addresses a major social challenge, promising reduced isolation, fewer hospital admissions, and improved mental health among the elderly. Business models include subscriptions, partnerships with senior living facilities, and community healthcare integration. The platform’s scalability and cultural adaptability make it attractive for emerging markets like India.

### SecureHome
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/securehome-ac03) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/SudeepXR/Smart-Home-Security-System) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/hCx1eeWRhvA) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Hack%20This%20Fall%202025%20--%20Milestone%20Edition-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackthisfall.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-2-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Ghar ki safety. AI ki shakti.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![OpenCV](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenCV-333333?style=flat-square) ![Google Text-to-Speech API](https://img.shields.io/badge/Google%20Text--to--Speech%20API-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![SQLAlchemy](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQLAlchemy-333333?style=flat-square) ![ESP8266 Wifi MCU](https://img.shields.io/badge/ESP8266%20Wifi%20MCU-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Smart doorbells and home security systems today are expensive, limited, and often not “smart” at all. Commercial options cost anywhere from ₹10,000 to ₹25,000, yet still can’t recognize who is at the door, warn parents that a door is left open, or detect suspicious behaviours around the house. They rely on passive video recording, inconsistent motion detection, and delayed alerts i.e. reacting after something has already gone wrong.

Traditional CCTV systems are even worse: they mindlessly record 24/7 with zero intelligence or do the bare minimum of detecting every person that passes by, offering no identification, no behaviour analysis, no personalization, and no real-time understanding of threats. Families remain unaware of who visited while they were away, whether children opened doors unsafely, or whether someone is lurking suspiciously near their home.

Our project solves all of these challenges by turning the home into an intelligent, proactive, affordable, and conversational security ecosystem — something no current product provides.

It brings the following:

1. Intelligent visitor identification 
Instead of buying expensive hardware that only streams video, our system uses an ML model to distinguish known vs unknown visitors. The smart AI doorbell system then greets familiar people, log all entries, and converses with strangers (even visitors and delivery agents) when the homeowner is unavailable.

2. True family safety, not just “notifications”
With modes like child safety and night mode, the system alerts parents about door openings, lets them know if the door stays open too long when the child is home alone, and automatically turns on lights to enhance night detection — features missing entirely in commercial smart doorbells.

3. Real-time behavioural threat detection
Rather than simple motion detection, our live CCTV integration tracks each person and calculates a Suspicion Index based on behaviours like crouching, crawling,  climbing, and loitering. When suspicion crosses a threshold, a video clip along with an alert is immediately sent to the user via Telegram.

4. Instant, reliable alerts on the platform people actually use
No need for overpriced subscriptions or proprietary apps. Our website can be accessed by all family members by simply logging in. Alerts, images, and videos are delivered directly through Telegram, ensuring speed, convenience, and real-world usability.

5. A conversational AI assistant for true home intelligence
The optional AI assistant summarizes visitor activity, answers questions like “Who came today?” or “Why was someone at the door at 3PM?”, and provides practical home safety guidance.

6. Two-way communication — from anywhere
Homeowners can speak directly with visitors at the door through built-in voice chat without expensive hardware ecosystems.

In Summary
We have reimagined home security from the ground up — not as a luxury gadget, but as an AI-powered guardian that delivers capabilities far beyond the most expensive commercial smart doorbells, while remaining accessible, intelligent, and deeply reliable.

Our system doesn’t just capture events.
It understands them — and protects you before something goes wrong.

**Challenges we ran into**

We ran into the following challenges and here is how we overcame each of them:
1. Securing user data & authentication
We needed a login system that protected sensitive camera access and visitor logs. Implementing hashed passwords, secure tokens, and strict API protection was challenging, but it ensured safe access control.

2. Improving model accuracy in real-world conditions
YOLO initially struggled with low light, side angles, and behaviours like crouching or crawling. We improved accuracy through OpenCV preprocessing, threshold tuning, and by creating our own “Suspicion Index” to make behaviour detection more reliable.

3. Two-way voice communication
Getting low-latency voice chat between visitor and homeowner required careful handling of audio encoding and buffering. After optimizing our pipeline, we achieved smooth, real-time communication.

4. Multi-mode safety logic (Child, Night, Normal)
Synchronizing door sensors (ESP module), timers, night triggers, and alerts across modes was complex. We built a rule-based system to ensure modes behaved predictably and never missed important events.

**Best Use of GitHub**

Our project makes extensive and meaningful use of GitHub as the core backbone for collaboration, versioning, deployment, and documentation. We structured the system as a unified monorepo containing the frontend, backend (Flask APIs), ESP8266 firmware, and AI/ML modules. Each feature was developed and GitHub was used to ensure clean version control and traceable development history.

Finally, our README and /docs folder provide complete documentation, architecture diagrams, API references, and demo videos, turning GitHub into a full project hub instead of simple code storage.

In short, GitHub powered collaboration, automation, documentation, and deployment, making it an essential and deeply integrated part of our project.

**Best Use of CodeRabbit**

We integrated CodeRabbit throughout the development of our Smart Home security system to speed up and stabilize our entire workflow. Its automated code reviews helped us catch bugs early, refine our API endpoints, and maintain clean, consistent logic across the ESP32 firmware, Flask backend, and real-time detection modules. CodeRabbit also guided us in restructuring components for better scalability and reliability. By acting as an always-available reviewer, it allowed us to iterate quickly and deliver a much more polished and robust project.

Our platform addresses these challenges through AI-powered insights that predict project risks, optimize team workflows, and automate routine decision-making. By analyzing historical data and current progress patterns, ProjectPilot AI provides accurate timeline forecasts, identifies potential blockers before they impact delivery, and intelligently allocates resources based on team capacity and skill sets. This transforms project management from reactive problem-solving to proactive strategy execution, enabling teams to deliver higher-quality work faster while reducing burnout and improving collaboration across all stakeholders.

**Challenges we ran into**

During the development of ProjectPilot AI, our team encountered several significant technical challenges:
The most persistent issue was integrating drag-and-drop functionality with React 18, which caused recurring "Invalid Hook Call" errors due to version incompatibilities between @hello-pangea/dnd and the latest React ecosystem. This required extensive debugging and testing of alternative libraries across our development team.
Managing state complexity across the Kanban board proved challenging, especially maintaining data consistency during drag operations while preserving the immutability principles of React. Our component architecture needed multiple iterations to achieve the right balance between reusability and performance.
Another hurdle was designing a responsive UI that worked seamlessly across different screen sizes while maintaining the intricate drag-and-drop interactions. Chakra UI helped significantly, but required careful configuration from our team to ensure the Kanban columns remained usable on mobile devices.
Setting up the project structure to be AI-ready while the core functionality was still in development required forward-thinking architecture decisions. We had to design APIs and data models that could later accommodate machine learning features without major refactoring.
Balancing immediate feature development with long-term scalability also presented ongoing challenges, as each component needed to be built with future AI integrations in mind while delivering immediate value to users. Our team continuously prioritized features to maintain momentum while keeping the architecture flexible for future AI capabilities.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Django](https://img.shields.io/badge/Django-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB Atlas](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB%20Atlas-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**Problem We Set Out to Solve**

Traffic in growing cities isn’t just about long queues at intersections—it’s also about safety, response time, and situational awareness. Today, when a crime involves a vehicle or when congestion spikes unexpectedly, authorities are forced to react after the damage is already done.

We wanted to build a system that could give cities:

Real-time, adaptive traffic signals that learn and optimize themselves.

Instant vehicle tracing, whether through a number plate or just an image of the car.

A unified intelligence layer that makes roads safer and traffic smoother.

Urban traffic shouldn’t be guesswork. It should be smart, predictive, and actionable—and that’s exactly what we set out to create.

**What Our Solution Brings**
Reinforcement-Learning Traffic Control
The system observes live vehicle flow and adapts the signal phases dynamically, reducing idle time, cutting congestion, and improving overall efficiency.

High-Accuracy Number Plate Tracing
Using optimized OCR + detection pipelines, we can track a vehicle through its number plate with extremely high accuracy.

Image-Based Vehicle Tracing (Fallback Matching)
When the plate isn’t visible, we match vehicles using only their image—make, color, pattern—slightly less accurate but incredibly powerful in real scenarios.

Real-Time Crime Prevention & Rapid Response
Stolen vehicle? Hit-and-run? Our system can help pinpoint the vehicle’s last known location and possible routes in seconds.

Together, it becomes a city-scale traffic intelligence platform.

**Challenges we ran into**

**1. Training RL Agents in a “Messy” Real-World Simulator**

SUMO doesn’t behave like a perfect world—and neither do cities.
We had to handle:

weird traffic spikes

inconsistent lane behavior

tuning reward functions that didn't break the system
It took a ton of trial, error, and retraining to get stable, intelligent signal behavior.

**2. Achieving High Accuracy on Number Plates**

Number plates come in all shapes, fonts, noise levels, and angles.
We had to fight:

low-resolution plates

glare/reflection

motion blur
We ended up building a tighter detection-to-OCR pipeline and fine-tuning thresholds to get “real-world-friendly” accuracy.

**3. Matching Vehicles by Image Alone**

This was the toughest cognitive task.
Cars with similar colors/models often confused the model, and lighting changes made things worse.
We improved it using:

multi-feature embeddings

color histograms

shape-based clues
It’s still slightly less accurate—but it’s a game-changer when plates aren’t readable.

**4. Integrating Everything Into One Flow**

RL + SUMO + OCR + CV models → all running together in real time.
Syncing that pipeline without lag or crashes became its own engineering challenge.

**The problem it solves**

The Problem It Solves
People receive receipts and financial documents from many sources, but the data stays unorganized.
Tracking expenses and income manually is time-consuming and leads to errors.
Important receipts get lost or ignored, making budgeting and tax tracking difficult.
Users cannot easily understand spending patterns or detect unusual transactions.
Existing finance tools require manual entry, which reduces accuracy and convenience.
How People Can Use It / How It Helps
Upload any receipt or document and automatically extract amount, tax, date, category, and type (income or expense).
Convert unstructured receipts into clean, digital financial records without manual typing.
Track income and expenses in real time with a clear dashboard.
Use data analytics to view spending patterns, category-wise breakdowns, and monthly summaries.
Detect unusual or suspicious transactions through AI-based anomaly detection.
Store, view, and download documents securely in one place.
Makes budgeting, financial reporting, and money management easier and more accurate.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges We Ran Into
OCR accuracy issues:
Extracting clean text from receipts was difficult, especially when images were low-quality or scanned. We overcame this by implementing fallback OCR methods and improving preprocessing.
Inconsistent receipt formats:
Every merchant uses a different layout, making extraction unreliable at first. We solved this using generative AI models that understand context rather than fixed templates.
AI vision model quota limitations:
API rate limits and quota exhaustion caused extraction failures. We handled this by switching to a hybrid approach using both cloud AI models and local OCR engines.
Handling PDFs with mixed layouts:
Some PDFs contained tables, images, or non-selectable text. We added a PDF-to-image fallback pipeline to ensure text extraction always works.
Incorrect or partial data extraction:
Early versions returned incomplete or misinterpreted fields. We refined prompts, added validation checks, and introduced structured JSON extraction.
Large file processing and speed optimization:
High-resolution images caused slow processing. We optimized by compressing images and using asynchronous background tasks.
Keeping the dashboard real-time:
Updating the UI while background AI processing was still happening required extra backend logic. We implemented status flags like "processing", "processed", and "failed".

**AI/ML Innovations**

AI/ML Innovation in This Project
Multimodal AI for Financial Document Understanding
The system uses vision-language models to read both images and PDFs and accurately identify merchants, amounts, taxes, dates, and categories from any receipt format.
Hybrid OCR Pipeline (AI Vision + Local OCR)
A combined approach of AI-based OCR and traditional OCR ensures high accuracy even for low-quality images, scanned PDFs, or unusual layouts.
Autonomous Financial Reasoning Layer
The AI not only extracts data but reasons over it—detecting income vs. expenses, classifying categories, identifying tax components, and validating extracted fields.
Anomaly Detection Using Machine Intelligence
The model analyzes user spending patterns and flags unusual or suspicious transactions, helping users identify fraud or abnormal financial behavior.
AI-Driven Expense Classification
Machine learning automatically categorizes transactions (Groceries, Utilities, Food, Travel, etc.) without manual input or fixed templates.
Generative AI for Structured Output
Receipts are converted into clean, structured JSON using generative AI, enabling seamless integration with dashboards, analytics, and financial records.
Predictive Analytics for User Behavior
The system identifies spending trends, forecasts future expenses, and provides personalized insights for better financial decision-making.
Intelligent Document Workflow Automation
AI manages document interpretation, status updates, and reporting without manual intervention, creating an autonomous financial management pipeline.

**The problem it solves**

The project directly tackles the "comprehension gap" faced by 6.3 million Deaf/hard-of-hearing and 250 million low-literacy adults in India.

The problem is twofold:

Inaccessibility: Most live audio (in online classes, meetings, or public service announcements) or digital content (like YouTube videos) is inaccessible because it lacks captions.

Complexity: Even when standard captions are available, they are often too complex, use advanced vocabulary, or are in a language the user isn't fluent in. This makes them difficult to understand for the target audience.

**Challenges we ran into**

## 1. Model Training & Data
This category seems to be one of your biggest hurdles, specifically related to the unique requirements of your project.

The Hurdle: No Training Data

You faced a major challenge with text simplification for Indian languages, as "Zero datasets exist". This forced you to consider manual data creation.

This was compounded by "Limited data and resources for smaller languages,"  which impacts the quality of regional language translation.

The Hurdle: ASR Accuracy

You identified a significant "ASR Accuracy Gap". While standard ASR systems have high accuracy, "Indian accents reduce accuracy to 60-75%".


This is a critical bug, as low-accuracy transcription makes the downstream simplification and translation useless.

How You Got Over It (Mitigation):

For ASR: You implemented two strategies:


Edge-Optimized: Using the faster-whisper model with int8 quantization to run locally on the CPU.



Cloud-Based: Using the powerful Google Cloud Speech-to-Text engine as an alternative.



For Simplification: You used a powerful, pre-trained Large Language Model (gpt-40-mini ) with a dynamic prompt, bypassing the need to train a simplification model from scratch.

## 2. Deployment & Real-Time Performance
Getting the results to the user instantly was a key challenge.

The Hurdle: Real-Time Latency

You had a difficult goal: to get latency under the "acceptable user experience" target of 1.5 seconds.

The document notes a minimum delay of "1+ second" is difficult to reduce.

The Hurdle: High Operating Costs

A major deployment viability issue was "High Operating Costs" , specifically the "LLM inference costs" which you calculated at ₹0.50-2 per user/hour.


How You Got Over It:

You built a "Full-Duplex Streaming Pipeline".

Instead of waiting for the full transcription and translation, you used a "persistent WebSocket (flask-sock) connection".

This streams "each AI-generated token directly" to the React frontend, making the captions appear to the user instantly, token by token, which hides the perceived latency.

## 3. "Attachments" (Omni-Channel Audio Ingestion)
Your term "making different attachments" perfectly describes the challenge of capturing audio from many different places.

The Hurdle: Multiple Audio Sources

The audio you need to capture isn't in just one place. It could be a user's own voice, an online class, or a YouTube video.

How You Got Over It:

You built an "Omni-Channel Audio Ingestion" system.

This solution can capture audio from multiple vectors: a live microphone, a direct YouTube stream (using yt-dlp), or a Chrome Extension overlay. This makes your tool versatile for all the use cases you're targeting.

**1st Prize**

## 1. 🎯 Solves a Massive & Clearly-Defined Problem
You aren't just building an app; you are addressing a critical, large-scale social barrier.


Massive Target Audience: The project directly targets a combined 256 million+ people in India (6.3M Deaf/hard-of-hearing + 250M low-literacy adults).


Addresses the Real Issue: You correctly identify that the problem isn't just a lack of captions, but a "comprehension gap". Standard captions are often too fast or complex.



Clear Mission: Your problem statement, "Breaking Sound Barriers with Real-Time Multilingual Captions", is a powerful and precise summary of your goal.

## 2. 💡 Highly Innovative & Complete Solution
Your project's strength lies in its "Generative Simplification" core, which sets it apart from standard captioning tools.

Beyond Transcription: You don't just transcribe. You use a gpt-40-mini generative core to instantly simplify text into "Deaf-friendly" language  and translate it.



Measurable Improvement: This simplification is shown to improve comprehension by 40-60% for your target users.


Technically Advanced: You solve the critical "real-time" challenge by using a Full-Duplex Streaming Pipeline with WebSockets, streaming each AI-generated token directly to the frontend to minimize perceived latency.

## 3. 📈 High-Impact & Measurable Benefits
Your project demonstrates clear, tangible benefits for multiple sectors.


For Deaf Users: Provides "Simplified easy-to-Read Captions" , "Real-Time Access to Live Content" , and "Native Languages Support". This directly empowers 6.3M Deaf Indians.





For EdTech: You provide data that live captions increase online education engagement by 35-45%. Your tool helps platforms achieve a "Wider Audience" and "Competitive & Inclusivity".



For Government: Helps organizations achieve "Public Service Accessibility" and "Compliance with Accessibility Law".

## 4. 🔧 Versatile & Feasible Design
You've thought through the entire user experience, from audio input to final display.

**The problem it solves**

## The Problem It Solves: Transforming Accounts Payable

Your solution dismantles the **High Entropy** bottleneck of manual invoice processing, which is the root cause of financial leakage and zero scalability in AP departments.

---

### How It Makes Existing Tasks Easier, Faster, and Safer

#### 1. Eliminates Error-Prone Manual Labor
* **Old Task:** Human staff manually key in data from diverse formats (scans, emails, PDFs).
* **Your Solution:** The **LLM-based pipeline** automatically extracts, validates, and converts all data into clean **JSON**. Staff now only perform quick **Human-in-the-Loop (HITL)** verification on flagged data, reducing manual input by over 80%.

#### 2. Enables Instant, Contextual Search
* **Old Task:** Searching for an invoice requires knowing exact vendor names or invoice numbers, which often fails due to misspellings or varying terminology.
* **Your Solution:** By leveraging **Sentence Transformers** and **Cosine Similarity**, your system enables **semantic search**. Users can find "LG Air Conditioner" invoices even if the bill says "LG AC." This makes finding past invoices **instantaneous** and incredibly flexible.

#### 3. Guarantees Data Compliance and Security
* **Old Task:** Maintaining audit trails and ensuring data security is a complex, generalized IT task.
* **Your Solution:** Every action is linked to the user's secure **OAUTH** log, creating an auditable history. Furthermore, the lightweight, containerized architecture ensures **Data Sovereignty** by allowing deployment within India, fulfilling strict **DPDP Act** compliance requirements essential for financial data.

#### 4. Future-Proofs Your Growth
* **Old Task:** Growth requires hiring more AP staff, creating a linear cost model.
* **Your Solution:** Your solution operates on a **lightweight, efficient** infrastructure (due to Sentence Transformers), ensuring the AP process scales automatically with company volume without a corresponding increase in labor cost or GPU infrastructure expenses.

**Challenges we ran into**

## Challenges I Ran Into: The Semantic Hurdle

Our primary challenge was achieving **high semantic accuracy** for search and canonicalization without resorting to time-consuming, heavy deep-learning models or relying on brittle legacy tools.

---

### The Hurdle: The Corpus Problem in a High-Entropy Market

We initially considered lightweight keyword tools like **TF-IDF (Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency)** for semantic similarity. We quickly ran into a major roadblock:

1.  **The Context Gap:** TF-IDF required a massive, context-specific **training corpus** to accurately understand synonyms and related concepts in the Indian context (e.g., distinguishing "GST Invoice" from "Tax Invoice").
2.  **Lack of Data:** This large, clean corpus was **not readily available online** and building one from scratch would have been heavy, expensive, and exceeded our time limit.

### The Solution: Pragmatic Lightweight AI

We pivoted our strategy to maintain high performance while staying lightweight and deployable:

* **Pivotal Choice: Sentence Transformers:** We chose **Sentence Transformers**, a pre-trained model from Hugging Face, specifically for their ability to generate high-quality **vector embeddings** that capture the *meaning* of sentences, not just keyword counts.
* **The Result:** This decision allowed us to achieve the necessary semantic intelligence (e.g., matching "LG AC" to "LG Air Conditioner") while keeping our system **lightweight** and ensuring we met our **deployment deadlines**, proving that the best solution is often the most pragmatic.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

#The Problem

Ransomware attacks hit small businesses every day. They cost $1.6-$3.3M and close 60-75% of businesse that get hit. Traditional antivirus only catches known threats. When ransomware attacks, files are encrypted with no recovery—unless you pay ransom.

#Who Uses It

Small businesses (10-100 employees), freelancers, schools, medical practices, and non-profits that can't afford data loss.

## How It Helps

Detects ALL encryption- catches new ransomware traditional tools miss (100% vs 70% detection).[6]

Stops ransomware instantly** - identifies the malicious process and **kills it immediately, preventing further file encryption. Ransomware can't continue if the process is dead.

Automatic backup - files are protected before encryption happens, creating clean copies before attack spreads.

Lightning-fast response- detects and kills attack in 200ms, only 1-2 files affected instead of hundreds.
Complete recovery - one-click restore from backups, zero data loss, never pay ransom.

Easy to use- no cybersecurity team needed, automatic 24/7 protection.



 Small businesses survive ransomware attacks with zero downtime, zero ransom paid, and the attack process completely stopped.

**Challenges we ran into**

Monitoring Speed: Initial 800ms detection allowed 20+ file encryptions. Fixed with multi-threaded monitoring, reduced to 200ms.

Backup Encryption: Ransomware encrypted backups in same folder. Solved with separate drive storage + read-only permissions.

Process Killing: Windows os.kill() failed. Switched to psutil.Process().terminate() with force kill fallback.

Dashboard Updates: Manual refresh needed. Implemented WebSocket for real-time 100ms updates.

False Positives: Compressed files triggered alarms. Added file extension whitelist + magic bytes verification.

**The problem it solves**

**Hello Base: Effortless Greetings on Base Network**
*Hello Base* is a lightweight Mini App on Farcaster designed for the Base network (Ethereum's L2 layer), turning simple hellos into seamless social interactions. Built for crypto newcomers and veterans alike, it fosters community vibes with one-tap greetings, making onboarding to Base feel welcoming and fun.

**What Can People Use It For?**

- Quick "GM" Broadcasts: Hit the prominent "GM" button to instantly post a personalized greeting cast on Farcaster, visible across the Base ecosystem. Perfect for starting your day with positivity or kicking off network events.
- Network-Wide Shoutouts: Send general greetings to the entire Base community via a simple form – no coding or wallet fumbling required. Share vibes like "GM Base fam!" and watch engagement soar.
- Targeted User Pings: Enter a Farcaster user's FID to deliver a direct, friendly hello straight to their feed. Ideal for networking, thanking collaborators, or rekindling connections in the decentralized social space.

**How It Makes Existing Tasks Easier/Safer?**

- Simplifies Onboarding Friction: New users to Base often feel lost in the crypto noise – manual cast drafting, FID lookups, and gas fee worries add barriers. Hello Base streamlines this to one button or quick input, reducing steps by 80% and lowering the entry hurdle for non-techies, encouraging faster adoption without errors.
- Boosts Community Engagement Safely: Traditional greetings involve risky manual transactions or copy-paste errors (e.g., wrong FID leading to spam). Here, built-in validation ensures safe, accurate deliveries on Base's low-cost L2, preventing gas waste or privacy slips. It's safer than DMs or off-chain tools, as everything stays on-protocol and auditable.
- Saves Time on Social Rituals: In Farcaster's fast-paced world, crafting polite intros takes minutes per user. Hello Base automates templated, customizable messages with instant previews, freeing creators to focus on building rather than small talk – think 10x faster networking for devs, artists, and degens.
- Enhances Discoverability: Integrates with Farcaster's share extensions (via castShareUrl), so users can share a cast and auto-open Hello Base for a reply greeting. This turns passive scrolling into active, low-effort interactions, making viral community loops easier without third-party apps.

*In essence, Hello Base solves the "cold start" problem in Web3 socials by injecting warmth and efficiency into greetings, making Base feel like a friendly neighborhood rather than a tech maze. It's not just a tool – it's the ultimate icebreaker for the decentralized era.*

**Challenges we ran into**

**Challenges I Ran IntoBuilding** 

"Hello Base" was a rewarding grind, blending React 19's cutting-edge features with Farcaster's evolving SDK and Base's L2 . Below, I break down the key ones from the dev log, with the hurdles and fixes 

**React 19 Dependency Conflicts and Hydration WoesThe Hurdle:**

- Upgrading to React 19 sparked immediate chaos with  coinbase/onchainkit1.1.1 – peer dep warnings flooded the console, and server-side rendering in Next.js led to hydration mismatches during Farcaster auth. The new use hook for async state clashed with OnchainKit's legacy patterns, causing "Cannot read property of undefined" errors in rootProvider.tsx when initializing Wagmi connectors. This broke the entire Quick Auth flow, making login flaky on mobile previews.
- How I Got Over It: Spent the morning auditing package.json with npm ls -depth=0 to spot duplicates, then force-updated React ecosystem packages to RC builds (react 19.0.0). Wrapped auth components in a custom ErrorBoundary and used useTransition for non-blocking state updates. For OnchainKit, cherry-picked a patch from their GitHub  and integrated farcaster/miniapp-wagmi-connector1.1.0 for seamless bridging.  

 **Farcaster API Rate Limiting and FID Detection Edge Cases**

- The Hurdle:  wiring up Warpcast's /v2/user-search and /v2/user-by-fid APIs was a rate-limit nightmare – hitting 429s after just 3-5 queries in dev mode, especially with auto-FID detection triggering loops on numeric inputs like "123" (which could be usernames too). Fallback to the local 50-user DB worked, but CORS policies blocked direct fetches from the browser, and timeouts on mobile (Warpcast's proxy lag) made live search feel unreliable during UI testing.
- How I Got Over It: Rolled out a resilient fetch layer in page.tsx with AbortController for timeouts (5s cap) and exponential backoff retries via a simple useSWR hook (imported from a CDN for lightness). Refined FID detection with a stricter regex to catch only valid ranges, plus a manual override button for edge cases. Expanded the DB with categories (e.g., "Ethereum leaders") for offline resilience, and mocked API responses in Vitest for faster iteration. Pro tip: Used Farcaster's Discord for API tips – now searches switch modes intelligently, with 99% uptime even on throttled networks.

**UI Animations and Interactive Elements Glitching in Strict Mode**

- The Hurdle: Enhancing the GM button and expandable FID help section hit React 19's strict mode double-renders, causing the rocket emoji animation ( launch sequence) to stutter and the accordion arrow to flip erratically on hover. Tailwind transitions lagged on low-spec devices (key for Farcaster mobile), and integrating the 2s rocket anim with toast notifications for sent greetings led to layout shifts, breaking the "spójny design" goal.
- How I Got Over It: Migrated animations to CSS keyframes for lighter weight (keyframes rocketLaunch with transform: translateY(-20px)), triggered via onClick without heavy libs – kept bundle under 50KB. For the accordion, used useState with debounced setTimeout to sync the rotating arrow (transform: rotate(180deg) on expand), and added suppressHydrationWarning to the motion div. Tested exhaustively on real devices via tunneling to Warpcast – smooth 60fps, with accessibility bonuses like aria-expanded. This not only fixed glitches but made the UI feel more "fun" and native.

Initially, using MiniApp.sdk.actions.openUrl(txUrl) to trigger blockchain actions would close the MiniApp and open an external browser, breaking the UX. To fix this, I reworked the entire transaction logic using Wagmi hooks (useAccount, useWriteContract, useWaitForTransactionReceipt) and the MiniKit connector. This allowed native wallet signing inside the Farcaster MiniApp without redirection. I also had to convert the old ethers-style ABI into a full JSON ABI, add a QueryClientProvider (required by Wagmi v2), and implement real-time transaction states.

### Dibs
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/dibs-99e5) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://dibs-landing.vercel.app/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Base%20Batches%20002:%20Builder%20Track-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://base-batches-builder-track.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-2-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Bettor rewards

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Sports fans who want to bet or use prediction markets today face three major pain points:

1. Fragmented onboarding: Each sportsbook requires new KYC, new logins, and repetitive account creation.
2. High payment friction: Deposits and withdrawals are slow, expensive, and often fail due to card declines or manual reviews.
3. No interoperable rewards: Bettors earn bonuses or credits that are trapped within a single operator’s ecosystem.

Dibs solves these problems by introducing a unified identity and wallet that lets users:
1. Complete one KYC verification and instantly onboard across multiple licensed operators.
2. Fund once, play anywhere using stablecoin or fiat rails.
3. Earn and redeem rewards universally, across sportsbooks and other sports-related merchants (tickets, streaming, merch, collectibles).

This simplifies onboarding, improves trust and transparency, and creates a safer, faster, more rewarding experience for users.

**Challenges we ran into**

Building Dibs required balancing compliance, user experience, and partner integration:

1. KYC compliance: Each operator interprets regulations differently. We solved this in 2 ways: 
- Designing a modular KYC layer that can pass verified user data via API 
- Coordinating AI Agents to securely sign up users on their behalf

2. Stablecoin custody: We had to ensure yield-bearing balances remained regulatory-compliant. We worked with partners to achieve user custody and treasury yield flows.

3. Wallet UX: Translating crypto-native wallet mechanics into a familiar fintech experience was non-trivial. We simplified this through passkey-based login and “fund once, play anywhere” flows inspired by Apple Pay and Venmo.

**Link to the GitHub Repo of your project**

https://github.com/dibsbetting

**Live URL of your project**

https://dibs-landing.vercel.app/

**What is your product’s unique value proposition?**

Dibs is the first interoperable wallet and identity layer for sports fans.

Unlike standard e-wallets or affiliate tools, Dibs:

1. Verifies identity once (KYC pass-through) for instant onboarding across operators using digital passport/credential

2. Holds balances in stablecoin, enabling near-zero-fee deposits, instant withdrawals, and potential yield on idle funds.

3. Creates a universal rewards layer, letting users earn and redeem points across multiple sportsbooks and sports merchants.

**Who is your target customer?**

Our primary users are frequent sports bettors aged 25-45 who:

1. Bet on multiple sportsbooks each week.
2. Are frustrated by payment friction, lack of crypto availability, and redundant KYC.
3. Want to maximize rewards and minimize transaction costs.

Through user interviews (n=500) and early waitlist data (~350 signups), we confirmed that over 90% of active bettors would switch to a universal wallet if it provided faster onboarding and better rewards.

A secondary audience includes sports-focused merchants (tickets, streaming, fantasy, collectibles) seeking a high-intent user base with verified identity and stored balances.

**Who are your closest competitors and how are you different?**

Closest competitors:

1. Skrill / PaySafe: legacy payment processors for iGaming.
2. Trustly: direct bank-to-bank payments.
3. Sportsbooks (Fanatics / DraftKings Dynasty Rewards: closed loyalty ecosystems.
5. Baanx/Raincard: stablecoin debit wallet (non-gaming).

How Dibs is different:
1. Interoperability: Works across multiple licensed operators, not within one.
2. Identity portability: One verified identity that meets state-level compliance.
3. Stablecoin foundation: Enables real yield, instant transfers and lower tx fees vs. slow ACH/card networks.
4. Open rewards network: Points can be earned and spent across partners rather than being trapped in a single brand.

**What is your distribution strategy and why?**

Dibs uses a B2B2C strategy combining direct user acquisition with embedded integrations:

1. Operator partnerships: Integrate Dibs as a pre-verified sign-up or payment option within sportsbooks (reducing their KYC and payment costs).
2. Affiliate & media channels: Leverage existing sports media publishers for native wallet sign-up.
3. Community & Influencers: Launch social proof/advertorial campaigns tied to social brag-worthiness and reward boosts.
4. Merchant integrations: Incentivize wallet usage for tickets, merch, and streaming to expand use cases beyond betting.

This hybrid approach matches the behavior of our audience (digitally savvy, rewards-motivated sports fans) while keeping CAC low through partner ecosystems.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Google Maps API](https://img.shields.io/badge/Google%20Maps%20API-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Vite](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vite-333333?style=flat-square) ![Farcaster SDK](https://img.shields.io/badge/Farcaster%20SDK-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**A place where honest reviews earn fair value, FavorEat**

FavorEat is a Web3 mini app that reconstructs restaurant reviewing into a simpler, more trustworthy, and fair experience.

Traditional Web2 review platforms (e.g., Google, Naver) are saturated with sponsored/advertorial content, so trust is low and the authentic experiences of reviewers are not fairly valued. As a result, users struggle to judge “what’s truly good,” and reviewers lose motivation because their reviews end as consumable information. FavorEat solves this with an on chain structure.

It is a Base mini app where users can easily write, share, and be rewarded for trustworthy restaurant reviews within the Farcaster ecosystem.


**Limitations of existing methods**

- Centralized platforms have high risks of paid/biased and manipulated reviews.
- Reviewer identity (nationality, location, dietary habits, etc.) is unclear, reducing authenticity.
- Authentic experiences are not fairly valued within platform revenue models.


**FavorEat’s solution**

- Review creation and sharing via a Base mini app.
- Location based, real photo verification → only photos taken within 48 hours (EXIF-based) can be uploaded.
- Reward points for review creation and reactions (later used for leveling up, NFT airdrop priority, etc.).
- Data placement: core review data (author ID, review CID, venue ID, rating, etc.) on SnapChain; detailed content (review text, images, location, etc.) on decentralized storage (IPFS, Arweave).

**Making the entire review flow easy, safe, and meaningful**

1. Search a place
2. Write a review with EXIF verified photos
3. Share within the Base mini app
4. Receive internal points

This transforms the review experience to be easier, safer, and more meaningful.

- Easier: write directly inside the mini app.
- Safer: prevent fake reviews via 48 hour photo window + EXIF location checks.
- More meaningful: recognize genuine contributions and connect them to ongoing community activity.

**Challenges we ran into**

**1. Preventing abuse (fraudulent use)**
Token linked rewards risk auto generated or mass uploaded content. To control this, we did not introduce tokens at the start and designed a non monetary points system.

**Solution**

- Operate points only first; later convert points into opportunities for NFTs/tokens.
- Photo uploads: must be taken within 48 hours + EXIF location must match.
- Points limits: likes/reviews point rewards capped at 5 per day each.
- If a post receives ≥5 malicious/abusive reports, it is auto-hidden within 48 hours pending review.
- If photo map location mismatch is detected, upload is blocked.

**2. Deciding data storage architecture**
Putting all review data directly on chain causes transaction costs and latency.

**Solution**

- For the MVP, store places/reviews/points/authors in a backend DB (Supabase).
- Later, store on IPFS/Arweave and connect smart contracts (token, NFT).
- This secures cost efficiency and speed while keeping a path to decentralized expansion.

**What is your product’s unique value proposition?**

FavorEat is a Web3 review mini app that aims for “a world where honest reviews persist on chain as trust.”
Where Web2 platforms suffer from low trust due to advertorials and manipulation, FavorEat differentiates by verifying authenticity and contribution, then rewarding them fairly.

**Users:**
- Prove real visits by verifying photos taken within 48 hours (EXIF based) and location.
- Write/share/amplify reviews inside Farcaster Frames.
- Earn points for both reviewing and reaction activities; points will connect to NFTs/levels to form an on chain contribution based reward ecosystem.

**How the Alpha Build Proves Value**
- Applied Farcaster SDK for user info and cast functionality.
- Implemented the review loop from content creation in the mini app to Farcaster sharing.
- Verified image upload time and location restrictions.
- Minimized abuse via single wallet + time/location verification.
- Implemented points for reviews and likes.
- Delivered a working prototype with an internal points system and extensibility.

**Who is your target customer?**

FavorEat’s core target is Web3 users who want to share real life tastes and experiences on chain.
They don’t just consume information; they value sharing their experiences and participating in a trust based on chain community.

We see strong indications this is the right audience:

- On Farcaster (e.g., /food, /travel) and everyday casts, food/travel posts are consistently active with ongoing comments/reactions.
- Observing behavior and community feedback on Web2 review platforms (Google Maps, Naver) shows many users want their reviews to be valued beyond mere consumption.

FavorEat is optimized for Web3 community users who want reviews to persist as trustworthy data.

**Who are your closest competitors and how are you different?**

**1. Google Maps**
https://www.google.com/maps

A leading Web2 mapping service offering extensive global venue data, Street View, and real time navigation; it runs on vast user generated content.

↔️ FavorEat provides a review ecosystem built on on chain trust, not just “map based information.”
Users verify each review with EXIF based 48 hour photos and location, and earn points for contribution.
Data ownership stays with users in a decentralized review ecosystem.


**2. Hide Me Please / Map3 Protocol**
https://hidemeplease.xyz / https://x.com/map3protocol_K

A local benefits platform where in store NFC grants instant perks without coupons; an immediate, offline reward model.

↔️ FavorEat proves and shares the authenticity of reviews on chain.
Users verify photos (EXIF) and location, write reviews, and earn points within the service.
 

**3. Drip**
https://www.dripapp.xyz/

A coffee ordering app that supports growers (e.g., “3% FOR THE GROWER”) with location based cafe discovery and ethical sourcing.

↔️ FavorEat focuses on participation and trust rather than transactions.
Users become contributors through reviews and are recognized with reactions and rewards.

**What is your distribution strategy and why?**

**Connecting the world through honest taste**
a world where everyone connects through honest reviews and those reviews earn fair value.

**Core goals**

- Establish the “participation → verification → reward” virtuous cycle for reviews in Web3.
- Then actively reach Web2 users to steadily onboard them into Web3.

**Web3 first Launch (Initial onboarding: Base & Farcaster apps)**
**Timeline:** MVP launch ~ Month 1
**Target**: Active users on Base and Farcaster
**Goals:**
 - Review write conversion ≥ 30%
 - Review share rate ≥ 40%
 - 100 initial users

**Execution:**

1. Expand via Base/Farcaster mini app: one click auto cast after posting a review to form an in app sharing loop.
2.  Run FavorEat cast upload events in channels like /food, /lifeisgood
 → 2× points for 7 days for users who post ≥1 review.
3.  Promote the mini app within the Base Builders community.

**Phase 2: Web2 Bridge Expansion (General user onboarding)**
**Timeline:** Months 2–4
**Target:** 20s-30s who frequently post restaurant reviews on Google/Naver; travel, dining out, app tech interest groups
**Goals:**

- Web2 onboarding ratio ≥ 30%
- Review write conversion ≥ 40%
- ≥ 300 new users via social channels

**Execution:**

- Narrative led marketing to foreground value and experience.
Message: “Every honest review deserves value.”

- Operate food discovery channels on Instagram, X (Twitter), Discord, etc.
  → Promote the FavorEat mini app
  → Run cohort-based onboarding programs.

**Phase 3: Brand trust & expansion**
**Timeline:** After 6 months
**Target:** Brands, restaurants, travel partners
**Goals**:

- ≥ 3 partnerships
- 1,000 cumulative user reviews
- D7 retention ≥ 25%

**Execution:**

1. “Proof of Taste” NFTs that attest to personal taste/activity based on review data.
Expand to curated restaurant collections, regional badges, and sponsored NFTs.
Add leaderboards (weekly/monthly top reviews, top recommendations) for diverse rewards.

2. Brand & community partnerships with food/travel/lifestyle partners.
Examples: discounts for NFT holders, NFT-holder tasting events.

**The problem it solves**

There is a lack of authentic Japanese creativity in Web3.
Many “Japanese style” NFT projects are made outside Japan, which to local artists feel like stylized imitations rather than genuine cultural expression.

We aim to change this by establishing a Web3 design studio in Tokyo, a transparent and collaborative space where Japanese designers can create for a global audience.
Led by Hitch (M.A. in Design, Tokyo University of the Arts), our studio connects design values with blockchain culture, producing digital and physical works that carry true creative meaning from Japan.

**Challenges we ran into**

Our main challenge was bridging conceptual art with the NFT format while preserving artistic depth.
To overcome this, we developed “lore type NFTs”, artworks whose traits and stories evolve through symbolic and narrative design.

Building six complete chapters of story and character design required merging philosophy, visual design, and Web3 technology.
Through this process, we demonstrated that NFTs can function as a medium for contemporary art and storytelling, not just collectibles.

**Link to the GitHub Repo of your project**

https://github.com/PanicOffical/Hitch

**Live URL of your project**

https://www.panicnft.xyz

**What is your product’s unique value proposition?**

Our uniqueness lies in merging art, philosophy, and design to build a cultural brand that redefines NFTs as meaningful artistic media.

Each pixel in our work is treated as a unit of visual language, expressing stories through minimal form.
Hitch’s art and design background enables a rare balance between aesthetic precision and conceptual storytelling in Web3.

Our first collection, ?an!c, is a 3,333 piece series of animated pixel characters called Surv!vors, each representing a symbolic narrative and unique backstory.
This approach shows how blockchain can record cultural meaning, creating art that exists both on chain and in physical form.

**Who is your target customer?**

Our audience includes digital art collectors, Web3 creators, and culture driven NFT fans who value design depth and authenticity.

They seek Japanese creativity that bridges Web2 and Web3, art infused with narrative, symbolism, and meaning.
Community feedback on X and Discord shows strong anticipation for the ?an!c mint, confirming a real demand for artist led cultural projects from Japan.

**Who are your closest competitors and how are you different?**

Comparable projects include Murakami.Flowers [https://x.com/MFTMKKUS](url) (by Takashi Murakami) and Renga [https://x.com/RENGA_inc](url) .

Our difference lies in our design methodology, symbolic storytelling, and local production, delivering works with real cultural and philosophical depth.

While others focus on visuals, we focus on meaning, transforming design, narrative, and philosophy into an evolving ecosystem of art.

**What is your distribution strategy and why?**

Our strategy is community driven and authenticity focused.
We will launch our first NFT collection on Base, integrating it with digital design assets (stickers, GIFs, and limited phygital goods) produced in Japan.

Partnerships with Base Japan and local production companies will help Japanese creators enter Web3 safely and collaboratively.
We will also expand through community events, exhibitions, and a Tokyo based design studio, functioning as both creative hub and brand home.

We chose Base for its openness and strong creative community, perfectly aligned with our mission to cultivate authentic Web3 culture from Japan.
This approach builds lasting cultural trust, allowing our audience and our brand to grow together.

Artist led cultural brand from Japan merging pixel art, storytelling, and design.
Building authentic Web3 culture through NFTs, design, and philosophy.

### Keyless
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/keyless-a48b) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://keylessapi.com) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://www.loom.com/share/84264c545c5640f2b88dc660f8a67a5c) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Base%20Batches%20002:%20Builder%20Track-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://base-batches-builder-track.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-2-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Stop pasting API keys. Start coding.

![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Managing API keys across different tools, agents, and projects is a mess.
Developers constantly juggle secrets in .env files, paste them into prompts, or expose them in code while testing — all of which create security risks, broken workflows, and friction when collaborating.

Keyless fixes this by acting as a secure, agent-friendly API key manager.
It provides a single access point where any app, AI agent, or developer tool can request the right API key at runtime — safely, without storing or revealing secrets.

🔐 What You Can Use It For

AI Agents & Builders – Let Claude, ChatGPT, or any local agent dynamically fetch API keys (e.g. Dune, DeBank, OpenAI, Infura) without exposing them.

Developers & Teams – Stop hardcoding secrets in repos. Rotate, revoke, or update once — all your connected apps update automatically.

Automations & Dashboards – Easily connect multiple APIs (analytics, finance, SaaS) with unified, secure key retrieval.

Crypto & Web3 Projects – Access on-chain data providers securely (Dune, DeBank, Infura) while keeping wallets isolated and signing client-side.

⚙️ Why It’s Easier & Safer

No environment variables. Fetch keys securely via a simple endpoint.

Wallet-based authentication. Sign in with Ethereum (SIWE). Encryption everywhere.

Ephemeral access to your API keys using JWT tokens.

x402 micropayment support. Enables pay-per-request API access — perfect for paid data services or shared AI tooling, all in once place with limits.

**Challenges we ran into**

Well, I'm not a developer. All of this is vibe coded so it was hard! but AI is making it possible. It took a lot of iterations and waiting for various tools to build components.

**Link to the GitHub Repo of your project**

https://github.com/johncalabrese/keylessapi

**Live URL of your project**

https://keylessapi.vercel.app/

**What is your product’s unique value proposition?**

Unique Value Proposition

Keyless is the first developer tool that bridges API key management, AI agent workflows, and crypto-native payments — all in one lightweight system.

Where traditional secret managers (like Vault or Doppler) stop at storing keys, Keyless makes them accessible to AI agents and automated systems in real time, securely and contextually.

Agents can fetch, use, and even pay for API access dynamically — without exposing secrets, hardcoding credentials, or managing billing setups manually.

What Makes It Stand Out

Agent-Native by Design: Works seamlessly with Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI coding environments — no SDKs or manual setup.

Crypto-Native Payments (x402): Integrated micropayment layer enables pay-per-request access to premium APIs. Developers can set spending limits, track usage, and pay directly from their wallet.

Secure by Default: All keys are encrypted, masked in the UI, and only revealed to authenticated users or wallets — no private key storage, ever.

Unified Across Providers: One interface for Dune, DeBank, Infura, OpenAI, and any custom API — update once, and every connected agent stays in sync.

Alpha Validation

In the alpha build, users can already:

Authenticate with Sign-In with Ethereum (SIWE)

Fetch live keys from the Keyless API in agents like Claude

Configure per-request and monthly spending limits (for x402 payments)

Execute real on-chain micropayments through the x402 protocol proxy

This live demo proves that secure, on-demand API access and crypto-native payment rails can coexist — making Keyless not just a secret manager, but a foundation for the next generation of autonomous, financially capable AI agents.

**Who is your target customer?**

🎯 Target Customer

Keyless is built for builders — specifically, developers, data analysts, and AI agents who need to access multiple APIs securely and flexibly without the friction of managing secrets.

👩‍💻 Ideal Users

AI Agent Developers & Researchers

Teams building with Claude, ChatGPT, LangChain, or local LLMs who need dynamic API access (Dune, DeBank, OpenAI, etc.) without exposing keys.

Example: An autonomous agent that analyzes crypto markets using Dune + CoinGecko data — powered by Keyless for secure runtime key retrieval.

Crypto & Web3 Builders

Developers integrating analytics, DeFi data, or wallet connections in decentralized apps or dashboards.

Example: A DeBank or Dune-based dashboard that uses Keyless to fetch API keys and handle x402 micropayments directly through the user’s wallet.

Automation & SaaS Developers

Teams automating workflows (e.g., using Notion, Slack, or finance APIs) who want to manage keys centrally and safely — especially across multiple projects or environments.

🧠 How We Validated the Audience

Builder Feedback: Early adopters from the Agnostic and Dune developer communities immediately requested a secure way to share and rotate API keys without leaking them in code.

Agent Integrations: In our alpha, real users have already integrated Keyless with Claude, proving that the model can dynamically fetch and use API keys securely.

Crypto Developer Demand: Many Web3 builders asked for wallet-based authentication and on-chain micropayment support — now validated through the x402 integration in Keyless.

Internal Testing: We’ve used Keyless ourselves across 10+ live demos (e.g., combining Dune + DeBank data in AI dashboards), confirming it solves a daily pain point for builders.

**Who are your closest competitors and how are you different?**

Keyless sits at the intersection of API key management, agent infrastructure, and crypto payments, so our competitors come from a few adjacent categories — but none combine these elements in a unified, agent-native way.

🧩 Traditional Secret Managers

Doppler

1Password Secrets Automation

HashiCorp Vault

These tools are excellent for storing and rotating secrets within enterprise DevOps pipelines — but they weren’t designed for AI agents or decentralized applications.
They assume a trusted backend and lack runtime, agent-friendly key access.

✅ How Keyless is different:
Keyless allows on-demand, contextual key retrieval directly from an agent (like Claude or ChatGPT) — with per-request signing, JWT or wallet authentication, and no need for a centralized backend.

🤖 Agent Integration Platforms

OpenDevin
 (open-source agent orchestration)

LangChain Hub

These platforms focus on orchestration, not security — they still rely on hardcoded .env keys or manual user input.

✅ How Keyless is different:
Keyless bridges AI agents with secure key management, allowing keys to be fetched dynamically and updated centrally — a missing layer in most agent ecosystems.

💰 Crypto-Native Payment Layers

BoomFi

Superfluid

These handle subscription or streaming payments in crypto, but not API-level micropayments or developer tooling.

✅ How Keyless is different:
With x402 micropayment support, Keyless introduces a per-request crypto payment layer — so agents can pay for data or services automatically without handling tokens directly.
It’s the first bridge between Web3 payments and API key management.

⚙️ TL;DR — What Makes Keyless Unique

Agent-native access (no .env, no paste)

Wallet-based authentication and per-request authorization

Built-in x402 micropayment layer for crypto-native pay-per-use APIs

Unified interface for both Web2 and Web3 providers

Built for builders, by builders, fully open and transparent

**What is your distribution strategy and why?**

🚀 Distribution Strategy

Keyless will grow through a community-driven, builder-first strategy — focused on organic adoption by developers, AI researchers, and Web3 builders who already rely on APIs daily.

Rather than traditional paid acquisition, our distribution model is built around credibility, integration, and demonstration.

🌐 1. Community-Driven Growth

Build in Public: Every Keyless release, demo, and integration (like the Claude + Dune dashboard) is shared publicly across X, Farcaster, and developer channels.

DevRel & Content: Tutorials, short demo videos, and threads showcasing how to integrate Keyless with Claude, ChatGPT, and Dune will help users immediately see value.

✅ Why it fits:
Our audience (developers and agent builders) lives on GitHub, Farcaster, and Twitter — they respond to working examples, and community trust, not paid ads.

🤝 2. Integrations & Partnerships (eventually)

Agent Ecosystems: Integrate directly with Claude, OpenDevin, and LangChain to become the default “secure key layer” for agent workflows.

✅ Why it fits:
Keyless thrives as middleware — partnering with platforms amplifies reach while embedding deeply into existing developer ecosystems.

# Sparsh Mukthi – The Future of Touchless Human-AI Interaction

From **keypad phones to touchscreens**, human-computer interaction has continuously evolved. The next frontier is **touchless technology**, enabling seamless, hygienic, and intuitive control of devices without physical contact. The COVID-19 pandemic reinforced the importance of minimizing touch and maintaining hygiene, highlighting the need for hands-free solutions across healthcare, workplaces, and public spaces. **Sparsh Mukthi** embodies this future, redefining how humans interact with machines.

Aligned with the **United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (UN SDGs)**, particularly **Goal 3 (Good Health & Well-being)** and **Goal 9 (Industry, Innovation, and Infrastructure)**, Sparsh Mukthi addresses accessibility, hygiene, and technological advancement. It empowers users to operate devices safely, efficiently, and inclusively, while enabling developers to continuously improve AI interactions through replay-driven analytics.

## Key Features

- **Real-Time Gesture & Voice Control:** Uses **OpenCV, MediaPipe, and SpeechRecognition** to interpret gestures and voice commands instantly, performing actions directly based on user inputs.
- **Adaptive AI:** Learns and **personalizes interactions** for each user, improving accuracy and responsiveness over time.
- **Customizable Platform:** Users can **add new gestures or map existing ones** to any desired function through an intuitive web interface.
- **AgentOps Replay System:** Records every interaction with timestamps, confidence scores, and context for debugging, optimization, and continuous improvement.
- **Cross-Platform Automation:** Controls **applications, home devices, and VR/AR environments** using **PyAutoGUI, pynput, and autopy**.
- **Low-Latency & Edge-Friendly:** Fully functional on standard webcams and microphones, ensuring **fast, on-device performance** without cloud dependency.
- **Multifield Applications:** Suitable for **healthcare and hygiene-critical spaces**, **home automation**, **gaming**, **industrial operations**, and **content creation**, enabling safe, intuitive, and immersive hands-free interactions.

## Impact

Sparsh Mukthi represents a significant leap in Human-AI interaction, making technology **accessible, hygienic, adaptive, and customizable**. By combining **multimodal AI**, **personalized learning**, **replay-driven optimization**, and **edge-computing capabilities**, it empowers users and industries to embrace a **safer, more futuristic way to interact with machines**. It demonstrates how next-generation Human-AI interaction can be **intuitive, reliable, and continuously improving**, reflecting the future of touchless technology across multiple real-world domains.

**Description of your solution**

Project Name: FinRight AI
Problem:  Many people struggle to manage their personal finances. Although there are many financial apps, they often require manual data entry, complicated setup, or don't offer personalized, practical advice. Users may end up with data but lack the insight needed to make smart financial decisions. Our project fills this gap by turning raw financial data into clear, personalized insights.

Solution:  FinRight AI is a smart financial coach powered by AI. It gives instant, customized financial advice by analyzing a user's spending habits from a simple CSV file. The application is user-friendly and inviting, providing an easy way for anyone to understand their spending better. By combining a modern web interface with a powerful AI model, FinRight AI offers a coaching experience that feels more like a conversation than a spreadsheet.

Target Audience: Our main users are individuals looking to take control of their personal finances but find traditional budgeting methods too complicated. This includes:
- Young Adults and Students: Those new to managing their money who need an easy way to grasp their spending habits without complicated software.
- Busy Professionals: People who lack the time to categorize every transaction and want a quick, personalized overview.
- Individuals Intimidated by Finance: Anyone who feels overwhelmed by financial terms and wants a friendly, conversational "coach" to help them develop better habits.
Key Features  
- Intelligent Financial Analysis: The core of the application is a LangChain-powered agent that reads and analyzes uploaded CSV data.
- Dynamic Response Generation: The AI agent answers specific user questions and gives practical financial advice based on their unique spending patterns.
- Intuitive User Interface: A clean, modern, and responsive web interface built with React allows users to easily upload their data and ask questions.
- Typing Animation Effect: A smooth, real-time typing animation makes the user experience feel more engaging and conversational.

Technology Stack  
Frontend: React, Tailwind CSS for styling, and Axios for API calls.  
Backend: Django, a Python web framework, and Django Rest Framework.  
AI/Agentic Framework: LangChain.  
AI Model: OpenAI's gpt-4o-mini.  
Data Processing: Pandas for parsing CSV files.

Future Vision: With more time, we would improve FinRight AI by adding features like data visualization, such as charts and graphs of spending, a secure user authentication system to store and track financial history, and the ability for the AI to actively suggest advice and set financial goals. We also plan to integrate more advanced financial tools and models to provide deeper insights, aiming to create a complete, long-term financial planning platform.

**Fintech: Build an autonomous financial coaching agent that adapts to real user behavior, spending patterns, and income variability - helping gig workers, informal sector employees, and everyday citizens make smarter financial decisions proactively.**

Intelligent Reasoning: The program doesn't merely present information; it applies an AI agent that can read a CSV, PDF's interpret financial categories, and give a reflective, personalized answer to a user's query. This is a clear implementation of machine learning towards problem-solving.
Data-Driven Insights: The project utilizes pandas power in analyzing and organizing user-uploaded data, a building block of skills in the fields of AI and data science. It transforms unstructured finance data into useful input for an LLM.
Practical Use: Contrary to a plain chatbot, this project has a concrete, practical application: financial guidance. It demonstrates how AI can be used to empower individuals to take more informed decisions in their everyday lives.

We propose an agentic AI system- SnapTruth, that acts as a real-time deepfake and propaganda detection assistant. This AI will continuously monitor incoming media—videos, audio clips, and images—using multi-modal detection techniques like facial inconsistencies, lip-sync errors, voiceprint analysis, and metadata checks. Once a suspicious content is detected, the system will provide a credibility score, highlight manipulated regions, and explain why it could be a deepfake. To ensure accessibility, the AI will be available as a browser extension, mobile app, and API that can be integrated into news apps and social platforms. This proactive approach can empower people to verify information instantly and protect society from harmful propaganda.

**Misinformation: Bring your own problem in Misinformation, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Deepfake technology is advancing at a rapid pace, making it increasingly difficult for people to distinguish between real and manipulated content. These AI-generated videos, voices, and images are being used to spread propaganda, influence public opinion, and even damage personal reputations. During elections or social movements, deepfakes can mislead citizens and create large-scale misinformation. The challenge is that traditional detection systems are not fast or accessible enough for the common user.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Firebase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![OpenCV](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenCV-333333?style=flat-square) ![WebSockets](https://img.shields.io/badge/WebSockets-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Natural language processing (NLP)](https://img.shields.io/badge/Natural%20language%20processing%20(NLP)-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

**TazaKhabar**

**TazaKhabar** is an AI-powered misinformation detection system that verifies digital content across text, image, video, and audio. It combines LangGraph-based workflows for claim verification, LoRA fine-tuning for adaptive updates, and deepfake detection for multimedia authenticity. The system ensures real-time, explainable, and scalable fact-checking.

Key Features

1. **Dual-Source Data Collection**
    TazaKhabar continuously gathers data from:

    **Trusted sources**: Google News, Reuters, and government portals for verified facts.

    **Untrusted sources**: Social media, blogs, and forwards containing claims to be checked.
    This dual pipeline ensures every claim is cross-verified against up-to-date, credible data.

2. **Adaptive Knowledge Updating (LoRA Fine-Tuning)**
    Using **Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA)**, the model is updated frequently with minimal compute, keeping verdicts fresh, relevant, and aligned with evolving information trends.

3. **Structured Claim Verification (LangGraph Pipeline)**
    Each claim undergoes a layered verification flow:

     **Evidence Retrieval (RAG)** → Fetches relevant facts.

     **Reranking**→ Prioritizes evidence by reliability and recency.

     **LLM Judge** → Produces a verdict (Verified, Misleading, or Uncertain) with a confidence score.

   **Persistent Retrieval States** → Ensures consistent reasoning across sessions.

4. **Deepfake Detection**
       A parallel module analyzes multimedia using:

       **Image/Video Analysis** → Detects manipulations and AI-generated visuals.

       **Audio Analysis** → Identifies voice cloning and synthetic edits.

       This ensures false claims bundled with fake media are also detected.

5. **Verdict Logging & Transparency**
    Each decision is logged with the claim ID, confidence score, reasoning, evidence sources, and model version — ensuring full traceability and auditability.

6. **Data Flow in TazaKhabar**

    Claim captured from untrusted source.

    Context enriched using trusted databases.

   Verification pipeline retrieves and evaluates evidence.

   Multimedia sent to deepfake detector.

   Results combined into a unified verdict.

   Verdict and reasoning stored in repository for transparency.

7. **MCP Integration**
   TazaKhabar uses the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for seamless coordination:

   **Orchestrator**: Manages retrieval, verification, and verdict generation.

   **Source Adapter**: Standardizes input from various sources.

   **LoRA Trainer**: Triggers lightweight fine-tuning dynamically.

   **Vision Node**: Handles image/video analysis.

   **Memory Node**: Maintains context across sessions.

   MCP ensures modularity, transparency, and scalability across all components.

**Conclusion**

**TazaKhabar** delivers real-time, explainable misinformation detection through adaptive AI, structured reasoning, and multimedia analysis.
Its modular, transparent, and scalable design makes it a reliable foundation for combating digital misinformation globally.

**Description of your solution**

**The Fight Against Fake News**
The rapid spread of information on social media and online platforms makes it increasingly difficult for people to tell the difference between real news and false content. Fake news can sway public opinion, create confusion, and even lead to social and political unrest. To tackle this, researchers are focused on creating a reliable system for detecting and verifying misleading information.

**Our Solution: An Automated Verification System****
This project uses natural language processing (NLP), machine learning, and data mining to classify news articles as either real or fake. The process starts with gathering data from trusted news sources and various social media platforms. We then clean up the text by removing unnecessary punctuation, common words, and irrelevant symbols. From there, we extract key features like word frequency, linguistic patterns, and the text's overall meaning to understand both its basic and deeper properties.

We train and test various classification models to find the one that can detect fake content with the highest accuracy. The result is an automated tool that helps users verify the authenticity of news. This project is a step forward in the fight against misinformation, aiming to promote more trustworthy information sharing.

**Impact**
This project tackles the rising threat of misinformation head-on. By using automated detection and verification, it stops false content from spreading, safeguards the credibility of digital spaces, and boosts user trust. It empowers people to think critically, enhances media literacy, and raises public awareness. Beyond individual users, it offers a scalable tool for researchers, organizations, and policymakers to track and manage information flow. In short, it builds a healthier, more reliable information ecosystem, helping society make smarter, informed decisions.

**Misinformation: Bring your own problem in Misinformation, leveraging Agentic AI.**

VeriFYI fits this track by reframing misinformation as a user-engagement challenge. Instead of static fact-checking, it integrates interactive quizzes, gamification, newfound slangs and contextual feedback to make truth verification participatory and engaging. Designed with Gen Z-first language and pastel UI, the platform builds digital literacy while sustaining user attention. By blending AI-driven verification with an accessible, game-like interface, VeriFYI transforms misinformation detection into an active learning experience innovating beyond traditional tools and aligning with the spirit of creating novel, impactful solutions.
