![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Firebase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Google Maps API](https://img.shields.io/badge/Google%20Maps%20API-333333?style=flat-square) ![AWS](https://img.shields.io/badge/AWS-333333?style=flat-square) ![OpenAi](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenAi-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

SmartPath is an AI-powered solution designed to make public transport smarter, safer, and more inclusive. Today, passengers face long boarding times due to cash payments, fraudulent ticketing practices, lack of accessibility for differently-abled individuals, and almost no real-time monitoring or emergency response. Our project tackles these challenges by creating a multi-agent AI system that works collaboratively to improve the passenger and authority experience.
The Accessibility Agent provides chatbot and voice support to guide passengers, ensuring inclusivity for differently-abled users. The Payment and Fraud Agent processes Aadhaar/UPI-based digital transactions while detecting anomalies to reduce fraud. Meanwhile, the Dashboard Agent helps authorities track occupancy, payments, and system health in real time.
In critical situations, the Emergency Agent instantly notifies authorities, enhancing passenger safety. To promote sustainability, the Sustainability Agent recommends eco-friendly routes and provides insights into greener mobility options. Together, these agents form an ecosystem that reduces inefficiency and builds trust in public transportation.
For the hackathon demo, we plan to implement three working agents — Passenger Chatbot, Payment & Fraud, and Emergency — along with a simple dashboard for monitoring. The Accessibility and Sustainability agents will be presented as future roadmap features. This ensures we can showcase a working prototype while also highlighting the long-term impact of our idea.
SmartPath will lead to faster boarding, reduced fraud, better inclusivity, and more responsive emergency systems, while also supporting green transport goals. Ultimately, it empowers both passengers and authorities with AI-driven tools for safer, transparent, and efficient public mobility.

**Fintech: Bring your own problem in Fintech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

SmartPath directly aligns with the FinTech track by reimagining how payments and fraud prevention work in public transport. Today, most passengers still rely on cash-based transactions, which lead to long boarding times, revenue leakages, and opportunities for fraud. Our system introduces an AI-powered Payment and Fraud Agent that enables Aadhaar/UPI-based digital transactions for faster and more transparent ticketing.
The Payment Agent not only processes seamless digital payments but also applies AI-driven anomaly detection to identify fraudulent activities such as pass misuse, duplicate tickets, or suspicious transaction patterns. This ensures greater security and trust for both passengers and transport authorities.
By embedding financial technology into daily commuting, SmartPath improves accessibility to digital payments, reduces dependency on cash, and builds a fraud-resilient ecosystem for public transport. At the same time, the dashboard for authorities provides clear financial transparency, which helps in better revenue tracking and accountability.
In short, SmartPath leverages FinTech innovation to solve critical problems in public transportation, combining the ease of digital payments with the intelligence of fraud detection systems, while also enhancing passenger safety and inclusivity.

**Description of your solution**

**NIRNAY AI** is an advanced AI-powered platform designed to detect and combat misinformation during global and local crises. It scans diverse content streams including text, audio, video, and social media posts using **cutting-edge** multimodal AI techniques to analyze code-mixed and regional languages. By cross-referencing claims with trusted fact-checking databases and real-time sources, Nirnay AI generates accessible, contextual verdicts that help users distinguish between true, false, or uncertain information. The platform prioritizes transparency, accessibility, and user empowerment through multilingual explanations, audio summaries, and an intuitive interface aimed at reducing harm caused by misinformation.
 
***Minimum Viable Product (MVP) Features:***

**1.**	**Multi-format Content Submission:** Users can submit suspicious content via app, web, or Meta APIs in various formats including text, audio, video, and social posts.

**2.**	**Preprocessing Pipeline**: Automated Speech-to-Text (STT), Optical Character Recognition (OCR), and language detection supporting code-mixed and regional languages, producing unified transcripts for analysis.

**3.**	**Multimodal AI Analysis:** Advanced models analyze text, images, and videos to identify misinformation cues, including linguistic signals, deepfake detection, and metadata inconsistencies.

**4.**	**Fact-Checker Engine:** Cross-references content against internal archives, credible news sources, and government databases to verify claims with ranked citations.

**5.	**Verdict** Delivery:** Provides clear, confidence-scored labels (Fake, Real, Open/Uncertain) accompanied by user-friendly explanations and evidential citations.

**6.**	**Accessibility Support:** Features multilingual captions, text-to-speech audio summaries, and customized outputs to ensure broad usability.

**7.**	**User Interaction:** Enables users to appeal, request human review, share verdicts, or keep results private through a flexible UI and API.

**8.**	**Archive and Transparency:** Stores verdicts and related artifacts in a searchable public library to promote trust and ongoing fact-checking.

**Misinformation: Create an Agentic AI system that continuously scans multiple sources of information, detects emerging misinformation, verifies facts, and provides easy-to-understand, contextual updates to the public during crises.**

*NirnayAI is an intelligent agentic AI system built to align perfectly with the Misinformation track: 
it continuously scans multiple sources such as social media, news, and uploaded content for emerging misinformation during crises, uses advanced AI to detect and verify questionable claims, and delivers easy-to-understand, contextual updates with supporting evidence to the public. With features like multilingual support, accessibility, intuitive verdicts, and transparent archiving, NirnayAI empowers society with reliable information exactly when it is needed most.*

**Description of your solution**

**Problem Statement**

Consumers struggle to navigate complex and often misleading food labels. They frequently rely on packaging claims like “Sugar-Free” or “Natural Ingredients” without truly understanding whether those claims align with their personal health conditions (such as diabetes, hypertension, allergies, or fitness goals).

Existing solutions provide only generic nutritional facts, not personalized insights. There is a clear gap in connecting a food product’s actual composition with a consumer’s unique health profile.

**Solution:**

**FoodLens AI** is an **Agentic AI-powered** mobile application built using Flutter that helps users instantly analyze the nutritional value and health impact of any food item simply by scanning or uploading a photo of it.

Once a user registers, the app collects basic health details (age, weight, conditions like diabetes, cholesterol, etc.) and stores them securely. Using this data, FoodLens AI acts as a personal AI health companion that:

- Scans food or packaged items using the camera.
- Identifies ingredients and their nutritional breakdown.
- Provides health-based insights — e.g., “This item is high in sugar; not suitable for diabetes. Try this alternative.”
- Learns user preferences over time to improve recommendations.
- Allows users to update or edit health records anytime for accurate results.


**Agentic AI Integration**

Our backend uses an Agentic AI system that operates as an autonomous decision-making health assistant.
It continuously learns from user behavior, food patterns, and feedback to deliver personalized, dynamic, and explainable insights — far beyond static food analysis apps.
This makes FoodLens AI adaptive, context-aware, and truly intelligent — aligning perfectly with the Agentic AI theme of the hackathon.

**Technologies Used**

- **Frontend:** Flutter (for cross-platform mobile app)
- **Authentication & Database:** Firebase
- **Backend:** Node.js + Python (AI Model API integration)
- **Agentic AI System:** Autonomous AI modules for personalized nutrition feedback and adaptive learning
- **Image Recognition:** TensorFlow Lite + custom model integration
- **Cloud Services:** Firestore & Google Cloud Storage


**Go-To-Market (GTM) Strategy**

**Target Users**
Health-conscious individuals, diabetic and hypertensive patients, fitness enthusiasts, and wellness startups.

**Launch Plan**
**Phase 1:** Beta testing with students, gym communities, and wellness enthusiasts.
**Phase 2:** Strategic partnerships with nutritionists, gyms, and health brands for validation and promotion.
**Phase 3:** Public app launch with AI-driven personalization as our unique USP.

**User Engagement**
- AI-driven suggestions and daily health insights.
- Gamified challenges and progress tracking.
- Multilingual support for accessibility across India.
- Option to share food health scores and achievements.

**Monetization:**

**Free Plan:**

- Scan or upload up to 5 products per month (combined across scan/upload/search).
- Basic ingredient insights and nutritional breakdown.
- No access to chatbot or advanced AI reasoning.

**Premium Plan:**

- Unlimited scans/uploads/searches.
- Advanced AI insights including long-term health recommendations.
- Access to FoodLens ChatBot

**Vision**

To make FoodLens AI India’s most intelligent and trusted nutrition companion, empowering users to make informed, healthy food decisions every single day.

**Misinformation: Bring your own problem in Misinformation, leveraging Agentic AI.**

FoodLens AI directly addresses the growing problem of **misleading food labels and health claims** that cause consumers to make uninformed dietary choices. By using **Agentic AI** and verified nutritional databases, it identifies **false** or **exaggerated product claims** (like “sugar-free” or “100% natural”) and provides users with **accurate, personalized insights** based on their health profiles. This helps users distinguish **truth from marketing-driven misinformation** and make safe, data-backed food decisions effectively combating **misinformation in the nutrition and wellness space.**

> Smart AI Triage for Mumbai’s Quickest Response

![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![SQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![SQLite](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQLite-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Google Maps API](https://img.shields.io/badge/Google%20Maps%20API-333333?style=flat-square) ![JSON](https://img.shields.io/badge/JSON-333333?style=flat-square) ![WebRTC](https://img.shields.io/badge/WebRTC-333333?style=flat-square) ![AI/ML](https://img.shields.io/badge/AI/ML-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

We propose Mumbai A.I.D. (Agentic Intelligent Dispatch) — an Agentic AI-powered emergency triage and dispatch system.

**Flow Architecture (MVP)** :
1. **Input**: User enters symptoms in natural language (e.g., “My father is having severe chest pain and can’t breathe”).
2. **AI Triage**: A lightweight, fine-tuned NLP model (DistilBERT) classifies the case (Cardiac, Trauma, Respiratory, Neurological, etc.).
3. **Hospital/Doctor Match**: The backend queries a mock database of 10–15 Mumbai hospitals, their specializations, and linked doctors.
4. **Ambulance Dispatch Simulation**: Selects from 5–10 virtual ambulance starting points and plots the fastest route with ETA.
5. **Output Dashboard**: User sees a status screen with:
- Map (Google Maps API) showing ambulance route.
- Hospital details + doctor name.
- A button to join a WebRTC video call for immediate medical guidance.


**Target audience**: Citizens in emergencies, hospitals, doctors, ambulance providers, municipal authorities.

**GTM & Revenue Streams**:

- **GTM**: Pilot → BMC + 108 partnerships → city-wide mobile launch.

1. **Phase 1 – Pilot** :

- Partner with 1 hospital + 1 ambulance service in Bandra/Andheri.
- Test routing, AI triage, and video consultations using mock + partial real data.
- Collect feedback and refine workflows.

2. **Phase 2 – Partnerships**:

- Expand to 5–10 hospitals + multiple ambulance providers.
- Formalize with BMC + 108 emergency services for credibility.
- Launch a native mobile app with real-time ambulance GPS & ER bed availability.

3. **Phase 3 – City-Wide Rollout**:

- Achieve full Mumbai coverage with hospitals, ambulances, and municipal integration.
- Position as the official emergency dispatch platform with BMC.
- Scale to other metros (Delhi, Bengaluru, Chennai).

**Revenue**: 

1.  **Hospitals**: Subscription + premium listing, API integration for ER admissions.
2. **Ambulances**: Revenue share on dispatch bookings.
3. **Government/CSR**: Funding via healthcare and smart-city programs.
4. **B2B APIs**: Integrations with insurance, telemedicine, and hospital chains.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Mumbai faces a critical challenge in providing timely medical emergency response. During emergencies like cardiac arrest, trauma, or respiratory distress, patients lose crucial minutes navigating hospital information, finding the right specialist, or arranging an ambulance. Existing helplines (like 108) are not optimized for real-time triage, hospital-specialist matching, and virtual guidance, leading to delays that can cost lives.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

The domestic-help sector in India is plagued by misinformation: fake IDs, fabricated work histories, manipulated reviews, and doctored photos or videos. This leads to mistrust among households, financial loss, wasted time, and unfair disadvantages for genuine workers with real credentials. Current verification methods are either manual, slow, or easily manipulated, leaving the ecosystem vulnerable.

TrustGuard AI introduces an agentic-AI trust layer that deploys autonomous agents specialized in multi-source verification. These agents authenticate documents via OCR and tamper detection, validate references, detect review fraud using NLP, and apply deepfake/media forensics. The results are synthesized into real-time, explainable trust scores with concise, plain-language rationales that anyone can understand.

This solution not only enables households to hire confidently but also ensures genuine workers get the visibility and opportunities they deserve. By reducing fraud and building trust, TrustGuard AI empowers millions of urban families and workers while addressing misinformation at scale in a socially impactful, commercially viable way.

**Misinformation: Bring your own problem in Misinformation, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Problem

Misinformation about workers’ skills, background, and experience — and about employers’ reliability, payment history, and safety — creates a major trust gap in the informal job sector.
This leads to wrong hiring decisions, exploitation, safety risks, and lost opportunities for both sides.

Agentic AI Role

🤖 Profile Verification Agent
Cross-checks documents, work history, and references to confirm real identities and skill authenticity.

🧠 Reputation Monitoring Agent
Detects fake reviews, biased ratings, or manipulated feedback to maintain a fair ecosystem.

📊 Trust Score Generator
Creates a dynamic trust index for both workers and employers based on verified data, reliability, and user feedback.

⚖️ Dispute Resolution Agent
Analyzes complaints, evaluates evidence, and suggests fair resolutions for conflicts or misinformation-related issues.

Outcome

A trustworthy, AI-driven employment marketplace that connects skilled workers across all professions — from electricians and drivers to designers and technicians — with reliable employers through verified, real-time, and transparent information.

Both parties can make informed decisions, building a safer, smarter, and misinformation-free hiring ecosystem.

**Description of your solution**

**Problem Context:**
Headaches, migraines, and stress are a growing concern in today’s fast-paced world. People often waste valuable time searching for the “right” music for relief, only to settle for generic playlists that offer inconsistent results. Traditional streaming platforms overlook the science of brainwave frequencies and how different sound patterns uniquely affect each individual’s mood, focus, and pain perception. This results in reduced effectiveness and missed opportunities for music-based wellness solutions.

**Target Audience:**

- Individuals dealing with headaches, migraines, or chronic stress.
- Wellness and meditation enthusiasts seeking science-backed sound therapy.
- Students and professionals who need focus-enhancing background music.
- Digital health and wellness sectors exploring AI-driven music therapy tools.





**Data Sources:**
- User Listening History — genres, tempos, frequency ranges, and mood patterns.

- Self-Reported Symptoms — headache type, intensity, and mood state.

- Chatbot Interaction Logs — conversational preferences and mood-based queries.

- Effectiveness Data — aggregated insights from prior user sessions.


**What We Plan to Build:**

- AI-Powered Music Recommendation Engine that learns and adapts over time.

- Generative AI Lo-Fi Tracks with specific brainwave frequency alignment (alpha, theta).

- Music Generation Based on Past Listening History — creating new tracks inspired by the genres, tempos, and frequencies the user enjoys most.

- Headache Type Prediction based on listening behavior patterns.

- NLP Chatbot for quick, intuitive, and personalized music suggestions.

- Visual Wellness Analytics Dashboard to monitor and measure effectiveness.


**Technology:**
- Machine Learning Models for preference prediction and symptom correlation.

- Generative AI Music Models to produce personalized lo-fi harmonic tracks.

- NLP Frameworks for chatbot interaction and natural conversation flow.

- Data Visualization Tools for interactive dashboards.


**Go-To-Market (GTM) Strategy:**
 Phase 1: Launch as a free web app to collect behavior data and refine AI models.

 Phase 2: Collaborate with wellness influencers and online mental health communities.

 Phase 3: Integrate with Spotify/Apple Music APIs for seamless music access.

 Phase 4: Launch a mobile app with premium AI-generated tracks and advanced analytics.

**Revenue Streams:**
- Freemium Model — basic recommendations free, premium AI-generated tracks & analytics for subscribers.

- Subscription Plans — monthly/annual tiers with unlimited personalized tracks and wellness insights.

- Partnerships — collaborations with wellness brands, meditation platforms, and health tech companies.

- B2B Licensing — providing wellness analytics to spas, therapy centers, and corporate wellness programs.


**Impact:**
NeuroHarmony transforms music into a personalized health tool — reducing headache intensity, improving mood, and enhancing focus using AI-powered, science-backed sound therapy. By merging neuroscience, machine learning, and user-centric design, it turns everyday listening into an intelligent, health-enhancing journey.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

NeuroHarmony fits this track by using an AI agent to analyze a user’s past music preferences, listening habits, and feedback to both recommend and generate personalized brainwave-aligned lo-fi tracks aimed at reducing headaches, migraines, and stress. The platform’s generative AI creates new music tailored to each individual’s neurological and emotional profile, while a built-in Health Impact Analyzer tracks how different sound frequencies affect well-being and identifies likely headache triggers and types. Through adaptive recommendations, AI-driven music creation, and an interactive chatbot for effortless navigation, NeuroHarmony delivers a personalized, non-invasive wellness experience, making mental health support more accessible and effective.

**Problem:**
In many parts of the world — especially rural areas — psychologists and mental health resources are scarce. This leaves people without access to professional guidance for self-understanding and wellness.

**Solution:**
Personify is an AI-powered mobile app that combines personality recognition (MBTI + Big Five) with an AI chat for mental wellness, providing accessible, structured psychological support for anyone, anywhere.

**Coming soon:**

- Expanded wellness & journaling tools
- Official Play Store release

To make mental health awareness and guidance universally accessible, empowering individuals — especially those in underserved communities — with AI-driven support.

**Description of your solution**

We propose an AI-driven predictive healthcare system, built as a prototype for Kochi city, which is highly affected by monsoon floods and water-borne diseases.

Our solution integrates multiple datasets via APIs and local data sources to generate city-level, ward-level, and hospital-level predictions. It provides customized outputs for three key stakeholders:

**Hospitals**
Predicts next 7-day patient inflow (with uncertainty ranges P10, P50, P90).
Forecasts department-wise load (Emergency, ICU, General).
Generates staffing recommendations (doctors, nurses, ICU beds).
Action plan in tabular report format for easy hospital planning.

**Government**
A map-based dashboard showing wards with circles in red, yellow, and green:
Red Zone → Critical area (high patient surge or disease outbreak predicted).
Yellow Zone → Medium risk (monitor closely, partial preparedness).
Green Zone → Safe ward (no unusual surge expected).
Risk Mapping of floods, epidemics, and pollution-related health impacts.
Resource Allocation Guidance → where to deploy extra doctors, medicines, and emergency response teams.

**Citizens**
SMS/Notification alerts on upcoming risks.
Simple language precaution messages (e.g., “High dengue risk in Ward 12 — use mosquito nets, remove stagnant water”).
Safety guidance during floods and pollution spikes.

**How It Works (Workflow)**

**Data Collection:**
Hospital records: patient counts, doctors, nurses, ICU beds.
Weather & rainfall/flood datasets (via APIs).
AQI & pollution levels.
Historical disease cases (dengue, cholera, respiratory issues).
Festivals and seasonal events.

**Data Processing:**
Merge all sources into one timeline.
Create features: Day of week, Month, IsFestival, Rainfall Severity, AQI impact.
Add lag and rolling averages of patient load.
Link weather–disease correlation (e.g., rainfall → dengue).

**Machine Learning Models**
Quantile Gradient Boosting → Patient inflow prediction with uncertainty ranges (P10, P50, P90).
Random Forest Multi-output → Predicts department-wise patients (Emergency, ICU, General).
Severity Risk Estimator → Identifies critical vs mild patient distribution.

**Decision & Optimization Layer**
Hospital: Converts predicted numbers into doctors, nurses, and beds required.
Government: Shows risk zones on a map with red/yellow/green circles.
Citizens: Sends alerts and preventive measures in simple Hindi/English.

**Outputs :-**

Hospitals: 7-day Action Plan table (patients + staff recommendations).
Government: Risk map with colored zones, resource allocation report.
Citizens: Alerts + precautions via SMS or app notifications.
Innovative Features
API Integration → Real-time weather, AQI, and hospital feeds.
Risk Maps with Traffic-Light Zones → Easy for govt officers to visualize critical wards.
Disease–Weather Correlation → Predicts which diseases are likely after heavy rainfall or floods.
Multi-Sector Outputs → One system serving hospitals, government, and citizens together.
Uncertainty Forecasting (P10, P50, P90) → Hospitals get a range of predictions for flexible planning.
Bilingual Alerts → Citizens can get messages in English + Hindi (extensible to regional languages).
Scalability → Prototype is for Kochi, but can scale to Mumbai, Delhi, Chennai etc.

**Impact of Our Solution**

Hospitals: Can plan resources in advance → less overcrowding, better patient care.

Government: Gets early warning maps → faster disaster response and better resource distribution.

Citizens: Receive timely alerts and stay safe → reduced disease spread and fatalities.

By combining AI predictions, API-driven real-time data, and map-based visualizations, our project creates a complete predictive and preventive system for healthcare management in crisis situations.

NeoWealth.AI - Hackathon Solution

 **Core Concept**

NeoWealth.AI is a self-evolving financial ecosystem where AI agents autonomously manage your money, teach you financial habits, and pay you for good behavior. It's not just an app—it's your AI financial twin that grows smarter and more valuable over time.

 **The Three-Pillar Architecture**

1. Personal Financial Twin (AI Agent Core)
Autonomous Monitoring: Tracks all transactions via UPI/bank APIs/SMS parsing

Behavioral Learning: Builds predictive models of spending patterns and financial risks

Proactive Coaching: Sends real-time nudges, warnings, and optimization suggestions

Adaptive Intelligence: Learns from user responses to improve recommendations

2. NeoCoin Economy (Self-Sustaining Revenue)
Earn-to-Save Model: Users earn NeoCoins (1 NeoCoin = ₹1) for positive financial actions

Data Monetization: AI sells anonymized insights to fintechs → revenue shared as dividends

Affiliate Integration: Investment actions (SIP, insurance) generate commissions (70% user, 30% platform)

Challenge System: Gamified financial goals with NeoCoin rewards

3. Community Hive Intelligence (Collective Growth)
AI-Managed Groups: Small saving circles (5-10 people) managed by AI algorithms

Automated Investing: AI pools funds and optimizes investment strategies

Social Accountability: Peer rankings and group challenges drive engagement

Collective Intelligence: Group data improves AI predictions for all members

** Technical Implementation**

AI Agent Architecture
Personal Twin Agent:
├── Transaction Monitor (Real-time parsing)
├── Behavior Analyzer (ML prediction models)
├── Goal Optimizer (Dynamic target adjustment)
├── Reward Calculator (NeoCoin distribution)
└── Community Connector (Hive matching)


**Revenue Streams**


Data Insights: 40% (₹160/user/month)

Affiliate Commissions: 35% (₹140/user/month)

Premium Features: 15% (₹60/user/month)

Transaction Fees: 10% (₹40/user/month)

Total Platform Revenue: ₹400/user/month with 25% margin

**Agentic AI Solution**


NeoWealth.AI deploys autonomous AI agents that don't just analyze - they act, decide, and evolve independently:

**Core Agentic AI Components**


**1. Personal Financial Twin Agent**

Autonomous Capabilities:

Proactive Decision Making: Initiates financial actions (alerts, investments, savings) based on real-time analysis

Goal Optimization: Automatically adjusts financial targets based on user progress and market conditions

**2. NeoCoin Reward Engine Agent**

Autonomous Capabilities:

Dynamic Pricing: Automatically adjusts reward amounts based on user behavior and platform economics

Challenge Generation: Creates personalized financial challenges without human input

Autonomous Capabilities:

Market Analysis: Identifies valuable data patterns for monetization

**Description of your solution**

1. Automated Attendance: Fully Automatic Attendance from classroom footage using facial recognition to eliminate manual labour, save time and avoid proxies. The Classroom footage is taken from the CCTV or a single photo is clicked. Faces are recognised from  the footage and checked with a pre defined directory containing images of each student of that class.

2. Individual Student's Behaviour Tracking: Monitoring Classroom behaviour patterns of every student to ensure active participation, identify non-attentive students and recommending teachers to take the necessary action. Each student is monitored and his/her behaviours are tracked continuously during a class.

3. Audio Analysis and Detecting Noisy Classrooms: Identifying noise percentage in classrooms to enable teachers and administrators to take necessary actions. Analysing extracted audio to track syllabus progress.

4. Enhancing Safety: Detecting unauthorized entry of students from different classes or intruders, as well as fire and smoke to send immediate notifications to the authorities.

5. Students’ Seating Pattern Detection: Detecting noisy or mischievous groups in the classroom helps teachers to conduct classes more effectively.

6. Examination Monitoring and Evaluation: Automatic Invigilation during examinations without physical invigilators using CCTV. Using our behavior tracking model, student's behaviors are also tracked during examinations.

7. Seat Arrangement Checking: The seating arrangement of the Examination Hall is checked with the predefined Seat Matrix to ensure that no students are swapping seats or pursuing unfair means.

8. Efficient Resource Management: Monitoring usage pattern of Resources (e.g. projectors, computers) to determine usage time and automatically schedule maintenance.

9. Data-Driven Insights: Generate graphical data and weekly reports of individual students' performance to assist teachers with assessments and evaluations. Additionally, include an AI-based chatbot to help students and address their learning gaps.

**Description of your solution**

Imagine a user signs up for a digital bank and is instantly approved, only to be met with a frustrating message 'Your card will arrive in 7 to 10 business days.' This unacceptable delay creates massive customer drop off up to 30% a critical failure point where banks lose both valuable customers and the huge amount of money they spent on acquisition. Customers, meanwhile, become severely frustrated by the verification hurdles and waiting game, and are often worried about identity theft if their credentials or card details might be compromised. This is the core problem Cipher, our autonomous AI Agent, is built to solve .We plan to build a Multi-Agent Orchestration system that acts as the secure decision engine, automating the entire customer verification process in under 60 seconds. Cipher achieves this speed by orchestrating specialized sub-agents that leverage Computer Vision (CV) for instant document authentication and Machine Learning (ML) for real-time risk scoring and immediate Biometric Anti-Spoofing—a security upgrade that eliminates the identity theft vulnerabilities inherent in manual checks. Importantly, the original document image is immediately encrypted or securely purged after the necessary data is extracted, minimizing the risk footprint. Furthermore, Cipher operates on a principle of data minimization: we only keep the necessary, non-PII (non-personally identifiable information) audit data—a unique, encrypted proof of verification. This commitment to data minimization is our fundamental security guarantee to the user because every piece of sensitive PII we don't store is a piece of data that can never be leaked. Our primary target audience is the B2B Fintech sector, specifically Neobanks, Digital Lenders, and Embedded Finance Platforms, all dependent on frictionless user growth. For a Fintech company, issuing a virtual card first is cheaper than printing and mailing a physical one. We tap into the virtual cards segment of the trillions-of-USD Global Market Total (GMT), which is growing at a CAGR exceeding 21%. Our revenue model relies on B2B licensing through a per-verification fee and a SaaS subscription for advanced fraud monitoring. 
Cipher stands out by providing an Explainable Audit Trail, delivering not just speed, but verifiable trust, while strictly minimizing third-party data risk.

**Fintech: Bring your own problem in Fintech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Cipher, fits perfectly within the Fintech landscape by addressing the critical balance between speed, compliance, and user experience—the three pillars of modern financial technology.

1.The Human Problem: Erasing the "Wait"
Fintech’s core promise is speed and zero friction. Cipher is designed to eliminate the most frustrating moment for a new customer: the 7-to-10-day waiting period for a card to arrive. By converting this anxious wait into instant utility, Cipher honors the digital bank's promise, replacing customer disappointment with immediate access and satisfaction. This directly translates to higher customer retention and engagement for financial institutions.

2.The Business Imperative (Securing Sunk Costs): Banks invest heavily in customer acquisition, and when users abandon the long sign-up process, that sunk marketing cost is lost. Cipher bridges this commercial gap by instantly and securely onboarding the customer, converting a potential loss into immediate revenue generation.
3. The Technology Mandate (AI as the New Trust): Modern finance demands security without human delay. Cipher uses AI orchestration—leveraging CV and ML for anti-spoofing—to turn slow, high-risk manual KYC into an instantaneous, auditable security upgrade.

**Description of your solution**

# ClarifyAI: Real-Time Fact-Checking for a Safer Web

**TL;DR**  
ClarifyAI is a Chrome extension that uses agentic intelligence to combat misinformation in real time—empowering users with transparent, evidence-backed insights across text, images, URLs, and entire webpages.

---

## What Is ClarifyAI?

ClarifyAI is an AI-powered browser extension built to detect and prevent the spread of fake news. It functions as a real-time research assistant, verifying the authenticity of:

- Text content  
- URLs and articles  
- Images and embedded claims  
- Entire webpages  

Powered by Gemini-driven multi-agent reasoning, ClarifyAI delivers instant, context-aware verdicts with a single click—making truth-checking as seamless as browsing.

---

## How It Works

ClarifyAI orchestrates a network of specialized AI agents via a Flask-based API. Each agent is responsible for a specific verification task:

- Text analysis  
- Image validation  
- Source credibility assessment  

These agents collaborate to produce a unified verdict that includes:

- Truth status  
- Confidence score  
- Verified sources  
- Recommendations for users  

All results are stored locally for transparency and user control.

---

## Core Capabilities

ClarifyAI offers four primary tools to enhance digital literacy:

- **Text Fact-Checking**: Validates written claims with citations and confidence scores  
- **URL Analysis**: Assesses credibility, bias, and source integrity of any webpage  
- **Image Verification**: Detects visual misinformation using multimodal AI  
- **Full Page Audit**: Scans entire webpages for misinformation risks and suggests corrections  

---

## Why It Matters

ClarifyAI introduces a “truth layer” for the internet, helping users:

- Instantly identify misinformation  
- Build trust in digital content  
- Make informed decisions while browsing  

It represents a responsible step forward in AI-driven fact-checking, showcasing how agentic intelligence can strengthen public discourse and protect online communities.

**Misinformation: Create an Agentic AI system that continuously scans multiple sources of information, detects emerging misinformation, verifies facts, and provides easy-to-understand, contextual updates to the public during crises.**

## Why ClarifyAI Solves the Problem Statement

- **Real-Time, Multi-Source Scanning**  
  ClarifyAI continuously analyzes live web content—text, images, URLs, and full pages—directly from the browser, satisfying the need for constant monitoring across diverse information sources.

- **Agentic Intelligence for Detection and Verification**  
  Its multi-agent system handles misinformation detection and fact verification in parallel, combining specialized reasoning (text, image, source credibility) into a unified, evidence-backed verdict.

- **Contextual, Crisis-Ready Feedback**  
  Users receive clear, actionable insights while browsing—truth status, confidence scores, and recommendations—making it especially useful during fast-moving events or public crises.

- **Transparent and User-Controlled**  
  All results are stored locally, ensuring transparency and giving users full control over how information is processed and presented.

**Description of your solution**

**InfoGuard – Agentic AI Misinformation Companion**

 **Overview**

 1. InfoGuard is a multi-platform Agentic AI system designed to detect, verify, and explain misinformation in real time across browsers and messaging platforms.

2. It acts as a personalized, privacy-focused misinformation companion, combining automation, explainability, and multilingual communication.

**Core Components**

**1. Chrome Extension**

- Scans and highlights suspicious claims on web pages.
- 
- Shows popups with verdicts, confidence scores, explanations, and sources.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/95a1255732d740e69a7422972b3bb790/f651214b-e5d0-4671-8d2a-96ccfbd6b495.jpeg)
**Provides multilingual support (English, Hindi, Tamil).**

Offers copyable, empathetic suggested replies to counter misinformation.

Includes privacy toggle for on-device or anonymized processing.



**2. WhatsApp Bot**

Users can forward messages for instant fact-checking via Twilio API.

Returns verdicts, explanations, confidence scores, and source links.

Supports multiple languages and provides polite, shareable replies.



**3. Backend (FastAPI)**

Handles claim detection, OCR for image text, and evidence retrieval.

Scores credibility using source reliability and recency metrics.

Categorizes claims as Likely False, Needs Context, or Likely True.

Integrates with both Chrome Extension and WhatsApp bot.

Collects user feedback for continuous learning.

* Key Features

Agentic Workflow – Autonomous claim detection, verification, and response generation.

Source-Backed Verdicts – Uses data from WHO, CDC, Reuters, AltNews, etc.

Multilingual Empathy – Culturally adaptive explanations.

Feedback Mechanism – Improves verdict accuracy over time.

Privacy & Transparency – Clear sources, confidence levels, and optional local processing.

InfoGuard thus provides a unified, real-time misinformation defense system combining automation, privacy, and human-centered design.

**Misinformation: Bring your own problem in Misinformation, leveraging Agentic AI.**

InfoGuard fits perfectly under the “Misinformation: Bring Your Own Problem” theme by leveraging Agentic AI to autonomously detect, verify, and explain misinformation across platforms. It addresses the self-defined challenge of creating a proactive, privacy-preserving companion that operates seamlessly on the web and messaging apps. Using Agentic AI, InfoGuard autonomously scans content, analyzes claims using trusted fact-checking sources, generates human-readable explanations with confidence scores, and adapts its behavior across contexts like Chrome and WhatsApp. It also learns from user feedback to refine its accuracy over time. Unlike passive fact-checking tools, InfoGuard acts as an intelligent agent that assists users in real time, empowering them to recognize and counter misinformation responsibly. With its multilingual support, transparency, and user-centric design, InfoGuard demonstrates how autonomous AI can combat misinformation effectively while maintaining user trust and privacy.

**Description of your solution**

# आरोग्यमAI: Predict. Prepare. Prevent — Powered by Multi-Agent
Hospitals across India often face sudden surges in patient inflow during festivals, pollution peaks, and epidemics—overwhelming staff, medical supplies, and infrastructure. To tackle this, we present an (**आरोग्यमAI**) Agentic AI–driven Predictive Hospital Management System that forecasts patient surges during festivals, pollution spikes, and epidemics using real-time data like air quality, weather, and event calendars. It proactively recommends optimal staffing, medical supply adjustments, and patient advisories. This helps hospitals prepare in advance, reducing overcrowding, wait times, and resource strain.

## The Problem
Hospitals around the world face similar crisis during epidemics and other emergencies
- Sudden surge in patients with respiratory issues, burns, and accidents during scenarios like forest fires, riots and stampedes
- Supply shortages when oxygen cylinders and medicines run out mid-crisis
- Staff burnout from 72-hour shifts during unexpected rushes
- Overcrowded wards with patients waiting hours for basic care
- Zero preparation time because no one saw it coming

# Our Solution
A multi-agent AI system that acts as your hospital's crystal ball

### What we do  
![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/f1159a57a0f94c2a8d757e5772a4d9a8/614b50fd-437a-4736-881d-c248bd084b99.jpeg)

#### Predicts the Unpredictable  
Analyzes air quality, festival calendars, pharmacy sales, social media trends, and 50+ data sources to forecast patient surges 7-14 days in advance.

#### Plans Everything Automatically  
AI agents calculate exactly how many doctors, nurses, oxygen cylinders, and ICU beds you'll need — and when.

#### Explains Its Thinking
"Air Quality Index crossed 300 + Diwali in 5 days → Expect 40% increase in respiratory cases"
Every prediction comes with crystal-clear reasoning.

#### Orders Supplies Before You Run Out
The procurement agent drafts purchase orders automatically. You approve with one click. Supplies arrive before the surge hits.

## How It Works
Surge Prediction Agent → Sees the future 
Resource Optimization Agent → Plans everything 
Procurement Agent → Orders supplies automatically  
Patient Advisory Agent → Warns the public 
Load Balancing Agent → Coordinates hospital network
Clinical Support Agent → Helps doctors diagnose faster
Insurance Agent → Speeds up paperwork
Fact-Checking Agent → Filters social media noise


## Architecture Diagram:
![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/f1159a57a0f94c2a8d757e5772a4d9a8/9b5f586e-5254-496e-bd1f-732407159cda.jpeg)

## Target Audience
Primary :

Large hospital chains and standalone 200-1000 bed hospitals in metro cities and Tier-1 cities (Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata)

And other beneficiaries : Government & Public Health Agencies

## GTM and Revenue Streams

GTM 
Pilot Phase
-	Partner with 2–3 large hospitals in metro cities (e.g., Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru) during high-demand seasons.
-	Validate predictive accuracy and measure improvements in wait times, staff efficiency, and patient throughput.
-	Integrate with existing Hospital Information Systems (HIS) / Electronic Medical Records (EMR) for smoother adoption.
Awareness & Outreach
-	Case studies from pilot hospitals to build trust.
-	Healthcare conferences, medical associations, and public health forums as channels.

Revenue Stream
SaaS Subscription Model
-	Tiered pricing based on hospital size (beds count, departments, data scale).
Data-as-a-Service (Long Term)
-	Aggregated, anonymized insights sold to insurance companies, health research orgs, or policy makers.

## Data Sources
This is where everything begins. The system continuously monitors multiple data streams:
- **Environmental Sensors**: Realtime Air quality Index, temperature, humidity and meteorological data
- **Calendar Intelligence**: Major Festival dates, public holidays and other events specific to region
- **Epidemic Surveillance**: Government health bulletins, WHO alerts, disease outbreak data
- **Pharmacy Sales Signals**: Real-time OTC medicine purchases (cough syrup, inhalers, masks)
- **Traffic & Crowd Analytics**: Google Maps API, event attendance, traffic patterns to scan for probable stampede and accident risk
- **Social Media Intelligence**: Scan social media posts mentioning symptoms, health complaints
- **Historical Hospital Data**: Hospital’s past records for admission patterns, seasonal trends

## Predictive Intelligence Engine  

Raw data is messy and meaningless. This module transforms it into predictions.

- **Data Integration**: Cleans, standardize and combine all incoming data
- **ML models**:  Leverage Time-Series forecasting to predict patient volume for the next 7-14 days, assess data from multiple sources to access risk level, spot unusual patterns that don’t fit normal trends and categorize surge severity,   
- **Explainable AI**: A central model that translates model predictions into natural language and

**Healthtech: Manage unpredictable surges in patients during festivals, pollution spikes, or epidemics with an AI agent that autonomously analyzes data and recommends staffing, supply, and patient advisory actions in advance.**

To tackle this, we present an (**आरोग्यमAI**) Agentic AI–driven Predictive Hospital Management System that forecasts patient surges during festivals, pollution spikes, and epidemics using real-time data like air quality, weather, and event calendars. It proactively recommends optimal staffing, medical supply adjustments, and patient advisories. This helps hospitals prepare in advance, reducing overcrowding, wait times, and resource strain.

**Description of your solution**

The project integrates piezoelectric crystals positioned beneath speed bumps, toll plazas,railway tracks and crowded roadways to convert the pressure created by vehicles driving on them into electrical energy. Electricity is created and then converted and stored in batteries or supercapacitors that will store electrical energy for later use. The stored energy can be used to power streetlights, traffic lights, and E-vehicle charging .

The system will provide a continuous, reliable source of energy and will still operate during peak traffic hours.

**Description of your solution**

AntarMann is a digital mental health and psychological support platform designed specifically for students in higher education. It addresses the challenges of limited access, stigma, and lack of structured support by creating a safe, intelligent, and institution-integrated ecosystem for mental wellness.

The solution combines AI-powered early detection, anonymous counseling, and data-driven policy insights into a single Progressive Web App (PWA). Through validated self-assessment tools such as PHQ-9, GAD-7, DASS-21, BAI, and BDI-II, AntarMann identifies early signs of stress, anxiety, or depression. The AI module “LUKUB” (Let Us Know You Better) personalizes the user journey, offering tailored self-help recommendations and connecting students to appropriate resources or counselors.

To overcome stigma, AntarMann enables anonymous appointment booking using aliases — the user’s identity is only revealed to their chosen counselor upon confirmation, ensuring privacy and comfort. Institutions benefit from an Admin Dashboard with anonymized analytics on mental health trends, helping them design proactive wellness initiatives without compromising confidentiality.

The platform’s “Serenity Section” provides instant emotional support through mindfulness exercises, soundscapes, and guided relaxation. An empathetic AI mascot interacts with users, ensuring a humanized experience even in digital form.

Built with React.js, Node.js, MongoDB, TensorFlow, and Docker, AntarMann offers secure, scalable, and seamless integration with existing college systems like the Institution Management System (IMS). With SSL/TLS encryption, JWT-based authentication, and PWA offline capabilities, it ensures accessibility, reliability, and data protection.

In essence, AntarMann delivers a holistic, stigma-free, and technology-driven mental health solution that empowers students, supports institutions, and builds a culture of care within campuses.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

AntarMann fits into the Healthtech track by using Agentic AI to enhance mental healthcare accessibility and personalization. The platform leverages AI-driven modules like LUKUB (Let Us Know You Better) for proactive mental health screening, sentiment analysis, and personalized support recommendations. An empathetic AI agent guides users through self-assessments, provides real-time emotional assistance, and connects them to counselors securely and anonymously. By combining psychological science with intelligent automation, AntarMann transforms digital mental healthcare into an adaptive, stigma-free support system for students in higher education.

> The "Agent as Adversary" Defense Simulator

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![fast.ai](https://img.shields.io/badge/fast.ai-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Generative Advarsarial Networks (GANs)](https://img.shields.io/badge/Generative%20Advarsarial%20Networks%20(GANs)-333333?style=flat-square) ![AI/ML](https://img.shields.io/badge/AI/ML-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

SATORN: Simulated Adversary Training & Orchestrated Reconciliation Network

A 3-Agent, highly advanced, self-improving, agentic AI based technology that not only detects and verifies the existing misinformation, but also works on generating and inventing all the possible misinformation related to a topic, hence retraining and strengthening its own validation and verification power.
The model is divided into two teams of two different agents, one of them attacks the other with simulated environment and misinformation of all sorts while the other team defends all the misinformation produced and flags them accordingly. A third, orchestrator AI agent, judges the two teams and encourages them to perform better. It works like a feedback loop and works on the self-improving and validating feature of the system.
Both teams operate autonomously toward their opposing goals, while the third learns from their interaction, continuously adapting and strengthening the defense system without human intervention in the training loop.

**Misinformation: Bring your own problem in Misinformation, leveraging Agentic AI.**

The system is a self-improving misinformation detector. Instead of waiting for real-world fake news to train your AI (which is always too late), you use an Agentic AI (Red Team) to invent the fake news and attack a simulated environment. Then, your defense Agentic AI (Blue Team) has to fight it off. The system learns from this automated fighting, making the defense stronger every minute, preparing it for any new lie the real world might throw at it.

**Description of your solution**

**CarePulse AI** is an Agentic AI-powered hospital management platform designed to predict and manage patient surges during festivals, pollution spikes, and epidemic outbreaks in India. The system integrates real-time data — including weather, air quality, and event calendars — to forecast hospital demand and autonomously recommend optimal staffing levels, supply management, and patient advisories.

**Our platform consists of three main components:**
- A predictive analytics engine that forecasts patient inflow using historical and environmental data.
- An AI agent that provides actionable recommendations for staffing and resource allocation.
- An interactive dashboard for hospital administrators to visualize trends and make AI-driven decisions easily.

**CarePulse AI addresses major pain points in the healthcare system:** 
- Unpredictable Patient Surges: Helps hospitals anticipate demand spikes during festivals or pollution periods.
- Resource Mismanagement: Prevents shortages of staff, oxygen, and medicines through predictive planning.
- Delayed Response Times: Automates alerts and action plans to reduce administrative delays during crises.
- Data Silos: Integrates multiple data sources for unified decision-making and forecasting.
- By enabling data-driven preparedness and proactive hospital management, CarePulse AI reduces patient wait times, optimizes resource allocation, and minimizes mortality risks.

**The target audience includes:**
- Primary: Public and private hospitals, healthcare administrators, and emergency response teams.
- Secondary: Government health departments, NGOs, and smart city healthcare planners.
- Long-term: Healthcare analytics and insurance companies seeking predictive intelligence integration.

**Our Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy focuses on:**
 
- Pilot Programs: Implementing in mid-sized hospitals in major cities (Delhi, Mumbai, Hyderabad) for validation.
- B2B Outreach: Engaging hospital networks via healthcare conferences, LinkedIn, and industry expos.
- Government Collaboration: Integrating with state and national smart healthcare initiatives.
- AI-as-a-Service (AaaS): Offering the predictive engine via APIs for integration with existing hospital systems.

 **Revenue Streams**:
- Subscription Model: Tier-based SaaS plans for hospitals.
-  API Licensing: Paid access for hospitals and HMS vendors.
- Data Insights & Analytics: Anonymized predictive reports for health departments.
-  Customization & Support: Paid implementation and integration services.

**In short, CarePulse AI transforms hospital operations from reactive to proactive, empowering healthcare institutions to predict, prepare, and protect lives with intelligent foresight.**

**Healthtech: Manage unpredictable surges in patients during festivals, pollution spikes, or epidemics with an AI agent that autonomously analyzes data and recommends staffing, supply, and patient advisory actions in advance.**

**Description of your solution**

We're trying to build a next-generation **asset tokenization** platform called **Neural Vault**, designed to revolutionize how digital assets are managed. The foundation is built on the high-performance **Solana blockchain**, using secure and efficient Rust smart contracts to handle the on-chain logic. Our core mission is to take traditionally **illiquid assets**, like real estate and art, and make them fully liquid by converting them into tradable digital tokens, which in turn unlocks fractional ownership for a wider range of investors.

What truly sets our approach apart is the deep integration of artificial intelligence to create a smarter and safer ecosystem. It starts with valuation; we use AI to provide **dynamic, real-time pricing** for every asset, a significant leap from the static models our competitors use. To protect these assets, we’ve integrated on-chain AI that proactively detects fraud by analyzing transaction patterns for anomalies. We also tackle the complexities of regulation by using AI to automate compliance and due diligence processes like **KYC/AML checks**. To ensure the entire system runs on reliable information, we use **AI-powered oracles** to validate external data before it's fed to our smart contracts.

Ultimately, by merging the speed and low costs of Solana with multifaceted AI intelligence, our goal is to offer a superior solution for asset tokenization that mitigates risk while maximizing value and transparency for our users.

It directly tackles critical financial operations by moving beyond static pricing with an AI engine that provides **dynamic, real-time asset valuation**. Furthermore, it addresses major industry pain points by automating complex regulatory compliance (RegTech) with AI-driven KYC/AML modules and actively protects assets through on-chain, AI-powered fraud detection. By creating a more efficient, secure, and transparent market on the high-speed Solana blockchain, Neural Vault is not just participating in the financial technology space but is actively building its future infrastructure

**Description of your solution**

# Juggle

## Stop juggling finances. Start living.

**Juggle** is an agentic AI financial coach designed to move beyond simple, backward-looking expense tracking. Our solution directly tackles the core challenge of the MumbaiHacks 2025 Fintech track by creating a proactive agent that helps users, particularly those with volatile incomes, manage the complex interplay between their daily spending, recurring bills, and future life events.

Instead of just showing users where their money *went*, Juggle provides **financial foresight**, showing them where their money *needs to go*. It acts as a personal financial coach that continuously learns a user's habits to anticipate future cash flow challenges and opportunities, transforming financial anxiety into actionable, forward-looking plans.

## How Juggle Works: From Data to Foresight

Juggle's intelligence is built on a unified view of a user's financial and personal life. The process is simple for the user but powered by a sophisticated backend agent:

1.  **Secure Data Integration:** The user securely connects their bank accounts (for transaction data) and their Google Calendar (for event data). This creates a comprehensive picture of both their financial history and their upcoming commitments.

2.  **AI-Powered Analysis:** Our AI agent gets to work, performing several key tasks:
    *   **Transaction Categorization:** It intelligently categorizes spending to understand financial habits.
    *   **Event Identification:** It scans the calendar for significant events—birthdays, anniversaries, festivals, travel plans, and bill due dates.
    *   **Income Pattern Recognition:** It analyzes historical data to learn the user's income patterns, whether they are fixed monthly salaries or the fluctuating payments of a gig worker.

3.  **Proactive Forecasting & Intervention:** This is the core of Juggle's agentic nature. The AI synthesizes all this information to model the user's future cash flow. It doesn't just send a simple reminder. Instead, it provides proactive, contextual advice.

    *   **Example Intervention:** *"Heads up! Next month you have Diwali expenses, your car insurance premium, and a friend's wedding coming up. Based on your typical income, I project a potential shortfall of ₹7,000. Let's start an automated micro-savings plan of ₹250 per day to cover it without stress."*

## The Agentic Core: More Than Just an App

The central theme of MumbaiHacks 2025 is "Agentic AI," and Juggle is designed specifically to meet this mandate. Our solution is not just an app that *uses* AI; it is an app where the AI *acts* as an agent on the user's behalf.

*   **Continuous Learning:** The agent's recommendations become smarter over time. It learns which events are high-priority, understands seasonal spending spikes, and adapts its forecasts as a user's income and habits evolve.
*   **Proactive Risk Identification:** The agent's primary function is to identify financial risks *before* they become problems. It looks for budget conflicts and potential cash flow gaps weeks or even months in advance.
*   **Personalized Recommendations:** All advice is tailored to the individual. The agent understands the user's unique financial situation and delivers recommendations that are realistic and achievable, a key differentiator from generic financial tools.

## Key Features

*   **Unified Financial Dashboard:** A single, clear view of all connected accounts, transactions, and net worth.
*   **Calendar-Integrated Budgeting:** Budgets that automatically account for upcoming personal and financial events.
*   **AI-Powered Cash Flow Forecasting:** A forward-looking projection of the user's financial health based on income patterns and future commitments.
*   **Automated Micro-Savings:** The ability to set up and automate small, regular savings transfers towards specific goals identified by the agent.
*   **Conversational AI Coach:** A chat interface where users can ask financial questions and receive personalized, data-driven advice.

## Revenue Streams
To ensure the long-term sustainability and growth of Juggle, we plan to implement a dual-stream revenue model that aligns with our mission to provide accessible financial coaching.

* Freemium Subscription Model: The core features of Juggle will be available for free. We will offer premium paid plans that unlock the full power of our agentic AI, providing more advanced and accurate analysis, unlimited automated savings plans, and deeper "what-if" scenario planning.

* Personalized Loan Recommendations: For users who face a projected cash flow shortfall that cannot be covered by short-term savings, our agent can identify and recommend personalized, ethical loan products from trusted financial partners. This provides a valuable service to users in need while creating an affiliate revenue stream, reinforcing our role as a trusted financial coach.

**Fintech: Build an autonomous financial coaching agent that adapts to real user behavior, spending patterns, and income variability - helping gig workers, informal sector employees, and everyday citizens make smarter financial decisions proactively.**

## How Juggle Fits the Fintech Track

Our project, **Juggle**, is designed as a direct and comprehensive answer to the challenge laid out in the MumbaiHacks 2025 Fintech track.

> **"Develop a financial coaching agent that continuously learns about individual user behavior by integrating varied financial data streams and proactively analyzing spending and income patterns, identify risks, and deliver personalized recommendations and reminders."**

Here is a point-by-point breakdown of how our solution aligns perfectly with this objective:

### 1. A Proactive Financial Coaching Agent

Juggle is not a passive budgeting app that simply shows users where their money went last month. It is an **agentic AI coach** built to provide financial foresight. By analyzing future commitments alongside past behavior, it actively guides users, helping them prepare for upcoming financial stress points before they happen. This proactive stance is the core of our solution and directly addresses the call for a "financial coaching agent."

### 2. Continuous Learning and Personalization

The agent **continuously learns** from every transaction and income deposit. It identifies the user's unique financial rhythm—whether it's a fixed monthly salary or the volatile, irregular income of a gig worker. This learning model allows Juggle to move beyond static budgets and offer dynamic, personalized forecasts that adapt over time to the user's evolving financial life.

### 3. Integration of Varied Data Streams

Our solution is built on the principle of integrating **varied financial data streams** to create a holistic financial picture. Juggle synthesizes two critical sources of information:
*   **Financial Data:** Securely connected bank accounts provide a clear view of transaction history, spending habits, and income patterns.
*   **Personal Life Data:** Google Calendar integration allows the agent to see upcoming events like birthdays, anniversaries, travel, and bill due dates that have a direct financial impact.

### 4. Proactive Analysis and Risk Identification

The primary function of the Juggle agent is to **proactively analyze** this combined data to **identify risks**. It looks for future cash flow conflicts, such as a major festival, a large insurance premium, and a family birthday all occurring in the same pay cycle. By forecasting the potential for a budget shortfall weeks in advance, Juggle empowers users to take corrective action early, preventing financial stress.

### 5. Personalized Recommendations and Reminders

Because every analysis is based on the user's own data, every recommendation is inherently **personalized**. Instead of offering generic advice like "save 10% of your income," Juggle provides specific, actionable recommendations. For example, it might advise: *"Based on your upcoming commitments, I project a potential shortfall of ₹5,000 next month. Let's start a 4-week automated micro-savings plan to cover it."* This is the kind of tailored, timely, and effective coaching the track calls for.

In essence, Juggle is the direct embodiment of the track's challenge. It is purpose-built to be the learning, proactive, and personalized financial agent that the problem statement describes.

Autonomous Monitoring:

Automated Verification:

Contextual Communication:

- Ensures actionable insights for the public, journalists, and decision-makers.
Proactive Action:

Impact:
- Reduces misinformation-driven harm and confusion during crises.
- Supports faster, informed decisions by authorities and the public.
- Enhances public safety by delivering verified, trustworthy information quickly.
- Demonstrates autonomous, agentic AI behavior—perceiving, reasoning, deciding, and acting without human intervention.

**Description of your solution**

# Arthya
## Autonomous Financial Coaching Agent for Variable-Income Earners

## Solution Overview

We're building **Arthya** an **AI-powered financial companion** that acts as a personal CFO for gig workers, freelancers, and informal sector employees people whose income fluctuates unpredictably. Unlike traditional budgeting apps that assume steady paychecks, this agent learns individual spending behaviors and income patterns to provide proactive, personalized financial guidance at exactly the right moment.

## Core Innovation

The agent uses **adaptive machine learning** to understand each user's unique financial fingerprint:

- **Income Intelligence**: Predicts when the next payment will arrive and how much, accounting for variability
- **Behavioral Learning**: Recognizes spending triggers (weekend splurges, post-payment spending spikes, stress-related purchases)
- **Proactive Coaching**: Sends timely nudges *before* financial mistakes happen, not after

## Key Features

### 1. **Smart Income Forecasting**
Analyzes multiple income streams with different frequencies to predict cash flow with confidence intervals. The system learns that your freelance client pays on the 15th, your ride-share earnings come daily, and your consulting gig is seasonal.

### 2. **Context-Aware Coaching**
Real-world example nudges:
- *"Your rent of ₹10,000 is due in 5 days, but your next income arrives in 7 days. You're short ₹3,000. Let's make a plan."*
- *"Great! ₹15,000 just came in. Based on your bills, I recommend setting aside ₹8,000 now. Want me to help?"*
- *"I noticed you spend 40% more on weekends. Your weekend starts tomorrow with ₹3,000 available. Consider a ₹1,500 limit?"*

### 3. **Conversational Interface**
Natural language interaction makes financial planning accessible:
- "How much can I spend today?"
- "How much money will I be left with at the end of this month?"
- "Help me save ₹5,000 in 3 months"

### 4. **Income Smoothing Engine**
Automatically suggests optimal savings during high-income periods and spending adjustments during lean times, creating financial stability from variable income.

## Technical Architecture

### AI/ML Stack:
- **Time-series forecasting** (LSTM + Prophet) for income prediction
- **Anomaly detection** (Isolation Forest) for unusual spending patterns
- **Reinforcement learning** to optimize recommendation timing and effectiveness
- **NLP** (Transformers) for conversational coaching

### Data Integration:
- Bank account linking via open banking APIs
- Smart bank statement parsing for manual uploads
- Multi-source income tracking with reliability scoring

### Security-First Design:
- End-to-end encryption for financial data
- Privacy-preserving ML using anonymization
- Local data processing where possible
- GDPR/PCI DSS compliant architecture

## Why This Solves a Real Problem

**350+ million gig workers in India** face daily financial stress because:
- Traditional tools assume steady income they don't 
- Generic advice doesn't account for behavioral patterns
- No one provides guidance *before* financial mistakes happen

This agent bridges the financial literacy gap by making personalized coaching accessible, affordable, and automatic.

## Measurable Impact

Success metrics:
- **15%+ increase** in user savings rate
- **60% reduction** in overdraft incidents
- **40% improvement** in financial stress scores
- Users hitting emergency fund goals **2-3 months faster**

##  Hackathon Deliverable

For the hackathon, We'll build a **working MVP** demonstrating:
1. Transaction tracking with auto-categorization
2. Income pattern recognition and prediction
3. Behavioral spending analysis
4. Proactive coaching nudges based on learned patterns
5. Conversational query interface
6. Interactive mobile-first UI showing real-time financial health

The demo will showcase the agent learning from sample user data representing typical gig worker scenarios, then providing intelligent, timely financial guidance that traditional apps simply cannot deliver.

This project perfectly aligns with the Fintech track as it leverages artificial intelligence, behavioral analytics, and financial technology to empower individuals especially those with irregular or variable incomes to make smarter, data-driven financial decisions. By combining real-time income prediction, adaptive budgeting, and autonomous financial coaching, the solution directly addresses financial inclusion gaps in underserved populations such as gig workers and informal sector employees. Unlike static finance apps, this agent continuously learns from user behavior and proactively offers personalized guidance, transforming traditional financial management into a dynamic, intelligent, and human-like experience. In doing so, it embodies the spirit of the Fintech track: using advanced technology to democratize access to financial well-being and promote smarter money management for everyday citizens.

**Description of your solution**

**Project: [ArthSaathi ](https://arth-saathi.vercel.app/)(अर्थसाथी)**

**Tagline**: Your Personal Board of Al Financial Agents 

**Executive Summary**: ArthSaathi is a hyper-personalized financial coaching platform designed to address the "financial volatility" and "Income Irregularity Chasm" faced by India's growing gig economy, including freelancers, creators, and small-business owners. Traditional financial advice often fails this demographic due to their variable incomes. ArthSaathi provides a solution by creating a "personal, on-demand board of Al financial advisors". This system transforms "financial anxiety into financial acumen" through an empathetic, video-first coaching experience delivered by generative AI.

**The Solution: A Collaborative AI Agent Ecosystem**
ArthSaathi's core is a sophisticated workflow where five specialized AI agents collaborate to create a deeply personalized coaching experience.

1. **The Architect (Persona Generation Agent)**: This agent engages the user with a dynamic survey to understand their financial landscape. It then constructs a "high-fidelity, simulated financial world" and a core persona (e.g., "Freelance Graphic Designer") for the user to navigate.
2. **The Analyst (Behavioral Analysis Agent**): As the user interacts with the simulation or provides real data, the Analyst observes their decisions. It identifies "behavioral biases (loss aversion, credit reliance)" or analyzes "real-world financial health (cash flow, diversification)".
3. **The Strategist (Counterfactual "What-If" Agent)**: In simulation mode, this agent builds a "decision tree" to generate a report on "the road not taken," illustrating the "second-order effects of each choice".
4. **The Mentor (Actionable Insights Agent)**: The Mentor synthesizes all reports to distill complex information into a "simple, prioritized action plan". It provides the user's "top two most impactful next steps".
5. **The Storyteller (Veo3 Scripting Agent**): This is the key innovation. It acts as a master agent, receiving structured reports from all other agents. Its task is to "transcend data and create a narrative," weaving all insights into a "cohesive, empathetic, and encouraging script".

This script is then fed to **Google Veo3** , which delivers the final, informational coaching session to the user.

**The User Journey: Three Distinct Paths**
ArthSaathi offers two simulation journeys and one real-world analysis feature.


- **Path A**: The Instant Simulation (For the Curious Explorer): A frictionless, first-visit experience. The user is "instantly assign[ed]... a relevant, pre-built default persona" (e.g., "Freelance Designer from Mumbai") and placed in a 3-month financial simulation. Upon completion, they receive a compelling video report from the AI coach summarizing their performance.
- **Path B**: The Personalized Journey (For the Dedicated Planner): The user engages with "The Architect" agent via an "intelligent survey". This "construct[s] a bespoke simulation that mirrors your financial life". The final AI coach video is "significantly more impactful" because it's based on the user's specific goals and a world built for them.
- **Beyond Simulation**: The Portfolio Health Check: This feature bridges simulation and reality. Users can "securely upload real financial documents" like portfolio statements or bank transaction sheets. The AI agents adapt: the Analyst performs a "rigorous analysis" of real cash flow, diversification, and debt. The Mentor generates "concrete recommendations" , and the Storyteller scripts a "Financial State-of-the-Union" video delivered by the Google Veo3 coach, outlining a clear, real-world action plan.

**Technology Stack**

- Frontend: React, TypeScript, D3.js (for decision tree visualization).
- Backend: Python (FastAPI).
- Database: PostgreSQL.
- Agentic AI Framework: LangGraph / CrewAI (for agent orchestration).
- AI & ML Models:
  - Generative Video: Google Veo3.
  - Core Logic (LLMs): Google Gemini Advanced / Llama (for agent reasoning).
  - Multi-Modal Input: Google Cloud Speech-to-Text & Vision AI (OCR).

**Description of your solution**

FineFlex
Tagline: Smart financial planning with AI for irregular earners.

The Problem We Solve:
The modern workforce is rapidly shifting towards gig and freelance roles, creating a vast population of irregular earners. In India alone, this constitutes a staggering 80% of the workforce. These individuals—delivery partners, freelance creatives, small vendors, and daily wage earners—face a constant financial struggle. Traditional financial apps are built on a flawed premise: a fixed, predictable salary. This one-size-fits-all approach fails miserably for those with volatile income, leaving them without the tools to budget effectively, save consistently, or achieve financial security.

Our Innovative Solution:
FineFlex is an intelligent, adaptive financial coach designed specifically for the variable cash flows of the 21st-century earner. We move beyond rigid, salary-based models to a dynamic system that learns and evolves with the user's unique income pattern.

Core Features:

Income Pattern Intelligence: Our proprietary tracker analyzes earnings history to identify unique cycles, trends, and volatility, forming the foundational understanding of your financial rhythm.

Adaptive Budgeting Engine: Unlike static budgets, FineFlex provides dynamic, flexible budgeting advice. It intelligently recommends allocating surplus from high-income periods to cover essentials during anticipated lean spells.

AI-Powered Financial Insights: Leveraging the OpenAI API, FineFlex acts as your personal finance advisor. Get plain-English answers to complex questions like, "Can I afford this expense?" or "How can I reach my savings goal faster?"

Personalized Goal Tracking: Set ambitious savings or investment targets. FineFlex creates a realistic, automated plan to achieve them, complete with visual progress graphs that motivate and inform.

Unified Financial Dashboard: A centralized, clean interface provides a real-time snapshot of your financial health—cash flow, spending categories, and goal progress—all at a glance.

Our Technical Foundation:
We are building a secure, scalable, and user-friendly platform with a modern tech stack:

Frontend: A lightweight, responsive web application using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

Backend: A robust and secure API built with Node.js and Express.js.

Database & Security: SQLite for efficient data storage and JWT authentication for ironclad user security.

AI Integration: Powered by the OpenAI API to deliver cutting-edge financial coaching.

Our Mission & Impact:
FineFlex is more than an app; it's a tool for economic empowerment. We are committed to providing this service completely free, ensuring that financial stability is not a privilege reserved for salaried employees. By equipping gig workers, freelancers, and daily earners with intelligent, personalized financial planning, we are fostering a future of reduced stress, increased savings, and profound financial resilience for millions.

**Fintech: Build an autonomous financial coaching agent that adapts to real user behavior, spending patterns, and income variability - helping gig workers, informal sector employees, and everyday citizens make smarter financial decisions proactively.**

FinFlex directly addresses the core challenge of this Fintech track by building an autonomous financial coaching agent specifically for users with irregular incomes, such as freelancers, gig workers, and informal sector employees.

While most financial tools are designed for fixed salaries, our app uses AI to analyze a user's unique, variable income and spending patterns. It proactively provides personalized, actionable advice to help them budget, save, and invest more effectively.

Key features that demonstrate this fit include:
1.Real-time tracking of irregular income and expenses.
2.AI-powered cash flow prediction, currently with 84% accuracy, to forecast future financial standing.
3.Personalized, proactive tips for saving and managing money amidst income variability.

Goal tracking to visualize progress towards savings and investment targets, fostering smarter financial decisions.

Our plan is to continue developing this into a fully-fledged, free-to-use mobile application, expanding the AI's capabilities to further adapt to real-user behavior and provide even more powerful, proactive coaching for this underserved segment.
