### Metronome
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/metronome-1c54) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Nightwing007/Metronome) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12oyRU94nkaUpnasVpK6mfLZAKmnr_mCh?usp=drive_link) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Syntax%20Error%202025-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://syntax-error-2025.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-2-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Randomness is the king

![Unity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Unity-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

This fun and quirky game centers around the adorable **Pokémon Togepi**, known for its unpredictable charm. The gameplay revolves around randomness, making every round unique and exciting. The main highlight of the game is Togepi’s signature move, *Metronome*, an ability that triggers a completely random action every time it’s used. Players must adapt quickly to whatever outcome occurs—whether it’s a powerful attack, a silly move, or a surprising effect. This element of surprise keeps the game lively and full of laughter. Strategy meets chaos as players try to make the best of whatever *Togepi* does next. It’s a lighthearted experience that celebrates chance, creativity, and the delightful unpredictability of Pokémon battles.

**Challenges we ran into**

**Art Creation & Polish**: Spent a lot of time creating the art assets and ensuring every animation and transition looked smooth and visually appealing.

**Animation System Challenges**: Setting up the state machine for character animations was quite difficult, especially to make transitions flow naturally between states like idle, run, and attack.

**Trial and Error Process**: As a solo developer, most of the work relied on repeated testing, debugging, and refining through continuous trial and error.

**Time Management Struggles**: Managing all aspects alone under strict deadlines was exhausting and stressful.

**Hackathon Pressure**: Being freshers, working in a time-bound hackathon environment was a new experience, making time the biggest challenge throughout development.

**Open Track - Development**

**Creative Interpretation**: It takes a well-known Pokémon concept — Togepi’s Metronome — and turns it into a unique, playable game experience, showcasing creativity and originality.

**Technical Implementation**: The use of randomness mechanics, animation state machines, and smooth art transitions demonstrates solid technical understanding and implementation beyond beginner level.

**Standalone Concept**: The game isn’t limited by a specific theme or restriction — it can appeal to any audience due to its fun, unpredictable, and replayable nature.

**Innovation in Gameplay**: By combining randomness with skill-based reactions, it introduces an innovative twist on traditional Pokémon-style gameplay.

**Polished Execution**: Despite being made in limited time, the project shows attention to detail, smooth animations, and balanced gameplay — aligning well with open innovation criteria.

**Freshman Track**

**Beginner-Friendly Concept**: The game is built around a simple yet creative idea — Togepi’s Metronome move — which makes it approachable for beginners to design and implement.

**Focus on Learning**: It demonstrates learning in multiple areas like animation, state machines, and randomization mechanics — perfect for showcasing growth as a new developer.

**Solo Effort & Skill Development**: As a solo project, it highlights individual effort, problem-solving, and the willingness to experiment and learn through trial and error.

**Creative Use of Time**: Despite limited time and experience, it manages to deliver a functional and fun product, reflecting adaptability and dedication.

**Hackathon Spirit**: It captures the true spirit of the freshman track — creativity, persistence, and learning through hands-on development.

> Villagers Go Digital, Panchayats Go Smart"

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

🏡 Digital-E Gram Panchayat

Digital-E Gram Panchayat is a user-friendly, web-based platform that empowers citizens to apply for and download official panchayat documents—like birth, income, or residence certificates—in PDF format.
Our goal is to bring transparency, ease, and digital access to essential village governance services.

🚀 The Problem It Solves

In rural areas, villagers often face multiple challenges to get basic certificates:

Long travel to Panchayat offices

Paperwork delays & manual processing

Lack of transparency in approvals

Extra costs due to middlemen or corruption

Digital-E Gram Panchayat solves this by:

Allowing direct online applications for certificates

Providing instant PDF downloads with QR verification

Sending real-time status updates on applications

Reducing human dependency → making the system more efficient, safe & corruption-free

🔧 Features

📝 Online Certificate Requests → Apply directly through the platform

📄 PDF Generation → Instantly generate downloadable, QR-coded certificates

📢 Announcements & Notices → Stay updated with all Panchayat news

🌐 Multilingual & User-Friendly → Simple design for villagers in Hindi/English/local language

👩‍💻 Admin Dashboard → Panchayat officers can approve/reject requests with one click

🎯 Why This Project?

✅ Promotes digitization of village governance services

✅ Provides convenient & remote access to essential documents

✅ Enhances transparency and efficiency in Panchayat operations

✅ Saves time, money, and effort for rural citizens

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/5d67a45c0fe94052a0e66d2b4adfc0b7/5ffe23f6-e4d9-4d1b-9071-d9afda2795a2.png)

**Challenges we ran into**

🐞 Challenges I Ran Into

During the development of Digital-E Gram Panchayat, I faced a few key hurdles:

PDF Generation with QR Code

Initially, generating certificates in PDF format with QR verification was tricky.

The formatting was breaking on different devices, and QR codes weren’t embedding properly.

🔑 Solution: I explored libraries like pdf-lib and jsPDF, tested multiple approaches, and finally used a combination that ensured both text formatting and QR placement worked smoothly.

Data Flow Between User & Admin Panels

Managing the flow where a villager applies → admin reviews → certificate gets approved/downloaded was complex.

🔑 Solution: I structured a clear database schema (for requests + approvals) and created API endpoints for each stage, which simplified the workflow.

User-Friendly Multilingual UI

Many villagers prefer using local languages, so ensuring the app could support both English + Hindi (and potentially more) was challenging.

🔑 Solution: Integrated i18n (internationalization) support and designed the UI with simple icons + visuals, so even first-time digital users could navigate easily.

Time Constraints of a Hackathon

Building both frontend & backend within 24 hours was intense.

🔑 Solution: Focused on MVP-first approach → started with essential features (certificate request + approval + PDF download), and kept “nice-to-have” features like WhatsApp notifications as future scope.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/5d67a45c0fe94052a0e66d2b4adfc0b7/564d35d5-3940-4203-8e52-b870322f8fed.png)

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/5d67a45c0fe94052a0e66d2b4adfc0b7/fb30900b-9413-4f64-913e-e2697759fc72.png)

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/5d67a45c0fe94052a0e66d2b4adfc0b7/f775fa92-d1ba-4d8d-876d-e15c6922e422.png)

**Open Innovation**

🌐 How This Project Fits Open Innovation

Digital-E Gram Panchayat directly aligns with the Open Innovation track of HackAura because it solves a grassroots governance problem in a unique and scalable way.

✅ Why it belongs to Open Innovation?

Inclusive Problem-Solving

Unlike niche AI or Web3 tools, this project addresses a universal challenge faced by millions of rural citizens: access to official documents.

It empowers any villager, regardless of tech skills, to apply for and receive essential certificates digitally.

Innovation for Governance & Communities

Digitalization of panchayat processes reduces dependency on manual paperwork.

Promotes transparency, accessibility, and accountability in local governance.

Scalability & Adaptability

Can be extended to 700,000+ villages in India, and replicated globally for community-level administration.

Designed to be multilingual, mobile-friendly, and low-data accessible, making it adaptable to diverse rural populations.

Bridging the Digital Divide

Villagers no longer need to travel long distances, pay middlemen, or face bureaucratic hurdles.

This makes governance simpler, safer, and faster for communities who are often digitally excluded.

🌟 Essence of Open Innovation

At its core, Open Innovation is about creating impactful, accessible, and human-centered solutions.
Digital-E Gram Panchayat reflects this by:

Simplifying governance for people who need it most.

Bringing transparency into rural administration.

Using technology as a bridge to close gaps in accessibility and trust.

👉 In short, it’s not just tech for the sake of tech — it’s tech for everyone, especially for those who are usually left behind.

> AI-Powered FIRs and Smarter Case Documentation

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![SQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![Git](https://img.shields.io/badge/Git-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-333333?style=flat-square) ![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Law enforcement and investigative teams spend countless hours on manual, repetitive, and error-prone tasks like transcription, FIR drafting, case reporting, and evidence documentation. These inefficiencies slow down justice delivery and increase the chances of mistakes that can impact lives.

How CaseSync helps:

Faster Documentation – Converts speech into structured FIRs in real time, reducing hours of manual typing into minutes.

Error Reduction – Ensures FIRs and reports follow standardized legal formats, minimizing inconsistencies.

Multilingual Support – Powered by AI (Bhashini + Whisper), enabling officers to record and document cases in their local languages.

Offline Mode – Works in rural or low-connectivity areas, making it inclusive and reliable everywhere.

Secure Evidence Handling – Encrypts, stores, and manages digital case data with proper chain-of-custody logging.

Smarter Analysis – AI tools analyze emotions, tone, and case trends to give deeper insights for investigators.

Courtroom-Ready Output – Automatically generates professional reports and even AI-powered FIR-to-video summaries for better engagement and communication.

Why it matters:

By simplifying and automating the most time-intensive tasks, CaseSync allows law enforcement officers to:

Spend more time in the field instead of behind paperwork.

Ensure citizen trust through faster and more accurate FIR registration.

Handle diverse linguistic regions without communication barriers.

Improve safety and efficiency, ultimately strengthening justice delivery.


CaseSync automates transcription, FIR drafting, and evidence management with AI, making law enforcement tasks faster, safer, multilingual, and legally compliant—saving officers hours of paperwork while improving accuracy and accessibility.

**Challenges we ran into**

Multilingual Support – Handling real-time transcription in diverse Indian languages was complex. We integrated Bhashini APIs and optimized preprocessing to ensure accurate and fast translations.

AI Redaction & Accuracy – Automated redaction of sensitive details (faces, license plates, PII) sometimes over- or under-detected. We solved this by combining rule-based filters with AI models to boost reliability.

Resource Constraints – With a zero budget, we had to rely on open-source tools, community datasets, and free-tier cloud services while carefully optimizing compute-heavy AI tasks.

Offline & Low-Connectivity Use Cases – Many rural areas lack stable internet. To address this, we designed offline-first transcription workflows, storing data locally until sync was possible.

Scalability & Security – Managing sensitive law enforcement data required strong encryption and compliance. We implemented role-based access controls, JWT authentication, and encrypted storage early in the prototype.

Team **JainwinCoders** -- [Naveen Sharma](https://github.com/naveensh16), [Shantanu Singh](https://github.com/ShantanuisCoding), [Sneha Sneha](https://github.com/Sneha73685)

**The problem it solves**

****What People Can Use It For****

**Soil Analysis**: Get real-time data on soil moisture, pH, temperature, and nutrients.

**Crop Recommendation:** AI suggests best crops based on soil, weather, and market demand.

**Weather Forecasting**: Timely alerts about rainfall, temperature changes, or extreme events.

**Market Price Tracking**: See live prices for crops in nearby mandis to sell at the right time.

**Challenges we ran into**

When we first connected our IoT sensors (for soil moisture, temperature, and water level) to the web&mobile app, we ran into a critical issue:

The app was not showing live data — instead, it would either freeze or display outdated readings.

The problem came from CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) errors and API timeout issues between our Flask backend and the Frontend &Android app.

This made it impossible for farmers to trust the system because they couldn’t rely on the readings.

**$300(Open): Cash Prize**

**1. AI for Real-World Impact**

Smart Krishi leverages artificial intelligence to solve critical farming challenges. It uses AI for:

Crop recommendation based on soil and weather data.

Early detection of crop diseases using machine learning models.

Data-driven irrigation and resource optimization.

This aligns perfectly with the theme’s goal of creating practical AI solutions that address everyday problems in sustainability and agriculture.

**2.Open Innovation**

Smart Krishi goes beyond AI by integrating IoT-based soil sensors, real-time weather updates, and a marketplace feature for farmers. This end-to-end approach modernizes farming and empowers both rural and urban growers, making it a strong candidate under the Open Innovation theme as well.

**Ethereum Track**

**Transparent Marketplaces:** Use Ethereum smart contracts to create trustless crop-sale agreements between farmers and buyers, eliminating middlemen.

**Decentralized Data Ownership:** Allow farmers to own and control their soil, weather, and crop data, selling it to researchers or agri-companies securely.

### Smart Shopping Cart
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/smart-shopping-cart-6ded) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://prezi.com/p/edit/tvrxf0m6a2wg/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-NexHack-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://nexhack.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-2-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> No Cashier, No Hassle, Just Convenience

![Firebase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase-333333?style=flat-square) ![Internet of Things (IoT)](https://img.shields.io/badge/Internet%20of%20Things%20(IoT)-333333?style=flat-square) ![ESP-32 WiFi Module](https://img.shields.io/badge/ESP--32%20WiFi%20Module-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

1. Eliminating Long Queues

Traditional billing requires customers to stand in long checkout lines.

This leads to frustration, wasted time, and a poor shopping experience.

The smart cart eliminates queues by handling billing automatically in the cart itself.

2. Reducing Human Errors in Billing

Manual scanning at counters may cause mistakes (missed items, wrong pricing, duplicate scans).

RFID ensures automatic, accurate detection of items and real-time updates.

3. Making Shopping Faster & Easier

Customers don’t need to manually scan barcodes or wait for staff.

Just drop the item in the cart — the system takes care of billing.

Removing items is equally easy, with the price instantly deducted.

4. Enhancing Safety & Hygiene

Post-pandemic, customers prefer minimal contact shopping.

No need to hand over items to a cashier → safer, touch-free billing.

5. Better Shopping Experience

Customers see their running total in real-time, helping them manage budgets.

Reduces the stress of last-minute surprises at billing counters.

6. Supporting Retailers

Helps stores cut costs by reducing dependence on multiple billing counters.

Prevents theft/misplaced items since every product has an RFID tag.

Provides data insights for inventory management and targeted offers.

**Challenges we ran into**

Multiple RFID Tags Being Read Together

Problem: When two products with RFID tags were placed close together, the reader sometimes detected them incorrectly (either missing one or reading duplicates).

Solution: Implemented a filtering algorithm and added a small delay in reading cycles so only one tag is registered at a time.

2. Real-Time Cart Updates on LCD

Problem: The LCD was not updating instantly when items were added/removed, causing display lag.

Solution: Optimized the ESP32 code to refresh only the changed values (item count/price) instead of rewriting the whole screen every time.

3. Removing Items from the Cart

Problem: Initially, the system could only add items but didn’t handle item removal correctly (the price stayed the same).

Solution: Added logic to check whether a tag is inside or outside the cart. If removed, the quantity reduces or the item gets deleted from the bill.

4. Power & Wiring Management

Problem: With multiple components (ESP32, LCD, RFID), wiring on breadboards became messy, leading to loose connections and unstable power.

Solution: Organized wiring with separate breadboards, used male-to-female jumpers where needed, and ensured stable power supply via micro USB.

5. Accuracy in Quantity Updates

Problem: When the same tag was scanned multiple times, it sometimes created duplicate entries instead of increasing quantity.

Solution: Introduced a mapping system (tag ID → product) so that if the same tag ID appears again, only the quantity is updated.

> Your AI powered farming assistant

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask-Ask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask--Ask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

We encountered several challenges while developing and implementing an AI smart crop and price prediction system. These can be categorized into technical, operational, and user-related issues.
​Technical and Data Challenges
​Lack of High-Quality Data: Training accurate AI models requires massive, high-quality, and standardized datasets. We found that agricultural data is often fragmented, incomplete, or inconsistent. This includes historical crop yield data, real-time sensor information (like soil moisture and temperature), and market price records. Much of this data is either not collected or is in formats that are difficult to integrate.  
​Environmental Variability: A key challenge is the unpredictable nature of agriculture. Weather patterns, pest infestations, and soil conditions can vary dramatically from one farm to the next and from season to season. A model trained on data from one region or one growing season may not perform well in another, leading to a phenomenon known as "data drift" which requires constant model retraining.  
​Model Accuracy and Interpretation: While AI can provide predictions, ensuring the model's accuracy is a continuous task. Furthermore, the "black box" nature of complex AI models makes it difficult to explain to a farmer why a particular prediction was made. This lack of explainable AI can erode trust in the technology.  
​Operational and Adoption Challenges
​Cost and Infrastructure: The initial investment for implementing AI solutions can be very high. This includes the cost of sensors, drones, and other IoT devices for data collection, as well as the computational power needed to process the data. This high cost is a significant barrier, especially for small-scale farmers in developing regions.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Monaco Editor](https://img.shields.io/badge/Monaco%20Editor-333333?style=flat-square) ![Electron JS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Electron%20JS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**Developers lose countless hours on three painful tasks:**

- Understanding large codebases — figuring out how components, functions, and hooks connect.
- Writing API test cases manually — repetitive and time-consuming for projects with dozens of endpoints.
- Debugging across multiple tools — switching between Postman, editors, and logs just to find root causes.

***This slows down onboarding, increases frustration, and delays real progress.***

💡** How Dude Code Helps**

- Dude Code makes development faster and smoother by combining AI-powered flowcharts, automated API testing, and root cause analysis (RCA) into one tool.

- Understand instantly: One command generates a visual flowchart of the project, with code explanations and AI suggestions.

- Test automatically: CLI auto-generates API test cases directly from the code, runs them in seconds, and saves reports.

- Debug smarter: On failure, Dude Code explains the root cause, shows the exact code snippet, and even allows inline fixes — no tool switching.


👉 What **used to take days or weeks now takes just minutes**, giving developers their time back to focus on building.

**Challenges we ran into**

**Building Dude Code wasn’t easy — we hit a few big hurdles along the way:**

- Parsing the project structure → Separating components, hooks, and functions accurately and then connecting them in the flowchart was tough.

**Solution:** We built a custom parsing and classification logic that intelligently maps each element to its relationships.

- AI-generated test accuracy → Early versions produced test cases that didn’t always match real-world API needs.

**Solution:** We added an option for developers to review and refine AI-generated test cases before execution.

- Error explanations (RCA) → Simply showing “fail” wasn’t useful.

**Solution:** We integrated AI-powered root cause analysis that not only shows why an error occurred but also highlights the exact code snippet for quick fixing.

**These challenges shaped Dude Code into a more practical and developer-friendly tool.**

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![STT](https://img.shields.io/badge/STT-333333?style=flat-square) ![Supabase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Supabase-333333?style=flat-square) ![Elevenlabs](https://img.shields.io/badge/Elevenlabs-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**🎯 Problem**
Interview prep today is noisy, vague, and full of guesswork. Candidates copy-paste their resumes into generic tools, get surface-level advice, and still walk into interviews unsure of what to fix or focus on. I wanted to change that.

**🛠️ Solution:**
Resume + JD → Voice-based Interview Readiness Report Built a modular, voice-enabled prep assistant that delivers clarity and confidence in minutes:

1. Resume Parsing: Extracts key data—name, contact, skills, experience, education.
2. JD Matching: Compares resume against job description across multiple dimensions (skills, seniority, relevance).
3. Readiness Report:
3.1. Score (0–100)
3.2. Top strengths
3.3. Specific gaps
3.4. STAR stories auto-generated from resume evidence
3.5. Targeted practice questions
4. Voice Practice: Candidates speak their answers aloud and receive real-time feedback on clarity, structure, and relevance.

**🚀 Outcome**
Faster and realistic prep. Sharper focus. Lower anxiety. A safer, smarter assistant that helps candidates walk in ready—not just hopeful.

**🔗 Links**
* https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/11w9D54r5nZ0s921LLc_mAj9tV06ZyanZUq19pOILsAM/preview
* https://prepaired.lovable.app
* https://devfolio.co/projects/test-2c5c

**🌀Categories:**
1. Lovable
2. Eleven Labs
3. Windsurf

**🛤️Tracks:**
- Track 1: Voice AI & Conversational Products
- Track 2: Vibecoding your idea
- Track 3: AI Agents & Workflow Automation

**Challenges we ran into**

1. Confirming resume parsing is correct. I added a simple “Parsed Resume Preview” step so people can quickly check what the app understood before generating a report.
2. How to get deterministic output from LLM. I asked for a JSON-only output in the system prompt.
3. Real resumes are messy. I added null/empty handling so sections render “No data yet” instead of failing the whole report.
4. Speed vs quality. I use a fast model for previews and a larger one for the final report, keeping the UI snappy without sacrificing quality.
5. Debugging - required tool switching, and waiting for credits to be topped up at midnight UTC. The tools hallucinated or were inconsistent with certain implementation and coding conventions.

**Top 100 Participants**

This project showcases Lovable’s chat-driven building end-to-end:

1. I used Lovable to scaffold the app, wire Supabase, and iterate on components rapidly.
2. Simply by chatting, I added two API routes (parse resume, generate report), migrations, and environment wiring without leaving Lovable. No technical skills needed.
3. The result highlights Lovable’s strength for founders: ship a real, AI product in days or even hours.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**The Problem It Solves**
Relocating to a new city or country can be overwhelming. Information is scattered across multiple websites, forums, or agencies, making it difficult to know where to start or what to trust. 
As someone who has moved cities myself, I realized I needed more than just a checklist — I needed a companion that made the process less overwhelming and more engaging.

**Slide**
https://app.chroniclehq.com/0153b4e4-34c2-4f7e-b118-6887d40833b6/document/d28e229e-31aa-48cc-89db-272da80a9500/intro

**How People Can Use It**
I have turned relocation into a gamified journey:
- Instead of dry to-do lists, users get a step-by-step pathway tailored to their destination.
- Every time they complete a task, they earn points, unlock badges, and progress through milestones.
- The experience feels less like a burden, and more like leveling up in a game while building your new life

**Features**
- Gamified rewards – Points, streaks, and badges make the relocation journey motivating and fun.
- Timeline-based tasks – Organized into milestones like Day 1–7, Week 2, Month 1, so you always know what’s most important right now.
- Personalized experience: Tasks are organized by timeline (Day 1–7, Week 2, Month 1), so users know what to prioritize first.
- Voice assistance – All guidance is available in text and audio, so you can listen while commuting or running errands. [WIP]

**How It Makes Life Easier & Safer**
- Saves time by cutting through scattered information.
- Reduces mistakes by keeping critical deadlines and steps front and center.
- Boosts confidence with structured, guided progress.
- Accessible for all through simple UI and audio playback.
- Adds excitement to what is usually a stressful process — every task feels like an achievement.

**Challenges we ran into**

At first, I planned to connect directly to providers like OpenAI or Anthropic for generating text and reasoning. However, managing different APIs, prompt formats, and fine-tuning requirements added unnecessary complexity to in the build. Since this is a 2 week buildathon, I switched to MindStudio as my orchestration layer where I configured the agent flows, model selection and prompt logic in one place. This was easier to manage, save cost and debug errors.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/c6cec22e1bbe41d1993db60363c9888c/6ddcd5c0-8376-4bee-b0e9-a80ec024b1f4.png)

For this prototype, I decided to keep things as lean as possible. Instead of building a full database to store client information or audio files, I focused on integrating ElevenLabs directly.
One challenge I ran into was API latency and response issues when generating audio on demand.
To work around this, I streamlined the request flow and implemented basic fallback handling, ensuring that even if the API was slow or inconsistent, the prototype could still deliver a smooth user experience.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/c6cec22e1bbe41d1993db60363c9888c/3d69ab51-115f-4547-ba84-f9fcbca49bc6.png)

**The problem it solves**

# How Tripper Solves the Current Problem

## The Problem  
Managing group expenses during trips is often messy and stressful:  
- Difficult to track who paid for what  
- Manual calculations in spreadsheets or notes  
- Awkward money conversations with friends/family  
- Existing apps feel too rigid or lack automation  

## The Solution – **Tripper**  
Tripper simplifies group expense management with a clean Next.js implementation and smart automation:  

- **Smart Expense Tracking**  
  Automatically records, categorizes, and organizes expenses for the group.  

- **Optimized Settlements**  
  Uses an efficient algorithm to minimize redundant transactions, ensuring faster and fairer settlements.  

- **Real-Time Updates**  
  Keeps balances instantly updated so everyone always knows who owes how much.  

- **Voice-Enabled Experience (via ElevenLabs)**  
  Tripper announces key events with natural voice feedback:  
  - Trip creation confirmations  
  - Expense additions  
  - Settlement updates  

- **Frictionless Collaboration**  
  Transparent expense tracking reduces misunderstandings and awkwardness.  

---

✨ With Tripper, traveling with friends, family, or colleagues becomes fun again — no more stressing about money management.

**Challenges we ran into**

# Challenges I Ran Into

While building **Tripper**, I faced a few key challenges:

### 1. Handling Fair Expense Splitting  
At first, splitting expenses fairly across multiple people with different contributions was tricky.  
- **Hurdle:** My initial approach led to redundant settlements (e.g., one person paying multiple small amounts to different people).  
- **Solution:** I implemented an optimized settlement algorithm that minimizes the number of transactions, making the process smooth and efficient.

### 2. Database & State Management  
Synchronizing expense data in real-time between users was another hurdle.  
- **Hurdle:** Inconsistent state updates caused mismatched balances for some group members.  
- **Solution:** I added proper database transaction handling and real-time syncing, ensuring every participant sees the same updated data.

### 3. UI/UX & Usability  
Designing a clean interface that worked seamlessly across devices was a big challenge.  
- **Hurdle:** The first version felt cluttered and confusing for users to navigate.  
- **Solution:** I simplified the layouts, added intuitive flows, and focused on making the experience more user-friendly and responsive.

### 4. Voice Integration with ElevenLabs  
Integrating voice feedback for trip events was a new area for me.  
- **Hurdle:** Initially, voice announcements were either delayed or inconsistent across different events.  
- **Solution:** I optimized the API integration and added event-based triggers, ensuring clear voice updates when trips are created, expenses are added, or settlements are completed.

---

💡 Each of these challenges pushed me to dig deeper into **algorithms, real-time systems, frontend design, and API integrations**, which made the final product much stronger.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Supabase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Supabase-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Kids spend hours grinding in Fortnite and Roblox for digital rewards. Today's games reward effort with clout, skins, and social power.

Parents are stuck in constant battles over screen time while kids crave status and recognition online. 

The problem isn’t screens. The problem is that real life doesn’t reward kids the way games do.

There has never been a system that makes their real-world effort count the same way. 

PIRL brings that loops to real life.

**The Solution**

We turn verified real-world effort into exclusive digital rewards. Steps walked, homework finished, sports played. Every mission is personalized by a GenAI engine and every completion is verified with data or parent approval. The earned item goes into a PIRL Locker which is a digital identity layer that shows what you achieved, not what you bought.

**Why Now**

Gen Z lives at the intersection of digital and real. Parents want healthy habits. Platforms want new mechanics. PIRL aligns all three at the exact moment screen time is under fire.

PIRL makes real life count. With AI powering personalization and proof of effort, we are creating *a new category of play where progress in life unlocks value online.*

**Challenges we ran into**

Neither of us are developers. I’m in communications, and Michael is in strategy and operations. Before this Buildathon, I didn’t even know what a terminal was or how to download files. We were truly starting from zero.

We leaned heavily on AI, TPF workshops, and each other. We kept taking screenshots when we got stuck for chatGPT, asking it to break it down like we were five, and learning to debug with patience instead of panic. One breakthrough moment was finally getting Supabase connected so the form could create a real database. Another was discovering the simple “download ZIP” button during a TPF workshop. That tiny tip unlocked hours of frustration and changed the way we worked.

By the end, we didn’t just have a landing page, we had a working form, a live waitlist, a basic prototype, and the foundation for something much bigger. 

Our prototype includes a Figma+Supabase demo showing PIRL’s mission and reward logic in action, paired with a Rocket.new+Supabase website that provides an access link, demo video, and waitlist signup.

**All Registered Participants**

We are two non-technical founders, and Windsurf gave us the ability to take PIRL beyond slides and concepts into the foundation of a real application.

With Windsurf we built a functioning backend with a live database and working form connections. For us, even getting that far was a breakthrough.

We did not get a polished UI in place, but the process taught us how the pieces connect. We went from not knowing what a terminal was to managing full file structures, debugging errors, and testing in real time.

Having PIRL partially working in Windsurf showed us the next step is possible. We will continue to work to the MVP so we can test PIRL with users and validate the idea.

**The problem it solves**

1.	Many elderly people struggle with managing medications, remembering appointments, and tracking health activities.

2.	They often feel isolated and may not have easy access to AI-powered companionship or health reminders.

3.	CareMate helps bridge this gap by providing a simple, AI-driven assistant that ensures elderly users stay on top of their health and feel supported.

4.	It not only reduces the chances of missed medicines or checkups but also promotes independent living with confidence.

5. In case of an emergency, elders can notify their guardians by simply pressing and holding the red button at the top of the screen for 2 seconds.

6.	By blending health support with emotional care, CareMate aims to become a trustworthy digital companion for seniors and their families.


Presentation Deck : https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1SUeeoZ-kWMSg2SmS_12aV56QBjdAnBEj/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=115738733966006147037&rtpof=true&sd=true

**Challenges we ran into**

1.	Integrating Eleven Labs for natural speech felt challenging, especially ensuring clear, friendly, and elder-friendly communication.
2.	Using Windsurf for backend required us to carefully design data handling for health reminders and user management.
3.	Creating the entire UI from scratch demanded thoughtful design to make it intuitive, simple, and accessible for elderly users.
4.	Coordinating the frontend, backend, and AI modules smoothly without conflicts required extra effort and testing.
5.	Ensuring that the design, backend logic, and voice integration aligned within limited time was tough.

**All Registered Participants**

In CareMate, I used Windsurf to connect the frontend with Firebase backend, manage real-time data, and integrate ElevenLabs’ conversational AI agent. This enabled features like medicine reminders, health updates, and voice interactions, making the app interactive, responsive, and easy to use for elders.

**Vibecoding your Idea | Powered by Rocket.new**

In CareMate, I used Rocket.new to build the complete front-end of the app. It helped me create a user-friendly interface, smooth navigation, and responsive design, ensuring the app was easy to use for elders and their families.

**Voice AI & Conversational Products | Powered by Elevenlabs**

In CareMate, I integrated ElevenLabs’ conversational agent to enable voice-based interactions. Elders can talk to the app, receive guidance, reminders, and updates naturally through speech, making the app more accessible, interactive, and user-friendly.

## The Silent Crisis Killing Rural India

Every 7 days of outbreak detection delay = 21 preventable deaths. Today, 1.4M children die annually from diseases we could prevent if detected earlier.

## 🐚 PanchajanyAI: The Digital Conch

Like Krishna's conch warned of danger, PanchajanyAI transforms 1M ASHA workers into India's real-time disease surveillance network. Detection time: **7 days → 6 hours (28x faster)**.

**How it works:** ASHA workers WhatsApp voice notes → AI transcribes Hindi/English → Extracts location/symptoms → Detects clusters → Predicts spread → Alerts officials

## 📊 Impact & ROI (Validated with Julius AI)

- **Lives Saved:** 10,000/year
- **Healthcare Savings:** ₹500 Cr/year  
- **ROI:** 2,147% (8-month payback)
- **Scale:** Ready for 600,000 villages
- **Adoption Potential:** 98% (uses WhatsApp)

- PRD with Claude (30min vs 3hr)
- Market Analysis with Julius AI (TAM: ₹1,200Cr)
- n8n Investigation Agent (finds outbreak causes)
- Pitch Deck with Gamma.app

**Development:**
- Voice→Text: Sarvam AI (Hindi optimized)
- Code: Replit
- Dashboard: Streamlit
- Clustering: DBSCAN algorithm
- Alerts: WhatsApp/SMS automation

## 🎯 Why PanchajanyAI Wins

**Technical Innovation:**
✅ First voice-first health surveillance for low-literacy users
✅ Landmark-based GPS ("near temple" → coordinates)
✅ Code-mixed Hindi-English NLP processing
✅ Outbreak prediction (48hr forecast with 70% accuracy)
✅ Automated investigation agent (weather + patterns + history)

**PM Innovation:**

✅ 10x faster than traditional development
✅ Zero designers/developers needed

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![WebSockets](https://img.shields.io/badge/WebSockets-333333?style=flat-square) ![WebRTC](https://img.shields.io/badge/WebRTC-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

We're leaving leads on the table and **missing huge growth opportunities.**

*   **LIMITED REACH:** Human teams simply can't call enough prospects fast enough.
*   **INCONSISTENT QUALIFICATION:** Varying pitches and follow-ups mean missed potential.
*   **SLOW SPEED-TO-LEAD:** Delays in initial contact hurt conversion rates.
*   **EXHAUSTING REPETITION:** Drains human energy, leading to burnout.

Irelia can **scale with your outbound efforts**, intelligently engage prospects, and optimize early-stage negotiations.

**Challenges we ran into**

1.  **AI needed real-time market context for *every* conversation.** Like, second-by-second.
    *   **THE FIX:** We constantly feed Irelia live market data from the dashboard. `sendContextualUpdate` keeps it brutally honest and adaptive about the best offer or prospect interest. No more guessing.
2.  **AI needed to *hear* human responses perfectly.** And update the dashboard instantly to guide the conversation.
    *   **THE FIX:** Our custom ElevenLabs tool, `set_user_offer`, lets Irelia pinpoint verbal responses and pushes that data straight to the UI. It closes the loop for intelligent, adaptive dialogue.
3.  **Keeping the whole system connected and resilient.** The internet's a wild place for high-volume calls.
    *   **THE FIX:** Built a robust watchdog system. If the connection wobbles, Irelia knows, recovers, or tells you. No silent failures during crucial outreach.

**Top 100 Participants**

Used lovable to prototype the ui.

**All Registered Participants**

Used Windsurf to Build Irelia

**All Registered Participants.**

For high-volume outbound, **voice is paramount**. We needed an agent that sounds **human, not a robot**, and hears every nuance from prospects.

*   **ElevenLabs was the only choice.**
    *   **THE VOICE:** Unparalleled natural synthesis. Makes Irelia sound persuasive and trustworthy for initial contact, not programmed.
    *   **THE EARS:** Pinpoint speech-to-text. Ensures Irelia *hears* prospect responses, no misfires, allowing for adaptive conversations.
    *   **THE BRAIN-TO-VOICE LOOP:** Our custom tools tie spoken responses directly to Irelia's dynamic strategy.

Irelia doesn't just *use* ElevenLabs; it's **powered by it**. It's the reason our agent can actually *engage* conversationally at scale. It makes outbound real.

**Challenges we ran into**

**NEURAL LEARN: Development Challenges**

**Major Bugs & Solutions**

**1. Theme Consistency Issues**

**Problem:** Components showed white backgrounds despite theme switching

**Solution:** 
- Replaced prose prose-invert with theme-aware classes
- Fixed prop passing to use themeConfig objects instead of strings

**2. Scrollbar Theme Stuck**

**Problem**: Scrollbars stayed orange even in gamified theme 

**Solution**:
- Added !important to CSS declarations
- Replaced custom-scrollbar with dynamic theme classes
- Implemented forced body class refresh

**3. Audio Management Chaos**

**Problem**: Multiple audio files playing simultaneously, memory leaks 

**Solution**:
- Centralized audio control with useRef
- Added proper cleanup with revokeAudioUrl()
- Implemented section-based audio management

4. API Integration Complexity

**Problem**: Inconsistent error handling across multiple APIs 

**Solution**:
- Created unified service files with consistent error patterns
- Added toast notifications for user feedback
- Implemented secure API key validation

**Key Learnings**
1. Centralized theme configuration essential from start
2. CSS specificity requires !important for complex overrides
3. Audio applications need careful resource management
4. Windsurf AI collaboration with systematic todo tracking accelerated development

**100% AI-Generated Code**

Neural Learn showcases the power of AI-assisted development - every line of code was written using Windsurf AI. > Your AI CFO for smarter spend forecasting.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Supabase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Supabase-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

🌍 Intro + Problem It Solves

Small business owners live in constant financial anxiety. They don’t know if they’ll have enough cash next month, invoices slip through the cracks, and the current tools (QuickBooks, Xero, Zoho, spreadsheets) bury them in jargon and historical data.

CFO Buddy solves this by being a financial co-pilot, not just a ledger. It gives SMBs a crystal-clear cash runway dashboard (“72 days of cash left”), smart invoice reminders, and a weekly health digest — all in plain English. No accountant required, no hidden fees.

It’s not about graphs. It’s about confidence: helping founders know what’s coming, not just what happened.

Project code Github link:- https://github.com/Shruti-lab/CFO_Buddy
Project Presentation Deck:- https://shorturl.at/cHHxD

**Challenges we ran into**

🔧 Challenges I Ran Into

**Bank Feeds are Unreliable**
Bank integrations often miss data or duplicate transactions. We realized syncing real-time feeds is an engineering moat, so for MVP we prioritized manual upload + clarity first, deferring heavy integrations to v2.

**Balancing Simplicity vs. Power**
SMBs crave forecasting and “what-if” scenarios, but building AI forecasting upfront risks over-complexity. We stripped it down to a core emotional hook: runway visibility and invoice tracking — solving the pain before the dream.

**Trust in AI for Finance**
Users don’t blindly trust AI with money. We learned to design for explainable AI — surfacing predictions in human language (“Runway drops by 30 days if invoices remain unpaid”), always paired with manual override.

**Market Saturation**
QuickBooks, Xero, Zoho dominate. The challenge: why would someone switch? The answer became our differentiator — predictive clarity + simplicity + trust. Not another accounting app, but an AI CFO built for humans.

> The Digital Marketplace for Street Vendors

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Vendee – The Digital Marketplace for Street Vendors Problem: 

India has over 10 million street vendors who are the backbone of the fresh produce economy. Yet they remain invisible in the digital world, customers can’t easily locate vendors, know their inventory, or order from them. 
On the other side, vendors lose sales and face growing competition from dark-store delivery apps like Zepto and Blinkit, which are expensive, warehouse-based, and disconnected from local vendors. 

Solution: 
- Vendee is a hyperlocal digital marketplace that connects street vendors and customers in real time. 
- Vendors simply upload their daily inventory (photo or manual entry) and are instantly visible on a live map. 
- Customers can discover nearby vendors, check availability, and either walk to the vendor or request delivery through gig partners. 
- The app brings trust, visibility, and convenience to the unorganized vendor economy, an “Swiggy for local vendors” where every vendor can be discovered, and every customer can shop fresh and local. 

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/fd99c6fde1bd4e38984e260f6b3181f7/1c91ba06-40e7-4108-b1f7-7735906f9452.png)

**Challenges we ran into**

One major hurdle we ran into while building Vendee was with real-time location updates of vendors. Initially, our backend kept overwriting vendor location data inconsistently, which caused the frontend map to either show outdated pins or duplicate vendors.

How We Solved It

- We debugged and realized the issue was that our API was sending updates too frequently without proper checks.
- To fix it, we added rate limiting and state validation so that only meaningful location changes (e.g., moving >50m) were sent to the database.

After this fix, vendor movement appeared live and accurate on the map, improving the overall user experience and making the app feel truly dynamic.

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/odisha-development-dashboard-29c0) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/rehan-shaikh-1/OdisaDevelopmentDashboard/tree/main) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/xVbKNW22On4) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackOdisha%205.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackodisha-4.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-2-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Odisha’s Growth Powered by Smart Data Insights

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Wolframe](https://img.shields.io/badge/Wolframe-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**The Odisha Development Dashboard** powered by *Wolfram Language* solves the challenge of fragmented, complex public data by providing a single, unified, interactive platform for exploring and visualizing critical development metrics such as literacy rates, agricultural output, infrastructure growth, and economic indicators.

**Key Uses and Benefits**
Data-Driven Governance: Enables government officials to monitor program performance and make informed, timely decisions based on real data trends across districts and years.

**Enhanced Transparency**: Citizens gain easy, frictionless access to public information, fostering accountability and participation.

Efficiency & Accuracy: Automates data aggregation, analysis, and visualization, significantly reducing time and errors compared to manual reporting.

**Policy Planning**: Helps identify outliers, correlations, and efficiency gaps to better allocate resources and design targeted programs.

**Real-Time Monitoring**: Supports dynamic exploration of KPIs, scheme progress, and socio-economic indicators for responsive governance.

**Cross-Sector Integration**: Combines data from departments, enabling holistic views of development status and progress.

**Challenges we ran into**

**Specific Hurdles**
Data Inconsistency: Public datasets are often collected across heterogeneous geographic boundaries with inconsistent formats, requiring robust data cleaning and normalization strategies.

**Real-Time Interactivity**: Balancing Wolfram Language’s powerful dynamic visualization with smooth user experiences over the web posed performance challenges.

**API Integration Complexity**: Designing Wolfram Cloud APIs that reliably deliver correct filtered data dynamically for complex dashboard controls involved iterative debugging.

**Team Learning Curve**: Team members initially struggled with Wolfram’s functional programming paradigm, requiring focused training and mentorship.

**Cloud Deployment Permissions**: Fine-tuning deployment permissions and security for public access on Wolfram Cloud required careful configuration.
How These Were Overcome
Implemented an early-stage data validation and preprocessing pipeline for multi-source normalization.

Optimized Wolfram dynamic modules with efficient data querying and caching to improve dashboard responsiveness.

Created modular API functions with detailed logging for rapid identification and fixing of integration bugs.

Conducted internal Wolfram language bootcamps, collaborative coding sessions, and leveraged Wolfram’s extensive documentation.

Worked closely with Wolfram Cloud support to establish best practices for public deployment and secure APIs

**Web3 Track prize**

**Utilizing Wolfram** Language for data processing, interactive visualization, and deploying scalable dashboards on Wolfram Cloud via *CloudDeploy* and *APIFunctions*.

### FinanceQuest
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/financequest-68a8) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/oindreela04/FinanceQuest.git) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://finance-hub-sage.vercel.app/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackOdisha%205.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackodisha-4.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-2-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Level up your money game.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![MetaMask](https://img.shields.io/badge/MetaMask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JWT](https://img.shields.io/badge/JWT-333333?style=flat-square) ![Chart.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Chart.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Learning personal finance and investing is usually boring, intimidating, and risky. Most people either:

Jump straight into real trading and lose money, or

Avoid learning altogether because existing platforms feel too technical.

FinanceQuest turns this challenge into a game-like journey where users learn finance by playing, not just reading.

✅ What People Can Use It For

Gamified Learning: Unlock levels, earn badges, and complete challenges while mastering financial concepts.

Safe Practice Arena: Simulated trading lets users experiment with portfolios and strategies risk-free.

Market Exploration Quests: Search and track real stocks, crypto, and ETFs in an engaging, game-style dashboard.

Progress Tracking: Visual dashboards show skill growth, portfolio performance, and milestones achieved.

🎯 How It Makes Tasks Easier, Safer & More Fun

Reduces risk → users gain confidence before investing real money.

Boosts motivation → gamification makes financial literacy addictive and fun.

Centralizes tools → no need to juggle multiple apps for learning, tracking, and trading practice.

Empowers beginners → turns complex finance concepts into interactive, bite-sized missions.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/3983036439bf494f807e02495a6a8fa7/b2b9fa24-a5a3-47f6-a6f0-45092f47ba0b.png)

**Challenges we ran into**

Building FinanceQuest came with both technical and design hurdles. Some of the key challenges were:

1. Integrating Real-Time Market Data

Problem: Stock and crypto APIs often had rate limits, inconsistent response formats, or required authentication keys. This made it tricky to fetch and update data smoothly.

Solution: I implemented caching for repeated requests and normalized API responses so that the frontend always received clean, structured data.

2. JWT Authentication & State Management

Problem: Handling user sessions across multiple pages (login, dashboard, portfolio) was buggy at first — tokens weren’t persisting correctly, and protected routes weren’t secured.

Solution: I set up a JWT-based authentication system with secure HTTP-only cookies and built a global AuthContext in Next.js, ensuring users stayed logged in consistently.

3. Gamification Logic

Problem: Designing the badge and level-up system was not straightforward. The challenge was to keep it meaningful while still being fun.

Solution: I introduced a point-based system where users earn XP for completing quests, making trades, and checking market insights. This was stored in MongoDB and tied directly to user progress.

4. Frontend ↔ Backend Communication

Problem: At times, the backend API responses didn’t match what the frontend expected, causing broken dashboards and incorrect chart rendering.

Solution: I standardized all backend responses (JSON format with status + message + data) and built reusable frontend API hooks to reduce inconsistencies.

5. Deployment on Vercel

Problem: Deploying both the Next.js frontend and Express backend on Vercel required some tweaking, since serverless functions behave differently than a regular Node.js server.

Solution: I restructured the backend into API routes compatible with Vercel functions, and used environment variables (NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL) to ensure smooth integration.

🔥 Every hurdle turned into a learning opportunity — now the platform is stable, scalable, and much easier for new users to enjoy.

**Ethereum Track**

FinanceQuest uses Ethereum to transform gamified finance learning into real, ownable achievements and tokens, bridging the gap between simulated trading and decentralized finance.On-Chain Rewards & Badges

Instead of just storing badges in MongoDB, we can mint NFTs on Ethereum to represent achievements.

Example: Completing a trading quest → user earns a “Trader NFT” on-chain, which they actually own.

Decentralized Portfolio Tracking

Users can connect their Ethereum wallet (MetaMask, WalletConnect).

Simulated trades could evolve into real DeFi portfolio tracking, where they manage tokens, stablecoins, and NFTs directly.

Gamified Learning with Tokens

XP/points earned in FinanceQuest can be mapped to an ERC-20 token.

Tokens can be used to unlock premium learning modules, enter competitions, or even be exchanged on-chain.

Safe Introduction to Web3

Beginners who start with simulated finance can smoothly transition to real-world crypto investing.

FinanceQuest becomes a bridge from Web2 → Web3, making blockchain adoption safer and more accessible.

**Web3 Track prize**

FinanceQuest combines gamified finance learning with Wolfram’s computational intelligence to deliver real-time market analysis, interactive problem-solving, and smarter investment simulations

**Participation prize**

FinanceQuest takes complex finance workflows and reimagines them into simple, gamified Balsamiq-style wireframes that evolved into a functional, user-friendly product.User-Centered Design

Finance can feel intimidating; our wireframes focused on making navigation intuitive (Home → Dashboard → Portfolio → Market → Quests).

Designed with beginners in mind, ensuring a low learning curve.

Gamified UI

Wireframes were used to map progression systems (levels, badges, challenges) before coding.

Ensured the gamification felt natural, not overwhelming.

Rapid Iteration

Using Balsamiq-style wireframing allowed quick testing of layouts: portfolio cards, charts, XP tracker, and reward badges.

Feedback loops helped refine the dashboard → quest flow → progress tracker.

Bridging Prototype to Product

The Balsamiq-like sketches translated directly into Next.js + Tailwind UI components, proving how strong wireframes can accelerate dev.

Team **Semicolon** -- [Oindreela Saha](https://github.com/oindreela04), [Subhasree Paul](https://github.com/6289subhasree)

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![XGBoost](https://img.shields.io/badge/XGBoost-333333?style=flat-square) ![AI/ML](https://img.shields.io/badge/AI/ML-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Breast Cancer Detection AI Model

This project is an AI-powered breast cancer detection system designed to assist in the early diagnosis of breast cancer. Early detection is critical for improving treatment outcomes, and this model helps achieve that with high accuracy.

Objective: Provide a fast and reliable tool to predict whether a tumor is benign or malignant based on medical data.

Accuracy: The trained model achieves 97% accuracy, ensuring trustworthy predictions.

Benefits:

Enables early detection of breast cancer.

Supports doctors in making more informed decisions.

Helps in reducing delays in diagnosis, potentially saving lives.

How it Works:

The user inputs medical parameters into the web interface.

The trained AI model analyzes the data.

The model predicts the tumor type and displays the result: Benign or Malignant.

Technologies Used:

Python & Flask for the web application

Machine Learning (Scikit-learn) for the model

HTML/CSS for frontend interface

Pickle for model serialization

**Challenges we ran into**

While building this AI breast cancer detection project, I faced a few technical challenges:

Git & Repository Management

Problem: I had difficulty pushing my local project to GitHub because the remote repository already had files (like README.md), which caused src refspec main does not match any and merge conflicts.

Solution: I resolved this by pulling the remote changes with --allow-unrelated-histories, merging them locally, and then pushing my branch successfully.

Author Identity in Git

Problem: Git initially blocked commits because my author identity was not set.

Solution: I configured my Git username and email globally using:

git config --global user.name "Arghyadutta253"
git config --global user.email "duttarghya203@gmail.com"


Connectivity & Deployment Challenges

Problem: Deploying the Flask app to a permanent URL was tricky due to server requirements and connectivity limitations in free hosting platforms.

Solution: I explored multiple hosting options like PythonAnywhere, Render, and Railway and structured my app to work with low bandwidth and local deployment if needed.

Flask Template Rendering

Problem: Initially, my templates/ folder and HTML files didn’t show on GitHub after manual upload.

Solution: I ensured the templates/ folder had at least one HTML file, added it through Git, and pushed the full project.

✅ These hurdles helped me learn proper Git workflows, Flask project structuring, and deployment strategies, making the project more robust and reliable.

> Art is the closest thing to Heart.!

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Artify provides a centralized, interactive, and visually appealing platform for digital and traditional artists. Traditionally, artists struggle to showcase their work, reach a wider audience, and receive feedback, while art enthusiasts find it hard to discover new creators and follow trends.

Artify solves this by:

**Showcasing artwork in one place** – users can browse, search, and filter artworks easily.

**Connecting artists and audiences **– users can follow artists, like, and comment on artworks.

**Simplifying discovery **– trending artworks and categories make exploration faster.

Providing profiles & contact info – artists can share their social handles and details, enabling collaboration or commissions.

Preserving interactions – likes, views, and comments are persistent, creating a richer engagement experience.

**Challenges we ran into**

**Real-Time Comment Persistence**

Problem: Comments were disappearing on page refresh because they were initially stored only in the React state.

Solution: Implemented localStorage to persist comments across sessions, ensuring user interactions remained intact.

Dynamic Image Upload Preview

Problem: Users couldn’t see their uploaded image before submitting the form, which made uploads confusing.

Solution: Integrated a live image preview using FileReader and updated the state in real time.

UI Consistency Across Pages

Problem: Each page (Home, Upload, Profile, Artwork Detail) had inconsistent styling and layouts.

Solution: Standardized design with gradients, shadows, and rounded components to create a cohesive “Artify” theme.

Frontend Deployment on Render

Problem: Render was trying to run npm run dev instead of serving the built frontend, causing a deployment failure.

Solution: Configured Render to use the dist folder as the publish directory and set the correct build command (npm run build).

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/synergyai-81e8) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Kritiman2005/SynergyAi) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackOdisha%205.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackodisha-4.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-2-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> AI-Powered Workforce Insights, Smarter Decisions.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![API](https://img.shields.io/badge/API-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

📌 Project Summary – Synergy AI

Synergy AI is an intelligent HR management platform that leverages machine learning and LLMs (Gemini) to help organizations make better workforce decisions.
The system focuses on three major areas:

Attrition Predictor 🧑‍💼

Uses employee data (age, role, tenure, performance, salary, etc.) to predict who is at risk of leaving.

Provides explainability (via SHAP/LIME + Gemini) so managers know why the prediction was made.

Skill Gap Analyzer 📊

Parses resumes and job requirements using NLP.

Highlights missing skills for employees and recommends personalized training courses.

Smart Shift Scheduler 📅

Analyzes attendance + absenteeism patterns.

Predicts absenteeism probability.

Uses Gemini to optimize shift schedules to balance workload and reduce risks.

Tech Stack:

Firebase Firestore → structured database for employees, datasets, predictions, schedules.

Firebase Storage → dataset uploads (attrition.csv, skills.csv, shifts.csv).

Cloud Functions (Python) → ML training & prediction endpoints.

Gemini 1.5 Pro → NLP for skill extraction, recommendations, and schedule optimization.

Next.js + React frontend → dashboard for dataset uploads & visualizations.

**Challenges we ran into**

⚠️ Problems I Faced

Dataset Handling

Difficulty in finding real-world HR datasets for attrition, skills, and absenteeism.

Needed to clean and preprocess data heavily (missing values, inconsistent columns).

Firebase Setup

Initial confusion around creating Google Auth keys and API configurations.

Managing Firebase Storage vs Firestore structure (where to store CSVs vs metadata).

LLM Integration (Gemini)

Designing proper prompts to extract structured outputs (JSON) from Gemini.

Ensuring Gemini recommendations aligned with ML predictions (avoiding contradictions).

Model Training Challenges

Attrition dataset was imbalanced (fewer “attrition = yes” cases).

Needed to tune ML models to avoid overfitting.

Time Constraints (Hackathon)

Building three separate ML modules (attrition, skills, shifts) under limited time.

Integrating frontend + backend + LLM smoothly for demo readiness.

> Plan Better. Learn Better. Live Better.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The Problem It Solves

Students today face two major challenges:

1. Disorganized Study Routines

   * Many struggle to balance multiple subjects, exams, and    assignments.
   * Traditional planners are rigid and don’t adapt when schedules change.

2. Mental Health & Exam Stress

   * Anxiety, burnout, and stress are common among students.
   * No single platform combines academic planning with                           mental wellness.


What People Can Use It For

ShikshaSathi makes studying 'smarter and healthier' by combining (AI-powered planning + wellness tracking) in one web:

AI Study Planner
 Automatically generates adaptive schedules that adjust when tasks are missed or completed early.

Wellness Tracker
Lets students log their mood, track stress, and practice quick breathing/meditation exercises.

Exam Feedback Tool
 Provides instant, personalized insights into mistakes, helping students improve faster.

Task Management & Analytics
Shows daily progress, weak topic prioritization, and actionable next steps.


 How It Makes Tasks Easier

1)Saves time-by auto-creating study schedules.
2)Reduces stress- through integrated wellness exercises.
3)Improves grades- with actionable feedback, not just scores.
4)All-in-one solution- no need for separate planners, wellness apps, or tutors.

**Challenges we ran into**

1. Dynamic Testimonial System

   * Setting up a backend with Express.js to store and fetch user testimonials was tricky.
   * Faced issues with form validation and handling missing input fields.

   * Solution: Added server-side checks for required fields (`name`, `location`, `text`) and displayed clear feedback messages on the frontend.

2. Wellness Animation (Breathing Exercise)

   * The breathing-circle animation didn’t look smooth at first and caused layout shifts.

   *  Solution: Used CSS `@keyframes` with easing functions to create a calm, looping animation that fits the wellness theme.

3. Image & Asset Management

   * During testing, placeholder images (for testimonials and wellness charts) broke the layout.
   
* Solution: Switched to consistent aspect ratios and added `object-fit: cover` in CSS to maintain balance.

4. Time Management

   * Building both **study planning** and **wellness features** in the short hackathon timeline was overwhelming.
   
*  Solution: Broke tasks into smaller milestones (UI first → backend APIs → polish animations) and prioritized must-have features.

1.) For Job Seekers

Resumes don’t stand out → Most candidates struggle to tailor their resume for each job description.

Missing critical keywords → Many resumes get rejected by Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) before a recruiter even sees them.

Unclear feedback → People don’t know why their resumes aren’t getting shortlisted or what exactly to improve.

2.) For Recruiters & Hiring Managers

Time-consuming resume screening → Recruiters must go through hundreds of resumes manually.

Difficult to assess relevance quickly → It’s hard to measure how well a candidate’s skills match the job description at first glance.

Inconsistent evaluation → Human bias and fatigue can lead to missed qualified candidates.

**Challenges we ran into**

1.) Parsing Different Resume Formats:
Handling multiple file types (PDF, DOCX, TXT) was tricky because each format required different libraries (like pdfminer.six and docx2txt), and ensuring consistent text extraction across them wasn’t easy.

2.) Skill Extraction Accuracy:
Simple keyword matching often missed context — for example, “machine learning” vs “ML.” Making the system smart enough to detect synonyms and related skills was a challenge.

3.) Job Match Scoring Logic:
Designing a fair way to calculate the match percentage between a resume and a job description required experimentation. Balancing precision (not overcounting repeated skills) and recall (not missing related skills) was tough.

4.) Backend–Frontend Communication:
Setting up the Flask backend and connecting it with the React frontend through APIs (CORS issues, JSON handling, async requests) caused a lot of debugging.

5.) User Experience & Design:
Making the results dashboard both beautiful and functional took effort. Implementing animations with Tailwind + Framer Motion while keeping performance smooth was a learning curve.

6.) Deployment Issues:
Deploying the Flask backend on Render and React frontend on Netlify came with challenges like environment setup, large file handling, and ensuring smooth API calls after deployment.

**Web3 Track prize**

Our project, Resume Skill Extractor, leverages Natural Language Processing (NLP) to analyze resumes and extract relevant skills. This aligns strongly with Wolfram’s focus on computational intelligence and advanced data analysis.

* Data Processing & Semantic Analysis: Wolfram tools are designed for deep text and knowledge-based computation. Our system could integrate Wolfram Language APIs to enhance keyword extraction, semantic understanding, and context-aware analysis of resumes.

* Intelligent Insights: Beyond simple skill extraction, Wolfram’s computational engine could help provide deeper analytics, such as skill frequency distributions, career trajectory predictions, and gaps in technical domains.

* Scalability for Recruiters & HR: Using Wolfram’s advanced algorithms, our project can evolve from basic skill extraction into a smart recommendation system that matches candidates with job requirements more effectively.

> Smart travel, safe travel.

![Firebase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Firestore](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firestore-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![HTML/CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML/CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The issue it solves.
In a busy college context, commuting is consistently frustrating for students. Public transportation isn't reliable, and ride-share services (Uber, Ola, etc.) can be too expensive for student budgets. Drivers drive alone, which leads to more traffic on the roads, parking issues on campus, and a larger carbon footprint. Most importantly, safety concerns of sharing a vehicle with a stranger are a big deal for students who may need a ride home at 3:00am or 6:00am. 


Campus Commute solves this issue by establishing a student-only peer-to-peer network. It makes travel cheaper by cutting out the fees and letting students split the costs directly. Campus Commute guarantees safety by ensuring every user goes through verification with their college ID. It makes the experience more convenient by giving students access to a simple platform that matches them with other students that are willing to help them, reducing time lost waiting and reducing congestion on the road.

**Challenges we ran into**

The biggest challenge I ran into was building a seamless real-time interaction flow for a hackathon, without a complex backend and without using a dedicated chat service (or chat channels). I originally planned to have a chat section using Firebase's Realtime Database, however, I struggled with how to manage the listeners and ensure that the data was synced correctly. This resulted in a situation where a "No document to update" occurred when a driver accepted a ride. This threw the user flow into disarray.
To get around this, I had to step back and re-evaluate the core need of the project. For a hackathon, the main aim is to show that it works - not that it's scalable. Instead of building a complex chat where messages were stored, I pivoted the design. The current solution uses a link directly to a temporary 'in-app' chat that is activated after a ride has been accepted by a driver. This allowed me to indicator the rider and driver quickly, swiftly eliminated the bug and still checked the box for core communication scenario the project required. The most important lesson was to focus on getting an MVP out as a product and simplifying the tech stack to successfully stay in scope for the project earlier.
