> Smarter matches. Stronger hacks

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![appwrite](https://img.shields.io/badge/appwrite-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

HackDevs solves one of the biggest challenges in hackathons — finding the right teammates.
Participants often struggle to connect with people who share similar interests, complementary skills, or aligned project goals, which leads to unbalanced teams and wasted time in coordination. Many talented individuals miss opportunities to work on meaningful projects simply because they can’t find the right collaborators. HackDevs uses AI to streamline this process, making team formation smarter, faster, and more impactful, so participants can focus on building innovative solutions instead of worrying about team logistics.

**Challenges we ran into**

1. Maintaining Redux Store on Hard Refresh

A major challenge was that the Redux Toolkit store would reset whenever the user performed a hard refresh. This meant that authentication details and user information were lost, disrupting the user experience.
Solution: Instead of relying on Redux Persist, we integrated Appwrite authentication services to check whether a user is still logged in after a refresh. Based on Appwrite’s session validation, we updated the Redux store accordingly, ensuring users stayed authenticated and their data remained consistent.

2.  Real-Time Updates in the Account Page

We wanted the account page to reflect changes instantly (like profile edits or updates in user details). Initially, changes were only visible after a manual refresh.
Solution: We implemented Appwrite’s real-time subscriptions and React state management, allowing the UI to update automatically whenever backend data changed.

3.  Building Protected Routes

Another hurdle was setting up protected routes so only authenticated users could access certain pages. Initially, unauthorized users could bypass restrictions with direct URL access.
Solution: We implemented a custom PrivateRoute component in React Router DOM, integrated with Redux state and Appwrite authentication, to verify sessions before rendering components, thereby securing restricted pages.

**The problem it solves**

What is AetherCode?

AetherCode is a smart code editor that runs in your browser. It combines everything developers need—coding, AI help, and teamwork—into one simple web app.

💡 Problems it solves

**Challenges we ran into**

🚧 Challenge: The "Run" Button Bug

One of the trickiest bugs I faced in AetherCode was making the "Run" button work properly with the console output.

At first, it looked simple: click "Run," execute the code, and show the results in the console panel. But in practice, I ran into three big problems:

Blank Console – The code ran, but nothing showed up in the console, so users had no feedback.

Only One File Ran – The system only executed the currently open file, not other dependent files in the project.

Broken State Updates – React’s state wasn’t updating in time, so logs appeared inconsistently (a race condition).

🛠️ How I Fixed It

Built a Custom Console

I created a custom console object (log and error) and passed it into the code’s sandbox so that all outputs were captured safely.

Batch Execution

Instead of running just one file, I filtered all JavaScript/TypeScript files in the project and ran them in sequence, combining their outputs.

Atomic State Update

I first collected all the logs into a local array, then updated React state once at the end. This prevented race conditions and made the console display consistent.

✅ With these fixes, the Run button now executes multiple files properly and always shows the correct logs in the console.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

- Rapid emergency reporting: Citizens submit incidents with location, photos, and details in seconds.

- AI-assisted triage: Auto‑classifies severity, category, and urgency to prioritize faster response.

- Team coordination: Sends rich incident cards to Slack and alerts via SMS for immediate action.

- Situational awareness: Live map of reports, shelters, and alerts for clear operational visibility.

- Multi‑language support: Real-time translation makes reporting and updates accessible to more people.

- Data-driven decisions: Analytics and risk predictions help plan resources and anticipate hotspots.

- Result: Faster, safer, and more coordinated emergency response for communities and responders.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the biggest hurdles we faced was integrating our AI models into the Flask backend. Initially, the server would freeze whenever the model tried to process large datasets, mainly because the requests were being handled synchronously. This made the application feel unresponsive and unreliable during testing.

To overcome this, we explored asynchronous request handling and optimized the way we loaded our AI models. Instead of loading the model on every request, we initialized it once when the Flask server started. This small but critical change drastically reduced response time and prevented the server from crashing under load.

Through this challenge, we learned the importance of efficient resource management and designing APIs that can handle real-time crisis scenarios smoothly.

**Best Use of Akash**

Our Crisis Management System uses Akash Network to deploy AI models for disaster prediction and response on a decentralized, cost-efficient cloud. By leveraging Akash’s GPU scalability and resilient infrastructure, our Flask application remains reliable and accessible even in crisis scenarios, making it a perfect fit for the Best Use of Akash track.

**The problem it solves**

Globally, one-third of food produced is wasted, resulting in substantial financial losses for families and environmental degradation as the planet suffers from increased carbon emissions and resource depletion. Households frequently forget expiry dates, overbuy groceries, and lack effective inventory management, leading to unnecessary discarding of edible items. In India, this issue is particularly acute, with average households wasting 50-70 kg of food annually, and 40% of urban food waste stemming from poor storage and expiry oversight. Simultaneously, communities grapple with paradoxical challenges of food surplus in some areas leading to waste, while others face shortages, exacerbating inequality and sustainability concerns. This inefficiency not only drains household budgets—potentially costing ₹15k–20k per year—but also hinders eco-friendly practices, highlighting the urgent need for innovative tools to minimize waste, optimize grocery planning, and foster community sharing for a more sustainable kitchen ecosystem.

**Challenges we ran into**

While building Smart Rannaghar, our team faced a few technical and logical hurdles:

1.Expiry Date Tracking Bug

Initially, we had issues with storing and comparing expiry dates in the database. Dates were being saved as plain strings, which caused errors when calculating “days left.”

Solution: We switched to using proper date formats (DATE type in Supabase) and added a check to calculate expiry using JavaScript’s Date object.

2.Inventory Update Errors

When adding new grocery items, our frontend sometimes showed “function not defined” errors (e.g., addInventoryItem is not defined).

Solution: We refactored the code so all functions were properly imported and ensured event listeners were bound after DOM loading.

3.Price Compare 
We could not find the API to compare the price of the online shop.

Team Collaboration & Merge Conflicts

While pushing code to GitHub, we often faced merge conflicts because multiple members were working on frontend and backend simultaneously.

Solution: We adopted a branching workflow (feature/branch) and resolved conflicts by frequent pulls and proper code reviews.

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/careervibe-96b8) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Manishburnwal/career-vibe-ai) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://careervibe-ai.vercel.app/) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=apyOUBdlxCg) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-SMF%20Smart%20Make--A--Thon-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://smf-smart-makeathon.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-2-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Your Personal Career Autopilot

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Supabase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Supabase-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Career planning is overwhelming, fragmented, and unclear. Students and professionals struggle with:

- Confusion about which career path to choose

- Uncertainty about skills, exams, or colleges to focus on

- Outdated tools that give generic results

- Lack of accessible mentorship

- Risk of wrong choices leading to wasted time and money

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the biggest hurdles was generating dynamic career reports in JSON format that looked structured and meaningful when converted into visual dashboards. Initially, the AI outputs were inconsistent and difficult to standardize.

To solve this, we created a strict JSON schema for the report, defining fields like career choices, skills, exams, financial planning, and backup paths. We then validated every API response against this schema, ensuring clean and reliable data for visualization.

Another challenge was making the AI guidance feel like more than a chatbot. To overcome this, we separated the "AI Mentor" into its own module and built an Interactive Career Path Simulator that auto-updates the report when users tweak their inputs. This made the system feel more like a simulator rather than just a Q&A tool.

Team **APEX** -- [Mayank Soni](https://github.com/mayank9142), [Manish Kumar](https://github.com/Manishburnwal), [Ayushman Koley](https://github.com/ayushmankoley)

> Empowering Communication Beyond Barriers.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

## 🌟 Features

### 🎯 **Core Learning Features**
- **Text-to-Sign Translation**: Convert text input to ASL hand gestures
- **Realistic ASL Visualizations**: SVG-based hand illustrations for accurate learning
- **Interactive Quizzes**: Gamified learning with progress tracking
- **Progress Dashboard**: Track learning journey and achievements

### 🌍 **Internationalization**
- **Multi-Language Support**: English, Hindi, and Gujarati
- **Dynamic Language Switching**: Real-time language changes
- **Localized Content**: All UI elements translated
- **Persistent Language Settings**: Remembers user preferences

### 🎨 **User Experience**
- **Modern UI/UX**: Clean, responsive design with Tailwind CSS
- **Dark/Light Theme**: Toggle between themes
- **Mobile Responsive**: Works seamlessly on all devices
- **Accessible Design**: WCAG compliant interface

### 🤖 **AI-Powered Features**
- **Smart Sign Detection**: Automatic recognition of common words
- **Custom ASL Components**: Specialized visualizations for key words
- **Intelligent Fallbacks**: Graceful handling of unknown words

**Challenges we ran into**

🧩 Challenges I Ran Into

Building SignSpeak Tutor wasn’t completely smooth — here are some key hurdles I faced and how I overcame them:

1. Accurate ASL Visualizations

Challenge: Representing ASL gestures realistically using only SVGs was harder than expected. Many gestures required motion indicators (like circular or nodding motions) which static images couldn’t convey well.
2. Internationalization (Multi-Language Support)

Challenge: Switching between English, Hindi, and Gujarati dynamically caused some components to not re-render properly, leading to inconsistent translations across the UI.

Solution: I built a custom LanguageContext with React Context API, ensuring all UI strings updated in real-time whenever the language was switched. Also, I persisted the chosen language in localStorage so user preferences were remembered.

### HaatBazar
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/haatbazar-c5ae) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/ranadebsaha/status_code_2) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/u4EWzV24MiA) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-StatusCode%202-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://statuscode-2.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-2-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> “hand-to-hand” local bazaar.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Django](https://img.shields.io/badge/Django-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Django rest framework](https://img.shields.io/badge/Django%20rest%20framework-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

- **High Delivery Costs:** Traditional e-commerce platforms often impose delivery charges, which can be a barrier for customers. Our platform eliminates these delivery fees, making the service more accessible and appealing.

- **Inefficient Delivery Routes and Environmental Impact:** Standard delivery services frequently face challenges with inefficient routing due to unfamiliarity with local areas, leading to increased fuel consumption and higher carbon emissions. Our model aims for a 0% carbon emission delivery solution.

- **Limited Product Flexibility and Customer Choice:** Conventional delivery partners often restrict customers to specific product quantities. Our platform offers greater flexibility, allowing customers to receive products according to their precise needs and accommodating changes of mind.

- **Lack of Vendor Demand Visibility:** Local vendors often struggle with accurately assessing customer demand. Our platform provides genuine vendors with clear insights into local demand, enabling them to optimize their offerings.

- **Issues with Product Freshness and Quality:** Existing quick commerce platforms rely on local warehouses, which can lead to issues with product expiry or damage. Our platform ensures customers receive fresh, on-demand vegetables, fruits, and grocery items directly.

- **Vendor-Friendly Interface and Experience:** Many current platforms are not optimized for the needs of genuine local vendors. Our platform is designed to be truly user-friendly for these vendors, streamlining their operations.

**Challenges we ran into**

- **Real-time Functionality and Geospatial Integration:** A significant challenge was the successful implementation of real-time capabilities, specifically concerning live location tracking and the integration of geographical mapping facilities. This involved ensuring accurate and immediate updates for both users and delivery partners, a critical component for an efficient and user-friendly experience.

- **Sustainable Profitability Model:** Developing a viable and competitive profit generation model posed another substantial challenge. This required careful consideration of how the platform would achieve profitability, especially when compared to established quick commerce and e-commerce platforms like Blinkit, which operate with different revenue streams and market positions.

**Vultr Cloud Deployment Track**

For deployment, we chose Vultr Cloud Deployment. It provides us with reliable infrastructure, scalability, and cost-effectiveness. With Vultr, we can deploy our backend services, database, and APIs on globally distributed servers, ensuring low latency, high performance, and smooth real-time updates for both customers and vendors.

**Best Use of Gemini API**

To make HaatBazar smarter, we also integrated Gemini API. This helps in product upload and classification directly from images, making it effortless for vendors to list their products quickly and accurately even if they’re not tech-savvy.

**Best Use of MongoDB Atlas**

On the technical side, we chose MongoDB as our primary database. Since HaatBazar deals with highly dynamic data products, vendor inventories, customer orders, real-time delivery updates, and even geo-coordinates - MongoDB’s flexible document model makes it ideal. It allows us to handle unstructured and rapidly changing data efficiently. Its scalability and geospatial queries are especially useful for features like live delivery tracking, mapping vendors to customers, and optimizing routes.

**Open Innovation**

Our project fits into the **Open Innovation** track because it rethinks the way local commerce, delivery, and vendor-customer interactions are managed. Instead of relying on traditional e-commerce models, we introduce an **inclusive, vendor-friendly, and sustainable ecosystem** that solves real-world challenges such as:

- **Eliminating delivery fees** to make services more accessible.
- **Enabling 0% carbon emission delivery** through optimized routing and eco-friendly practices.
- **Providing flexibility for customers** in product selection and quantity.
- **Empowering local vendors** with genuine demand visibility and an easy-to-use interface.
- **Ensuring product freshness** by enabling direct, on-demand delivery.
- **Building real-time functionality** with geospatial integration for seamless tracking.
- **Designing a sustainable profitability model** that differs from existing platforms.

This open innovation approach not only **bridges gaps in current quick commerce solutions** but also creates a **scalable, community-driven platform** adaptable to diverse local markets.

### SplitX
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/splitx-257a) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/prakritisarkar/Split_x) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/rAeupJBQn_Q) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-StatusCode%202-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://statuscode-2.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-2-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Share moments, not money stress.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Vanilla JS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vanilla%20JS-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Managing shared expenses in groups — whether on trips, hostel stays, or team outings — is usually messy. People struggle with:

- Remembering who paid what.
- Manually recalculating when someone joins or leaves midway.
- Figuring out who owes whom without endless back-and-forth.
- Dealing with existing apps that feel cluttered and overcomplicated.

SplitX solves this by:

- Providing instant clarity: simple statements like “A owes B ₹200”.
- Offering a clean, minimal UI that avoids unnecessary features.
- Automatically adjusting splits when group members change.
- Ensuring settlements are transparent, fair, and effortless.

Our USP is clarity and simplicity — we make expense sharing stress-free, so groups can focus on enjoying their time together rather than worrying about money.

**Challenges we ran into**

We ran into a few key challenges while building SplitX — 

(1) converting our Figma designs into working desktop code, where spacing and alignment often broke, which we solved by creating reusable components and a shared CSS style guide.

(2) implementing the settlement logic, since our first version only showed balances and was confusing, so we redesigned it to output clear pairwise statements like “A owes B ₹200” .

(3) database structuring, as initially we stored all expenses in one collection which slowed queries, but we fixed it with a group-based model where each group document contains its members and expenses. 

(4) time constraints, where we focused on core features like group creation, expense tracking, and settlement while leaving advanced features such as payment integration for future versions.

**Open Innovation**

SplitX is built on the spirit of open innovation— it takes a common, everyday problem and solves it with a transparent, lightweight, and extensible approach. Anyone can use it, adapt it, and improve it, making it a truly community-first solution.

Because we kept the tech stack simple and open (Node.js, MongoDB Atlas, HTML/CSS/JS).

And since our design focuses on clarity and fairness, the app can be trusted and adopted by diverse communities, from students in hostels to teams on work trips — encouraging wider collaboration and innovation.

### Traily
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/traily-221c) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Rohit-Dnath/trail-2) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-StatusCode%202-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://statuscode-2.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-2-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Browser Layer for researchers

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![React.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/React.js-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Modern researchers face an overwhelming information landscape where knowledge discovery is fragmented, disconnected, and difficult to navigate. Traditional browsing creates isolated pockets of information without meaningful connections, making it challenging to:

Track Research Threads: Losing track of how different pieces of information relate to each other
Maintain Context: Jumping between tabs and sources without preserving the research journey
Visualize Connections: Understanding relationships between concepts, authors, and domains
Retrieve Past Insights: Finding previously discovered information buried in browser history
Synthesize Knowledge: Connecting dots across multiple sources and timeframes
Traily's Solution: An Intelligent Browser Layer
Traily transforms your browser into an intelligent research companion that automatically builds and visualizes your knowledge graph as you browse. It creates a persistent, interconnected map of your research journey.

🧠 Automatic Knowledge Extraction
AI-Powered Analysis: Uses Google Gemini 2.5 Flash API to intelligently extract key concepts, relationships, and insights from web content
Zero Manual Input: Captures knowledge automatically as you browse - no need to manually tag or organize
Content Understanding: Distinguishes between pages, concepts, authors, and domains to create meaningful categorizations
🌐 Interactive Knowledge Graph
Visual Research Map: See your research as an interconnected network of nodes and relationships
Dynamic Exploration: Click, zoom, and navigate through your knowledge to discover hidden connections
Relationship Discovery: Understand how different pieces of information relate to each other
Temporal Tracking: Visualize how your understanding evolves over time
🔍 Intelligent Search & Discovery
Semantic Search: Find information using natural language queries across your entire research history
Web Search Integration: Seamlessly search Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo, and other engines directly from the interface
Website Logo Detection: Visual recognition of sources for easier navigation
Advanced Filtering: Filter by content type, date range, domain, and relationship strength
📊 Research Analytics & Export
Export Capabilities: Save your knowledge graph as JSON, CSV, or PNG for sharing and backup
Research Insights: Understand your research patterns and knowledge accumulation
Cross-Session Continuity: Your knowledge graph persists across browser sessions and devices
🚀 Researcher-Focused Features
Dark Space Theme: Comfortable interface for extended research sessions
Minimal Distractions: Clean, focused design that doesn't interrupt your flow
Quick Access: Popular research sites readily available below the search bar
Zoom-Responsive Nodes: Text becomes more detailed as you zoom in for deeper investigation

**Challenges we ran into**

🚧 Challenges I Ran Into
1. AI Integration & API Management
Challenge: Integrating Google Gemini 2.5 Flash API for intelligent content analysis while managing rate limits and API costs.

Solution:
Implemented efficient caching mechanisms to avoid redundant API calls
Created a pre-configured API key system for immediate functionality
Added fallback mechanisms for API failures
Optimized content extraction to focus on the most relevant information


2. Real-Time Knowledge Graph Visualization
Challenge: Creating a smooth, interactive graph that can handle hundreds of nodes without performance degradation.

Solution:
Implemented dynamic node sizing based on graph complexity
Used ReactFlow for optimized graph rendering with virtualization
Created efficient position algorithms to prevent node overlap
Added zoom-responsive design for better scalability


3. Chrome Extension Architecture Complexity
Challenge: Building a Manifest V3 extension with multiple components (background service, content scripts, side panel) while maintaining state consistency.

Solution:
Designed a robust message passing system between components
Implemented local storage management for persistent data
Created modular architecture with clear separation of concerns
Added proper error handling and fallback mechanisms


4. Content Analysis Accuracy
Challenge: Extracting meaningful relationships and concepts from diverse web content types (articles, papers, forums, documentation).

Solution:
Fine-tuned AI prompts for better content understanding
Implemented content type detection and specialized processing
Added relationship strength scoring for more accurate connections
Created feedback loops to improve extraction quality over time


5. User Experience Design
Challenge: Creating an interface that's powerful yet intuitive for researchers with varying technical backgrounds.

Solution:
Adopted a space-themed, minimal design inspired by research environments
Implemented progressive disclosure - simple interface with advanced features available
Added comprehensive tooltips and hover states for discoverability
Created multiple interaction patter

**Open Innovation**

The Traily project is highly suitable for open innovation because it addresses a universal challenge faced by researchers across disciplines—navigating fragmented, disconnected information landscapes—and transforms it into a collaborative opportunity. By automatically building and visualizing knowledge graphs, Traily creates a transparent research trail that can be easily shared, exported, and extended, encouraging community-driven collaboration and cross-disciplinary learning. Its modular, interoperable architecture allows developers and researchers to plug in new models, visual layers, or analytics, fostering an ecosystem where collective contributions enhance the tool’s capabilities. Moreover, by democratizing access to intelligent research tools that are often locked behind enterprise walls, Traily empowers students, independent researchers, and institutions worldwide to participate in knowledge construction. This openness, scalability, and adaptability make Traily a strong candidate for open innovation, as it shifts the research process from isolated efforts to a community-oriented, co-created ecosystem.

### EduPulse
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/edupulse-36b2) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://learn-offline-connect.lovable.app/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackBuild-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackbuild.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-2-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Learn.Solve.Lead

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Students in remote or underserved areas often lack internet, labs, and localized learning resources, making STEM education difficult and unsafe.
Offline-first: Lessons and practice work without internet.

Virtual Lab: Safe, hands-on practice with simulated instruments.

C Programming Sandbox: Real-time coding practice without complex setup.

Local Languages: Content in Tamil, Hindi, and more.

Progress Tracking & Gamification: Keeps students motivated and teachers informed.

Mobile-Friendly: Runs smoothly on low-end devices.

👉 EduPulse makes STEM learning accessible, safe, and engaging for every student.

**Challenges we ran into**

One major challenge was making the platform fully offline-first. Handling lesson downloads, progress tracking, and ensuring quizzes worked without internet required rethinking data storage. I solved this by using local storage and caching strategies, so progress syncs automatically when the device reconnects.
Another hurdle was the Virtual Lab simulation. Getting instruments like voltmeters and ammeters to behave realistically in a browser was tricky. I overcame this by breaking the circuits into modular components and validating outputs step by step.
Finally, local language support was challenging, especially with fonts and alignment in Tamil/Hindi. I resolved it using proper Unicode handling and fallback fonts.

**Ethereum Track**

Although EduPulse is primarily an offline-first STEM learning platform, we see strong relevance to the Ethereum track. By integrating Ethereum-based credentialing, student progress, certificates, and achievements can be stored on the blockchain. This ensures tamper-proof, verifiable educational records that students in underserved regions can use for scholarships, jobs, or higher education—without relying on fragile paper-based systems. Leveraging Ethereum makes EduPulse not only a learning tool but also a trust layer for education credentials, empowering students globally.

### CareQueue
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/carequeue-smart-slotbased-clinic-queue-and-appointment-managementsystem-1c21) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/158fuy099Mo7QcAcJTlYfrNGX4tQyOCR8?usp=sharing) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackBuild-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackbuild.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-2-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Less Waiting, More Healing

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Machine Learning](https://img.shields.io/badge/Machine%20Learning-333333?style=flat-square) ![WebSockets](https://img.shields.io/badge/WebSockets-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flutter](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flutter-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**CareQueue** is a next-generation, community-focused healthcare platform designed to turn local clinic visits from unpredictable and stressful into predictable, transparent, and hassle-free experiences — for both patients and healthcare providers.
At its core, CareQueue combines slot-based appointment booking, dynamic walk-in availability, encrypted medical records, and a specialist-trained AI chatbot — all wrapped inside a map-first, multilingual, and voice-assisted interface.

***Our Key Features***

  **1.Slot-Based Booking**
  **2.Dynamic Walk-In Availability**
  **3.Integrated Medical History**
  **4.Specialist-Trained Chatbot**
  **5.Voice Assistant + Multilingual Layer**

***For Patients***

1.   **Know before you go:** Live clinic availability, open/closed status, walk-in    capacity,      and estimated wait times at a glance.
2.   **Book smarter:** Reserve 1-hour slots in advance and get real-time queue updates.
3.   **Stay informed:** Receive alerts when earlier slots open due to cancellations or early completions.
4.   **Health at hand:** Securely access your medical history anytime, anywhere, with consent.

***For Clinics***

1.   **Command center dashboard:** Manage bookings, queues, and walk-ins from  a single view.
2.   **Emergency mode notifications:** Broadcast urgent messages instantly.
3.   **Smart insights:** Analytics to track patient flow, identify peak hours, and optimize staff schedules.
4.   **Voice-powered service:** Book slots, check queues, and send alerts in multiple languages — making care accessible for elderly, rural, and low-literacy patients.

***Why It Matters***

By combining real-time data, AI-driven symptom triage, and secure record management, CareQueue eliminates wasted trips, reduces patient anxiety, and maximizes clinic efficiency.

***Key Impact***

-   **Patients:** Certainty, speed, and inclusive access to care.
-   **Clinics:** Streamlined workflow, reduced administrative burden, and data-backed decision-making.

***CareQueue — because every minute matters in healthcare.***

**Challenges we ran into**

***Challenges for Patients and Their Solutions:***

**Uncertain Clinic Availability** – Patients have no reliable way to check if a clinic is open, accepting patients, or overcrowded.
**Solution:** CareQueue provides a map-first interface with live clinic status, available slots, estimated wait times, supported languages, and walk-in availability, allowing patients to make informed decisions before traveling.

**Wasted Travel Time** – Patients often visit multiple clinics before finding one with capacity.
**Solution:** GPS-based nearby clinic discovery combined with real-time slot and walk-in availability ensures that patients go directly to a clinic that can accommodate them.

**Stressful,Unpredictable Waiting**– Long queues without progress updates cause frustration.
**Solution:** Live queue tracking gives real-time position and estimated wait-time updates, available both in text and via voice assistant.

**Fragmented Medical History** – Each visit feels like starting from scratch because records are scattered.
**Solution:** Encrypted, integrated medical history keeps patient records accessible anywhere with their consent, including diagnoses, prescriptions, and lab results.

**Lack of Pre-Visit Guidance** – Patients have no quick, trustworthy advice before deciding to visit.
**Solution:** A specialist-trained AI chatbot offers safe offline triage, structured Q&A for symptom analysis, home remedy suggestions for minor issues, and doctor appointment recommendations when necessary.

***Challenges for Clinics and Their Solutions:***

**Inefficient Scheduling** – Manual queues cause bottlenecks and slow down patient flow.
**Solution:** Slot-based appointment booking with fixed capacities, automated queue arrangement, and dynamic walk-in management ensures smooth scheduling.

**Poor Communication with Waiting Patients** – Clinics cannot instantly update patients on delays or changes.
**Solution:** Real-time notifications inform patients about slot delays, emergencies, and alternative clinic options instantly.

**Emergency Disruptions** – One urgent case can derail the entire day’s schedule.
**Solution:** A one-click emergency mode alerts all waiting patients and suggests nearby clinics with available capacity.

**Lack of Actionable Insights** – Clinics struggle to forecast demand or optimize resources.
**Solution:** The admin dashboard provides analytics such as peak hours, no-show rates, and consultation times to support data-driven decision-making.

### MediConnect
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/mediconnect-b9db) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/16J8Uj-XJXazSaAui9qihJRBhw4ODFx-X) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackBuild-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackbuild.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-2-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Your Bridge Between Need and Care

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Problems MediConnect Solves

Uncertain Waiting Times
Patients often face unpredictable queues at clinics and hospitals, leading to wasted time and unnecessary stress. MediConnect provides live wait times and real-time queue tracking, reducing uncertainty.

Lack of Real-Time Doctor Availability
Patients have no reliable way to know if a doctor is available or when they can be seen. MediConnect shows instant availability and appointment slots, improving planning.

Difficulty in Finding the Right Specialist
Identifying the correct doctor for specific conditions is confusing. MediConnect offers detailed doctor profiles (specialization, qualifications, reviews), helping patients make informed choices.

Poor Communication Between Patients and Clinics
Patients often rely on phone calls or word-of-mouth for updates, which are unreliable. MediConnect adds real-time notifications, reminders, and alerts to ensure clear communication.

Overcrowding & Inefficient Patient Flow
Doctors and staff struggle to manage patient flow, causing congestion. MediConnect’s queue tokens, scheduling, and digital dashboards help regulate flow and minimize overcrowding.

Fragmented & Paper-Based Records
Patients often carry physical files and reports, risking loss or damage. MediConnect introduces MediVault, a secure digital record system where patients can upload and share files seamlessly.

Accessibility Barriers for Elderly & Less Tech-Savvy Users
Many apps overlook seniors or patients with low digital literacy. MediConnect provides an elderly-friendly interface with voice assistance, larger buttons, and simple navigation.

No Centralized Platform for Clinics
Clinics rely on scattered systems (manual registers, WhatsApp groups, outdated websites). MediConnect centralizes these into a single platform for doctors and patients.

Limited Options During Emergencies or Bad Weather
Patients may postpone visits due to rains, floods, or pandemics. MediConnect enables secure video consultations, ensuring continuous care in emergencies.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges We Faced in Coding & How We Solved Them

Integrating Two Databases (MongoDB + JDBC)

Challenge: Handling both a document-oriented database (MongoDB) for dynamic data and a relational database (via JDBC) for transactions created synchronization issues.

Solution: We divided responsibilities clearly: MongoDB for flexible patient/doctor profiles & queue updates, and Relational DB (MySQL/Postgres via JDBC) for structured appointment bookings. We wrote middleware logic in Java to keep both in sync.

Real-Time Updates Without Heavy Frameworks

Challenge: We needed instant updates (queue position, wait times) but didn’t want to depend on heavy third-party frameworks.

Solution: We implemented WebSockets / Server-Sent Events (SSE) in Java, which pushed real-time data directly to the frontend (HTML/JS). This gave us a lightweight and efficient real-time communication channel.

Handling File Uploads & Secure Sharing

Challenge: Building MediVault meant coding secure file uploads (medical reports, prescriptions) while avoiding oversized storage or data leaks.

Solution: We stored only file metadata in MongoDB, and actual files in a secured directory (or S3-like storage). For sharing, we generated time-limited encrypted links via Python utility scripts, ensuring privacy.

User Authentication & Session Management

Challenge: Patients and doctors needed different access levels, and managing sessions securely in a hackathon timeframe was tough.

Solution: We implemented JWT tokens in Java for authentication and role-based access control (patient vs. doctor). This kept the system simple but secure.

Frontend–Backend Integration

Challenge: Connecting a vanilla frontend (HTML/CSS/JS) to a Java backend while also fetching from two databases caused several bugs (API mismatches, data format issues).

Solution: We standardized all API responses in JSON format, and used consistent schema mapping so both frontend and backend stayed aligned.

**The problem it solves**

**The Problem CareQueue Solves**
Accessing local healthcare is often confusing, stressful, and inefficient for both patients and clinics:

**Patients struggle with:**
1. Not knowing which clinic is open or nearby.
2. Unclear waiting times, leading to wasted hours.
3. Difficulty finding the right doctor for their condition.
4. Language barriers and poor communication with clinic staff.

**Clinics struggle with:**
1. Managing queues manually with paper or verbal updates.
2. Handling frustrated walk-ins during peak hours.
3. Communicating real-time doctor availability.
4. Limited digital tools to serve patients efficiently.

Our Solution: **CareQueue**
CareQueue is a smart, map-based healthcare companion that connects patients with local clinics in real time.
It makes existing tasks simpler, safer, and faster by:
1. Showing nearby clinics on a live map with real-time queue status.
2. Providing doctor availability tracking so patients know who’s on duty before visiting.
3. Enabling slot booking & anonymous check-ins to reduce waiting stress.
4. Offering in-app chat between patients and clinic staff for clarity.
5. AI Health Companion – personalised advice: routines, symptom checks, nutrition tips, and self-care guidance.
6. Emergency Portal – quick doctor connect, nearest hospital alerts, and home-visit requests.
7. Electronic Health Records (EHR) – patients can securely share past reports and prescriptions with clinics.

It helps:
1. Prevent repeated tests.
2. Ensures smooth treatment if patients move cities.
3. Builds trust through safe and transparent data sharing.


What People Can Use It For
**Patients:**
1. Find the nearest clinic with the shortest wait time
2. Check which doctors are available before leaving home
3. Book appointments or request slots instantly
4. Get reliable advice on self-care through the AI health companion
5. Communicate with staff in real time (multilingual support)

**Clinics & Reception Staff:**
1. Digitally manage queues and waiting lists
2. Update doctor availability for transparency
3. Reduce overcrowding and improve patient satisfaction
4. Collect insights from dashboards to optimise operations

In short, CareQueue makes local healthcare more transparent, accessible, and stressfree for both patients and clinics, solving one of the most common but rarely addressed pain points in community healthcare.

	Fix: Switched to MapLibre + OpenStreetMap — free, open-source, and user-friendly, while preserving a smooth user experience.
2. API Requests issue
3. UI elements integration.

### Smart_Canteen
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/smartcanteen-9377) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/gauranshiyy/smart-canteen/tree/main) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/DrqVxD_l4XI) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackVerse:%20Into%20the%20Web-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackverse-into-the-web.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Less waiting. Better choices.Smarter campus dining

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![JSX](https://img.shields.io/badge/JSX-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

College canteens give students almost no information before they physically reach the counter. There's no way to know how long it'll take — so students end up standing in long queues just to find out, often only to discover the item they wanted is sold out or will take too long. This wastes the limited time students have between classes and frequently results in poor, rushed food choices.

What People Can Use It For
Browse the live menu remotely — see prices, ratings, availability, and estimated wait times before leaving for the canteen, instead of queueing blind and order before itself to not wait in the line.
Filter by what actually matters — budget, veg/non-veg preference, and category, so you only see options you'd actually order.
Get instant recommendations — type a request like "Under ₹100 • Vegetarian • Filling" and get a ranked shortlist of the top matches, powered by a transparent, explainable rule-based scoring system (not a black-box AI), so you can see why an item was recommended.
Check ratings and reviews — get a sense of food quality from other students before ordering, reducing the risk of a disappointing meal.
(For canteen staff) Use the admin panel to update menu items, mark things available/unavailable, and manage estimated wait times — keeping the information students see accurate in real time.

How It Makes Existing Tasks Easier/Safer
Saves time: Decisions happen before joining the queue, not while holding up the line — directly cutting down time lost between classes.
Keeps students on budget: Clear, filterable pricing prevents the common problem of overspending or discovering a good option was outside your budget only after waiting.
Reduces crowding: Better visibility into wait times naturally spreads demand across less-busy stalls/items instead of everyone converging on the same popular choice.
Gives canteen staff useful data: Ratings and popularity trends help staff understand what students actually want, supporting better stocking and prep decisions.
Removes guesswork and reduces food waste indirectly: Since students commit to informed choices upfront rather than switching last-minute at the counter, there's less mismatch between what's prepared and what's ordered.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the main hurdles we faced was getting the frontend and backend to communicate reliably. Initially, the application worked locally, but some features failed when accessed through the network, and we also encountered repeated “failed to fetch” errors. This made it difficult to determine whether the problem was in the frontend, backend, or the connection between them.

We solved it by debugging the system step by step instead of changing everything at once. We first verified that the backend was running correctly, then checked the API endpoints and frontend requests, and finally tested the application through the network URL. We also made sure that the frontend was using the correct backend address instead of relying on a localhost URL. This helped us isolate the issue and get the different parts of the application working together reliably.

> Transparent government -corruption free

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

GroundTruth solves municipal corruption, slow repair times, and contractor fraud by creating a transparent bridge between everyday citizens and government officials. 

Here is how it makes things easier and safer:
* **For Citizens:** Instead of ignoring neighborhood potholes, broken streetlights, or hazards, anyone can snap a quick photo using their phone. Our AI automatically turns a simple complaint into a formal legal notice in seconds.
* **For Municipalities & Workers:** It cuts out messy paperwork by putting all reports into a live dashboard. It automatically tracks strict repair deadlines (SLAs) so critical safety hazards get fixed fast.
* **Stopping Fraud:** It blocks fake or recycled repair photos using strict live-camera locks, GPS location checks, and AI image comparisons. If a contractor tries to fake a fix or misses a deadline, the system flags it and automatically handles legal penalties.

**Challenges we ran into**

While building GroundTruth, we ran into a few major hurdles:

* **Blocking Fake Photos:** Corrupt contractors tried to cheat by recycling old repair photos or uploading images from their gallery. We solved this by forcing live camera-only inputs (`capture="environment"`) and adding a "Ghost Vendor" duplicate check using perceptual image hashing (`dHash`).
* **Location Verification:** Making sure repair crews were actually standing at the exact defect site was tricky. We overcame this by extracting and parsing hidden EXIF GPS metadata from photos to enforce a strict on-site geofence radius.
* **Keeping Portals in Sync:** Keeping the citizen reporting side and municipal command dashboard instantly synchronized without delays was tough. We resolved this by leveraging Firebase Firestore for real-time cloud data updates and automated SLA countdown trackers.

### Triage
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/triage-2671) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/ilakkiyasuresh/Triage) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wtob08nC0CI) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackVerse:%20Into%20the%20Web-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackverse-into-the-web.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> "Stopping malware before it even gets an answer."

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Zeek/PCAP](https://img.shields.io/badge/Zeek/PCAP-333333?style=flat-square)

**Challenges we ran into**

Our DGA detector's rarity scoring broke when we scaled its training corpus from 150 to 10,000 domains — the original "never seen before = rare" check worked by accident on a tiny corpus but silently stopped flagging anything once the bigger corpus had seen nearly every letter pair at least once. We caught it by re-testing known-bad domains and fixed it with percentile-rank scoring plus a keyboard-adjacency signal. Separately, since the resolver, DoH server, and dashboard run as separate processes, their in-memory state can drift apart — we found a real bug where the Tunneling Radar showed a different score than the resolver actually used, caused by two copies of the same sliding-window logic disagreeing on the window size. Merging an independently-built frontend with our backend also meant fixing a mismatched API contract (wrong table names, missing env vars) before real data would render. We also learned that a fully public "everything live" deployment needs a real cloud VM, not a serverless platform, since a raw UDP DNS resolver can't run on serverless infrastructure.

**The problem it solves**

Most DNS filtering only blocks domains after a human has already flagged them — too slow for botnets that generate thousands of disposable domains algorithmically (DGAs), or for DNS tunneling, which hides data exfiltration inside traffic that looks harmless one query at a time. This project blocks known-bad domains instantly using a real ~49,600-domain threat-intel blacklist, catches previously-unseen DGA domains through character-level scoring rather than waiting for a manual blacklist update, and detects tunneling by watching per-source-IP query patterns instead of trusting any single query. It covers DNS-over-UDP, DoH, and DoDTLS, plus offline PCAP/Zeek analysis, while staying fast enough (sub-100ms, cache-backed) to actually work as a real resolver.

**The problem it solves**

Autistic adults face high unemployment (50–85%), social isolation (79%), and difficulty transferring clinic‑learned skills into real‑world contexts.
Current therapy approaches (role‑play, weekly social groups) are too safe, too low‑pressure, and not realistic enough — they don’t replicate unpredictable strangers, ambient noise, or time pressure.

NeuroPractice VR bridges this “generalization gap” by offering therapist‑controlled, repeatable, graded exposure in realistic VR scenarios (job interviews, restaurant ordering, conflict conversations).

**Challenges we ran into**

Building within a hackathon window meant balancing ambition vs. feasibility:

*NPC Dialogue Complexity: Designing branching dialogue trees that felt unscripted but still hackathon‑ready was tricky.

Therapist Dashboard Sync: Making the difficulty slider actually change NPC behavior in real time required careful state management between Unity (VR client) and React (dashboard).

WebXR Fallback: Ensuring judges without a headset could still demo the scenario meant implementing a browser‑based fallback, which introduced compatibility quirks.*

**Specific Bug / Hurdle**
*One major hurdle was real‑time difficulty adjustment:

Initially, the slider changes on the therapist dashboard weren’t reflected in the VR client — NPCs stayed “stuck” at their initial difficulty.

Root cause: Firebase session state wasn’t updating fast enough, so Unity wasn’t receiving the new difficulty tier before the dialogue advanced.*

How We Overcame It
*We implemented a lightweight WebSocket channel for instant updates, bypassing Firebase’s delay.

Added a “sync confirmation” on the dashboard so therapists could see when the VR client acknowledged the change.

This fix not only solved the bug but also made the demo feel smoother and more professional.*

### Aura-Shield
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/aurashield-3e67) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/pritam26-arch/Aura-Shield) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HyperFusion-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hyperfusion.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Your silent guardian—always active, even offline.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**Challenges we ran into**

1. The "Dead Device" Architecture Dilemma
The Hurdle: The fundamental flaw in our initial design was relying entirely on the client-side app to trigger an SOS. If an attacker snatched the phone and enabled Airplane Mode or powered it down, the React frontend was rendered useless, and no alert could be sent to our Node.js backend.
The Fix: We completely inverted the logic by building a server-side "Dead Man's Switch." We implemented a Heartbeat Protocol using Socket.io and an in-memory Map() on the Node.js server. The frontend now emits a silent ping every 10 seconds. We set up a setInterval watchdog on the server to monitor these pings; if a user's heartbeat abruptly stops for more than 30 seconds, the server automatically generates a Red Alert and broadcasts the last known GPS coordinates to emergency contacts.
2. Asynchronous State & Context Crashes
The Hurdle: While building the active monitoring dashboard, the Vite compiler continuously threw import-analysis and rendering errors. If the UserContext hadn't fully loaded the user's saved permissions (mic, location) or trips, the app would crash attempting to map over undefined arrays.
The Fix: We implemented safe destructuring with fallback values (e.g., const { contacts = [], permissions = { location: false } } = useUser?.() || {};) across our React components. This ensured the Glassmorphism UI could still render a skeleton or default state while waiting for the MongoDB data to resolve.
3. Version Control & Routing Collisions
The Hurdle: As our team rapidly integrated backend logic with frontend UI, we ran into severe Git merge conflicts. A major issue occurred when collaborative route updates in App.jsx completely overwrote our main Landing Page, routing users directly to an unstyled dashboard and breaking our component hierarchy.
The Fix: We utilized Git stashing (git stash -> git pull -> git stash pop) to safely merge incoming backend routes without destroying the UI. We then restructured our React Router architecture, clearly decoupling the public Landing.jsx from the protected Dashboard.jsx, and added catch-all Navigate routes to ensure broken links safely redirected users back to the home screen.
4. Perfecting the Glassmorphism UI on Mobile vs. Web
The Hurdle: When converting our mobile-first login and dashboard screens to a responsive web layout, the Tailwind UI components began stretching uncontrollably. The translucent backgrounds (backdrop-blur) either completely blacked out the background image or made the text illegible.
The Fix: We locked the core interactive components inside strict max-w-md containers for forms, while using a grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 layout for the main dashboard. We finely tuned the z-index layers and used bg-[#0B071E]/80 overlays to achieve a premium, readable glass effect without losing the underlying aesthetic.

**The problem it solves**

Traditional safety applications rely on a critical flaw: they assume a victim has the time, physical freedom, and active internet connectivity to press an SOS button during an emergency. Aura-Shield shifts personal safety from reactive button-pressing to proactive, automated monitoring using zero-touch sensor triggers and cloud-backed intelligence.
Core Use Cases
Late-Night Commutes: Users traveling alone can activate a silent monitoring mode that tracks their route securely in real-time without drawing attention.
Low-Network Zones: Navigating underground parking lots or remote areas where standard data connections frequently drop.
High-Risk Encounters: Situations where pulling out a phone to dial the police is impossible or would escalate the attacker's aggression.
How It Makes Safety Foolproof
The "Dead Man's Switch" (Server-Side Monitoring): If an attacker snatches the phone and powers it off or enables Airplane Mode, the backend server detects the abrupt loss of the device's "heartbeat" ping. It automatically broadcasts a Red Alert with the last known location to emergency contacts, ensuring that the absence of a signal is the signal.
Offline SMS Fallback: If an emergency is triggered but the internet connection is lost, the frontend bypasses web protocols and instantly initiates a native SMS sequence pre-loaded with the victim's exact GPS coordinates.
Tamper-Proof Evidence Locking: Potential threat audio is processed and streamed directly to cloud storage. Even if the physical device is completely destroyed by an attacker, the encrypted evidence remains locked and accessible for law enforcement.
Aura-Shield vs. Traditional Safety Apps

> Speak Without Fear. Prove Without Doubt

![Firebase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![React.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/React.js-333333?style=flat-square)

**Challenges we ran into**

# Engineering Challenges in Building KAVACH

Building **KAVACH** required solving complex technical hurdles at the intersection of client-side cryptography, multi-modal data normalization, zero-server-knowledge cloud storage, and automated statutory legal compliance.

---

### 1. Dual-Level Client-Side Envelope Encryption & Key Recovery
* **The Trilemma:** Ensuring zero-server-knowledge cloud confidentiality, eliminating the risk of permanent evidence loss if a distressed victim misplaces their key, and avoiding central server master keys.
* **The Technical Solution:** A two-tier browser-native envelope architecture implemented via the W3C WebCrypto API:
  1. **Payload Encryption (DEK):** An ephemeral 16-character alphanumeric Data Encryption Key (DEK) is generated via CSPRNG (`window.crypto.getRandomValues`), digested using SHA-256 into a 256-bit AES-GCM key, and used to encrypt the evidence payload with a 12-byte initialization vector (IV).
  2. **Deterministic Institutional Wrapping (KEK):** An institutional Key Encryption Key (KEK) is deterministically derived from the tenant domain string (`sit.ac.in`) using PBKDF2 (100,000 iterations, HMAC-SHA256, tenant salt). The DEK is encrypted under the KEK with a second 12-byte IV to produce a wrapped envelope (`wrappedKeyBase64`).
* **Result:** The cloud database (`Firestore`) stores strictly opaque ciphertext and wrapped envelopes. Authorized institutional reviewers can automatically re-derive the KEK in browser memory to unwrap and decrypt case files.

---

### 2. Multi-Modal Ingestion, OCR Latency & Fallbacks
* **Heterogeneous Text Parsing:** Platform-specific WhatsApp exports across iOS and Android feature differing regex header delimiters, 12h/24h timestamps, and multi-line chat bubbles. A stateful parser was built to extract records and filter out platform encryption banners.
* **Vision LLM Latency & Resilience:** Processing mobile screenshot images via multimodal LLMs over HTTPS introduces network latency and rate limits. The system enforces an aggressive 25-second execution timeout paired with a deterministic fallback mechanism to prevent client workflow interruptions.

---

### 3. In-Memory Temporal Fusion & Deduplication
* **Cross-Source Collisions:** Complainants frequently submit both raw chat exports (`.txt`) and graphical screenshots covering identical conversations.
* **Solution:** Disparate timestamp strings are normalized into uniform 64-bit Unix epoch milliseconds. An in-memory hash map keyed on `item.messageContent.trim().toLowerCase() + item.timestamp` eliminates overlapping duplicate messages before ordering the timeline chronologically.

---

### 4. Pre-Encryption Lexical Screening & Victim Verification
* **In-Memory Abuse Tagging:** To flag harassment without transmitting plaintext data to backend servers, the engine executes client-side lexical keyword screening directly in browser memory before encryption. Flagged items are visually highlighted for complainant review and confirmation prior to irreversible cryptographic sealing.

---

### 5. Administrative Recovery Fallbacks & Constrained Legal Synthesis
* **Graceful Decryption Fallback:** If automated KEK unwrapping fails or a legacy record lacks an envelope, an administrative modal dialog allows manual entry of the victim’s 16-character key.
* **Statutory Compliance Extraction:** Passing decrypted evidence to an LLM under strict JSON schema constraints maps interactions to Section 2(n) and Section 3(2) of the Indian POSH Act, 2013, calculating calibrated 1–10 incident severity scores with a local cryptographic integrity verification tag.

**The problem it solves**

# KAVACH: System Overview & Technical Reference

**KAVACH** is a privacy-preserving digital forensics and automated compliance system designed to solve digital evidence fragmentation, cloud privacy vulnerabilities, and legal reporting latency under statutory frameworks such as the Indian Prevention of Sexual Harassment at Workplace (POSH) Act, 2013.

---

### 1. Three-Tier Runtime Architecture
1. **Complainant Browser Sandbox:** Ingests raw multi-modal artifacts, normalizes timestamps, executes pre-encryption abuse screening, and cryptographically seals payloads in client memory.
2. **Zero-Server-Knowledge Cloud Storage (Firestore):** Stores only Base64-encoded AES-GCM ciphertexts, initialization vectors, and wrapped key envelopes without holding plaintext records or master keys.
3. **Administrator Browser Sandbox:** Retrieves encrypted logs, executes automated in-browser key unwrapping, decrypts payloads in local memory, and invokes a constrained LLM pipeline to synthesize statutory POSH compliance dossiers.

---

### 2. Multi-Modal Ingestion & Chronological Fusion
* **Text Export Parsing:** An in-browser regex parser extracts messages, handles multi-line communications, and strips platform status notices from iOS and Android WhatsApp exports.
* **Multimodal Vision OCR:** Screenshot captures are converted to Base64 and processed via Google Gemini 3.6 Flash (temperature 0.1, 25s timeout) to extract structured JSON entries, backed by a deterministic mock fallback for execution resilience.
* **In-Memory Fusion & Deduplication:** Message timestamps are converted to 64-bit Unix epoch milliseconds. An in-memory JavaScript Map keyed on message content and timestamp eliminates duplicate entries across overlapping text dumps and screenshots.

---

### 3. Client Envelope Encryption & Deterministic Key Wrapping
* **Data Encryption Key (DEK):** Generated via WebCrypto CSPRNG as a 16-character alphanumeric key, digested via SHA-256 into a 256-bit AES-GCM key, and used to encrypt the payload with a random 12-byte initialization vector.
* **Institutional Key Encryption Key (KEK):** Derived deterministically from the tenant domain string (e.g., `sit.ac.in`) using PBKDF2 (100,000 iterations, HMAC-SHA256, tenant-specific salt).
* **Envelope Wrapping:** The DEK is encrypted under the KEK using AES-GCM with a second 12-byte IV to form a wrapped key envelope. This guarantees zero-knowledge cloud confidentiality while enabling seamless institutional recovery without manual key transfer by the victim.

---

### 4. In-Browser POSH Legal Synthesis & Presentation
* **Automated Decryption:** The administrator sandbox re-derives the KEK, unwraps the DEK, and decrypts the payload directly in browser memory (with a 16-character manual fallback modal).
* **Statutory Compliance LLM:** Decrypted logs are evaluated by Gemini 3.6 Flash under strict prompt constraints to classify misconduct under Section 2(n) and Section 3(2) of the POSH Act, assign numerical severity ratings (1–10 scale), and append a local cryptographic integrity verification stamp.
* **Dual-Tab UI:** Renders an official letterhead legal compliance report with print styling alongside an interactive chronological raw evidence stream.

**Challenges we ran into**

## Challenges We Ran Into

**1. Native dependency compilation failure (SQLite)**
Our first backend design used SQLite (`better-sqlite3`) for storage. On 
setup, `npm install` failed with a Visual Studio Build Tools error — the 
package needs a C++ compiler to build native bindings, which isn't installed 
by default on most Windows machines. This wasn't just our problem either: 
any judge or teammate testing the project locally would hit the exact same 
wall.

*Fix:* We swapped SQLite for a plain JSON-file-based store instead. It's a 
deliberate trade-off — less "production database," but zero native 
dependencies, meaning `npm install` works identically and instantly on any 
machine, judges' laptops included. For an MVP at this scale, that 
reliability mattered more than SQL.

**2. `.ics` calendar files silently corrupting special characters**
When we built the calendar-export feature, deadlines exported fine, but 
descriptions containing commas (e.g. "₹1,000–5,000/month") or embedded line 
breaks weren't rendering correctly in calendar apps — we were escaping 
special characters *after* joining strings together instead of before, 
which double-escaped some characters and broke others.

*Fix:* We restructured the escaping to happen per-field, before joining, and 
validated the output against a real iCalendar parser (Python's `icalendar` 
library) rather than just eyeballing the text — which caught the bug 
immediately and confirmed the fix.

**3. All-day event date math (off-by-one)**
Early versions of our calendar export had deadline events disappearing a day 
early in some calendar apps. The iCalendar spec treats `DTEND` as 
*exclusive* for all-day events — so an event ending "on" October 31st 
actually needs `DTEND` set to November 1st, not October 31st itself. Easy 
to miss, since it silently produces a wrong-but-plausible-looking result.

*Fix:* Added explicit UTC-based date math to compute the correct exclusive 
end date, and re-verified with the same parser-based testing approach.

**4. Nested folder structures breaking deployment**
When deploying to GitHub Pages and Render, our repo ended up with the 
project nested two folders deep (an artifact of how zip extraction and 
`git mv` interacted), which made Render unable to find our `backend` 
directory and caused a failed first deploy.

*Fix:* Used `git mv` to flatten the structure so `backend` and `docs` sit 
directly at the repo root, matching what both GitHub Pages and Render 
expect by convention — a good reminder that deployment platforms are 
opinionated about repo layout, and it's worth checking that early rather 
than after a failed build.

**What this taught us:** most of our real bugs weren't in the "smart" parts 
of the project (the matching logic worked correctly from early on) — they 
were in the unglamorous plumbing: dependency management, spec-compliant file 
formats, and deployment conventions. Validating against real parsers and 
testing on a clean environment (not just "it works on my machine") caught 
issues that manual testing alone would have missed.

**The problem it solves**

**The Problem It Solves**

In India, hundreds of scholarships and government financial schemes exist — 
Post-Matric Scholarships, state-level schemes like SVMCM and Aikyashree, 
AICTE's Pragati and Saksham, minority fellowships, disability grants, and more. 
But this information is scattered across dozens of disconnected portals 
(NSP, AICTE, state welfare sites), each with different, often confusing 
eligibility rules — income ceilings, category reservations, state domicile, 
education level, and more, all stacked together.

The result: **students who are genuinely eligible never find out these 
schemes exist**, or give up halfway through figuring out whether they 
qualify. Awareness, not availability, is the real bottleneck.

 **What People Can Use It For**

- **Find every scheme you're actually eligible for, in one place** — enter 
  your profile once (income, category, gender, state, education level, 
  disability/minority status), and get a ranked list of matching scholarships 
  and government schemes, instead of manually cross-checking dozens of 
  portals one by one.
- **Understand *why* you matched** — every result comes with a plain-English 
  explanation (e.g. "State scheme for West Bengal," "Open to your category"), 
  so it's not a black-box recommendation — you can see and verify the logic 
  yourself.
- **Never lose track of a deadline** — export any scheme's deadline directly 
  to your calendar (Google, Outlook, Apple) with a built-in reminder, either 
  one at a time or in bulk for everything you've matched or are tracking.
- **Track your applications end-to-end** — once you apply, move it through 
  Applied → Under Review → Sanctioned → Amount Credited with one tap, so you 
  always know the status of everything you've applied to, in one dashboard.
- **Learn from other applicants** — ask questions or read crowdsourced tips 
  under each scheme (e.g. "does this cover B.Tech students?", "apply early, 
  the portal slows down near the deadline") from people who've actually gone 
  through the process.

## How It Makes This Easier and Safer

- **Easier:** replaces manual searching across dozens of portals with one 
  structured profile lookup — what used to take hours of cross-referencing 
  eligibility PDFs now takes under a minute.
- **Safer:** eligibility is checked using transparent, rule-based logic — 
  not a black-box model — so results are explainable and verifiable, not 
  just "trust the algorithm."
- **More reliable:** deadline reminders and a persistent application tracker 
  reduce the chance of a genuinely eligible student missing out simply 
  because they lost track of a date or forgot which portal an application 
  was on.
