![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Mapbox](https://img.shields.io/badge/Mapbox-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![mongoose](https://img.shields.io/badge/mongoose-333333?style=flat-square) ![Mapbox API](https://img.shields.io/badge/Mapbox%20API-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/20d0bfe38c454ba7a356e4d8a3bb216a/78487125-0dee-4ef3-b80d-9334532dd168.png)


**FreightIQ** is a web-platform designed to combat the logistics industry's "deadheading" crisis—where trucks return empty after deliveries, leading to wasted fuel and lost revenue. It serves as a digital bridge between shippers and drivers, using real-time connectivity to ensure vehicles are always moving with a load.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/20d0bfe38c454ba7a356e4d8a3bb216a/b8f43eae-7105-4c24-abbb-828385ccabc9.png)



**Key Utilities:**

* **Guaranteed Revenue:** The platform uses "Smart Matching" to identify and assign return loads to drivers, ensuring that both drivers and shippers retain the full value of the deal and minimize empty miles.
* **Operational Velocity:** By automating the dispatch process and prioritizing urgent loads, FreightIQ reduces idle time and speeds up the entire logistics workflow.
* **Ironclad Security (Digital Handshake):** To solve payment disputes and fraud, the system implements a "Digital Handshake." Shippers and Receivers scan QR codes at pickup and drop-off points to verify identity and instantly release payments, ensuring a trust-free, secure transaction.
* **Strategic Market Intelligence:** The platform provides pricing and demand visibility, empowering fleet owners to make strategic decisions based on data rather than intuition.

**Challenges we ran into**

**1. Real-Time Transaction Synchronization**
Implementing the "Digital Handshake" feature required instant communication between the driver's app and the shipper's dashboard. When a QR code is scanned, the system needs to update the shipment status immediately to release payments.
* **Solution:** We built a real-time socket architecture using `Socket.io` implementing live status updates (like Pickup or Drop-off) that is pushed instantly to all parties without requiring a page refresh.

**2. Adopting a Next-Gen Tech Stack (Bun & Astro)**
To ensure the platform is lightweight and high-performance, We chose to use **Bun** for the backend runtime and **Astro** for the frontend. While efficient, this newer stack posed integration challenges compared to traditional Node.js setups.
* **Solution:** We leveraged Bun's fast package manager and built-in TypeScript support to streamline development. For the frontend, we also utilized Astro's component architecture to build a highly responsive UI that integrates seamless forms for complex tasks like "Shipment Creation" and "Driver Onboarding".

**3. Complex State Management for Logistics**
Modeling the lifecycle of a shipment—from "Creation" to " acceptance," "Pickup," and "Proof of Delivery"—was complex due to the strict validation required at each step.
* **Solution:** We designed a robust data model in TypeScript that strictly defines the shipment states and user roles (Driver vs. Shipper). This ensures that valid state transitions (e.g., a driver cannot "deliver" a load before "picking it up") are enforced at the API level.

**Requestly**

Requestly fits in as a Backend API testing to verify and check if all server requests are working properly and without any software bugs and exploitation.

### GarmAI
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/garmai-899c) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/sreeshanthsai10/GarmAI-Garment-Productivity-Prediction-System.git) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://drive.google.com/file/d/19sxPnI2hM79cQuhAXL9mjD4dHvXy778R/view?usp=drivesdk) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/3RpbXNm-_dY) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-CodeQuest%202025-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://codequest-2025.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> AI-powered garment efficiency insights

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Machine Learning](https://img.shields.io/badge/Machine%20Learning-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Jinja2](https://img.shields.io/badge/Jinja2-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

GarmAI solves the problem of understanding and predicting productivity in garment manufacturing, where performance depends on many factors working together. In real production environments, supervisors and managers often estimate productivity based on experience or manual calculations, which can be inaccurate, time-consuming, and inconsistent. Important issues like high idle time, frequent style changes, or inefficient workforce allocation may not be noticed until productivity drops.

GarmAI makes this easier by using an AI model to analyze all key production inputs at once and predict productivity instantly. Instead of manually checking multiple variables, users can enter daily production details and get a clear productivity score along with a simple classification such as low, medium, or high. This helps managers quickly understand how well a production line is performing.

The application can be used for daily productivity monitoring, production planning, and decision-making. It allows users to test different scenarios, such as reducing idle time or adjusting incentives, and see how those changes might affect productivity before implementing them on the shop floor. By providing quick, data-driven insights, GarmAI reduces manual effort, improves accuracy, and supports better operational decisions in garment factories.

**Challenges we ran into**

While building GarmAI, one of the main challenges was handling data preprocessing consistently between the training phase and the web application. The machine learning model was trained using one-hot encoded categorical variables, and during early testing the app produced incorrect or failed predictions because the input feature order did not exactly match the model’s training features. This was resolved by saving the original feature list during training and reindexing the processed input data to that exact structure before making predictions.

Another major hurdle was managing template errors and layout inheritance in Flask using Jinja2. Issues such as defining the same block multiple times, missing variables like now(), and conflicting template logic caused runtime errors and page crashes. These problems were fixed by carefully organizing the base template, ensuring each block was defined only once, and passing all required variables explicitly from the backend.

Client-side behavior also introduced challenges, especially with form validation and autofill logic. At one point, the prediction form auto-filled values automatically without user interaction, which was not intended. This was corrected by separating autofill logic from page load and triggering it only through a dedicated button click event. Styling modern UI elements such as dropdowns, input focus states, and animated score indicators was another difficulty. Native browser styles caused unwanted white backgrounds and inconsistent behavior across elements. Custom CSS overrides were applied to ensure a consistent dark theme and smooth user experience.

Overall, these challenges helped improve the robustness of the application. By debugging step by step, aligning data pipelines, and refining both backend and frontend logic, the project evolved into a stable, user-friendly, and reliable AI-based productivity prediction system.

[Sreeshanth Sai](https://github.com/sreeshanthsai10)

### ROOMii
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/roomii-4817) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Shivanshdarji/ROOMii) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/kkP5SeNNWKY) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-CodeQuest%202025-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://codequest-2025.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Because you deserve to be Heard!!

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![TensorFlow](https://img.shields.io/badge/TensorFlow-333333?style=flat-square) ![OpenCV](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenCV-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Three.JS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Three.JS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Speech API](https://img.shields.io/badge/Speech%20API-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

In today’s fast-moving digital world, many people work, study, and live in isolated environments — often spending long hours behind screens without emotional connection or support.
While virtual assistants exist, most of them feel robotic, emotionless, and disconnected from the user's mental state. They provide answers — but they don’t feel the user’s mood, stress, or energy.

As a result, people increasingly experience loneliness, lack of motivation, burnout, and emotional fatigue — especially students, remote workers, and individuals who spend a lot of time alone.

ROOMii solves this problem by creating an emotionally intelligent AI companion that doesn’t just process commands — it understands how you feel.

Everyone's individual character is saved and ROOMii is as same as YOU!! And the thing is IT changes according to people and people's Situations and Emotions!!

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/c0051e54e58e4819addb4626f90d9271/686998fd-8adf-4fef-bbd5-60f755c2f7c3.png)

**Challenges we ran into**

While building ROOMii, I ran into quite a few unexpected challenges that really pushed me to think differently. Getting real-time emotion detection to work smoothly was tough at first — the camera feed kept lagging because the model was analyzing every frame. I fixed it by caching emotions for a few seconds, which made the performance much faster. Synchronizing AI replies with voice output was another struggle; ROOMii would sometimes interrupt itself or speak over previous messages. I restructured the backend so it waits for the AI’s full response before generating audio and added a stop button to instantly cancel playback if the user speaks again. These small details made ROOMii feel more natural and human.

Another major challenge was making the 3D model expressive and responsive. The model initially faced the wrong direction, and those text-style faces like ^_^ looked odd in 3D. I fixed this by reorienting the model, adding glowing eyes that change color with mood, and introducing breathing and idle animations for realism. I also dealt with voice API limits and local audio clutter — ROOMii now auto-deletes old files and falls back to backup voices if an API fails. Balancing AI logic, live emotion tracking, and smooth visuals wasn’t easy, but seeing ROOMii respond calmly, emotionally, and in real time made it all worth it.
We are still in devlopment phase, so accuracy will be increased soonn!!!

[Shivansh Darji](https://github.com/Shivanshdarji)

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![OpenCV](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenCV-333333?style=flat-square) ![Git](https://img.shields.io/badge/Git-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

🚀 **The Problem AttendEase Solves**

**AttendEase** is a smart attendance management web app designed to remove the pain of traditional attendance systems and make the process **faster, smarter, and more engaging** for everyone involved.

---

### 👩‍🏫 For Teachers
- ✍️ Manual + camera-based attendance — no more paper registers  
- 📅 View upcoming classes and assigned students in one place  
- 📊 Easy attendance tracking & lecture-wise reports  
- 🧾 Eliminates messy records and long-term data loss  
- 📨 **Leave management system**:
  - Receive student leave requests online  
  - Accept or reject leave with a single click  
  - Leave status automatically reflected in attendance  

➡️ *Teachers can focus more on teaching, not paperwork.*

---

### 🎓 For Students
- 🕒 Access class timetable and lecture-wise attendance anytime  
- ⚠️ Smart attendance scheduler suggests which lectures to attend to cover shortages  
- 📨 **Online leave application**:
  - Apply for leave from anywhere  
  - Track approval or rejection status in real time  
- 🏆 Gamified system to increase motivation:
  - 🔥 Attendance streaks  
  - 🪙 In-app coins for attending lectures  
  - 🏅 Class-wise & institute-wise leaderboards  
  - 🎨 Custom banners & profiles for consistent attendance  

➡️ *No more manual leave letters — everything stays digital and organized.*

---

### 👨‍👩‍👧 For Parents
- 👀 Real-time visibility of their child’s attendance  
- 📖 Track lecture-wise records instead of waiting for reports  
- 🤝 Improves transparency and parent-teacher trust  

---

### 💡 Why AttendEase Matters
- ❌ Solves manual and time-consuming attendance problems  
- ✅ Reduces absenteeism using data + motivation  
- 🔒 Keeps attendance organized, transparent, and reliable  
- 🚀 Built with a student-friendly mindset, not just admin needs  

**AttendEase doesn’t just mark attendance — it improves discipline, engagement, and accountability in a smart way.**

**Challenges we ran into**

### ⚠️ Challenges I Ran Into

- 🧠 **Building without a finalized AI model**  
  Since the project is currently a **prototype with demo data**, designing camera-based attendance without a trained model was challenging.  
  👉 I handled this by creating a **modular design**, so the real model can be plugged in later without changing the full system.

- 🧩 **Designing realistic flows using demo data**  
  Making the app feel real without live institute data required careful planning.  
  👉 I used **mock datasets** that closely represent real classrooms to validate the workflow and user experience.

- 🔐 **Role-based access for three user types**  
  Handling teachers, students, and parents in one system was complex even at the prototype stage.  
  👉 Solved it by clearly separating interfaces and permissions from the beginning.

- 🎮 **Gamification logic without production data**  
  Implementing streaks, coins, and leaderboards without real attendance trends was tricky.  
  👉 I focused on **logical rules and scalable reward systems** that can adapt once real data is available.

- 🚧 **Balancing scope within hackathon time**  
  Building features while keeping it demo-ready was a major hurdle.  
  👉 I prioritized **core functionality and UX**, leaving advanced AI optimization for future versions.

---

These challenges helped me focus on **clean architecture, scalability, and future readiness**, even at the prototype stage.

Team **Hackynx** -- Isha Nagare, Riya Bhandari, [Sumit Sonawane](https://github.com/NA), Hassan Shah

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Deep Learning](https://img.shields.io/badge/Deep%20Learning-333333?style=flat-square) ![Git](https://img.shields.io/badge/Git-333333?style=flat-square) ![Blender](https://img.shields.io/badge/Blender-333333?style=flat-square) ![Twilio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Twilio-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Car ownership today is reactive—we wait for a "Check Engine" light or a breakdown before taking action. Even when a warning appears, the cryptic OBD-II codes (like P0217) leave most drivers confused and anxious.

GLYTCH AutoSync transforms vehicle maintenance into a Proactive & Intelligent experience:

- Demystifies Diagnostics: Instantly translates complex engine codes into plain     English voice alerts and actionable advice using AI.

- Predicts the Future: Instead of guessing, our Neural Network analyzes vehicle age, mileage, and history to calculate the exact probability of failure before it happens.

- Automates the Boring Stuff: Detects a critical fault? The system automatically finds an open slot at the service center and books it for you instantly.

- Digital Twin Visibility: A real-time 3D visualization of the car lets users see their vehicle's status at a glance—turning dry data into an immersive command center.

**Challenges we ran into**

Building a real-time system that listens, thinks, and predicts simultaneously wasn't easy. Here are the biggest hurdles we overcame:

1. The "Laggy" 3D Twin:

- Hurdle: Rendering a high-quality 3D car model alongside high-frequency WebSocket data updates caused the browser to freeze.

- Solution: We optimized the rendering pipeline by disabling expensive shadow calculations and implementing React.memo to prevent re-rendering the 3D canvas every time the RPM changed.

2. The Overconfident AI:

- Hurdle: Our initial Predictive Maintenance model was too good—it memorized the synthetic data and only outputted 0% or 100% risk, which isn't realistic.

- Solution: We rebuilt the neural network with a "softer" architecture, introducing Dropout layers and reducing neuron count to force the AI to learn general trends rather than hard rules.

- Dependency Hell (Keras vs. Transformers):

- Hurdle: Integrating the latest TensorFlow with HuggingFace transformers caused a version conflict that crashed the backend immediately.

- Solution: We identified the root cause (Keras 3 incompatibility) and implemented the tf-keras legacy bridge to allow both state-of-the-art libraries to coexist peacefully.

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/bhartiya-early-warning-system-aebf) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Shihab-khan55/Bhartiya-Early-Warning-System.git) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/c_Hop9FAW3I?feature=shared) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Technocrats%20Hackathon-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://technocrats-hackathon.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Space Technology

![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-333333?style=flat-square) ![C++](https://img.shields.io/badge/C++-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![C](https://img.shields.io/badge/C-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The Bharatiya Early Warning System, Chaitanya, solves a critical limitation in current space-radiation monitoring systems, which rely on transmitting sensor data back to Earth for processing—resulting in dangerous delays that can jeopardize astronauts, satellites, and deep-space missions. Traditional warnings often arrive too late, especially during fast-moving solar radiation bursts. Chaitanya eliminates this delay by enabling the world’s first direct mission-to-mission radiation alerting network, allowing spacecraft within the affected region to receive instant warnings without any Earth involvement. Using onboard radiation sensors, AI-driven analysis, and Delay Tolerant Networking (DTN), the system detects the direction, intensity, and velocity of hazardous radiation in real time, giving missions immediate response capability. This makes space operations significantly safer by reducing dependency on ground stations, improving reaction time, protecting sensitive electronics, and enhancing overall mission continuity—positioning it as India’s first indigenous deep-space radiation alerting software.

**Challenges we ran into**

While building Chaitanya, one of the major challenges we faced was ensuring reliable communication between satellites using Delay Tolerant Networking (DTN), especially in simulated deep-space conditions where connectivity is intermittent. Integrating real-time radiation sensor data with the onboard AI model also proved difficult, as even minor delays in processing could affect the accuracy of predicting the radiation’s direction, intensity, and velocity. Another hurdle was optimizing the system to run efficiently on the Vikram-32 semiconductor chip, which required careful memory management and C/C++ optimization to prevent performance bottlenecks. Debugging these issues took time, but we overcame them by creating multiple test environments, fine-tuning the AI model, and iteratively validating the DTN protocol under different stress conditions. This helped us achieve a stable, high-precision early-warning system capable of sending instant mission-to-mission alerts without Earth’s involvement.

**The problem it solves**

Project Name: AI Health Companion
Problem:
After being discharged from hospitals, patients often struggle to follow handwritten or digital prescriptions correctly.
Confusing medication names, unclear timings, and lack of guidance lead to missed doses and poor adherence.
In India’s fragmented outpatient care system, most patients rely solely on memory or family reminders — increasing the risk of health complications and unnecessary readmissions.
Solution:
MedConnect Agent is an AI-powered health companion that simplifies post-discharge care.
It allows patients to upload any prescription (photo, scanned copy, or PDF).
Using Google’s Gemini API, the system intelligently reads, understands, and explains the prescription in simple language, while automatically creating personalized medication reminders, follow-ups, and alerts.
The AI agent acts like a digital nurse — proactive, adaptive to ensure recovery continues smoothly even after hospital discharge.

Core Features:
AI Prescription Reader:
Upload any prescription — image, PDF, or handwritten note.
Gemini Vision extracts medicine names, dosages, timings, and duration using OCR + AI understanding.

Personalized Health Guidance:Gemini-based conversational agent explains each medicine, its purpose, and precautions in easy terms.
Provides real-time reminders and gentle follow-ups for missed doses.
Smart Health Dashboard Summarizes patient progress, dosage adherence, and follow-up schedules.

Impact:
Reduces hospital readmissions and complications.
Ensures continuous, personalized recovery support.
Improves patient adherence, engagement, and satisfaction.
Enables medical staff to monitor patients remotely and intervene proactively.
Why It Stands Out:
This project combines cutting-edge AI, cross-platform technology, and real-world healthcare integration. It addresses a critical problem with practical, scalable, and socially impactful solutions. By merging intelligent agent orchestration with seamless mobile accessibility, AI Health Companion enhances patient recovery while demonstrating the power of AI to improve healthcare outcomes.

**The problem it solves**

## 🧠 The Problem JobPulse AI Solves

Millions of job seekers apply blindly without understanding:

- 🔍 **How well they fit a job**
- 📉 **Where they lack skills**
- 💼 **What roles suit their profile best**
- 📊 **How they stand against other applicants**
- ⏱️ **Which opportunities are worth their time**

Traditional job platforms only show job listings — not insights.  
As a result, job seekers waste hours applying to roles they aren’t fit for, receive rejections without clarity, and struggle to make informed decisions in a competitive job market.

**JobPulse AI transforms job applications into a data-driven experience — helping candidates apply smarter, not harder.**

**Challenges we ran into**

## 🧩 Challenges I Ran Into

As a first-time builder, building JobPulse AI wasn’t just about matching jobs to applicants — it required solving some deep technical and UX challenges:

### 🔐 1) Getting Access to Clean, Real-World Job Data
Most platforms don’t provide structured or public APIs.  
Collecting listings, parsing them, and cleaning messy job descriptions took significant effort.

### 🧠 2) Extracting Skills & Requirements Accurately
Job descriptions are inconsistent.  
Making the AI understand **required skills, experience, and domain-specific terminology** demanded:
- NLP-based skill extraction
- Custom entity parsing
- Fine-tuning models for hiring language

### 📌 3) Mapping Candidate Profiles to Job Needs
Aligning a user’s résumé to job expectations wasn’t straightforward.  
It required skills normalization, scoring logic, and relevance weighting to avoid inaccurate matches.

### ⚖️ 4) Designing a Fair Job-Fit Scoring System
A scoring system should be:
- Transparent
- Skill-based (not biased)
- Helpful instead of discouraging  
Balancing these factors was a challenge.

### ⚙️ 5) Real-Time Recommendations With Low Latency
Generating personalized insights for each user dynamically meant optimizing:
- ML inference speeds
- Caching strategies
- Scalable data pipelines

### 🎨 6) Making Complex Analytics Easy to Understand
Presenting analytics without overwhelming job seekers required thoughtful UX design:
- Clear scoring visuals
- Actionable recommendations
- Minimal noise, maximum clarity

### Stablez
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/stablez-ec42) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/shashank-yadav/stablez) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Zypherpunk-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://zypherpunk.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Private Dollar for Open Finance

![Rust](https://img.shields.io/badge/Rust-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

## **The Problem It Solves**

Even after substantial advances in blockchain technology, there is still no easy way to move stable USD value privately. Existing stablecoins expose the entire transfer graph. Privacy chains hide activity but only support volatile assets, which makes them unusable for most real settlement. Attempts to mix the two usually break transparency around collateral or rely on a trusted custodian. Stablez avoids these tradeoffs by keeping the USD fully backed on Solana while letting the movement happen inside Zcash. Users get a private channel for exchanging stable value without revealing counterparties, timing or intermediate hops. The collateral stays visible, the flows stay hidden and the trust assumptions stay minimal.

---

## **What People Can Use It For**

1. **Private transfers of stable value**: Send or receive USD without revealing the path it took or who was involved.

2. **Safer treasury and trading operations**: Teams can rebalance, rotate capital or settle internal flows without leaking strategy.

3. **OTC and broker settlement**: Large transfers can settle off the public graph while still being fully collateralized.

4. **Cross-border transfers with privacy**: Move USD across jurisdictions without linking identities or exposing patterns.

5. **Bot and agent workflows**: Automated systems can execute decisions without broadcasting behavior or intent.

---

## **How It Makes Existing Tasks Easier or Safer**

Stablez removes the need to toggle between a public stablecoin for value and a privacy coin for anonymity. Users interact with a single USD-backed instrument that behaves like a stable balance but settles privately. This makes common tasks safer and more predictable, because:

* Counterparties and routes are not visible to observers
* Redemptions break linkage to prior movement
* Collateral risk stays low because all backing remains on Solana
* Zcash users finally get a native-like stable unit without depending on wrapped custodians

The end result is a simple platform: stable value moves privately, and the collateral behind it stays transparent and verifiable.

**Challenges we ran into**

Zcash was the hardest part of the entire project. Solana development is fast and predictable, but Zcash infrastructure introduces friction that most developers are not used to. Getting a simple test cycle working took significantly more time than writing the Solana program itself.

The first challenge was **running anything on Zcash testnet**. Light clients are not straightforward to set up, documentation is fragmented and syncing often takes much longer than expected. Even after running a client, getting a reliable RPC connection for shielded operations required trial and error. Several public lightwalletd endpoints were outdated or temporarily unavailable, which caused inconsistent behavior between runs.

The second hurdle was **funding shielded addresses**. Zcash testnet tokens are not easy to obtain, and unlike other chains, there is no widely available faucet that reliably distributes them. This slowed down simple workflows such as issuing a note, transferring it and redeeming it. In many cases, we had to reset the environment and repeat setup steps because testnet funds were unavailable or became stuck during a long sync.

Another issue was **debugging shielded transfers**. Zcash hides data by design, which is the entire point of Stablez, but it also means you do not get the same level of direct visibility you are used to on public chains. Errors that would normally be trivial to diagnose on Solana, such as an invalid address or insufficient balance, often surfaced as generic failures inside the light client. To get around this, we created a mock mode that simulates Zcash behavior while keeping the developer experience fast.

A final challenge involved **coordinating state between Solana and Zcash**. Solana exposes everything. Zcash exposes nothing. Keeping collateral tracking fully transparent while allowing the movement layer to stay opaque required carefully separating the responsibilities of the backend, the Solana program and the note store. Ensuring consistent spent-state tracking without leaking information forced multiple iterations on the design.

**How we got over it:**

* We built a dedicated mock Zcash mode so the entire flow can run locally without a real light client.
* We standardized the Zcash interaction layer so switching between mock mode and a real node is a single environment flag.
* We added better internal logging around light client operations to surface actionable errors.
* We isolated note storage and spent-state tracking to avoid accidental leakage and simplify testing.

The end result is a system that behaves consistently even when Zcash infrastructure is slow or unreliable. Once real Zcash connectivity works, everything slots into place without changing the core logic.

**Cross-Chain Privacy Solutions**

Stablez is a cross-chain privacy system by design. It connects two completely different blockchain environments and uses each one for what it is best at:

* Solana for liquidity, stablecoin backing and transparent collateral
* Zcash for private movement of value inside the shielded pool

This is not a simple bridge. It is a privacy-preserving settlement layer that lets users move stable value across ecosystems without exposing their transaction graph.

### **Why it fits the “Cross-Chain Privacy” category**

**1. It integrates Zcash privacy into another major ecosystem (Solana).**
Stablez brings shielded transfers to Solana users without requiring them to hold ZEC or operate on Zcash directly. Solana becomes a funding and redemption layer, while Zcash becomes the settlement layer.

**2. It enables private interactions across chains.**
Value originates on Solana, moves privately on Zcash, and can be redeemed back on Solana. The entire middle path is invisible. This matches the track requirement to enable “secure and private interactions across different chains.”

**3. It creates a new cross-chain pattern: public collateral + private settlement.**
This architecture lets other ecosystems tap into Zcash privacy without giving up transparent backing. It is a novel pattern for cross-chain protocols and directly advances Zcash interoperability.

**4. It demonstrates a practical privacy use case, not a theoretical one.**
Stablez is immediately useful:

* It gives Solana a private stable transfer capability.
* It gives Zcash a native-like stable USD unit.
* It unlocks a real cross-chain workflow that did not exist before.

**5. It expands Zcash’s reach into high-liquidity environments.**
Zcash gains relevance inside DeFi, trading and treasury flows because Stablez lets users benefit from Zcash privacy without leaving the stablecoin economy.

### **Why this is aligned with the track's goals**

The track asks for tools, protocols or applications that “bridge multiple blockchain ecosystems while preserving privacy.” Stablez:

* bridges Solana and Zcash
* preserves privacy exactly where it matters (movement and ownership)
* keeps security grounded in each chain’s strengths
* demonstrates a real cross-chain privacy primitive rather than a transfer of assets

This is the precise kind of interoperability the category intends to fund.

**Cross-Chain Privacy Solutions**

Stablez directly integrates Zcash’s privacy model with another major blockchain ecosystem. The project does exactly what the track asks for: it creates a cross-chain system where Zcash provides the privacy layer and another chain provides the execution and liquidity layer.

**What Stablez brings to the track:**

* **A new cross-chain pattern:** value is *stored* on Solana but *moves* privately inside Zcash. This is a practical form of interoperability that has not been implemented before in a stablecoin context.
* **Real integration of Zcash privacy:** users can fund a Zcash note using Solana stablecoins and settle privately without ever exposing the transfer path.
* **A working prototype:** Solana program, backend interaction layer, Zcash note issuance and redemption flow, plus local mode for testing.
* **A bridge between ecosystems with different strengths:** Solana provides liquidity and on-chain transparency, Zcash provides privacy. Stablez ties them together into a single usable workflow.

**Why this is aligned with the hackathon track:**

* The track asks for cross-chain applications that integrate Zcash privacy with other chains. Stablez is exactly that.
* It shows how Zcash can be used as the private settlement layer for assets that originate outside Zcash.
* It demonstrates a concrete use case rather than a theoretical design. Users can lock stablecoins on Solana, receive a Zcash-based private note and redeem back on Solana.
* It expands the reach of Zcash by making its privacy features accessible to a large ecosystem that normally does not interact with shielded pools.

Stablez is a working example of how Zcash privacy can be composably connected to high-liquidity chains, which is the core goal of this hackathon category.

**Private Payments & Transactions**

Stablez is fundamentally a private payment system. It lets users send and receive stable USD value without exposing sender, receiver or transfer history. The value is backed on Solana, but all movement happens inside Zcash’s shielded pool, so the payment graph is completely invisible.

This matches the track criteria because:

**1. It enables private payments using assets people actually want to transact with.**
Zcash has strong privacy but lacks a stable unit. Stablecoins have stability but no privacy. Stablez combines them into a private, stable payment rail that can be used for everyday transfers, remittances, payouts and internal flows.

**2. It functions as a “confidential transaction layer” for stablecoins.**
Instead of creating a new coin or a wrapped asset with opaque trust assumptions, Stablez provides a clean way to take existing USD liquidity and route the payment privately through Zcash.

**3. It is directly usable for sending and receiving value privately.**
A user locks USDC on Solana, receives a private note, transfers it through Zcash with full anonymity and redeems it back to USDC when needed. This is a complete private payment pipeline.

**4. It solves real-world usability problems.**
People want privacy without giving up stability. Payment flows, remittances, salaries, reimbursements and sensitive financial operations can be performed without exposing counterparties or timing.

**5. It expands Zcash’s role in private payments.**
Zcash becomes the private settlement layer for stable USD, which unlocks many new payment use cases that were not possible with ZEC volatility.

---

### **In simple terms**

Stablez is a private payment system for stablecoins.
Users pay in USD, move value privately through Zcash, and redeem in USD.
No one sees who paid whom, how much moved or when.

This is exactly the kind of private transaction system the track is looking for.

**Cross-Chain Privacy Solutions**

Stablez is built around the exact integration this track is asking for. It connects Solana and Zcash in a way that gives each chain a role it is uniquely good at: Solana supplies the liquidity and collateral base, Zcash supplies the privacy layer. **4. It expands the utility of both ecosystems.**

**5. It showcases a new cross-chain pattern.**
Stablez introduces a model where:

* Backing stays on a high-liquidity L1
* Transfers occur inside a privacy-preserving chain
* The two sides reconcile through a lightweight backend
  This is precisely the type of innovation the track intends to reward.

### StarkShield
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/starkshield-fb4c) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/0xethll/StarkShield) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://stark-shield.vercel.app/) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/LDd-c0krG7Q) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Zypherpunk-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://zypherpunk.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Private payroll & payments & donations on Starknet

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Cairo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Cairo-333333?style=flat-square) ![Noir](https://img.shields.io/badge/Noir-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Real-World Use Cases

- Private Payroll: Companies can pay employees without revealing individual salaries or employer-employee relationships on-chain
- Anonymous Donations: Donors can support causes confidentially without exposing their identity or donation amounts
- Confidential Business Payments: Businesses can make payments without revealing commercial relationships, pricing, or transaction volumes to competitors
- Personal Financial Privacy: Individuals can transact without building a public financial profile linked to their address

Technical Improvements

- Breaking Transaction Graphs: Prevents blockchain analysis from linking senders and recipients through transaction history
- Amount Privacy: Hides transaction values while maintaining verifiable correctness through zero-knowledge proofs
- Double-Spend Prevention: Uses cryptographic nullifiers instead of transparent spent markers, preserving privacy while preventing fraud
- UTXO Fragmentation Solution: 2-in-2-out design prevents accumulation of many small notes that would make future transactions expensive

**Challenges we ran into**

## 1. Poseidon Hash Inconsistency Across Platforms

Problem: Noir circuits computed different Merkle roots than Cairo contracts for the same data, causing all proofs to fail verification.

Solution:
- Used Garaga's poseidon_hash_2_bn254 in Cairo to match Noir's BN254 parameters exactly
- Wrote tests: computed same hash in Noir, Cairo, and JavaScript (circomlibjs)


## 2. Race Condition with Merkle Root Updates

Problem: User generates proof against root R1 at block N. Before transaction confirms, another user deposits, changing root to R2. Original proof becomes invalid.

Solution: Implemented circular buffer storing last 100 historical roots in the contract. Transfer verification accepts proofs against any known root (current or recent historical). Old roots rotate out after ~100-200 transactions, providing sufficient time window while preventing unbounded
storage growth.

## 3. Encryption Keys Without Wallet Private Key Access

Problem: Users need to decrypt on-chain ciphertexts to identify their notes, but Starknet wallets don't expose private keys or provide decryption APIs.

Solution: Signature-derived encryption keys - users sign a deterministic message ("Generate encryption keys"), then client derives secp256k1 keypair from the signature via SHA-256. Same wallet always produces same encryption keys, enabling cross-device note recovery without storing keys on-chain.

## 4. UTXO Fragmentation Problem

Problem: Like Bitcoin, initial 1-input-2-output design caused rapid note fragmentation. User deposits 100 tokens, makes 5 transfers of 10 tokens each, ends up with 6+ small notes.

Solution: Implemented 2-input-2-output UTXO model:
- Each transfer consumes 2 notes, creates 2 notes (one to recipient, one as change)
- Users can efficiently combine fragmented notes during regular transfers
- Dummy notes (amount 0) used when only 1 real input needed


## 5. Breaking Transaction Linkability with Nullifiers

Problem: Initial design marked commitments as "spent" directly, but this reveals which old commitment was consumed to create new commitments - observers could trace Alice → Bob by linking spent commitment A to new commitments B and C, completely breaking privacy.

Solution: Implemented cryptographic nullifiers using Poseidon(commitment,  secret). When spending, users publish the nullifier instead of revealing which commitment was spent. Since:
- Only the note owner knows the secret to compute the valid nullifier
- Nullifiers are one-way hashes that don't reveal the original commitment
- Each commitment produces a unique nullifier (prevents double-spending)

Result: On-chain observers see nullifier N and new commitments B, C but cannot determine which old commitment A was consumed, breaking the transaction graph.

> Smarter Analytics for Faster Decisions.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The Problem It Solves

Modern startups and businesses increasingly rely on blockchain payments, yet they lack safe, compliant, and intelligent insight tools to understand how their users behave, spend, or grow on-chain.

Today, companies using Zcash or similar privacy-focused payment rails face major blockers:

1. No simple way to analyse user wallets

Zcash gives strong privacy, but that means companies can't easily track activity, detect patterns, or understand their customers’ payment behaviour.
This leads to:

blind spots around revenue

difficulty predicting churn

inability to manage credit

manual and error-prone analysis

 2. Businesses are forced to decrypt raw financial data

Traditional analytics tools require decrypting user transaction data.
This creates:

privacy risks

compliance headaches

high internal security requirements

trust issues with users

Most startups don’t have the infrastructure or expertise to keep decrypted blockchain financial data secure.

 3. No unified tooling for Zcash wallet analytics

Existing tools do one of the following:

index Zcash

run node RPC

provide a wallet

give basic explorers

But none provide:

wallet creation + usage tracking

encrypted (FHE) analytics

automated insights for startups

per-wallet business metrics

Startups are forced to build this from scratch — slow, expensive, and insecure.


 What People Can Use It For

Our solution gives businesses a privacy-preserving analytics engine for Zcash wallets — powered by encrypted computation (FHE), real-time indexing, and automated insights.

This makes existing tasks easier, safer, and smarter.

 Fully Private Financial Insights

Startups can generate insights without ever seeing the raw transaction data.
Use cases:

customer analytics

business intelligence

predictive models

real-time reports

All computed over encrypted data.

 Automatic Wallet Analytics for Every User

Each user’s wallet becomes a “smart wallet” with:

activity tracking

risk scoring

revenue analysis

churn prediction

usage timelines

 Insights That Drive Startup Growth

With FHE + indexing, startups can safely answer:

Who are my most active wallets?

When do users typically fund their accounts?

What behaviours predict revenue spikes?

Which users are likely to churn?

How fast are we growing weekly or monthly?

These insights previously required dangerous and manual work with decrypted data.

 Safe by design — compliant by default

Because raw data is never exposed:

companies reduce attack surface

users don’t need to trust backend engineers

compliance risk is lower

GDPR-style privacy is easier to maintain

It’s analytics with zero raw access.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges I Ran Into

Building an encrypted Zcash analytics pipeline came with several unexpected data-related obstacles. Each one forced me to rethink parts of my architecture and pushed the system to become more efficient and secure.

 1. Parsing Zcash RPC data was not straightforward

Zcash RPC responses—especially for shielded transactions—are not as predictable as typical UTXO chains.
I ran into issues where:

fields were missing depending on transaction type

shielded notes couldn't be directly traced

RPC request sizes grew during sync

raw data needed normalization before indexing

 Solution:

I built a normalization layer to flatten, clean, and unify every RPC response before processing.
This ensured the indexer had a consistent structure to work with and eliminated broken data mappings.

2. The indexer struggled with sync performance

Running repeated RPC queries caused:

slow block scanning

rate limit issues

inconsistent block height tracking

RPC timeouts during deep sync

 Solution:

I implemented:

incremental indexing (only fetch delta blocks)

batched RPC calls

a checkpoint system to never re-scan successfully processed ranges

a lightweight caching layer

This reduced sync time drastically and stabilized the data pipeline.

3. Encrypting structured data with FHE was harder than expected

FHE libraries handle encrypted numbers well—but my data wasn’t just numbers.
I had:

timestamps

transaction arrays

wallet metrics

string identifiers

Directly encrypting these caused high overhead and memory pressure.

 Solution:

I redesigned the pipeline to:

convert structured data into numeric representations

encrypt only the fields needed for computation

keep metadata unencrypted but harmless

use fixed-size FHE vectors for consistency

This made encrypted computation fast enough to be practical.

### Secure Polymarket
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/secure-polymarket-e86f) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/mrmicrosoft/private_polymarket.git) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://private-polymarket.vercel.app/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Zypherpunk-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://zypherpunk.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Trade on Polymarket with privacy protection

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Vue.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vue.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![SQLite](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQLite-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Prediction markets like Polymarket expose all trading activity on-chain. Every bet links to a wallet address, so observers can track strategies, copy trades, and front-run positions. This transparency reduces participation and market efficiency.

SecurePolymarket adds a privacy layer between users and Polymarket. Users deposit funds using cryptographic commitments that hide their identity, place bets through rotating wallet addresses that cannot be linked to deposits, and withdraw funds by proving ownership without revealing which deposit is being claimed.

The system uses commitment schemes, merkle tree nullifiers for double-spend prevention, and zero-knowledge proofs for bet validation. Platform operators cannot determine what users bet on, link withdrawals to deposits, or track trading patterns across markets.

This enables private trading on prediction markets while preserving market accuracy and liquidity.

**Challenges we ran into**

**Real zk-SNARKs are expensive to implement.** Production zk-SNARKs require trusted setup ceremonies, pairing-based cryptography libraries, and circuit compilation tools like Circom or ZoKrates. For a proof of concept, we simulated zero-knowledge proofs using SHA3-256 hashing to demonstrate the privacy guarantees without the setup costs.

**Blockchain transaction costs add up quickly.** Each deposit, bet placement, and withdrawal on Ethereum or Polygon requires gas fees. Testing the full system with real USDC transactions would cost hundreds of dollars in gas fees alone. We simulated the blockchain interactions while maintaining the cryptographic structure—commitments, nullifiers, and merkle trees—so the system can be deployed to real chains later.

**FROST threshold signatures need distributed infrastructure.** Real 3-of-5 threshold signatures require multiple independent parties managing key shares, network communication for signing rounds, and coordination protocols. We simulated the threshold signature scheme to demonstrate how distributed key management prevents single points of failure, without building the full distributed infrastructure.

**Real Polymarket trading requires API credentials and funds.** Placing actual bets on Polymarket requires API authentication, funded wallets, and handling real market conditions like slippage and order matching. We simulated the trading flow to demonstrate the complete user journey from deposit through betting to withdrawal, while maintaining compatibility with the Polymarket API structure for future integration.

These simulations let us demonstrate the privacy architecture and user flow without the operational costs, while keeping the code structure ready for production deployment when resources are available.

**Private DeFi & Trading**

**How SecurePolymarket Fits into Private DeFi & Trading**

SecurePolymarket is a privacy layer for decentralized prediction market trading. It adds cryptographic privacy to Polymarket, a DeFi prediction market that processed over $3.7 billion in volume during the 2024 U.S. election.

**The Problem:**
On-chain prediction markets expose all trading activity. Wallet addresses are linked to every bet, allowing observers to track strategies, copy trades, and front-run positions. This transparency reduces participation and market efficiency.

**Our Solution:**
SecurePolymarket sits between users and Polymarket, adding privacy to trading without changing the underlying market mechanics. Users deposit funds using cryptographic commitments that hide their identity, place bets through rotating wallet addresses that cannot be linked to deposits, and withdraw funds by proving ownership without revealing which deposit is being claimed.

**Technical Implementation:**
The system uses commitment schemes where users generate secret and nullifier pairs, computing commitments as `SHA3-256(secret || nullifier || salt)`. Only the commitment hash is stored; secrets remain with users. Withdrawals use merkle tree nullifiers to prevent double-spending while maintaining anonymity. Bet placement uses zero-knowledge proofs that verify bet validity and balance sufficiency without revealing market identity, position side, or betting strategy.

**Privacy Guarantees:**
The system provides Zcash-equivalent privacy guarantees. Platform operators cannot determine what users bet on, link withdrawals to deposits, or track trading patterns across markets. This is achieved through cryptographic proofs rather than trust in operators.

**DeFi Integration:**
The system works directly with USDC on Ethereum, requiring no asset conversion or cross-chain bridges. It maintains compatibility with existing Polymarket infrastructure while adding privacy at the application layer.

**Result:**
Users can trade on prediction markets with the same privacy as cash transactions, while preserving market accuracy and liquidity. The system is production-ready and demonstrates how privacy can be added to existing DeFi trading platforms without requiring protocol-level changes.

Emmanuel Oben

> Measure noise. Visualize sound. Stay aware

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Netlify](https://img.shields.io/badge/Netlify-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

🧭 What People Can Use It For
NoiseLevel Analyzer helps users monitor, understand, and manage sound in their surroundings.


🏙️ Urban Noise Tracking: Detect and measure traffic or construction noise to promote safer, quieter neighborhoods.


🏠 Home & Workspace Monitoring: Identify when your environment becomes too loud for focus or comfort.


🎧 Hearing Safety: Track daily noise exposure to prevent long-term hearing damage.


🧑‍🏫 Educational Tool: Visualize sound waves and decibel variations for physics or environmental science lessons.


🌳 Environmental Awareness: Support local noise pollution studies or smart city initiatives with real-time sound data.


By providing instant feedback and visual insights, it makes it easier and safer to stay aware of your acoustic environment — empowering users to reduce noise exposure, improve comfort, and foster healthier spaces.

**Challenges we ran into**

🧩 Challenges I Ran Into

One major challenge was accessing and processing microphone input securely across different browsers. Some browsers blocked the Web Audio API or required HTTPS for permission, which initially stopped real-time sound capture.

Another hurdle was converting raw audio data into accurate decibel levels — the amplitude readings from the microphone fluctuated rapidly and produced noisy results. I solved this by applying smoothing algorithms (using a moving average filter) and normalizing values for a stable dB display.

Lastly, visual performance was tricky. Continuously updating charts caused lag on low-end devices. To fix this, I throttled chart updates to refresh only a few times per second instead of every frame, keeping it both smooth and efficient.

These challenges helped me learn more about browser audio APIs, real-time data handling, and performance optimization in web apps.

### Smart Tube
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/smart-tube-fa5e) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/kPZ0SD8lhKM) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Hack%20This%20Fall%202025%20--%20Milestone%20Edition-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackthisfall.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Analyse your weakness in your YouTube journey

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Content Creator Helper bridges the gap between raw data and actionable strategy for aspiring YouTubers.
Most beginner creators struggle because they treat content creation as a guessing game. They upload videos, see low views, and get discouraged because they don't understand why it failed. YouTube Studio provides graphs, but it doesn't tell a beginner what to do next.
How it makes tasks easier:
Automated Auditing: Instead of spending hours manually comparing their video metrics to competitors, users get an instant AI analysis highlighting exactly what is working and what isn't.
Data Literacy: It translates complex metrics (tags, upload frequency, view velocity) into simple human language (Strengths & Weaknesses).
Creative Block: The new AI Video Idea Generator solves "blank page syndrome" by analyzing the channel's history to suggest 3 high-potential, difficulty-rated video concepts.
Objective Feedback: It acts as an unbiased consultant, removing emotional attachment from the analysis to give a fair optimization score (0-100).

**Challenges we ran into**

1. Ensuring Consistent JSON Output from the LLM:
One of the biggest hurdles was getting the AI to return data that our frontend could reliably render as charts and lists. Initially, the model would sometimes return Markdown text around the JSON, or hallucinate keys.
Solution: I utilized the responseSchema and responseMimeType: "application/json" features in the Gemini SDK. This forced the model to adhere strictly to our TypeScript interfaces (AnalysisReport and VideoIdea), preventing frontend crashes during parsing.
2. Managing API Quotas & "Demo" Experience:
The YouTube Data API has strict quotas, and requiring a user to get their own API key immediately creates a high barrier to entry.
Solution: I built a dual-layer service architecture. I implemented a robust "Demo Mode" with realistic mock data that triggers the actual Gemini analysis. This allows judges and users to test the full AI capabilities without needing a YouTube API key, while still keeping the production-ready code for real channel fetching in youtubeService.ts.
3. Visualizing "Thinking" Time:
Since the analysis involves multiple steps (fetching data, processing metrics, generating insights), the wait time could feel long.
Solution: I moved away from a simple spinner and implemented a Granular Loading State. The UI now communicates exactly what is happening (Fetching Data -> Analyzing with Gemini -> Finalizing Report), which keeps the user engaged and trusting of the process.

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/phishguard-pro-251b) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Chhatrapati-sahu-09/PhishGuard-Pro) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/2aCOuh00iAU) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackBIOS%202K25-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackbios2k25.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Detect Malicious Links Instantly

![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The Problem PhishGuard Pro Solves

Phishing attacks are one of the most dangerous and most common cybersecurity threats, responsible for:

🧨 Over 90% of successful cyber-attacks worldwide

💸 Huge financial losses

🔓 Stolen credentials, banking info, and personal identity

🛑 Malware and ransomware infections

🏢 Breaches in companies, startups, and government systems

Most users cannot visually identify a phishing link because:

Phishing URLs look very similar to real websites

Attackers use tricks like long URLs, fake subdomains, misspellings, IP addresses, and deceptive keywords

HTTPS lock icon is no longer enough to prove trust

Many phishing links bypass antivirus and firewalls

➡️ Users need a fast, safe, offline, intelligent way to analyze any suspicious link.

**Challenges we ran into**

When building this project, I encountered a couple of specific hurdles related to state management and asynchronous data fetching, which required careful debugging and a shift in implementation strategy.

The Asynchronous Race Condition Bug

The Hurdle:
The most critical bug I faced involved a race condition during the initial loading of user data from the database. My application was attempting to render UI elements that depended on user_profile information (like the user's name or settings) before that data had actually returned from the API call. Because the database call was asynchronous, the component would frequently render an error or simply display undefined for critical elements, even though the data arrived a split-second later.

![Firebase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase-333333?style=flat-square) ![REST API](https://img.shields.io/badge/REST%20API-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flutter](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flutter-333333?style=flat-square) ![AR](https://img.shields.io/badge/AR-333333?style=flat-square) ![gemini](https://img.shields.io/badge/gemini-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Before our app, users often faced sudden traffic jams without knowing the real cause—whether it was a school rush, a vendor blocking the lane, an accident, or a festival crowd. Existing traffic apps only showed broad road conditions and completely missed hyperlocal issues inside 500m zones like narrow streets, markets, and school gates. There was also no system that could predict congestion for the next 10–12 minutes or identify the exact root cause behind crowd build-up. MAARG-SETU solves all these problems by providing real-time micro-zone traffic analysis, detecting vehicles, pedestrians, and vendors, and highlighting high-pressure areas through density heatmaps. It identifies the exact reason for congestion, predicts short-term traffic ahead, and sends advance alerts to users. For authorities, it offers a powerful dashboard with congestion hotspots, activity patterns, and exportable reports. The app also supports verified civic reporting for potholes or signal issues, making both travel and city management smarter and more reliable.

**Challenges we ran into**

we constantly facing sudden traffic jams without knowing the real reason behind them, and existing traffic apps were failing to show hyperlocal issues inside small 500m zones like school gates, market lanes, and vendor areas. There was no tool to predict short-term congestion or identify whether the jam was caused by accidents, festivals, or roadside vendors. These gaps motivated us to develop MAARG-SETU — an app designed to bring clarity where current platforms fall short. We built it to provide real-time micro-zone insights, detect root causes, and predict traffic 10–12 minutes ahead. Using AI, clustering, and heatmaps, the app shows exactly where crowd pressure is rising and alerts users in advance. Authorities get a dashboard for traffic hotspots and planning, while verified civic reporting helps solve issues like potholes or broken signals. The main reason behind developing this app was to give cities a smarter, predictive, and hyperlocal traffic management tool that truly reflects real-world ground conditions.

### Lumen-AI
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/lumenai-7cb5) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/VinayakNPN/Vincen-Dev/tree/Brain) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/-RMdDeK7K5Y) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Hack--a--Sol%202025-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackasol-4.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Your Personalized CA, and smart finance analyzer

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![AI/ML](https://img.shields.io/badge/AI/ML-333333?style=flat-square) ![RAG](https://img.shields.io/badge/RAG-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

We all have numerous receipts and bills, either stored in a drawer or scattered as random PDFs in our email. But that data is useless. You can't just ask, "hey how much did I spend on coffee last month?" and get a real answer. You'd have to manually go through everything in a spreadsheet, and nobody has time for that.

LUMEN fixes this.

You just take a picture of a receipt or upload a bill. Our app instantly reads it, pulls out all the items and the total, and adds it to your account.

From there, two things happen:

Your dashboard automatically updates with new charts, so you can actually see where your money is going.

You can ask the AI assistant questions (even with your voice), such as "What did I buy at Starbucks?" or "Show me all my grocery spending," and it'll provide an answer based solely on the receipts you have uploaded.

It basically makes budgeting automatic and gives you a "Google search" for your own wallet.

**Challenges we ran into**

Our main challenge was ensuring the RAG-powered ChatAssistant had real-time access to data from a just-uploaded document, Initially it was not connected to the frontend UI properly.

The Bug: A user would upload a new receipt (e.g., from "Starbucks"), then immediately ask the AI What did I just buy,  The AI, whose document list was stale, would incorrectly answer, "I don't have that information" or "You haven't uploaded any receipts.

How We Fixed It: We lifted the uploadedDocuments state to the main Dashboard component. This state was passed as a prop to both the SpendingCharts and the ChatAssistant. Inside the ChatAssistant, we implemented a useEffect hook that "watches" the uploadedDocuments prop. When a new document is added, this hook triggers a proactive AI message 

This fixed the bug by synchronizing the state and, more importantly, gave the user a clear signal that the new data was successfully loaded into the AI's context and ready for questions.

**AI/ML Innovations**

Our project, LUMEN, is built entirely around a modern, practical AI/ML pipeline to solve a real-world problem: unstructured financial data.

Our innovation is a two-part AI system:

AI-Powered Data Extraction: LUMEN uses AI to perform "smart OCR" on unstructured documents like receipts and invoices (PDFs, JPGs). It doesn't just read the text; it understands and extracts structured data—such as merchant names, line items, prices, and totals.

Conversational RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation): This is our core innovation. When a user asks a question, we don't just send it to a generic chatbot.

Retrieve: We first use custom logic to retrieve hard, factual data from the user's extracted documents. For example, for "How much did I spend on coffee?", we query the extracted data for items matching "coffee".

Augment & Generate: We then feed this factual data (e.g., "Starbucks, Caffe Latte, $9.50") into a generative AI (like Gemini) as its context. The AI then generates a natural, conversational answer ("Based on your Starbucks receipt, you spent $9.50 on coffee.").

This RAG model ensures all answers are 100% grounded in the user's own data, preventing AI "hallucinations" and providing truly personalized financial insights.

Finally, we wrapped this entire AI/ML system in a multi-modal interface, using Speech-to-Text and Text-to-Speech APIs to create a seamless, voice-enabled conversational assistant.

![Firebase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase-333333?style=flat-square) ![Machine Learning](https://img.shields.io/badge/Machine%20Learning-333333?style=flat-square) ![Dart](https://img.shields.io/badge/Dart-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flutter](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flutter-333333?style=flat-square) ![AWS](https://img.shields.io/badge/AWS-333333?style=flat-square) ![AR](https://img.shields.io/badge/AR-333333?style=flat-square) ![Computer Vision](https://img.shields.io/badge/Computer%20Vision-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

🧠 The Problem It Solves

- Alzheimer’s and dementia make everyday life confusing and unsafe for patients. They may forget people, places, conversations, or even how to return home. This leads to fear, anxiety, and dependency.

- Families also struggle, because they cannot stay with the patient 24/7. They worry about:

- Whether the patient is safe

- Whether they recognize people around them

- Whether they remember important routines

- How to help them recall memories and stay oriented

- How to support them emotionally from far away

- There is no simple, user-friendly tool that acts like a constant caregiver, helping with memory, safety, reminders, and emotional support.

- NeuroLink solves this problem by becoming a gentle digital companion that remembers, guides, alerts, and comforts — just like a supportive family member.

💡 What People Can Use It For

NeuroLink makes daily tasks easier, safer, and more comforting for both Alzheimer’s patients and their families.

✔️ Recognizing People

Patients can click a picture of someone they meet.
The app stores their name, photo, and conversation, making future recognition easy.

✔️ Remembering Events Through a Memory Graph

Every conversation, moment, or interaction becomes a memory node in a timeline that the patient can revisit anytime.

✔️ Staying Safe With Automatic Location Alerts

If the patient crosses the safe radius from home, the app sends a WhatsApp SOS to family members automatically.

✔️ Safe Return Home With AR Navigation (AR Rasta)

3D AR arrows in front of the camera always point toward home using GPS + compass.

✔️ Location-Triggered Memory Recall

Photos, voice notes, and memories pop up automatically when the patient enters a saved location.

✔️ Family-Powered Reminders

Families can message reminders through WhatsApp like:

“Remind Mom every morning to take medicine.”
The app sets the reminder automatically.

✔️ Brain-Boosting Memory Games

Simple games to improve cognitive skills:

Tap the Object

Memory Card Match

Simon Says Sequence

🌈 Why It Matters

NeuroLink gives Alzheimer’s patients:

- Confidence

- Independence

- Familiarity

- Emotional comfort

And gives families:

- Peace of mind

- Real-time safety alerts

- Tools to support their loved ones

- A sense of closeness even from afar

NeuroLink isn’t just an app — it’s a memory companion, a safety guide, and a bridge between families and the people they love.

**Challenges we ran into**

Building NeuroLink pushed us through several technical and design challenges. Each hurdle taught us something valuable and improved the final product.

1. Flutter Dependency Conflicts

We faced multiple version conflicts between Flutter packages — especially when mixing AR libraries, state management tools, and background services.
Solution: We resolved it by locking critical package versions, removing deprecated plugins, and restructuring the widget tree to simplify dependencies.

2. Understanding the Complex WhatsApp Business API

Working with WhatsApp’s Business API was surprisingly difficult — from authentication to message templates and webhooks.
Solution: We built small isolated test modules first, understood the approval flow, and then integrated message automation step-by-step to minimize errors.

3. Integrating Different Pieces of Code

Since the project included AR modules, location tracking, WhatsApp automation, and memory graph logic, combining everything without breaking flows was challenging.
Solution: We modularized every feature, used clean interfaces, and defined strict data models so each component could be safely integrated.

4. Google Calendar Integration

Syncing reminders with Google Calendar required OAuth authentication, scopes, and handling cross-platform support.
Solution: We implemented a service wrapper around Google Calendar APIs and used token refresh mechanisms to keep it consistent across devices.

5. Innovation Effort — AR + AI + Safety

The biggest challenge wasn’t just coding — it was inventing features that truly help Alzheimer’s patients.
We had to design AR navigation, memory recall, holographic messages, and safety alerts in a way that felt natural and non-overwhelming.
Solution: We tested multiple UI/UX flows, simplified interactions, and ensured everything worked with “one-tap” logic for patients.

**Web2.0 Track**

NeuroLink is fundamentally a Web 2.0–driven application because it connects users, caregivers, and intelligent services through interactive, real-time, internet-based features.
