![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![MySQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/MySQL-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Key Problems Solved:
1. Time-Consuming Manual Attendance
Before: Teachers spend 5-10 minutes each class manually calling names and marking attendance
After: Students tap RFID cards in <2 seconds, attendance is automatically recorded to the database
Impact: Saves ~15-20 hours per semester per teacher, maximizing actual teaching time
2. Attendance Fraud & Proxy Attendance
Before: Students could answer for absent friends during roll calls
After: Physical RFID card required - each student must personally scan their unique card
Impact: 100% authentic attendance records with timestamp verification
3. Fragmented Data & Poor Visibility
Before: Attendance scattered across paper registers, Excel sheets, making tracking difficult
After: Centralized MySQL database with real-time dashboards for teachers, students, and admins
Impact: Instant access to attendance trends, subject-wise breakdowns, and historical data
4. Delayed At-Risk Student Identification
Before: Low attendance noticed only during mid-terms or finals, too late for intervention
After: AI-powered risk detection immediately flags students with <65% attendance
Impact: Early intervention prevents academic failure - teachers can reach out proactively
5. Subject-Specific Attendance Gaps
Before: Only overall attendance tracked, hiding patterns like "good in Math, poor in Physics"
After: Individual subject tracking (Maths, PPS, Physics) with separate percentages
Impact: Teachers identify subject-specific attendance issues for targeted support
6. Manual Report Generation
Before: Hours spent compiling attendance reports for administration or parents
After: One-click PDF export with charts, statistics, and student-wise breakdowns
Impact: Instant reporting for meetings, parent conferences, or compliance audits
7. Club Duty Management Chaos
Before: Club responsibilities communicated via WhatsApp/email, updates lost or ignored
After: Dedicated duty assignment system with student portal access and progress tracking
Impact: Clear accountability, real-time updates, organized club operations
8. Leave Request Bottlenecks
Before: Paper leave applications, manual approval routing, lost forms
After: Digital leave requests with teacher approval workflow and status tracking
Impact: Faster processing, transparent status, digital record keeping
Who Benefits:
Teachers: Save time, gain insights, identify struggling students early
Students: Instant attendance visibility, track their own progress, submit digital leave requests
Administrators: Compliance reporting, system-wide analytics, audit trails
Parents: Access real-time attendance data to monitor their child's consistency
Safety & Reliability:
Data Integrity: Dual storage (MySQL + Excel backup) prevents data loss
Authentication: JWT-based role access ensures only authorized users access sensitive data
Audit Trail: Every scan logged with timestamp, location, and student ID for accountability
Offline Resilience: System falls back to cached data if server connection drops
This system transforms attendance from a tedious administrative task into an automated, intelligent tool that actively supports student success through early intervention and data-driven insights.

**Challenges we ran into**

MySQL2 Query Result Inconsistency
Problem: The mysql2 library was returning query results in different formats - sometimes as an array [rows, fields] and other times as a single object. This caused undefined errors when trying to access student data.

Solution: Implemented flexible result handling:
2. Foreign Key Constraint Failures
Problem: Database initialization kept failing with foreign key violations when inserting seed data. The teacher_id references in attendance records pointed to non-existent user IDs.

Solution:

Added SET FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS = 0; before DROP statements in schema
Corrected teacher user_id sequence from 6-15 to 5-14 to match actual user insertions
Changed problematic teacher_id to NULL where appropriate

**The problem it solves**

# The Problem It Solves

Students and teachers face multiple challenges in the learning process:

- Students struggle with consistency and maintaining a disciplined study routine.
- Motivation decreases due to a lack of personalized guidance.
- Most learning tools use a one-size-fits-all approach and do not adapt to individual pace or weaknesses.
- Assessments are manual, slow, and provide delayed feedback.
- Students get distracted easily and lose study focus.
- Teachers lack intelligent tools for automated checking and real-time progress tracking.

# How the Solution Helps

Our AI-driven system introduces personalization, automation, and structure into the learning journey.

## Hyper-Personalized Roadmaps
- AI generates a custom learning roadmap for every student.
- Continuously adapts to learner speed, strengths, and weaknesses.

## Adaptive Study and Assessments
- AI-optimized daily study schedules.
- Automatic revision of weak topics through calendar integration.
- Instant-feedback quizzes and auto-generated assessments.

## Behavioral Mastery System
- Ensures a student masters each topic before progressing.
- Reinforcement cycles support long-term retention.

## Distraction-Free Study Mode
- Blocks distractions to maintain session focus.
- Converts focused time into XP and rewards.

## Full-Loop Integration
- Modules like Courses, Calendar, Quizzes, Notes, and Roadmaps work together seamlessly.
- AI synchronizes performance data across the platform.
- Teachers get automated progress reports.

## Makes Learning Easier and More Effective
- Students benefit from an AI tutor, planner, evaluator, and focus assistant in one system.
- Teachers save significant time through automation.
- Parents gain transparency into progress and study habits.
- Learning becomes structured, consistent, and outcome-driven.

**Challenges we ran into**

# Challenges I Ran Into

## 1. Integrating Multiple AI Features Into One Flow
Connecting roadmaps, quizzes, daily tasks, notes, and behavioral mastery into one AI-driven system was complex.  
Each module required different prompt formats and data structures, causing inconsistent outputs.  
I solved this by creating a unified AI service layer that standardizes prompts and normalizes all responses before saving them.

## 2. Stabilizing Gemini API for Structured Outputs
Using the Gemini API to generate roadmaps, tasks, quizzes, and feedback initially produced messy or hallucinated results.  
The model often ignored JSON structures.  
I fixed this by enforcing strict schema-based prompting, adding cleanup functions, and validating the output before accepting it.

## 3. JWT Cookie Authentication in Production
JWT cookies worked locally but failed on Render due to cross-domain and secure-cookie policies.  
Logins were successful, but authenticated routes returned “Not authorized”.  
This was resolved by configuring CORS properly, enabling `SameSite=None`, setting cookies to `secure: true`, and matching HTTPS requirements.

## 4. Building the Real-Time Battle Arena
The battle arena required generating fast quizzes, tracking per-user performance, and computing analytics instantly.  
Initial versions lagged and sometimes lost user results.  
I optimized this by caching prompts, preloading AI models, and redesigning the scoring logic to make the system both fast and reliable.

**Challenges we ran into**

A Bug I Encountered & How I Solved It

While building this project, one of the biggest hurdles I ran into was placing the “Submit Quiz” button at the correct position — specifically at the bottom of all generated questions.

❌ The Problem

Originally, the Submit Quiz button was part of the control panel at the top of the quiz section. This caused two issues:

Users had to scroll back up after answering all questions just to submit.

When the quiz regenerated, the old button sometimes stayed disabled or didn’t align with the newly generated questions.

Additionally, because the quiz questions were dynamically inserted using JavaScript, trying to move the existing button using CSS or HTML didn’t work — it simply didn’t exist yet at the moment the quiz rendered.

🔍 Root Cause

The quiz questions were being created inside the renderQuiz() function, but the submit button wasn’t.
This meant:

It didn’t follow the quiz list

It wasn’t recreated on quiz regeneration

It stayed in the wrong place visually

✅ The Fix

I solved the problem by:

Removing the original submit button from the static HTML

Dynamically creating a new submit button inside renderQuiz()

Appending it at the bottom of the question list

Like this:

const submitBtn = document.createElement("button");
submitBtn.textContent = "Submit Quiz";
submitBtn.className = "btn";
submitBtn.onclick = submitQuiz;

quizArea.appendChild(submitBtn);


By generating the button right after all quiz questions are rendered, it:

Always appears in the correct position

Always belongs to the current quiz instance

Automatically refreshes when the quiz is regenerated

Delivers the best user experience

### LearnOra
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/learnora-c978) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/achiit/learnOra-frontend) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/SGo-7OHsxNI) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-hackCBS%208.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackcbs-8.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Learn in your way

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Manim](https://img.shields.io/badge/Manim-333333?style=flat-square) ![vitejs](https://img.shields.io/badge/vitejs-333333?style=flat-square) ![gemini](https://img.shields.io/badge/gemini-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Creating mathematical visualizations using libraries like Manim requires both programming skills and a deep understanding of mathematical syntax.
While Manim is incredibly powerful for animations, it’s inaccessible to non-programmers - especially educators or students who just want to visualize a math concept quickly.

Existing tools either:

Focus only on symbolic math (like WolframAlpha or Desmos), or

Require manual coding and debugging.

There’s no tool that bridges natural language understanding with precise code generation for Manim, ensuring that the output is both mathematically accurate and syntactically correct.

LearnOra solves this by using a RAG model trained on Manim documentation, code examples, and mathematical concepts, enabling it to retrieve the right code snippets and generate working visualizations from plain English prompts.

**Challenges we ran into**

1. Understanding the Abstraction Gap

Natural language like

“Show a sine wave expanding and rotating in 3D”
is very high-level, while Manim code requires exact classes, methods, and scene structures.
Bridging that semantic gap required fine-tuning prompt templates and curating example-rich documentation chunks for retrieval.

2. Chunking the Manim Documentation Effectively

Manim’s documentation mixes API references, tutorials, and code examples.
If chunked incorrectly, the retriever would bring irrelevant or incomplete snippets (e.g., only function definitions without context).
We had to experiment with hierarchical chunking (function → class → usage) and semantic embedding models (e.g., all-MiniLM / OpenAI text-embedding-3-large) to ensure the model retrieved complete and meaningful references.

3. Retrieval Noise

Sometimes multiple Manim methods achieve similar effects (e.g., Transform vs. ReplacementTransform).
The retriever often fetched overlapping code blocks that confused the generator.
We mitigated this using similarity score thresholds and context ranking based on prior successful generations.

4. Syntax-Safe Code Generation

LLMs sometimes hallucinate methods that don’t exist in Manim (e.g., Wave3D()), which breaks rendering.
We introduced a post-processing validator that:

Runs a static syntax check (python -m py_compile)

Searches retrieved documentation for all functions used in the code

Re-prompts the model with feedback if invalid methods are detected.

5. Rendering Bottlenecks

Even with correct code, video rendering using Manim (via Cairo/OpenGL) is heavy and slow.
We optimized by:

Using low-res previews (480p) for instant demos

Caching repeated renders

Deploying asynchronous render queues using Celery + Redis.

6. Aligning Math Semantics with Animation Logic

Prompts like

“Show area under curve y = x² from 0 to 3”
require both symbolic math understanding and animation sequencing (graph → fill area → highlight region).
We integrated a math parser (SymPy) to interpret functions, then passed structured data to the RAG model so it could generate Manim scenes with logical flow.

7. Evaluation & Debugging

It’s tricky to evaluate whether generated animations “match the intent” of a prompt.
We implemented a 3-level evaluation:

Syntax validity

Render success

Semantic alignment (manual check + feedback loop)

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/alfredo-cook-smartly-36b1) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Prthmsh7/HackCBS8.0) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1SXWwHqhOxOIfvIMOhk7w4HWSWKQ4-nx4?usp=drive_link) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-hackCBS%208.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackcbs-8.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> What should I cook today?

![Artificial Intelligence](https://img.shields.io/badge/Artificial%20Intelligence-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flutter](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flutter-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**WHAT SHOULD I COOK TODAY?**

**Challenges we ran into**

Developing Alfredo in Flutter introduced several technical challenges, especially around integrating real-time conversational AI and voice-first interaction. The first major hurdle was achieving smooth, low-latency speech-to-text and text-to-speech synchronization. Flutter’s asynchronous event handling required careful coordination between the speech_to_text and flutter_tts packages to avoid delays or overlapping audio. Ensuring that Alfredo could listen, process, and respond naturally — similar to ChatGPT’s voice mode — involved optimizing how the app waited for API responses and queued speech playback.

Another major challenge was AI model integration via the A4F API. Many models returned access or rate-limit errors, which forced the implementation of automatic fallbacks and request throttling to maintain conversation continuity. Managing asynchronous HTTP requests while keeping the UI responsive and preventing freezes on slower networks also required custom handling using isolates and background processing.

From a design perspective, building a clean and voice-first UI in Flutter that still provided clear visual feedback was difficult. Balancing between hands-free usage and intuitive touch interactions required a lot of iteration in UI/UX flow. Additionally, real-time updates for nutrition tracking, AI-generated recipes, and pantry management demanded efficient state management with Provider and local caching to support partial offline access.

In short, making Alfredo feel alive, fast, and context-aware within the constraints of Flutter’s mobile runtime was a significant challenge — but also the most rewarding part of the build.

**BLOG WRITING COMPETITION**

While Alfredo started as an AI-powered nutrition assistant, one of the most rewarding parts of building it was the community recipes feature. It turned the app into more than just a personal tracker — it became a space where people could share their food stories. Every recipe someone uploads isn’t just about ingredients; it’s about a memory, a cultural twist, or a healthy idea worth sharing.

That’s where it naturally connects to blog writing. In a way, these recipes are small personal blogs, written through food. Some users like to write detailed stories about where their dish came from, others prefer quick healthy hacks — and Alfredo gives everyone that space. The AI can help polish their writing, suggest creative descriptions, or even make the recipes more accessible to others, but the heart of it still comes from real people sharing what they love.

So even though Alfredo is built with tech and AI at its core, its most meaningful part is human — helping people express themselves through their cooking and connecting through those shared stories. That’s what makes it a great fit for a blog writing competition.

**Best Use of Gemini API**

In Alfredo, the Google Gemini API powers the app’s AI understanding and generation features — it’s the intelligence behind the conversations and recipe creation. Specifically, Gemini is used for natural language processing (NLP) and context-aware content generation.

When a user speaks or types something like “Make something with oats and banana” or “Give me a high-protein breakfast recipe”, the app sends this query to the Gemini model. Gemini processes the input, understands the user’s intent and available pantry items, and then generates a personalized recipe suggestion — often with step-by-step instructions, nutritional details, and ingredient substitutions.

It’s also used in the community feature, where Gemini helps users improve their recipe descriptions or generate creative titles and summaries — like a smart writing assistant for food blogs. Additionally, Gemini helps Alfredo respond naturally during voice conversations by giving context-aware replies instead of static text, making the assistant feel more human and engaging.

In simple terms, Gemini is the creative and conversational brain of Alfredo — it interprets what users say, turns that into meaningful actions, and helps generate useful, personalized, and expressive responses across both the nutrition and community sections of the app.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

This project automates Shopify data ingestion, stores it securely for multiple tenants, and visualizes key metrics like sales, revenue, and top customers through an interactive dashboard — making data analysis faster, easier, and smarter.

**Challenges we ran into**

One major challenge was handling multi-tenancy — ensuring that data from different Shopify stores remained isolated and secure. I overcame this by adding a tenant identifier in the database schema and API routes, so each store’s data was stored and fetched independently.

Another hurdle was authenticating with Shopify APIs, especially managing access tokens during setup. I resolved this by carefully following Shopify’s OAuth flow and testing API calls using Postman before integrating them into the backend service.

> An AI Assistant to find right teammates.

![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Streamlit](https://img.shields.io/badge/Streamlit-333333?style=flat-square) ![langchain](https://img.shields.io/badge/langchain-333333?style=flat-square) ![LangGraph](https://img.shields.io/badge/LangGraph-333333?style=flat-square) ![pineconeDb](https://img.shields.io/badge/pineconeDb-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Finding an perfect hackathon team-mates is very tough and challenging especially when you are looking for particular skill set and they need to be in particular location. 
To make this easier, I developed an AI-Powered Teammate Search Platform that simplifies the entire process.

Users can create a profile on the platform, add their skills and experience, and then simply enter a query for example “Looking for a frontend developer familiar with React and AI tools.”
AI Agent will automatically search for the most compatible teammates and it will returns ranked results with a matching score, explaining how closely each person fits your criteria.

**Challenges we ran into**

Some of the huddles i faced was - 

1. Choosing the best strategy between the vector based search or hybrid search( keyword + vector). I tried both the approach and the hybrid search gave a more good result for the user query. Exact skill/role were matched by keyword filters and vector search captured semantic similarity.

2. Prompt caching was another issue which i faced. If user entered the different prompt the contextual meaning of the prompt was same then the agent has to recompute everything. So i came up with semantic prompt caching. It normalises the query and create embeddings and store in the vector db. so when user enter new prompt and similarity of the prompt is >= 0.95 we server the same result.

3. For agentic workflow i have used langgraph. I have created different states which allowed me to pass the data between the graph node. I have attached the screenshot below of the graph workflow.

> Old for you, Gold for someone

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**ReWear – Community Clothing Exchange** is designed to tackle one of the most overlooked sustainability issues — clothing waste. Every year, millions of wearable clothes end up in landfills while countless people struggle to access basic clothing. ReWear bridges this gap by creating a community-driven digital platform where individuals can donate, exchange, or request clothes in a safe, transparent, and convenient way.

Through ReWear, people can:
- Easily upload their unused clothes with images and details.
- Explore available items uploaded by others in their area.
- Request or exchange clothing items directly through the platform.
- Contribute to a circular fashion economy and reduce textile waste.

By making clothing exchange simple, digital, and community-focused, ReWear empowers users to make eco-friendly choices while helping others — making sustainability accessible to everyone. 🌍♻️

**Challenges we ran into**

⚙️ Challenges I Ran Into

Building ReWear – Community Clothing Exchange wasn’t as easy as it looked. The biggest challenges included both technical and integration hurdles:

🔐 User Authentication Issues:
Initially, login and signup requests kept failing even though the API worked perfectly on Postman. The issue turned out to be CORS misconfiguration and mismatched API routes between frontend and backend. After carefully debugging network requests and aligning all routes, authentication started working seamlessly.

🧩 Connecting Frontend with Backend:
Fetching and displaying uploaded clothing items dynamically from the database required careful handling of async API calls and state updates in React. We fixed it by restructuring our useEffect hooks and ensuring proper API endpoint responses.

☁️ Deployment Challenges:
Deploying both the backend and frontend on AWS caused environment variable and image-loading issues. Adjusting environment paths and using Cloudinary for image hosting helped stabilize everything.

These challenges taught us real-world debugging, frontend-backend synchronization, and how to make a project production-ready with robust APIs and clean state management. 💪

**Build on Aptos**

ReWear aligns strongly with the Aptos Blockchain track because it integrates decentralization, trustless ownership verification, and transparent transactions into the sustainable fashion ecosystem. Here’s how:


🧾 On-Chain Proof of Ownership (NFTs on Aptos):
Every uploaded clothing item can be tokenized as an NFT on the Aptos blockchain, representing digital proof of ownership. This ensures authenticity, prevents duplicate listings, and lets users transfer item ownership securely between community members.


♻️ Transparent Exchange Records:
Using Aptos smart contracts, we can maintain immutable records of all exchanges — who donated what, who received it, and when. This creates trust and accountability within the ReWear community.


💰 Reward Mechanism:
Contributors who donate or exchange items can earn Aptos-based tokens as a reward, encouraging more participation and promoting a sustainable clothing cycle.


⚡ Built for Speed and Scalability:
The Aptos blockchain’s Move language and parallel execution engine make it perfect for high-frequency community interactions (uploads, exchanges, verifications) without performance issues.


🌐 Integration Simplicity:
Using the Aptos SDK, ReWear can directly integrate wallet-based logins, transaction signing, and NFT minting, making blockchain features accessible to non-technical users.

> Agentic AI for Smarter Channel Partner Management

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![AWS](https://img.shields.io/badge/AWS-333333?style=flat-square) ![nestjs](https://img.shields.io/badge/nestjs-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![OpenAi](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenAi-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Real estate developers and channel partners currently operate in a disjointed environment — juggling multiple tools, spreadsheets, and manual communications. Tracking visits, managing offers, monitoring broker performance, and maintaining updated marketing collateral often become chaotic and time-consuming.

The CP Management Tool solves these inefficiencies by embedding Agentic AI into the real estate ecosystem — automating communication, data management, and analytics in one unified platform.

How It Helps

🧠 Centralized Intelligence: View all projects, offers, leads, and site visits in one dashboard.

🤖 Agentic Automation: Automatically handle broker interactions, follow-ups, and sourcing tasks.

📊 Actionable Insights: Get real-time analytics on performance, growth trends, and broker engagement.

💬 Smart Collaboration: Channel partners can access marketing and sales materials instantly through an AI chatbot.

⚡ Less Manual Work: Replaces repetitive, human-dependent tasks with intelligent automation.

🔒 Secure Ecosystem: Ensures all broker–developer data and communication remain protected and controlled.

In essence, the CP Management Tool brings automation, intelligence, and structure to the developer–broker workflow — making real estate operations faster, safer, and effortlessly scalable.

**Challenges we ran into**

Building the CP Management Tool came with several technical and architectural challenges, especially while integrating multiple AI-driven systems into a single real estate workflow.

1. Data Structuring for Channel Partners

One of the toughest hurdles was handling inconsistent broker data from multiple sources — duplicates, missing fields, and unstandardized formats.
Solution: We built a dynamic data normalization pipeline that cleans, categorizes, and prioritizes broker data using AI-assisted validation, ensuring accuracy at scale.

2. Real-Time Synchronization

Managing real-time updates between the developer dashboard and the chatbot was initially unstable, especially when multiple users interacted simultaneously.
Solution: Implemented a WebSocket-based architecture with queue management to ensure consistent and real-time data flow across both systems.

3. AI Model Training & Response Alignment

Training the AI model to understand context-specific queries from brokers (like “show me offers for Project X”) required fine-tuning on domain-specific data.
Solution: Created a hybrid training approach using both structured project data and natural language FAQs to make responses precise and conversational.

4. User Experience Optimization

Balancing the complexity of analytics, lead tracking, and AI tools within a clean and intuitive interface was a design challenge.
Solution: Adopted a modular UI approach — each module (Projects, Offers, Leads, etc.) was separated but connected seamlessly for smooth navigation.

**Best AWS Hack**

We intentionally built the project to maximize AWS’ strengths: resilient compute, durable object storage, and a tightly coupled database layer running on AWS. Using EC2 instances to host both n8n (workflow automation) and our backend gives us fine-grained control over runtime, networking, and scaling behavior while keeping everything inside an AWS environment. All binary and static assets are stored in an S3 bucket for highly-available, low-cost storage and simple integration with the app and CI/CD pipelines. Our application data is served from MongoDB hosted on AWS (deployed within the AWS account/VPC) to ensure low latency, secure networking, and consistent operational control.

This architecture proves we can design, deploy, and operate a full-stack production system on AWS — which is the core objective of the track.

**Best Agentic AI**

The CP Management Tool is built entirely around Agentic AI — every feature, decision, and interaction in the system is driven by autonomous, intelligent agents working together to simplify real estate operations.

1. Agentic Workflow Automation

Instead of static dashboards or rule-based bots, the system uses autonomous agents that take proactive actions:

The AI Sourcing Agent scans, prioritizes, and recommends brokers using live data.

The Communication Agent handles mass messaging, follow-ups, and personalized outreach.

The Analytics Agent continuously learns from interactions, identifying top-performing brokers, trends, and deal patterns.

The Knowledge Agent trains on developer-specific data (projects, offers, policies) to power the chatbot and voice assistant.

These agents don’t just respond — they think, decide, and act based on context.

2. AI-Powered Developer Dashboard

The developer dashboard uses Agentic AI to analyze real-time data from brokers, visits, and campaigns.
It auto-generates insights like growth trends, top customers, and performance forecasts — removing the need for manual tracking or human data analysis.

3. Chatbot with Agentic Intelligence

The chatbot isn’t rule-based — it’s context-aware and action-driven. It can understand queries like:

“Show me the best-performing project this month”
“Book a site visit for tomorrow”
“Send marketing collateral for Project X to 20 brokers”

It then performs these actions autonomously by invoking the right internal agents.

4. Continuous Learning Loop

Every interaction — whether a lead update, site visit, or broker message — feeds back into the system. The AI continuously refines broker priorities, campaign strategies, and communication tone through reinforcement-like learning patterns.

5. Voice & Natural Language Interface

The Agentic Voice Layer allows brokers to communicate naturally — the AI interprets speech, identifies intent, and executes relevant actions instantly.

In Short

The CP Management Tool isn’t just using AI — it’s built on Agentic AI.
It operates as a network of autonomous agents that learn, collaborate, and execute tasks without human micromanagement — making real estate operations self-running, intelligent, and infinitely scalable.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Swappify - The Problem It Solves
🎯 Problem Statement
In today's consumer-driven society, we face three critical challenges:

Environmental Crisis: Millions of usable items end up in landfills annually, contributing to waste pollution and resource depletion
Economic Inequality: Many people cannot afford new items they need, while others have unused items gathering dust
Community Disconnect: Traditional commerce lacks personal connection and trust-building opportunities
💡 Our Solution: Swappify
Swappify is a zero-money, community-driven barter platform that enables people to exchange items they don't need for items they do need - without spending a single rupee.

🌟 What Makes Swappify Unique
1. 100% Money-Free Economy
No payment processing
No transaction fees
No hidden costs

**Challenges we ran into**

🚧 Challenges I Ran Into
1️⃣ Google Maps API Billing Crisis 💳
The Problem:
Google Maps API required credit card verification and billing setup, even for the free tier. This was a blocker for a student project.

The Solution:
Migrated to OpenStreetMap + Leaflet - completely free, open-source, and no billing required. Bonus: better aligned with our accessibility mission.

2️⃣ React-Leaflet Version Incompatibility 🔥
The Problem:
After switching to Leaflet, the Add Item page showed blank. Error: render2 is not a function. React-Leaflet v5 expected React 19, but we used React 18.

The Solution:
Downgraded to compatible versions:

bash
npm install react-leaflet@4.2.1 leaflet@1.9.4 --legacy-peer-deps
Moved Leaflet CSS to main.jsx for global scope.

3️⃣ Vercel Deployment Build Failures 🚀
The Problem:
Build worked locally but failed on Vercel with path resolution errors:

Error: Rollup failed to resolve import "/src/main.jsx"
The Solution:
Deployed pre-built dist folder instead of letting Vercel build from source. Built locally, deployed the compiled output via Vercel CLI.

4️⃣ Firebase Real-time Chat Sync 💬
The Problem:
Messages not appearing in real-time, duplicate messages, inconsistent ordering.

The Solution:
Implemented proper real-time listeners with onSnapshot() and cleanup:

javascript
const unsubscribe = onSnapshot(
  query(messagesRef, orderBy('timestamp', 'asc')),
  (snapshot) => setMessages(snapshot.docs.map(doc => doc.data()))
);
return () => unsubscribe();
5️⃣ Image Upload Performance 📸
The Problem:
Users uploading 5-10MB phone photos, causing slow uploads and storage concerns.

The Solution:
Client-side image compression before upload - reduced images from 5MB to 200-300KB (95% reduction) while maintaining quality.

🎓 Key Lessons Learned
Always research pricing before integrating third-party APIs
Version compatibility matters - check library requirements
Have backup deployment strategies when primary fails
Optimize media files before upload
Real-time features need proper cleanup to prevent memory leaks
Open-source alternatives can be better than paid solutions
Every challenge made the platform more robust and taught valuable lessons about building production-ready applications. 🚀✨

### Garuda.AI
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/garudaai-f1bf) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/UzairProg/GarudaAI) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://garuda-ai.netlify.app/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HACKSTROM%202025-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackstrom-1.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Atmanirbhar Vigilance. Unbreakable Defense.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Selenium](https://img.shields.io/badge/Selenium-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Express.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Express.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Hyperledger](https://img.shields.io/badge/Hyperledger-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Twilio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Twilio-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**The Problem It Solves**
**Fragmented Security Tools:**
Cybersecurity analysts currently depend on multiple independent tools (Nmap, Nessus, OpenVAS, Nuclei, etc.), each producing large, unstructured reports that are difficult to correlate.

**Delayed Vulnerability Response:**
The absence of an integrated platform leads to delayed identification and prioritization of vulnerabilities, increasing the window of exposure for cyberattacks.

**Manual Data Correlation:**
Analysts spend excessive time merging scan results, mapping CVEs, and verifying data from multiple intelligence sources — a process prone to human error.

**No Real-Time Alerting:**
Traditional scanners provide results after full completion, not in real time. This delay prevents teams from taking immediate preventive action during active threats.

**Lack of Contextual Understanding:**
Existing systems detect vulnerabilities but fail to explain the underlying cause, possible exploit chain, and effective remediation strategy in an understandable format.

**Data Integrity and Traceability Issues:**
Reports shared manually between teams can be altered or lost, compromising data reliability and auditability.

How Garuda-AI Makes Tasks Easier and Safer

**Unified Cyber Intelligence Platform:**
Garuda-AI consolidates multiple vulnerability scanners into one intelligent dashboard, eliminating tool fragmentation and simplifying management.

**AI-Powered Analysis and Reasoning:**
It leverages Artificial Intelligence to analyze, prioritize, and predict possible exploit chains — transforming raw scan results into actionable insights.

**NLP-Based Solution Generation:**
Using Natural Language Processing (NLP), Garuda-AI automatically interprets complex vulnerabilities and provides concise, human-readable solutions with clear remediation steps for each issue.

**Real-Time Alerts and Notifications:**
The system continuously monitors active scans and generates real-time alerts for critical vulnerabilities, enabling instant response and mitigation.

**Automated Reporting and Knowledge Correlation:**
Garuda-AI correlates results from various tools, enriches them with global threat intelligence (CVE, NVD, ExploitDB), and auto-generates structured, detailed reports.

**Blockchain-Enabled Data Integrity:**
All reports and audit logs are stored securely using blockchain, ensuring immutability, traceability, and transparency.

**Adaptive and Scalable Design:**
Built using microservices, Garuda-AI can scale effortlessly across cloud or on-prem environments, adapting to organizations of any size.

**Supporting India’s Atmanirbhar Cyber Vision:

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/1a86212572204284b7c0becc2d4bc1ef/0133f298-2f34-4f05-8c6b-3bbd42ea23b0.jpeg)

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/1a86212572204284b7c0becc2d4bc1ef/210eedbd-b937-4af1-aa16-8ddd74cce2ff.jpeg)

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/1a86212572204284b7c0becc2d4bc1ef/25b90a14-b941-4285-acc7-878ff1cdea97.jpeg)

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/1a86212572204284b7c0becc2d4bc1ef/fbca8c15-69f2-4e35-99cd-777a21504e8b.jpeg)

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/1a86212572204284b7c0becc2d4bc1ef/9bdaf0bf-a208-4cd6-a14a-9b704d78b526.jpeg)

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/1a86212572204284b7c0becc2d4bc1ef/fe3970f7-01fb-4185-b13e-9ae6b767d89a.jpeg)**
Designed and developed indigenously, Garuda-AI contributes to India’s self-reliant, secure, and intelligent cyber defense ecosystem.

**Summary**

Garuda-AI unifies the entire vulnerability management cycle — from detection to decision — under one AI-powered, blockchain-secured ecosystem.
By providing real-time alerts, AI-based prioritization, and NLP-generated remediation guidance, it empowers cybersecurity teams to act faster, smarter, and more confidently.

**Challenges we ran into**

**Challenges I Ran Into**

**Integrating Multiple Scanning Tools**:
Combining outputs from tools like Nmap, Nessus, Nuclei, and OpenVAS into one consistent format was one of the toughest tasks.
Each tool had a different data structure and result schema.
Solution: We developed a custom parser and normalization layer that converted all results into a unified JSON format for AI processing.

**Building Real-Time Alerting System**:
Ensuring that Garuda-AI could provide instant notifications during scans was a challenge because most scanners complete asynchronously.
Solution: We implemented asynchronous background workers and event-driven WebSocket communication to stream live scan progress and alerts to the dashboard.

**AI & NLP-Based Solution Generation**:
Training the AI to generate concise and accurate remediation guidance in natural language required extensive dataset tuning and prompt optimization.
Solution: We fine-tuned a lightweight NLP model using vulnerability datasets (CVE descriptions, NVD data, and ExploitDB entries) and created a prompt-based reasoning engine for human-readable outputs.

**Ensuring Data Integrity via Blockchain**:
Integrating blockchain for tamper-proof report storage initially caused performance delays during data write operations.
Solution: We introduced an asynchronous blockchain commit queue and batch verification to balance performance and integrity.

**Coordinating AI with Threat Intelligence Feeds**:
Fetching and correlating real-time CVE and exploit data without API rate limits or slowdowns was tricky.
Solution: Implemented intelligent caching and periodic sync jobs to locally mirror threat feeds for offline and faster access.

**UI/UX Complexity for Multi-Role Users**:
Designing a single interface usable by admins, analysts, and developers required balancing simplicity with functionality.
Solution: We built a role-based dynamic dashboard with modular components that adapt based on user permissions.

**Summary**

Building Garuda-AI was a technically demanding process — especially integrating multiple scanners, live alerting, and AI-based reasoning within a single ecosystem.
By overcoming these challenges through modular design, asynchronous processing, and optimized NLP logic, the system became faster, more intelligent, and more reliable.

> Digital Steps Toward Sustainable Poultry

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

DIGI-FARM addresses these issues by providing a digital management system that helps farmers track hygiene tasks, monitor poultry health, receive real-time disease alerts, and follow standard biosecurity protocols. It also connects local farmers with government and veterinary departments for faster reporting and action.

This platform reduces the communication gap between farmers and authorities, minimizes disease spread, and enhances productivity through data-driven decisions — ultimately leading to sustainable poultry farming and financial stability for both farmers and the government.

**Challenges we ran into**

One major challenge was integrating multiple modules like disease alerts, hygiene tracking, and a multilingual dashboard into one platform without breaking functionality. We had to optimize the flow so that even users with limited technical knowledge could use it easily.

First hurdle was hosting the project live under limited time and resource constraints. Many free platforms had restrictions that made real-time deployment difficult, but after multiple trials and debugging, we managed to keep the system active temporarily for demo purposes.

We also faced data accuracy challenges — getting reliable information about poultry diseases and biosecurity standards required extensive research from FAO and ICAR guidelines. Translating that data into simple, user-friendly features was a big learning curve.

Despite these hurdles, teamwork, quick problem-solving, and adaptability helped us turn every roadblock into a learning opportunity.

> Empowering Farmers, One Smart Field at a Time

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![TensorFlow](https://img.shields.io/badge/TensorFlow-333333?style=flat-square) ![OpenCV](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenCV-333333?style=flat-square) ![Google Translate API](https://img.shields.io/badge/Google%20Translate%20API-333333?style=flat-square) ![OpenAi](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenAi-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Agriculture forms the backbone of India’s economy, yet smallholder farmers lack access to localized, real-time farming advice, government schemes, and smart market insights.
AGRINOVA addresses this gap with AI-powered, voice-enabled solutions tailored to empower every Indian farmer. Farmers often miss early signs of crop diseases, leading to low yield and financial loss.

Indian agriculture, employing over 50% of the workforce and a key GDP contributor, faces challenges that hinder productivity. Despite 60% of farmers owning smartphones [QQRI, 2022], only 1-2% use agritech apps [Times of India, 2022]. Smallholder farmers (86% of the sector) struggle with low incomes and limited market access [World Economic Forum, 2021].*** Key issues include***:

- Limited access to timely information on crops, markets, and schemes.
- Language barriers restricting resource comprehension.
- Complex government schemes causing confusion.
- Logistical challenges in accessing services like cold storages.
- Need for personalized farming advice.

Indian farmers need a user-friendly, multilingual platform for localized information, scheme access, and recommendations to enhance productivity and income.

**The problem AGRINOVA solves**

- No smart, real-time tools exist to detect or manage crop diseases effectively.
- Limited awareness among farmers to identify disease symptoms accurately.
- Manual inspection is slow, error-prone, and unsuitable for large-scale farms.
- Lack of access to agricultural experts in rural areas for timely guidance.
- Technology gap — minimal use of AI, IoT, and analytics in regular farming.
- Poor internet connectivity in villages restricts the use of online solutions.

Overall, farmers face inefficiency, low productivity, and repeated losses due to lack of intelligent, accessible tools.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges AGRINOVA Rans

**Data Quality & Model Reliability**
Collecting clean, labeled crop disease data was difficult due to inconsistent lighting, angles, and field conditions.
➤ Solution: We used image preprocessing and data augmentation to improve model accuracy and robustness.

**Cost & Accessibility of Advanced Hardware**
High-end drones, sensors, and GPUs were expensive and hard to access for continuous testing.
➤ Solution: Simulated drone data using open-source datasets and optimized the model to run on low-cost IoT boards.

**Scalability for Large Farmlands & Co-operatives**
Handling large-scale data from multiple devices created latency and performance bottlenecks.
➤ Solution: Implemented modular architecture with edge computing to process data locally before syncing with the cloud.

**Regional Soil & Climate Diversity**
Models trained on one region didn’t perform equally well in other climatic zones.
➤ Solution: Incorporated region-specific datasets and adaptive learning to improve prediction accuracy across geographies.

**Best Use of AWS — In Association with AWS**

### Anna Bazaar
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/anna-bazaar-cf42) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Mr-Swapnil25/HackSpire) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/27_NRY4riw4) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackSpire'25-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackspire25.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Anna ka rang, Zindagi ka sang.

![Firebase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flutter](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flutter-333333?style=flat-square) ![Firestore](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firestore-333333?style=flat-square) ![AI/ML](https://img.shields.io/badge/AI/ML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Firebase Cloud Messaging](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase%20Cloud%20Messaging-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The problem solved by the "Anna Bazaar" platform, is primarily the challenge faced by small and marginal farmers in accessing fair and transparent markets. Traditionally, these farmers struggle with the dominance of intermediaries who take a significant cut of the profits, leaving farmers with reduced earnings and minimal bargaining power. This problem exists because the agricultural marketing system is fragmented with multiple layers, which restricts direct connectivity between farmers and buyers.

### What Anna Bazaar Solves

- Direct connection between farmers and buyers, eliminating middlemen and increasing farmer profits through transparent listing and negotiation.
- Real-time price information and negotiation enabled by AI-powered automation, allowing farmers to get fair market rates.
- Hassle-free digital transactions with secure payments tailored specifically for agriculture commerce.
- Addresses technology adoption barriers through multilingual support and an intuitive interface, making it accessible to farmers with low digital literacy.
- Automated quality checks and crop listing using AI, saving time and ensuring product quality.
- Protection of Minimum Support Price (MSP) automatically through the platform.
- Localized regional adaptation to support diverse crops, languages, and farming practices.


### How It Makes Tasks Easier or Safer

- **Saves Time:** AI automation reduces the time needed for listing crops and managing transactions by over 70%.
- **Reduces Costs:** Removes intermediaries, reducing transaction costs and increasing farmer income.
- **Improves User Experience:** Multilingual support and a guided, intuitive interface ease technology adoption for rural users.
- **Enhances Security:** Features like secure logins, encrypted data, and KYC verification protect users and transactions.
- **Empowers Users:** Real-time price and weather insights help farmers make smarter decisions.
- **Facilitates Direct Negotiation:** Live chat-based negotiation lets farmers and buyers discuss and agree on prices transparently.


### Use Cases

- Small and marginal farmers can use the platform to sell their produce directly to buyers at fair rates.
- Rural producer groups and agri-organizations can aggregate produce and negotiate with bulk buyers efficiently.
- Retailers and urban consumers gain access to fresh, high-quality, traceable farm produce with transparency.
- Agri-businesses and cooperatives can leverage data insights and digital advisory through the platform.

Overall, Anna Bazaar streamlines agriculture commerce by creating a transparent, secure, and accessible marketplace directly linking farmers with buyers, enhancing profitability, and empowering farmers digitally in local languages.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the main challenges encountered while building the Anna Bazaar platform was handling the fragmentation and complexity of the agricultural marketing system, which involved multiple layers of intermediaries and limited direct access between farmers and buyers. This created hurdles in building a transparent, real-time negotiation and transaction platform that could be easily accessible and trusted by small and marginal farmers with low digital literacy.

Specific implementation hurdles included:

- Ensuring real-time price updates and market data accuracy, which required integration with live government price databases and weather APIs.
- Developing AI-powered automation for crop listing and quality checks that had to be reliable and efficient even on low-end mobile devices with intermittent internet connectivity.
- Providing a smooth multilingual user experience to overcome language barriers common in rural areas.
- Implementing secure and seamless digital payment systems tailored to farming transactions with proper KYC verification to guarantee safety.
- Overcoming user adoption challenges by designing an intuitive interface suitable for first-time digital users and providing continuous support.

The team overcame these hurdles by leveraging a tech stack with cross-platform Flutter UI for accessibility, Firebase for scalable backend services, and Google Cloud AI tools such as TensorFlow Lite for on-device AI predictions. They also integrated Google Translate to support 22 Indian languages, ensuring inclusivity. The solution included real-time government price compliance for transparency and KYC-based security features to build user trust. Continuous feedback loops and user education helped ease the adoption barrier among farmers.

This approach collectively addressed the technical, language, security, and user experience challenges to create an effective, user-friendly marketplace empowering farmers and buyers alike.

### dammn
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/dammn-fea0) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://dammn.xyz) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/90-WAcC4Xs8) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Base%20Batches%20002:%20Builder%20Track-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://base-batches-builder-track.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> transact. save. earn.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Saving spare change is a classic financial habit, but it's always been broken or never really existed onchain. Every small deposit had to be done manually, and earning real yield requires active management. But not anymore.

dammn is an onchain microsavings app that puts your spare change to work. It's a "set and forget" savings layer for your smart wallet. After a simple one-time setup, every transaction you make in the stablecoin you approve —sends, trades, purchases, contract interactions —is automatically rounded up to the nearest dollar. The spare change is then put into a high-yield Morpho Vault where it can grow. The user can withdraw their stablecoins at any time with one click of a button.

dammn is designed to make saving and earning yield an invisible, effortless background process, turning every onchain interaction into savings.

**Automation - your personal, onchain savings machine.**

- One Time Setup, You approve your stablecoin/s once using spend permissions.

- Invisible Savings, Every send, swap, or onchain interaction becomes a savings opportunity, without you lifting a finger.

- Gasless, The integrated paymaster covers the gas fees on all savings deposits and withdrawals, so every cent of your spare change goes directly to work for you.

- Real Yield, Your savings don't just sit there, they're put into a Morpho Vault to earn real, onchain yield.

**Challenges we ran into**

One challenge I ran into was deciding on the architecture for tracking and filtering user transactions in real time. I first built a system using a direct WebSocket connection to an RPC node. It required complex logic to handle connection drops and would have been a significant infrastructure and computational burden to scale and maintain. After some research, I found and pivoted to using Alchemy's Webhooks. This completely offloaded the responsibility of blockchain listening aswell and saving a lot of computational resources. Instead of the server constantly managing a connection, Alchemy simply notifies the app when a transaction from a users wallet occurs, then the backend filters it and decides weather or not to round it and deposit the change to a Morpho Vault. This made the backend simpler, more reliable, and alot more scalable.

Another challenge I ran into was the backend implementation of spend permissions. I initially faced a problem where I was getting a gas estimation with the cdp server wallets error when trying to use the spend permission, the problem was that the permission wasn't approved onchain. The solution was to create the approval logic on frontend where it would approve onchain right as the user approved it.

**Link to the GitHub Repo of your project**

https://github.com/Ga-1ile0/dammnpublic

**Live URL of your project**

https://dammn.xyz

**What is your product’s unique value proposition?**

Active management is the biggest barrier to entry for saving onchain. Users need to constantly be depositing their funds, constantly clicking, approving, and paying gas. dammns unique value proposition is turning this active process into a passive, invisible, and automated experience where the user doesn't even have to think about it.

dammn stands out by being an automated savings layer rather than just an interface. The real magic is the seamlessness and automation, users don't have to do anything after they approve the spend permission for their savings to grow. This is powered by base account, making a web2 like experience possible onchain.

The alpha build directly validates this. It demonstrates the core "magic loop" that no competitor offers

    - A user grants a simple spend permission.

    - They make any onchain transaction (like a send or swap).

    - They see their spare change automatically appear in a high-yield Morpho Vault, without any further interaction or gas fees.

This proves our core promise, dammn makes saving and earning an effortless byproduct of daily onchain activity.

**Who is your target customer?**

The initial target customers are crypto-native individuals who use the base app/base account. These users are already transacting onchain, buying and selling coins, NFTs, and engaging with mini apps, but find the complexity of active saving to be a major time sink. They understand the value of saving and yield but want smart, automated tools that work for them in the background. I’ve confirmed this through DMs to TBA users, and many of them said similar things. They said that if there was an option or a way they could save onchain without actively thinking and acting on it by approving and depositing tokens, they would definitely use it. The desire for "set and forget" tools is a constant theme. Users are looking for ways to make their assets productive without having to think about it.

**Who are your closest competitors and how are you different?**

Competitors fall into two categories

1.  **FinTech Round-Up Apps,** **Acorns** ([acorns.com](https://acorns.com)) and **Digit** ([oportun.com/savings](https://oportun.com/savings/)) are the biggest competitors in this category. They pioneered the automated micro savings model in web2. Dammn in different because its transparent, and built onchain. Users direct access to the newest yield protocols, not the low-yield bank accounts used by the FinTech counterparts. It doesn't matter where in the world the user is to start saving and earning yield, unlike with the web2 counterparts.
2. **Manual yield protocols:** There are some powerful tools for active DeFi users like Morpho itself or other yield protocols, providing an interface to interact with protocols. Dammn is a passive, automated savings engine. The true competitor is having to actively deposit into these protocols, dammn is 10x better because the user doesn't have to even think about saving and they'll be doing it, automation is key.

**What is your distribution strategy and why?**

At first the distribution will be on X, Farcaster, Base app where the target costumers spend thier time, this could be from asking active onchain creators to try and share their experience with using and saving with the app, The next phase of distribution will be in the base app directly via the mini app once spend permissions are supported, apperently this quarter tentatively. The unique advantage is the frictionless user experience powered by the account abstraction and spend permissions on base. This creates a sort of **"wow"** moment of real **"set and forget"** onchain savings that is currently only possible on base. An insight I have that makes this GTM work is that the biggest barrier to DeFi adoption is complexity, approving, signing, and depositing. By removing this barrier to entry, making the UX seamless and automated, it bypasses competitors where the user has to actually interact with their product to save and earn yield. This is the best strategy because the product's best marketing is the product itself. Most individuals value demonstration over advertising, and by showing them an effortlessly simple way to save, dammn will build the momentum needed to scale.

### Curio
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/curio-6fdc) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/72c1LUKW0XQ) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Base%20Batches%20002:%20Builder%20Track-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://base-batches-builder-track.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Rewarding curation

![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![YouTube Data API](https://img.shields.io/badge/YouTube%20Data%20API-333333?style=flat-square) ![Supabase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Supabase-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

In today’s music ecosystem, discovery is dominated by algorithms, not people. Great taste has no economic value, and independent curators—who shape culture every day on social media—have no way to earn from their influence.
Curio changes that.

Curio turns music curation into an onchain, rewardable act.
Anyone can:

- Share tracks they love (from Spotify, YouTube, or other platforms).

- Build playlists that earn reputation and tips as listeners engage.

- Discover new music through trusted human taste instead of opaque feeds.

By connecting listeners, curators, and artists directly onchain, Curio makes music discovery more transparent, rewarding, and community-owned.
It gives cultural value the same economic dignity that technical or financial work already has in web3.

**Challenges we ran into**

Building Curio forced me to connect multiple layers — music embeds, feed sharing, and onchain tipping — all within the Base app ecosystem.
One of the biggest challenges was handling music streaming across platforms. Spotify embeds only play short previews, while YouTube embeds allow full tracks but need API logic for autoplay and playlist transitions. I had to build a custom YouTube Player integration using the IFrame API to make Curio feel seamless and “native.”

Another hurdle was designing the data flow between curators, playlists, and tracks in Supabase. I restructured the schema multiple times to support curator dashboards, featured playlists, and dynamic track lists.

Finally, the biggest creative challenge was realising that technical functionality wasn’t enough — the app needed social energy. That’s when I redesigned Curio’s flow around curators and reward loops, so every playlist or “repost” feels like building cultural capital, not just using a tool.

**Link to the GitHub Repo of your project**

https://github.com/ethrahere/music-curator

**Live URL of your project**

https://music-curator.vercel.app

**What is your product’s unique value proposition?**

Curio makes taste valuable.

While most music platforms reward streams or sales, Curio rewards curation itself — the act of finding and sharing great music.
Each curator builds reputation and earns rewards based on the engagement their playlists receive: plays, likes, and re-adds by others. This flips the usual dynamic — instead of chasing algorithms, listeners follow human taste.

The alpha build demonstrates this by letting users:

- Share playlists that play full tracks via YouTube integration.

- Tip or reward curators directly onchain for their taste.

It’s not another streaming app; it’s a social layer of human discovery on Base, where cultural value and economic value finally align.

**Who is your target customer?**

Curio is built for the next generation of music tastemakers — people who already share songs, build playlists, or post music recs online, but don’t earn anything for the culture they create.

Our ideal users are:

Independent curators who love digging for music and want their taste to have tangible value.

Artists and micro-collectives who use curation to build discovery loops around their sound.

Web3-native listeners and Base builders who value open platforms and onchain reputation.

Through early testing and community conversations, we found that many music lovers were already curating on platforms like Spotify or Farcaster but had no reason to keep doing it consistently. Curio gives them that reason — recognition, rewards, and belonging.

In short: Curio’s users are the ones who set the vibe of the internet — and now they can finally own it.

**Who are your closest competitors and how are you different?**

Curio sits at the intersection of music discovery and social curation, so our closest competitors are a mix of traditional music platforms and emerging onchain or social-music experiments:

- Factory.fm : https://factory.fm - Factory focuses on music reviews and playlists as editorial content. Curio focuses on curation as a social-onchain act — every playlist is linked to a curator’s identity, score, and earning potential.

- Audius: https://audius.co - Audius is a decentralized streaming platform for artists. Curio doesn’t host music — it connects existing streaming links and rewards the curators who surface them.

- Sound.xyz: https://sound.xyz - Sound rewards artists through collectible music drops. Curio rewards listeners and curators for discovery and taste, creating a complementary layer on top of platforms like Sound.

In short: They monetize music. Curio monetizes taste.

Our approach builds an open, composable “curation layer” that any artist, listener, or app can plug into — making human discovery a native part of the Base ecosystem.

**What is your distribution strategy and why?**

Curio’s growth strategy is community-driven and network-based, not paid.
Our audience already exists in creative web3 circles — on Farcaster, Base, and independent music subcultures — so our goal is to activate taste networks, not chase mass users.

We’ll grow through three loops:

- Curator Loop: Onboard small, high-signal curators through private “Curio Seasons.” Each season features limited curators whose playlists are showcased and rewarded publicly. Early seasons create social proof and narrative.

- Social Loop: Integrate Base sharing and tipping directly, so every playlist shared becomes its own marketing channel. Every tip or “add to playlist” action posts automatically, bringing Curio content into public timelines.

- Incentive Loop: Reward discovery actions (listening, re-adding, tipping) with Curio Score or $CURIO rewards, turning participation into reputation. As the ecosystem matures, these rewards will tie into Base’s onchain social graph and identity layers.

This strategy works because Curio’s value isn’t transactional — it’s social and cultural. The product spreads through taste, not ads. By focusing on curators with existing influence and giving them tools to own their discovery networks, Curio can grow organically, virally, and sustainably across the Base ecosystem.

**The problem it solves**

Early-stage founders struggle to create professional, investor-ready documents such as pitch decks, resumes, and accelerator applications. These documents are essential for securing funding, partnerships, or admission into programs yet most founders:

1. Don’t know what investors want to see,
2. Spend too much time formatting instead of building their products,
3. Can’t afford consultants or designers,
4. And often submit incomplete or inconsistent materials.

Our product solves this by offering a guided, AI-assisted platform where founders can easily generate professional startup documents. It makes documentation faster, clearer, and more accessible. In short, it helps founders focus on execution while presenting their ideas like pros.

**Challenges we ran into**

**Frontend:**
During development, I ran into an issue sending data to the backend endpoint responsible for pitch deck creation. The problem was caused by passing incorrect field values that didn’t align with the backend’s expected data structure. After debugging network requests and reviewing the API schema, I identified the mismatch and fixed it by ensuring the frontend payload matched the backend requirements. Once corrected, the data submission worked seamlessly.

**Backend:**
I faced challenges when parsing and cleaning AI API responses. The AI often returned mixed text, symbols, and formatting artifacts that broke JSON parsing. To solve this, I implemented a dedicated AI response cleaning and validation function that sanitizes the output, strips unnecessary characters, and ensures only structured JSON data is processed.

**Performance / AI Integration:**
One major issue was that AI slide generation queries took several minutes, causing the app to freeze and degrade user experience. To fix this, I offloaded heavy AI tasks to background workers, allowing the application to handle other requests while processing intensive tasks asynchronously. This change improved response time, prevented timeouts, and created a much smoother user experience.

Our unique value lies in simplicity, localization, and AI-guided storytelling.
While existing tools (like PitchBob or Gamma) focus primarily on deck generation, our product creates a complete startup documentation suite, from pitch decks to resumes to accelerator applications all tailored for founders.

What makes it stand out:

- Guided question flow that teaches founders what to write and why.
- Fast document generation that’s polished and editable.
- Local + global relevance: Templates suitable for both emerging-market founders and global accelerators.
- Crypto Pay-as-You-Go integration: Founders anywhere can access tools seamlessly without currency barriers.

The alpha build validated this by successfully generating professional, formatted outputs during our MVP demo, proving that our guided framework works even under tight timelines.

**Who is your target customer?**

**Primary Users:**
-  Early-stage founders (tech, creative, and social startups)

- Solo founders and small teams without design or funding support

Startup hubs, accelerators, and entrepreneurship programs that support founders

We confirmed the need through:

- Feedback from startup competition judges who described it as “relevant and impactful.”
- Conversations with founders across communities who expressed frustration over documentation prep.
- Early sign-ups from students and accelerator applicants on our waitlist.

In short, our product is built for ambitious founders who want to tell their story clearly without the complexity of design or consultancy costs.

PitchBob is an AI-powered startup assistant that helps founders generate pitch decks, one-pagers, business models, and investor documents through guided question flows. It’s ideal for early founders who want content structure but not necessarily high visual customization.

**How We’re Different:**

**Broader document coverage:** GidiPitch goes beyond pitch decks to include founder resumes, accelerator applications, and startup documentation kits all in one place.

**Higher visual polish:** We blend structured storytelling (like PitchBob) with modern design templates and brand customization closer to presentation tools.

**Localization & inclusivity:** Our templates consider regional accelerators, funding ecosystems, and local storytelling nuances, making it globally adaptable but context-aware.

2. **Gamma.app**

 https://gamma.app

**About:**
Gamma is an AI-powered document and presentation platform that helps users create polished, visually appealing decks, websites, and documents quickly. It’s highly design-oriented and great for general content creation.

**How We’re Different:**

**Purpose-built for founders:** Gamma is a broad tool for all users; GidiPitch is laser-focused on startup founders and investor readiness.

**Guided storytelling:** We don’t just generate slides. we teach founders what to say and how to say it, using structured, question-based content coaching.

**Integrated suite:** We combine pitch decks, resumes, and application templates in a single platform. Gamma doesn’t support startup-specific workflows.

**Affordable, flexible model:** Crypto-based pay-as-you-go makes access simpler and cheaper for early founders than Gamma’s subscription model.

3. **Other Emerging Competitors**

**Beautiful.ai** (https://www.beautiful.ai) — Focuses mainly on design automation for presentations, not startup-specific use.

**Tome.app** (https://tome.app) — Great visual storytelling, but lacks guided content and startup framework context.

**Our Distinct Advantage**

GidiPitch combines the guided intelligence of PitchBob, the visual polish of Gamma, and the accessibility of pay-as-you-go crypto payments all tailored specifically for founders preparing to pitch, apply, and grow.

We’re not just a document generator; we’re a startup-readiness companion that helps entrepreneurs build, refine, and present their story with clarity and confidence.

**What is your distribution strategy and why?**

Our go-to-market strategy focuses on community-driven growth and strategic partnerships.

**Phase 1 – Direct & Organic:**

Build visibility through LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and founder communities.

Share educational content (pitch tips, templates) to attract organic users.

**Phase 2 – Partnerships:**

Collaborate with accelerators, universities, and startup hubs to integrate our product into their founder programs.

Offer discounted or co-branded versions to institutions.

**Phase 3 – Paid & Scalable:**

Targeted ads to startup communities globally.

Partnerships with blockchain/fintech firms to enable crypto-based pay-as-you-go access.

**Why this works:**
Founders trust peer recommendations and community endorsements more than ads.
By positioning ourselves within startup ecosystems (where founders already gather), we can acquire users with low CAC (customer acquisition cost) and strong retention through trust and value.
