> AI organism that learns, debates & protects truth

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

Core Concept:

VeriSphere is an AI-driven “immune system” for the internet. Its purpose is to detect misinformation before it spreads widely, verify it against credible sources, and deliver clear, unbiased explanations in different languages and formats.

It functions like a living AI organism that protects digital truth by learning, debating, and explaining.

What We’re Building:

1. AI Misinformation Radar:

VeriSphere continuously monitors social media platforms, news websites, public WhatsApp forwards, YouTube transcripts, and other content streams. It uses a network of specialized AI agents to detect emerging misinformation trends. These agents identify viral content, cross-verify claims using trusted multilingual databases, analyze why the content is spreading, and craft factual counter-narratives in the same tone, style, and language as the original message.

2. Autonomous Verification Graph:

A dynamic knowledge graph links claims, sources, experts, and sentiment. When a new claim appears, VeriSphere checks historical patterns, finds credible counter-evidence, assigns a truth likelihood score, and explains why the claim may be misleading in clear, accessible language.

3. Contextual Communication Engine:

VeriSphere adapts its explanations to different audiences to ensure clarity and impact. It provides WhatsApp-friendly summaries for elders, concise explainers with verified references for students, and detailed source-level context for professionals. It can also generate short videos or voice notes in regional languages such as Hindi and Marathi to make verified information easier to share.

4. Crisis Simulation and Early Warning System:

The system detects misinformation surges during critical events such as elections, pandemics, and disasters. It can simulate how false narratives may spread across different regions and demographics. Media organizations, fact-checkers, and government agencies receive alerts before misinformation reaches its peak.

Additional Features:

VeriSphere includes a real-time misinformation heat map that highlights trending false narratives across regions. It also offers an AI Debate Mode where two AI agents argue for and against a claim to make the reasoning process transparent. A Digital Literacy Companion Bot explains viral news to users in their preferred language through WhatsApp.

**Misinformation: Create an Agentic AI system that continuously scans multiple sources of information, detects emerging misinformation, verifies facts, and provides easy-to-understand, contextual updates to the public during crises.**

How VeriSphere Fits into the Misinformation Track:
1️⃣ The core problem of this track:
Misinformation spreads rapidly during global or local crises like pandemics, elections, or climate events.
People face an overload of conflicting or false information, which causes panic, mistrust, and poor decisions.
2️⃣ What VeriSphere does:
VeriSphere directly tackles this challenge using agentic AI to:
Detect early signs of misinformation trends across multiple online sources.
Verify claims by cross-referencing trusted scientific, governmental, and journalistic data.
Explain the truth clearly and contextually for different audiences — in multiple Indian languages.
Predict future misinformation waves before they go viral.

**Description of your solution**

AI Privacy Guardian is an advanced Agentic AI-based cybersecurity system designed to safeguard users’ digital privacy across games, mobile applications, and websites.
In today’s digital world, many platforms secretly access personal data — such as location, contacts, or microphone inputs — without user awareness. This project provides an intelligent AI solution that monitors, detects, and prevents privacy breaches in real time.


---

 How It Works

1. Real-time Monitoring:
The system continuously scans network traffic generated by games, web apps, and mobile applications.
It observes data packets and identifies where user data is being sent.


2. Agentic AI Analysis:
The AI Agent evaluates every data transmission using machine learning and behavioral pattern analysis.
If it detects abnormal or unauthorized data flow, it immediately flags the activity.


3. Cross Verification:
The agent cross-checks suspicious IPs and domains with trusted cybersecurity databases like VirusTotal and Google SafeBrowsing to verify legitimacy.


4. Instant Alerts & Actions:
Users receive instant notifications about the detected threat.
The system suggests preventive actions — such as revoking permissions, blocking network requests, or uninstalling unsafe apps.


5. Self-Learning Intelligence:
The AI model continuously learns from every detection, adapting to new threat patterns, and improving accuracy over time.




---

 Core Features

AI-driven autonomous privacy protection

Multi-platform compatibility (Game, Web, App)

Real-time threat detection & alert system

Integrated cyber database verification

Adaptive self-learning for smarter protection

**Misinformation: Create an Agentic AI system that continuously scans multiple sources of information, detects emerging misinformation, verifies facts, and provides easy-to-understand, contextual updates to the public during crises.**

Addresses “Digital Misinformation” at the Data Level

While traditional misinformation focuses on false content (fake news, wrong facts),
your project targets data-level misinformation — when apps, games, or websites mislead users about how their data is used or shared.

 Example:
An app says “We respect your privacy” but secretly sends your contacts or location to unknown servers.
This is data deception — a hidden form of misinformation.

Your project exposes this by letting an AI agent analyze and verify the data flows, revealing the truth.


---

2️⃣ Agentic AI Element

Your solution uses an autonomous AI Agent that:

Scans data transmissions in real time.

Analyzes patterns using machine learning.

Cross-verifies with trusted cybersecurity databases (like VirusTotal).

Decides and acts — warns users, blocks threats, or recommends actions.


That’s exactly what Agentic AI means — an AI that takes initiative and makes decisions, not just predicts.


---

3️⃣ Verification & Transparency

Just like misinformation agents verify online claims,
your AI Privacy Guardian verifies app and website claims (e.g., “This app is safe,” “Your data is private”) by checking real network behavior.

If it finds a mismatch, it provides clear, contextual explanations to the user — similar to how misinformation agents clarify truth vs lies.


---

4️⃣ Empowering Digital Awareness

Your system helps users:

Understand which platforms are safe or risky.

Protect themselves from hidden privacy manipulation.

Build digital trust and awareness, aligning with the hackathon’s vision of “AI that empowers people through truth and transparency.”

**Description of your solution**

# SnapRAG - AI That Speaks Like Anyone on Farcaster

## The Problem

Want to understand what @vitalik or @dwr thinks about something? You'd need to read through thousands of their casts. Want to build AI agents that understand Farcaster users? You're stuck with generic ChatGPT that knows nothing about the protocol.

## Our Solution

**SnapRAG lets you chat with any Farcaster user through AI that learned from their actual posts.**

One command. Zero API keys. Completely local.

```bash
$ snaprag ask @jesse.base.eth "What are your thoughts on Base?"

Jesse Pollak:
building on base is incredible 🔵 
we're seeing amazing things ship every day
```

The AI doesn't just answer correctly — it matches Jesse's exact writing style, tone, and personality.

## What Makes It Special

### 1. True Local-First AI
- No OpenAI API. No Anthropic. No third-party services.
- Runs entirely on your machine with local LLMs (Ollama)
- Your data stays yours

### 2. Complete Farcaster Mirror
- Syncs full social graph via Snapchain gRPC
- Stores profiles, casts, links, reactions locally (Postgres)
- Real-time updates as new casts appear

### 3. Intelligent Style Mimicking
- Analyzes 10,000+ posts per user
- Learns emoji usage, sentence length, tone, formality
- Time-weighted: recent posts matter more
- Interactive chat with conversation memory

### 4. Production-Ready API
- RESTful endpoints for all features
- x402 payment integration (MetaMask + EIP-712)
- Session-based chat with automatic cleanup
- MCP server for AI agent integration

### 5. Extreme Performance
- 100x faster embedding checks (batch queries)
- 10-30x faster vector search (optimized PostgreSQL)
- Progress bars and real-time feedback
- Handles millions of casts efficiently

## Technical Stack

- **Language**: Rust (performance + safety)
- **Database**: PostgreSQL + pgvector (vector search)
- **Embeddings**: Local models via Ollama (nomic-embed-text)
- **LLM**: Qwen, Llama, or any Ollama-compatible model
- **Protocol**: Snapchain gRPC for Farcaster data
- **Payment**: rust-x402 (our own implementation)

## Live Demo

**Video**: [1-minute demo](demo/complete_demo.mp4)

**Try it yourself**:
```bash
# Install
cargo install --git https://github.com/RyanKung/snaprag

# Ask anyone anything
snaprag ask @vitalik.eth "your question"
snaprag ask 99 --chat  # Interactive mode

# Start API server
snaprag serve api --payment
```

## Why It Matters for Farcaster

1. **Enables sovereign AI** - Developers can build AI agents without dependency on closed APIs
2. **Unlocks new apps** - Personality-aware bots, context-rich searches, intelligent recommendations
3. **Demonstrates scalability** - Proves local AI can handle social network scale data
4. **Payment-ready** - x402 integration shows path to sustainable AI services

## What We Built in This Hackathon

- ✅ Complete Farcaster sync pipeline (Snapchain integration)
- ✅ Vector embedding system (13M+ casts indexed)
- ✅ AI role-playing engine with style analysis
- ✅ Interactive chat with conversation memory
- ✅ Session-based API with 4 endpoints
- ✅ x402 payment integration + MetaMask support
- ✅ Performance optimizations (100x+ improvements)
- ✅ CLI + API + Web demo (api-tester)

**Total**: 2,456 lines of new code, 30 files modified, fully tested and deployed.

## Repos & Resources

- **Main repo**: https://github.com/RyanKung/snaprag
- **x402 lib**: https://github.com/RyanKung/rust-x402


**SnapRAG proves that in the age of AI, sovereignty stays with builders — not platforms.**

**No gatekeepers. Just code.**

**Misinformation: Bring your own problem in Misinformation, leveraging Agentic AI.**

## How does this project fit within the Misinformation track?

SnapRAG solves AI hallucination by grounding every response in verifiable Farcaster data. 

Instead of letting AI fabricate answers, SnapRAG:
- Retrieves from indexed, timestamped casts (not imagination)
- Provides traceable sources for every claim
- Uses time-weighted relevance (recent = more accurate)
- Runs locally with transparent pgvector (no black boxes)

**Result**: Agentic AI that cites real statements from real users, not hallucinated fiction. When an AI claims "@vitalik said X", you can verify it against his actual 50,000+ posts.

This is the missing piece for trustworthy AI agents in social protocols.

To support variable-income workers, new financial products like income smoothing accounts, flexible credit, and portable benefits can provide stability. These tools are complemented by educational and community-based initiatives, such as targeted financial literacy programs, peer mentorship networks, and digital community savings groups (ROSCAs). Finally, government policies like simplified tax withholding for freelancers and subsidized emergency savings funds can create a crucial support structure, helping workers build a resilient financial foundation.

**Fintech: Build an autonomous financial coaching agent that adapts to real user behavior, spending patterns, and income variability - helping gig workers, informal sector employees, and everyday citizens make smarter financial decisions proactively.**

Individuals with variable incomes, such as gig workers and freelancers, face significant financial precarity because traditional budgeting tools are too rigid for their fluctuating earnings. This lack of adaptive financial guidance heightens economic instability and obstructs opportunities for long-term wealth creation.

To solve this we can have Technological and App-Based Solutions where AI-Powered Financial Coaching , Automated Percentage-Based Allocation, Income and Expense Forecasting Tools, Micro-Investment and Savings Platforms can featured. To support variable-income workers, new financial products like income smoothing accounts, flexible credit, and portable benefits can provide stability. These tools are complemented by educational and community-based initiatives, such as targeted financial literacy programs, peer mentorship networks, and digital community savings groups (ROSCAs). Finally, government policies like simplified tax withholding for freelancers and subsidized emergency savings funds can create a crucial support structure, helping workers build a resilient financial foundation.

The platform is built on a modern, scalable tech stack. The Plaid API securely connects to user bank accounts for real-time transaction data. A cross-platform mobile application developed using React Native ensures a seamless and intuitive user experience. A microservices architecture using Node.js (Express) for the primary API and Python (Flask) for the machine learning service. MongoDB is used for flexible data storage.AI & Machine Learning: The core intelligence relies on Python libraries like scikit-learn and TensorFlow to forecast income, categorize expenses, and identify behavioural patterns. These insights are then processed by a Large Language Model (LLM) via the Gemini API to generate personalized, conversational coaching prompts. The entire system is containerized with Docker and deployed on the Google Cloud Platform (GCP) for robustness and scalability.

By democratizing access to hyper-personalized financial advisory, Fin-Coach AI empowers an underserved demographic to build financial resilience, make smarter decisions, and achieve long-term economic stability

It empowers retail investors, gig workers, and everyday citizens to make informed, goal-oriented investment choices — effectively democratizing access to professional-level financial intelligence.

**Description of your solution**

**Problem**

Many students, freelancers and gig workers face irregular income and poor financial guidance. Existing banking apps only show balances or generic tips — they don’t predict cashflow gaps or proactively adapt budgets to changing incomes.

**Solution (FinGEN)**

FinGEN is an Agentic AI Financial Coach that continuously learns each user’s income and spending behaviour and then proactively recommends budgets, saving actions and short-term cashflow fixes. It acts like a personal CFO for irregular incomes.

**Key Features**

- Agentic Guidance: Not just responses — the AI identifies issues (e.g., upcoming cash shortfall) and suggests concrete actions.
- Income-aware Budgets: Dynamic budgets that change when income changes.
- Expense Forecasting: Short-term forecast (7/30 day) of cashflow and alerts for predicted deficits.
- Goal-based Savings: Automatically suggests micro-savings targets aligned to goals.
- Explainable Advice: Short human-readable rationale for each recommendation (why it suggested an action).

**How it works (simple architecture)**

- User data → Agentic AI (LLM + rules) → Recommendation Engine → Dashboard
- Users either add income/expense entries or connect transaction data. The agent analyses patterns, predicts cashflow, and produces prioritized recommendations which the dashboard displays.

**What makes FinGEN different**

Focused on irregular incomes (gig workers & students) rather than salaried users.
Agentic: not reactive chat — it proactively monitors, predicts, and recommends.
Designed for actionable outputs (exact amounts to save, split bills, stagger payments) not just tips.

**Impact & Use Cases**

- Helps users avoid short-term cash shortfalls and meet monthly savings goals.
- Use case example: a freelancer with variable monthly income receives an adjusted saving plan that ensures an emergency buffer by month end.

**Roadmap (next milestones)**

 - Clarify & refine agent rules + build offline simulation tests (current)
 - Onboard 50 pilot users for usability feedback (30 days)
 - Integrate with UPI / transaction read APIs for real transactions
 - Add investment recommendation module

**Tech stack**

React, Node.js, Python, MongoDB, LangChain/Flowise (agent orchestration), OpenAI/Gemini for LLM reasoning.

- Yogesh Pande — AI & Backend (ML prompts, agent design)
- Shriansh Jaiswal — Frontend & UX (Dashboard and user flows)

Our proposed solution:
Autonomous Hospital Operations Agent, is an AI-driven system designed to predict and manage unpredictable patient surges caused by factors like pollution spikes, epidemics, or festivals. The system continuously correlates real-time external data (such as air quality index, weather, and local event trends) with internal hospital data (like admission rates, staff availability, and bed occupancy). Using a hybrid forecasting model that combines Prophet, LSTM, and XGBoost, the AI predicts patient inflow volume and case types up to 72 hours in advance.

Once a potential surge is detected, the integrated CrewAI autonomous agent automatically generates a “Surge Response Playbook” — a set of prioritized, data-backed recommendations for staffing allocation, supply management, and public health advisories. These insights are delivered in real time to a Next.js-based interactive dashboard, powered by a FastAPI backend for efficient data handling and Celery for asynchronous task scheduling.

our system stores and processes data in PostgreSQL and ChromaDB, while visual analytics and forecasting trends are displayed through Chart.js. Deployed on AWS for scalability and Vercel for frontend testing, this platform transforms hospital management from a reactive, crisis-driven process into a proactive, intelligent, and adaptive operational model, ensuring hospitals stay prepared for any surge scenario.

- Machine Learning: LSTM and XGBoost ensemble
- Backend: Python (FastAPI / Flask)
- Frontend: Next.js for real-time dashboard
- Database: PostgreSQL and Chroma DB
- Data Sources: AQI APIs, weather data, hospital EHR systems
- Visualization: Chart.js
- Cloud: AWS  for scalability and real-time processing. Testing on Vercel.

**Description of your solution**

FinBuild is an Agentic AI–driven personal-finance ecosystem that learns from every user’s financial behaviour to deliver proactive insights, automated planning, and personalized investment guidance.
Each module acts as an autonomous financial agent, collaborating through a central orchestrator to achieve one goal — help users grow wealth intelligently and effortlessly.

1. Statement Analyzer Agent
What it does: Reads uploaded bank statements or live transaction data (SMS / UPI / open-banking APIs) and classifies income, expenses, and merchants.
Agentic AI implementation: A multimodal LLM parses diverse formats, learns new transaction patterns over time, flags anomalies, and retrains itself from user feedback for higher accuracy.

2. Adaptive Budget Planner Agent
What it does: Creates and continuously updates monthly budgets.
Agentic AI implementation: A reinforcement-learning agent monitors spending habits and automatically reallocates category limits. It reasons with historical data and gives real-time warnings or saving suggestions.

3. Investment Advisor Agent
What it does: Recommends stocks, mutual funds, and SIPs suited to each user’s profile.
Agentic AI implementation: A forecasting agent analyses price trends, news sentiment, and user risk level. It simulates outcomes before proposing plans and explains its reasoning transparently.

4. Tax Planner Agent
What it does: Computes taxes, deductions, and optimizations.
Agentic AI implementation: A reasoning LLM understands user context, cross-checks current tax laws, and converses naturally to suggest section-wise savings opportunities.

5. Reminder & Payment Agent
What it does: Keeps track of bills, EMIs, and subscriptions.
Agentic AI implementation: Predictive scheduling agents detect recurring transactions, forecast upcoming dues, and trigger smart reminders or automated payment actions (with consent).

6. Knowledge & Insights Agent
What it does: Provides financial education and news.
Agentic AI implementation: A RAG-based content agent retrieves trusted articles, summarizes them to the user’s interest areas, and adapts future recommendations from reading behaviour.

7. Financial Companion Chatbot Agent
What it does: Acts as a conversational interface for all modules.
Agentic AI implementation: A context-aware LLM with long-term memory recalls past interactions, interprets current financial status, and coordinates other agents to answer complex, multi-step queries.

**Description of your solution**

FlowGuide: India's First AI Financial Coach for the Unbanked .
FlowGuide is not another financial app for urban elites or a generic AI tool dressed in Indian colors. It's a ground-up, practical AI financial coach built specifically for India's 400 million informal workers—street vendors, gig drivers, domestic helpers, and daily wage earners—who live outside the formal banking system, often without smartphones, reliable internet, or financial literacy. While most tech solutions build for users who already have UPI and credit scores, we built a system that works on a basic Nokia feature phone, understands everyday phrases like "I earned 350 rupees today, but rent of 200 is due tomorrow," and remembers your financial journey using just your phone number—no login, no ID, no bank integration required.

The Problem: Financial Exclusion in Plain Sight

In India, 78% of informal workers have never spoken to a financial advisor. They manage unpredictable cash flows with minimal tools—relying on memory, physical savings, or word-of-mouth advice. Missed rent payments, emergency borrowing, and debt traps are daily realities. Traditional financial technology fails them because it assumes smartphones, internet access, literacy, and stable income. FlowGuide flips this approach: we meet users where they actually are—via SMS and voice calls—and deliver compassionate, personalized guidance that fits their lives.

Our Solution: AI That Works Without the Internet

FlowGuide operates entirely over SMS and voice calls, with an optional lightweight web companion. Users simply text or call a local number, share their income or concerns ("I've run out of money"), and receive immediate, human-like advice in Hindi, English, Tamil, or Hinglish. No app download. No sign-up. No UPI required. Just clear financial guidance, one message at a time.

The web dashboard is designed for gradual adoption: when a user visits website and enters their phone number, their entire financial profile loads instantly—savings progress ("70 of 500 rupees emergency fund"), weekly income trends, bill reminders—all rendered efficiently using modern web technologies, making it usable even on slow 2G networks.

Technical Innovation: Reliable, Not Guesswork

What truly sets FlowGuide apart is our practical architecture. Instead of letting an AI model guess financial advice and risk dangerous mistakes, we separate conversation from accurate calculations. The language model acts only as a router—it never generates numbers or advice directly. Instead, it calls specialized, verifiable microservices:

Budget Advisor: Allocates income using culturally aware principles ("pay rent first, save what's left") rather than Western financial rules.

Cashflow Predictor: Forecasts income gaps for gig workers using patterns that account for irregular work, festivals, and seasonal changes.

Goal Tracker: Monitors small savings goals and delivers progress updates via SMS or voice.

Safety Checks: The ethical foundation—verifies every response for accuracy, blocks dangerous suggestions, simplifies language, and includes clear disclaimers.

This approach ensures no invented advice, complete transparency, and safe operation—exactly what judges look for in a responsible AI system.

India-First Identity: Your Phone Number Is Your Profile

We use the phone number as a secure, persistent identity. All interactions—SMS, voice, web—are linked to an encrypted record associated with your phone number. This enables:

Continuity: "Last week you saved 50 rupees—want to add more today?"
Personalization without passwords
Smooth transition between SMS and web

The web dashboard requires only a phone number to load your financial journey—no OTP, no email, no complexity. This design serves both the tea vendor on a basic phone and the delivery rider with occasional internet access, without forcing either into digital systems they can't use.

Hybrid Voice + SMS Pipeline, Built for Indian Reality

Voice calls are transcribed using advanced speech recognition fine-tuned on Indian languages and accents, with responses delivered through natural-sounding text-to-speech with Indian voice profiles.

SMS acts as a reliable fallback in areas with poor connectivity, with responses crafted to fit standard message limits while remaining helpful.

Our language understanding engine recognizes real-world phrases like "I got payment," "my brother gave me money," or "I'm feeling stressed"—trained on thousands of examples from actual informal workers.

Ethical by Design, Not by Afterthought

We never connect to banks or UPI. Users manually log income and expenses via SMS—giving them control and avoiding security risks. Every interaction requires clear consent ("Reply YES to save your goals"). All data is securely encrypted, and we automatically delete records after 90 days to comply with India's data protection laws. Our safety checks ensure we never suggest loans, inv

**Description of your solution**

Millions of elderly citizens, rural workers, and low-literacy individuals still find themselves cut off from digital finance in many ways. **They struggle quite a bit to handle pensions, process claims, or steer clear of fraud**. The issue comes down to those complex systems that rely heavily on reading skills, all geared toward people who already know their way around tech.

Current fintech apps and chatbots seem to chase after speed and convenience above all else. **But they often miss the mark on real accessibility, building trust, or even offering support in local languages**. In the end, this leaves vulnerable users pretty much isolated from the digital side of things.

We are developing a **WhatsApp-based AI Finance Assistant** right now. It lets users check the status of their pensions and insurance claims without any hassle. They can also receive reminders for payments and alerts on due dates. All of this happens directly inside WhatsApp, which makes it accessible to just about everyone. The tool sends out **fraud alerts too, by scanning messages that look suspicious.** It even notifies family members when that step feels necessary, which helps keep safety and transparency in place. For larger payments or anything that raises a red flag in transactions, the system kicks off **AI-powered voice verification calls**. This brings in a secure layer that feels more human and reliable. Overall, it steps in as a round-the-clock intelligent finance officer of sorts. It blends simple back-and-forth conversations with tailored guidance and solid checks on identity. The goal is to make financial services safe and reachable for people across the board.

**FinChat Guardian really empowers seniors, rural families, and those on low incomes by giving them more confidence in handling money matters**. It works to close the digital divide that exists in India today. The whole thing gets built on tools like FastAPI with Python, along with LangChain, APIs from OpenAI and Gemini, the WhatsApp Cloud API handled by Twilio, MongoDB for storage, and Next.js for the front end. With that setup, it has the potential to expand right across the nation. It stands as India's initial layer for conversational finance, one that pushes forward inclusive FinTech centered on real human needs.

**Fintech: Bring your own problem in Fintech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

FinChat Guardian acts as a WhatsApp-based AI assistant for finance matters. It takes on the main challenges tied to financial inclusion right away. In India, millions of older citizens, rural workers, and people with low literacy levels deal with real struggles. **They often cannot reach digital financial services like pensions, insurance claims, or fraud protection easily**. Users can now check their pension and insurance statuses through it. They get payment reminders too. Fraud alerts come in as well. Everything stays inside WhatsApp for simplicity. This setup delivers key financial services in a way that feels accessible and easy to handle.

The platform adds **AI-driven voice checks for bigger transactions or ones that seem off.** It strengthens security and builds trust overall. Those elements stand at the heart of FinTech work. Conversational AI mixes in with real-time alerts and identity checks. All of this lets underserved groups handle their money with more assurance.
FinChat Guardian really captures what FinTech means these days. **Financial services become safer, easier to reach, and smarter through it**. The tool closes gaps in the digital world for those who need help most. **Cutting-edge tech steps in to boost trust and make things more usable.**

**Description of your solution**

DischargeFlow AI is an autonomous Agentic AI system that orchestrates the entire patient discharge process—from prediction to execution—solving a costly bottleneck that wastes ₹3.5 Crore annually per 200-bed hospital.

**THE PROBLEM**

Patients wait 4-6 hours for discharge not due to medical needs, but poor coordination: lab results delay, discharge summaries aren't written, prescriptions aren't filled, appointments aren't scheduled, transport isn't arranged. This keeps ER patients waiting and causes 20-30% preventable readmissions.

**OUR AGENTIC AI SOLUTION**

DischargeFlow AI operates as a true autonomous agent:

1. **PERCEIVES:** Monitors patient vitals, labs, clinical notes, hospital workflows in real-time via FHIR-compliant HMS APIs

2. **THINKS:** ML models (Random Forest/XGBoost) predict discharge dates 24-48 hours ahead (85%+ accuracy). Neural Network identifies readmission risk (75%+ accuracy) using comorbidities, social factors, compliance history

3. **DECIDES:** Autonomously triggers discharge planning, prioritizes tasks, adapts to changing patient conditions

4. **ACTS:** Automatically schedules tests/imaging via HMS APIs, generates discharge summaries using NLP (GPT-4/LLaMA), creates prescriptions, checks drug interactions, books follow-ups, arranges transport, sends notifications, updates bed management—all without human intervention

5. **LEARNS:** Tracks outcomes (delays, readmissions, satisfaction), retrains models weekly, adapts to hospital workflows, A/B tests interventions

**TECH STACK**

Agentic AI: Python orchestrator, Celery+Redis scheduler, Kafka streaming | ML: scikit-learn, TensorFlow, GPT-4/LLaMA | Backend: FastAPI, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, FHIR APIs | Frontend: React.js, Material-UI, WebSocket, Chart.js | Deployment: AWS/GCP, Docker+Kubernetes, HIPAA-compliant | Data: MIMIC-III + synthetic Indian hospital data

**KEY FEATURES**

1. Predictive Discharge Engine: 24-48hr advance predictions
2. Autonomous Task Orchestrator: Background agent executing discharge tasks
3. AI Summary Generator: NLP-powered multi-language summaries
4. Readmission Risk Detector: ML classifier for high-risk patients
5. Real-Time Dashboard: Live predictions, action log, status tracking
6. Continuous Learning: Weekly retraining, hospital-specific optimization

**WHAT MAKES IT AGENTIC?**

Unlike traditional software requiring manual inputs or rigid automation, DischargeFlow demonstrates true agency: autonomous decision-making from learned policies (not pre-programmed rules), proactive action-taking, goal-oriented behavior (optimize discharge while minimizing readmissions), continuous adaptation, multi-step departmental coordination.

**MEASURABLE IMPACT (200-bed hospital)**

Clinical: 40% faster discharge, 15% bed turnover improvement, 20% fewer readmissions

Operational: 70% faster summaries (60min→5min), 40% less admin burden

Financial: ₹2.25 Cr annual impact, ₹12L cost = ₹2.13 Cr NET BENEFIT (1,775% ROI)

**MARKET VALIDATION**

Competitor Qventus raised $200M+ at $400M+ valuation, HonorHealth saved $62M over 3 years. Patient Flow market: $1.89B (2025)→$13.88B (2035), 20% CAGR. India HMS: $12.4B (2025)→$25.7B (2031). Hospitals increasing IT budgets 20-25%.

**COMPETITIVE ADVANTAGE**

10-50X more affordable (₹12L vs $500K-2M), India-first (local patterns: festivals, pollution), laser-focused on discharge, true agentic AI (autonomous execution vs analytics), fast deployment (2-4 weeks vs 6 months)

**24-HOUR DEMO**

Working prototype: 3 trained ML models, autonomous agent monitoring 10+ patients, real-time dashboard updating every 5min, live action log ("DischargeFlow scheduled ECG for Patient #007"), HMS integration via REST APIs, SMS/email notifications. Demo: Watch AI predict discharge (92% confidence), autonomously schedule ECG, generate summary, book follow-up, arrange transport—no human clicks.

Free beds for emergencies, reduce doctor burnout, prevent readmissions, and efficient healthcare. Building the future where no patient waits unnecessarily, hospitals operate at peak efficiency, and doctors focus on healing.

**Description of your solution**

# **TrendCast India - Solution Description**

## **Overview**
TrendCast India is an intelligent, multi-agent AI system specifically designed for the Indian financial markets. It autonomously monitors Indian market indices, extracts verified data from official Indian financial sources, and generates professional podcast episodes in English and Hindi that explain market movements with data-backed justifications.

## **Core Problem Solved for Indian Market**
Indian investors face unique challenges:
- Information scattered across multiple Indian regulatory sites (SEBI, RBI, NSE, BSE)
- Complex interplay of domestic policies, global markets, and FII/DII flows
- Language barriers for regional investors
- Need to understand sector-specific factors (IT, Banking, Pharma, Auto)
- Impact of government policies and budget announcements
- Currency fluctuations affecting market sentiment

TrendCast India automates comprehensive market analysis specifically tailored for Indian investors.

---

## **Indian Market Focus**

### **Indices Covered:**
1. **NIFTY 50** - Flagship NSE index
2. **SENSEX** - BSE benchmark
3. **NIFTY Bank** - Banking sector
4. **NIFTY IT** - Technology sector
5. **NIFTY Midcap 100** - Mid-cap opportunities
6. **NIFTY Smallcap 100** - Small-cap segment
7. **NIFTY Auto** - Automotive sector
8. **NIFTY Pharma** - Pharmaceutical sector
9. **NIFTY FMCG** - Consumer goods
10. **NIFTY Metal** - Metals & mining

---

**Fintech: Bring your own problem in Fintech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

**System Architecture - India Specific**
**1. Trend Analyzer Agent**
**Purpose:** Real-time Indian market intelligence
**Data Sources:**

- NSE (National Stock Exchange) real-time feeds
- BSE (Bombay Stock Exchange) data
- India VIX (Volatility Index)
- FII/DII daily flows from NSE

**Analysis Includes:**

- Price movements during Indian trading hours (9:15 AM - 3:30 PM IST)
- Pre-market and post-market indicators
- Sectoral rotation patterns
- Small/mid/large cap relative performance
- Technical indicators adapted for Indian market behavior
- SGX Nifty correlation for global cues

**Output:** Structured trend report with Indian market context

**2. Data Collector Agent**
**Purpose: **Authoritative Indian source validation
**Primary Official Sources:**
1. **SEBI (Securities and Exchange Board of India)**

- Regulatory announcements
- FPI (Foreign Portfolio Investment) data
- Corporate action notifications

2. **RBI (Reserve Bank of India)**

- Monetary policy decisions
- Repo rate, CRR, SLR changes
- Inflation data (CPI, WPI)
- Forex reserves and rupee interventions

3. **NSE & BSE Official Sites**

- Real-time market data
- Block deals and bulk deals
- Corporate announcements
- Derivatives data (F&O)

4. **Ministry of Finance**

- GST collections
- Fiscal deficit data
- Government bond yields

5. **Ministry of Commerce**

- Export-import data
- Trade deficit figures

6. **PIB (Press Information Bureau)**

- Government policy announcements
- Sectoral reforms

7. **MOSPI (Ministry of Statistics)**

- GDP growth data
- IIP (Index of Industrial Production)
- Manufacturing PMI

8. **Corporate Filings**

- Quarterly results from BSE/NSE
- Management commentary
- Concall transcripts

**Indian-Specific Data Points:**

- FII/DII buying/selling patterns
- Rupee vs Dollar movement
- Crude oil prices (major import impact)
- Monsoon forecasts (agricultural impact)
- GST collection trends
- Government bond yields (10-year G-Sec)

**Output:** Verified Indian market dataset with regulatory source attribution

**3. Script Writer Agent**
**Purpose:** India-focused narrative intelligence
**Script Structure:**

1. **Market Overview** (30 seconds)
-  NIFTY/SENSEX movement
-  Key gainers/losers sectors
-  Market breadth (advances vs declines)

2. **Driving Factors**(90 seconds)
- Domestic triggers (RBI policy, government announcements, earnings)
- Global cues (US markets, crude oil, geopolitical events)
- FII/DII flows and their impact
- Currency movement implications

3. **Sector Analysis** (60 seconds)
- Best and worst performing sectors
- Sector-specific news from official sources
- Corporate results impact

4. **Technical View** (45 seconds)
- Support/resistance levels
- India VIX reading and interpretation
- Key technical patterns

5. **Forward Looking** (45 seconds)
- Upcoming events (RBI meeting, macro data releases, earnings calendar)
- Risk factors to watch
- Opportunities highlighted

**Language Options:**

- English - For urban, English-speaking investors
- Hindi - For Hindi-speaking retail investors (Hinglish style with market terms in English)
- Regional languages (future): Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, Gujarati, Bengali

**Indian Context Features:**

- References Indian festivals and trading holidays
- Explains impact of Union Budget, RBI policies in simple terms
- Uses Indian examples and comparisons (e.g., "similar to the 2020 post-COVID rally")
- Cites Indian business news sources (Economic Times, Business Standard, Mint)

**Output:** Culturally relevant, India-focused podcast script
**4. Podcaster Agent**
**Purpose:** Multi-lingual audio production
**Features:**

- Indian English accent TTS for authenticity
- Hindi TTS with proper financial term pronunciation
- Background music suitable for Indian audience
- Time-appropriate greetings ("Good morning Mumbai...")
- Duration: 4-5 minutes (optimal for commute listening)

**Distribution Formats:**

- Podcast RSS feed
- YouTube (with market charts as visuals)
- WhatsApp audio files (popular in India)
- Telegram channel integration
- Mobile app notification with audio

**Output:** Production-ready podcast in multiple languages

**Description of your solution**

ArogyaSetu is a citywide, autonomous platform designed to transform how hospitals handle unpredictable patient surges. Leveraging advanced AI, it predicts surges using historical hospital data, festival schedules, pollution spikes, epidemics, and social media trends. Beyond prediction, the system acts autonomously—reallocating staff and beds, optimizing supplies, deploying pop-up triage units, and rerouting patients to hospitals with available capacity. It also monitors staff stress and patient anxiety in real-time, dynamically adjusting workloads and sending personalized patient guidance to improve experience and reduce wait times. An interactive dashboard visualizes surge hotspots, patient flows, and staff workload, allowing hospital managers to simulate interventions before deployment. By combining citywide scale, proactive action, and human-centered intelligence, ArogyaSetu ensures efficient hospital operations, timely patient care, and enhanced staff well-being.

ArogyaSetu directly addresses HealthTech Track 2 – Problem Statement 1, which seeks solutions to manage unpredictable patient surges. It predicts surges, autonomously executes staffing, supply, and patient advisory actions, and enhances hospital preparedness. By coordinating multiple hospitals, monitoring staff and patient well-being, and providing real-time notifications and guidance, it transforms surge management from reactive to proactive, holistic, and human-centered, fully aligning with the track requirements.

**Gullak : The Agentic AI Companion for Micro-Investing**

Gullak empowers young individuals to start investing from just ₹10 by automatically investing spare change and guiding users through personal financial goals. Its gamified, conversational interface leverages autonomous Agentic AI agents to make investing simple, educational, and habit-forming.

🔹**Proposed Solution :**

Gullak runs on a multi-agent architecture where each AI agent autonomously plans, learns, and acts to help users make better financial decisions , NO financial background needed

- *Investment Agent* - Analyzes spending patterns and auto-invests spare change from daily spendings
- *Goal Planner Agent* - Breaks user goals in achievable daily savings
- *Finance Tutor Agent* - Teaches basic financial concepts through interactive micro-lessons
- *Risk & Compliance Agent* - Ensures all investments remain SEBI-compliant and user-safe.


Features : 

- *Auto Micro-Investing* - Invest spare change automatically.
- *Goal-Based Savings* - Track and achieve financial goals.
- *Voice Queries* – “How much did I save this week?” — ask, and Gullak answers.
- *Personalized Insights* - AI-driven budgeting and investing tips.
- *Progress Motivation* - Streaks, badges, and nudges

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*Frontend* : React Native 
*Backend* : Node.js (Express) + Python (AI modules)
*AI Framework* : LangGraph or CrewAI for autonomous multi-agent orchestration
*Database* : MongoDB / Firebase
*APIs* : RazorpayX, Groww, INDmoney
*Hosting* : AWS Lambda, CloudFront, S3

To create a generation of financially independent youth who don’t fear investing — they enjoy it.
Because with Gullak, even small change can make a big future.

**Description of your solution**

Financebhau is an intelligent, on-premise AI-powered financial dashboard that acts as a personal financial companion for users. It combines conversational AI with interactive analytics, allowing users to talk naturally with their financial data, make informed spending decisions, and set achievable financial goals all within a secure, locally hosted environment (no external data sharing).

Instead of juggling spreadsheets and banking apps, users can simply **talk or chat** with FinanceBhau to ask questions like:
> “What was my biggest expense last month?”  
> “Can I afford a new laptop if I save for two months?”  
> “How close am I to my savings goal?”

FinanceBhau analyzes **spending patterns, income streams, and savings goals** to generate **personalized insights and actionable recommendations**, helping users make smarter financial decisions.

Unlike typical fintech apps that rely on cloud servers, **FinanceBhau operates fully on-premise** — meaning:
- All data stays **securely on the user’s device**
- No third-party or external APIs ever see the user’s financial data
- AI models are **locally deployed**, ensuring **privacy and autonomy**

### **Key Highlights**
- 💬 Conversational financial coaching via chat or voice  
- 💡 Predictive purchase advisor for smart spending  
- 🎯 Adaptive goal tracking and budgeting assistance  
- 🔐 Local AI engine for complete data ownership  
- 📊 Visual dashboard showing income, expenses, and progress  

FinanceBhau turns financial management into a **personal, intelligent, and private conversation**, empowering users to *own their data and master their money.*

**Fintech: Build an autonomous financial coaching agent that adapts to real user behavior, spending patterns, and income variability - helping gig workers, informal sector employees, and everyday citizens make smarter financial decisions proactively.**

Our project aligns strongly with the Fintech track by developing an autonomous financial coaching agent that continuously learns from real user behavior, spending patterns, and income variability. The AI dynamically adapts to each user’s financial rhythm, understanding when their income fluctuates, how they spend across categories, and how their goals evolve over time to offer precise, context-aware guidance.

It is designed especially for gig workers, informal sector employees, and everyday citizens who face irregular earnings or limited access to structured financial tools. The agent proactively monitors their financial activity, predicts upcoming shortfalls or opportunities, and recommends practical steps to improve financial stability and savings.

Running entirely on-premise, it ensures data privacy and user trust while delivering personalized insights in real time. In essence, this system transforms traditional financial management into an intelligent, adaptive, and proactive coaching experience that empowers individuals to make smarter, confident financial decisions every day.

********Project Name:********
Allure
********Tagline:********
“Smart AI to manage medicines, prescriptions, and daily health.”
********Project Description:********
Many people, especially the elderly or busy professionals, often forget to take their medicines or take the wrong dose. This can lead to serious health problems, hospital visits, or complications from drug interactions. Managing multiple medications and keeping track of refills is difficult, stressful, and time-consuming.

Allure is an AI assistant designed to solve this problem. It can read prescriptions from text or images, track dosage schedules, detect potential drug conflicts, send reminders, order refills automatically, and notify relatives if doses are missed. By combining intelligent planning and real-time tracking, Allure acts as a personal healthcare assistant, making medicine management simple, safe, and stress-free.

This project is worth selecting because it has the potential to solve a real daily problem, can be demonstrated easily in a hackathon using mock data or APIs, and shows how AI can make everyday life easier, safer, and more reliable.

**Healthtech: Manage unpredictable surges in patients during festivals, pollution spikes, or epidemics with an AI agent that autonomously analyzes data and recommends staffing, supply, and patient advisory actions in advance.**

Allure fits very well in this area because many people, especially elderly or busy individuals, often forget to take their medicines or take the wrong dose, which can cause serious health problems. Allure uses AI to read prescriptions from text or images, keep track of medicine schedules, check for possible drug conflicts, send timely reminders, and even order refills automatically when stocks run low. It can also alert relatives if medicines are missed repeatedly, making it easier for families to support patients. By combining smart planning and real-time tracking, Allure makes medicine management simple, safe, and stress-free, improving daily health and reducing the risk of errors. This project shows how AI can be used in a practical way to solve real-life problems and help people take better care of their health.

**Description of your solution**

GenFi: Making India's Invisible Earners Visible

Priya earns ₹1.2 lakhs/month as a freelancer with zero payment defaults and perfect tax compliance. Her bank rejected her loan application with one line: "Variable income. We only process salaried employees."

She's one of 160 million Indians earning real money but credit-invisible to the system. This is GenFi.

GenFi is an autonomous multi-agent AI platform that sees what banks can't: that gig workers, freelancers, and micro-entrepreneurs are creditworthy based on their actual financial behavior—not their job titles.

Three intelligent agents work autonomously:
- Credit Agent: Analyzes UPI history, income patterns, and tax compliance to calculate a transparent GenFi Credit Score (0-100)
- Insurance Agent: Identifies coverage gaps and recommends personalized policies
- Investment Agent: Suggests micro-investment strategies aligned with their risk profile

All three run in parallel, collaborate intelligently, and deliver one unified financial recommendation through a mobile-first chat interface.

In 24 hours, we're building a working MVP that unlocks ₹165+ trillion in lending potential for India's informal economy. Think of it as the financial advisor 400 million Indians never had—accessible, trustworthy, and designed specifically for how they actually earn money.

The tech: Free-tier stack (Gemini API, FastAPI, Supabase, React) deployed on Vercel. The impact: Making financial inclusion intuitive for the first time in India.

**Fintech: Bring your own problem in Fintech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

GenFi is a purpose-built solution for the Fintech track that leverages autonomous multi-agent AI to solve India's financial inclusion crisis. The core innovation lies in deploying three independent, agentic AI agents (Credit, Insurance, Investment) that operate autonomously rather than as static routing mechanisms. Each agent reasons independently from user queries—the Credit Agent analyzes financial behavior to calculate a transparent creditworthiness score, the Insurance Agent profiles risks and recommends coverage, and the Investment Agent suggests portfolio allocations—all while running in parallel orchestration. This represents true agentic AI: agents collaborate without explicit instruction, adapt based on feedback, and make autonomous decisions that merge into unified financial guidance. The problem it solves is critical and unmet: India's 160+ million credit-underserved gig workers and informal earners are invisible to traditional banking systems despite consistent income and perfect payment discipline. GenFi makes them visible by analyzing alternative data (UPI history, tax compliance, spending patterns) instead of relying on outdated employer-centric logic. The solution directly addresses the hackathon's theme of "bringing your own problem in fintech leveraging agentic AI" by demonstrating how autonomous agents can transform access to credit, insurance, and investment for India's informal economy—a ₹30 lakh crore market opportunity currently abandoned by traditional financial institutions. The technical implementation is production-ready: using free APIs (Gemini, Supabase, FastAPI), the system is deployable in 24 hours and scalable to serve millions of users through mobile-first, chat-based interfaces aligned with how informal earners actually use fintech.

**Description of your solution**

Agent FIDES: The Ethical Alpha Trust Layer is an AI-powered, self-governing multi-agent system that restores integrity across CeFi and DeFi markets. It tackles the rise of high-frequency trading bots (HFTs) that manipulate Indian exchanges and flash-loan exploits that drain DeFi protocols. Current tools are siloed and reactive; Agent FIDES builds a unified Trust Layer for Finance through three cooperative agents: the AI Guardian (detects HFT manipulation), the DeFi Sentinel (predicts on-chain exploit risks), and the Ethical Alpha Agent (forecasts prices and enforces an AI Veto Layer that halts trades under corruption alerts). This ensures only “ethical alpha” — profits untainted by manipulation. It directly benefits retail traders, SEBI/NSE regulators, brokers, and DeFi protocols, protecting transparency and market stability.

Technologies Used: Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, AutoGen, Polygon/Ethereum APIs, Zerodha KiteConnect, vector databases (Pinecone/Milvus), and a React + Flask dashboard for alerts and analytics.

Go-To-Market: Begin by licensing the RegTech module to SEBI so all trading firms must validate transactions through the Agent FIDES integrity feed, driving mandatory adoption. Revenue comes from B2B SaaS subscriptions for Ethical Alpha Signals, enterprise licensing for regulators/exchanges, and premium integrity-data access. By merging regulatory AI with blockchain security, Agent FIDES makes finance fair, transparent, and ethically intelligent — where AI not only predicts but protects.

**Fintech: Bring your own problem in Fintech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Our project fits the Fintech (Agentic AI) track because it directly tackles two of the most critical challenges in modern financial systems — market manipulation in centralized finance (CeFi) and security risks in decentralized finance (DeFi). While traditional Fintech tools focus on analytics or automation, our solution introduces Agentic AI agents that act autonomously to monitor, predict, and protect financial ecosystems. The system combines CeFi order book data and DeFi blockchain activity through intelligent agents that ensure ethical trading, transparency, and trust — core pillars of Fintech innovation. By unifying market integrity, predictive intelligence, and regulatory compliance within one AI-powered “Trust Layer,” our project advances the next generation of responsible and intelligent finance, perfectly aligning with the MumbaiHacks 2025 theme of Agentic AI in Fintech.

> AI-Powered Security Scanning for the Modern Web

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

CyberGuardians is an advanced, web-based security scanning platform designed for ethical hackers and cybersecurity professionals. It combines automated penetration testing tools with AI-driven analysis to provide comprehensive vulnerability assessments of web applications, networks, and domains.

**Key Features:**

- Multi-Tool Scanning: Supports 8+ security tools (Nmap, Nikto, WPScan, etc.) in single or chained configurations for thorough assessments.
- Real-Time Monitoring: Live terminal output, progress tracking, and status dashboards during scans.
- AI-Powered Insights: Generates intelligent security reports with vulnerability prioritization, recommendations, and executive summaries using advanced AI analysis.
- Interactive Analytics: Charts and visualizations for scan history, tool usage, success rates, and target analysis.
- Modular Architecture: Extensible design with tool management, scan history, and export capabilities (HTML, JSON, PDF).
- User-Friendly Interface: Responsive web UI with dark theme, tabbed navigation, and mobile optimization.

**How It Works:**

1. Users input targets (URLs, IPs, domains) via the web interface.
2. Select scanning modes: single tool or automated tool chains with customizable intensity.
3. Backend (Flask/Python) executes security tools and streams results in real-time.
4. AI analyzes raw outputs to generate actionable reports and insights.
5. Results are displayed with visualizations, exportable reports, and historical tracking.

**Target Users**: Cybersecurity professionals, penetration testers, and organizations requiring automated security assessments.

**Tech Stack**: Python (Flask backend), HTML/CSS/JavaScript (frontend), Chart.js (visualizations), AI integration for intelligent analysis.

**Benefits**: Reduces manual scanning time, provides AI-enhanced insights, supports both quick recon and deep analysis, and offers a professional-grade interface for security operations.

**Misinformation: Create an Agentic AI system that continuously scans multiple sources of information, detects emerging misinformation, verifies facts, and provides easy-to-understand, contextual updates to the public during crises.**

Backend (Flask/Python): Handles API endpoints for security scans, tool execution, result storage, and AI analysis using tools like Nmap, Nikto, etc.
Frontend (HTML/CSS/JS): Web interface with tabs for:
Scanner: Select targets, tools (single or chain scans), and options.
Terminal: Live output during scans.
Results: Display scan findings.
AI Report: Generate intelligent security insights.
Analytics: Charts for scan history and metrics.
Tools/History: Manage installed tools and past scans.
Workflow: User inputs target → selects tools → starts scan → views real-time progress → gets AI-analyzed reports and visualizations.

**Description of your solution**

MUMBAIHACKS 2025 

Team : Spark Squad
Team Members : Afreen Kazi, Yashvi Mehta, Mahi Palimkar,  Shipra Singh

Project Name : HeartSense 360
Tagline: Smart Heart-beat sensing, from prediction to protection.

Problem Statement: Cardiac patients in hospitals are at constant risk of arrhythmias, heart failure, or sudden cardiac arrest. Most existing ECG monitoring systems only raise alerts when preset thresholds are crossed, this often leads to delayed intervention or alarm fatigue among healthcare staff.
What’s missing is an intelligent system capable of continuously interpreting ECG signals in real time, correlating them with other vitals, and proactively recommending or initiating timely medical actions.
Beyond hospital settings, patients discharged with wearable ECG devices also face delayed responses when abnormalities occur. There is a need for an adaptive system that can analyze wearable ECG data, classify risk levels, and alert the user or medical professionals instantly when urgent attention is required.

Solution: We propose an Agentic AI-powered Continuous ECG Monitoring System that combines hospital-grade ECG monitoring and wearable ECG monitoring into one unified intelligent platform.
In hospitals, the system will continuously analyse 12-lead ECG signals, detect anomalies such as arrhythmia, atrial fibrillation, or ischemia, and correlate them with other vitals to guide medical decisions.
For wearable users, the system will run a lightweight classification agent that monitors 1–3 lead ECG signals in real time and immediately notifies the user to contact medical professionals if critical anomalies are detected.
This agentic architecture allows the system not only to detect but also to reason, plan, and act which is  much like a digital clinical assistant.

Datasets : 
[MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database (PhysioNet)](https://physionet.org/content/mitdb/1.0.0/)
[MIT-BIH Atrial Fibrillation Database v1.0.0](https://physionet.org/content/afdb/1.0.0/)
[Long Term AF Database v1.0.0](https://physionet.org/content/ltafdb/1.0.0/)
[PTB-XL, a large publicly available electrocardiography dataset v1.0.3](https://physionet.org/content/ptb-xl/1.0.3/)
[Apnea-ECG Database v1.0.0](https://physionet.org/content/apnea-ecg/1.0.0)
[CPSC 2018 Challenge Dataset](https://physionet.org/content/challenge-2018/1.0.0)

What we plan to build:(approach)
1. Data Acquisition & Preprocessing
Sources: Hospital monitors, Holter devices, wearable ECG sensors.
Input: WFDB files (.dat, .hea, .atr), streamed in 5–10 s windows.
Preprocessing:
![image]

2. Diagnostic Classification (Diagnostic Agent)
Feature Extraction using Deep learning: Raw waveform → CNN → Extract RR intervals, HRV, ST-segment, P-wave morphology features.
Models: LSTM for Temporal Dependencies and Transformers for long-range time-series dependencies.
Output: Rhythm class (Normal, AFib, PVC, etc.) + confidence score.

Agent logic: 
Low confidence → request longer data window
high confidence → forward to decision layer.

3. Decision Layer (Action Agent)
Applies AHA/ESC-based rules to act:
Normal → log silently.
AFib HR < 120 → notify for follow-up.
AFib HR > 140 or VTach → trigger emergency alert.
Agentic behavior: Autonomously decides to ignore, observe, or escalate.

4. Personalization (Personalization Agent)
Learns patient-specific baselines and adapts thresholds.
Tracks long-term trends (e.g., HRV decrease, HR rise).

5. Communication & Learning (Interaction + Adaptive Agents)
Generates explainable summaries (“3 AFib episodes, avg HR = 140 bpm”) for staff/nurses.
Routes alerts: 
patient → app.
doctor → dashboard/report.
 emergency → critical contacts.
Continuously improves alert policy via clinician/patient feedback using reinforcement learning.

What pain points/ problems it addresses : 
Reduces response time in cardiac emergencies and facilitates faster intervention through predictive alerts and contextual reasoning.
Mitigates alarm fatigue by providing context-aware, prioritized alerts.
Improves accuracy of ECG interpretation and early detection of arrhythmias.
Enables personalized monitoring, adapting to each patient’s cardiac profile.
Helps in preventing cardiac arrest through proactive intervention.

Methodology:

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/338ae3427b4c4d17a1253873b041ff44/56164654-bb66-46e9-8d9d-18d5c3513363.png)

Target Audience: 
Hospitals and cardiac care centers.
ICUs and post-operative cardiac units.
Long-term care facilities for high-risk patients.
Healthtech companies building remote patient monitoring platforms.

GTM and Revenue Streams: 
B2B SaaS Model: 
Subscription models for hospitals and clinics to use the monitoring dashboard and AI services.
Hardware Integration: 
Partnerships with ECG device manufacturers to embed the AI agent in monitors.
API Licensing:
Provide ECG interpretation APIs to telemedicine and healthcare app developers.
Data-as-a-Service (DaaS):
Anonymized ECG trend data for research and pharma use (subject to compliance).

**Healthtech: Manage unpredictable surges in patients during festivals, pollution spikes, or epidemics with an AI agent that autonomously analyzes data and recommends staffing, supply, and patient advisory actions in advance.**

- Unpredictable Surges Context:-
During festivals, extreme weather, or pollution spikes, cardiac events (arrhythmia, myocardial infarction, tachycardia) increase sharply, especially among elderly or pre-existing cardiac patients.
Your system proactively monitors high-risk patients through continuous ECG tracking, allowing hospitals to anticipate and prepare for such surges in cardiac emergencies.

Agentic AI Alignment-
The project uses multiple specialized agents (diagnostic, decision, personalization, communication, and adaptive agents).
These agents:-
-Continuously analyze ECG data in real time.
-Detect early cardiac anomalies.
-Recommend proactive interventions (e.g., notifying staff, preparing equipment, alerting cardiologists).

This is directly in line with the “AI agent that autonomously analyzes data and recommends actions in advance."

Hospital Resource Optimization-
The aggregated data from multiple patients helps hospitals:

-Identify patterns in cardiac stress events (e.g., spike in AFib during air pollution or heat).
-Forecast patient load and resource demand.
-Allocate staff and ICU beds efficiently before a surge occurs.
-Patient Advisory Actions:-
For wearable users, the system notifies patients when abnormal ECG patterns are detected and advises medical consultation early, helping reduce emergency admissions.
This aligns with the “patient advisory” part of the problem statement.

-Preventive Health Infrastructure:-
The agentic system acts as an early warning and advisory network, not just reactive.
It can even feed into a larger hospital network to provide population-level health insights during critical times.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Express.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Express.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Managing doctor appointments manually is often time-consuming and inefficient. Patients face difficulties in booking appointments, checking doctor availability, and tracking their consultations. Doctors and hospital staff, on the other hand, struggle to manage multiple bookings, maintain patient records, and keep track of earnings  especially without a centralized digital system.

This project solves those issues by providing a secure, digital platform where:

Patients can easily book, view, and manage appointments anytime, anywhere.

Doctors can monitor their schedule, update their profiles, and track earnings effortlessly.

Admins can oversee the entire system, ensuring smooth coordination between patients and doctors.

By automating the appointment process, it makes healthcare more accessible, organized, and efficient, reducing human error and saving valuable time for both doctors and patients.

**Challenges we ran into**

##  Challenges I Ran Into

While building the Full Stack Appointment Booking System, I faced several technical hurdles:

1. **CORS Issues Between Frontend and Backend**  
   - **Problem:** When connecting the React frontend (port 5174) to the Node.js backend (port 4000), the browser blocked API requests due to CORS policy errors.  
   - **Solution:** I updated the backend’s CORS configuration to allow multiple origins and enabled credentials. This fixed the preflight request errors and allowed smooth communication between frontend and backend.

2. **Implementing Role-Based Authentication**  
   - **Problem:** Managing three types of users (Patient, Doctor, Admin) and restricting access to specific routes was tricky.  
   - **Solution:** I implemented JSON Web Tokens (JWT) for secure authentication and created middleware in Express to protect routes based on user roles. This ensured that each user could only access authorized features.

3. **Database Relationships & Data Fetching**  
   - **Problem:** Linking appointments with doctors and patients in MongoDB efficiently was challenging, especially when fetching nested information.  
   - **Solution:** I used Mongoose’s `populate()` method to reference related collections, allowing me to fetch all necessary details in a single query without redundant data.

4. **Handling Time Conflicts in Appointments**  
   - **Problem:** Preventing patients from booking overlapping appointments with the same doctor required careful backend validation.  
   - **Solution:** I implemented server side checks that compared the requested appointment time with existing bookings, ensuring no conflicts and maintaining schedule integrity.

5. **Frontend State Management**  
   - **Problem:** Managing appointment data, user sessions, and doctor info across different dashboards became messy.  
   - **Solution:** I used React Context API combined with localStorage to maintain state across pages and reloads, providing a seamless user experience.

These challenges not only tested my problem solving skills but also gave me hands on experience with **real world full stack development issues** like security, data integrity, and role-based access control.

**Open Track - Development**

Our project is a full-stack appointment booking system designed for hospitals and doctors. It involves multiple levels of authentication patients, doctors, and admin and features comprehensive functionalities including booking management, profile updates, and earnings tracking. Since the core of the project is developing a robust, interactive software solution, the Development track is the most appropriate choice.

**The problem it solves**

In today’s world, many people have valuable skills but lack a free and accessible way to learn or share them. Existing platforms often require payment, limiting opportunities for students and learners. There’s a clear gap between those who want to teach and those eager to learn collaboratively. Mitramedha aims to bridge this gap by creating a peer-to-peer skill-swapping website. It promotes knowledge exchange, collaboration, and personal growth without monetary barriers. The platform encourages community-driven learning and mutual development for everyone.

**Challenges we ran into**

High cost of learning platforms – Many online courses and certifications are expensive, limiting access for students and learners from diverse backgrounds.

Lack of practical peer learning – Most learners don’t get real interaction or hands-on experience from online videos or lectures.

Skill gap between learners and job requirements – Students often learn theory but struggle to gain real, applicable skills needed in the industry.

Underutilized personal talents – People with strong skills or hobbies rarely get the chance to share their expertise with others.

Limited networking opportunities – Learners lack a social and collaborative space to meet like-minded individuals and grow together.

Dependence on money-based learning – Current systems make skill growth dependent on financial capability, excluding many potential learners.

Difficulty finding reliable mentors or learners – There’s no simple, verified, and trust-based system that connects people safely for mutual learning.

**The problem it solves**

Problem Statement:
Lack of a unified platform that combines social interaction, culinary learning, and professional opportunities for food lovers and chefs.

In today’s digital age, millions of food lovers, home cooks, and professional chefs use scattered platforms—social media for visibility, cooking apps for recipes, and delivery apps for food orders. However, there is no single, integrated platform that combines:

recipe sharing,

community engagement,

AI-powered food discovery, and

professional chef services.

Additionally, students and local chefs often struggle to find earning opportunities or a platform to showcase their culinary skills, while users waste time searching across multiple apps for recipes, food orders, or cooking help.

Thus, there is a gap between food enthusiasts and culinary professionals, and between learning, social interaction, and earning — all of which this platform aims to bridge.

Project Impact
1. Community Building

Creates an interactive ecosystem where users can connect, share, and learn from each other.

Promotes cultural exchange by allowing people to discover global cuisines and regional cooking styles.

2. Empowerment of Chefs and Students

Professional and aspiring chefs can earn income through premium content, live sessions, or chef-for-hire services.

College students can become delivery agents, opening up micro-entrepreneurship opportunities.

3. AI-Driven Food Innovation

The AI-powered ingredient search helps reduce food waste by suggesting recipes from what users already have at home.

Encourages smart cooking and sustainable food practices.

4. Personalization and Learning

Personalized recommendations and meal planning tools promote healthier eating habits.

Users can enhance their culinary skills through tutorials, collaboration, and professional chef interaction.

5. Economic and Social Impact

Creates a new digital economy for chefs, food bloggers, and delivery students.

Bridges the gap between home cooking, social media engagement, and professional opportunities. Here Users can also share there personal recipes and make their own community on the platform like social media.

> let's save the world

![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![JSON](https://img.shields.io/badge/JSON-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB Atlas](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB%20Atlas-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Let's be honest, messaging can get pretty boring. That's why we built a Marvel-themed game that lives right inside Telegram. No downloads, no app-switching, just instant fun with your friends.
Our bot lets you challenge your friends, show off your Marvel knowledge, and dive into a world of trivia and strategy—all without leaving your chat. It's perfect for when you need a quick break, want to geek out over your favorite characters, or just make your group chats way more entertaining.
We're turning those everyday conversations into actual gameplay. Because why should gaming and chatting be separate when they can be so much better together?

**Challenges we ran into**

**Challenges We Faced**

**1. 40+ Characters Almost Broke Us**

 We thought creating 40+ Marvel characters would be cool. It was cool. It was also a nightmare. Every single character needed unique moves, abilities, and stats. We spent hours just deciding if Iron Man's repulsor rays should do 50 or 100 damage.

*How we survived: * Made a template so we weren't copy-pasting like maniacs. Started with the popular characters, then cloned and tweaked for the rest. Not glamorous, but it worked.

**2. Bug Whack-a-Mole**

Fixed a bug in the battle system? Cool, now three more appeared. The Telegram bot randomly crashed.  At one point, Spider-Man could one-shot Thanos. Fun times.

*How we survived:* Started actually testing things instead of just hoping they'd work. Kept a running list of broken stuff. Helped each other debug when our own code stopped making sense to us.

**3. Time Management?** 

We had big dreams and a ticking clock. Spoiler alert: the clock won most of our arguments.

*How we survived:* Cut features we loved but didn't need. Focused on "make it work" before "make it pretty." Accepted that perfection wasn't happening T_T and good enough is actually pretty good.

**4. Sleep Was Optional (It Wasn't)**

The biggest challenge wasn't the code,it was staying awake and somewhat functional.

*How we survived: *Honestly? Caffeine, stubbornness, and the fact that quitting felt worse than continuing. Also, we kept hyping each other up when motivation died. Teamwork and desperation are a powerful combo.

**Open Track - Development**

**Why This Project Fits
**Technical Complexity

Built a full RPG game engine inside a Telegram bot
Handles complex turn-based combat with accuracy, damage, and stat calculations
Manages concurrent battles across multiple users without conflicts
Implements persistent data storage for 14 characters, player progress, and team management

**Advanced Features**

Multi-user state management - tracks inventory, levels, tokens, and boss progression
Dynamic level scaling - NPCs scale with player team strength
Real-time PvP system - reply-based dueling in group chats
Character progression - 10 levels + transformations with stat growth
Team switching - swap characters mid-battle when defeated

**Development Excellence**

Clean command system with 15+ interactive commands
Pagination for large datasets
Balanced game economy (tokens, EXP, rewards)
Error handling and user-friendly feedback
Modular architecture - easy to add new content

**Innovation**

Combines RPG mechanics with messaging platform constraints
Story mode progression system with 4 boss battles
Dual game modes (PvE + PvP)
Group chat integration for player battles

**Bottom Line**
This isn't just a chatbot - it's a fully functional RPG with complex game logic, strategic combat, progression systems, and multiplayer features, all built on Telegram's platform. It demonstrates advanced development skills in state management, game design, and user experience.

**Alum Track (Development) - Evolving Tales**

Our project, Marvel Universe Bot, brings the Marvel world to life as an interactive Telegram RPG. Unlike static games, every player shapes their own unique journey—choosing heroes, building teams, battling bosses, and dueling others. With dynamic battles, evolving character progressions, and unpredictable outcomes, no two playthroughs are the same. It fits the Evolving Tales track by turning a fixed storyline into a living, replayable adventure powered by player choice and creativity.
