### GharSe
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/gharse-e9ae) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Architrb1795/GharSe.git) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Syntax%20Error%202025-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://syntax-error-2025.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Har Bite Mein Ghar Ka Pyaar

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

1. The Core Problem & Our Solution
The Problem
Working professionals and students in bustling Indian localities face a persistent challenge: finding healthy, authentic, and affordable homemade food. They are often forced to choose between costly, unhealthy restaurant food and time-consuming self-cooking. Meanwhile, highly skilled non-working individuals and housewives possess untapped culinary talent and a desire for financial independence.

The Solution: GharSe (Ghar Se Aaya)
GharSe is a two-sided platform that bridges this gap, transforming home kitchens into micro-businesses. We empower Housewife/Home-Chefs (our Dabbawalas) to earn a stable income while providing our Customers with personalized, affordable, and nutritious home-cooked meals (tiffin services/dabbas).

2. Differentiators & Key Features
GharSe goes beyond a basic food delivery app by focusing on community, personalization, and monetization for the seller.

I. Seller (Dabbawala) Empowerment
Business Dashboard: A dedicated interface providing real-time sales data, customer insights, and full business analytics to help Dabbawalas understand and grow their business.

Custom Social Profile: Editable profiles where sellers can tag their Cuisine Expertise (e.g., North Indian, Konkani, Kashmiri, Jain). This allows them to market their unique skills and reach niche customers.

Next-Day Listing Model: Sellers list their fixed tiffin package menu and capacity the night before, ensuring minimal food waste and predictable earnings.

II. Customer Experience & Personalization
Curated Discovery: Customers search listings based on the Dabbawala's cuisine Tags and the fixed Today's Menu items.

Subscription Model (Seller-Specific): Customers can directly subscribe to a specific Dabbawala for a month, guaranteeing consistent, personalized home-cooked meals and providing the seller with stable, recurring revenue.

Custom Request Feature: Customers can submit special requests for items outside the fixed menu (e.g., “Can you prepare Idlis tomorrow?”). The seller has the option to Accept/Decline the request, allowing for premium, expertise-based monetization.

Advanced Filters: Basic filtering by Price, Average Rating, Spice Level, and specialized sorting based on seller tags.

III. Platform Monetization & Growth
Platform Subscription (Tiered Services): A Zomato Gold-like model where customers can pay a subscription fee to get Faster Service, Priority Delivery slots, and exclusive Discounts.

Rating & Reach: A robust rating system that directly correlates with the seller’s search visibility and reach, rewarding high-quality food and service.

Dedicated Snacks Section: Sellers can list packaged, shelf-stable snacks (e.g., namkeens, thetcha) separate from the dabba meal, creating an additional, scalable revenue stream.

3. Unique Feature: The Social Kitchen (Future Scope)
Though not fully implemented in the prototype, the vision includes a powerful content creation/consumption platform:

Short-Video Recipe Feed: Dabbawalas can upload short-form videos showcasing their cooking process and signature dishes.

Recipe Summaries: Below each video, a clean, summarized recipe and ingredient list will be provided.

Community Building: This feature builds trust, showcases the hygiene and authenticity of the kitchen, and turns Dabbawalas into community-recognized culinary personalities, significantly increasing their market reach.

**Challenges we ran into**

Our Development Journey: Challenges We Tackled Building GharKaDabba
Building GharKaDabba has been a rewarding journey, and like any ambitious project, it came with its own set of unique technical challenges. Our goal was to create a seamless, intuitive, and trustworthy platform for both our home chefs and our customers in Roorkee. Here’s a look at some of the key hurdles we navigated to bring this vision to life.

1. Architecting a Dual-Interface Platform
One of our first and most significant challenges was designing a single application that serves two completely different user roles: Chefs and Customers. This wasn't just about showing different pages; it required building two distinct experiences within one cohesive system.

We had to implement separate authentication flows (/auth for customers and /chef/auth for chefs) and manage role-based access control meticulously. Our system needed to instantly recognize a user's role upon login and direct them to the appropriate interface—the customer-facing homepage or the internal chef dashboard—without any confusion. This required careful state management and routing logic to ensure a user never landed on the wrong side of the platform.

2. Ensuring Backend Data Integrity and Consistency
The heart of GharKaDabba is the relationship between our chefs, their kitchens, and the customers who subscribe to them. Modeling this in our database was a complex task. We designed a schema where data is interconnected—a single review, for instance, affects the kitchen's overall rating and review count.

A key challenge was ensuring this data remained consistent. For example, when a customer submits a review, our backend doesn't just store the new comment. It has to perform multiple actions in a single, atomic transaction: create the review document, fetch all existing reviews for that kitchen, recalculate the new average rating, and update the reviewCount on the kitchen's profile. We engineered our Convex mutations to handle these multi-step operations reliably, ensuring the data displayed is always accurate and up-to-date.

3. Creating a Frictionless Onboarding and User Flow
We were determined to make the onboarding process as smooth as possible, especially for our chefs. A major challenge we focused on solving was eliminating the frustrating step of asking a user to log in right after they've completed a long registration form.

To achieve this, we engineered a seamless flow where a new chef is automatically authenticated and redirected to their dashboard upon successful registration. This involved carefully managing session states and tokens from the moment the account is created. This ensures the user's first interaction with their new dashboard is immediate and positive, setting the right tone for their journey on our platform.

4. Developing a Cohesive and Scalable Design System
To ensure GharKaDabba felt professional and trustworthy, we needed a consistent look and feel across the entire application. While we leveraged a component library as a foundation, the challenge was to customize and extend it to create a unique brand identity that felt warm and homely.

We invested significant effort in building a set of reusable, adaptable components—from cards and buttons to complex modal forms. This system had to be robust enough to work flawlessly across both the public-facing customer interface and the data-heavy chef dashboard, ensuring a polished and intuitive user experience no matter where a user was on the site.

**Open Track - Development**

GharSe is a comprehensive full-stack development project that perfectly aligns with the "Open Track - Development" by addressing a real-world social and economic problem through the creation of a sophisticated, feature-rich, two-sided digital marketplace. The project's scope extends far beyond a simple food delivery app, presenting significant development challenges and opportunities across its architecture.

Here’s how our project fits into this track:

Complex Full-Stack Architecture: The core of GharSe is a two-sided platform requiring the development of two distinct yet interconnected user experiences: one for the Customer (consumer app) and one for the Seller (Dabbawala). This involves:

Backend Development: Building a robust and scalable backend with a well-designed RESTful API to manage user authentication, complex database schemas (for users, menus, orders, subscriptions, ratings), payment gateway integration, and real-time order tracking notifications.

Frontend Development: Crafting two separate, intuitive user interfaces—a consumer-facing app for discovery, ordering, and subscription management, and a powerful "Business Dashboard" for sellers to manage listings, track earnings, and view customer analytics.

Advanced Feature Implementation: The project focuses on developing unique features that require non-trivial logic and implementation:

Seller-Specific Subscription Model: Engineering a recurring payment and order generation system that locks a customer to a specific seller, providing stable revenue for the seller and guaranteed service for the customer.

Dynamic Next-Day Listing System: Creating an efficient system for sellers to post daily menus and capacity, which requires careful state management and time-based logic to ensure listings are fresh and food waste is minimized.

Custom Request & Monetization Logic: Implementing a feature where customers can send special requests, and sellers can accept/decline and set a custom price, creating a dynamic, expertise-based monetization channel.

Data-Driven Functionality: The platform heavily relies on data to enhance user experience and business intelligence. This involves developing:

An Algorithmic Rating & Reach System: The rating a seller receives will directly influence their visibility in search results. This requires creating an algorithm that fairly weights ratings, reviews, and other performance metrics.

Sophisticated Search and Filtering: Implementing multi-faceted search functionality based on cuisine tags, price, spice level, and menu items, demanding efficient database querying and indexing.

Real-Time Analytics Dashboard: Developing a backend system to process sales data and customer insights, and presenting it visually on the seller's dashboard.

Ambitious Future Scope (The Social Kitchen): Our project roadmap includes the development of a content-heavy "Social Kitchen" feature. This is a significant development challenge involving video upload, processing, storage (e.g., using cloud services like S3), a content delivery network (CDN) for smooth streaming, and building community features like comments and sharing.

In summary, GharSe is a challenging and impactful development project that combines e-commerce, a subscription service, a business analytics tool, and a social media platform into one cohesive solution. It presents a fantastic opportunity to build and showcase a wide range of modern development skills.

### Peerlink
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/peerlink-bb64) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/GarvitJain99/peerlink) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1csbq7JqPqdIBV18A0-LrkjcOAyBkTw5T?usp=sharing) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://vimeo.com/1126398832) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-CodeSangam%202025-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://codesangam2k25.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> An offline, peer-to-peer file sharing app

![Firebase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase-333333?style=flat-square) ![Dart](https://img.shields.io/badge/Dart-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flutter](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flutter-333333?style=flat-square) ![Firebase Authentication](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase%20Authentication-333333?style=flat-square) ![Nearby API](https://img.shields.io/badge/Nearby%20API-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Connectivity Barrier : Sharing files in areas with poor or no Wi-Fi, such as classrooms, remote locations, or crowded events, is often impossible. Relying on mobile data is expensive and not always an option.

Privacy Concerns : When you upload a file to a cloud service or send it via a messaging app, your data passes through third-party servers. This poses a significant privacy risk for sensitive documents, personal photos, and confidential work files.

Speed and Inconvenience : Transferring large files over slow internet connections is a frustratingly slow process. Legacy methods like Bluetooth are unreliable for large files, and using USB cables is cumbersome and requires physical contact.

PeerLink eliminates these barriers by creating a direct, private, and high-speed bridge between nearby devices, requiring no internet connection or mobile data for the transfer itself.

How PeerLink Helps: Your Solution for Seamless Offline Sharing
PeerLink empowers users to share files with anyone nearby, effortlessly and securely. It's designed to make digital collaboration faster, safer, and more accessible for everyone.

What can people use it for?
⚡ Instant, Offline Sharing:
Students in a lecture hall can instantly share notes and project files. Colleagues in a meeting can securely exchange presentations and reports. Friends on a trip can share high-resolution photos and videos—all without searching for a Wi-Fi password or burning through their mobile data plans.

🔐 Enhanced Privacy & Security:
Because PeerLink creates a direct peer-to-peer connection, your files travel from your device straight to the recipient's, without ever being uploaded to an intermediary server. This makes it the ideal tool for sharing sensitive information, such as legal documents, financial records, or personal data, with complete peace of mind.

Integrated PDF Viewer & Annotator: PeerLink includes a powerful in-app PDF viewer. Users can instantly open, read, highlight, and annotate documents without leaving the app. Changes are saved directly to the file, streamlining review cycles and making collaboration seamless.(no need of 3rd party apps)

**Challenges we ran into**

1. **Edge cases of connection and disconnection logic**
-did frequent and numerous tests , to know the timing and position of problem occuring .

2. **Multi-user data leakage bug** 
- During testing, we discovered that if User A logged in, received some files, and then logged out, a new user (User B) logging in on the same device would see all of User A's private files in their library. User B could open, manage, and even delete them. This was a major security flaw that completely undermined user trust
we solved it by -
User-Specific Storage: we modified the storage key to be unique for each user by appending their Firebase UID. This ensured that each user had their own private, sandboxed space for their file list.

3. **Receiving File of unknown size**
- The nearby_connections library is incredibly powerful for sending raw data, but it sends the file payload (the bytes) without any associated metadata. When a user started receiving a file, our UI could only show a generic name like _nearby_12345.tmp and couldn't display a proper progress bar because it didn't know the total file size.
we solved it by -
A Two-Phase Transfer Protocol:
Phase 1: Before sending the large file, the sender's device first transmits a tiny BYTES payload. This payload contains a small JSON object with all the essential information: the original fileName, the fileSize, and a unique payloadId.
Phase 2: Send the Actual File: Immediately after sending the metadata, the sender transmits the actual FILE payload.

### ArtHive
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/arthive-8db3) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/sahilbharne/webster) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://vimeo.com/1126402081) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-CodeSangam%202025-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://codesangam2k25.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Portfolio Management

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The Problem It Solves

In today’s digital world, artists and photographers often struggle to find a dedicated space that truly caters to their creative workflow. While platforms like Instagram or Pinterest allow sharing art, they’re not built for artists — they prioritize algorithms, engagement metrics, and ads over genuine artistic discovery and collaboration.

Artists face several pain points:

🎨 Scattered Portfolio Management – Many use multiple tools (Google Drive, Behance, Instagram) just to store, showcase, and share their work.

🧠 Poor Discoverability – Without proper tags or curation, beautiful artwork often goes unnoticed in algorithm-heavy feeds.

🤝 Limited Artist-to-Artist Interaction – General platforms don’t encourage meaningful community-building between creators.

🧾 Manual Organization – Artists waste time manually tagging, categorizing, and curating their artworks.

💡 How ArtHive Makes Things Better

ArtHive streamlines the entire process — from uploading to discovery — in a single, cohesive platform built for artists, by tech.

🖼️ Centralized Creative Hub

Users can upload, organize, and manage their artworks and collections seamlessly. No juggling between cloud drives and social apps — it’s all in one place.

🤖 Smart Auto-Tagging with AI

The integrated Google Cloud Vision API automatically generates tags for uploaded images, helping artists skip the tedious manual tagging process while improving visibility and searchability.

🔒 Secure and Hassle-Free Access

With Clerk authentication, users enjoy secure sign-in options (Google, email, etc.), ensuring that data and identity remain protected — no more dealing with weak password systems or broken auth flows.

🌐 Artist Networking Made Simple

A built-in Follow system, likes, and saves foster an authentic artist community — one that’s focused on creative appreciation rather than algorithmic virality.

🎯 Personalized Discovery

The recommendation engine learns from what you like and follow, curating a feed that feels tailor-made for your artistic taste, helping users find new inspirations effortlessly.

🚀 Creator-Friendly Performance

Optimized Cloudinary uploads and image transformations mean artists can share high-quality images without worrying about slow load times or bandwidth issues.

**Challenges we ran into**

⚙️ Challenges I Ran Into

Building ArtHive wasn’t all smooth sailing — it came with its fair share of late-night debugging and facepalm moments. Here are a few key challenges and how I tackled them:

🧩 1. File Uploads Breaking During AI Tagging

The problem:
Initially, the image upload + AI auto-tagging pipeline was built using multer.diskStorage(). This meant each image was first written to disk, then read again for analysis by the Google Vision API, and finally uploaded to Cloudinary. On some systems (especially Windows), this caused file permission errors and temporary file clutter, breaking the upload route.

The fix:
I refactored the entire pipeline to use multer.memoryStorage(), which stores files directly in memory. The data is then streamed straight to Cloudinary without ever touching the filesystem. This completely eliminated the permission and cleanup issues while improving upload speed.

🧠 2. Data Sync Issues Between User Stats and Actions

The problem:
Whenever a user created or deleted an artwork or collection, the corresponding counts (artworkCount, collectionCount, etc.) sometimes went out of sync due to multiple async operations updating user stats concurrently.

The fix:
Instead of using incremental $inc updates, I wrote a centralized backend utility method — user.updateStats() — that recalculates all user stats directly from the database. This ensured that counts were always accurate, even if multiple actions occurred in parallel.

🔁 3. Stale Frontend Data After Updates

The problem:
After performing certain actions (like creating a new collection or liking an artwork), the frontend UI didn’t reflect the change immediately — users had to refresh manually to see updates.

The fix:
I built a custom “refetch-on-focus” hook using useEffect that listens to the browser’s window.focus event. Whenever the user returns to the tab, it automatically refetches the latest data from the API, keeping everything fresh and reactive.

🧠 4. AI Service Timeout Handling

The problem:
The Google Vision API occasionally took too long or failed due to network latency, which stalled the upload process.

The fix:
I wrapped the API call in a timeout wrapper using Promise.race() and added fallback behavior — if the AI tagging fails, the upload still completes successfully with default metadata. This ensured that one flaky external service could never break the core upload experience.

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/vanivyapar-23c3) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Somilgupta07/Vani-Vyapar) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-EcoCode-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://ecocode.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> A New Way To Trade With Speech

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![JWT](https://img.shields.io/badge/JWT-333333?style=flat-square) ![Natural language processing (NLP)](https://img.shields.io/badge/Natural%20language%20processing%20(NLP)-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Small shopkeepers and business owners often struggle to maintain proper financial records due to lack of time, technical skills, or accounting knowledge. Managing daily transactions manually—like noting expenses, sales, and income—can be confusing, time-consuming, and prone to errors.

Vani Vyapar solves this problem by introducing a voice-enabled smart accounting assistant that allows users to manage their financial records simply by speaking.

💡 How It Makes Tasks Easier

Hands-Free Operation: Users can add or view transactions using voice commands without typing anything.

No Technical Skills Required: Even non-technical users can maintain digital accounts easily.

Error Reduction: Automatically extracts the correct amount, category, and transaction type using NLP.

Faster Record Management: Saves every transaction instantly in a secure MongoDB database.

Real-Time Dashboard: Displays all income and expense records in a simple, organized way.

Bilingual Voice Support: Works with both Hindi and English commands for better accessibility.

🌟 In Short

Vani Vyapar transforms traditional bookkeeping into a smart, voice-based system, helping shopkeepers, small businesses, and individuals maintain accurate financial records quickly and effortlessly — just by speaking.

**Challenges we ran into**

🗣️ 1. Voice Input Accuracy (Hindi + English)

One major challenge was making the system understand both Hindi and English commands correctly.
Initially, the speech recognition API worked well for English but failed to detect Hindi phrases.

Solution:
I implemented a language detection function that checks the spoken text for Hindi characters and then processes the command accordingly. This allowed smooth handling of bilingual (Hindi-English) inputs.

🤖 2. NLP Intent Recognition

Detecting user intent (income vs expense) and extracting the correct amount and category from natural sentences was tricky.

Solution:
I designed a rule-based NLP logic that identifies key patterns like “add expense,” “income of,” or “रुपए का खर्च,” and uses regular expressions to extract numeric values and categories accurately.

💾 3. Database Integration

During integration with MongoDB, I faced issues where transactions weren’t saving in the correct collection (Expense vs Sales).

Solution:
I separated the logic to store each transaction in its respective collection based on the detected type and verified it through API testing with Postman.

🎨 4. Real-Time UI Updates

Making the transaction tables update instantly after each voice command was another hurdle.

Solution:
I used JavaScript functions to dynamically insert new rows into the respective table (Expense or Sales) immediately after a successful database save.

**AI for Urban Resilience**

Urban resilience refers to a city’s ability to adapt, recover, and sustain essential functions during challenges — whether economic, social, or environmental.
A resilient urban economy depends on the stability and digital empowerment of small businesses, which form the backbone of most cities.

💡 Role of Vani Vyapar

Vani Vyapar contributes to urban resilience by using AI and voice technology to strengthen the financial management capacity of small shopkeepers and micro-entrepreneurs.

In many Indian cities, local vendors and small-scale shop owners still maintain handwritten records. During crises (like pandemics, natural disasters, or economic shocks), these manual systems often fail — causing financial loss and instability.

Our project tackles this issue by offering an AI-powered voice-based accounting system that ensures:

Continuity of business operations: Even in low-resource settings, users can manage accounts via voice commands on any basic device.

Digital inclusion: Supports Hindi and English, enabling non-technical and semi-literate users to participate in the digital economy.

Data security and transparency: Transactions are stored safely in a cloud database (MongoDB), ensuring no loss of financial data.

Automation through AI: Natural Language Processing (NLP) and voice recognition reduce human errors and manual workload.

🏙️ Impact on Urban Resilience

By empowering local businesses with easy-to-use AI tools, Vani Vyapar helps build a more adaptive and financially stable urban ecosystem.
It promotes:

Economic resilience – by supporting small vendors in record-keeping and decision-making

Social resilience – by enabling inclusive access to technology in regional languages

Technological resilience – through automation and secure cloud-based data storage

🌱 In Summary
Vani Vyapar = Voice + AI + Finance = Smarter, Stronger, and More Resilient Urban Communities

**AI for Urban Resilience**

GaiaGuide strengthens urban resilience by using artificial intelligence to promote sustainable waste management and environmental awareness at the community level. In rapidly urbanizing areas, improper waste disposal directly affects public health, sanitation, and ecosystem stability. GaiaGuide addresses this by leveraging AI-powered image recognition and personalized learning to help citizens, especially children understand and adopt proper waste segregation practices.

Through data-driven insights and gamified community engagement, it encourages collective responsibility and builds long-term behavioral change, making cities cleaner, more adaptive, and sustainable. By transforming education into action, GaiaGuide ensures that urban communities are better equipped to handle environmental challenges, enhancing both ecological and social resilience.

### KrishiSetu
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/krishisetu-eafb) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/starkeyyyy/MarketPlaceServer) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-EcoCode-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://ecocode.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Ai Marketplace for Farmers and contributors

![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![React Native](https://img.shields.io/badge/React%20Native-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

We propose a sustainable, circular ecosystem that addresses this problem:
1. Incentivized Contribution: We reward waste producers (households, restaurants) for contributing organic biowaste, which our AI system analyzes for NPK content.
2. Affordable Organic Fertilizers: This collected waste is converted into high-quality, NPK-specific organic fertilizers, which we offer to farmers at a competitive price. This process ensures the raw materials do not degrade and retain their valuable properties.
3. Smart Application: Our recommendation system helps farmers apply the exact nutrients their soil needs, improving efficiency and crop health.
4. Direct-to-Consumer Marketplace: Farmers using our fertilizers can sell their produce directly on our platform, earning a premium by cutting out middlemen.
5. Community Benefits: Contributors can use their reward points for discounts on organic produce, closing the loop and benefiting the entire community.

**Challenges we ran into**

Building this circular economy model, while promising, comes with significant challenges. Here are the key hurdles we've identified:  
• Waste Collection and Quality Control:
• Contamination: Our system relies on clean biowaste. A major challenge is preventing contamination with non-organic materials like plastics, heavy metals, or other harmful substances that can compromise the final fertilizer's quality and safety.  
• Consistency: The nutrient composition of biowaste varies widely. Ensuring a consistent and balanced NPK ratio in our final product requires careful sorting and processing, which adds complexity and cost.
• Supply Chain Logistics: Maintaining a consistent and sufficient supply of biowaste from diverse contributors, along with efficient collection, transport, and processing, is a logistical puzzle.
• Fertilizer Production and Efficacy:
• Slow Nutrient Release: Unlike artificial fertilizers, organic compost releases nutrients slowly. While this is great for long-term soil health, it might not meet a crop's immediate nutrient demands during critical growth stages. We need to find ways to communicate this to farmers and potentially offer blended products.  
• Bulkiness: Organic fertilizers are generally more bulky than chemical ones, which can increase transportation, storage, and application costs for farmers.
• Standardization: Establishing a standard for our organic fertilizer's quality and nutrient content is crucial to build trust and ensure it meets a farmer's specific needs.
• Technology and User Adoption:
• Farmer Skepticism: Farmers, especially in remote areas, are often skeptical of new technologies and may be hesitant to adopt an app-based system or use real-time soil sensors. We need to clearly demonstrate a compelling return on investment (ROI).
• Digital Infrastructure: Lack of reliable internet and mobile connectivity in many rural areas can be a significant barrier to using our app-based services and real-time data collection.  
• Usability: Our app must be simple and intuitive for users with varying levels of technical literacy, from urban contributors to rural farmers.
• Economic and Financial Viability:
• Initial Capital Investment: Setting up the necessary infrastructure—collection points, processing facilities, and a robust digital platform—requires significant upfront capital.
• Competitive Pricing: To compete with cheap artificial fertilizers, we must keep our costs low, which is difficult given the logistics of collecting and processing diverse waste streams.
• Profitability: Ensuring the model is financially sustainable for all parties—contributors, our company, and farmers—is paramount. We must find a balance where rewards are meaningful, fertilizers are affordable, and the business remains profitable.

**Intelligent Ecosystems & Circular Economies**

Our project is a prime example of a circular economy. Instead of a linear "take, make, dispose" model, we create a closed loop for organic waste.
• We eliminate waste by diverting biowaste from landfills.
• We circulate materials by transforming this waste into a valuable new product: organic fertilizer.
• We regenerate nature by using this fertilizer to improve soil health and grow food sustainably, replacing polluting chemicals.
In short, we turn a disposal problem into a regenerative solution, keeping valuable resources in circulation and benefiting both the environment and the economy.

Essentially, it turns scattered, informal connections into an organized, accessible platform that empowers learning, collaboration, and local support.

Open Innovation Context:
Open innovation is about leveraging ideas, skills, and knowledge both inside and outside an organization or community to co-create solutions, share expertise, and accelerate progress. Instead of relying solely on a closed, internal approach, open innovation encourages collaboration, sharing, and crowdsourcing of talent.

SkillSwap & Open Innovation:

Community-driven skill exchange: Your platform allows users to share their skills openly with peers in the community—students, hobbyists, or local helpers—creating a pool of knowledge that anyone can tap into.

Collaborative learning and problem-solving: Users can offer expertise or seek help, fostering a culture of collaboration, mentoring, and mutual support.

Decentralized idea flow: By enabling any user to post tasks or offer skills, your system creates an open channel for innovation where creative solutions emerge from diverse contributors rather than a single source.

Rapid knowledge transfer: People can learn new skills or get tasks done faster, promoting innovation at the individual and community level.

Feedback and improvement: Through interactions and task completion, users indirectly refine and improve skills in an open, iterative manner—mirroring the core principles of open innovation.

Summary:
SkillSwap acts as a microcosm of open innovation at the community level. It connects talent and need, encourages the free flow of ideas and skills, and allows users to co-create value without formal organizational boundaries. In essence, it turns learning and collaboration into an open, community-powered innovation network.

**The problem it solves**

Mental Health is undoubtedly becoming more and more prevalent in society. We as humans should be more aware of the betterment of mental wellness. There has been a significant increase by 41% in anxiety disorder cases and a 67% increase in suicide cases due to mental health problems.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/82128d18302a406b9713fdf3f269fb69/5da15542-bc3e-40ef-be13-8f8a00653c32.png) To reduce the rates, our team decided to create SereneSpace which will use fun psychological tests to assess an individual's mental health status and provide pre-built solutions to improve mental health conditions. 
1. Firstly There is a user authentication part so the user needs to sign themselves up. 
2. The user can detect his stress level and can get an insight into what necessary he should take. 
3. We have a ChatBot also to assist our users. 
4. Then as a solution, we have Music therapy where users can meditate with soothing music playing in the background. There is a Yoga & Exercises section where there a Yoga poses that is being displayed on the screen with which our user can do regular practice and keep themselves healthy physically as well as mentally. 
5. SereneSpace has a Game & Quiz section where users can learn something knowledgeable in a fun way and can also play brainstorming games. 
6. The purpose of SereneSpace is to assist its users by providing solutions to their mental health conditions without requiring professional help in most cases. 
We have observed that these solutions work efficiently in bettering their mental health conditions.

**Challenges we ran into**

As we built SereneSpace, one of the largest challenges that we encountered was handling user data privacy — particularly because the site is about mental health and emotional support.

Initially, we were only concerned about making the chatbot and user interaction work. It was thrilling to watch users tell us how they were feeling and receive responses from the model. But then I remembered something important:
those messages weren't mere data — they were true emotions and personal thoughts.

I couldn't help but wonder:

"What if a person's private conversation with the bot gets accidentally stored or exposed?"

It was really that idea that made me think about the project in a different way.

Early on, I was storing chat logs in plain text files to try out the responses. Worked well for debugging, but then I realized that doing this could result in a serious privacy breach. Anybody with access to the server could potentially read them. That's when I began reading about data encryption, safe storage, and privacy legislation such as GDPR and India's DPDP Act.

I also discovered how crucial it is to turn off debug mode in production, deal with user sessions securely, and see that no sensitive information is being logged or cached.

This phase of the development process made me think outside of code — it made me understand that when you create something that works with human emotions, trust and confidentiality are equally vital as the technology itself.

**AI**

SereneSpace fits directly into the Artificial Intelligence (AI) domain because it uses intelligent systems to understand, analyze, and respond to human emotions — mimicking supportive, empathetic conversation like a human would.

At its core, the project applies Natural Language Processing (NLP) — a key subfield of AI that focuses on understanding and generating human language. The chatbot component interprets user messages, processes the emotional tone behind the words, and responds with contextually appropriate and comforting replies.
| Area                                          | AI Concept Used                                 | Role in the Project                                                                               |
| --------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 💬 Chatbot Interaction                        | **Natural Language Processing (NLP)**           | Understands user inputs and generates meaningful, human-like responses.                           |
| 😊 Emotion Recognition                        | **Sentiment Analysis / Emotion Detection**      | Analyzes user messages to identify emotional states like sadness, stress, or positivity.          |
| 🧩 Response Generation                        | **Machine Learning Models**                     | Uses trained models or APIs to craft supportive and context-aware replies.                        |
| 📊 Recommendation System *(optional feature)* | **Predictive Analytics / ML-based Suggestions** | Recommends self-care tips, breathing exercises, or motivational content based on user patterns.   |
| 🧠 Continuous Improvement                     | **AI Learning Loop**                            | The system can improve over time as more interactions are analyzed (depending on implementation). |

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Commuters often face uncertainty about metro rush levels, leading to long waits, discomfort, and wasted time. Current apps only show train timings, but not how crowded a train or station actually is.

Our solution provides:

Live Rush Data → Helps people decide the best time or station to travel.

Comfort & Safety → Reduces overcrowding, improves passenger experience, and promotes safer travel.

Time Management → Allows commuters to plan journeys efficiently, avoiding unnecessary delays.

Community-Driven Insights → Users can contribute real-time updates, making the system smarter with every trip.

In the long run, this can integrate with Smart City initiatives, helping authorities optimize metro operations and making public transport smarter and more reliable.

**Challenges we ran into**

While building the Metro Rush Detection & Comparison App, one of the biggest challenges we faced was handling real-time crowd data. Initially, our system either showed delays in live updates or sometimes displayed inconsistent rush levels across stations. This reduced the accuracy of predictions and created confusion.

We also struggled with a bug in integrating multiple data sources. The formats were mismatched, which caused the backend to crash whenever both inputs were processed simultaneously.

> smart vision for smarter vision

![scikit-learn](https://img.shields.io/badge/scikit--learn-333333?style=flat-square) ![pandas](https://img.shields.io/badge/pandas-333333?style=flat-square) ![Matplotlib](https://img.shields.io/badge/Matplotlib-333333?style=flat-square) ![SQLite](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQLite-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Seaborn](https://img.shields.io/badge/Seaborn-333333?style=flat-square) ![OpenAi](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenAi-333333?style=flat-square) ![Streamlit](https://img.shields.io/badge/Streamlit-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The Smart Expense Manager helps people track, categorize, and analyze their spending in one place. Users can:

Quickly add expenses and let the app automatically categorize them, saving time and reducing manual errors.
Set monthly budgets for different categories and get instant alerts when they approach or exceed their limits, helping prevent overspending.
Visualize spending patterns with charts, making it easier to understand where money goes and identify areas to save.
Split bills easily among friends, removing the hassle of manual calculations.
Get AI-powered insights, such as weekly spending comparisons and top categories, to make smarter financial decisions.
Export expense data for backup or further analysis.
Overall, it simplifies personal finance management, increases awareness of spending habits, and helps users make safer, more informed financial choices.
The integrated AI chatbot (Blackbox Dialog) in the Smart Expense Manager enhances user experience by providing instant, data-driven assistance for expense management. Here's how people can use it and the benefits:

What People Can Use It For:
Quick Expense Summaries: Ask "What's my total spending?" to get real-time totals, category breakdowns, and recent expenses without opening multiple pages.
Financial Advice and Tips: Query "Give me advice" for personalized suggestions, like budgeting tips based on spending patterns (e.g., "Focus on reducing entertainment costs").
Category Insights: Say "Show category breakdown" to see spending by category with amounts, helping identify high-spend areas.
Recent Activity Review: Use "What are my recent expenses?" to list the last few entries for quick recall.
Saving Strategies: Ask "How can I save money?" to get targeted tips, such as focusing on the top-spending category.
General Help: For unmatched queries, it offers guidance on available features, like "Ask something like 'What's my total spending?'".
How It Makes Existing Tasks Easier/Safer:
Efficiency: Eliminates navigation through menus/pages; get insights instantly via natural language in a floating modal, speeding up decision-making (e.g., check totals mid-session without switching to "View Expenses").
Personalization: Responses pull live data from the database, offering tailored advice (e.g., "Your groceries are 20% of total – consider meal planning"), making budgeting more intuitive than static charts.
Accessibility: Rule-based logic ensures no external API dependencies, keeping data private and secure (no API keys or internet required), reducing risks of data breaches or quota issues.
User-Friendly: Conversational interface lowers the barrier for non-technical users; no need to understand filters or visualizations – just chat.
Proactive Guidance: Provides contextual tips (e.g., alerts for high spending), encouraging better habits and preventing overspending without manual checks.
Safety: Local processing means sensitive financial data stays on-device, avoiding cloud risks; responses are deterministic and based on user data only.

**Challenges we ran into**

A specific hurdle encountered during development was ensuring accurate and automatic expense categorization. Relying only on keyword matching led to misclassifications, especially for ambiguous descriptions. To overcome this, a two-tier system was implemented: fast keyword matching for common cases and a fallback machine learning model (Naive Bayes) for improved accuracy. This hybrid approach significantly increased categorization reliability and made the app more user-friendly.

**$300(Open): Cash Prize**

This project fits perfectly into a hackathon track focused on financial technology, automation, or data-driven solutions. It demonstrates how modern tools—like machine learning, data visualization, and web frameworks—can be combined to solve real-world problems such as personal finance management. By automating expense tracking, providing actionable insights, and making financial data easy to understand, the project addresses key hackathon goals: innovation, impact, and practical usability. It showcases rapid prototyping, teamwork, and the application of advanced technology to improve everyday life.

**The problem it solves**

The primary problem is the high risk of injury and delayed assistance following falls among the elderly, which can lead to serious health complications, prolonged recovery, or even fatal outcomes. Many older adults live alone or experience limited supervision, making timely detection and intervention critical. Traditional monitoring methods rely heavily on manual checks or wearable devices, which may be unreliable or go unnoticed during an emergency. This creates an urgent need for an automated, real-time fall detection system that ensures immediate alerts and rapid response to safeguard elderly individuals’ health and independence.

**AI in HealthCare**

This project exemplifies the integration of AI in healthcare by providing intelligent, real-time monitoring for elderly individuals. Using AI-powered algorithms, such as computer vision and machine learning, the system can accurately detect falls, differentiate them from normal movements, and immediately send alerts to caregivers or healthcare providers. Beyond reactive assistance, the AI can analyze patterns in mobility over time to identify individuals at higher risk, enabling preventive interventions. By offering continuous, non-intrusive monitoring, this solution enhances patient safety, reduces response times in emergencies, and supports independent living, demonstrating how AI can improve healthcare outcomes and quality of life for vulnerable populations.

**AI in Education**

Personalized Learning Pathways

AI could analyze what topics a student watches (e.g., Algebra, Mechanics) and recommend the next best video or topic based on their progress.

Example: If a student is spending more time on Trigonometry, the system could suggest Coordinate Geometry next.

Smart Recommendations (like Netflix, but for study)

Instead of just showing videos in a list, AI can rank or recommend videos based on difficulty, student level, or even performance in quizzes.

Automatic Video Summaries & Notes

AI can generate bullet-point summaries or concept maps for each video lesson.

Students could review these instead of rewatching the entire video.

Interactive Q&A (AI Tutor)

Students could ask questions in natural language while watching the video.

AI could explain concepts, answer doubts, or even pull relevant timestamps from the video.

Adaptive Assessments

After each video, you could add quizzes powered by AI that adapt to the student’s level.

If they get questions wrong, AI could direct them back to the specific part of the video that explains it.

Multilingual Support

AI can auto-generate subtitles, transcripts, and translations so students can learn in Hindi, English, or any language they’re comfortable with.

Learning Analytics

AI can track metrics like:

Which videos are rewatched the most?

Where do students pause or drop off?

Which topics are students struggling with?

> One App for the Entire Farming Journey.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Our project is a next-generation AI-powered farming assistant designed to transform agriculture by providing end-to-end support for farmers. Unlike existing applications that only address isolated issues such as crop disease, weather updates, or market access, our solution brings all critical farming needs together into a single, intelligent platform.

At its core, the system leverages advanced AI models to analyze soil characteristics, weather conditions, and crop patterns to recommend the most suitable crops for cultivation. Beyond just recommending, it also predicts expected yields, helping farmers plan their season with greater accuracy and financial confidence.

A unique strength of the platform is its disease prediction and prevention system, which uses AI to identify plant health risks early and suggest effective treatments and preventive measures. This minimizes crop losses and ensures healthier harvests.

The project goes further by offering plantation guidance and crop planning strategies, equipping farmers with step-by-step instructions on improving productivity and sustainability. Unlike traditional advisory services, these recommendations are personalized and data-driven, ensuring they are practical for each farmer’s specific conditions.

Another key differentiator is the integration of local-language voice interaction. Farmers can interact with the platform in Tamil or English using simple voice commands, eliminating barriers related to literacy or technical complexity. This ensures inclusivity, making advanced technology usable by small-scale farmers who often lack formal education.

Beyond intelligence, the platform fosters a connected farming ecosystem. Farmers can link with one another to share experiences, resources, and advice through community chat features. They can also access local shop and service provider listings, creating a seamless link between agricultural knowledge, inputs, and market opportunities.

In essence, our project does not simply give information — it acts as a complete farming companion, guiding farmers from soil preparation to final market connection. It humanizes AI by delivering it in the farmer’s own language and voice, empowering them with knowledge, confidence, and tools for better productivity and profitability.

**Challenges we ran into**

While building this project, one of the major challenges I faced was ensuring that the dataset paths were set correctly. Initially, the training and validation directories worked fine, but the test dataset path pointed to a Kaggle directory that did not exist locally. This caused repeated file-not-found errors. I resolved this by carefully restructuring my dataset folders and updating the code to dynamically reference the correct local paths.

Another hurdle was related to GPU utilization. At first, the model was running entirely on the CPU, which made the training process extremely slow. I added a device handling function that automatically switches to GPU if available. This significantly improved training speed and made experimentation more practical.

I also ran into difficulties when plotting the confusion matrix. The code initially threw errors because the arrays used for predictions and labels were not initialized properly. By explicitly creating all_labels and all_preds lists and ensuring they were updated inside the evaluation loop, I fixed the issue and successfully generated detailed performance metrics.

Finally, tuning hyperparameters such as the learning rate, weight decay, and number of epochs required several iterations. I overcame this by adopting the OneCycle learning rate policy, which stabilized training and helped the model converge faster.

Overall, these challenges pushed me to debug systematically, double-check assumptions, and adopt best practices for training deep learning models. Each hurdle not only improved my problem-solving skills but also deepened my understanding of how data pipelines and neural networks behave in practice

**The problem it solves**

Core Problem

One-size-fits-all classrooms fail most students.

Large classrooms (30–60 students) → teachers cannot personalize learning.

Students have different learning styles (visual, auditory, reading/writing, kinesthetic).

Language barriers in India — many students struggle because lessons aren’t in their mother tongue.

Current EdTech gaps:

Most platforms provide pre-recorded videos, not adaptive 1:1 guidance.

AI tools exist but are rarely multilingual, knowledge-graph-aware, or fully personalized

**Challenges we ran into**

Integrating Gemini 2.0 API for adaptive learning

Challenge: Generating quizzes and explanations in real-time, personalized to each student’s pace and learning style.

Solution: Created a generic LLM wrapper (llm_client.call_llm()) to simulate responses during hackathon demo.

Knowledge Graph (Neo4j) for concept relationships

Challenge: Modeling prerequisite chains (e.g., Algebra → Linear Equations → Quadratics).

Solution: Designed mini-KG for Math topics and a simple query function to recommend next concepts.

Multilingual support

Challenge: Translating adaptive explanations and quizzes accurately into multiple languages without losing context.

Solution: Built LLM-driven translation module with transliteration fallback for non-Latin scripts.

Frontend + Backend integration

Challenge: Real-time interactive demo with student progress tracking, adaptive quiz, explanations, and dashboard.

Solution: Used Next.js + Tailwind for responsive frontend, Node.js + Express backend, and dummy APIs for Gemini calls.

Database design

Challenge: Storing student profiles, quiz attempts, progress metrics, and KG mappings efficiently.

Solution: PostgreSQL for structured data + Neo4j for KG queries, with local JSON fallback for demo.

Deployment under time constraints

Challenge: Making full-stack demo runnable for judges within 24 hours.

Solution: Docker Compose setup + Vercel (frontend) + Railway (backend) ready, ensuring plug-and-play demo.

Ensuring hackathon-ready UX

Challenge: Conveying AI capabilities clearly without actual students.

Solution: Interactive demo flows with sample students, quizzes, and AI explanations to simulate real usage.

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/ghost-key-c043) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/YASMIN-SEKH/triple-trouble) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=caVPEB3nMFk) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-DSU%20DevHack%202.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://dsudevhack2.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Transparent biometrics to secure systems

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![TensorFlow](https://img.shields.io/badge/TensorFlow-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Passwords are the weakest link in online security. They can be stolen, guessed, or phished, and even two-factor authentication (2FA) isn’t always effective against sophisticated attackers. Traditional authentication methods often force users to choose between security and usability, either the system is easy to use but unsafe, or it’s secure but adds friction.
GhostKey solves this problem by making authentication:
•	Invisible → Users simply type naturally, and GhostKey verifies them using their unique keystroke rhythm.
•	Safer → Attackers can’t copy typing dynamics or voice patterns, making credential theft useless.
•	User-friendly → No extra tokens or codes required — security is built directly into the way you type and speak.
•	Privacy-first → Models are stored locally per user, with no raw keystrokes or voice data shared.

**Challenges we ran into**

Building GhostKey came with several technical and design challenges:
1. Feature Engineering for Keystrokes
Capturing raw keystrokes and converting them into meaningful features such as hold time, flight time, and error rate was difficult. Initially, the model overfit because of inconsistent input sizes.
Solution: We implemented a padded fixed-length vector (inputDim = 34) and standardized data preprocessing to keep samples consistent.
2. Custom Autoencoder Training in TypeScript
Instead of relying entirely on TensorFlow, we built a custom autoencoder training loop from scratch in TypeScript. Debugging weight updates and ensuring gradients worked properly was a major challenge.
Solution: We logged reconstruction errors per epoch, tested with small synthetic datasets, and validated results against TensorFlow.js to confirm correctness.
3. Voice Biometrics Integration
Extracting MFCC and spectral features in the browser was resource-intensive. The Meyda library sometimes produced unstable results depending on microphone input quality.
Solution: We added averaging across multiple samples and built a robust similarity score by combining spectral and MFCC features to smooth inconsistencies.
4. Privacy and Storage
We wanted to ensure that no sensitive keystroke or voice data was stored in plain form. Balancing functionality with a privacy-first design was challenging.
Solution: We introduced a privacy mode to discard raw data after training and stored only lightweight JSON models per user.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![Express.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Express.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![OpenAi](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenAi-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Firebase Authentication](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase%20Authentication-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**Real-world context**

1. Dual-earner parenting is now the norm: in 2024, both parents were employed in 66.5% of married-couple families with children [[Bureau of Labor Statistics.](https://www.bls.gov/news.release/pdf/famee.pdf) ]

2. Parents are also reporting significantly higher stress than other adults (33% vs. 20% reporting high stress), which correlates with time pressure and work-family conflict. [HHS.govPMC](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10138671/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) 

3. A 2024 study from the [C.S. Mott Children’s Hospital National Poll on Children’s Health](https://www.contemporarypediatrics.com/view/survey-bedtime-routines-prove-important-for-young-children-s-sleep) shows that 1 in 4 parents find bedtime challenging with children aged 1-6 years

4. A [2023-24 nationally representative survey](https://www.edweek.org/teaching-learning/young-kids-are-struggling-with-skills-like-listening-sharing-and-using-scissors/2024/06) of over 1,500 preK-3 teachers found that 
- 94% report that listening and following instructions is more challenging now for young students compared to five years ago. 
- Similarly, 85% say sharing, cooperating, and taking turns have become more difficult for current students.


**Problem Statement**

For children 0 - 5, the hardest moments are transitions - bedtime, getting dressed, cleaning up, trying new foods, etc. At this stage, kids are pre-literate, have limited executive function and self-regulation, and don’t internalize abstract reminders. Most tools available to parents (checklists, timers, sticker charts) help adults plan, but they don’t change a child’s state in the moment. The result: repeated prompts, power struggles, and a frayed parent–child connection. 

Dual-working parents, under time pressure, need fast, easy, emotionally engaging ways to guide children through their daily routines. 

**How ParentPlay Helps**

*ParentPlay* turns daily mundane routines into play with personalized voice and customizable music, so children cooperate easily with time-pressed, dual-working parents.

1. **Custom Routine Songs (ElevenLabs Music)**: Parents can create catchy songs tied to a routine and the child's interests (e.g., “get dressed, mealtime”), making everyday routines into joyful experiences.

2. **Stories in Parents’ Voice (Voice Clone + Narration):** Bedtime stories read in a parent’s own voice that is familiar, soothing, and screen-down friendly. [Research](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6334756/) shows that children show specialized neural responses to their mother’s voice 

3. **Long form Story Narration ( TTS)** - Parents can play a story in a voice of their choice.

4. **Parent Coach Chat (Voice-in/Voice-out):** In the moment, parents speak a question/a parenting struggle they are facing (STT) and hear a well-crafted coach feedback (TTS): tailored by age and situation.

**Challenges we ran into**

1. The voice clone I created did not sound like my voice. However, it's a [known limitation](https://help.synthesia.io/en/articles/9770805-why-is-my-accent-not-being-captured-in-my-voice-clone) that ElevenLabs instant voice cloning does not always preserve the accent of non-native English speakers, as ElevenLabs only has English accent data for US, UK, Australian, and Canadian English.


4. Eleven Labs Latency - Experienced high latency when rendering Voice clone and custom song. To keep the experience smooth, the UI shows an activity indicator with stage hints and then saves the file locally so every replay is instant.

3. Faced an issue with audio playback. Used ChatGPT to fix Object Storage headers that were playback-friendly and added better MediaSession controls.

4. Faced issues with mic recording. Used ChatGPT to get help. Removed timeslice entirely.

5. Went down the rabbit hole multiple times with Replit agent to fix errors - cost a lot of credits!

**All Registered Participants.**

The complete app is built and hosted using AI-powered vibe coding ( Tool used - Replit).

**Voice AI & Conversational Products | Powered by Elevenlabs**

I used **ElevenLabs** end-to-end to build **ParentPlay, a voice-first PWA that turns stressful daily routines into play.**

1. **Personalized TTS (Voice Cloning + TTS)**: Parents create a personal voice and play stories to their child in their voice -> reducing anxiety and increasing comfort during bedtime.

2. **Long-form narration (TTS)**: Parents can choose from various voices in Eleven Labs to narrate natural-sounding bedtime and transition stories.

3. **Generative music for behavior cues (Music API):** Parents can create catchy songs tied to a routine and the child's interests (e.g., “get dressed, mealtime”), making everyday routines into joyful experiences

4. **Voice-in**: Parents speak a question to Coach (STT) during chaotic moments (“What do I say when he won’t share?”).

5. **Voice-out:** Coach replies with concise, spoken guidance (TTS), so parents don’t need to read a screen.

**The problem it solves**

Picking “the right” model or prompt for writing tasks is guesswork, slow, and subjective. Creators and marketers bounce between tabs, eyeball outputs, and still struggle to explain why one option is better- or to keep quality consistent under budget limits. This tool makes that process measurable and fast: it generates side-by-side outputs and scores them automatically on Creativity, Accuracy, Speed, and Relevance, so you can decide with data, not vibes.

**What people can use it for (and how it makes work easier/safer):**

**Quick Compare (generic tasks)-** Paste any prompt and instantly compare multiple models with clear 1–5 scores and rationales.
Easier: one click to see winners;
Safer: flags basic risks (clickbait, all-caps spam, over-claims).

**Playbook flows (deep dives)-** 
Curated evaluators for: YouTube Hooks, YouTube Titles, LinkedIn Openers, Landing-page Hero, Idea Lists, Generic Tasks
Easier: channel-aware rubrics and heuristics (length limits, keyword fit, CTA checks); Safer: readability and integrity checks reduce spammy or misleading copy.

**Please note:**
For the public demo we intentionally use lower-cost OpenAI models to contain token spend, making it budget friendly.
Transparent: scores still help rank options; the UI clearly labels that higher-end models are BYOK (coming soon).

Future-proof model choice (BYOK, loading soon). You’ll connect your own keys and run any supported model (e.g., GPT-5 / Claude / Gemini) with the same fair rubrics.
Safer: your keys, your data;
Consistent: identical evaluation criteria across models.

**What’s live today (demo constraints):**
Multi-model compare (cost-effective OpenAI models), automatic scoring on Creativity / Accuracy / Speed / Relevance, prompt suggestions, Playbooks, and basic heuristics.

BYOK toggle is visible but disabled with “loading soon,” to make the roadmap explicit and to cap demo costs.

**Vision & next steps:**
BYOK for full model freedom, pairwise tournaments, mini-datasets for batch evals, richer rubrics per channel, CSV/Share links, and lightweight reports for stakeholders.

Loom explainer video: https://www.loom.com/share/cc37b969946e4b849ac8a3d6ebbc9037?sid=df8b47f1-7fd3-4bb3-ba9d-2e9b1ba6bb76

Note for the evaluators: Due to API limitations, if during evaluation the credits run out, please do not hesitate to reach us out at priyanshk260@gmail.com for extension of credits. 
Thanks!

**Challenges we ran into**

**Challenges we ran into:**

We aimed… high 😅. The vision was a full eval lab (playbooks, pairwise, datasets, reports). But two things hit hard: designing good playbooks is slow craft, and evals are a whole discipline, not just “ask a model to judge.” Here’s what tripped us up and how we adjusted.

**Evals is a whole different thing:** 
While everyone is talking about AI, automation, workflows, there are less people talking about it.

**Playbooks are harder than they look:**
Turning “good” into measurable. Converting vibes (“this hook slaps”) into rubrics and heuristics (length caps, specificity, integrity) took far longer than expected. We cut scope to 5 playbooks and added a Generic Task fallback so users can still test anything.

**Rubric conflicts:**
Clarity vs. curiosity, brevity vs. context- optimizing one hurt another. I added weights per metric and made the judge explain why (short rationale) so trade-offs are visible, not magic.

**LLM-as-judge realities:**
Inconsistent JSON + verbosity. Judges sometimes returned essays or malformed JSON. I switched to strict JSON-only prompts with a lenient JSON extractor and default fallbacks.

**Hallucinated certainty / over-claims:**
We added light integrity/credibility checks and banned words (e.g., “CLICK HERE”) in heuristics to catch spammy outputs.

**Cost vs. quality:**
For the public demo, we used lower-cost OpenAI models and kept BYOK visible but disabled, clearly labeled as “coming soon.” This kept the demo affordable without pretending it’s the final model lineup.

**Engineering & infra speed bumps:**
**Time sink:** OAuth + CORS. Sign-in, cookies, and CORS between Next.js and Flask were fiddly. 
**Rate limits & abuse:** Even with BYOK, users can overload our server. We added per-IP RPM limits, concurrency caps, and Cloudflare Turnstile on the free-demo path. This all started becoming too much to do in too little a time, somehow, we were still able to manage half of what we planned, yay!
**Pairwise complexity:** True pairwise grows O(M²) and doubles judge calls. We pushed it behind BYOK and limited the number of matches; the demo runs rubric + heuristics only.

**Time & scope reality check:**
We ran out of time. Building channel-aware playbooks well (with real examples, thresholds, and benchmarks) needs research. We cut to a colorful, clean MVP: quick compare + four headline scores (Creativity, Accuracy, Speed, Relevance as chart), minimal playbooks, and transparent limits.

We underestimated how much conversation it takes to make rubrics feel fair (PMs vs. founders vs. marketers judge differently). We chose to ship something honest: useful today, and explicit about what’s “loading soon.”

**How we got over it (for now):**

**Scope slice:** shipped a Quick Compare hero with weighted rubrics.
**Guardrails:** strict JSON judging, parsing fallbacks, cost caps, basic abuse protection.
**Roadmap in UI:** BYOK toggle shown (disabled) with a note on the vision, so users see where this is going.

If we had two more weeks: seed each playbook with real examples + outcomes, tighten thresholds from data, and switch BYOK on, well that is what we aimed for :)

**The problem it solves**

FetchIt makes information and file recall faster and more efficient for those managing large data and sets of information (about any topic), especially across multiple or unorganized platforms. FetchIt works by connecting to your most-used platforms and pulling up files or answering questions about your information based on what you ask it. Its chat interface allows you to ask it different questions or have it do different tasks for you, whether you need it to give you "the top 10 files related to project x" or find you "the stakeholders managed by person y". FetchIt makes it easier to find information or answer your questions right away. You save time from looking through pages of files to work on the other stuff that's most important.

NOTE: If you want to test the Google Drive integration on FetchIt, ping me in the Slack Channels @IsavellaTsoulias, and I can add your account to the verified test list.

**Challenges we ran into**

I ran into a few challenges when developing FetchIt. The first challenge was creating an AI that is able to understand the questions I'm asking it and be able to identify what files were actually "relevant" to the question. But, the obstacle for this challenge was that I couldn't have access to OpenAI or Gemini APIs, so I had to get different AI tools to create my own AI models specifically for FetchIt and its relevant tasks. But, after a lot of trial and error and being more intentional with the prompts I provide, I was able to create a v1 AI bot for FetchIt that understands basic file recall questions. 

Another issue I ran into was OAuth for different platforms, like my Google Drive. In the future, I want to host more platforms, but I started with Google Drive for testing. There were bugs that kept occurring where it wasn't able to access my Google Drive API, and also where the URI would keep changing because I would test the platform on different hosts. But I was able to find a way to keep the hosting consistent and make sure that FetchIt could access the API so I could connect my Google Drive.

Sometimes, the platform would just time out, and I would need to spend a lot of time debugging and make sure the web app was stable for testing.

I wasn't able to get APIs for all the platforms I wanted to be available for FetchIt, and not all of them would be able to be used publicly, so I had to shrink down my available connections to Canva, GitHub, and Google Drive, if you get your email on the test list.

# RegTech Compliance Suite for Indian Fintech

## Vision  
To empower Indian Fintech companies to innovate and grow responsibly by simplifying and automating regulatory compliance.

## Problem Statement  
India’s Fintech sector faces increasing complexity and stringent regulations from authorities such as the RBI, SEBI, and FIU-IND. Non-compliance risks substantial financial penalties—often in crores—and operational disruptions, especially in critical areas like KYC/AML, digital lending, and marketing. The current manual and reactive compliance approach consumes 6-10% of operating costs, hindering innovation and agility.

## Goals and Objectives  
1. **Reduce Client Penalties:** Cut annual regulatory penalty costs by 50% within the first year of adoption.  
2. **Increase Efficiency:** Automate 80% of manual compliance tasks in KYC, transaction monitoring, and marketing content review.  
3. **Improve Time-to-Market:** Shorten compliance review cycles for new product launches and marketing campaigns by 60%.  
4. **Achieve Market Penetration:** Onboard 50 paying Fintech clients within 18 months post-launch.

## Target Audience  
Chief Compliance Officers, Legal Teams, Product Managers, and Marketing professionals at small to mid-sized Indian Fintech firms—including lending platforms, payment gateways, and wealth-tech companies.

## Success Metrics  
- **Primary:** Reduction in client-reported penalties; client retention rate above 90%; monthly active users (MAU).  
- **Secondary:** Average time saved per compliance task; number of automated reports generated; Net Promoter Score (NPS).

Feature Completion and Real-Time Data
Transitioning from static mockups to dynamic, real-time compliance scanning, report generation, and dashboard visualization required complex backend logic and frontend state management.

Build and Deployment Stability
Managing TypeScript compilation errors, test file exclusions, and module resolution issues delayed production readiness and demanded careful build configuration.

**Problem Statement**
