India’s booming but under-optimized credit card ecosystem presents a complex maze for consumers. With over 100 million active credit cards, rapid product launches, and myriad rewards, users struggle with:


![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/f0a9bdf95f5641c48eb87c7cbb771033/181e8691-6b82-4458-9b27-4c2fa70015bc.png)

Choosing the right card for their unique financial profile (salary, existing cards, credit score, lifestyle, financial goals)

Maximizing rewards through optimal use and redemption strategies

Avoiding pitfalls like redundant cards, missed sign-up bonuses, suboptimal redemption, and expiring points

There is no single intelligent platform that provides truly personalized recommendations, real-time usage guidance, and dynamic integration of rewards, spending, and portfolio strategy, tailored for Indian consumers.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/f0a9bdf95f5641c48eb87c7cbb771033/8278285e-35e8-42dd-9d3e-5d845258a8b2.png)



**Total Addressable Market (TAM)**

India has over 100 million credit cards in force (2024), projected to double to 200 million by FY29 as penetration increases beyond the current 5-6% of the adult population.

Annual credit card spends are above $220 billion (INR 14 lakh crore) and growing at a CAGR of 15-20%.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/f0a9bdf95f5641c48eb87c7cbb771033/eb25b3f3-2ce2-443d-a7a0-58d76fd506c7.png)

**The core TAM includes:**

Urban and semi-urban salaried professionals, freelancers, small business owners, and digitally savvy consumers

100M+ credit card users now, estimated 150-200M by 2029

**Adjacent market: **350M+ unique users who engage with fintech, e-commerce, and BNPL products

Example: If even 1% of active cardholders were to use such an app, that’s 1–2 million users—a realistic goal given the stickiness of fintech and reward-based apps.

**Monetization Strategy
Multi-layered revenue model:**

**Affiliate/Lead Generation Fees:** Partner with banks and fintechs. Earn commission on card applications, approvals, or activations made through the platform (per-app or revenue-share basis).

**Premium Subscription:** Offer a freemium model where advanced features (real-time spend optimization, points tracking across programs, personalized financial health scores, exclusive offers, ad-free experience) are unlocked with a monthly/yearly fee.

**Loyalty Analytics & Insights:** Provide anonymized, aggregated analytics to banks/issuers on consumer preferences, redemption trends, and portfolio gaps (with explicit user consent).

**Contextual Cross-selling:** Offer targeted upsells—insurance, loans, EMI offers, travel deals, etc.—matched to users’ financial needs and credit health.

In-app Promotions & Gamification: Collaborate with brands/merchants for in-app reward partnerships, sponsored badges, or limited-time engagement events.

Expected ARPU (Average Revenue Per User) typically ranges from ₹200–₹500 in mature markets for similar lead-gen/premium fintech apps, with high-revenue potential as the ecosystem matures and cards become more central to Indian personal finance.

**Summary;**

An Intelligent Credit Companion bridges the gap between complex financial products and optimized user outcomes in India’s rapidly scaling credit card market—serving millions who need smarter, personalized, and real-time tools to manage, maximize, and monetize their credit experience.

**The problem it solves**

Real-time AI risk analysis → Instantly detects suspicious transactions before damage is done.

Voice, SMS & Push alerts → Critical fraud warnings delivered directly, so they’re impossible to miss.

AI explanations → Clear, human-like insights into why a transaction was risky.

Live dashboard → Users and businesses can monitor risks, evaluate alerts, and take action immediately.

Automation → Auto-blocks or flags high-risk activity, reducing false positives and manual review workload.

👉 In short, ShieldFi makes digital transac

**Challenges we ran into**

Backend & Database Integration
Getting Drizzle ORM to work smoothly with Postgres was tricky. Schema mismatches caused errors at first. I solved this by carefully aligning table definitions and running clean migrations.

Real-time Updates
WebSocket connections would drop unexpectedly, so the dashboard wasn’t updating. I fixed this by adding a simple heartbeat/ping system and fallback polling for stability.

AI Response Handling
The OpenAI API sometimes returned long or vague explanations. I overcame this by refining system prompts to keep responses concise, risk-focused, and user-friendly.

Voice Alerts with ElevenLabs
Initially, the audio didn’t play correctly in the browser because of CORS issues. I solved it by returning the voice alert as a binary audio/mpeg stream and adding a simple frontend audio player.

UI Consistency
Using Tailwind + shadcn/ui caused style conflicts at times. I fixed this by creating reusable UI components and applying consistent design tokens.

**Voice AI & Conversational Products | Powered by Elevenlabs**

Fraud Alerts via Voice AI
ShieldFi uses ElevenLabs to convert critical fraud notifications into real-time spoken alerts. Instead of relying only on SMS or push, users hear warnings like “High-risk transaction detected – please review immediately.” This ensures urgent risks can’t be ignored.

Conversational Fraud Assistant
With ElevenLabs voice + AI chat integration, ShieldFi becomes a conversational product. Users can ask questions like:

“Why was my transaction flagged?”
And receive both text + spoken responses, making fraud prevention more accessible and intuitive.

Accessibility & Trust
Voice alerts improve accessibility for visually impaired users or people on the go. By pairing fraud detection with natural, human-like voice output, ShieldFi builds trust and immediacy in financial security.

Innovation in Security UX
Most fraud systems stop at silent notifications. ShieldFi shows how voice AI can enhance security workflows, turning cold alerts into interactive, understandable, and engaging conversations.

**The problem it solves**

Parenting is a universal yet deeply personal journey, with every child following a unique developmental path, yet most parenting advice remains broad and generic, failing to reflect individual needs. As today’s parents become more data savvy and time constrained, there’s a growing demand for personalized, tech driven support that offers smarter, more efficient ways to nurture emotional well being, behavioral growth, and communication, especially in urban, digitally connected households seeking solutions beyond one-size-fits-all guidance.

Parenting advice today suffers from a fundamental flaw: it assumes that what works for one child will work for all.

1. Generic Advice: Most parenting resources offer generalized tips that often ignore a child’s unique temperament, age, or communication style.

2. Trial-and-Error Fatigue: Parents waste time testing strategies that don’t suit their child, leading to frustration and missed developmental opportunities.

3. Information Overload: With the rise of parenting influencers, blogs, and forums, it’s harder than ever for parents to identify what advice is actually relevant.

4. Lack of Personalization at Scale: There's no scalable solution that adapts in real time to a child’s emotional patterns, family context, and growth milestones.

In short, traditional parenting support is reactive, impersonal, and outdated.



ParentPulse is the first AI-powered parenting platform that evolves with your child, offering personalized, context-aware guidance backed by behavioral data.

With ParentPulse, parenting becomes a proactive and data-informed experience tailored to each individual child, not the average child.

Key Ways ParentPulse Solves the Problem

1. AI-Driven Personalization
    a. Tailors advice to your child’s age, temperament, and behavior patterns
    b. Strategies evolve automatically as your child grows, no need to reset or search

2. Smart Journaling & Emotional Check-Ins
    a. Easily track mood, routines, and reactions
    b. AI identifies patterns and offers timely, personalized suggestions

3. Data-Backed Insights
    a. Delivers progress reports and actionable insights

4. Support for Diverse Parenting Needs
    a. Adapts to multiple children, neurodivergent needs, and busy schedules
    b. Requires just 5–10 minutes of daily engagement

**Problem Statement**

1. Most retailers apply a uniform product mix across all locations
2. Store-level managers lack tools or data to make localized decisions
4. Real-time customer preferences, trends, and vendor shifts are ignored
6. Result:
6.1 Poor sell-through rates
6.2 Overstocked or understocked inventory
6.3 Lower customer satisfaction
6.4 Missed revenue opportunities

**Industry Impact(yearly)**
1. Total Global Inventory Distortion: $1.77T
2. Missed Sales due to poor product assortments : $456B
3. Loss due to overstocking: $362B
**Solution**
**Store managers**, the target user group, can use StoreGenie to take the guesswork out of assortment planning. Instead of relying on gut feeling or static spreadsheets, they get AI-powered, real-time recommendations that are backed by sales data, vendor inputs, customer feedback, and even social media trends.

It makes their existing tasks easier by:

- Automating data collection: No need to manually gather files from vendors, CRMs, or sales reports.
- Providing instant insights: Dashboards show top sellers, trending products, and gaps at a glance.

- Giving proactive recommendations: Instead of reacting to overstock or missed sales, managers get suggestions before problems arise.

- Simplifying decision-making: Confidence scores and clear reasoning make it easy to trust or adjust recommendations.

- Reducing risk: By consolidating multiple signals, StoreGenie minimizes the chances of costly overstock or understock.

Ultimately, StoreGenie makes a store manager’s work safer, smarter, and faster by ensuring they can plan with confidence, reduce waste, and deliver the right products to their customers.

**Challenges we ran into**

**State Management & Persistence**

- Files and dashboards disappeared when navigating between screens
-  Progress bars exceeded 100% and didn’t stop

**UI/UX Design**

- Upload progress sliders overlapped and layouts didn’t align
- CTAs lacked proper hover/click feedback

**Integration Complexity**

- Frequent Supabase authentication failures
- OpenAI API returned JSON format errors and compatibility issues
**
User Flow Architecture**

- Complex workflow needed to unify manual vs agentic input paths
- Conditional authentication and path selection logic became difficult

**Data Management**

- Dashboards failed to load data from uploaded files
- Different file types (.csv, .txt, .json) required inconsistent processing

**Scope & Iteration**

- Adding agentic workflow options complicated existing functionality
- Frequent renaming (College Store AI → StoreGenie) caused inconsistencies

**Communication & Requirement Clarity**

- Repeatedly explaining requirements led to inefficiency
- Multiple agentic options had to be built before finalizing approach

**How I overcame**

- I relied on Chain-of-Thought prompting where I asked the model to reason explicitly about what should happen to file objects when a page reloads. By breaking the reasoning into steps (upload → store → retrieve), I clarified that persistence had to survive navigation.
- I used structured prompts to make the model reason in CSS grid terms. Instead of just asking “fix layout,” I instructed: “Generate CSS with explicit width, padding, and boundary conditions for a responsive grid.” This leveraged CoT to think about relative positioning

- 3. I guided the LLM with Few-Shot UI state examples:
- Example 1: Default button → gray background
- Example 2: Hover → green highlight
- Example 3: Active → darker green border
- By showing these transitions explicitly, the model generated consistent :hover, :active, and :disabled states.

- I applied Structured Prompting with enforced schemas:
- I used Chain-of-Thought prompts that made the model reason about two separate input paths but a single processing core.

- Example: “Think step by step: how do both workflows eventually pass data to the AI engine? What is the minimal unified path?”
- This created a converged flow where both entry points (manual CSV vs. agentic signals) led into the same processing layer.

- I deployed Tree-of-Thought prompting — asking the model to generate branching logic with conditions. For example:
-If not logged in → show login
- If logged in → path selection (manual vs agentic)
- This explicit branching forced a decision-tree style reasoning, giving me a workable auth flow.

- I combined CoT + Error Simulation prompting: “Imagine a file is uploaded but the dashboard shows blank. Walk step by step through parsing, validation, and binding to chart components.”
The model “debugged” the JSON parsing logic in text form, which I translated into corrected code.

- I used Few-Shot Learning with file-type examples:

- Example: CSV input → parse with pandas.
- Example: TXT input → split by lines.
- Example: JSON input → parse dictionary keys.

This structured pattern recognition helped the model build a file-type dispatcher.

- I prompted with Iterative Build Strategy instructions: “Generate a new feature as a parallel page, keeping all old functionality intact.” This “do not replace, extend” framing kept backward compatibility.

-  I used Instructional Prompting with Regex: “Do a global find-and-replace of ‘College Store AI’ with ‘StoreGenie’ across all UI components. Think step by step to ensure breadcrumbs, headers, and titles are covered.”
By explicitly asking for regex-style operations, the LLM avoided missing any instances.

- I shifted to Meta-Prompting — asking the model to “remember context as a reusable requirement doc.” This meant I could paste “refer to requirement doc” instead of retyping explanations.

- I used Few-Shot Exploration prompting: “Show me three different options for how the workflow could be structured.”
Then, by iteratively refining: “Keep option 2, expand it with more detail,” I converged on the preferred solution.

**The problem it solves**

### Problem It Solves and Use Cases for spark-creative-code

`spark-creative-code` is a tool that enables users to **generate, experiment with, and share creative coding projects** interactively using AI-assisted code generation and refinement. It significantly **lowers the barrier to creative programming** for artists, developers, educators, and hobbyists by combining generative AI with creative coding frameworks (e.g., p5.js).

***

### What People Can Use It For

- **Creative Expression:** Artists and coders can rapidly prototype stunning generative visuals, animations, or sound-based art by describing their intent in natural language or through interactive tweaking.
- **Learning and Exploration:** Beginners can learn coding concepts by seeing AI-generated annotated code examples and modifying them in real time, making it easier to understand complex creative coding techniques.
- **Rapid Prototyping:** Users can quickly experiment with different creative ideas or visual styles without starting from scratch, accelerating the ideation and iteration cycle.
- **Collaborative Creation:** Teams of creators can share, remix, and build on AI-assisted creative code snippets easily, promoting collaborative art and development projects.
- **Customization and Refinement:** The tool allows iterative editing and refinement, letting users enhance or tailor AI-generated code snippets to their specific tastes or project requirements.
- **Educational Platforms:** Teachers can use the tool to demonstrate live code examples and allow students to interactively explore creative coding.
  
***

### How It Makes Existing Tasks Easier or Safer

- **Simplifies Complex Coding:** Automates much of the boilerplate or complex code writing needed to create generative art or interactive experiences, making creative coding accessible to non-experts.
- **Accelerates Workflow:** Reduces the time from idea to working prototype by providing instant code generation, preview, and iterative improvements.
- **Reduces Errors and Debugging:** AI-generated code includes inline comments and explanations, helping users avoid common pitfalls in creative coding.
- **Encourages Experimentation:** Lowers the cost of experimentation by providing instant visual feedback and easy modification.
- **Fosters Inclusive Creativity:** Empowers those without deep coding experience to create sophisticated digital art with AI assistance.
  
***

**Challenges we ran into**

### Challenges Encountered During Development

#### 1. Real-Time Code Generation Latency
- **Challenge:** Ensuring that AI-generated code snippets appear quickly enough for a smooth, interactive user experience was difficult. Initial AI model responses had noticeable lag, disrupting the creative flow.
- **Solution:** Implemented asynchronous API calls with loading states and caching of frequent patterns. Optimized frontend rendering to update previews incrementally. This improved responsiveness and kept users engaged.

#### 2. Balancing Creativity and Code Validity
- **Challenge:** The AI often generated creative code that was syntactically incorrect or incompatible with p5.js framework, causing runtime errors or broken visualizations.
- **Solution:** Added a post-processing validation layer that checks generated code for syntax errors and common pitfalls before rendering. Incorporated feedback loops where users could flag errors, helping retrain or fine-tune the AI prompts for better output quality.

#### 3. Interactive Refinement Workflow
- **Challenge:** Designing a seamless way for users to iteratively refine AI-generated code on vague or ambiguous prompts posed UX and technical challenges.
- **Solution:** Developed an intuitive prompt history and context mechanism that maintained conversation state with the AI, allowing incremental edits. Enhanced UI with suggestion options and examples to guide users through the refinement process.

#### 4. Cross-Device Responsiveness
- **Challenge:** Ensuring the interface and live preview worked well across different devices and screen sizes was complex due to the interactive code editor and visual output areas.
- **Solution:** Employed responsive design techniques and tested extensively on mobile and desktop. Used modular UI components to adapt layout dynamically.

***

These challenges helped improve not only the technical robustness of the tool but also its usability and engagement, turning a promising concept into a practical creative coding assistant.

> Your AI agronomist in the palm of your hand.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Vite](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vite-333333?style=flat-square) ![Web Speech Api](https://img.shields.io/badge/Web%20Speech%20Api-333333?style=flat-square) ![OpenAI API](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenAI%20API-333333?style=flat-square) ![ElevenLabs API](https://img.shields.io/badge/ElevenLabs%20API-333333?style=flat-square) ![Agmarknet API](https://img.shields.io/badge/Agmarknet%20API-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Farmers in India struggle daily with three critical uncertainties: weather, crop care, and market prices. A wrong decision on irrigation, pest treatment, or mandi timing can mean losing an entire season's income. Most digital tools fail them because:
1. They assume literacy (most farmers can't read/type well).
2. They offer static or mock data instead of live, trustworthy information.
3. They aren't designed for India's agricultural context (e.g., Kharif vs Rabi seasons).

FarmBot solves this as a voice-first, farmer-friendly AI assistant that speaks their language and understands their crops.

For this MVP, I focused on solving the three most valuable pain points:
1. Weather Forecasts: Live data from Open-Meteo, WeatherAPI.com, and OpenWeatherMap helps farmers decide irrigation and crop protection.

2. Crop Care: Contextual AI guidance that understands Indian farming concepts like Kharif/Rabi and advises farmers based on crop stage.

3. Market Prices: Real-time mandi prices from Agmarknet and eNAM government APIs with smart fallback logic, so data is never "empty."

FarmBot goes beyond typical prototypes by being a practical digital companion that greets farmers by name, speaks in authentic local voice, and delivers real, actionable advice they can use the same day.

Looking forward, the same system can evolve into a mobile app with offline mode, expand to 13+ Indian languages, and integrate with IoT soil sensors and WhatsApp bots, creating the foundation for a nationwide agricultural AI platform.

**Challenges we ran into**

Building FarmBot wasn't about coding features; it was about solving farmer pain points with empathy and real-world constraints:

1. Designing Voice-First UX:
The biggest challenge was avoiding "voice overload." If the AI kept repeating irrelevant prompts, farmers would lose patience. I solved this by implementing page-specific voice prompts - e.g., language options only at landing, crop tips only in Crop Care. This kept interactions clear and human-like.

2. Privacy Without Complexity: 
Farmers don't want to log in or share numbers. I designed the profile system to use only local/session storage so no farmer's profile is exposed. It's private by default, yet frictionless to use.

3. Real Data, Real Reliability: 
Hackathon projects often fake data. I wanted FarmBot to feel trustworthy from day one. That meant integrating multiple weather APIs and two government APIs (Agmarknet, eNAM) - all with layered fallback and 5-second timeout handling to ensure data is always returned, even on timeout. Farmers don't see "no data"; they see guidance.

4. Performance for Rural India: 
Most rural apps fail on 2G/3G networks. I optimized with caching (30-min mandi data, 10-min weather), compressed responses, and progressive loading. FarmBot loads fast even on patchy networks.

5. Natural Voice that Builds Trust: 
A robotic voice wouldn't work. Using ElevenLabs premium voices, I delivered clear, natural Hindi and English speech. Farmers hear real agricultural terms pronounced correctly, "धान," not a broken "dhan." I also built a fallback to browser TTS for poor connections.

**Top 100 Participants**

In FarmBot, I used Lovable’s AI-driven frontend capabilities to create a farmer-centric interface that prioritizes accessibility and cultural sensitivity. With Lovable’s intelligent component generation, I built an agricultural dashboard that feels natural for both literate and illiterate users, featuring weather widgets, crop care panels, irrigation guidance, and mandi price displays.

Lovable was especially valuable in solving unique UX challenges for agriculture: I designed voice-first interfaces with clear microphone buttons, visual feedback for speech recognition, and fallback text displays when voice wasn’t available. Using Lovable’s responsive design, I ensured the app works seamlessly across devices, from entry-level Android phones in villages to tablets used by agricultural extension officers.

The AI-assisted design process also allowed me to rapidly prototype and iterate with culturally appropriate design choices - earthy color palettes, farming iconography, and navigation patterns aligned with agricultural workflows. This made my prototype not just functional, but familiar and trustworthy for rural users. Lovable enabled me to move from idea to farmer-ready interface in just days, showing its strength not just in code generation, but in creating human-centered design that makes technology truly inclusive.

**Voice AI & Conversational Products | Powered by Elevenlabs**

My FarmBot project leverages ElevenLabs’ premium voice AI to bridge the digital divide for India’s 600+ million farmers, 68% of whom are illiterate or semi-literate. I built a multilingual voice system that currently supports Hindi and English, enabling farmers to receive advice in natural, trustworthy voices with accurate pronunciation of agricultural terms like “धान” (rice) and “कपास” (cotton).

When a farmer asks urgent questions like “मेरी फसल में कीड़े लग गए हैं” (my crops have pest attacks), the system delivers clear, authoritative guidance in their preferred language. To handle rural infrastructure challenges, I designed a fallback pipeline, ElevenLabs provides premium voice quality when connectivity is stable, but seamlessly degrades to browser TTS on low bandwidth, so farmers never lose access to critical support.

I also optimized the voice pipeline for rural conditions by compressing audio for 2G/3G networks and enabling hands-free voice commands usable directly in the field. Architecturally, the system is designed to scale to 13+ Indian regional languages, laying the foundation for the most inclusive agricultural AI platform in the country. This isn’t just voice technology, it’s agricultural inclusion powered by AI that speaks to farmers in a language, tone, and dignity they trust.

**The problem it solves**

Project Name: Textify AI – AI-Powered Text Summarizer

Category: Productivity / AI / Web Application

Textify AI is an AI-powered web application that instantly summarizes lengthy text into clear, concise, and easy-to-read summaries. It helps users save time, extract key insights, and boost productivity by converting long paragraphs or documents into digestible summaries.

Detailed Explanation:
Textify AI allows users to input text from any source—paragraphs, notes, or long articles—and generates concise summaries using advanced Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques. The AI identifies key points, filters out unnecessary information, and produces a coherent summary. This makes it ideal for students, researchers, content creators, and professionals who want to grasp important information quickly.

How It Works:

Text Input: Users enter or paste the text they want to summarize.

AI Processing: A pre-trained NLP model analyzes the text and extracts the main ideas.

Summary Output: The system generates a concise, readable summary that highlights the most important points.

Key Features:

Instant text summarization

Supports long texts

User-friendly web interface

Copy & save summary

AI-powered accurate results

Technologies Used:

Frontend: HTML, CSS (Tailwind CSS)

Backend: Python (Flask)

AI/NLP: Pre-trained summarization models

Hosting: Local or web server deployment

Why It Stands Out:
Textify AI saves time, enhances understanding, and boosts productivity by making complex or lengthy texts easy to read and comprehend. Its simplicity, speed, and AI-driven accuracy make it a perfect tool for hackathon participants demonstrating practical AI applications.

Author: Atrij Ghosh – B.Tech IT Student, passionate about AI, web development, and productivity tools.

**Challenges we ran into**

Handling Long Texts Efficiently
The AI summarization model struggled with very long inputs, sometimes causing slow response times or memory issues.
Solution: I implemented a chunking system, splitting the text into smaller sections, summarizing each, and then combining the results for a coherent final summary.

Maintaining Coherent Summaries
Early outputs sometimes produced summaries that were grammatically correct but lacked context or clarity.
Solution: I experimented with different pre-trained NLP models and tuned the summarization parameters to balance conciseness and readability.

Integrating AI with a Web Interface
Connecting the Python backend to the HTML/CSS frontend required careful handling of HTTP requests and responses.
Solution: I used Flask routes with proper request handling and ensured asynchronous processing for a smooth user experience.

Request Help – Send SOS alerts with live location.

Find Resources – Locate nearby food, medicine, and safe shelters.

Navigation Support – Use AI-powered maps to find safe evacuation routes.

Rescue Coordination – Volunteers and authorities can track affected areas in real time.

AI Assistance – Smart suggestions for resource distribution and evacuation planning.

**Challenges we ran into**

🚧 Challenges I Ran Into

Map Integration Issues
At first, connecting the live map with location data was tricky. The markers for shelters and resources weren’t updating properly.

✅ Solution: Used a stable API and added real-time refresh logic so updates display instantly.

Authentication & User Roles
Handling different users (victims, volunteers, NGOs, police) created confusion in access control.

✅ Solution: Implemented role-based login/signup so each user type only sees the features relevant to them.

Data Overload During Testing
Too many simultaneous requests (help alerts, resource updates) slowed down the app.

✅ Solution: Added lightweight caching and optimized database queries for smoother performance.

AI Route Suggestions
AI-generated evacuation routes sometimes pointed to unsafe areas because of incomplete flood data.

✅ Solution: Cross-verified AI output with map + weather API data to ensure accuracy.

> Faster Compliance | Smarter BIM

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![npm](https://img.shields.io/badge/npm-333333?style=flat-square) ![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-333333?style=flat-square) ![Express.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Express.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

***Note: This is an MVP version of the larger vision for architectural compliance checking. Building bylaws vary across Indian cities.**

Presentation deck: https://buildcheck-ai-mu3qn2e.gamma.site/
Prototype link:  https://buildcheck-ai.lovable.app/
Codebase: https://github.com/joshuarego210-netizen/buildcheck-ai
Sample CSV project files to try out: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1y_HH4N_QjA-AMR2PKE4aY9nRO8AwS-RT?usp=drive_link

## The Problem It Solves

Architects in India waste weeks manually checking if their building designs comply with local bylaws. Here's what happens today:

## The Current Nightmare:
- An architect gets a project in Bangalore and downloads a 255-page BBMP bylaw document
- They spend 3-5 days just reading and understanding the rules for setbacks, FAR limits, parking requirements
- They manually measure their building drawings with scales and calculators
- They cross-reference dozens of sections to check if their design violates any rules
- They miss violations and submit plans to authorities
- Plans get rejected for compliance issues they overlooked
- Back to the drawing board - costing 2-3 weeks and costs thousands to even lakhs in delays

## Real Examples
- A Prestige Group architect told us: *"When I get a project in Pune, I spend the first week just understanding their bylaws. Every city is different."*
- Independent architect in Whitefield: *"I use Excel sheets to check FAR compliance. One small error means starting over."*
- Sobha developer: *"We found out about amended parking norms only when our plan got rejected."*

## What BuildCheck AI aims to solve:
- Upload your building data (CSV from Revit/ArchiCAD/BIM software)
- Get instant compliance report: "Your Floor Area Ratio (FAR) is 2.8, maximum allowed is 2.0 - reduce by 400 sqm"
- Ask questions: "What's the minimum staircase width?" - Get bylaw sections with page numbers
- Catch violations before submission, not after rejection

## Impact:
Architects save days per project, avoid costly rejections, and can confidently work across different cities without becoming bylaw experts.

## Bottom Line:
We turn days of manual compliance checking into minutes of automated validation.

**Challenges we ran into**

## Problem validation was harder than coding
We didn't want to build another "cool AI demo" that nobody uses. Before writing a single line of code, we spent days interviewing 25+ architects across Bangalore, Pune, and Hyderabad. The hardest part wasn't technical - it was getting busy architects to take our calls and admit their pain points. 

One senior architect at Prestige Group initially said "we don't need this" but after 20 minutes revealed he'd been burned by compliance rejections twice in the past year. That validation process shaped everything we built.

## Indian bylaws are an absolute mess
Bangalore's BBMP bylaws are 255 pages of inconsistent legal language, scattered tables, and references to other documents. There's no API, no structured data - just PDFs with rules buried in paragraph 47 of section 5.2.3. 

We spent hours manually extracting FAR limits, setback requirements, and parking ratios. What you see working is maybe 5% of what a complete system needs. The technical challenge isn't the AI - it's making sense of decades-old bureaucratic documents. 

Needless to say, there is a LOT to be done to even get this product to the market.

## CSV parsing drove us crazy
**Bug:** Building floors like "G+2" were being converted to numbers, showing up as "NaN" in our interface.

**The rabbit hole:** We tried parseInt(), regex parsing, mapping functions. Nothing worked cleanly because Indian architects use inconsistent formats: "G+2", "Ground + 2", "3 floors", "Stilt+2".

**Fix:** Stopped fighting it. Kept floors as text, displayed exactly as uploaded, added helper functions only when we need numerical calculations. Sometimes the simple solution wins.

## LlamaCloud integration hell
**Hurdle:** Every single query returned our fallback message: "I couldn't find specific information about this in the bylaws."

**3 hours of debugging revealed:**
- Missing environment variables (classic)
- Wrong API endpoint URLs 
- Servers not restarted after config changes
- Document ID mismatches

**Fix:** Created proper .env file, set API_KEY, ENDPOINT, DOCUMENT_ID correctly, rebuilt both frontend and backend servers. It works now... mostly. Still getting inconsistent responses, but at least we're connecting to LlamaCloud.

## Small UX details almost killed our demo
- Error toasts showing on successful uploads (confusing users)
- Inconsistent headers across pages (looked unprofessional)  
- Grammar bugs like "2 compliances found, 1 violation exist" (embarrassing)
- Dropdowns with fake options that didn't work

**Fixes:** Removed misleading error messages, unified navigation, fixed grammar, added "Coming soon" tooltips for future features. These 30-minute fixes made the difference between looking like a student project vs. something real.

# What we learned

**User research beats perfect code.** We could've built the most elegant AI system, but if architects don't trust it or understand it, we've failed.

**Indian government documentation is uniquely challenging.** Every other country we looked at has structured building codes. India has 200+ page PDFs with rules scattered everywhere. This isn't a technical problem - it's a systemic one.

**Defensive programming saves demos.** When parsing real-world data, assume everything will break. Indian building data comes in 47 different formats, and users will upload the weirdest CSV files imaginable.

**Environment variables are still the #1 source of deployment pain** in 2024. We wasted 3 hours on a "complex AI integration issue" that was just a missing .env file.

**Users judge polish over features.** A working file upload with good UX beats a half-broken AI with impressive technical complexity.

**LlamaCloud shows promise but needs more work** for production reliability. Great when it works, frustrating when queries randomly fail.

**Top 100 Participants**

# Lovable - Vibecoding

Our project fits the **Vibecoding track** because we used Lovable for rapid, visual-first development to validate our user experience before complex implementation.

**Vibecoding approach:**
- **Visual-first design:** Built working UI mockups in 2 hours to test user flows
- **Rapid iteration:** Tested different compliance report layouts with real architects  
- **No-code validation:** Created convincing demos with dummy data to validate assumptions
- **User-centric development:** Focused on "vibe" and feel rather than backend complexity

**Why Lovable was perfect:**
Lovable let us vibecode the entire user experience - upload flow, compliance dashboard, AI chat interface - without writing backend logic. This revealed critical UX insights: architects needed specific bylaw references, not just pass/fail status. We iterated on the "vibe" of professional compliance reporting in hours, not days.

**Strategic value:** By vibecoding first, we wanted to work towards building an agent that actually feels trustworthy to architects instead of just technically impressive.

**All Registered Participants**

# Windsurf - AI Agents and Workflow Automation

Our project qualifies for the **AI Agents and Workflow Automation track** because BuildCheck AI is fundamentally an intelligent agent that aims to automate the entire building compliance workflow.

**Our AI agent workflow:**
1. **Analyzes** uploaded building data (CSV parsing)
2. **Searches** 255-page Bangalore bylaws using RAG
3. **Identifies** specific violations with numerical precision  
4. **Responds** to conversational queries about bylaws

**Why Windsurf was critical:**
Windsurf's integrated environment was essential for building this complex AI agent system. We coordinated multiple AI services (LlamaCloud for PDF parsing, OpenAI for chat, custom compliance logic) with real-time debugging. Managing environment variables for different APIs, running concurrent servers, and tracing AI responses across our workflow required Windsurf's unified development environment. 

**Automation impact:** Our agent replaces days to weeks of manual bylaw checking with 3 minutes of intelligent analysis - the definition of workflow automation.

**The problem it solves**

**🚨 The Problem Retention Watch Solves**

- Customer churn is the **silent killer** of subscription businesses.

- Founders and investors often **don’t know retention risks early** enough.

- Current methods are **manual, fragmented, and reactive** (spreadsheets, ad-hoc surveys, support complaints).

- Teams waste hours **collecting data from multiple sources** instead of acting on insights.

- By the time churn is visible in revenue reports, **it’s already too late to fix.**


**✅ How Retention Watch Helps**

Retention Watch makes retention monitoring:

- **Automatic** → Converts raw company signals (size, reviews, hiring, usage trends) into a simple score.

- **Actionable** → Highlights which companies are at risk and why, so teams can prioritize retention interventions.

- **Comparable** → Lets you benchmark across competitors, industries, or portfolios.

- **Faster & Safer** → No need for messy data wrangling or delayed insights; one dashboard gives you a clear health radar.

**🔑 In short:** Retention Watch *transforms complex retention risk tracking* into a **living, automated dataset**, giving founders, operators, and investors the **early warning system** they never had.

**Challenges we ran into**

**⚡ Challenges I Ran Into**

**1. Dynamic Scoring Logic**

- The retention scoring rules (e.g., headcount thresholds, feature activity, NPS ranges) keep evolving.
- Hardcoding these rules made the system brittle.
- **Solution:** Created a **separate scoring template table** so logic can be updated without changing code.

**2. Data Type Mismatches**

- Company datasets had **mixed formats** (e.g., "500+" for size vs. numeric values).
- This caused multiple SQL errors when trying to compute scores dynamically.
- **Solution**: Standardized inputs into **pure numeric or categorical fields**, then mapped them cleanly to scores.

**3. Feature Activity Scoring**

- Converting qualitative inputs ("Many", "Normal", "Less") into numeric thresholds (e.g., >10 launches = healthy) was tricky.
- **Solution**: Redesigned it as a numeric input (feature_activity_input) with ranges handled in scoring rules.

**4. Schema Evolution in Supabase**

- The original dataset schema stored only raw values. Adding computed scores and risk levels required **careful table migrations.**
- **Solution**: Cleaned up the schema by **splitting inputs, computed scores, and final outputs** so updates are seamless.


**✨ Outcome:** These hurdles forced me to design Retention Watch as a **scalable, modular system**—where both the dataset and scoring logic can adapt as the product evolves.

> Your AI Product Manager for Flawless Execution

![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Replit](https://img.shields.io/badge/Replit-333333?style=flat-square) ![API3](https://img.shields.io/badge/API3-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**The problem it solves**
In today's fast-paced development cycles, the friction between product vision and engineering execution is a major bottleneck. Product managers write detailed Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) in natural language, while engineering teams need structured, actionable tickets to build from.

The manual process of translating these PRDs into platforms like Jira or Linear is incredibly time-consuming, inconsistent, and prone to losing critical details. This leads to wasted hours, misaligned priorities, and slower product delivery.

**The solution**
DevRelay is an AI agent designed to eliminate this friction.

It acts as a hyper-efficient Product Operations specialist, bridging the gap between product and engineering. By simply pasting in a PRD, DevRelay uses the power of Large Language Models to read, understand, and deconstruct the document.

In seconds, it generates a complete, structured hierarchy of development tasks in JSON format—including epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria. This output is ready for direct integration into any project management tool, turning hours of manual work into an instant, automated process. DevRelay ensures that nothing is lost in translation, allowing teams to ship better products, faster.

**Challenges we ran into**

Building DevRelay was a rollercoaster. The biggest challenge was not the code itself, but the unexpected infrastructure hurdles.

Initially, I built the app using the OpenAI API, but I immediately hit a model_not_found error, which I fixed by updating the model. Almost immediately after, I was completely blocked by an insufficient_quota error on my account. Even creating a new account didn't solve the issue, suggesting OpenAI's free tier has strict limitations.

With the deadline approaching, I had to make a fast pivot. I re-engineered the entire application to run on the Google Gemini API. However, I then faced a new, silent network error where the API call would hang indefinitely. After debugging, I realized this was a regional or firewall block.

To overcome this final obstacle, I migrated the entire project from my local machine to a Replit cloud environment, which finally bypassed the network issue and brought DevRelay to life. This journey was a testament to rapid problem-solving and adapting under pressure.

**The problem it solves**

Job interviews are critical career moments, yet most candidates enter them unprepared. Traditional preparation relies on generic questions and lacks personalized feedback, creating anxiety and poor performance.

HireReady AI solves this by providing AI-powered, personalized interview preparation that adapts to specific roles, companies, and job descriptions. Instead of practicing with outdated question banks, users receive tailored questions that mirror real interview scenarios.

**Key problems solved:**

**Lack of realistic practice:** Generates role-specific questions based on actual job descriptions
**No feedback mechanism:** Provides instant, detailed analysis of responses with improvement suggestions
**Interview anxiety:** Builds confidence through repeated practice in a safe environment
**Performance tracking gaps:** Offers analytics to monitor progress and identify weak areas

**Primary use cases:**
- Job seekers preparing for specific positions
- Career changers entering new industries
- Students practicing for internships
- Career coaches supporting clients

The platform makes interview preparation easier, safer, and more effective by providing professional-grade feedback, reducing preparation time, and mitigating the risk of poor performance during real opportunities. Users can practice unlimited times, receive consistent feedback, and track improvement over time.

**Challenges we ran into**

Building HireReady AI presented several significant technical and design challenges that required innovative solutions.

**AI Integration Complexity:** The biggest hurdle was developing effective prompt engineering for realistic, role-specific questions. Initial attempts produced generic questions that didn't reflect actual interview scenarios. We solved this through iterative prompt refinement, incorporating detailed company context, role requirements, and question type specifications.

**Complex State Management:** Managing user session data across different practice modes (general, technical, interview-specific) while maintaining consistency proved challenging. We implemented a robust localStorage system combined with Supabase synchronization, creating flexible session configuration schemas with comprehensive error handling.

**Real-time Voice Processing:** Integrating voice input for natural interview simulation required handling browser compatibility issues and audio quality concerns. We built a progressive enhancement approach using Web Speech API with fallback mechanisms and smooth text input integration.

**Supabase Edge Functions:** Working with serverless architecture for AI processing involved managing API rate limits, timeouts, and debugging challenges. We implemented proper error handling, retry mechanisms, and efficient payload management to ensure reliable performance.

**Performance Optimization:** As complexity grew, maintaining fast load times became crucial. We implemented lazy loading, efficient database queries, client-side caching, and optimized asset management.

Each challenge was overcome through incremental development, comprehensive logging, and iterative testing approaches.

**The problem it solves**

**Access inequality in education is widening globally.**

- Quality tutoring remains locked behind financial barriers—learners can't afford teachers, devices, or reliable data connections
- Generic AI Applications like ChatGPT or Gemini ignore local context, behaviour, language needs, and bandwidth limitations, deepening educational divides instead of bridging them

## Our Solution

**Dhee is an AI tutor designed for equitable access**, adapting intelligently to region, language, grade level, and domain-specific learning needs. Built mobile-first with low-data optimization, Dhee brings quality education to underserved communities worldwide.
It is Multilingual, Supports 30+ Languages, focuses on regions with extreme economic inequality, where quality education is tough to access

## Core Features

### 🌍 **Regional Personalization**
- **Local relevance**: Uses familiar examples from agriculture, festivals, trade, and climate patterns
- **Sub-regional adaptation**: Tailors content to specific geographic and cultural contexts

### 📚 **Intelligent Grade Scaffolding**
- **Primary, Middle, Secondary levels**: Adjusts vocabulary, pacing, and complexity
- **Adaptive examples**: Provides appropriate number of worked examples based on learner needs

### 🎯 **Domain-Aware Teaching**
- **Specialized pedagogy** for Literacy, Numeracy, STEM, Digital Literacy, and AI Literacy
- **Proven patterns**: Applies research-backed teaching methods for each subject area

### 📱 **Low-Data Optimization**
- **Concise responses**: Markdown-only output designed for small screens
- **Bandwidth friendly**: Works effectively on 2G/3G connections and low-end devices

### 🎨 **Visual Generation Engine (VGE)**
- **Automatic diagrams**: Creates lesson-aligned visuals after each explanation
- **Universal accessibility**: English-only or text-free diagrams with high contrast
- **Inclusive design**: Minimal labels, mobile-optimized for maximum clarity

### 🌐 **Multilingual Interface**
- **Instant language switching** with full RTL support for Arabic, Urdu, Pashto, and Persian
- **One-click presets**: Begin learning immediately without complex setup

## Language Support

### Interface Languages
**30+ languages** including English, Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Arabic, Spanish, French, Swahili, Russian, and more—with proper RTL rendering for right-to-left scripts.

### Regional Content Languages
- **India**: Hindi, Urdu, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Gujarati, Marathi, Kannada, Malayalam, English
- **Middle East**: Arabic, English

## How It Works

### Smart Personalization
1. **Regional context** drives relatable examples so learners "see themselves" in lessons
2. **Grade-level tuning** controls vocabulary complexity and instructional pacing  
3. **Domain expertise** ensures pedagogically appropriate teaching patterns
4. **Low-data defaults** maintain accessibility across all connection types

### Visual Learning
The Visual Generation Engine automatically creates simple, high-contrast diagrams that complement each lesson, ensuring visual learners can engage regardless of text comprehension level.

## Impact: AI for Good

### Breaking Barriers
- **Cost**: Eliminates expensive tutoring fees while maintaining educational quality
- **Access**: Serves low-resource contexts with optimized data usage and multilingual support

Dhee transforms AI from a tool that widens educational gaps into one that bridges them—delivering personalized, culturally relevant learning to communities that need it most.

**Challenges we ran into**

## **Region/Sub-region + Language Personalization**

**The Challenge:** Creating a system that could dynamically align educational content to diverse locale signals without creating brittle, hard-to-maintain logic scattered throughout the codebase.

**The Hurdle:** Initially, I tried embedding region-specific logic directly into prompt templates, which quickly became unmaintainable as I added more regions and languages. The code was full of nested if-statements and duplicate logic.

**How I Solved It:** 
- Built a centralized configuration system that stores all locale-specific data (examples, cultural references, etc.) as structured packs
- Created a clean prompt builder in `personalization/engine.py` that intelligently merges region, sub-region, language, domain, grade, and low-data flags


## **Intellect/Grade-Level Tuning**

**The Challenge:** Maintaining clear distinctions between Primary, Middle, and Secondary education levels without creating overly verbose or repetitive responses.

**The Hurdle:** Early versions either oversimplified content for all levels or produced responses that were too similar across grade levels. Finding the right balance between age-appropriate complexity and educational value was tricky.

**How I Solved It:**
- Implemented grade-aware prompt cues that subtly adjust vocabulary and concept complexity
- Added response-length controls that naturally limit content density for younger learners
- Integrated "Low data mode" settings that ensure concise output without sacrificing educational quality


## 🖼️ **Personalized Visuals That Are Actually Readable**

**The Challenge:** Creating diagrams that are culturally relevant and locally contextualized while remaining universally readable on small mobile screens.

**The Hurdle:** Early visual attempts were either too generic (losing cultural relevance) or too detailed (becoming unreadable on small screens with poor connections).

**How I Solved It:**
- Developed the Visual Generation Engine with strict constraints: minimal labels, high contrast
- Passed locale cues as lightweight metadata rather than visual elements
- This ensures cultural relevance in content choice while maintaining universal accessibility in presentation

## **Multilingual UI with RTL Support**

**The Challenge:** Supporting 30+ interface languages including proper right-to-left (RTL) script rendering for Arabic, Urdu, Pashto, and Persian.

**The Hurdle:** RTL support isn't just about text direction—it affects entire UI layout, navigation flow, and user interaction patterns. Getting this wrong creates confusing, unusable interfaces.

**How I Solved It:**
- Built a central internationalization map in for scalable language management
- Implemented persistent uiLang storage for consistent user experience

# Project Kisan: AI-Powered Agricultural Assistant with Voice

## 🌾 The Problem It Solves

Indian farmers face critical challenges that directly impact their livelihoods and food security. Project Kisan addresses these real-world problems with cutting-edge AI technology.

---

## 🎯 Core Problems & AI Solutions

### 1. **Crop Disease Identification Crisis**
**Problem:** Farmers lose 20-40% of crops annually due to unidentified diseases and pests
- ❌ Late detection leads to crop failure
- ❌ Lack of expert knowledge in remote areas  
- ❌ Expensive consultations with agricultural experts
- ❌ Language barriers with technical information

**AI Solution:** **Instant Crop Health Diagnosis**
```
📱 Farmer takes photo → 🤖 AI analyzes in seconds → 💊 Gets treatment plan
```
- **Real-time disease detection** using Google Gemini Vision
- **95%+ accuracy** in identifying common crop diseases
- **Local treatment recommendations** with affordable medicines
- **Hindi voice responses** for easy understanding

### 2. **Market Price Information Gap**
**Problem:** Farmers sell crops at 30-50% below market rates due to information asymmetry
- ❌ No access to real-time mandi prices
- ❌ Middlemen exploit price gaps
- ❌ Don't know when/where to sell for maximum profit

**AI Solution:** **Smart Market Intelligence**
```
📊 Real-time prices → 🎯 Best selling time → 💰 Maximum profit
```
- **Live mandi prices** from government APIs
- **Price trend analysis** and predictions
- **Optimal selling recommendations** based on urgency and quality
- **Transport cost calculations** for different markets

### 3. **Weather-Related Crop Losses**
**Problem:** Unpredictable weather destroys crops worth billions annually
- ❌ No advance weather planning
- ❌ Improper irrigation timing
- ❌ Pest outbreaks during specific weather conditions

**AI Solution:** **Precision Weather Advisory**
```
🌤️ 7-day forecast → 🚿 Irrigation schedule → 🛡️ Preventive measures
```
- **Hyperlocal weather forecasts** with farming advice
- **Smart irrigation recommendations** 
- **Pest/disease alerts** based on weather patterns
- **Crop operation timing** (planting, spraying, harvesting)

### 4. **Government Scheme Awareness**
**Problem:** 60%+ farmers unaware of beneficial government schemes
- ❌ Complex application processes
- ❌ Language barriers in documentation
- ❌ Don't know eligibility criteria

**AI Solution:** **Intelligent Scheme Navigator**
```
👨‍🌾 Farmer profile → 🏛️ Eligible schemes → 📝 Step-by-step application
```
- **Personalized scheme recommendations**
- **Eligibility assessment** with farmer's data
- **Hindi explanations** of complex policies
- **Application guidance** with document checklists

---

- **Selling Decisions**: "प्याज कब बेचूं?" → Get best timing and market

## 🔗 Technology Stack

*Empowering farmers with AI, one crop at a time.* 🌾🤖

**Challenges we ran into**

# 🚧 Challenges I Ran Into

## 1. **ElevenLabs Voice Processing Latency** 🎙️

**The Problem:**
ElevenLabs API was taking 3-5 seconds to generate voice responses, creating awkward silences in conversations. Users would think the app was broken.

**The Hurdle:**
- Voice generation blocked the entire chat flow
- Users got impatient waiting for audio responses
- Real-time conversation feel was completely lost

**How I Solved It:**
- Implemented **async voice generation** parallel to text responses
- Added **visual feedback** (speaking animations, progress indicators)
- Created **fallback to browser TTS** when ElevenLabs is slow
- Used **audio preloading** and **streaming** for faster playback

---

## 2. **ElevenLabs Conversational AI Agent Management** 🤖

**The Problem:**
ElevenLabs Conversational AI required complex agent ID maintenance and lacked proper workflow management for agricultural use cases.

**The Hurdle:**
- No built-in agent persistence across sessions
- Limited agricultural knowledge in pre-trained agents
- Complex state management for multi-turn conversations
- No easy way to integrate custom tools (weather, market data)

**How I Solved It:**
- **Switched to Google ADK** which provided better agent orchestration
- Built **custom agent hierarchy** (main agent → weather/market/crop specialists)
- Used **session-based state management** instead of agent IDs
- Integrated **domain-specific tools** seamlessly with ADK's architecture

---

## 3. **Deployment Configuration Issues** 🚀

**The Problem:**
Multiple API integrations and WebSocket connections caused deployment headaches with environment variables and service coordination.

**How I Solved It:**
- Created **environment-specific configurations** with proper fallbacks
- Implemented **connection retry logic** for WebSocket stability
- Used **health check endpoints** to monitor all integrated services

---

## 4. **Real-time Image Processing Bottlenecks** 📸

**The Problem:**
Processing high-resolution crop images through Gemini Vision API while maintaining real-time chat experience was challenging.

**The Hurdle:**
- Large image files (5-10MB) took too long to upload and process
- Users uploading multiple images simultaneously crashed the system
- Base64 encoding doubled the data transfer size
- No progress feedback during image analysis

**How I Solved It:**
- Implemented **client-side image compression** before upload
- Added **queue management** for concurrent image processing
- Created **progressive analysis feedback** (upload → processing → analysis → results)
- Used **streaming responses** to show analysis progress in real-time

---

Each challenge taught me the importance of **user experience over technical perfection** - farmers need tools that work reliably under real field conditions, not just in development environments! 🌾

# 🎙️ How ElevenLabs Was Used in Project Kisan

- Created dedicated `ElevenLabsVoiceService` class handling all voice operations

Text Response → ElevenLabs API → MP3 Audio → Base64 Encoding → WebSocket → Frontend Playback

**Accessible Anytime, Anywhere:**

**Why It Matters**
AI GymBuddy doesn’t just help users exercise; it transforms the fitness experience by combining cutting-edge AI technology with secure, user-centered design, creating an environment where health goals are easier, safer, and more motivating to achieve.

**The problem it solves**

Here is the demo video link: https://youtube.com/shorts/_t97J5GMRAo?feature=share (facing issue with pasting it in top section, hence uploaded here)

In case the youtube embed doesn't work above, copy paste this url in browser.
https://youtube . com/shorts/_t97J5GMRAo?feature=share

Input file link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/113Wzxe1nl2UI6ggZU6RhqIwIK4v0lr2N?usp=sharing

**Problem:** Creating catchy remixes or jingles requires complex tools and music production skills, making it inaccessible for casual creators.

**Solution:** Our app lets anyone turn a simple voice clip into a viral-style remix instantly using AI, lowering the barrier to creativity and content creation.

Inspired by the creativity and fun remixes of Yashraj Mukhate, RemixStudio is an AI-powered app that takes a voice clip or song snippet as input and transforms it into a catchy jingle. The system mimics the playful style of viral remixes by layering speech, music, and generative sound design that bridges entertainment with generative AI.

The **use case** is to enable anyone to become a remix creator instantly, whether for memes, content creation, or just fun. Instead of professional music production skills, users can simply provide an input audio, and the app generates a polished jingle that can be shared across social media.

**Tech Specs**

> Frontend

Built with React + Tailwind for a clean and fast UI.

Audio recording/upload interface.

Playback system for generated jingles.

> Backend

FastAPI (Python) server for orchestration.

Handles audio processing pipeline end-to-end.

> Pipeline Workflow

Speech-to-Text (STT): Extract transcript from input audio.

Keyword Detection: Pick out “catchy” or meme-worthy words.

Voice Synthesis (TTS): Generate stylized speech using ElevenLabs TTS (WAV format).

Music Generation: Produce matching background beats using generative models.

Audio Mixing (PyDub): Overlay synthesized vocals with music → output as .wav.

> Deployment

Hosted on Vercel for frontend + API endpoints.

Python backend functions optimized for WAV-only (no FFmpeg dependency).

KeyNote: ✅ Current Version Capabilities

- Converts speech/audio to transcript (STT)
- Detects catchy keywords from transcript
- Selects a matching tone / background music
- Generates remix audio with music

-> Yet to be implemented:

Adding synthesized words (TTS) layered with music to complete the jingle

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenge faced:
One of the main challenges was audio processing on Vercel PyDub needs FFmpeg for MP3 handling, which isn’t available in serverless environments. This caused remix generation to fail silently. We solved it by switching the entire pipeline to WAV format, making it reliable and deployment-friendly.

**All Registered Participants.**

This project reimagines how voice can be transformed into creative audio. It uses speech-to-text to understand voice input, voice synthesis (TTS) to generate catchy spoken words, and then fuses them with music to create remixes. By combining voice recognition + voice generation, it showcases the playful, expressive side of Voice AI beyond traditional assistants or chatbots.

Team **Main Bhi Yashraj** -- Khyati Mirani, Anuj Jindal

**The problem it solves**

- **GameGen lets anyone make HTML5 games**—teachers, students, hobbyists, marketers—**without writing code**. Pick a template, customize with AI, and export.
- **Completely visual:** Drag, drop, type your ideas, and see immediate results. No confusing manuals. No “Hello, world.” No bugs in curly brackets.
- **AI does the heavy lifting:** Generates new art, music, and game balance in under a minute. What used to take weeks (hunting assets, tweaking parameters) now happens with a few clicks.
- **Safe, portable, offline-ready:** Exports a single folder with `index.html` that runs anywhere—school, office, or just for fun. No servers, no ads, no tracking.
- **Rapid prototyping:** Experiment with mechanics by typing prompts like “harder obstacles” or “8-bit forest theme.” Instantly see if the game is fun.

**Challenges we ran into**

| Challenge                  | How I Fixed It                                                                 |
|----------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **AI latency**             | Added low-res previews and background loading—now waits feel instant           |
| **CORS & API-key leaks**   | All AI calls go through a tiny backend proxy; keys never touch the browser     |
| **Touch vs. keyboard**     | Wrote a wrapper that unifies clicks, taps, and tilts into one control system   |
| **Bloated export files**   | Auto-compress images to WebP and bundle sprites—cut average size by 75%       |
| **Mismatched art styles**  | “Style-lock” tags ensure every asset (character, BG, UI) shares one look      |
| **AI logic doesn’t “get” games** | Built simple template libraries—AI tweaks parameters, not whole engines |

**Voice AI & Conversational Products | Powered by Elevenlabs**

GameGen taps ElevenLabs’ real-time voice synthesis to **auto-compose dynamic background music (BGM)** for every user-made game:

- **AI-Driven Soundtrack:** We stream ElevenLabs’ generative audio API to produce on-the-fly loops that match the game’s theme and difficulty.
- **Conversational Prompts:** Players simply describe the vibe—“retro arcade,” “chill lo-fi,” “intense boss fight”―and ElevenLabs returns a seamless, copyright-free score.
- **Accessibility & Immersion:** Spoken voice cues (e.g., “New high score!”) are synthesized in-engine, enhancing feedback for both sighted and visually-impaired gamers.
- **Zero Audio Skills Needed:** Non-coders drag-and-drop the BGM block; GameGen handles the API call, encoding, and looping.

By converting plain-language requests into adaptive game soundscapes and voice feedback, GameGen embodies the **Voice AI & Conversational Products** vision—bringing studio-quality audio creation to everyone with a browser.

### GharBot
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/gharbot-5c7f) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://wa.me/14155238886?text=join%20had-machinery) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-mosAIc:%20AI%20in%20action%20with%20The%20Product%20Folks-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://mosaicbytpf.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> From Missed Calls to Deals: AI for Indian Realtors

![Webhook](https://img.shields.io/badge/Webhook-333333?style=flat-square) ![Twilio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Twilio-333333?style=flat-square) ![Google Sheets](https://img.shields.io/badge/Google%20Sheets-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

In India’s high-velocity real estate market, most customers still prefer to call rather than text. But for independent agents, it’s nearly impossible to answer every call especially while managing site visits, ongoing deals, and daily travel.

And when calls are missed?
📉 Leads go cold
📦 Opportunities are lost
⏳ Time is wasted chasing callbacks

Customers follow up on WhatsApp. Real estate agents can't keep up with manual replies. Valuable leads get buried in message threads. Conversions drop due to slow or no follow-ups.

**Enter the AI WhatsApp Assistant - GharBot**

This solution adds an AI assistant on WhatsApp that:

- Sends instant follow-ups when a call is missed

- Captures buyer intent: budget, location, need

- Logs everything into Google Sheets

- Schedules meetings without manual coordination

**Simple, Seamless, Scalable**

With GharBot in place, agents will never miss a lead, stay organized, and respond faster all without needing extra staff or complex CRM tools. It’s an automation that works the Indian way, using channels buyers already trust.

**Challenges we ran into**

Building this automation wasn’t without its bumps. One tricky challenge was getting the data to flow smoothly between modules on the Make platform. The biggest headache? Phone number formatting.

The webhook would sometimes send numbers with extra characters like double plus signs or the whatsapp: prefix and Twilio’s API kept rejecting those numbers as invalid. Every time this happened, the scenario would fail, and messages wouldn’t send.

At first, it was confusing to figure out why the numbers weren’t accepted, but I dug into Make’s text functions and learned to use replace() and concat() to clean up the input before passing it on. This small fix made all the difference.

Another puzzle was managing multiple filters in the Google Sheets module. If the conditions weren’t set just right, the data retrieval would break or return nothing. I had to carefully test and tweak the filters to get reliable results.

It took patience, trial and error, and lots of testing with the Make debugger, but eventually, everything clicked into place and the automation started running smoothly.

**The problem it solves**

💳 What can people use this for?

Choose the right credit card → Instead of scrolling comparison sites, users get personalised recommendations based on their lifestyle and spend patterns.

Maximise rewards & perks → Transparent value breakdown shows exactly how much cashback, points, or lounge access they gain.

Avoid missed milestones → Workflow accounts for hidden caps and milestone rules, so users don’t lose out.

Quick financial decisions → Results in under 3 seconds; no more manual research across 30+ cards.

Data safety → No sensitive spend data needed. Responses are stored in Google Sheets for resumption & dedupe, not heavy databases.

Adaptable globally → Replace the card dataset with your country’s banks/offers → workflow instantly works in any geography.

⚡ How it makes tasks easier & safer

Easier:

Automates the boring manual comparison of cards.

Gives answers in plain ₹ value, not just “points” or “percentages.”

Keeps an audit log in Sheets so you can always track and refine.

Safer:

No need to share raw credit card or bank account data.

All data stored in a user-controlled Google Sheet.

Deduplication ensures clean records, avoiding misuse or overlap.

👉 In short: This workflow is like a credit card decision assistant — fast, transparent, and privacy-friendly.

**Challenges we ran into**

🐞 Hurdle I faced

One major bug I ran into: multi-select answers breaking the scoring logic.

In the quiz, users could select multiple spend categories (e.g. Travel + Dining + Shopping).

My first implementation just gave each match a flat score → which made users selecting fewer options look “weaker” than those selecting more.

Result: Recommendations were skewed and didn’t feel fair.

✅ How I solved it

I redesigned the logic in n8n Function nodes to use percentage match scoring:

For multi-select:
Score = (matches / total user selections) × max_score

This way, whether you select 1 or 5 categories, the system normalises fairly.

Example: If you pick only “Travel” and it matches, you still get full credit for that answer.

🚀 Outcome

Scoring became balanced across all user profiles.

GPT recommendations felt much more accurate and personalised.

Testers said the top-3 picks finally made sense.

Nishant Pandita

**Challenges we ran into**

🛠 Bug/Hurdle We Faced

One of the major hurdles we ran into while building EduSakha was the integration of multiple AI models (for learning guidance, career navigation, and financial coaching) into a single seamless platform.

⚡ The Problem

- The models produced inconsistent results when combined.

- APIs had different response times, which caused delays in the user interface.

- Handling real-time feedback while ensuring accuracy became challenging.


✅ How We Solved It

- We introduced a middleware layer using FastAPI that standardized responses from all AI models.

- Implemented asynchronous API calls to reduce latency and keep the UI smooth.

- Added data validation and caching mechanisms to avoid repeated processing and ensure reliable outputs.

- Conducted extensive testing with mock data before live integration, which helped us catch and fix inconsistencies early.


🚀 Outcome

- After resolving this hurdle, EduSakha was able to:

- Deliver real-time, accurate guidance without noticeable lag.
 
-  Provide a unified experience across learning, career, and financial modules.
 
- Improve both stability and user trust in the platform.

> Prepare Smarter. Learn Faster.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Students and learners often struggle with revising large amounts of study material effectively. Reading notes or PDFs passively doesn’t guarantee retention, and manually creating practice questions is time-consuming and overwhelming. Teachers also spend significant effort designing question papers with varied difficulty and formats.

Prepify solves this by:

Automatically converting notes/PDFs into personalized question banks.

Allowing users to choose difficulty level, number, and type of questions (MCQ, SAQ, essay, true/false).

Generating AI-powered answers for essay-type questions, making self-study more guided.

Saving time while making preparation more active, engaging, and exam-focused.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the major challenges was reliably extracting clean text from PDFs using JavaScript. PDF parsing often produced inconsistent formatting, broken lines, or missing content, which made it difficult to maintain context for question generation.

Another challenge was structuring the extracted text in a way that LLaMA could process effectively. Since raw text can be unorganized, designing prompts that guided the model to generate meaningful and accurate questions (across multiple formats like MCQ, SAQ, essay, true/false) required multiple iterations and fine-tuning.

Balancing performance, accuracy, and usability while integrating AI was also a key hurdle — ensuring that the questions were relevant, appropriately difficult, and not too generic.

**Top 100 Participants**

Our project fits into the Lovable track because it focuses on making the user’s experience smooth, personalized, and engaging. It’s designed not just to work, but to feel enjoyable and meaningful, so users would want to keep coming back.

**The problem it solves**

**CareerCraft AI** addresses the core challenge of managing job applications efficiently and optimizing a candidate’s resume for each opportunity. Job seekers often struggle to keep track of applications, deadlines, statuses, and follow-ups across multiple platforms, leading to missed opportunities or lost information. This platform offers:

A **centralized space** to securely track all job applications, document status, and manage deadlines, reducing manual effort and confusion.

An easy way to upload and analyze resumes and job descriptions, with AI-powered suggestions that boost the alignment and effectiveness of each application.

**Actionable guidance** to improve resume-job fit, helping users surface missing skills, keywords, and tailor their applications—directly increasing their chances of being shortlisted.

A **clean, intuitive dashboard** with filtering and analytics, making it easier to prioritize opportunities and manage the job search process with confidence.

*The result is a user-friendly, secure environment that helps job seekers take control of their career search, make smarter decisions, and save time compared to juggling spreadsheets or emails.*

**Challenges we ran into**

Building Career Craft AI came with several technical and practical challenges:

Secure Authentication Integration: Setting up multi-provider authentication (email/password + Google) required careful configuration to ensure robust security and smooth user onboarding.

AI-Powered Resume Analysis: Integrating AI for resume and JD comparison involved both prompt engineering and handling unstructured data.

State Management & UI Consistency: Handling real-time updates across the dashboard (e.g., reflecting new applications or edits instantly) meant addressing issues with state management and responsiveness.

To overcome these challenges, modular development was prioritized: testing each component in isolation and leveraging pre-built UI libraries for consistency. For the AI component, iterative prompt tuning and fallback mechanisms ensured the system delivered valuable suggestions even in edge cases.

**The problem it solves**

Documentation Burden in Healthcare
Documentation Burden: Globally, doctors spend 30-40% of their workday on Electronic Health Record (EHR) tasks, manually updating patient details, symptoms, and diagnoses, with outdated systems amplifying the strain, especially in India’s overburdened public hospitals.
Effects on Healthcare:

Rushed Consultations: Cuts patient interaction time, risking incomplete care and repeat visits.
Burnout & Fatigue: Extends workweeks, driving mental exhaustion and burnout among doctors.
System Strain: Reduces patient capacity, increases errors, and worsens doctor shortages.

DocAst
DocAst: An AI-powered assistant that records doctor-patient conversations, auto-generates structured clinical notes, and captures diagnoses, freeing doctors from paperwork, boosting efficiency, and enhancing patient care.

**Challenges we ran into**

Getting the AI model to understand medical conversations accurately was the biggest hurdle - distinguishing between doctor and patient speech, handling medical terminology. 

Mitigated this by integrating ElevenLabs' speech-to-text API with speaker diarization for accurate voice separation and accent handling.

Additionally, fine-tuned Hugging Face's FalconsAI model on medical datasets and applied chain-of-thought prompting to enhance terminology recognition and contextual understanding
