### PM Voice
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/pm-voice-6dfe) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://pmvoice.netlify.app/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-mosAIc:%20AI%20in%20action%20with%20The%20Product%20Folks-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://mosaicbytpf.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Practice Smarter. Interview Stronger.

![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Many job seekers, especially aspiring Product Managers, spend weeks perfecting their resumes and applications but rarely practice the actual live interview experience. PM Voice solves this gap by acting as a voice-first interview coach.
It simulates realistic interview rounds with short, natural questions.
It uses adaptive probing to ask follow-up questions only when useful, preventing wasted time.
After each round, it provides structured feedback, STAR rewrites, and a micro-goal so candidates know exactly how to improve.
Sessions are saved as Memory Packs, so users can pick up right where they left off.
In short, PM Voice makes interview prep easier, more consistent, and more confidence-building by giving users a daily, conversational practice partner, something that’s hard to achieve with books or one-off mock interviews.

**Challenges we ran into**

One major hurdle came when I added the Coach scoring + retries feature.
Problem: The /scoreTurn endpoint that handled feedback wasn’t showing up in our routes. It turned out we had mounted it incorrectly with router.post("/") instead of router.post(""). As a result, the ElevenLabs Agent couldn’t call it, and our scoring pipeline kept failing.
On Cloud Run, /route kept failing with 404s because our API_BASE environment variable was still pointing to localhost. This caused frustrating loops where the backend looked fine locally but broke in production.
Fixes:
Corrected the router mount and verified with /__routes to ensure it was exposed.
Updated Cloud Run environment variables so API_BASE pointed at the deployed URL.
Added smoke-tests using curl after each deploy, which caught issues early.
Once these were fixed, the scoring pipeline worked, and we could see real-time STAR feedback and retry attempts being logged in Firestore. This was a turning point, it unlocked the “coach” mode that makes PM Voice more than just an interviewer, but also a guide for continuous improvement.

**The problem it solves**

# ♻️ SmartBin: Go Clean, Go Sustainable  

SmartBin is an AI-powered waste management system that helps classify, forecast, and manage waste more effectively.  
Built during **HackOdisha5**, it combines computer vision, real-time detection, and predictive analytics to promote sustainable living.  

---

## 🏆 The Problem It Solves  

Waste segregation is confusing and often ignored. This leads to:  
- ❌ Mixed waste that is hard to recycle  
- ❌ Higher landfill burden  
- ❌ Costly and time-consuming manual segregation  

**SmartBin makes this process simple and accessible for all ages**:  
- 🎥 Upload or scan waste in real time → get instant classification  
- 📊 Forecast waste patterns to plan better recycling strategies  
- 🌱 Encourage clean and sustainable disposal habits in homes, offices, and campuses  

---
## 🔮 Future Scope  

- 📊 **Dashboards** – Live insights for corporates, universities, and municipalities  
- 🎮 **Gamified learning** – Engage all ages (especially rural areas) with fun waste-management challenges  
- 🤖 **IoT-enabled SmartBin prototype** – Servo motors, buzzers, and sensors for auto-sorting  
- 🌍 **Smart city integration** – Combine AI + IoT + forecasting for large-scale deployment

**Challenges we ran into**

## 🚧 Challenges We Ran Into  

- ⏱️ **Real-time delay** – Current webcam inference takes ~3 seconds  
  - ✅ Optimized pipeline; plan to use lighter/faster models in future  

- 📂 **Limited dataset** – Could only train on demo data during hackathon  
  - ✅ Still managed to build a functional classifier and forecasting model  

- ⚡ **Time constraints** – Balancing training, UI, and deployment in <36 hours  
  - ✅ Kept architecture modular and built 3 working sections  

Following the improvements of the current model as per the future scopes will help us accomplish - 
🌍 A solution with both **immediate utility** and **long-term vision**

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/edu-efd5) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/meena-kumari0605/edu-plus) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1vxNgcu9IkskbpVYhT8zBF2Qu6YG8qlSr/edit?slide=id.p1#slide=id.p1) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/6_swIEnrIKE?si=i6xZpO7gAR8Bgq7H) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackOdisha%205.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackodisha-4.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Learn it

![Firebase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase-333333?style=flat-square) ![Dart](https://img.shields.io/badge/Dart-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flutter](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flutter-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

As B.Tech students, we all know how messy learning can get. Notes are scattered in WhatsApp groups, quizzes are buried in random PDFs, and half the time we don’t even know which material is for our branch, year, or semester. It wastes a lot of time and makes studying harder than it should be.

On top of that, most apps don’t really understand our needs. They throw generic content at us instead of giving subject-specific material. And when it comes to practice, we’re often stuck with outdated question banks instead of interactive quizzes that actually test how much we’ve learned.

Our app solves this by putting everything in one place—subjects, notes, quizzes, and more—organized exactly by branch, year, and semester. It’s like having your own personalized learning hub. You log in once, set up your details, and from then on, the app knows what content you need.

It also makes studying smarter: quizzes help you check your knowledge instantly, and since everything is digital, you don’t waste time hunting for resources. Plus, because it’s built on Firebase, accounts and data are secure.

In short, the app makes studying simpler, faster, and way less stressful, so students can focus on learning instead of searching.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the biggest challenges was getting Firebase authentication to work smoothly with my Flutter app. At first, login and signup weren’t connecting properly with the database, and I kept running into errors like “supplied auth credential is not correct.” It was frustrating because the UI worked perfectly, but the backend just wouldn’t respond the way I expected.

Another hurdle was understanding how to structure user data dynamically. I wanted students to not only log in but also save their details like year, semester, and bio so that the app could personalize their learning path. Figuring out how to store and fetch this data correctly in Firebase without breaking the flow of the app took quite a bit of trial and error.

I got past these issues by breaking them down step by step—first making sure Firebase was properly initialized in main.dart, then testing login and signup separately, and finally connecting everything together. Reading Firebase documentation and debugging with test accounts helped me figure out where I was going wrong. Once the auth flow was stable, storing extra user info felt much easier to implement.

**Ethereum Track**

Our project is submitted under the ETHIndia track as part of the main hackathon challenge. We focused on solving a real problem faced by B.Tech students by building a learning app with authentication, quizzes, and subject-based organization. While we didn’t use any sponsor-specific tools, our project directly aligns with the spirit of ETHIndia—using technology to create impactful solutions that improve education and accessibility for students.

### Guardian Chip
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/guardian-chip-d03c) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://guardian-chip-link.lovable.app) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/CqJEaQSLyoU) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackOdisha%205.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackodisha-4.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Revolutionizing Safety

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Figma](https://img.shields.io/badge/Figma-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**The 112Link** (***Guardian Chip – Tria***) addresses a critical gap in personal safety solutions. Traditional phone-based SOS systems are unreliable in real-world emergencies because:

- Navigation through phone apps takes too long.

- Victims in hidden violence situations can’t always use phones discreetly.

- Phone batteries can die, making them useless.

- OS restrictions may block emergency features.

How 112Link helps:

- Provides a dedicated SOS hardware trigger (triple-press or voice keyword).

- Works independently of the phone’s battery.

- Uses low-power GNSS for accurate location.

- Captures live audio and sends it securely to responders.
 
- Synchronizes with smartwatches for accessibility.

- Directly connects to ERSS-112 (India’s emergency response system) and guardians for immediate action.

**Challenges we ran into**

*While building this project, some hurdles likely included*:

**Hardware–Software Integration**:
Getting the Guardian Chip to work seamlessly with smartphones and smartwatches required solving Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) sync issues.
**
Power Managemen**t:
Ensuring the device could operate on low power while still running GNSS and audio streaming was a technical challenge. Optimizing firmware helped overcome this.

**Reliable Trigger Mechanism**:
Implementing a triple-press button that avoids accidental triggers but still works instantly in emergencies was tricky. Careful hardware testing solved it.

**Cloud & ERSS Integration**:
Connecting real-time audio and location data securely to the backend, and then linking it with ERSS-112 for emergency response, needed both backend optimization and API-level testing.

**Web3 Track prize**

112Link generates valuable data — SOS frequency, locations, response times, and audio patterns. Using Wolfram’s computational intelligence, we can analyze emergency trends, optimize response strategies, and even predict high-risk zones. This makes the system not only reactive but also proactive in saving lives.

**Use Gofr (A Golang Framework)**

The SOS pipeline requires fast and reliable communication between hardware, mobile app, and cloud. GoFr provides lightweight API integration, which makes it easier to transmit location, audio streams, and guardian alerts in real time. This reduces development overhead and ensures smooth IoT connectivity.

**Participation prize**

112Link required a clean, intuitive UI for both patients and responders. Balsamiq helped us quickly prototype wireframes, visualize user flows, and iterate on design before development. This ensured the app and dashboard were user-friendly in high-stress emergency situations.

**Verbwire API Challenge**

112Link deals with highly sensitive emergency data (SOS triggers, location, live audio). Using **Verbwire’s** blockchain APIs, we can store SOS event logs in a tamper-proof, verifiable way, ensuring that:

- Emergency data cannot be altered or deleted.

- Authorities and guardians have a trusted record of alerts.

- The system gains transparency and security, which is critical for life-saving use cases.

**Best Use of Akash**

During emergencies, cloud downtime or latency could cost lives. Akash Network’s decentralized cloud hosting ensures that 112Link’s backend runs on a resilient, distributed infrastructure with low latency and high availability. This guarantees that SOS data, location, and audio streams are always accessible, even under heavy load or regional outages.

**🏆 Internship Opportunities at Threeway Studio**

For a safety product, trust and usability are critical. Threeway Studio’s design expertise helps us build clear visuals, intuitive layouts, and strong branding for the app and website. This ensures users can trigger SOS actions quickly and confidently without confusion in high-stress moments.

**Build with Orkes Conductor in the AI Track**

112Link requires multiple steps when an SOS is triggered — activating the chip, syncing with the phone, pushing data to the cloud, alerting guardians, and notifying ERSS-112. Orkes helps by orchestrating these workflows reliably, ensuring that every action is executed in sequence without delays or failures. This makes the emergency pipeline fast, scalable, and fault-tolerant.

> From Static to Life

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Unity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Unity-333333?style=flat-square) ![Vuforia](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vuforia-333333?style=flat-square) ![Blender](https://img.shields.io/badge/Blender-333333?style=flat-square) ![C#](https://img.shields.io/badge/C#-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**Problem Our Project Solves**
Textbooks often show animals only through static pictures, which makes it difficult for students to fully understand their structure, size, and unique features. This leads to:
Limited visualization of animals beyond 2D images
Less engaging learning experiences for kids
Difficulty in remembering details about different species
Lack of exposure to animals that cannot be seen in real life

**Our Solution: mAgicmiRror**
The Animal & Planet Augmenting AR Science Book addresses this by allowing students to scan book pages and instantly view realistic 3D models of animals and planets. Animals can be observed from all sides to understand their posture and biological traits, while planets can be explored in 3D to study their size, surface, and texture in the solar system.The models can be seen from all sides, giving a clear idea of their shape, posture, and characteristics.
This makes learning:
*Simpler* –  Things are easier to understand when viewed in 3D
*Memorable* – vivid visuals help students recall facts better
*Accessible* – usable offline with printed books and AR PDFs
*Modern learning* – supports NEP 2020’s experiential approach

Our AR science book turns ordinary pages into living visuals of animals and planets, making zoology and space science lessons more immersive and effective without the need for physical models, telescopes, or field trips.
****How to Use****
**Using the Website**
1. Open our Magic Mirror website on your browser.
2. Browse and select the book volume - Animal or Planets 
3. Download the AR-enabled PDF or view directly online.
4. Scan AR book by downloading AR Apk to see the 3D models of animals from earth to planets from sky.
5. Explore 3D models 

**Using the Mobile App**
1. Download and install the our Magic Mirror APK from the website.
2. Open the app and grant camera access.
3. Scan a page from the AR book.
4. Watch models appear in 3D on your screen.
5. Learn through visuals information provided in the app.

**Website Link** [mAgicmiRror](https://magiic-mirror.netlify.app/)

**Challenges we ran into**

mAgicmirRor app was built at Hack4Bihar under Open Innovation.
For HackOdisha 5.0, we’re submitting an **improved version** with added **website, drive, APK, and AR-PDF features**. The idea follows an open-innovation approach.
Old Version
1). AR-powered book with 3D models and Android AR app for scanning.
New Version
1). Added website platform for wider accessibility
2). Cloud drive integration for storage & sharing of resources
3). APK download option for instant installation on Android devices
4). AR-enabled PDFs allowing interactive offline learning
5). Multi-volume support Animal volume and planets volume 
6). User-friendly dashboard for managing resources
7). Cross-device access (web + mobile)
8). Improved UI/UX for smoother navigation
9). Scalability for adding new subjects and modules
10). Extended vision towards an AR/VR-powered learning ecosystem
11) 3D planets AR book for immersive exploration of the solar system
12) Comparative 3D visualization of planets to study differences in size, atmosphere, and surface features

Learning today is scattered across articles, videos, PDFs, and notes. Manually skimming, summarizing, and connecting ideas is slow and inconsistent. KnowledgeHub ingests multiple sources and gives you a structured first-pass: executive summary, key insights, concepts, quotes, difficulty, reading time, and a synthesis/topic map — so you understand faster and retain more.

**Challenges we ran into**

CORS & scraping: client-side fetches are blocked → used AllOrigins proxy; production should use a server fetcher.

YouTube transcripts: often require backend due to CORS/rate limits → simulated in demo; real flow via backend.

PDF parsing: pdf-parse is Node-only → simulated; use PDF.js (client) or server worker with pdf-parse.

Main content extraction: sites vary → heuristic selectors now; add Readability-style extractor later.

Credibility/concept extraction: heuristic → replace with real NLP (server or WebGPU) for production.

Persistence: UI hints at profiles/settings; no DB wired yet (Supabase is listed but unused).

### Smart API Gate way
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/smart-api-gate-way-1a5e) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://cbdey.pythonanywhere.com/) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/tl80fMluPXM) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackOdisha%205.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackodisha-4.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> "Turning Data Chaos into Clarity"

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![ngrok](https://img.shields.io/badge/ngrok-333333?style=flat-square) ![SQLite](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQLite-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Problem Description

Government departments, survey agencies, and research institutions collect large volumes of structured data from citizens, businesses, and field surveys. However, accessing this data for analysis is often difficult because:

1. Raw SQL Queries → Analysts and officials must write complex SQL queries to retrieve specific insights. This is not user-friendly for non-technical users.


2. Security & Privacy Risks → Direct SQL access to databases exposes them to risks like SQL injection, unauthorized queries, and data leaks.


3. Scalability Issues → Large datasets are hard to query efficiently without optimization and secure access control.


4. Lack of Standardized APIs → There is no unified, secure API layer to fetch structured survey data in a controlled, validated, and easy-to-use format.



Because of these challenges, decision-makers struggle to retrieve insights quickly, delaying policy-making, research, and development initiatives.



What Our Project Solves

The Smart SQL API Gateway acts as a secure, intelligent bridge between raw databases and end-users (citizens, officials, researchers, or developers).

✅ Secure Data Access – Users submit natural SQL-like queries via an API, which are validated and sanitized before execution, preventing SQL injection.
✅ Authentication & Authorization – Token-based access ensures only verified users can retrieve allowed datasets.
✅ Optimized Querying – Built-in validation and optimization allow fast retrieval from large survey datasets.
✅ Standardized API Output – Data is returned in clean JSON/CSV formats, ready for dashboards, analytics tools, or apps.
✅ Bridging Technical Gap – Non-technical users (like govt. officers) can retrieve insights without writing raw SQL, through a simple and secure API interface.

In short: It transforms raw, insecure, and complex SQL data access into a smart, secure, and user-friendly API gateway, making government and survey data accessible, reliable, and actionable.

**Challenges we ran into**

Technologies Used

Programming Language: Python

Frameworks & Libraries:

Flask (for building the API backend)

Flask-CORS (for cross-origin access)

Pandas (for handling and processing datasets)

SQLite3 (for lightweight database management)

PyJWT / Secrets (for authentication and token-based security)


Deployment Tools:

Ngrok (for initial testing and public tunneling on Google Colab)

PythonAnywhere (for stable and persistent cloud deployment)


Data Handling: CSV files / large datasets (processed with Pandas)

Frontend Access: JSON/CSV API responses (integrated with dashboards or external applications)

**The problem it solves**

SwasthyaMitra bridges the healthcare gap in rural areas like Nabha, where doctors are fewer, hospitals are understaffed, and patients often travel long distances only to find no help.

With our platform, people can:

📱 Consult doctors remotely via video/audio (no need to travel).

🆔 Use their NABHA Health Card (QR-based) as a unique digital ID for medical records.

💊 Check real-time medicine availability at local pharmacies.

🤖 Get quick guidance using our AI-powered symptom checker in local languages.

👩‍⚕️ Rely on ASHA workers for support if they are uneducated or don’t have mobile access.

It makes healthcare more accessible, faster, and safer by reducing unnecessary travel, saving costs, and ensuring timely treatment.

**Challenges we ran into**

⚡ Low Internet Connectivity in Rural Areas:
We had to ensure the platform works with offline-first support (SMS/USSD + QR cards). Solved by adding SMS alerts + ASHA worker integration.

⚡ Handling Patients Without Smartphones:
Many villagers don’t have smartphones or literacy. Solved this with voice-guided system + ASHA worker registration centers.

⚡ Real-Time Video Calls with Low Bandwidth:
Rural network issues made video consultations tough. We overcame this by choosing Agora.io SDK which has good low-bandwidth optimization and audio fallback.

⚡ Data Privacy & Security:
Health data is sensitive. We implemented JWT authentication, AES encryption, and token-based secure video calls to protect patients’ records.

**Ethereum Track**

Our project leverages blockchain for:
Tamper-proof storage of health records
Transparent medicine supply chain
Incentive mechanisms for ASHA workers
This showcases real-world Ethereum adoption in healthcare.

**Verbwire API Challenge**

Verbwire APIs enable Web3 integration such as:
Turning NABHA Health Cards into secure NFT-based health IDs

Adds a unique digital identity + trust layer to your solution.

**Best Use of Akash**

Akash is a decentralized cloud ideal for:
Hosting your telemedicine backend (video, chat, health records)
Reducing infrastructure cost, especially for rural areas
Ensures affordable and scalable healthcare hosting.

**Build with Orkes Conductor in the AI Track**

Orkes provides workflow orchestration that can automate:
Consultation → Prescription → Pharmacy sync → Medicine delivery
SMS reminders and follow-ups
Perfect for your multi-step healthcare process.

### Prepify
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/prepify-116f) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/koustab25/prepify) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://koustab25.github.io/prepify/) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/ALvvK1am17Q?si=SWiCgHZFLYsCDc8Q) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackOdisha%205.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackodisha-4.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Prepare Smarter. Learn Faster.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Problem it solves:
Students and learners often struggle with revising large amounts of study material effectively. Reading notes or PDFs passively doesn’t guarantee retention, and manually creating practice questions is time-consuming and overwhelming. Teachers also spend significant effort designing question papers with varied difficulty and formats.

Prepify solves this by:

Automatically converting notes/PDFs into personalized question banks.

Allowing users to choose difficulty level, number, and type of questions (MCQ, SAQ, essay, true/false).

Generating AI-powered answers for essay-type questions, making self-study more guided.

Saving time while making preparation more active, engaging, and exam-focused.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges I faced during development:
One of the major challenges was reliably extracting clean text from PDFs using JavaScript. PDF parsing often produced inconsistent formatting, broken lines, or missing content, which made it difficult to maintain context for question generation.

Another challenge was structuring the extracted text in a way that LLaMA could process effectively. Since raw text can be unorganized, designing prompts that guided the model to generate meaningful and accurate questions (across multiple formats like MCQ, SAQ, essay, true/false) required multiple iterations and fine-tuning.

Balancing performance, accuracy, and usability while integrating AI was also a key hurdle — ensuring that the questions were relevant, appropriately difficult, and not too generic.

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/ai-plant-disease-detection-2a03) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1OjXBrHVqzIFAe7AgP3YQ9WyHc8wzXD5n/view?usp=share_link) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/BDll8HuxVFA) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackOdisha%205.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackodisha-4.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Finding Disease in Plants And Helping Farmers

![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Most Indian farmers face a critical challenge when it comes to identifying plant diseases. Due to limited access to agricultural experts and lack of proper awareness, they often fail to recognize the exact disease affecting their crops. Without this knowledge, farmers are unable to make informed decisions and end up buying fertilizers, pesticides, or treatments that are either ineffective or entirely wrong. This not only increases their financial burden but also harms the soil quality and reduces overall productivity. The cycle of misdiagnosis and improper treatment further leads to lower crop yields, food insecurity, and loss of income, making farming an even riskier livelihood.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the major challenges I ran into was collecting and accessing reliable data. Finding the right datasets itself was a time-consuming task, and once I had them, the next hurdle was dealing with their sheer size. Downloading huge amounts of data required significant time and effort, and analyzing such large datasets further slowed down the process due to system limitations and long computation times. This made the entire workflow—from data acquisition to analysis—much more complex and resource-intensive than expected.

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/soilsathi-0e8e) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/SHIRSHAK0071/CredMate.git) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1qfaDs1jZI6m9XCUwnhR-9a-riupjKgx0) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://vimeo.com/1095076105/b0a30a5fbf?share=copy) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackOdisha%205.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackodisha-4.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Your Smart Soil Companion

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![OpenCV](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenCV-333333?style=flat-square) ![Arduino IDE](https://img.shields.io/badge/Arduino%20IDE-333333?style=flat-square) ![C++](https://img.shields.io/badge/C++-333333?style=flat-square) ![Kaggle](https://img.shields.io/badge/Kaggle-333333?style=flat-square) ![React Native](https://img.shields.io/badge/React%20Native-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The Problem SoilSathi Solves

Agriculture today faces a range of challenges, including declining soil health, unidentified plant diseases, limited access to expert knowledge, and inefficient farm management practices. Farmers and gardeners often rely on manual observation, costly laboratory testing, or trial-and-error approaches. This results in:

Reduced crop yield due to untreated soil and undetected plant issues

High input costs from improper use of fertilizers, pesticides, and water

Limited knowledge-sharing between farmers and communities

Difficulty in accessing modern agricultural services such as drones and e-commerce platforms

Lack of engaging and accessible educational tools for children, beginners, and the elderly

How SoilSathi Helps

SoilSathi is designed to make agriculture smarter, safer, and more accessible by combining artificial intelligence, real-time monitoring, and community-driven features.

Key Ways It Simplifies and Improves Tasks

Real-Time Soil Health Monitoring
Provides instant soil analysis and actionable recommendations, reducing the need for external testing and enabling timely decision-making.

AI-Powered Plant Disease Detection
Identifies plant diseases through simple photo capture and suggests treatments, preventing crop loss and improving productivity.

Role-Specific Dashboards
Farmers and gardeners have access to tailored dashboards that simplify complex data into practical insights.

Drone Services Integration
Offers aerial monitoring, spraying, and surveillance, improving efficiency while reducing manual labor and safety risks.

Educational Platform
Provides interactive learning tools such as games, AR exploration, and structured content for children, beginners, and elderly learners.

Community Features
Connects users for knowledge sharing, fostering collaboration and collective problem-solving.

Integrated E-commerce Marketplace
Delivers direct access to seeds, fertilizers, tools, and equipment with secure payment options and reliable order tracking.

Impact

For Farmers: Increases yield, reduces costs, and ensures better crop health through timely interventions.

For Gardeners: Simplifies plant care and provides expert guidance at home.

For Learners: Makes agricultural knowledge accessible and engaging through structured educational content.

For Communities: Creates a collaborative platform for exchanging agricultural practices and insights.

In summary, SoilSathi bridges the gap between traditional farming methods and modern, AI-driven solutions, making agriculture more efficient, sustainable, and accessible.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges I Ran Into

While building SoilSathi, several technical and design-related challenges arose:

1. AI Model Integration for Disease Detection

Challenge: Training and integrating an AI model that could accurately identify plant diseases from images was difficult due to limited datasets and varying image quality from mobile devices.

Solution: I overcame this by using transfer learning with pre-trained vision models and augmenting the dataset with synthetic images. This improved accuracy while keeping the model lightweight enough to run on mobile devices.

2. Performance Optimization in React Native

Challenge: The app initially faced performance issues, especially when handling camera features and rendering AR content.

Solution: I optimized rendering using React Native’s memoization techniques and offloaded heavy computations to background tasks. Additionally, I used Expo’s optimized libraries for camera and AR integration.

3. Offline Functionality for Farmers in Rural Areas

Challenge: Many target users, especially farmers, may not always have reliable internet connectivity.

Solution: I implemented offline data caching with AsyncStorage so users could still access soil health tips, saved analyses, and educational content without internet access. Data automatically syncs when connectivity is restored.

4. Designing for Multiple User Types

Challenge: Creating a single application that caters to farmers, gardeners, and children required distinct user experiences without overwhelming the interface.

Solution: I solved this by building role-specific dashboards (Farmer Dashboard, Gardener Dashboard, Kids Education Hub) with tailored features and simplified navigation for each user type.

5. Complex Navigation and State Management

Challenge: Managing navigation between multiple feature sets (dashboards, education, e-commerce, drone services) was complex.

Solution: I standardized navigation using React Navigation 6 and applied the Context API for consistent global state management across different modules.

Outcome

By addressing these challenges, I ensured that SoilSathi is not only technically robust and user-friendly, but also accessible to diverse users in both urban and rural contexts. These solutions helped transform the initial concept into a scalable and practical application.

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/expense-tracker-7aee) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/DhyeyKakadiya/nextexpense-tracker) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackOdisha%205.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackodisha-4.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> rack smart. Spend wiser

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Managing personal finances can be overwhelming, especially with scattered transactions, impulsive spending, and a lack of visibility into where money is going. Most people rely on mental tracking, spreadsheets, or overly complex tools that don’t align with their daily habits.

**Challenges we ran into**

1. Handling Authentication Securely with JWT

One of the early challenges was implementing secure user authentication using JWTs in a Next.js environment. Since Next.js handles both frontend and backend, properly managing tokens between API routes and client-side logic was tricky.

Solution:
We used httpOnly cookies for token storage to prevent XSS attacks and structured the auth flow using middleware to protect sensitive API routes. We also ensured password hashing was correctly handled using bcrypt.

2. Responsive and Minimal UI with Limited Tokens

Designing a clean and responsive UI with minimal code due to token limits was a constraint. Using a CSS framework like Tailwind would've helped, but it added extra boilerplate.

Solution:
We opted for custom, lightweight CSS and reusable components to minimize repetition while keeping the UI intuitive and responsive.

![Firebase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Swift](https://img.shields.io/badge/Swift-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flutter](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flutter-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![AI/ML](https://img.shields.io/badge/AI/ML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Nodejs](https://img.shields.io/badge/Nodejs-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Caring for plants is not always simple. Gardeners, farmers, students, and even plant lovers face challenges such as:

🌿 Identifying Plants – Many struggle to recognize plants correctly, especially rare ones.

🩺 Detecting Diseases Early – Plant diseases often go unnoticed until it’s too late, leading to crop loss or dying houseplants.

🏡 Choosing the Right Plants – People are unsure which plants suit their homes, interiors, or lifestyle.

🎓 Limited Learning Tools – Pharmacy, botany, and agriculture students lack immersive, hands-on learning experiences.

👩‍🌾 Smart Farming Needs – Farmers need simple digital tools for fertilizer planning and weather-based crop care.

**Challenges we ran into**

📦 3D Model Loading Issues → Initially, AR models (GLB/RealityKit) were not rendering properly on iOS devices. The fix involved restructuring the ARView setup and ensuring assets were correctly bundled.

🤖 AI Disease Detection Accuracy → Early prototypes struggled to differentiate between similar-looking leaf diseases. We improved this by using a larger training dataset and integrating pre-trained ML models.

🔄 Performance Optimization → Rendering AR scenes alongside real-time AI processing caused app slowdowns. We optimized by running heavy computations on background threads and caching results.

🌐 Real-Time Data Integration → Weather API and farming insights required stable API connections. We handled this by adding error handling + fallback defaults for offline use.

🎨 User Experience (UX/UI) → Balancing professional accuracy with a beginner-friendly interface was tough. We overcame it by iterating on multiple design mockups and gathering early user feedback.

### WildGuard AI
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/wildguard-ai-f0ac) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/suhanikundu/wildlife-poaching-detection) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](http://54.152.89.61:8501/) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/-MKftCvxH_U) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-SMF%20Smart%20Make--A--Thon-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://smf-smart-makeathon.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> AI-Powered Anti-Poaching System

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![AWS](https://img.shields.io/badge/AWS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Twilio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Twilio-333333?style=flat-square) ![Streamlit](https://img.shields.io/badge/Streamlit-333333?style=flat-square) ![YOLOv8](https://img.shields.io/badge/YOLOv8-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

1. Faster Poacher Detection

Forest authorities can automatically detect poachers in footage, reducing the time spent manually reviewing thousands of images.

2. Efficient Wildlife Tracking

Conservationists can track and archive sightings of endangered species, making research and population studies more efficient.

3. Accurate Record Maintenance

National parks and sanctuaries can maintain wildlife records that support eco-tourism and long-term preservation.

4. Improved Safety

The system flags human presence in restricted zones, helping prevent poaching incidents before they escalate.

5. Cost and Error Reduction

It automates analysis using existing camera trap data, lowering costs and minimizing human error without extra hardware.

**Challenges we ran into**

1. Model Accuracy for Species Detection

One major challenge was ensuring the YOLOv3 model correctly identified both animals and humans in varied forest conditions such as low light or heavy foliage. To overcome this, I experimented with augmenting the training dataset and fine-tuning model parameters to improve detection confidence.

2. Handling Large Volumes of Data

Camera traps generate thousands of images and videos, which made processing slow at first. I optimized the workflow by batching inputs and using GPU acceleration, which significantly reduced analysis time.

3. Limited Training Data for Rare Species

Rare and endangered species had very few labeled examples, leading to poor accuracy. I overcame this by sourcing open datasets from wildlife research communities and applying transfer learning techniques.

4. Dashboard Usability

Initially, the dashboard was difficult for non-technical users to navigate. I redesigned the layout in Streamlit, adding filters and simple visualization options to make it more user-friendly.

5. Future Expansion Constraints

Adding real-time alerts and audio-based detection proved complex with the current setup. For now, I documented a roadmap for incremental integration and designed the system architecture to allow future upgrades without major rework.

**The problem it solves**

UrbanEyes makes urban mobility smoother by combining parking discovery, booking, and AR guidance in one platform.

Drivers can instantly find and reserve nearby parking spots within a fixed radius (default 2 km).

AR navigation (Unity + OpenCV) helps users visually locate parking spots in real-time by overlaying directions onto their camera feed.

OpenCV-powered detection improves safety by identifying empty spaces, obstacles, or wrong parking zones.

Reduces traffic congestion, fuel waste, and random roadside parking, making cities more efficient and safer.

Parking providers can monetize their spaces while users enjoy a seamless, tech-driven experience.

**Challenges we ran into**

Geolocation Filtering: Implementing a consistent 2 km radius filter for both map markers and sidebar listings.

Map APIs & Cost: Google Maps API was too costly, so I switched to Leaflet + OpenStreetMap while keeping accuracy intact.

OpenCV Integration: Getting real-time object detection for parking spaces was challenging. Optimizing YOLO + OpenCV for performance on standard devices required fine-tuning.

AR in Unity: Overlaying AR navigation arrows and markers that stay in sync with real-world coordinates was complex. I used Unity AR Foundation and OpenCV data feed to stabilize visuals.

Authentication & Security: Implementing secure sign-in with Clerk/Auth.js while maintaining a smooth booking flow.

**The problem it solves**

## The Problem Alvora Solves

In cities like Delhi, air pollution is more than just a statistic—it’s something people encounter every day. Smoggy skies, burning eyes, and the constant worry about health risks have unfortunately become a part of daily life for millions. Children, the elderly, and anyone with breathing issues are especially vulnerable. While there are air purifiers on the market, most are either too expensive, too complicated to use, or only work for very small spaces. Many families and communities simply don’t have practical, affordable options to protect themselves from the dangers in the air they breathe.

## How Alvora Makes Life Easier and Safer

Alvora is designed to take the stress and guesswork out of clean air. It’s a smart, algae-based purifier that works for everyone:

- **For Families and Individuals:**  
  Just set up Alvora in your living room, bedroom, or office and it quietly gets to work, filtering out harmful particles and gases. You don’t need to fiddle with complicated settings—Alvora automatically senses and responds to rising pollution, so you can relax knowing you and your loved ones are breathing safer air.

- **For Schools, Hospitals, and Community Spaces:**  
  Alvora is safe and sustainable, making it a great fit for places with children, patients, or the elderly. It helps create healthier environments where people gather, reducing the chances of asthma attacks, allergies, and other health problems linked to poor air quality.

- **For Neighborhoods and Cities:**  
  Local leaders and city planners can deploy multiple Alvora units to tackle pollution hotspots, like busy roads or parks. Its real-time data makes it easy to spot where help is needed most and quickly see the improvement, making the air cleaner for everyone in the community.

- **For Everyday Peace of Mind:**  
  The easy-to-use dashboard lets anyone check air quality and see the purifier’s impact instantly—no technical skills required. Alvora’s efficient, algae-powered system means you get clean air without sky-high electricity bills or harming the planet.

- **Affordable and Accessible:**  
  By using natural algae technology, Alvora is both eco-friendly and cost-effective, so more people can afford to keep their air clean, not just those with big budgets.

**In short, Alvora is about making the promise of clean, healthy air a reality for everyone—at home, at work, and across entire communities. It takes the worry out of pollution and puts control back in your hands, so you can focus on living, not just surviving.**

**Challenges we ran into**

- Integrating multiple visualization libraries (Three.js, Chart.js, Leaflet.js) and managing their interactions on a single page was complex.
-  Achieving smooth real-time simulation and UI responsiveness with large data sets and 3D animations required performance optimizations.
- Handling live API data, geospatial logic, and responsive design together led to several debugging and compatibility challenges.

**The problem it solves**

**AgriSphere** is designed to tackle the major challenges faced by **Indian farmers**, such as unpredictable market prices, lack of localized crop guidance, and limited access to expert advice in their **native languages**. Many farmers struggle with making informed decisions due to fragmented information about weather, soil health, and government schemes. AgriSphere brings together **AI-powered crop prediction** , **real-time market data, and multilingual support** , helping farmers optimize yields, reduce risks, and improve profitability. By bridging the digital divide and making advanced agricultural insights accessible, AgriSphere empowers farmers to thrive in a rapidly changing agricultural landscape.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the **biggest challenges** we faced in developing the crop yield prediction model was finding a proper and **authentic dataset** that truly reflected the agricultural conditions in India. Agricultural data in India is often fragmented, scattered across different sources, and sometimes outdated, which made it difficult to ensure **reliability and consistency**. Even after sourcing the dataset, another major hurdle was guaranteeing the accuracy of the model’s predictions. Since we did not have an already evaluated **benchmark dataset** or the time to create one for validation, measuring the true performance of the model became complex. This lack of ground-truth evaluation data meant we had to rely on **indirect validation methods** and **careful parameter tuning**, while knowing that real-world accuracy could only be tested when deployed and used at scale. These challenges highlighted the importance of both **high-quality data availability** and robust evaluation mechanisms in AI model development, especially in a critical field like agriculture.

**Vultr Cloud Deployment Track**

We set up a multi-instance Vultr architecture. Backend VM (139.84.211.238) runs the Next.js + MongoDB API: Node.js via nvm, PM2 for uptime, repo cloned to /var/www with a production .env (NODE_ENV=production, HOST=0.0.0.0, PORT=4000, DATABASE_URL), built/started, verified with ss/curl. It’s fronted by Nginx on port 80 proxying to 127.0.0.1:4000, with UFW and a Vultr Firewall Group allowing 22/80 (keeping high ports private) and logs managed via PM2/Nginx. The frontend lives on a separate Ubuntu instance at http://65.20.90.250:4000, served by its own Node/Next.js process with the instance firewall permitting 4000 (optionally movable behind Nginx on 80/443). We also deployed two Python apps on dedicated Ubuntu VMs: (1) “A Robotic Playground for Algorithmic Trading Strategies” as a Streamlit app, installed via pip/venv, run behind a systemd service, and exposed through Nginx (reverse proxy on 80/443 to the Streamlit port); and (2) an AI crop yield prediction Flask service, likewise set up with venv + gunicorn, managed by systemd, and reverse-proxied by Nginx, with UFW and Vultr firewall rules limited to SSH and web. Overall, each service is isolated on its own instance, process-managed (PM2 or systemd), reverse-proxied by Nginx for stable public access, and secured with minimal open ports and ready for TLS when domains are assigned.

**Best Use of Gemini API**

# Our Best Use Cases 

## Use Case 1: Farmer Companion – Multi-lingual, Personalized, and Insight-Driven
### Description:
We built a Farmer Companion AI powered by Gemini that can converse with farmers in their local language, adapting dynamically to dialects and communication styles. Beyond just answering queries, the chatbot is personalized using chat history and contextual farmer data (location, soil, weather, crop type, market history). It provides profitability insights, yield optimization tips, and sustainability guidance. For example, if a farmer from Bihar with clay soil asks about rice, the AI gives targeted advice that blends scientific insights with hyper-local conditions.

## Use Case 2: Summarized Market & Policy Data without Web Scraping

### Description:
Instead of building fragile pipelines of web scrapers for government market-price portals, fertilizer cost updates, or policy announcements, we leveraged Gemini to directly consume raw HTML/text from official sources and produce structured summaries in real-time. The AI transforms scattered, unformatted updates into clean tables and concise insights—for example, the latest wheat, rice, and fertilizer prices in a summarized dashboard for the farmer.

**RISE TRACK**

Developing the AI model for crop yield prediction has been a journey of learning, experimentation, and refinement. The process began with understanding the agricultural domain, identifying key factors like crop type, season, rainfall, fertilizer use, pesticide application, and regional conditions that influence yield. Next came the preparation of data—cleaning, transforming, and structuring it so that the model could learn meaningful patterns. LightGBM, a powerful gradient boosting framework, was chosen for its speed and efficiency in handling large datasets with categorical and numerical features. Training involved carefully tuning hyperparameters and running multiple iterations to ensure the model captured both subtle and strong correlations between inputs and yield. The deployment side of development required creating a backend using Flask, which exposed the model as an API, and then bridging local servers to the web using Ngrok for real-time accessibility. This cycle of data preprocessing, model training, evaluation, and deployment not only strengthened the technical foundation but also deepened the understanding of how AI can be practically applied in agriculture to empower farmers with predictive insights.

**Open Innovation**

For the **Open Innovation track**, we are taking a holistic approach by integrating multiple specialized projects into a single unified system. By combining insights and technologies from the **RISE Foundation Track**, **Vultr Cloud Deployment Track**, **Best Use of Gemini API**, and the **Quantitative Finance Track** , we aim to create a platform that leverages the strengths of each domain. The RISE Foundation Track contributes social impact and sustainability insights, Vultr Cloud Deployment ensures scalable and reliable infrastructure, Gemini API integration enables intelligent, real-time data processing, and the Quantitative Finance Track adds analytical rigor and predictive modeling. Together, this convergence allows us to build a **comprehensive, multi-disciplinary** solution that is more than the sum of its parts — a platform that is technically robust, data-driven, and capable of addressing **real-world problems** with innovative approaches.

**Quantitative finance**

**Quant Trading Gym** is a hackathon-ready platform for developing and testing algorithmic trading strategies. It features three pre-built robots— **SMA Crossover, RSI Mean Reversion, and Market Mood pairs trading** —along with an interactive Streamlit dashboard for real-time performance metrics, visualizations, and customizable parameters. Users can backtest multiple assets, analyze **Sharpe ratios, drawdowns, and returns, and fine-tune** strategies with ease. Built for both CLI and web use, it’s a complete playground to experiment, optimize, and discover winning trading strategies.

> Smart Banking Spoken Simply

![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Express.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Express.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![OpenAi](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenAi-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

🏦 **VaniSetu – What Problem Does It Solve?**

**👤 From the User’s Perspective**
For millions of Indians, accessing banking services feels like trying to solve a crossword puzzle in the wrong language. VaniSetu smooths that out by:

- Speaking their language → Customers can talk to the bank in 11+ Indian languages, not just English or Hindi.
- Simplifying decisions → AI recommends the right financial product instead of forcing customers to navigate confusing brochures.
- Saving time → Instead of visiting branches or waiting in queues, users get answers and guidance over a simple phone call.
- Building trust → Real-time explanations in culturally familiar terms help users feel safe about financial choices.
- Ensuring inclusion → Even those with limited literacy or digital skills can access banking services confidently.

**👉 Basically: no more “bank is too complicated” excuses — the system bends to the customer, not the other way around.**

**🕴️ From the Banking Executive’s Perspective**

For banks, customer outreach usually means wasted calls, low conversion rates, and customers dropping off. VaniSetu makes life easier by:

- Precision targeting → Fewer dead-end calls with AI-driven suitability matching.
- Multilingual reach → Tap into underserved rural and semi-urban markets without hiring massive call center armies.
- Data-driven insights → Real-time analytics on conversations, sentiment, and conversion outcomes.
- Lower operational costs → Automated voice agents reduce dependence on large sales teams.
- Regulatory confidence → AI trained with RBI-compliant product documents ensures consistent, correct information is shared.
- Stronger relationships → Automated follow-ups and personalized recommendations make retention cheaper and easier.

**👉 In short: executives get a scalable, cost-effective, trust-building machine instead of a call center headache.**

**Challenges we ran into**

**🐞 Challenges We Faced & How We Overcame Them**
**1. Multilingual Voice Accuracy**
- The Problem: Our AI voice agent initially struggled with Indian accents and dialect variations. Words in Bengali or Tamil, for example, were often mis-transcribed or mispronounced.
- The Fix: We switched to Sarvam AI’s Saarika STT & Bulbul TTS, which are trained on Indian languages, and layered a post-processing correction pipeline for common misinterpretations. This boosted accuracy significantly.

**2. PDF Knowledge Base Embedding**

- The Problem: When embedding banking product PDFs, large documents often got truncated or lost context, leading to incomplete recommendations.
- The Fix: We implemented intelligent chunking (2000-character chunks with 200-character overlap) before embedding, ensuring the model always had enough context without overwhelming it.

**3. Real-Time Conversation Latency**

- The Problem: During live calls, there was a noticeable delay between customer speech and AI response, making the system feel robotic.
- The Fix: We optimised the pipeline with Voice Activity Detection (VAD) and streaming responses from GPT, so the AI starts responding as soon as it understands intent — not after the full sentence.

**4. Telephony Integration Complexity**

- The Problem: Connecting LiveKit WebRTC with Twilio SIP trunking was messy, causing dropped calls.
- The Fix: We debugged SIP headers, standardised codecs, and configured LiveKit’s trunking bridge properly. Stable PSTN calls finally worked.

**💡 In short, every “this will be easy” moment came back to bite us — but solving these hurdles made VaniSetu way more reliable in real-world use.**

Key Uses and Benefits

Save jobs securely to revisit later — no risk of losing track of interesting roles.

Keep track of applied positions with AI reminders and notifications for upcoming deadlines or status updates.

Reduces repetitive manual form-filling by auto-filling information stored in the AI Career Craft profile.

Insightful Job Details

Users can explore job descriptions, required skills, company info, and applicant counts in a clean, modal view.

Helps candidates assess roles quickly and make informed decisions.

It has also an integrated coding platform CodeQuest . 
It has also an integrated chat and voice Assistance for Interview Coaching.

Enhanced User Experience

Dark, professional UI ensures comfortable viewing for long sessions.

Minimalist, intuitive design reduces cognitive load and allows users to focus on job opportunities, not confusing interfaces.

Time-Saving Automation

Filtering and sorting eliminate irrelevant jobs, reducing wasted time.

Smart search ensures users find the best-fit roles faster than manually browsing multiple websites.

Secure and Reliable

Saved jobs and application history are stored locally or securely, preventing accidental data loss.

Users can confidently track career progress without exposing sensitive information publicly.

**Challenges we ran into**

While building the Job Portal feature, I ran into a hurdle with the “Save Job” and “Easy Apply” functionality. The saved jobs were not persisting after page reload, and multiple users applying to the same job caused data conflicts. Additionally, triggering toast notifications reliably for user actions without overlapping or disappearing too soon was tricky.

Why It Happened:

Initially, I was storing saved jobs in local component state only (useState).

There was no persistent storage (localStorage or backend DB) connected to track individual users.

Toast notifications were firing asynchronously, causing race conditions when multiple actions occurred quickly.

Solution:

Persistent Storage:

I switched to storing saved jobs in localStorage for frontend persistence.

For logged-in users, I also integrated a backend MongoDB collection to save jobs per user with JWT-based authentication.
Reliable Toast Notifications:

I used react-toastify with proper unique IDs for each action to avoid duplicate or flickering messages.

Added auto-close timers and type-based styling (success, info, warning) to improve user feedback.

Easy Apply Handling:

Created a centralized application handler in the backend to prevent conflicts for multiple submissions.

Connected it with the frontend so users get a real-time confirmation after applying.

**Vultr Cloud Deployment Track**

Help me , to initialise virtual servers VPS and Helps me to do Object storage

**The problem it solves**

Investezy is an AI-powered investment platform that makes stock and mutual fund investing accessible and safer, especially for beginners. Users can take a personalized risk assessment quiz to get tailored stock recommendations and see exactly how to allocate their budget across different risk categories. The platform features advanced LSTM neural networks for stock price predictions, comprehensive mutual fund analysis with SIP calculators, and portfolio management tools that provide AI-driven insights on performance and diversification. What makes it particularly valuable is its beginner-friendly approach - complex financial metrics are explained in simple terms with visual charts and emoji-rich guidance, while still providing professional-grade analysis. The platform combines real-time market data with personalized recommendations, ensuring users only see investments that match their risk tolerance and financial goals. By offering everything from educational content to advanced portfolio predictions in one place, Investezy eliminates the intimidation factor of investing while providing the safety guardrails and data-driven insights needed to make informed financial decisions. It's essentially like having a personal AI investment advisor that grows with users from their first stock purchase to building diversified portfolios.

**Challenges we ran into**

LSTM Model Training Complexity
•  Challenge: Training neural networks requires massive amounts of clean data
•  Solution: You built a sophisticated data pipeline that downloads from 20+ Indian stocks and combines them into a unified training dataset

Frontend-Backend Integration  
•  Challenge: Managing real-time data flow between React and Flask
•  Solution: Implemented comprehensive error boundaries and loading states for every API call

Cross-Origin Issues (CORS)
•  Challenge: Browser blocking API calls between frontend and backend
•  Solution: CORS(app) with proper configuration for all domains

The rate limiting issue was clearly your biggest "burger hurdle" - you spent significant effort building resilient systems that could handle API failures gracefully while still providing users with valuable predictions and insights. Your solution shows excellent engineering maturity by prioritizing user experience over perfect data availability.

**Open Innovation**

Investezy democratizes investment knowledge through AI-powered tools that make complex financial decisions accessible to everyone. Our platform transforms how users compare, analyze, and invest by providing smartphone-like comparison interfaces for stocks and mutual funds, unified dashboards connecting multiple brokers (Zerodha, Angel One, MF Central), and AI-driven recommendations. This open innovation approach breaks down traditional barriers in financial services, making sophisticated investment analysis available to all users regardless of their financial expertise.

**The problem it solves**

## The Problem It Solves

Healthcare in India often faces challenges like **limited access**, **fragmented resources**, and **lack of awareness** about available facilities.  
Patients struggle with:

- Finding reliable **doctors, hospitals, and pharmacies** nearby  
- Managing and **booking consultations** without long queues  
- Storing and accessing **medical reports** (MRI, blood tests, prescriptions) securely  
- Connecting with **others who share similar health conditions** for support  
- Getting **instant answers** to common medical queries  

**Med Mentor** makes these tasks easier, safer, and faster by:  

- Offering a **live healthcare map** to locate facilities across India  
- Providing **AI-powered consultation** through MediBot  
- Creating a secure **MediVault** for all past reports and consultation history  
- Enabling **one-click booking** for consultations with verified doctors  
- Building **health communities** for peer support and awareness  

In short, **Med Mentor** acts as a **trusted companion** that bridges the gap between patients and healthcare services, ensuring **accessible, reliable, and organized healthcare for everyone**.

**Challenges we ran into**

## Challenges I Ran Into

During the development of Med Mentor, I encountered several hurdles:  

- **Integrating AI-powered consultation**: Connecting the MediBot AI with the frontend while ensuring real-time responses was challenging. I resolved this by thoroughly studying API documentation, implementing proper asynchronous calls, and handling edge cases with fallback responses.  

- **Managing secure medical data**: Storing and retrieving sensitive medical reports required robust security. I overcame this by implementing encrypted storage and secure authentication protocols.  

- **Booking system conflicts**: Handling simultaneous booking requests without causing overlaps or errors was tricky. I solved this by implementing a transaction-based approach and adding proper validation on both client and server sides.  

- **Ensuring cross-platform consistency**: Making the UI responsive across devices needed careful testing. I addressed this by using flexible layouts, CSS media queries, and thorough testing on multiple screen sizes.  

- **Thinking of innovative features**: Deciding what unique functionalities to add without making the app too complex was a major hurdle. I overcame this by researching existing healthcare apps, brainstorming with peers, and prioritizing features that directly solve user problems.  

Each of these challenges taught me valuable lessons in **scalable architecture, secure data handling, and user-centric design**, ultimately making Med Mentor more reliable and user-friendly.

**The problem it solves**

CareQueue addresses core challenges faced by both patients and clinics during the walk-in healthcare experience 
Unpredictable wait times → Patients have no real-time visibility into queues.
Poor communication → Clinics rely on manual logs, phone calls, or outdated methods.
No centralised discovery → Hard for patients to know which clinics are open/available.
Staff overload → Receptionists handle endless calls and manual check-ins, reducing efficiency.

How People Can Use CareQueue & What It Makes Easier

For Patients:

Find Clinics Fast: View nearby trusted clinics on a map, see current status and wait times.
Check Queue Instantly: Access real-time queue lengths, estimated waits, and book slots.
Easy, Private Check-In: Reserve your place or check in anonymously via mobile/web.
Stay Informed: Receive direct messages, “your turn” alerts, and chat with staff.
Use in Any Language: Accessible multi-language interface.

For Clinics/Admins:

Manage Queues Digitally: Simplify check-ins, queue updates, and prioritize urgent cases.
Reduce Phone Load: Live dashboards replace constant phone queries.
Broadcast & Triage: Send bulk delay alerts and tag priorities easily.
Streamline Communication: Reply to patient queries and update statuses quickly.
Gain Insights: Analyze peak times and workflow data for better efficiency.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

1. Daily Financial Management Made Effortless

No need to manually track expenses or budgets — FINORA syncs with bank accounts, ERPs, and payment gateways to keep everything up to date automatically.

Smart alerts tell you only when something important or unusual happens, saving time and mental load.

2. Smarter, Safer Decision-Making

AI forecasts help you see financial problems months ahead so you can act before they happen.

“What-if” simulations let you test expansion plans, hiring, or big purchases without risking real money.

3. Automated Cost Savings

Detects overspending patterns and pauses wasteful expenses before they snowball.

Negotiates with vendors for better rates — you get the savings without awkward phone calls.

**Challenges we ran into**

1. Real-Time Data Integration Bottleneck

Problem: When connecting multiple banking APIs, ERP systems, and payment gateways, data refresh lagged by 20–30 seconds, breaking the “real-time” experience.

Solution: Implemented asynchronous API calls with batch processing queues, reducing refresh time to under 3 seconds.

2. Forecast Accuracy vs. Data Gaps

Problem: The AI model initially made poor predictions because many SMEs had incomplete financial histories.

Solution: Created a data enrichment pipeline that pulled in public market data, industry benchmarks, and seasonal trends to fill the gaps — boosting accuracy from 68% to 93%.

3. AR Dashboard Performance

Problem: AR visualizations lagged on low-end devices, making the interface feel slow.

Solution: Switched from heavy 3D rendering to lightweight vector-based rendering and lazy-loading of non-critical elements, improving FPS by 40%.

### Depth Wizard
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/depth-wizard-2c84) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/itsgadhithya/DepthWizard/tree/feature/api-service) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/yTQTWSkobcw) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/yTQTWSkobcw) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackVerse:%20Into%20the%20Web-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackverse-into-the-web.devfolio.co)

> From 2D Images to Real-World 3D Understanding.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Traditional imagery tells us **what a scene looks like**, but not its actual depth, elevation, or 3D structure. Accurate 3D reconstruction often depends on specialized technologies such as **LiDAR, stereo imagery, or multiple overlapping images**, which can be expensive or difficult to obtain.

**DepthWizard aims to bridge this gap** by using AI-based monocular depth estimation and geospatial calibration to transform a **single 2D image into meaningful, metric-scale 3D information** — enabling visualization, terrain analysis, and interactive 3D exploration.

**Challenges we ran into**

Building DepthWizard involved several key technical challenges:

- **Reliable Depth Estimation** — Extracting useful depth information from a single 2D image.
- **Relative → Real-World Scale** — AI depth maps are generally relative, so converting them into meaningful metric measurements required calibration.
- **3D Reconstruction** — Converting depth information into a usable surface/terrain representation while preserving important details.
- **Image Variations** — Handling differences in perspective, resolution, lighting, and scene characteristics.
- **Validation** — Finding practical ways to evaluate whether the reconstructed depth and terrain accurately represent the real scene.
- **Visualization** — Turning the reconstructed data into an intuitive and interactive **3D flythrough experience**.

Team **Y-Axis** -- Adhithya Gurunathan, Gowtham Satish, Ahil Niranjjen, abbhijith Vinodh, Advait S

### VeriAadhar
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/infolog-1a30) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/sarthak180506/InfoLog.git) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://vimeo.com/1223198438?share=copy&fl=sv&fe=ci) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackVerse:%20Into%20the%20Web-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackverse-into-the-web.devfolio.co)

> Verify Smarter. Trust Faster.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

VeriAadhar is an AI-assisted document verification platform that makes identity-document checking faster, safer, and more consistent. Users can upload an Aadhaar document and automatically analyze its structure, extract information using multilingual OCR, read QR-code data, and compare the information from different sources.
It can be useful for KYC, onboarding, fintech, banking, government services, education, employment, and other workflows where identity documents need to be checked.

**Challenges we ran into**

**OpenCV installation failure on Windows**: pip install opencv-python initially failed with “No matching distribution found.” We diagnosed the Python/pip environment and found that the virtual environment was using a MinGW-based Python interpreter, which was incompatible with the available OpenCV wheel. We recreated/used the correct 64-bit CPython 3.12 environment, after which OpenCV installed successfully.
**QR detection vs verification**: Detecting a QR code, decoding it, and cryptographically verifying it are three different operations. We separated these states so that the system does not incorrectly claim that a QR code is authentic simply because it was detected or decoded.
**Processing-time concerns**: Running OCR repeatedly on many preprocessing variants can significantly increase processing time. We limited the design to a small number of preprocessing variants so the prototype remains responsive enough for a live hackathon demonstration.
