### smartEdu
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/smartedu-0410) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/sadhana62/SmartEdu) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-hackCBS%208.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackcbs-8.devfolio.co)

> AI Powered Presence For the Modern Classroom

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The core problem we are solving with SmartEdu is the inefficient, time-consuming, and error-prone nature of manual processes in educational institutions. This problem manifests in two key ways:

Student Attendance: Traditional methods like verbal roll calls or paper sign-in sheets detract from valuable instruction time, disrupt class flow, and are susceptible to inaccuracies.

Resource Management: The lack of real-time data makes it difficult to manage unexpected teacher absences. This often results in unproductive "free periods" where student time is wasted because the administration isn't alerted quickly enough to assign a substitute teacher or distribute alternative work.

While automated solutions like facial recognition can solve the efficiency problem, they introduce a critical third challenge: the severe privacy and security risks of storing sensitive biometric data. Our project tackles all three of these issues. We are building an AI-powered system that automates attendance instantly, providing the real-time data admins need to manage class time effectively. Crucially, we do this with a security-first architecture, fully encrypting all facial embeddings to ensure our solution is not only efficient but also secure and trustworthy.

**Challenges we ran into**

Beyond the core problems we were solving for the user, the development process itself presented significant technical hurdles.

The first major challenge was selecting and integrating a reliable facial recognition model. Our initial attempts were problematic: the first model we tested was unreliable and prone to "ghost detections" (detecting faces where there were none). We then explored cloud-based solutions like Azure's facial recognition API but ran into persistent permission and configuration issues that blocked our progress. Next, we attempted to use the popular face_recognition library, only to discover it had strict dependency requirements that would have forced us to downgrade our entire Python environment. After this difficult iterative process, we finally settled on the deepface library, which provided the stability and accuracy we required.

The second significant challenge was managing collaborative development using Git. While working on the project simultaneously, we encountered unpredictable behavior with git stash, which corrupted our local working tree. This version control issue was severe enough that it forced us on two separate occasions to completely delete our local project folders and re-clone the entire repository, leading to lost time and development friction.

Team **No Sleep 'til Deployed** -- [Sadhana Shrivastava](https://github.com/sadhana62), [Raj Aryan](https://github.com/rajaryn)

### GhostCoder
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/ghostcoder-b2a9) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/ayushmanlakshkar/GhostCoder) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://ghost-coder-5401d9c0.base44.app) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/pKVvVeuGttc) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-hackCBS%208.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackcbs-8.devfolio.co)

> Smart AI reviewer with auto PRs

![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Git](https://img.shields.io/badge/Git-333333?style=flat-square) ![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-333333?style=flat-square) ![babel](https://img.shields.io/badge/babel-333333?style=flat-square) ![Regex](https://img.shields.io/badge/Regex-333333?style=flat-square) ![axios](https://img.shields.io/badge/axios-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Developers spend enormous time reviewing code, spotting bugs, and maintaining consistency across large repositories. Traditional linters or static analyzers only catch surface-level issues, while human code reviews are slow, subjective, and hard to scale — especially across fast-moving teams or large monorepos.

**GhostCoder** solves this by introducing a fully autonomous, AI-driven review system that understands your *entire codebase semantically*. Using **embeddings**, **symbol graphs**, and **context-aware reasoning**, it detects logical flaws, anti-patterns, performance issues, and security risks — not just syntax errors.

It can automatically suggest fixes or even create **Pull Requests** with improved code, drastically reducing review time and technical debt.

---

### ⚙️ How It Helps

* 🔍 **Smarter Reviews:** Goes beyond linting — understands intent, structure, and dependencies.
* ⚡ **Faster Iteration:** Auto-generates code improvements and PRs, freeing developers for real problem-solving.
* 🧠 **Context-Aware Analysis:** Uses semantic embeddings to reason across multiple files, not just the one being edited.
* 🔒 **Safer Codebase:** Detects vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and inconsistent logic early.
* 🤖 **Continuous Learning:** Adapts to your project’s coding style and standards over time.

GhostCoder turns code review into a continuous, intelligent, and autonomous process — ensuring cleaner, safer, and more maintainable code at scale.

**Challenges we ran into**

A major challenge was handling **multi-file context** during semantic search. While analyzing large repositories, the AI often missed cross-file references or lost context about how functions interacted across modules. For example, if a function was imported and used elsewhere, the model wouldn’t always connect the two, leading to incomplete or inaccurate analysis.

Another issue came from **regex-based context extraction**. I initially relied on regex to match function and class definitions for embedding generation, but it broke easily with complex syntax or nested structures. Minor differences in formatting or indentation caused the regex to fail, making the indexing inconsistent.

I overcame this by restructuring the parsing process — cleaning code before embedding and simplifying how files were fed into the model. Instead of forcing regex-based extraction, I focused on smaller, well-defined chunks per file and improved how embeddings were cached and retrieved. This made the semantic understanding more stable and reliable, even without perfect multi-file awareness.

**Build Your Business with AI - Using Studio & Base44**

### 💡 How I Used Base44 in the Frontend

I used **Base44** as the core engine to **generate the entire frontend directly from a prompt**. Instead of manually designing or coding UI components, Base44 takes a natural language description and builds the full frontend structure — including layout, styles, and interactions.

Basically, I just define *what* the interface should do or look like through a prompt, and Base44 handles the *how* — generating the complete UI automatically. This made development insanely fast, letting me focus on the backend logic and AI systems while Base44 handled the visual and structural side of the app.

So in short — the frontend isn’t hand-coded; it’s **created by Base44 from a prompt**, making it a fully AI-generated interface.

**Best Use of Qapi**

tried using QAPI as it’s a great tool for testing all APIs at once and accelerating backend development. It allows you to simulate, organize, and validate multiple endpoints efficiently during iteration. However, I ran into localhost configuration issues that prevented it from running properly — the tool couldn’t connect to my local server environment. Despite that, I found QAPI’s interface and parallel testing capabilities really useful for improving the overall development and debugging workflow.

> Farming made Wise with Farmwise

![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![Express.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Express.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Redis](https://img.shields.io/badge/Redis-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

## 🌾 The Problem It Solves

Indian farmers face a simple but serious challenge  they have access to information, but not **guidance**.
Weather forecasts, crop care advice, and subsidy details exist, but they’re scattered across multiple government portals, English-heavy websites, and apps that are hard to use.

FarmWise bridges this gap by acting as a **digital farming companion** that listens, understands, and helps all in the farmer’s own language.

### 🚜 What People Can Use It For

**Daily Activity Logging**
Farmers can simply speak or type what they did today  like *“Aaj wheat field mein irrigation kiya”* and FarmWise logs it automatically, building a complete digital farm diary.

**Personalized Farming Advice**
Farmers get context-aware guidance based on their land, crop type, soil, and local weather.
For example, based on the weather forecast it will suggest the farmers *“Kal baarish aane wali hai, fertilizer kal subah daaliye for best absorption.”*

**Government Schemes & Subsidies**
No more confusion. FarmWise finds all the schemes a farmer is eligible for, explains them in local language or voice, and even helps track applications.

**Market Prices & Sales Planning**
Farmers can check real-time mandi prices, identify good selling opportunities, and make data-backed decisions to maximize profits.

**Timely Alerts & Reminders**
Whether it’s pest risks, irrigation windows, or subsidy deadlines, FarmWise sends smart alerts so farmers never miss important actions.

### 🌱 How It Makes Life Easier

FarmWise **simplifies everything** from farming decisions to subsidy access.
It saves time, removes guesswork, and helps farmers act smarter using the power of AI.
With support for multiple Indian languages and offline access, even farmers in the most remote areas can use it effortlessly.

**In short:** FarmWise turns technology into a trusted, everyday partner for farmers, helping them grow better, earn better, and live better.

**Challenges we ran into**

## ⚙️ Challenges I Ran Into

While building FarmWise, we faced a few challenges that really tested our problem-solving and teamwork.

### 🔔 Setting Up Real-Time Notifications

We wanted farmers to get instant alerts like weather changes, irrigation reminders, or scheme deadlines but syncing all of that in real time was tricky.
Different APIs updated at different times, and background jobs sometimes got delayed.

**How we solved it:**
We used **Inngest** to handle background event triggers and queue systems efficiently.
This helped us schedule notifications and reminders in near real-time without slowing the app down.

---

### 🏛 Fetching Government Schemes in a Usable Format

One of the hardest parts was structuring government scheme data.
The data from portals like *myScheme.gov.in* wasn’t in a clean, API-friendly format everything came as HTML or PDFs with inconsistent fields.

**How we solved it:**
We built a **custom data parser** that extracts key details  eligibility, benefits, deadlines and then feeds it into our database in a structured way.
We also plan to connect directly with official APIs once they’re public, to make the process smoother and scalable.

---

### 🗄 Handling Database Migrations

As we kept adding new features like activity logs and scheme data, our database schema kept changing and that led to a few broken tables and mismatched columns.

**How we solved it:**
We decided to move to Drizzle ORM, which makes versioned migrations much cleaner and rollback-safe.
It helped us maintain consistency across the dev and production databases and avoid accidental data loss.

---

### 🗣 Building a Multilingual Voice Interface

Making the app truly “farmer-first” meant supporting multiple Indian languages and natural voice commands.
But integrating voice recognition with context understanding was harder than expected.

**How we solved it:**
We integrated **LiveKit AI Voice Agent** with our **LangChain** pipeline so the system can not only transcribe voice but also *understand intent* whether the farmer is logging an activity, asking for a scheme, or checking prices.
It made the overall experience much smoother and more human.

---


### 🌦 Integrating Different APIs

We faced a real challenge while connecting multiple external data sources like weather updates, market prices, and government scheme data.
Each API had its own structure, refresh timing, and reliability issues, which made it tough to sync everything smoothly in real time.

**How we solved it:**
Instead of forcing everything into one big service, we built **separate AI agents** each handling a specific data type (weather, market, schemes, etc.).
These agents activate automatically based on the farmer’s voice prompt, and the main AI can switch between them dynamically to fetch the right data when needed.

This modular approach not only made integration easier but also made the system more reliable so even if one service lags, the others still run seamlessly in the background.

---

### 💬 In Short

Every challenge we hit from handling messy government data to syncing real-time alerts taught us how to design for **simplicity at the surface and intelligence underneath**.
Now, FarmWise doesn’t just “work”; it actually **feels reliable** for the farmer who uses it.

### GetHired
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/gethired-6e4c) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/JUGADU-GEEKS/GetHired) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/BwhjGsxLvr0) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-hackCBS%208.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackcbs-8.devfolio.co)

> Your AI Partner to Ace Every Interview.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![gemini](https://img.shields.io/badge/gemini-333333?style=flat-square) ![openrouter](https://img.shields.io/badge/openrouter-333333?style=flat-square) ![LLAMA3.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/LLAMA3.0-333333?style=flat-square) ![Groq.ai](https://img.shields.io/badge/Groq.ai-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**The Problem It Solves**

- Interview preparation is stressful and inconsistent for most job seekers.
- Existing mock interview platforms use static question sets that don’t adapt to a candidate’s resume or target job.
- Candidates rarely get personalized feedback on how they communicate, behave, or present themselves.
- Soft skills such as confidence, facial expressions, and engagement are not evaluated in most existing tools.
- As a result, many candidates enter real interviews unprepared and unaware of their weaknesses.

**How GetHired Helps**

- Resume and Job Description Analysis: Users upload their resume and job description. The system automatically tailors interview questions based on their experience and required skills.
- Dynamic Questioning: Each question is generated in real time using AI. The next question adapts based on the user’s previous answer — just like a real interviewer.
- Cross-Verification: The platform detects inconsistencies between a candidate’s answers and their resume or job description, prompting clarification.
- Voice and Video Interview Simulation: Users can practice both phone and video interviews. The experience is fully interactive and human-like.
- Expression and Gesture Detection: The system observes facial expressions, gestures, and posture during the interview. It measures confidence, focus, and engagement levels to include in the final feedback.
- Distraction Detection: The AI can detect background movement, presence of other people, or phone usage. After three warnings, the session is disqualified for fairness and realism.
- Performance Summary: At the end of the mock interview, users receive a report summarizing their performance — covering accuracy, confidence, communication, and professionalism.

**Future Expansion: Learning Management System (LMS)**

- Integrated Learning Paths: Candidates will receive curated lessons and exercises based on their weak areas identified during mock interviews.
- Skill-Based Courses: Short interactive modules on communication, technical skills, and behavioral questions.
- Progress Tracking: A dashboard to track performance over multiple interviews and view improvement trends.
- Personalized Feedback Loop: Continuous learning through recommendations and quizzes tailored to each candidate’s skill level.
- 

**Why It Matters**

- Brings real-world interview simulation to anyone, anywhere.
- Provides honest, actionable feedback — not just scores.
- Helps users grow from every session by combining practice + learning.
- Builds confidence and readiness for real interviews in a structured, data-driven way.

**Challenges we ran into**

While building GetHired, our team faced a few challenges that shaped the direction of the project and helped us understand its real potential.

**1. API and Model Access**
We initially faced issues with selecting a suitable AI model for dynamic question generation.
OpenAI and Hugging Face had pricing and access limitations, so we moved to Groq, which offered faster responses and better flexibility.
Configuring the API keys and ensuring smooth backend integration took several iterations, but we managed to stabilize it.

**2. Frontend–Backend Integration**
During development, we encountered CORS and access errors while connecting our React frontend with the Node.js backend.
We fixed this by adjusting the CORS settings to allow all origins during testing, ensuring smooth data flow.

**3. Identifying the USP**
One of the toughest parts was defining what truly makes GetHired stand out.
Initially, the idea felt similar to existing mock interview tools, but after brainstorming, we identified our USP:
real-time expression and gesture detection, resume-based dynamic questioning, and the plan to integrate an LMS for continuous skill improvement.

**4. Time Constraints**
With limited hackathon time, we had to focus on getting the core system working end-to-end — dynamic interviews, resume verification, and basic expression analysis — leaving advanced features like the LMS for future development.

Overcoming these challenges helped us build a clearer vision of GetHired’s strengths and how it can genuinely make interview preparation smarter and more interactive.

Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning workloads require massive computational power, especially GPUs. > Smart Emergency Access, Simplified

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Figma](https://img.shields.io/badge/Figma-333333?style=flat-square) ![Adobe Photoshop](https://img.shields.io/badge/Adobe%20Photoshop-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

In critical medical emergencies, every second matters yet most patients and ambulances lose 15–30 minutes just searching for an available hospital.
There’s no unified system that shows real-time bed, ICU, or ventilator availability. This often leads to:

🚑 Ambulances being redirected multiple times, wasting crucial minutes.

📞 Families calling hospitals manually to check for space or doctors.

🏥 Hospitals working in isolation, without transparent data exchange.

MRGENSEE solves this by building a real-time emergency coordination platform that connects patients, hospitals, and responders.
It provides live hospital availability, smart routing to the nearest ready facility, and automated data dashboards for hospitals.

The result is faster treatment, fewer redirections, and a life-saving reduction in response time from 25 minutes to under 5 minutes.

**Challenges we ran into**

we planned on integrating automatic document verification, but that was found to be a little out of scope for us, rest went smoothly but without sleep

**Best Use of MongoDB Atlas**

Our project MRGENSEE uses MongoDB Atlas as the core of our real-time hospital data infrastructure.
We leverage Atlas for:
Geo-spatial queries to find the nearest available hospitals within a user’s location radius, enabling smart emergency routing.
Dynamic schema design for flexible hospital records, allowing live updates on ICU, ER, and ventilator bed availability.
Atlas Search & indexing to quickly filter verified hospitals based on city, services, or bed types.

We are createing a system to detect and monitor the spread of fake news, hate speech, or malicious content.

### FastAPI-Stock-Sentiment
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/fastapistocksentiment-1677) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/mohit7soni/FastAPI-Stock-Sentiment/tree/main) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/2buhF6loRlU) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Hack4Safety-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hack4safety.devfolio.co)

> MarketVibe: Beyond the chart, into the news.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![FastAPI](https://img.shields.io/badge/FastAPI-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The Consequence of This Disconnect: Because these two data streams are separate, traders must constantly switch between platforms (e.g., a charting tool and a news website). This process is:

Inefficient: It wastes valuable time.

Biased: A trader is prone to personal bias, giving too much weight to one or two articles they happen to read.

Incomplete: They may miss crucial articles that are driving the market's mood.

The Solution Your Project Provides:

This tool solves the problem of information overload by using NLP (TextBlob) to automatically read and analyze hundreds of articles in seconds.

It solves the data disconnect by integrating the final, unbiased sentiment score ("Positive," "Negative," or "Neutral") directly onto the same screen as the live TradingView price chart.

It delivers a single, easy-to-understand dashboard so a trader can instantly see both the price action and the sentiment driving it, leading to faster and more informed decisions.

**Challenges we ran into**

uring this project, a primary challenge was likely the backend-to-frontend integration, specifically solving the infamous CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) errors. These errors would have blocked your JavaScript frontend from communicating with your FastAPI backend. Another difficulty was integrating two different third-party APIs; you had to dynamically update the TradingView widget with the user's symbol (which isn't its default behavior) while also managing the API rate limits and data structure from the News API. Finally, you probably hit a limitation with TextBlob, which is a general-purpose NLP tool not trained on financial language. It can easily misinterpret a headline like "stock plummets to an all-time low," failing to see the strong negative sentiment because it doesn't understand the financial jargon.

How I Overcame It

I made sure every idea tied back to the main goal of creating relatable, audience-driven content, ensuring the final result aligned as closely as possible with the team’s intent.

### Sync Service
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/sync-service-51aa) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/sirdesai22/sync-service) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Devfolio%20Tryouts-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://tryouts.devfolio.co)

> Postgres–Elasticsearch Sync Made Simple.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![Golang](https://img.shields.io/badge/Golang-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Elastic Search](https://img.shields.io/badge/Elastic%20Search-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Modern platforms often use PostgreSQL as their primary database for reliability and relational integrity, but rely on Elasticsearch for fast search and filtering.
The challenge arises when data changes in Postgres (new users, project updates, deletions, etc.) these changes must be quickly and accurately reflected in Elasticsearch to keep search results up to date.

**Without a proper sync mechanism, systems face:**
- Out-of-sync data between Postgres and Elasticsearch.
- Search inconsistency stale or missing search results.
- Manual reindexing after failures or downtime.
- Lack of visibility into sync health or failed events.
- Data loss when Elasticsearch is unavailable.

**🚀 How the Sync Service Solves It**
- Automatically captures Postgres changes via the Outbox pattern.
- Asynchronously syncs those changes to Elasticsearch in near real-time.
- Handles failures gracefully failed syncs are stored in a Dead Letter Queue (DLQ).
- Provides a dashboard for visibility, retries, and debugging.
- Ensures consistency between your relational and search layers always in sync, even after failures.

**Challenges we ran into**

**⚙️ Challenges I Ran Into**

**🧠 Learning Go (Golang):**
Being a beginner at Golang (rating myself 5/10) and taking the gamble to build it completely in Golang itself was pretty challenging in itself.

🔄 Ensuring Reliable Sync Between Postgres and Elasticsearch:
Early on, Elasticsearch updates were missed or duplicated due to incorrect handling of outbox events. I solved this by implementing the Outbox Pattern and using a persistent BulkIndexer to guarantee event delivery.

💀 DLQ Not Populating:
The Dead Letter Queue stayed empty even when failures occurred. After deep debugging, I discovered that the OnFailure callback wasn’t executing because the BulkIndexer was being closed too early, fixing this taught me a lot about Go’s asynchronous behavior.

🧩 Handling Elasticsearch Downtime:
Sync failures during ES downtime caused data loss at first. I added a retry worker that reprocesses failed DLQ events once ES is back online, ensuring eventual consistency.

**The problem it solves**

# 🔬 SkinAlyze - AI-Powered Skin Disease Diagnosis & Progress Tracking

## The Problem It Solves

### 🩺 Current Healthcare Challenges

**1. Access Gap**
- Dermatologists are **scarce**: Only ~1 dermatologist per 100,000 people in developing countries
- Rural areas often have **zero specialist access**
- Consultation waiting times: 3-6 months in many regions
- High consultation costs make diagnosis inaccessible to lower-income populations

**2. Delayed Diagnosis**
- Skin conditions worsen when **untreated** for extended periods
- Early diagnosis can prevent complications (infection, scarring, psychological impact)
- Self-diagnosis often leads to **incorrect treatments**

**3. Inconsistent Treatment Tracking**
- Patients struggle to monitor progress without regular consultations
- No standardized way to track **severity changes over time**
- Dermatologists lack **historical visual records** for objective assessment
- Treatment adjustments happen at appointments, not in real-time

**4. Cost & Time Burden**
- Multiple specialist visits required
- Travel time and costs accumulate
- Lost productivity for patients seeking diagnosis

---

## How SkinAlyze Solves These Problems

### ✅ **Instant Accessible Diagnosis**
- **AI-powered screening** in minutes, accessible from home via smartphone
- Available **24/7** without appointment delays
- Supports multiple skin tones (diverse training data)
- Works on any device with a camera

### ✅ **Evidence-Based Treatment Planning**
- Provides **differential diagnosis** (top 3 possible conditions)
- Explains **treatment options** for each condition
- Enables **early intervention** before complications arise
- Gives patients knowledge to make informed decisions with their dermatologist

### ✅ **Objective Progress Tracking**
- **Visual timeline** of condition severity over time
- Confidence scores help doctors adjust treatment plans
- Patients can **self-monitor** at home between appointments
- Data-driven insights reveal which treatments work best

### ✅ **Reduced Healthcare Burden**
- Filters **low-risk cases** (reassurance without specialist visit)
- Flags **high-risk cases** for urgent referral
- Reduces unnecessary specialist appointments
- Enables telemedicine consultations with visual history

---

## Real-World Use Cases

### 👨‍⚕️ **For Dermatologists & Clinics**
- **Streamlined Triage**: AI screens patients before appointments, prioritizing severe cases
- **Better Documentation**: Visual records track condition changes objectively
- **Remote Consultations**: Patients can upload images between visits for progress updates
- **Resource Optimization**: Clinic time focused on complex cases, not basic screening
- **Decision Support**: AI provides second opinion, reducing diagnostic errors

### 🏥 **For Rural/Remote Healthcare**
- **No Specialist Required**: Primary care doctors get AI-assisted diagnosis
- **Telemedicine Ready**: High-quality images enable remote specialist consultation
- **Cost Reduction**: Fewer unnecessary referrals, fewer pointless specialist visits
- **Emergency Flagging**: Urgent conditions identified and escalated immediately

### 👤 **For Patients**
- **Early Action**: Catch conditions before they worsen
- **Treatment Guidance**: Know what to expect and how to monitor progress
- **Anxiety Relief**: Quick preliminary diagnosis reduces health anxiety
- **Empowerment**: Track their own recovery with concrete data
- **Affordability**: Avoids multiple expensive specialist visits

### 🏢 **For Hospitals & Health Systems**
- **Workflow Efficiency**: AI handles initial triage, staff focuses on treatment
- **Data Analytics**: Aggregate anonymized data reveals epidemiologic trends
- **Outbreak Detection**: Quick identification of contagious conditions (fungal, infectious)
- **Quality Metrics**: Objective progress tracking for treatment effectiveness

---

## Key Benefits Over Traditional Diagnosis

| Aspect | Traditional | SkinAlyze |
|--------|-----------|----------|
| **Access** | Weeks for appointment | Minutes from home |
| **Cost** | $100-300 per visit | Affordable subscription |
| **Documentation** | Subjective notes | Visual timeline + metrics |
| **Consistency** | Depends on doctor | Standardized AI criteria |
| **Progress Tracking** | Sporadic (only at visits) | Continuous (daily if needed) |
| **Availability** | Office hours only | 24/7 access |
| **Time** | 30-60 min appointment | 2 minutes diagnosis |

---

## Responsible AI Design

⚠️ **Important: SkinAlyze is a SCREENING TOOL, not a diagnostic device**

- **Transparency**: Displays confidence levels (20%, 80%, etc.)
- **Safety First**: Low confidence predictions recommended for specialist review
- **Ethical Use**: Never replaces professional medical judgment
- **Data Privacy**: All patient data encrypted, HIPAA-compliant infrastructure
- **Bias Mitigation**: Trained on diverse skin tones to prevent misdiagnosis

---

**Challenges we ran into**

# Challenges I Ran Into

## 1. 🔴 ML Model Compatibility Issues
**Challenge:** Model saved in development environment didn't load in production due to version conflicts and custom layer serialization.

**Solution:** Simplified the model architecture using standard Keras layers instead of custom preprocessing functions.

---

## 2. 🌐 API Integration & Communication
**Challenge:** Frontend and backend worked separately but failed to communicate when deployed on different platforms (CORS errors).

**Solution:** Configured proper cross-origin settings in backend to accept requests from production frontend domain.

---

## 3. ⚡ Performance Optimization
**Challenge:** Model inference was slow due to reloading on every request.

**Solution:** Cached the model in memory at application startup instead of loading for each prediction.

---

## 4. 🎨 Production Deployment Mismatch
**Challenge:** UI components worked locally but weren't rendering in production.

**Solution:** Properly configured build settings and ensured all styling/dependencies were included in the production bundle.

---

## 5. 🤖 Model Accuracy vs Real-World Performance
**Challenge:** Model training accuracy (80%) didn't translate to real-world predictions due to data distribution mismatch.

**Solution:** Implemented confidence scoring and showed users when predictions are uncertain, recommending specialist review for low-confidence cases.

---

## 6. 📦 Dependency & Version Management
**Challenge:** Different package versions locally vs. production caused runtime errors.

**Solution:** Pinned all dependency versions explicitly to ensure consistency across environments.

---

## 7. ⚙️ User Experience with Long Processing
**Challenge:** Users thought the app was broken during inference (30+ seconds).

**Solution:** Added real-time progress indicators and optimized request/response flow for faster perceived performance.

---

## Key Learnings

- **Test production environment early**, not just locally
- **Cache expensive resources** (models, data) on startup
- **Be transparent about model limitations** (confidence scores, uncertainty)
- **Pin versions in production** to avoid environment conflicts
- **Monitor real-world performance**, not just lab metrics
- **Show progress to users** during long operations

**The problem it solves**

In today’s education system, students often face a lack of personalized learning and real-time assessment. Traditional teaching methods treat every learner the same, leaving many without proper guidance on where they truly stand or how to improve. 

Institutions struggle to track progress effectively, while students lack access to intelligent tools that prepare them for real-world interviews and placements. EduNerve AI bridges this gap by offering an AI-driven learning and assessment system that adapts to each student’s strengths and weaknesses. It simplifies the journey from learning to employability through smart analytics, personalized recommendations, and mock interview simulations — making education not only smarter but more meaningful and future-ready.

**Challenges we ran into**

Building EduNerve AI was both an exciting and challenging journey. One of the biggest hurdles was integrating multiple technologies — connecting the Flask backend with dynamic HTML templates, handling routes, and managing data flow between the front-end and AI logic. At first, the application threw several routing errors, and static assets were not loading properly. Debugging these issues helped us understand how Flask’s directory structure and template rendering truly work.

Another major challenge was deploying the app on Vercel while maintaining the correct Python environment and dependencies. The build often failed due to configuration mismatches in vercel.json and missing libraries from requirements.txt. After several trials and community research, we successfully optimized our deployment pipeline using virtual environments and proper build commands.

We also faced difficulty in designing an intuitive user interface that balanced simplicity with AI-powered complexity. To solve this, we redesigned our templates, improved responsiveness, and refined our color scheme for clarity and engagement.

These challenges not only improved our technical knowledge but also strengthened our teamwork, patience, and problem-solving approach — turning every error into a learning milestone and every bug into an opportunity to build smarter.

**EdTech**

EduNerve AI perfectly aligns with the EdTech track as it redefines how students learn, assess, and prepare for the future using technology. 
It leverages artificial intelligence to create personalized learning pathways, provide adaptive assessments, and simulate AI-driven mock interviews that enhance both academic and career readiness. 
By combining intelligent analytics with real-time feedback, it empowers students to understand their strengths and improve their weaknesses effectively. For educators and institutions, it offers valuable insights into student performance, helping them tailor guidance for better outcomes. 
In essence, EduNerve AI transforms traditional learning into a smart, data-driven experience that bridges the gap between education and employability — making it a true innovation in educational technology.

### OptiCore - System Monitor
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/opticore-system-monitor-200f) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/KarmveerSingh18/prototype-4.git) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-22GGvx_C78) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Hack%20On%20Hills%207.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackonhills7.devfolio.co)

> Self Healing interactive GUI dashboard

![NumPy](https://img.shields.io/badge/NumPy-333333?style=flat-square) ![Matplotlib](https://img.shields.io/badge/Matplotlib-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tkinter](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tkinter-333333?style=flat-square) ![YAML](https://img.shields.io/badge/YAML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![JSON](https://img.shields.io/badge/JSON-333333?style=flat-square) ![SQLAlchemy](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQLAlchemy-333333?style=flat-square) ![imutils](https://img.shields.io/badge/imutils-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The problem every user faces is when systems run for long hours, many background or unresponsive processes begin consuming excess CPU, memory, or GPU resources. These  slow down the system, causes performance degradation ,overheating ,slowdown .The only manual solution today is to open Task Manager and end these processes yourself- which is neither efficient nor intelligent.

**OUR SOLUTION: Self-Healing System Monitor**

We’ve built a self-healing performance dashboard that continuously monitors CPU, GPU, and memory usage in real-time. 
When it detects anomalies - such as high resource usage or unresponsive behaviour - it automatically diagnoses and heals the issue without requiring manual intervention.

**TECHNICAL APPROACH**

1. Continuous Monitoring -   
Our system uses psutil and GPUtil to constantly track every active process’s CPU, GPU and memory usage.
It updates these metrics in real time monitoring through live graphs and logs.

2. Anomaly Detection -
Whenever a process crosses a resource threshold (say 85% CPU for more than 5 seconds), the system flags it as potentially unresponsive.
These events are automatically logged in the "Events. Log" section.

3. Smart Diagnosis -
Before acting, the system checks the process type - skipping essential system processes like System,svchost.exe , explorer.exe etc.
Only user-level processes (e.g., browsers, editors, simulations, games) are considered for healing .

4. Self-Healing (Automatic Recovery) -
The system first tries a soft recovery: lowering process priority or freeing up memory.
If the process remains unresponsive, it safely terminates it.
Once healed, it logs a "Healed successfully" event in real-time - visible in the dashboard.

5. Smart Whitelist Feature -
 OptiCore includes a smart Whitelist feature that lets users exempt selected applications from automatic recovery actions.
 It ensures that essential or user-selected processes – like IDEs, browser or games are never mistakenly terminated without the user-permission, maintaining full control and customization of the healing system.


In these project media attached, as we can see the CPU usage which spikes at the start drops down to 10-20 % and is maintained at that level, also the memory usage is optimized as shown in the image.
As seen in the image, the CPU usage is optimized and because of this, from 1-2 days since we were running this GUI on my system, even though we were working on multiple applications and many of them have been in background, still we are not getting any crash or unresponsive behaviour from any process or application and there hasn't been the need to restart our system even once regarding this issue.

That's how this software solves one of the most common problems faced at general user level, improves our efficiency and prevents our loss of data.

**Challenges we ran into**

While developing our system, we ran into several real-world engineering challenges that pushed us to refine our design, debugging, and integration skills:

1.Process Handling Complexity: Managing multiple background services — monitor, healer, dashboard, and control GUI — simultaneously without conflicts or crashes was tricky. Achieving smooth synchronization took multiple iterations.

2.Whitelist Reliability: Making sure whitelisted apps were truly skipped during termination required deep debugging around case sensitivity, process name mismatches, and real-time list refreshing.

3.Optimization Tracking Accuracy: Ensuring the CPU and memory optimization graphs reflected real improvements (not just zeros) demanded careful tuning of sampling intervals and process timing.

4.Tkinter UI Responsiveness: Building a modern, interactive control panel with pause/resume controls and a whitelist manager while keeping the backend threads responsive was a major challenge due to blocking loops.

5.Concurrency & Stability: Gracefully handling subprocess crashes and restarts in run_all.py — without freezing or leaving zombie processes — required several design overhauls.

6.Data Consistency: Keeping logs, optimization data, and whitelists perfectly in sync across multiple modules meant implementing careful file I/O management and periodic auto-refresh logic.

7.Integration Fatigue: Each new feature (like live optimization tracking, visualization, or dynamic whitelisting) impacted existing ones, turning cross-module debugging into an ongoing puzzle.

**Open Innovation**

Our system embodies the Open Innovation spirit by combining process-level intelligence, system optimization, and human-controlled automation into one cohesive platform. Instead of limiting itself to a single domain like system security or performance tuning, it takes a cross-disciplinary approach — merging OS-level monitoring, machine healing, real-time visualization, and user interactivity.

Here’s why it fits perfectly under Open Innovation:

Interdisciplinary Fusion — It integrates elements from system engineering, data visualization, and human-computer interaction. This blend is not tied to any single predefined problem statement, but explores how multiple technologies can work together for smarter computing.

User-Driven Innovation — Features like the User-Controlled Whitelist and Pause/Resume Healing empower users to take real-time decisions — bridging the gap between automation and manual control.

Dynamic Optimization Framework — The project introduces a novel way to track and visualize system performance improvements (CPU, memory) after self-healing actions — something rarely implemented in monitoring tools.

Extensible Architecture — The modular design (separate monitor, healer, optimizer, dashboard) encourages others to build upon it — allowing open-ended expansion for research or system management use cases.

Problem-Agnostic Design — It doesn’t target a narrow issue but reimagines how computers can self-maintain performance while keeping the user in control — perfectly aligning with the open innovation idea of solving real-world problems without strict boundaries.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

A smart landslide alert platform that monitors weather patterns and user reports to assess danger levels in real-time.

Visualized on an interactive map, showing safe and risk-prone zones.

Encourages community participation — users can report local landslides or rockfalls instantly.

Acts as a digital companion for the hills, ensuring safety and awareness for residents, tourists, and authorities.

**Challenges we ran into**

1 Displaying Alerts on Map

At first, the map only displayed location markers, but our alert pins and report options weren’t visible until the map was zoomed out.
How we fixed it: We adjusted the zoom threshold and marker clustering logic, ensuring users can now see alerts and interact with them easily.

🧠 2 Managing Backend Conflicts

During testing, our backend server (Node.js) often crashed with the “port already in use (EADDRINUSE)” error.
How we fixed it: We learned to terminate stuck processes and configure dynamic ports to keep the server running smoothly during multiple test runs.

🧑‍💻 3 Version Control Issues

While uploading to GitHub, the system blocked our push due to a mistakenly added Firebase key.
How we fixed it: We removed the secret key, cleaned the git history, and added a proper .gitignore file to ensure sensitive data is never exposed again.

🌄 4 UX & Design

Our early prototype just showed a map, which looked plain and uninformative.
How we fixed it: We redesigned the UI to highlight danger levels, weather summaries, and community alerts — making the experience both useful and visually engaging.

**The problem it solves**

How Our Solution Solves the Problem

The app tackles women’s safety challenges by combining real-time emergency support, proactive risk detection, and fast communication tools into one seamless system. Instead of waiting for danger to escalate, the platform identifies potential threats early, shares live location automatically, and connects users to safe routes and trusted contacts instantly.

When a user feels unsafe or is unable to react, the system steps in. With features like voice-activated SOS, automatic alerts during suspicious inactivity or route deviation, and quick access to nearby safe zones and authorities, help reaches the user faster than traditional methods. It also records and forwards live evidence, ensuring support teams have the context they need for rapid response.

This solution transforms safety from a reactive action into a smart, continuous shield. Women can move confidently knowing that if something goes wrong, the app acts immediately, even when they can’t.


---

Shorter judge-friendly line:
Your phone becomes your silent guardian. If danger strikes, help moves before fear freezes you.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges We Faced

Building Rakhshini involved tackling several real-world engineering complexities that naturally arise when bringing multiple technologies together:

System Integration & Architecture We had to seamlessly connect the mobile interface, backend server, and database. Ensuring smooth data flow and secure user session handling demanded careful planning and iterative refinement.

Backend & API Coordination Establishing reliable communication with external AI APIs and emergency services modules required robust backend logic. Handling authentication, API latency, and response parsing without compromising user safety features was a significant engineering challenge.

Database Synchronization Maintaining real-time synchronization between user data, location logs, and alert triggers meant designing efficient DB schemas and debugging concurrency handling across the stack.

Frontend-Backend Linking Creating a unified experience between the Android frontend and backend services involved debugging asynchronous requests, CORS-style behavior on mobile, and ensuring consistent state across components.

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/safebazaar-75db) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://preview--jaipur-safe-paths.lovable.app/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HACKSTROM%202025-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackstrom-1.devfolio.co)

> Jaipur ka Safest Guide — Safe Bazaar

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Natural language processing (NLP)](https://img.shields.io/badge/Natural%20language%20processing%20(NLP)-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Mapping](https://img.shields.io/badge/Mapping-333333?style=flat-square) ![Support Vector Machine (SVM)](https://img.shields.io/badge/Support%20Vector%20Machine%20(SVM)-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Tourists — especially solo travellers and women — often feel unsafe while exploring new cities like Jaipur, due to lack of real-time information about which areas are safe or risky.
There’s no easy way to know which routes or spots are safe, and traditional maps don’t show safety-based guidance.

Safe Bazar solves this by providing a crowdsourced safety heatmap — helping users:

1 Identify safe, caution, and avoid areas in real time.

2 Navigate through verified safe routes using Google Maps integration.

3 Submit safety reports that improve the map for everyone.

4 Get AI-powered suggestions (via Groq LLM) for safer travel decisions.

In short, it makes exploring Jaipur smarter, safer, and stress-free for every traveller.

**Challenges we ran into**

While building Safe Bazar, I faced a few key challenges:

1 Report Submission Bug:
Initially, user safety reports weren’t being saved in the database due to Supabase configuration issues. I fixed it by debugging the API routes and validating data before submission.

2 Google Maps API Integration:
Combining Maps, Directions, and Places APIs caused conflicts at first. I solved this by enabling the right services and using unique API keys with restricted domains.

3 LLM Response Optimization:
The chatbot (Groq LLM) often gave long replies. I implemented a short-response constraint (1–2 lines) to keep the experience quick and clear.

4 Safety Data Sync:
Ensuring that the map updates automatically when multiple users report the same location was tricky. I used a logic to update the area status only when 3–4 reports matched.

Each challenge helped refine the project and make it more reliable, responsive, and user-friendly.

### Heart Stress Detection project
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/heart-stress-detection-project-1459) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Sameer1-oo/heart-stress-dectctore) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://sameer1-oo.github.io/heart-stress-dectctore/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HACKSTROM%202025-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackstrom-1.devfolio.co)

> Heart is life

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Stress and fatigue detection are major challenges in today’s fast-paced world.
People often ignore early signs of tiredness, which can lead to accidents, reduced performance, or health issues.
This project uses AI and computer vision to detect stress and monitor eye blinks in real time — without needing any wearable devices.

**Challenges we ran into**

🧩 1. Camera Access Issues

At first, the webcam feed wouldn’t open correctly in Flask.
Different browsers and OS permissions caused problems.
Solution: I used OpenCV’s cv2.VideoCapture(0, cv2.CAP_DSHOW) to ensure stable camera initialization on Windows and handled frame encoding with Flask’s Response stream.

🎯 2. Flask Integration with Real-Time Video

Integrating OpenCV’s live frames inside a Flask web server caused frame lags and “Internal Server Error”.
Solution: I created a separate background thread to continuously process frames and used yield streaming for smooth camera feed.

### "Smart eye"Traffic management system
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/smart-eyetraffic-management-system-79fc) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/codewithtarun2005/traffic-management-system) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/JlJhvaVD_R4?si=iGYWWf2lwrrO8a38) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HACKSTROM%202025-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackstrom-1.devfolio.co)

> Refining mobility through innovation

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Sensors](https://img.shields.io/badge/Sensors-333333?style=flat-square) ![Image Processing - Open CV](https://img.shields.io/badge/Image%20Processing%20--%20Open%20CV-333333?style=flat-square) ![yolo v8](https://img.shields.io/badge/yolo%20v8-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Traffic congestion, accidents, and emergency delays are major urban issues that waste time, fuel, and even cost lives. Traditional traffic lights work on fixed timers and fail to adapt to real-time conditions, leading to unnecessary waiting even when roads are empty.
Our Smart Traffic Management System solves this problem by using AI-powered real-time vehicle detection to dynamically control signal timing based on traffic density.

It can also detect accidents and emergencies instantly, allowing authorities to take immediate action, reducing road blockage and improving safety. This system makes city transportation smarter, safer, and more efficient, while also reducing pollution caused by idling vehicles.

**Challenges we ran into**

While building the Smart Traffic Management System, we faced several technical and implementation challenges:

1. Real-time Camera Feed Integration:
Getting the live camera feed to work properly with the YOLO model in Flask was tricky. We had to handle frame rates and synchronization to ensure smooth real-time detection.


2. Accurate Vehicle Detection:
Initially, the YOLO model was detecting random objects. We refined the model by filtering only specific vehicle classes (like cars, buses, trucks, and bikes) to improve accuracy.


3. Signal Timing Logic:
Designing a fair algorithm to allocate green light time based on vehicle density while avoiding road starvation took several iterations.


4. Performance Optimization:
The detection process was heavy on system resources. We optimized it by using a lightweight YOLO model (YOLOv8n) and reducing frame size for faster inference.


5. Accident Detection Automation:
Identifying accident-like situations and triggering alerts in real-time required experimentation with motion detection and bounding box logic.

### TripSync
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/tripsync-c967) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://tripsync-alpha.vercel.app/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HACKSTROM%202025-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackstrom-1.devfolio.co)

> Sync Your Adventures, Share the Memories.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

TripSync solves the common problem of disorganized group travel planning and coordination. Often, friends, families, or travel groups struggle to align on destinations, dates, interests, and budgets, leading to confusion, missed opportunities, and last-minute stress. TripSync centralizes all trip details in one platform—allowing users to create trips, invite members, manage group preferences, chat in real-time, and even generate AI-powered itineraries tailored to the group’s interests. By syncing everyone’s plans and communication, it ensures smooth collaboration, minimizes misunderstandings, and makes group travel planning efficient, enjoyable, and stress-free. Essentially, TripSync transforms chaotic group trips into seamless shared adventures.

**Challenges we ran into**

During the development of TripSync, several challenges arose that tested both the technical and design aspects of the project. One major challenge was real-time group communication, ensuring that messages between trip members were delivered reliably and updated instantly without performance issues. Integrating AI-generated itineraries was also tricky, as it required handling user inputs, interests, and trip details accurately while keeping the generation process efficient. Another challenge was managing user authentication and profile data securely using Clerk, particularly when linking profile images and personal information with trips. Additionally, designing a responsive, intuitive, and visually appealing interface that could handle multiple features—like trip creation, member management, messaging, and itinerary viewing—was time-consuming. Handling file uploads for profile images and ensuring cross-browser compatibility were further hurdles. Overall, balancing functionality, performance, and user experience demanded careful planning and iterative problem-solving.

### NeuroNest
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/neuronest-22e6) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/NEURONEST-org/PINKY?tab=readme-ov-file) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://pinky-umber.vercel.app/) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/MOYnbhi_3Gk?si=jTnu_T-RlRdMKzXx) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HACKSTROM%202025-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackstrom-1.devfolio.co)

> "AI that Remembers to Care."

![Firebase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![TensorFlow](https://img.shields.io/badge/TensorFlow-333333?style=flat-square) ![OpenCV](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenCV-333333?style=flat-square) ![AWS Lambda](https://img.shields.io/badge/AWS%20Lambda-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Vercel](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vercel-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Dementia patients often struggle with memory loss, confusion, and disorientation, leading to challenges in performing daily activities, recognizing loved ones, and maintaining personal safety. These difficulties not only reduce their independence but also place a heavy emotional and physical burden on caregivers.

Traditional care solutions lack personalization and continuous support — there are no intelligent systems that adapt to a patient’s emotions, provide real-time safety alerts, or help recall familiar memories. As a result, patients experience increased anxiety and caregivers face burnout due to constant monitoring and stress.

To overcome this Neuro Nest solves the problem of dementia patients lacking accessible, AI-driven support for memory recall, emotional well-being, and safety, which often leads to confusion, wandering, and caregiver burnout.

🧠 What People Can Use Neuro Nest For

Neuro Nest is an AI-driven dementia care app that supports both patients and caregivers in managing daily life with comfort, safety, and confidence.

👩‍⚕️ For Dementia Patients:

Memory Recall: Helps recall loved ones, familiar places, and past moments through stored images, voice notes, and recordings.

Emotion-Based Reminders: Sends personalized reminders (voice/text/vibration) for medication, meals, or appointments — using familiar voices to reduce confusion.

Safety & Independence: Uses geo-fencing and SOS alerts to prevent wandering and ensure quick help during emergencies.

Cognitive Support: Offers AI chatbot interactions, mood tracking, and simple cognitive games to enhance mental engagement.

👨‍👩‍👧 For Caregivers:

Real-Time Updates: Instantly notifies caregivers when tasks are completed or when a patient leaves a safe zone.

Remote Monitoring: Allows caregivers to check the patient’s location, emotional state, and daily activities anytime.

Reduced Stress: Automates routine checks and reminders, easing the constant burden of manual supervision.

💡 How It Makes Life Easier & Safer

Replaces confusion with clarity through adaptive reminders.

Enhances patient safety with intelligent tracking and alerts.

Builds emotional connection with AI that understands and responds to feelings.

Offers a holistic digital companion — combining memory, safety, and emotional care in one platform.

**Challenges we ran into**

🧩 1. Complex AI Integration

While implementing face and object recognition, the models initially gave inaccurate results and required heavy computation.
✅ Solution: We optimized the models using OpenCV and lightweight TensorFlow frameworks, reducing processing time and improving accuracy through data augmentation and retraining.

🌐 2. High API & GPS Costs

Continuous location tracking and alert notifications through APIs like Twilio and Google Maps increased operational costs.
✅ Solution: We switched to open-source APIs and Firebase free-tier for real-time database and notifications, making the system cost-efficient and scalable.

🖥️ 3. Backend Downtime

Our backend, initially hosted on Render, faced performance lags and unexpected downtimes during testing.
✅ Solution: We migrated to AWS Lambda for a serverless, scalable architecture that ensured faster response and reliability.

🔐 4. Data Privacy Concerns

Handling sensitive patient data (photos, voice samples, and emotional responses) posed a major ethical and security challenge.
✅ Solution: Implemented AES encryption, GDPR compliance, and restricted access layers to ensure complete data protection.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![SQLite](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQLite-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Agri-Intel Chatbot: Smart Farming Assistant

Empowering Farmers with AI & Real-Time Insights

Description:
Agri-Intel Chatbot is an AI-powered digital assistant built to help farmers make smarter, data-driven decisions. From predicting mandi prices to scheduling irrigation and analyzing crop health — our chatbot acts as a one-stop companion for every farmer. It’s designed to be voice-enabled and available in local languages like Hindi, ensuring accessibility for even illiterate users in rural India.

Key Features:

🌦️ Real-Time Weather Forecast & Alerts: Get instant updates on rainfall, humidity, and temperature for your exact location.

💰 Mandi Price Predictor & Calculator: AI predicts the best time and price to sell your crop for maximum profit.

💧 Irrigation Scheduler & Reminder: Personalized watering reminders based on crop type and weather data.

🌿 Crop Health Detection: Uses multispectral and hyperspectral insights to detect crop stress early.

🗣️ Voice + Local Language Support: Interact naturally in Hindi or English — no need to type.

🧠 AI Farming Tips: Provides organic and inorganic solutions with expert-backed recommendations.

Tech Stack:

Frontend: React / Flutter

Backend: Flask / Django

Database: Firebase / MySQL

APIs: OpenWeather, Google Earth Engine

AI Models: Price prediction, weather forecasting, crop health analysis

Impact:
Agri-Intel empowers farmers with real-time, actionable insights — reducing losses, improving yield, and increasing income through AI-driven recommendations. It bridges the digital divide between modern agriculture and rural India.

Future Vision:
Integration with IoT sensors and drones, offline functionality for low-network regions, and expansion into more Indian languages for deeper reach.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges I Ran Into

Data Collection & Accuracy:
Getting reliable mandi price and crop health data was difficult — most datasets were outdated or inconsistent across regions.

Multilingual Voice Support:
Integrating Hindi voice recognition and natural speech response for rural users was a major technical challenge due to accent and dialect variations.

Crop Health Analysis Models:
Training accurate AI models using multispectral and hyperspectral data required high-quality labeled images, which were limited.

Personalization Logic:
Building a system that adapts recommendations to different crops, weather patterns, and soil conditions needed complex rule-based + ML integration.

User Accessibility:
Designing an interface that’s simple for illiterate farmers while still feature-rich was a tough UI/UX balance.

Network Constraints:
Many rural areas have poor internet connectivity, making it challenging to ensure smooth data fetching and chatbot responses.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

SmartShield is an AI-powered Android app security analyzer designed to make APK safety checking faster, easier, and safer.
It automatically scans APK files to detect malware, trojans, and suspicious behaviors using static and dynamic analysis.
Instant Security Insights:
Upload any APK file and get an AI-generated risk report (Low, Medium, or High) within seconds.

Simplifies Manual Analysis:
Instead of using multiple tools, SmartShield combines permissions, activities, and risk classification in one place.

Safer App Testing:
Developers and testers can analyze apps before installation, preventing malware from entering devices.

Educational Use:
Students and researchers can learn how APK static and dynamic analysis works using real AI-backed tools.

**Artificial Intelligence**

SmartShield fits the AI track because it uses machine learning to analyze APK files and predict their risk level (Low, Medium, High) automatically. It applies AI-based pattern recognition to detect potential threats, making app security analysis faster, smarter, and more accurate.

### NyayMarg
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/nyaymarg-9caf) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Tusharr06/Nyaya-marg) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-BruteForce-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://bruteforce.devfolio.co)

> Law + Tech: Smarter Justice

![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Machine Learning](https://img.shields.io/badge/Machine%20Learning-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flutter](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flutter-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

India’s judicial system faces a massive case backlog, with millions of cases pending for years due to uneven workloads, limited judicial capacity, and lack of data-driven tools. Lawyers and citizens often have no clarity on:
1) How long a case might take,
2) What the likely outcome could be, or
3) Which court might handle it most efficiently.

How NyayMarg Helps
NyayMarg uses Machine Learning and Data Analytics to make the justice process smarter and more transparent. It allows:
1) Case Outcome Prediction: Helps lawyers and clients estimate possible results based on historical data.
2) Timeline Forecasting: Predicts how long a case might take, improving planning and expectation management.
3)Risk & Recommendation Insights: Suggests efficient courts and provides data-backed insights to reduce delays.

In short — NyayMarg empowers the legal system with AI-driven clarity, fairness, and efficiency.

**Challenges we ran into**

1) Data Simulation & Realism:
Since open legal datasets in India are limited, I had to generate synthetic yet realistic datasets that mimic real court statistics like filing rates, disposal rates, and pending cases. Achieving balance between realism and randomness took multiple iterations.

2) Model Accuracy:
Getting consistent predictions was tricky — small data imbalances caused biased outcomes. I resolved this by normalizing the dataset, using stratified sampling, and fine-tuning model hyperparameters.

3) FastAPI Integration in Colab:
Running a full API server inside Google Colab due to system constraints with ngrok created tunnel errors and async issues. After debugging, I rewrote the server threading logic and ensured stable tunnels by auto-killing existing ngrok sessions before launching a new one.

**Artificial Intelligence**

NyayMarg leverages Artificial Intelligence to make sense of complex, unstructured judicial data and transform it into actionable insights. It uses machine learning models to analyze trends in court cases, predict outcomes like case pendency or resolution time, and assist in data-driven decision-making for legal planning and reform.

By automating the interpretation of massive datasets that would take humans days to analyze, it demonstrates AI’s core strength — learning from data to identify patterns, make predictions, and improve efficiency. In essence, NyayMarg applies AI to streamline the justice system and enhance transparency, showcasing how intelligent systems can create real social impact.

### Base Reels / The Hub Pictures
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/base-reels-72fc) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1_lwS84Rmzs5wM6nTIXG_PGcyHf897D9WKWkxYsbC6c8/edit?usp=sharing) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Base%20Batches%20002:%20Builder%20Track-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://base-batches-builder-track.devfolio.co)

> Films, short films, documentaries

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The Hub Pictures / Base Reels aims to bridge the gap between the professional film industry and the onchain creative economy.
Most filmmakers, production teams, and brands I’ve worked with stay far away from blockchain — not because they’re against it, but because they don’t understand how it could fit their work or bring them value.

Base Reels will serve as a creative hub for filmmakers onchain, where professional creators can:

publish short films, animations, or branded content directly on Zora,

use creator coins as access passes to exclusive behind-the-scenes material and VOD content,

connect and collaborate within a transparent, tokenized ecosystem.

In short, it makes the onchain world accessible, safe, and meaningful for filmmakers who want to create and share high-quality work while keeping creative ownership.

**Challenges we ran into**

The biggest challenge so far has been the technical implementation.
I come from a creative and film-music background — not from coding — so I had to learn how Zora and Base work on a deeper level before I could design a model for creator coins and token-gated VOD access.

To overcome this, I focused on understanding the onchain creator economy and building relationships with developers already active on Base. I also use tools like Cursor to prototype the logic behind the VOD and token system.
It’s a slow process, but each step brings me closer to a working alpha.

**Link to the GitHub Repo of your project**

https://github.com/chriss27172/The-Hub-Pictures-Base-Reels/tree/main

**Live URL of your project**

https://zora.co/@thehubpictures

**What is your product’s unique value proposition?**

Unlike existing Web3 film projects that rely on NFTs or speculative tokens, Base Reels focuses on real creative collaboration and token utility, not hype.

Our model:

Each post on Zora represents a unique film-related token - not a collectible, but an access or engagement token.

The creator profile itself functions as a creator coin, giving holders exclusive access to our onchain VOD platform and future productions.

The platform will showcase professionally produced short films and documentaries, starting with a mini-series about animal adoption.

This approach validates our value proposition: we merge real-world creative experience with onchain accessibility - showing professionals that blockchain can empower film, not distract from it.

**Who is your target customer?**

Our primary audience are professional filmmakers and creative industry professionals - directors, editors, cinematographers, animators, and music supervisors - who are curious about onchain tools but have never entered this space.

Through years of experience in advertising, music supervision, and film production, I’ve built strong relationships with such professionals who trust me and are open to experimenting once they see a working example.
The pilot series and the Base Reels hub will serve as a proof of concept to bring these creators - and later, brands - into the onchain ecosystem.

**Who are your closest competitors and how are you different?**

Comparable projects include:

Glass.xyz
 – an NFT-based video platform

Decentralized Pictures
 – a blockchain film funding platform

Traditional curated VOD spaces like Vimeo
 or Short of the Week

How we’re different:

We focus on professional-grade production rather than user-generated content.

We use creator coins, not NFTs, as a way to build long-term engagement.

We don’t compete - we collaborate and educate traditional filmmakers on how to use Web3 tools safely and creatively.

**What is your distribution strategy and why?**

Our distribution will combine onchain publishing and gated VOD access:

Zora posts will serve as the public front - teasers, behind-the-scenes clips, and updates available to all.

Token-gated VOD (for creator coin holders) will provide access to full films, early releases, and exclusive materials.

Community-driven growth will come from engaging Base and Zora users, plus outreach to filmmakers and creative professionals through social channels and industry contacts.

This strategy fits our mission because it merges onchain transparency with traditional creative storytelling, turning each project into both an artistic work and a live demonstration of blockchain in film.
