**The problem it solves**

# Axonlayer: A Revolutionary Advertising Platform

> The contemporary digital advertising landscape, dominated by a few centralized behemoths, is fundamentally broken for all participants. Its business model is predicated on what has been termed a **"vampiric monetization model,"** which involves the pervasive surveillance of users and the harvesting of personal data to be sold to the highest bidder. This system is plagued by inefficiencies, including rampant ad fraud, a lack of transparency in reporting, and the presence of rent-seeking intermediaries that capture a significant portion of ad spend, reducing the revenue that reaches actual content creators.

Axonlayer is a revolutionary advertising platform that directly solves these problems by enabling direct advertiser-to-publisher payments using the x402 protocol.

## For Publishers (dApps, Websites, Content Creators)
The platform addresses the challenges of slow payments, high fees, and lack of control.

* **5-Minute Integration:** Publishers can monetize their websites almost instantly by adding a simple script tag and div elements.
* **Instant Payments:** Revenue is paid in real-time via blockchain micropayments directly to the publisher's wallet.
* **No Middlemen:** By removing intermediaries, publishers keep 93-95% of ad revenue, a dramatic increase from the 50-70% typical in traditional networks.
* **Complete Control:** Publishers have the power to set their own prices and define their own content moderation levels.

## For Advertisers
The platform removes the friction and opacity of traditional ad buying.

* **Direct Placement:** Advertisers can place ads directly on publisher sites without going through complex, lengthy, and often biased approval processes.
* **Pay-Per-View Efficiency:** Campaigns are based on a pay-per-view model, ensuring advertisers only pay for actual ad engagement.
* **Global Reach & Instant Publishing:** Ads can be published instantly with no geographic restrictions after the on-chain payment is confirmed.

### A Win-Win-Win Scenario
This creates a win-win-win scenario where publishers earn more with instant payouts, advertisers get direct access and fair pricing, and the platform earns sustainable fees while disrupting a massive industry.

### FUUM
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/fuum-e3fe) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://gfuum.vercel.app/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Base%20Batches%20002:%20Builder%20Track-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://base-batches-builder-track.devfolio.co)

> The reward layer for Quality on base.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![React.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/React.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Supabase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Supabase-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

In today’s onchain social ecosystem, quality creators are overshadowed by engagement farming — likes, bots, and noise drown out meaningful work.
This not only discourages authentic creation but also prevents communities and projects from discovering credible, high-value content that builds trust.

How FUUM Solves This

FUUM introduces the FAKE Engine, a Quality Layer for Base that:

Scans onchain content to detect and reward Quality, not hype.

Distributes FUUM Points (FP) to creators based on originality, clarity, and impact.

Allows creators to convert FP → $FUUM or NFTs monthly.

Enables platforms on Base to plug into FUUM so their users can earn from posting Quality content.

Use Cases

Creators earn from valuable contributions instead of raw engagement.

Communities filter noise and highlight verified Quality voices.

Platforms integrate FUUM’s FAKE Engine to boost credibility and reward meaningful participation.

Projects discover Quality creators through transparent Quality scoring.

Why It Matters

FUUM makes onchain spaces more trustworthy, rewarding, and safe, turning Base into a network where visibility and rewards are earned through value — not noise.

**Challenges we ran into**

During beta testing, several users reported that the FAKE Engine wasn’t recognizing some of their high-quality posts, even though they were confident the content was valuable.
This exposed an early limitation in how the engine detected contextual quality — it was relying too heavily on surface-level engagement and keyword metrics.

**Link to the GitHub Repo of your project**

https://github.com/kemerald25/fuum-homebase-waitlist

**Live URL of your project**

https://gfuum.vercel.app/

**What is your product’s unique value proposition?**

FUUM is the first Quality Engine on Base that rewards creators, builders, and communities based on proof-of-quality, not hype or vanity metrics.

Unlike traditional social platforms that chase engagement, FUUM uses its FAKE Engine to analyze, rank, and reward Quality content through a transparent, onchain scoring system. Users earn FUUM Points (FP) which can be converted into $FUUM tokens or NFTs, creating a sustainable Quality economy.

The alpha build already demonstrates this value by:

Scanning live onchain posts and assigning Quality scores.

Allowing beta users to track FP growth via their FUUM account.

Rewarding high-quality creators and filtering out low-value engagement automatically.

In short, FUUM transforms the Base ecosystem into a Quality-first network where creators earn because of value, not virality.

**Who is your target customer?**

FUUM’s target customers are onchain creators, builders, and community platforms within the Base ecosystem who want to grow through quality engagement rather than hype.

1. Ideal Users

Creators & Builders – Individuals who publish posts, host spaces, or create content on Base and want to be rewarded fairly for value-driven contributions.

Community Platforms & dApps – Projects that host user-generated content (like social mini-apps, forums, or DAOs) and want to integrate FUUM’s Quality Engine to improve credibility and reward authentic participation.

Quality-Focused Brands & DAOs – Organizations that want to identify credible creators or reward community members based on transparent Quality scoring.

2. Validation & Feedback

During early beta testing across creator communities on Base and Farcaster, users consistently shared that:

They were tired of engagement-based systems dominated by bots or viral noise.

The FP (FUUM Points) reward system gave them a sense of fairness and measurable growth.

Partner platforms expressed interest in integrating the FAKE Engine to boost trust and content discovery in their apps.

This feedback validated FUUM’s direction — there’s a growing demand among Base creators and projects for a Quality-first layer that rewards real impact and filters out noise.

**Who are your closest competitors and how are you different?**

Lens Protocol — https://www.lens.xyz/

What They Do: A decentralized social graph that rewards engagement and ownership of content.
FUUM’s Edge: FUUM doesn’t reward engagement quantity — it measures Quality through the FAKE Engine, with FUUM FAKE engine integrated to Lens, FUUM score contents based on originality, clarity, and impact. Lens builds social networks; FUUM powers Quality networks.

Farcaster — https://www.farcaster.xyz/

What They Do: An open social protocol where users own their identity and content.
FUUM’s Edge: Farcaster focuses on communication, and with the FUUM FAKE engine integrated, FUUM integrates evaluation — offering a Quality layer that can plug into Farcaster and reward its top creators directly with $FUUM and FP (FUUM Points).

Zora — https://zora.co/

What They Do: A marketplace and protocol for minting and trading creative works.
FUUM’s Edge: Zora values creativity through NFTs; FUUM values creative impact through Quality metrics and ongoing rewards. It’s not about the mint — it’s about how the creation shapes the ecosystem.

DeSo (Decentralized Social) — https://www.deso.com/

What They Do: A blockchain for social media that monetizes engagement and content ownership.
FUUM’s Edge: DeSo rewards engagement stats; FUUM rewards verified Quality. FUUM’s FAKE Engine filters spam, bots, and low-value posts, ensuring rewards go only to authentic, valuable content.

**What is your distribution strategy and why?**

FUUM’s growth strategy is community-driven and ecosystem-first, designed to scale organically through the Base creator economy and strategic integrations for staking rather than traditional paid ads.

1. Platform Partnerships

FUUM will integrate directly with Base-native platforms, allowing them to plug into the FAKE Engine so their users earn FUUM Points (FP) for posting Quality content.
Each integration automatically exposes FUUM to thousands of users already active on Base.

2. Strategic Collaborations

Partnering with Farcaster channels, Zora mints, and Base DAOs and other Base products to embed FUUM’s reward layer into their platforms — rewarding Quality posts across multiple ecosystems.

3. Referral & Reputation Loops

Creators and platforms that bring others to Base and to FUUM earn FP multipliers or $FUUM bonuses, gamifying distribution.

### nounspot
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/nounspot-9c77) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://nounspot.com/) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://vimeo.com/1115248841) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Base%20Batches%20002:%20Builder%20Track-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://base-batches-builder-track.devfolio.co)

> people, places and things around the world!

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Google Maps API](https://img.shields.io/badge/Google%20Maps%20API-333333?style=flat-square) ![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![Geocoding](https://img.shields.io/badge/Geocoding-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The Nouns community is everywhere. Events, murals, shops, but not in one place, you can actually see it all. Nounspot is a living map where people find who is nearby, where stuff is happening, and what nounish things exist in each city.

For example, you land in a new town → open the map → see builders, meetups, art. Event hosts, shop owners, builders, and artists get a place to be seen, and the community gets one place to look.

**Challenges we ran into**

Making one codebase feel native in four contexts: mobile web, desktop web, Farcaster mini app on mobile, and Farcaster mini app on desktop, and not forking screens. I solved it with a small capabilities layer that detects device and mini app, an intent router for deep links to Waze or Google Maps with fallbacks, and share gating that uses composeCast in app and Web Share or copy link elsewhere.

**Link to the GitHub Repo of your project**

https://github.com/ojotapcosta/nounspot

**Live URL of your project**

https://nounspot.com

**What is your product’s unique value proposition?**

Nounspot turns the Nouns ecosystem from something that only feels digital and scattered into something you can actually explore in the real world. It maps every nounish location, including events, murals, hubs, builders and cultural moments, so people can see where the movement really exists.

Soon, by opening support for other web3 communities, Nounspot can evolve into the IRL social layer for crypto as a whole, becoming the place where communities are discovered not just online, but in physical spaces where people build and show up.

**Who is your target customer?**

Right now, our core audience is people inside the Nouns ecosystem, including builders, event hosts, artists, collectors and active community members who want visibility, discovery and a way to understand where things are happening in real life.

I validated this focus through many conversations with Nouns members who described the same issue: they don’t always know where nounish activity exists, who is nearby or how to connect offline.

As soon as we open the platform to other web3 communities, the target naturally expands to anyone who is part of a crypto-native group and wants to see where their community exists IRL, meet people locally or showcase what they are building.

**Who are your closest competitors and how are you different?**

One of the closest references in the space is btcmap.org (https://btcmap.org
), which maps physical locations where people can spend Bitcoin. Their approach is economic and utility-driven, focused on payments and adoption through commerce. 

Nounspot is different because it is social-first. Instead of answering “where can I spend crypto,” it answers “where can I find my community, connect with them and bridge the gap between the crypto world and the real world.” It maps builders, events, cultural touchpoints and hubs, starting with Nouns and soon expanding to other web3 communities. Nounspot is about identity, presence and connection.

**What is your distribution strategy and why?**

Our distribution is community-driven from day one. We’re starting inside Nouns, where builders, event organizers and collectors already talk to each other daily. The first users will be onboarded through Nouns Discord, Farcaster (especially /nouns), direct DMs and partnerships with nounish hubs like nouns.world and nounspace.com, as well as event hosts who want visibility on the map. Every new point added naturally brings more people in, since contributors share their city, their event or their work.

Once we open the platform to other web3 communities, distribution scales horizontally through partnerships with DAOs, NFT projects and onchain brands that want to showcase their IRL footprint. This approach works because crypto communities already organize socially and geographically, and they actively look for tools that help them be seen, meet, host experiences and prove they exist beyond the chain.

**The problem it solves**

Women’s safety continues to be a major social issue, especially during travel, late hours, or in isolated areas.
Emergency responses are often delayed due to lack of instant communication or location tracking.

Rakshana aims to solve this by providing:

One-tap SOS alerts with live GPS tracking

AI-based threat detection (sound, movement, or heart-rate monitoring in future updates)

Automatic SMS and location sharing to emergency contacts and local responders

Safe route suggestions and community alert zones


It helps women feel safer, react faster, and connect with help immediately — whether in urban or rural settings.

**Challenges we ran into**

As the app is currently in the planning stage, key challenges include:

Designing an intuitive and lightweight UI for emergency use under stress.

Planning a secure backend for real-time location sharing without privacy compromise.

Integrating AI-driven alert triggers (from sensors or sound patterns) in later phases.


We’re analyzing the best architecture and open APIs (like Twilio, Firebase, and Mapbox) for effective implementation.⁷

**Link to the GitHub Repo of your project**

https://github.com/manasa-chittaveni/rakshana-app/tree/main

**What is your product’s unique value proposition?**

Unlike most safety apps that only send alerts, Rakshana combines:

Smart Detection (future AI triggers for danger sounds or motion)

Community Support (crowdsourced safe zones & verified helpers)

Offline SOS mode (works even without stable internet, via SMS)
This hybrid approach makes Rakshana proactive — not just reactive — in ensuring safety.

**Who is your target customer?**

Primary users: Women, especially students, night-shift workers, and solo travelers.

Secondary users: Parents, friends, and communities who monitor safety.


User research (interviews + surveys) suggests strong interest in an app that’s fast, privacy-focused, and reliable during emergencies.

**Who are your closest competitors and how are you different?**

Competitors:

bSafe

My Safetipin

112 India


How Rakshana is Different:

Adds AI threat detection instead of manual SOS only

Offline alert fallback (works even with low network)

Community-driven response system rather than only police escalation

Focus on regional language support for accessibility across India

**What is your distribution strategy and why?**

Initial Phase: Launch Android version on Play Store + promote through college safety drives and social media campaigns.

Later: Partner with NGOs, women’s safety groups, and workplaces to integrate as a standard emergency tool.

Reason: Community-driven and word-of-mouth growth ensures trust and faster adoption among real users.

### Art based
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/art-based-5aab) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://www.figma.com/design/GwBnXvgdA5LA0oFsXPK3ZK/TruArtBased?node-id=0-1&p=f&t=yriXd5ozA5HtHlNz-0) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Base%20Batches%20002:%20Builder%20Track-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://base-batches-builder-track.devfolio.co)

> Create.Store.Own

![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Creators today struggle with provenance, ownership, and fair value on Web2 platforms. Their work is often copied, misattributed, or trapped in siloed systems, while royalties and recognition remain opaque. 

Our solution is a Base-native mini app TruArt based called that gives creators an Onchain Creator DID — a portable, verifiable digital identity linking their name, artwork, and creative history. Every mint, sale, collaboration, or license automatically logs onchain, ensuring authenticity, transparent royalties, and cross-platform provenance. We position Base not just as a marketplace or identity provider, but as the underlying cultural layer where creative provenance, reputation, and value circulate transparently across the Web3 ecosystem.

**Challenges we ran into**

We lack technical execution as we are a group of artist and founder-service designer-marketing and finance

Potential roadblocks

1. Designing a system that is intuitive for creators while maintaining robust onchain security.
2. Ensuring cross-platform portability, so the Creator DID works across multiple marketplaces, DAOs, and apps on Base.
3. Balancing community incentives with smart contract mechanics, so rewards, royalties, and governance flows feel fair and seamless.

**Link to the GitHub Repo of your project**

https://github.com/anupadasgupta06-creator

**Live URL of your project**

https://www.figma.com/design/GwBnXvgdA5LA0oFsXPK3ZK/TruArtBased?node-id=0-1&p=f&t=yriXd5ozA5HtHlNz-0

**What is your product’s unique value proposition?**

This mini app gives creators true ownership, control, and recognition. Unlike marketplaces or identity tools.
- It will provides a portable, onchain identity across all Base platforms.
- Tracks provenance, royalties, and collaboration history automatically.
- Enables community incentives and governance via DAOs.
- Turns Base into a composable cultural layer where creative value flows transparently and trust is built into the system.

**How It Works
1. DID Creation
Artists create their Creator DID on Base through a simple dashboard.
 Each DID stores their name, verified wallet, and metadata of artworks.
2: Artwork Linking
When an artist mints or uploads artwork, the DID automatically associates that artwork’s metadata (title, image hash, collection) with the creator’s profile.
 3: Verifiable Credentials
A verifiable onchain record is generated — linking creator → artwork → timestamp → wallet address, ensuring authenticity and provenance.
4: Public DID Profile
Collectors, curators, and DAOs can view a creator’s DID record, see linked artworks, and verify onchain authenticity before purchasing or collaborating.

How It Works on Base — Onchain Creator DID & Portable Digital Identity
Unified Creative Identity:  Every artist gets an Onchain Creator DID on Base — a decentralized identity that links their name, art, and creative journey into one verifiable digital passport.

Provenance That Travels:
 Each artwork minted or verified on Base automatically connects to the creator’s DID, making authorship and provenance visible and portable across platforms.


Cross-Platform Portability:
 Whether it’s art on Zora, music on Sound, or design on Lens, the creator’s DID acts as a bridge — carrying their verified creative history, collaborations, and value across all ecosystems built on Base.


Authenticity & Trust:
 Collectors, galleries, and cultural institutions can instantly verify authenticity, ownership history, and creative origin through onchain records, reducing fraud and misattribution.


Creator Ownership & Control:
 Artists retain full control over their data, audience, and creative rights — their identity and proof of authorship live on Base, not locked inside any platform.


Composable Cultural Layer:
 The DID system turns Base into a cultural trust layer — where creative provenance, reputation, and royalties flow seamlessly between communities and applications.


Ecosystem Collaboration:
 Builders and DAOs on Base can integrate the Creator DID into new tools — for showcasing portfolios, verifying IP, or distributing royalties transparently.


New Value for Creators:
 This system transforms provenance into a currency of credibility — enabling verified creators to access grants, collaborations, and markets across the Base ecosystem.

How will we use Base smart contracts:
Creator DID Minting:
The Base contract allows each artist to mint their Onchain Creator DID. This contract stores verified identity info, portfolio links, and creative history immutably onchain.

Artwork Registration & Provenance:

Every new artwork, NFT, or creative asset minted through the mini app is linked to the creator’s DID via the Base contract. Metadata such as creation date, collaborators, and licensing terms are written to the contract, creating a tamper-proof provenance record.

Royalty Automation:

Smart contract logic handles automatic royalty payments whenever an artwork is sold, resold, or licensed.The contract ensures fair and transparent distribution to creators and collaborators without intermediaries.

Cross-Platform Portability:

The Base contract makes the Creator DID recognizable across multiple apps and marketplaces built on Base.Any platform can query the contract to verify identity, ownership, and provenance in real time.

Collaborations & Co-Creation:

For joint projects, the contract supports multi-party linking, tracking contributions, and splitting royalties fairly.All collaboration history is recorded onchain, ensuring transparency.

Community Incentives & Governance:

The contract can mint reward tokens, badges, or voting rights tied to creator activity (minting, sales, collaborations).DAOs or mini communities can govern incentives directly through the Base contract.

Auditability & Immutable History:

Every interaction—DID creation, artwork registration, sale, or license—is permanently recorded. Collectors, galleries, and institutions can verify the full history of a creator and their work without relying on any centralized service.

**Who is your target customer?**

Primary: Digital artists, illustrators, photographers, musicians, designers — creators struggling with Web2 platform limitations.

Secondary: Collectors, galleries, cultural institutions, creative agencies, DAOs — RWA anyone needing verifiable provenance, ownership history, or royalty transparency.

**Who are your closest competitors and how are you different?**

Closest Competitors and How We Are Different
Competitors: Zora, OpenSea, Foundation, SuperRare, Ceramic, Async Art.

How We Are Different:
- Onchain Creator DID: Portable, cross-platform identity tied to every piece of work.
- Provenance That Travels: Ownership and history move with the creator, not the platform.
- Full Data Ownership: Creators control their audience, metadata, and IP.
- Community & DAO Layer: Rewards, governance, and co-creation embedded.
- Community Cat project funded by the proceeds of the Mini app - leading to a Meme social project in the future.

**What is your distribution strategy and why?**

A phased, ecosystem-first approach:

User First - Easy onboarding, workshops, no-code minting, and proof-of-authorship badges.

Collectors & Marketplaces: Integration with Base-native apps, verified creator badges, and provenance APIs.

Institutions & DAOs: White-label integrations and partnerships for galleries, cultural orgs, and creative collectives.

Roadmap
RWA users - like real estate and legal

### SafeRide
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/saferide-6349) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/greatunim24/saferide_system) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://saferide-swart.vercel.app/booking) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/EvyQlfIRZzI) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Base%20Batches%20002:%20Builder%20Track-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://base-batches-builder-track.devfolio.co)

> Making Ride-Hailing Accessible with No Barriers!

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

SafeRide is solving a global problem — millions of people around the world struggle to find safe and reliable transport when they need it most. Many don’t have smartphones, internet access, or their phones die at the wrong time, leaving them stranded with no way to get a ride.

This affects workers finishing late shifts, travelers, tourists, students, and anyone stuck in an unfamiliar place like an airport, bus station, or busy city center. When your phone battery dies, your wallet gets stolen, or you simply don’t know anyone nearby, SafeRide makes sure you can still get home safely.

SafeRide removes all the usual barriers to transportation. Instead of needing an app or smartphone, you can walk up to a SafeRide kiosk — found in airports, malls, hospitals, or transport hubs — and book a ride instantly. The kiosks connect to multiple ride-hailing services (like Uber, Bolt, or inDrive) all in one place, so you always have options.

You can pay with cash, card, airtime, or even access small emergency loans if you’re stuck without money. The system also works offline, meaning it can still process your request even when there’s no internet, syncing later when the connection returns.

In short, SafeRide makes sure no one is ever stranded again — not workers, not tourists, not anyone. It gives people around the world a safe, reliable way to get home, no matter their phone, location, or financial situation. It’s about safety, freedom, and equal access to transport for everyone, everywhere.

**Challenges we ran into**

This was my first experience working with blockchain, wallets, and crypto-related development, so naturally there was a steep learning curve. I had to ask many questions from my mentors and spend time understanding how everything connects — from creating my first Basename to setting up my own wallet.

One of the biggest hurdles was understanding how blockchain transactions actually work behind the scenes — especially how to integrate USDC payments into my app and enable wallet creation securely. I also learned that when working with crypto wallets, security and precision are everything — if you lose your wallet PIN or private key, there’s no way to recover it like a normal email password, so I had to be extremely careful.

Another challenge was figuring out how to deploy the app correctly. Through my mentors, I discovered Trae and learned how to use Vercel for deployment. It took a few attempts to get everything working smoothly, but in the process, I gained a better understanding of how frontend, blockchain, and backend systems connect.

Finally, I also learned how to use AI tools more effectively — from debugging to improving UI/UX ideas — which helped me work faster and smarter.

Overall, the process was challenging but rewarding. Each problem I ran into helped me grow my technical understanding and confidence in building blockchain-integrated applications.

**Link to the GitHub Repo of your project**

https://github.com/greatunim24/saferide_system

**Live URL of your project**

https://saferide-swart.vercel.app/booking

**What is your product’s unique value proposition?**

SafeRide’s big idea is “Universal Transportation Access” — meaning everyone should be able to get a safe ride, no matter what phone, data, or payment method they have.

Unlike other ride-hailing apps that only work with smartphones and internet, SafeRide works both online and offline through:

Physical kiosks in public places,

Tablets inside cars, and

A light web app that can run on any device.

Our early version (alpha build) already shows three key things that make SafeRide special:

Multi-provider access – book rides from Uber, Bolt, inDrive, and Maxima all in one place.

Crypto payments – pay easily using USDC on Base, with no gas fees thanks to PayMaster.

Emergency help – get small instant loans (DeFi) when you’re stranded without cash.

This means we can help over 1 billion people worldwide who can’t currently use digital ride-hailing. At the same time, we can make money through small user fees, business partnerships, and ads on our kiosks — making SafeRide both impactful and sustainable.

**Who is your target customer?**

Our main customers are everyday people who need transport but sometimes can’t use normal ride-hailing apps because of digital or financial barriers.

We’ve found six main groups of people who will benefit most from SafeRide:

Commuters – people who don’t have credit cards, debit cards, or smartphones to use regular ride apps.

Party-goers and night-life users – people who go out to parties, concerts, or events where phones often get lost or stolen.

Emergency users – anyone who needs transport quickly, like workers finishing late shifts, sick people, or anyone whose phone battery has died.

Travellers and tourists – people in airports or new countries who don’t have local SIM cards or a working smartphone.

Digitally excluded users – people in rural areas, the elderly, or those without bank accounts who still need safe transport.

Convenience seekers – people who just want to compare prices and book from different ride apps in one place without switching between apps.

In short, SafeRide is for everyone who needs a simple, safe, and reliable way to get home — even without a phone, data, or a bank card.

**Who are your closest competitors and how are you different?**

Our competitors include Uber(uber.com), Bolt(bolt.eu), inDrive(indrive.com), and traditional taxi services — but none of them solve the real problem of accessibility.

Key Differences

Uber and Bolt need smartphones, apps, and internet. SafeRide works on any device and through public kiosks, even without data.

Unlike those apps, SafeRide combines all major ride services in one place so users can compare prices and choose the best option.

Traditional taxis don’t have digital booking, tracking, or safety features.

USSD ride services only work with one provider and offer very limited features.

Our Unique Position

SafeRide is the only hybrid platform that connects digital and physical access.
It offers:

Crypto payments,

Multi-provider booking,

Emergency micro-loans,

Offline and kiosk-based access.

No other company does all of this. Instead of competing with existing ride-hailing services, SafeRide grows the market — giving access to millions of people who were previously left out of the digital transport world.

**What is your distribution strategy and why?**

Many of our users can’t be reached online due to lack of smartphones or internet access. That’s why SafeRide starts in the physical world, meeting users exactly where they need rides most.

Phase 1: On-the-Ground Launch

We will deploy 100 SafeRide kiosks in high-traffic locations such as malls, hospitals, taxi ranks, campuses, airports, bus and train stations, and stadiums.
Additionally, 50 in-car booking tablets will be installed, but only in vehicles driven by 5-star rated, experienced drivers — ensuring safety, reliability, and user trust.

Phase 2: Strategic Partnerships

We will secure exclusive agreements with venue owners and transport hubs for premium kiosk placement, creating a strong competitive moat and high visibility.

Phase 3: Nationwide Scale & Awareness

After initial deployment, we will expand to 200+ kiosks nationwide, while increasing awareness through QR codes, word-of-mouth, and local ambassadors. Users can access SafeRide during emergencies, after work, or when their phones die.

Why This Works

By being physically present where users already are, SafeRide ensures accessibility even without phones or data. Each kiosk and tablet is a revenue engine through usage fees, advertising, and partnerships, making growth self-sustaining.

Focusing on experienced, highly rated drivers also builds trust and safety, giving SafeRide a unique advantage over competitors and establishing a reliable, widely recognized brand in every community.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Making important decisions can be overwhelming. We often face choices where:

Too Many Options: Juggling multiple factors and alternatives leads to analysis paralysis.

Hidden Biases: Gut feelings and unconscious preferences can cloud our judgment, making it hard to be objective.

Lack of Structure: Without a clear method, we might focus on the most recent or emotionally charged information, rather than what's truly important.

How This App Helps
The Saaty Decision Assistant tackles these problems head-on by providing a structured, mathematical framework for your decision-making process.

Tames Complexity: It breaks down complex decisions with multiple options into a series of simple, manageable pairwise comparisons. Instead of weighing all factors at once, you only compare two at a time.

Eliminates Guesswork: By forcing you to quantify your preferences on a proven 1-9 scale, it converts subjective feelings into objective data. This reveals your true priorities and minimizes the impact of hidden biases.

Provides Clarity and Confidence: The final result isn't just a "gut feeling"—it's a clear, visual ranking of your options with calculated weights. This gives you the confidence to move forward, knowing your choice is backed by a logical and consistent process.

What People Can Use It For
This tool is versatile and can be applied to countless scenarios:

Personal Life:

"Which house should I buy?" (Compare: price, location, size, condition)

"Which vacation destination is best for my family?" (Compare: cost, activities, travel time, kid-friendliness)

"What should my next career move be?" (Compare: salary, growth, work-life balance, job satisfaction)

Business & Professional:

"Which marketing strategy should we invest in?" (Compare: reach, cost, conversion potential, timeline)

"Which job candidate should we hire?" (Compare: experience, cultural fit, skills, salary expectations)

"Which project should we prioritize this quarter?" (Compare: ROI, strategic alignment, resources required, risk)

Everyday Choices:

"What's the best laptop for my needs?" (Compare: performance, battery life, price, design)

"Which software tool should our team adopt?" (Compare: features, ease of use, integration, cost)

By making the AHP method accessible and easy to use, this app transforms a daunting cognitive task into a straightforward, insightful, and even enjoyable experience.

**Challenges we ran into**

Building My First "Viral-First" Application
As my first application designed specifically for mass adoption, this project presented unique challenges beyond just technical implementation. The core vision was to create something that felt instantly useful, genuinely fun, and inherently shareable for a wide range of users—from someone deciding on a weekend trip to a manager choosing a business strategy.

The main hurdle was balancing simplicity with power. The AHP method is mathematically robust, but presenting it in a way that didn't feel like a complex spreadsheet was crucial. I focused on creating an intuitive, game-like interface with interactive sliders and immediate visual feedback, transforming a scientific decision-making process into an engaging experience. Ensuring the app was accessible to everyone, regardless of their technical or mathematical background, was a constant priority.

***Conditionally display the Share button only when the app is opened within the Farcaster client, as posting results from The Base App (TBA) can cause issues.***

While other decision-making tools exist, the Saaty Decision Assistant stands out by transforming a powerful, academic methodology into a fast, engaging, and social experience.

Our core differentiator is our "Viral-First" Design. We don't just help you decide—we help you share the journey and the result in a fun, visually appealing way.

**The problem it solves**

Freelancers and clients in Web3 still rely on Web2 platforms like Fiverr or Upwork, which require traditional payment rails, high fees, and slow settlement. BaseLancer brings freelance work on-chain: it lets anyone instantly post or hire for small tasks and pay directly in USDC on Base.

People can use it to:

- Hire verified freelancers directly inside the Base app without leaving the ecosystem.

**Challenges we ran into**

As someone with not too much coding experience, the biggest hurdle was getting the Base mini app environment set up correctly, especially understanding how the minikit.config.ts, account association, and manifest validation work together. I also ran into build errors when integrating Supabase and OnchainKit, mainly due to missing dependencies and schema mismatches (like the recipient_address column not syncing).

To overcome these, I broke the problems down step-by-step, used the Base documentation extensively, and relied on AI-assisted debugging to quickly fix type errors and deployment issues on Vercel. Once the backend and smart contract interactions were stable, the biggest challenge became polishing the UI and connecting the payment flow cleanly inside the Base app — which I solved by switching to OnchainKit’s built-in <Transaction /> component for seamless USDC transfers.

Its unique edge is frictionless USDC payments on Base, powered by OnchainKit’s transaction layer: jobs can be created and paid in seconds, with full transparency on-chain.

Web3-native freelancers like designers, developers, writers, and marketers already active in the Base and crypto ecosystem who prefer to get paid in USDC instead of fiat.

Main competitors:

Fiverr https://www.fiverr.com/
 and Upwork https://www.upwork.com/
 – traditional centralized platforms that dominate freelance work today.

Native to Base: It runs directly inside the Base app as a mini app, making it instantly accessible to millions of on-chain users without extra logins or wallets.

Instant USDC payments: Built on OnchainKit, payments settle on Base in seconds — no off-chain escrow, no delays, no withdrawal fees.

Ultra-light, open model: Anyone can post or hire with a few clicks; no KYC, no platform intermediaries, and full on-chain transparency.

![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Vercel](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vercel-333333?style=flat-square) ![React.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/React.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Vite](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vite-333333?style=flat-square) ![PostCSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostCSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![autoprefixer](https://img.shields.io/badge/autoprefixer-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

💡 The Problem It Solves

Most space strategy or simulation games focus only on either exploration or combat — rarely both. ExoGensis solves this by creating a balanced, immersive experience where players can explore, scan, and conquer a procedurally generated galaxy in real time.

It addresses three main issues:

Lack of engagement and replayability — traditional games repeat the same missions. ExoGensis uses dynamic AI entities, randomized planets, and adaptive challenges to ensure every session feels new.

Overcomplicated interfaces — instead of complex menus, ExoGensis provides a simple, dashboard-based UI built with React and TailwindCSS for quick decision-making.

Limited accessibility — since it runs directly in the browser, anyone can play instantly without installation or setup, making galactic simulation games more approachable.

ExoGensis makes space strategy intuitive, visual, and endlessly replayable — blending technology, creativity, and gameplay into one cosmic experience.

**Challenges we ran into**

During development of ExoGensis, several challenges came up across design, configuration, and performance.

TailwindCSS setup was initially failing because Vite couldn’t resolve PostCSS correctly. The background styles wouldn’t appear and the entire UI looked broken. This was fixed by installing the correct Tailwind plugin and reconfiguring postcss.config.js.

React imports caused repeated “Identifier already declared” errors when mixing .jsx and .tsx files. Cleaning duplicate imports and converting all components to a consistent .jsx structure solved it.

Getting the galaxy dashboard to display full screen with gradient lighting and responsiveness was tricky. Adjusting the layout using 100vh height, custom radial gradients, and Tailwind’s responsive utilities fixed the issue.

Managing multiple gameplay states such as war funds, morale, and fleet power became confusing without external libraries. Consolidating state with React’s useState and lifting shared values into parent components made it manageable.

Adding color-heavy animations and transitions created noticeable lag during updates. Optimization was achieved by removing unnecessary animation layers and simplifying gradient effects.

Each problem helped strengthen the project’s structure and gave me a better understanding of frontend optimization, responsive design, and toolchain configuration.

**Link to the GitHub Repo of your project**

https://github.com/Nikunj2401-s/ExoGenisis

**Live URL of your project**

https://exo-genisis.vercel.app/

**What is your product’s unique value proposition?**

ExoGensis stands out because it transforms traditional space exploration into an interactive strategic simulation that’s both visually engaging and technically accessible. Most space games focus either on combat or discovery, but ExoGensis merges both through an adaptive gameplay system where every planet, species, and outcome is procedurally generated.

Its biggest strength lies in its balance of simplicity and depth — players can manage resources, command fleets, and interact with alien entities through a clean, real-time dashboard built with React and TailwindCSS. The interface dynamically reacts to player choices, making every session unpredictable yet intuitive.

Unlike typical web simulations that require large downloads or backend servers, ExoGensis runs entirely in the browser, offering smooth performance and instant playability. This accessibility — combined with immersive visuals and AI-driven logic — makes it a truly unique blend of creativity, technology, and replayable strategy.

**Who is your target customer?**

The target audience for ExoGensis includes strategy game enthusiasts, sci-fi fans, and tech learners interested in simulation-based storytelling. It appeals to users who enjoy decision-making, resource management, and exploring dynamic AI-driven systems.

The product also resonates with indie game developers, students, and creative coders who want to understand how procedural generation, state management, and real-time UI design can work together inside a browser.

Early feedback from testers showed that players were drawn to the clean dashboard design, quick load time, and unpredictable galaxy generation. These insights validated that ExoGensis successfully bridges entertainment and experimentation — giving both gamers and developers a fresh, replayable experience without requiring any downloads or installations.

**Who are your closest competitors and how are you different?**

Some of the closest competitors to ExoGensis include browser-based space simulators and indie management games like “Stellaris Galaxy Command” (https://www.paradoxinteractive.com/games/stellaris-galaxy-command
) and “OGame” (https://www.ogame.org/
). While these games focus heavily on long-term multiplayer progression and monetization, ExoGensis takes a different approach — it emphasizes creativity, accessibility, and quick engagement.

Unlike traditional strategy games that require installation or large data syncs, ExoGensis is fully browser-based and built with lightweight React and Vite architecture, offering instant gameplay and smooth animations. It focuses on a single-player experience powered by procedural generation, allowing each user to experience a unique galaxy every time.

What truly sets ExoGensis apart is its minimalist yet immersive UI — it delivers the intensity of galactic conquest without clutter or complexity, blending the feel of a data dashboard with the thrill of exploration and strategy.

**What is your distribution strategy and why?**

ExoGensis will follow a community-driven and content-first distribution strategy. The initial goal is to launch it as a free-to-play web experience hosted on GitHub Pages or Vercel to ensure instant accessibility. The focus is on building traction through online design and developer communities like Reddit, Discord, Product Hunt, and IndieHackers, where early adopters appreciate unique, experimental projects.

As engagement grows, short demo clips, gameplay previews, and UI showcases will be shared across social platforms such as Twitter (X), YouTube, and LinkedIn — targeting gamers, sci-fi enthusiasts, and frontend developers. The approach prioritizes organic discovery and community testing over paid acquisition to encourage authentic growth and feedback.

Once the concept gains traction, partnerships with indie game platforms like Itch.io or Newgrounds can help scale visibility while maintaining the project’s creative independence.

**The problem it solves**

On Farcaster, creators and builders often receive the same questions repeatedly, for example, about their projects, opinions, or how to get in touch (especially as their follower count grows).
Answering these messages manually is time-consuming, inconsistent, and can lead to missed opportunities for engagement.

XBTify lets users create their AI twin that can reply automatically whenever the user or the bot is tagged in a cast, allowing users to maintain engagement even when they’re offline.

Also using the Base Chat, users can speak with the AI bots privately, asking whatever they want.

**Challenges we ran into**

The AI component was the most complex part. We decided to create a personalized agent without fine-tuning, so we built a pipeline to extract the creator’s writing style and content patterns, and applied RAG to build a dynamic knowledge base. We also had to ensure the agent only responds when confident and can determine, in context, whether a reply is appropriate.

Also, for the XMTP chatbot, in this specific project, it's very difficult to deploy a new service that is live and listening to users' chat. The optimal solution would be to have a Kubernetes infrastructure that deploys every time a new Docker instance.

**Link to the GitHub Repo of your project**

https://github.com/builders-garden/xbtify

**Live URL of your project**

https://xbtify.me

**What is your product’s unique value proposition?**

XBTify lets users clone their online persona in a very simple manner, creating an AI agent that automatically replies to mentions or questions in their style and tone.

The clone maintains engagement and could, in the future, even generate revenue through interactions.

**Who is your target customer?**

Active Farcaster or Base users with significant engagement or followers, especially creators, thought leaders, and community builders who receive many mentions and want to share their knowledge efficiently without managing every interaction personally.

But ideally could be every person who has a good knowledge of something and wants to publicly share it (or just would like to create a funny bot).

**Who are your closest competitors and how are you different?**

Our closest examples are JesseXBT, which isn’t accessible to others for replication, and the Jackbox miniapp, which requires granting full access to your real profile.

XBTify differs by generating fully personalized XBT Agents on a new Farcaster profile, using data extracted from public social content, preserving authenticity and privacy while keeping social engagement organic.
The system can also easily integrate with external data sources such as PDFs or notes.

**What is your distribution strategy and why?**

We’re launching on the Farcaster protocol, leveraging its social-first ecosystem and viral mechanics. XBT agents naturally gain visibility by replying in the feed when tagged.

Each agent operates with its own wallet, paying a small fixed cost per action, creating a self-sustaining growth loop.

Universal Gaming Identity (UGID): an NFT passport representing a player’s cross-game achievements and stats.

Dynamic Metadata: achievements update in real time via game oracles.

XP Reputation Layer: every verified in-game action earns XP that builds your on-chain rep.

Social Layer: players can follow each other’s progress, squads, and tournaments.

Plug & Play SDK: easy integration for devs to sync in-game events with on-chain updates.

In short: your gaming identity, portable across worlds.

**Who is your target customer?**

Web3 game developers who want plug-and-play player identity tools.

Gamers who want cross-game achievements and asset ownership.

Esports communities that need verified profiles and transparent stats.

Game publishers exploring multi-world reward systems.

Early adopters: Web3 indie games, guilds, and gaming DAOs.

**Who are your closest competitors and how are you different?**

Steam Profile	Centralized, locked to Steam	Player-owned identity, cross-platform
Galxe / Layer3	Focus on tasks, not game events	Live integration with in-game actions
Project Nebula / Soulbound Tokens	Static NFTs	Dynamic, evolving metadata + XP economy

**What is your distribution strategy and why?**

Developer Partnerships: integrate SDK into early-stage Web3 games.

Launchpad Quests: cross-game missions to unlock limited badges.

Esports Events: sponsor tournaments with XP-based rewards.

Community Leaderboards: visual dashboards for player rankings.

Gaming Influencers: promote UGID minting as the “Web3 gamer tag.”

Why it works: combines community hype, utility, and direct developer integration.

![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![vibe coding](https://img.shields.io/badge/vibe%20coding-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

This app offers spiritual guidance through a quick mini-reading that uses current planetary transits and how they affect an individual's birth chart to draw cards that describe the user's predicament, as well as predict their next phase. It also includes a component of numerology, a topic I have more recently taken up ever since i began seeing angel numbers several times everyday when i check the time.
The app can be used to seek clarity in the midst of a confusing cycle while being far more cost and time effective than a standard reading with an astrologer. It also ensures total privacy if that may be a concern one might have where having a reading done by another person is concerned. 
It also opens up the practice to more people who might be curious to get a tarot and birth chart reading but may be constrained by any of the features that the standard reading offers.

**Challenges we ran into**

1. Coding the app to find the coordinates of a user's birth city - the initial version, which is the one with the best format so far, required the latitude and longitude coordinates to be inputed manually. This mean users had to search the coordinates of their birth town, which led to the next problem:
2. It was not clear if the coordinates should include minutes, or just degrees - a birth chart reading based on current planetary transits, as my app is designed to do, requires the minutes as well as degrees. I overlooked this with the first could of versions and I realised by about the 10th test use case when a user's coordinates included minutes for the first time. however, the app did not input them correctly and that was a bug I had to fix. It is probably what was responsible for some aspects of some charts being inacurate, eg., it first read that I have a Taurus moon, which is not the case. The solution was to code the app to find the coordinates of the user's birth place automatically, including the minutes.
3. I did not consider whether it was Tropical, Vedic or Sidereal astrology in my coding. This resulted in some charts being generated with slight inaccuracies based on the user's knowledge of their charts. Luckily, the test subjects were mostly aware of their birth chart information already and were able to point out to me in cases where the app was inaccurate about a particular placement. Additionally, it was not until one of the test users asked if the app used Western or Eastern astrology that i realised. The solution was to code in a tab with varied options of what kind of astrological chart the user wishes to generate, based on their preferences.

**Description of your solution**

We are building **Vyapaar.AI**. An **agentic financial & sales advisor** for small shop owners, that works over a simple **phone call**.

**Here’s the reality:** kiranas, pharmacies, and family-run stores already collect sales and inventory data. But they don’t have the time or skills to use it. That means wasted money, empty shelves, or missed sales.

With Vyapaar.ai, owners just **pick up the phone and talk**. The AI agent listens, understands, and acts like a real advisor:

- Ask, *“What should I order this week?”* —> it tells you exactly how much stock you need.
- Ask, *“How are my sales this month?”* —> it gives you a clear summary.
- Before festivals or busy weeks, it **proactively warns you**: *“Stock up, demand will rise by 39%.”*
- It even suggests new products that could sell better in your area.
- And because it’s an **agent, not just an assistant**, it **takes action**, placing orders directly with vendors, reordering popular items, or sending reminders so you never miss a sale.

No dashboards. No spreadsheets. No training. Just an **AI agent that thinks ahead and acts on your behalf**, speaks your language, and is always available on the device you already trust - your phone.

Think of it as your **CFO + sales planner + operations manager**, powered by AI, but built for the smallest shop owner in the simplest way possible.

**Fintech: Bring your own problem in Fintech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Money is the lifeline of every small shop. If you buy too much stock, your cash is locked up. If you buy too little, you lose sales. For millions of shopkeepers in India, this is their biggest financial struggle.

That’s why **Vyapaar.AI is a Fintech solution at its core**. It’s not just analyzing sales data, it’s an **agentic** system that actively helps shopkeepers manage their money better.

- It coaches them on smarter spending and cash flow.
- It **proactively alerts** them to risks like overspending or running out of fast-moving items.
- And most importantly, it can **take action on their behalf**, placing orders with vendors, scheduling reorders, or sending financial reminders so the owner never misses a critical step.

This makes Vyapaar.AI more than a tool. It’s like giving every small shop a **personal CFO and purchasing manager in one**, available anytime, on a simple phone call.

That’s why it fits squarely into the Fintech track: **personalized, proactive financial intelligence, delivered in the simplest way possible, powered by Agentic AI.**

**Description of your solution**

We are building ***Sonar AI***, an **autonomous IVR-based financial coaching agent** that brings personalized money guidance to anyone with a phone, no apps, no internet required.

The solution works in two modes:

1. **Inbound Calls** – Users can call Sonar AI anytime to ask questions like “How much did I spend this week?”, “When is my EMI due?”, or “Can I save more this month?”. The agent responds conversationally in their local language.

2. **Outbound Calls** – Sonar AI proactively reaches out with financial nudges, reminders, and coaching tips. For example, “Hi, your loan payment is due in 2 days. Would you like me to guide you through repayment options?” or “Your income this week is lower than usual, here’s a way to adjust your spending.”

On the backend, Sonar AI connects with 10+ financial and communication data sources through existing MCP integrations including emails, bank alerts, digital wallets, payment receipts, and accounting tools. These integrations allow the agent to automatically capture income flows, track spending activity, and recognize patterns in a user’s financial life. Using this context, Sonar AI adapts its coaching in real time to fit each individual’s situation.
The key features are:

- **Adaptive Coaching**: Learns from user behavior and tailors guidance over time.

- **Voice-first Design**: Works on any phone through IVR, supporting multiple local languages.

- **Proactive Outreach**: Goes beyond support to actively coach, remind, and guide users.

- **Financial Inclusion**: Designed especially for gig workers and informal sector employees who may not have access to apps or financial advisors.

With Sonar AI, a simple phone call becomes an ongoing, personalized financial coaching experience that helps users take control of their money and make smarter financial decisions, every day.

**Fintech: Build an autonomous financial coaching agent that adapts to real user behavior, spending patterns, and income variability - helping gig workers, informal sector employees, and everyday citizens make smarter financial decisions proactively.**

Sonar AI is an IVR-based financial coaching agent that works entirely over phone calls. It’s built for people who don’t always use apps or have stable internet — gig workers, informal sector employees, and everyday citizens who often face unpredictable income and spending habits.

Instead of being a passive helpline, Sonar AI is proactive: it can call users to remind them about upcoming EMIs, warn them about overspending, or suggest simple saving tips. It learns from each user’s behavior — like their income patterns, expenses, or cash flow gaps — and adjusts the advice over time.

On the backend, it connects to financial data sources (like wallet APIs, SMS parsing, or bank feeds), analyzes patterns, and turns them into clear, conversational voice guidance in the user’s preferred language.

The result is simple but powerful: a personal financial coach, available on any phone, in any language, at any time — helping people make smarter financial decisions without needing to install an app or read a dashboard.

> An Agentic AI-Powered Post-Discharge Companion

![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![PyTorch](https://img.shields.io/badge/PyTorch-333333?style=flat-square) ![scikit-learn](https://img.shields.io/badge/scikit--learn-333333?style=flat-square) ![spaCy](https://img.shields.io/badge/spaCy-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Chart.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Chart.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

1. The Problem: The Post-Discharge Chasm in Mumbai
The transition from hospital to home is a critical and vulnerable period for patients. In Mumbai, this gap is a chasm, marked by a chaotic discharge process, inadequate patient education, and a near-total lack of follow-up. This leads to high rates of preventable readmissions, unmonitored post-surgical complications, and poor medication adherence. Patients and their families are left feeling overwhelmed and unsupported, while hospitals bear the significant financial and operational burden of this systemic failure. The core issue is a lack of continuous, personalized care at a scale that can serve the entire city.
2. Our Solution: Aarogya Sahayak, an Agentic AI-Powered Post-Discharge Companion
We propose Aarogya Sahayak (Health Assistant), an autonomous AI-powered companion designed to actively manage a patient's recovery journey after they leave the hospital. This is not just another health app or a simple chatbot. It is a proactive agentic AI system that can reason, plan, and execute tasks on the patient's behalf, acting as a dedicated, 24/7 care manager for every individual.   
To ensure maximum accessibility and adoption, Aarogya Sahayak will operate primarily through WhatsApp, a platform with near-universal penetration in Mumbai, and will communicate in English, Hindi, and Marathi.
3. How It Works: A Multi-Agent System for Comprehensive Care
Aarogya Sahayak is built on a multi-agent architecture, where specialized AI agents collaborate to manage the entire recovery workflow. This can be developed using open-source frameworks like Microsoft's AutoGen or CrewAI.   
The "Ingestion & Planning" Agent: This agent's first job is to understand the patient's unique needs. It ingests the discharge summary—either via API integration with hospital Electronic Health Records (EHRs) or, more pragmatically for the fragmented Indian system, by using advanced Optical Character Recognition (OCR) and Natural Language Processing (NLP) to digitize paper or PDF documents. From this, it extracts key information (diagnoses, medications, follow-up dates, dietary restrictions) and creates a personalized, day-by-day recovery plan.   
The "Monitoring & Interaction" Agent: This is the patient-facing agent that executes the plan via WhatsApp. Its key functions are:
Simplify & Educate: Translates complex medical jargon into simple, easy-to-understand language.   
Manage Adherence: Sends intelligent, timed reminders for medications and exercises, and asks for confirmation to actively track compliance.
Proactive Monitoring: Gathers crucial Patient-Reported Outcomes (PROs) by asking questions like, "On a scale of 1-10, how is your pain today?" or "Have you noticed any redness around your wound?" This automates the vital surveillance needed to catch complications early.
24/7 Support: Acts as an always-on resource, answering patient questions about their care plan, symptoms, and restrictions based on their specific discharge summary.   
The "Triage & Escalation" Agent: This is the critical safety layer. The agent continuously analyzes patient responses for red flags—such as high pain scores, critical keywords ("severe chest pain," "bleeding"), or multiple missed medication doses. If a predefined threshold is crossed, it autonomously triggers a structured alert to a human nurse or doctor at the partner hospital, providing them with the patient's ID, the reason for the alert, and a summary of the recent conversation. This "human-in-the-loop" design ensures that clinical judgment is never fully replaced, but augmented, guaranteeing patient safety.   
4. The Innovation: From Passive Engagement to Autonomous Advocacy
Current solutions are either high-touch but unscalable (relying on human staff) or scalable but impersonal (B2B analytics dashboards that provide data to the hospital). Aarogya Sahayak transcends this trade-off. It is:
Exponentially Scalable: As a software-based agent, it can provide a private care manager to every single patient at near-zero marginal cost.
Proactive & Autonomous: Unlike apps that require patients to log in and track data, Aarogya Sahayak works for the patient, proactively managing their schedule, pushing reminders, and monitoring their health. It reduces the cognitive load of recovery, allowing the patient to focus on healing.
5. Target Audience & Value Proposition
Our primary target audience is hospitals in Mumbai for phase 1. The value proposition is clear and compelling:
Reduce Costly Readmissions: Directly addresses a major financial drain on hospitals.
Enhance Patient Outcomes & Satisfaction: Creates a superior patient experience, which is a key differentiator in a competitive market.
Improve Operational Efficiency: Automates the labor-intensive process of post-discharge follow-up, freeing up clinical staff to focus on in-patient care.
By bridging the post-discharge chasm, Aarogya Sahayak aims to make recovery safer, more efficient, and more humane

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Aarogya Sahayak is fundamentally an Agentic AI project designed to solve a critical Healthtech challenge. It directly aligns with this track by leveraging the most advanced concepts in autonomous AI to create a tangible, high-impact solution for a real-world problem in the Indian healthcare ecosystem.

1. Core Technology is Agentic AI, Not Just Predictive AI:

This project goes far beyond traditional AI applications like simple chatbots or predictive analytics. Aarogya Sahayak is designed as a true agentic system-an autonomous entity that can perceive its environment (patient data and communication), reason, plan multi-step actions, and execute tasks with minimal human intervention.   

Autonomous Workflow Management: The system doesn't just provide information; it acts. It autonomously ingests a discharge summary, formulates a personalized care plan, manages a daily schedule of reminders and check-ins, and decides when to escalate a situation to a human clinician. This ability to manage a complex workflow is the hallmark of an agentic architecture.   

Proactive, Not Reactive: Unlike passive patient portals, the agent is proactive. It initiates contact, gathers patient-reported outcomes, and monitors for warning signs without waiting for the patient to log in or report a problem. It functions as an autonomous advocate working on the patient's behalf.   

Advanced Architecture: The proposed multi-agent framework (using tools like AutoGen or CrewAI) is at the cutting edge of AI development, where specialized agents collaborate to achieve a complex goal. This demonstrates a sophisticated technical approach that is central to the agentic AI paradigm.   

2. Solves a Pressing and Quantifiable Healthtech Problem:

The project is firmly rooted in solving a well-documented failure point in the healthcare value chain: the post-discharge care gap. This is a classic healthtech problem with severe clinical and financial consequences.

Addresses a Critical Need: In Mumbai, the transition from hospital to home is fraught with challenges, including inadequate patient education, poor medication adherence, and unmonitored complications, leading to high rates of preventable readmissions.   

Data-Driven Impact: The solution is designed to directly impact key healthcare metrics: reducing 30-day readmission rates, improving patient adherence to treatment plans, and enabling early detection of post-surgical complications like Surgical Site Infections (SSIs). This provides a clear, measurable goal, which is vital for any successful healthtech venture.   

Patient-Centric Design: By using an accessible platform like WhatsApp and communicating in local languages, the solution is tailored to the Indian context, ensuring it can reach and be used by the target population effectively. This focus on user experience and accessibility is crucial for healthtech adoption.   

3. Embodies the Future of Human-AI Collaboration in Healthcare:

Aarogya Sahayak represents the next step in the evolution of AI in medicine. It is designed not to replace clinicians, but to augment their capabilities and extend their reach, creating a true human-AI partnership.   

The "Human-in-the-Loop" Safeguard: The "Triage and Escalation" agent is a critical feature that embodies responsible AI design. It ensures that while the agent handles routine monitoring and management autonomously, the final clinical judgment always rests with a human expert. This builds the trust necessary for deploying such a system in a high-stakes environment.   

Scaling Expertise: The agent acts as a digital twin or assistant for the clinical team, allowing a small number of nurses and doctors to effectively monitor a large population of discharged patients. It scales the hospital's capacity to deliver high-quality follow-up care, which is currently a logistical and financial impossibility.   

In summary, Aarogya Sahayak is a perfect fit for this track because it is not a theoretical application of AI. It is a pragmatic, buildable, and innovative solution that uses the core principles of agentic AI-autonomy, reasoning, and proactive task execution-to directly address a significant, unmet need within the Healthtech landscape.

**Description of your solution**

🧭 Nivrittisarthi — Your AI-Powered Retirement Sarthi

Nivrittisarthi is an AI-powered retirement planning platform designed to help individuals achieve long-term financial freedom through personalized, data-driven, and adaptive strategies. Inspired by India’s traditional values of savings and guided by modern AI intelligence, the app acts as your lifelong “Sarthi” (Guide) for a stress-free and independent retirement.

Building upon our hackathon experience in developing AI-integrated web platforms (like BlueCircle for work-life productivity and Spy & Grow for financial analytics), we designed Nivrittisarthi with a deeply agentic architecture — where multiple AI agents collaborate to analyze, plan, and optimize your financial journey automatically.

⚙️ How It Works

Nivrittisarthi leverages multi-agent AI systems and adaptive financial modeling to analyze your:

Income patterns, expenses, and savings habits

Lifestyle aspirations and long-term goals

Investment behavior and risk tolerance

Using this data, it generates dynamic retirement blueprints that evolve with your life stages, income changes, and market conditions — ensuring continuous alignment with your goals.

🌟 Key Features
🤖 AI-Driven Financial Agents

Smart AI agents collaborate in real-time to:

Predict future financial needs

Optimize monthly savings & investment distribution

Auto-adjust retirement timelines based on life events

💰 Smart Investment Insights

Tailored recommendations for SIPs, mutual funds, NPS, and pension plans, backed by data analytics and real-time market tracking.

📈 Progress & Projection Dashboard

A visually rich dashboard that projects your future corpus, compares goal vs. reality, and keeps you motivated through interactive milestones.

🔔 Intelligent Alerts

Get AI-curated reminders for monthly investments, milestone achievements, and rebalancing opportunities.

🧘 Financial Wellness Guidance

Personalized insights and lifestyle tips for balanced financial health, peace of mind, and mindful living.

🧠 Tech Stack & Innovation

AI/ML: Multi-Agent Architecture, LangChain, and LLM-based Recommendation Engine

Frontend: Next.js + Tailwind (for smooth, intuitive UX)

Backend: Node.js + Express + MongoDB

Analytics: Vector Search + Predictive Modeling for Financial Projections

This approach is inspired by our past hackathon solutions like:

🏆 BlueCircle — AI workspace productivity platform

📊 Spy & Grow — YouTube strategy & analytics tool

🧩 Marg.ai — AI-driven career guidance and roadmap generator

Each of these projects refined our understanding of building agentic, real-time, and user-centric AI ecosystems, which we applied to Nivrittisarthi.

🎯 Vision

To empower every Indian to plan and live a secure, independent, and peaceful retirement through the power of AI agents — blending technology with traditional wisdom to guide users toward financial freedom, one step at a time.

**Fintech: Bring your own problem in Fintech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

💡 Why Nivrittisarthi Fits in FinTech (Leveraging Agentic AI)

🧠 Agentic AI Ecosystem:
Nivrittisarthi uses multiple AI agents that autonomously collaborate — one analyzes income patterns, another recommends investments, while another tracks goal progress — creating a self-optimizing financial planning system.

📊 Personalized & Adaptive Financial Planning:
Unlike static calculators, our AI dynamically updates your retirement plan as your salary, spending, or market trends change — offering a truly living financial plan.

🤖 Intelligent Financial Decision-Making:
The agent network mimics a real financial advisor — identifying risks, suggesting fund rebalancing, and optimizing SIP or pension contributions automatically.

💰 Democratizing Financial Advisory:
Brings personalized financial guidance to middle-income Indians who can’t afford traditional financial planners — making AI-based wealth planning accessible and affordable.

🔍 Data-Driven Insights with Predictive Modeling:
Uses LLMs and financial data analysis to project long-term corpus growth, retirement age optimization, and inflation impact simulations.

⚡ Continuous Learning System:
Agents learn from user behavior, market fluctuations, and savings performance — improving recommendations over time through reinforcement learning.

🪙 FinTech Innovation with Cultural Relevance:
Blends traditional Indian saving values with next-gen AI tools, promoting responsible investment habits while leveraging modern tech.

🌍 Scalable Financial Infrastructure:
Can integrate with APIs from banks, SIP platforms, and UPI systems — making it scalable and interoperable within India’s FinTech ecosystem.

Unlike conventional FinTech tools that primarily target experienced investors or focus on transactions, this project emphasizes financial literacy, inclusivity, and habit formation, making it especially valuable for first-time earners. **Description of your solution**

We are building Saarthi, an IoT and Agentic AI-based assistive system combining smart glasses, a lightweight ear device, and a mobile app. The glasses use sensors and an optional camera for obstacle detection, OCR, and mapping. The ear device provides human-like real-time voice guidance through an AI agent that proactively assists with navigation and queries. Even if the glasses fail, the ear device continues functioning. The companion app enables caregiver connectivity with SOS alerts and monitoring. Saarthi also supports speech-to-text for hearing impaired and gesture-to-speech for speech impaired, making it inclusive for multiple disabilities. The target cost per unit is about ₹2,700, making it far more affordable than existing global alternatives.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

The core of Drishyam is an Agentic AI assistant built into the ear device that goes beyond simple rule-based systems. Instead of waiting for commands, it continuously interprets sensor inputs such as obstacle data, GPS signals, and user speech in real time, and then proactively provides guidance. The AI agent behaves like a human companion, anticipating the user’s needs, warning about potential risks, suggesting safer routes, and adapting its responses dynamically to changing environments. This initiative-taking, context-aware behavior is what makes it an Agentic AI system, directly aligning with the MumbaiHacks theme by showcasing how AI agents can act autonomously and intelligently to support human users in critical everyday situations.
