![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Firebase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase-333333?style=flat-square) ![ARCore](https://img.shields.io/badge/ARCore-333333?style=flat-square) ![TensorFlow](https://img.shields.io/badge/TensorFlow-333333?style=flat-square) ![scikit-learn](https://img.shields.io/badge/scikit--learn-333333?style=flat-square) ![NumPy](https://img.shields.io/badge/NumPy-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flutter](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flutter-333333?style=flat-square) ![Chart.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Chart.js-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

Aegis AI is a healthcare autonomous agent that has been designed to function as a post-treatment agent and give patients continuous support. Basically the system combines its wearable sensor data, environmental inputs, and patient-reported symptoms to uphold a real-time model of each individual's physiological and behavioural state. The system employs reinforcement learning in order to alter the care strategies based on previous results and it is at the same time it is finding the best solutions for intervention for medication adherence, rehabilitation guidance, and risk prevention. 

The agent is a contextual multi-modal pipeline that works through the different sources: the data from ECG, pulse oximetry, motion, and temperature sensors are combined with textual or voice symptom inputs and historical health records. Predictive analytics models help to discover the tiniest changes that can signal early complications or even relapse. Upon detecting any anomalies, the agent escalation procedures will be initialized by the patient conversationally, then the caregivers or professionals will be informed with a prioritized summary of metrics and explanations that are produced through the use of explainable AI methods such as SHAP or LIME. 

The on-device work for all the core inference and anomaly-detection functions is implemented through an AI architecture utilizing TensorFlow Lite which is optimized for low-latency operation on mobile or embedded processors. The aim of this design is to keep the patient's privacy and at the same time maintain responsiveness. The encrypted data synchronization and sharing that is driven by consent are in line with HIPAA, GDPR, and Indian health-data regulations. The records of immutable audit trails are made using lightweight blockchain frameworks for the purpose of providing integrity and traceability of AI decisions. 

The caregiver companion panel provides a snapshot of the patients real-time vitals, risk predictions, and explainable insights, so the caregiver can have a clear and easy view of the situation without the need of manually handling the data. There are augmented-reality modules that have been developed on top of ARCore/ARKit and these can give the users an interactive guide for their physiotherapy and at the same time the medication routines will be made easier thus the adherence rate will increase and in-person visits will be less necessary. 

Aegis AI is not just about remote monitoring, rather, it is a step towards real autonomy in digital healthcare. It provides the platform for continuous sensing, adaptive intelligence and ethical human-AI collaboration. This way the patient receives an anticipatory, dependable, and context-aware post-treatment healthcare that is portable to different healthcare ecosystems and can increase in size without losing security

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Aegis AI is a conceptualization of a fully autonomous, reasoning-capable agent which does not just monitor but also learns and adapts to the recovery context of each patient and acts accordingly. 

HealthTech Relevance: The main emphasis here is on post-treatment recovery, which is a highly impactful both clinically and societally but hardly automated so far. 

Human-AI Collaboration: The model of collaboration between human and AI that is being used here foresees AI making autonomous decisions but giving doctors explanations and having a chain of command for escalations to maintain medical oversight and ethical reliability. 

Innovation and Feasibility: The project features seamless integration of multi-modal data fusion, RL-based personalization, and edge inference into a privacy-first mobile ecosystem that can be deployed. 

Scalability and Accessibility: It is built for also for devices that are low-cost and wearable integrations, which makes it possible to facilitate healthcare locally and in remote areas both. 

Outcome and Impact 

The essential and continuous component of care that is also smart and can be understood by the user is made available to the patient through Aegis AI during the most vulnerable time of treatmentthe recovery period. 

The hospital readmissions it brings about are reduced, adherence is improved, and it is ensured that the risks are detected early on, while at the same time, patients are given the power to recover at home safely. 

The platform is an example of how healthcare can be transformed from merely reactive monitoring to agentic proactive, autonomous assistance with the help of AI, thereby being in line with the HealthTech leveraging AI Agents track vision of creating smart eco-systems of the next-gen healthcare that are intelligent in nature.

Project Name: The Coder'z

Tagline: Transforming How Students Learn, Build, and Grow as Developers

Overview

The Coder'z is an all-in-one developer learning and growth platform that combines AI assistance, project-based learning, open-source collaboration, and career preparation — built to bridge the gap between “learning theory” and “becoming industry-ready.”

Instead of just teaching code, The Coder'z gives students real tools, real projects, and real visibility into their growth — turning passive learners into active contributors and future engineers.

Key Modules & How They Fit the Tracks
1. AI Tools & Smart Learning Assistants (Innovation / AI & Automation Track)

-> The Coder'z integrates a suite of AI-powered tools designed to accelerate developer productivity:
-> AI Code Helper: Context-aware problem-solving and debugging assistant trained on real development patterns.
-> AI Project Mentor: Guides students through building projects step-by-step, suggesting architecture, libraries, and optimization tips.
-> AI Resume & Profile Builder: Generates personalized resumes and GitHub-ready portfolios using AI-generated skill insights.

This module fits the AI & Innovation track perfectly — it showcases how AI can be practically embedded into the developer journey to personalize learning and automate skill-building.

2. Open Source & GitHub Integration (Community / Developer Tools Track)

The Coder'z includes a built-in Open Source Contribution Hub, tightly integrated with GitHub.
Students can:

-> Browse live open-source projects from CODERZ or partner organizations.
-> View issues, submit pull requests, and track their contributions.
-> See themselves ranked on a live leaderboard, with points for PRs, merges, and issues resolved.

This module gamifies open source and helps students build real-world exposure — fitting the Developer Tools and Community Impact tracks by democratizing contribution and collaboration.

3. Mock Interviews & Career Prep (EdTech / Future of Work Track)

The Coder'z includes a Mock Interview Platform that simulates real tech interviews using AI-based evaluation:

-> Technical Interview Mode: Students are asked algorithm or system design questions and get structured feedback on their logic and clarity.
-> Behavioral Round: AI evaluates communication and reasoning, helping users improve soft skills.
-> Performance Analytics: Tracks growth across sessions with insights into weak areas.

This directly fits the Future of Work / Skill Development track — focusing on employability, self-improvement, and AI-driven upskilling.

4. Projects & Practical Learning Hub (EdTech / Learning Innovation Track)

Students can browse curated real-world project ideas, categorized by tech stack and difficulty level.
They can:

-> Build and publish their own projects.
-> Collaborate with peers.
-> Get feedback from mentors or AI assistants.

Each project completed adds to their The Coder'z Portfolio, making their learning measurable and visible.

This module embodies Project-Based Learning, a modern approach that fits strongly under the EdTech & Learning Innovation track.

5. Leaderboard & Gamified Learning Experience (Engagement / Innovation Track)

The Coder'z adds motivation through gamification:

-> Global and project-specific leaderboards.
-> XP points for tasks like PR merges, mock interviews, and completed projects.
-> Badges and achievements like “Top Contributor,” “Bug Fixer,” “AI Prototyper,” etc.

This feature keeps students engaged and builds healthy competition — ideal for Innovation in Engagement or Community Building tracks.

6. Community & Collaboration Layer (Social / Developer Ecosystem Track)

The platform has built-in discussion threads, peer feedback loops, and mentor interaction zones.
It encourages:

-> Cross-college collaboration
-> Hackathon-style teamwork
-> Real-time Q&A and support

This helps The Coder'z evolve into a social ecosystem for developers, not just a course platform.

**Description of your solution**

Our project, **FinSage**, is an A**I-powered financial coaching platform** that helps individuals - especially **gig workers, freelancers, students, and small business owners** - manage their money with confidence and clarity.

Many people in India struggle with irregular income, impulsive spending, and a lack of personalized financial guidance. Existing apps only track expenses; they don’t understand user behavior or offer actionable insights.

**FinSage** acts as a **personal AI mentor** that continuously learns from a user’s financial habits, goals, and lifestyle. It analyzes spending patterns, income fluctuations, and saving behavior to deliver **real-time, personalized advice** - such as how to save smarter, manage cash flow, and reach short- and long-term financial goals.

The system proactively sends alerts, creates smart budgets, and predicts upcoming expenses, empowering users to make better financial decisions without needing expert knowledge.

Our **target audience** includes people with irregular income sources - like gig workers, freelancers, and young professionals - who often lack access to traditional financial planning tools.

**FinSage** follows a **freemium business model** to ensure scalability and profitability:

1. **Free Tier**: Basic expense tracking, financial summaries, and AI chat guidance.

2. **Premium Tier**: Advanced insights, personalized investment suggestions, and exclusive saving plans (₹199/month or ₹999/year).

3. **Partnership Revenue**: Collaborations with banks, fintech APIs, and financial advisors to recommend trusted services.
 
4. **Aggregated Insights**: Providing anonymized financial behavior insights to partners for market understanding.

By turning financial complexity into simple, proactive advice, **FinSage** empowers users to take control of their money, build better habits, and move closer to financial freedom.

**Fintech: Build an autonomous financial coaching agent that adapts to real user behavior, spending patterns, and income variability - helping gig workers, informal sector employees, and everyday citizens make smarter financial decisions proactively.**

**FinSage** directly aligns with the **Fintech track** as it focuses on transforming how individuals manage their personal finances through intelligent technology.

Our solution empowers users - especially gig workers, freelancers, and individuals with irregular income - to achieve financial stability using **AI-driven insights**. By analyzing income patterns, expenses, and saving habits, FinSage provides **personalized, data-backed recommendations** that help users make smarter spending and investment decisions.

It fits the **Agentic AI challenge** within Fintech because the system doesn’t just analyze user data - it **acts proactively** by sending alerts, suggesting budget adjustments, and forecasting upcoming financial risks or opportunities.

FinSage brings financial literacy and planning to the next level by combining **automation, behavioral analysis, and decision intelligence**, making it an ideal project under the Fintech track.

> ransomware early warning system

![Bootstrap](https://img.shields.io/badge/Bootstrap-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![RestAPIs](https://img.shields.io/badge/RestAPIs-333333?style=flat-square) ![watchdog](https://img.shields.io/badge/watchdog-333333?style=flat-square) ![Pyinotify](https://img.shields.io/badge/Pyinotify-333333?style=flat-square) ![Anomaly detection: unsupervised ML models or heuristics](https://img.shields.io/badge/Anomaly%20detection:%20unsupervised%20ML%20models%20or%20heuristics-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

imagine your computer as a cozy little house — files neatly arranged, everything humming along — until an invisible intruder starts moving things around, quietly encrypting precious data. that intruder is ransomware. enter RansomEye, your vigilant digital sentinel.

RansomEye is designed to detect ransomware activity before encryption even begins. it continuously monitors file system changes, system logs, and process behavior. unusual activity, like mass renames, sudden spikes in file access, or the subtle creep of encryption processes, triggers alerts in real-time. RansomEye doesn’t just stop there: it isolates affected files and directories automatically, preventing the malware from spreading, all while keeping your system fully operational.

visual dashboard:

overview screen: a live “heartbeat” of your system — file activity, active processes, recent alerts.

threat timeline: interactive graph showing the sequence of suspicious events (chain-of-events visualization) with timestamps, affected files, and severity levels. think of it as footprints in the snow — you can trace exactly how the ransomware tried to move.

alerts & action panel: pop-up notifications for detected threats, buttons to “isolate,” “quarantine,” or “ignore” with optional automated responses.

metrics view: shows statistics like number of files monitored, threats detected, percentage of attacks stopped, and average response time.

settings & customization: users can tweak sensitivity, define monitored directories, and choose automatic vs manual isolation actions.

the workflow is intuitive:

monitor: RansomEye observes files, processes, and logs.

analyze: anomaly detection models (unsupervised ML or heuristics) flag abnormal patterns.

visualize: the dashboard renders suspicious activity with timelines and graphs.

act: isolate or quarantine affected areas automatically, optionally alert the user via desktop notification or webhook.

report: optional PDF or JSON reports summarizing incidents, useful for small office IT teams or startups.

RansomEye works for lone users, small offices, and startups, giving peace of mind that someone’s always watching, without blinking. it’s practical, visual, and designed to be demoed live in under 5 minutes, showing the “before → after” scenario that hackers can’t hide from.

**Misinformation: Bring your own problem in Misinformation, leveraging Agentic AI.**

RansomEye fits this track because it addresses a unique cybersecurity problem — early ransomware detection — that doesn’t fall under predefined categories like fintech or healthtech. It leverages agentic AI to autonomously monitor file systems, detect anomalous patterns, and take protective actions before damage occurs. By combining real-time analysis, automated intervention, and a visual chain-of-events dashboard, RansomEye exemplifies how agentic AI can solve a custom, high-impact problem beyond traditional applications.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![FastAPI](https://img.shields.io/badge/FastAPI-333333?style=flat-square) ![Telegram API](https://img.shields.io/badge/Telegram%20API-333333?style=flat-square) ![Agno](https://img.shields.io/badge/Agno-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

FinGenie is a fintech platform that offers tailored investment advice through a website chatbot, blending users' spending habits, investment history, and real-time market data to simplify financial decision-making.
Users interact with a telegram chatbot on daily basis to log expenses (e.g., "Spent ₹50 on coffee"), report investments, share profit/loss details, and set budgets, creating a detailed profile to assess risk tolerance. Using live data from Yahoo Finance (yfinance API), FinGenie recommends specific investments, like "Invest $200 in AAPL stock and $100 in ETH crypto."
We’ve crafted our own formula at the core, combining spending patterns, investment performance, budget, market trends, and news sentiment analysis. For sentiment, we adapt the risk detection approach from "**Modeling and Detecting Company Risks from News**" by Jiaxin Pei et al. (NAACL 2024), using our pre-trained model to identify risks like supply chain issues or regulations in headlines, adjusting suggestions to avoid volatile options.
As an agentic AI, FinGenie processes data autonomously and delivers monthly insights, if your spending shows overspending on dining, we might note, "You’ve spent excessively on dining this month, try saving more. At the end of every month a full report in pdf format will be sent to the user with all classified necessary and unecessary spendings.

**Fintech: Build an autonomous financial coaching agent that adapts to real user behavior, spending patterns, and income variability - helping gig workers, informal sector employees, and everyday citizens make smarter financial decisions proactively.**

FinGenie fits this track by acting as an autonomous financial coach that adapts to users' real-time spending (e.g., logging expenses), investment activity, and budget inputs to tailor advice. It accommodates income variability, common among gig workers and informal employees by factoring in profit/loss and budget constraints. Using the risk framework from the research paper, it proactively analyzes news sentiment to guide decisions, helping all users, from daily workers to citizens, make smarter financial choices based on their unique patterns.

AwareNet (Adaptive Misinformation Resilience Agent) isn’t just another fact-checker.

This project perfectly aligns with the Misinformation track because it shifts the paradigm:
from “detecting lies” ➝ to “developing digital wisdom.”
From fact-checking bots ➝ to human-centered cognitive resilience systems.

AwareNet doesn’t just flag falsehoods , it builds stronger minds.
And in a world drowning in misinformation, that’s the kind of intelligence we need.

**Description of your solution**

**Problem Statement**
Millions in smaller Indian cities struggle to access quality healthcare. They face confusion in choosing specialists, difficulty understanding complex medical reports, missed medications, and lack guidance navigating India’s fragmented healthcare system. These issues lead to delayed treatment and worse health outcomes.

**Proposed Solution**
Our Agentic AI-powered platform empowers users by autonomously analyzing symptoms, directing patients to the correct specialists, and simplifying medical documentation. It offers multilingual support, proactive medication adherence, healthcare cost optimization, and emergency assistance — all tailored to underserved Indian populations.

**Core Features**

-**Autonomous Symptom Analysis & Specialist Routing:** AI analyzes voice inputs or symptom photos, identifies the right specialist (e.g., dermatologist vs. general physician), auto-books appointments, and explains medical necessities in regional languages.
-**Medical Document Translator:** Uses OCR to scan prescriptions and lab reports, simplifies medical jargon, flags concerns, and translates into 10+ Indian languages.
-**Medication & Treatment Adherence:** Learns patient routines to optimize reminders, detects drug interactions, auto-orders refills, and adjusts timing based on patient behavior.
-**Healthcare Cost Optimizer:** Compares test prices, suggests generic medicines, identifies government schemes, and negotiates the best healthcare deals.
-**Emergency Response Agent:** Monitors vitals (if wearables integrated), alerts family and hospitals, shares medical history, and guides first aid.

**Minimal Viable Product (MVP) Focus**
For the hackathon demo, the MVP includes:

Symptom → Specialist Routing

**Medical Report Simplifier + Multilingual Translation**
Using APIs such as HealthifyMe, Practo, PharmEasy, Google Maps for real data, and IndicTrans2/AI4Bharat for multilinguistic support.

**Impact & Benefits**

- Addresses healthcare navigation challenges for over 70% of India’s tier 2/3 city residents.

- Democratizes healthcare by applying agentic AI that learns, decides, and acts autonomously.

- Improves treatment adherence, reduces costs, and enhances emergency response.

- Offers scalable B2C and B2B2C models via clinics, telemedicine platforms.
 
- Ensures user privacy with local encryption and consent-driven data use.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Swasth fits within HealthTech by leveraging agentic AI to act autonomously—not just assist. It analyzes symptoms smartly, auto-books the right specialist, simplifies medical reports into local languages, smartly manages medication schedules, and sends emergency alerts. It’s like a personal healthcare companion that removes barriers, bridges language gaps, and makes healthcare access seamless and affordable for millions in smaller cities. This kind of proactive, intelligent healthcare support is exactly what HealthTech strives to deliver.

> Predicting Tomorrow’s Market with GRU Intelligence

![TensorFlow](https://img.shields.io/badge/TensorFlow-333333?style=flat-square) ![pandas](https://img.shields.io/badge/pandas-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![scikit-learn library](https://img.shields.io/badge/scikit--learn%20library-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

Our solution leverages Deep Learning (GRU - Gated Recurrent Unit) models to accurately forecast stock prices across multiple companies. The system is designed to analyze past market behavior and predict future closing prices based on historical Open, High, Low, and Close values.

Each company’s data is processed individually to capture unique market patterns. The data undergoes scaling and sequence generation to form time windows that the GRU model learns from. Using these sequential dependencies, the model identifies complex temporal relationships in stock movements.

The trained GRU model for each company outputs future predictions of stock prices, which are then compared against actual market data for performance evaluation. The approach helps identify potential undervalued or overvalued scenarios for informed decision-making.

The final results are visualized as plots comparing actual vs. predicted prices for each company, enabling users to observe how effectively the model captures real-world market trends.

The idea is to let AI act more independently — analyzing data, making smart decisions, and improving financial processes. It’s about applying creativity and intelligence to make finance smarter and more efficient.

> Autonomous decentralized insurance agent

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Rust](https://img.shields.io/badge/Rust-333333?style=flat-square) ![AI/ML](https://img.shields.io/badge/AI/ML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Solana Blockchain](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solana%20Blockchain-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

The Agentic AI Breakthrough
MicroGuard is an autonomous, decentralized insurance platform designed to provide instant, reliable financial relief to India's most economically vulnerable populations: gig workers, small farmers, and micro-business owners.  
We are building a dual-agent AI system that automates the entire claims lifecycle, moving from event detection to payout in seconds without human intervention.  
Monitoring Agent (The Oracle):
Goal: Continuously monitors the real world for policy trigger conditions.  
Action: Autonomously queries authoritative, localized data sources, prioritizing the official India Meteorological Department (IMD) API. It checks if pre-defined thresholds (e.g., temperature exceeding 40°C for two days) are met.  
Innovation: It employs a Multi-Oracle Consensus mechanism, requiring verification from both IMD and a secondary source before triggering a payout. This directly minimizes "Basis Risk" (the mismatch between the trigger and actual loss) and builds systemic trust.  
Claims Agent (The Enforcer):
Goal: To execute financial settlements with absolute immutability and autonomy.  
Action: Embodied by a Smart Contract on the low-cost Solana blockchain, it holds premium funds in escrow and instantly executes the fixed payout upon receiving the verified trigger from the Monitoring Agent. The use of Solana ensures fees do not erode the value of micro-payouts.

**Fintech: Bring your own problem in Fintech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

India's rapidly growing gig economy, projected to include 23.5 million workers by 2030, along with millions of small-scale farmers and micro-entrepreneurs, operates without an effective financial safety net. For this demographic, a verifiable climate event like a severe heatwave or a localized flood isn't just an inconvenience—it's a crisis that halts their income and erases their immediate liquidity.
Traditional insurance products are fundamentally unsuitable for these workers. They are often inaccessible, prohibitively expensive, and too slow to pay out, failing to provide relief when it is most critical. This creates a time-sensitive liquidity gap at the moment of greatest need, exposing the most vulnerable segments of our economy to debilitating cycles of debt from predictable, insurable events.

> Your AI Maternal Care Companion

![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![AWS Cloudwatch](https://img.shields.io/badge/AWS%20Cloudwatch-333333?style=flat-square) ![React Native](https://img.shields.io/badge/React%20Native-333333?style=flat-square) ![Redis](https://img.shields.io/badge/Redis-333333?style=flat-square) ![Auth0](https://img.shields.io/badge/Auth0-333333?style=flat-square) ![langchain](https://img.shields.io/badge/langchain-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

**Overview**
Sakhi is a voice-first, multilingual AI copilot that accompanies pregnant and postpartum women through the entire journey—from antenatal care to baby care—by proactively coaching on medicines, nutrition, trimester-safe exercises, and danger-sign recognition, while triaging symptoms and connecting users to nearby PHCs/clinicians when needed. It functions as an autonomous agent that perceives user context, plans evidence-based next steps, acts via reminders and micro-coaching, verifies content with trusted guidelines, and learns from adherence and outcomes to continuously personalize care.

**What it solves**

Low adherence and fragmented guidance: Daily iron–folate, calcium, diet, ANC schedules, and exercise are hard to sustain without localized, simple, and timely nudges.

Preventable risks and late escalation: Danger signs (e.g., severe headache with high BP, bleeding, fever, reduced fetal movements) are often missed or escalated late.

Rising non-indicated C-sections: Anxiety and poor preparation for normal delivery increase surgical deliveries where not clinically necessary.

High anemia burden: Inconsistent supplement/diet adherence keeps Hb low, raising maternal-fetal risk.

Language, literacy, and myths: Regional languages, low digital literacy, and entrenched myths reduce evidence-based behaviors.

**Core user flows**

Medication and anemia coach: Sets personalized reminders for IFA/calcium, explains “why” simply, suggests iron + vitamin C pairings, tracks streaks, and prompts Hb rechecks.

Exercise and delivery prep: Trimester-safe routines with voice guidance, pelvic floor and breathing practice, weekly progression, and modules to build confidence for normal delivery when appropriate.

Symptom triage: Conversational intake for headache/swelling/bleeding/fever/reduced movements; rules + ML stratification decide self-care vs. watchful waiting vs. urgent PHC referral; generates referral notes and follow-ups.

Myth compass: Local-language, culturally sensitive myth-busting on diet, activity, sex, breastfeeding, newborn care—with short, trustworthy explanations users can act on.

Postpartum and baby care: Breastfeeding support, newborn red flags, immunization reminders, growth check-ins, and contraceptive counseling.

Care escalation and loop closure: One-tap PHC/teleconnect, automated follow-ups after any alert, and clinician-in-the-loop for flagged users.

**Agentic AI design**

Perceive: Understands voice/text in Indian languages; ingests basic vitals (BP, Hb, weight), pregnancy stage, fetal movement logs, visit schedules; maintains a longitudinal pregnancy state.

Plan: Applies ANC/PNC pathways to create day-by-day and trimester plans for medicines, exercise, nutrition, labs, and visits with clear thresholds for escalation.

Act: Proactive reminders, micro-lessons (audio/video), check-ins, and PHC/doctor connect; delivers myth-busting explainers tailored to the user’s context.

Verify: Uses a curated clinical corpus and national program materials; provides short rationales in simple language to build trust and understanding.

Learn: Personalizes content timing, modality, and tone from adherence and feedback; optimizes toward anemia correction, activity minutes, visit compliance, and readiness for normal delivery where appropriate.

**MVP for hackathon**

Android/PWA prototype + WhatsApp bot:

Voice chat in Hindi/Marathi + English

Medicine reminder setup and streak tracking

Trimester exercise plan with voice prompts

Triage flow demo (e.g., headache + high BP → urgent referral vs. self-care)

Myth-busting cards with short audios

Simulated PHC connect + auto-generated referral summary

Simple dashboard for ASHA/PHC: roster, alerts, and follow-up status

Basic analytics: adherence streaks, activity minutes, triage outcomes

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

- Sakhi fits the Healthtech track because it directly improves maternal and newborn health outcomes by translating clinical antenatal and postpartum guidance into daily, personalized actions via an autonomous AI agent for Indian users.

- The agent proactively coaches medication adherence (iron–folate, calcium), trimester-safe exercise, and nutrition to reduce anemia and strengthen healthy pregnancy behaviors aligned with national priorities, making it a healthcare intervention rather than a general assistant.

- It performs evidence-based symptom triage for danger signs (e.g., severe headache with high BP, bleeding, fever, reduced fetal movements) and triggers rapid referrals to PHCs or clinicians, strengthening timely care-seeking and coordination across the health system.

- Multilingual, voice-first delivery counters literacy and language barriers, while myth-busting explanations mapped to trusted guidelines address prevalent misinformation that undermines maternal care in India.

- Planned integrations with PHC/NHM workflows and FHIR-aligned data flows, plus measurable metrics (IFA adherence, ANC visit compliance, escalation timeliness, and appropriate normal delivery rates), demonstrate a practical, scalable Healthtech deployment path in the Indian public and private care ecosystem.

CHANAKYA (Credit Health, Autonomous Nudging, And Knowledge-Yielding Advisor): The Behavioral Strategist (Agentic AI Solution)

Overview and Core Goal

CHANAKYA is a streamlined, multi-agent system focused on preventing users from falling into high-interest debt traps, safeguarding their credit profile, and reinforcing sound financial habits. The system's primary directive is Proactive Debt Defense.
The primary focus is to move beyond passive advice, leveraging Behavioral Economics and Gamification to create proactive, context-aware financial guidance.

1. The Core Agentic Architecture (3 Consolidated Agents)

- Behavioral Data Agent: (Merged Income & Spend Analyser). Strategic Focus: Monitoring & Behavioral Flagging. Its responsibility is Data Ingestion & Audit. It tracks income volatility, identifies "Show-off Spending" and impulse buys, and serves as the trigger for all behavioral nudges.

- The CHANAKYA Agent 👑 (Credit Health, Autonomous Nudging, And Knowledge-Yielding Advisor): Strategic Focus: Strategy, Accountability, & Reporting. This is the Master Strategist, Execution, & Reporting hub. It manages Debt Ratio, implements the "Invest Before Purchase" plan, integrates CIBIL Score, and operates the Reward Engine.

- Insurance Recommender: (Dedicated Agent). Strategic Focus: Foundational Risk Mitigation. Its responsibility is Risk Management, verifying and recommending mandatory Term and Health Insurance coverage, and directly managing the primary revenue stream.

2. Behavioral Enforcement and Strategic Planning

- Fraudulent App Screening: The CHANAKYA Agent maintains a "Negative Registry" (built from public consumer reports and regulatory warnings).

- If the Behavioral Data Agent detects a transaction linked to a blacklisted entity, the CHANAKYA Agent issues an URGENT WARNING and provides immediate steps to freeze payments.

- Prioritized Debt Attack: The CHANAKYA Agent mandates that the user's focus must be on paying off the highest-interest debt first.
    
- This directive overrides all other financial advice (including non-essential savings/investment goals) until the user is free from toxic debt, directly protecting the user's CIBIL Score.

- Positive Reinforcement: The CHANAKYA Agent manages the FFP Reward Engine, awarding Financial Freedom Points (FFP) instantly for positive actions like delaying impulse buys or setting an SIP.

- Loss Aversion: The Behavioral Data Agent triggers the transfer for Opt-Out Defaults, where surplus income is automatically saved unless the user actively reverses the action.

- Goal Nudging: The CHANAKYA Agent enforces the "Invest Before Purchase" strategy for both short-term (EMI) and long-term goals by initiating SIP/MF recommendations.

- Impulse Interruption: The Behavioral Data Agent detects an impulse and triggers the "Health Checkup Nudge" to force reflection on "spending tomorrow's money today."

- Cost Transparency: The CHANAKYA Agent embeds Cost Visualization directly into the UI, instantly showing the total interest cost or opportunity cost of a purchase.

- Credit Accountability: The CHANAKYA Agent uses CIBIL Score transparency and reporting on Consequences of Non-Repayment and Good vs. Bad Debt to prioritize debt reduction strategies.

3. Revenue Model and Implementation Focus

- Insurance Selling Trail Income: Triggered by the Insurance Recommender when a coverage deficit is identified.

- MF Selling Trail Income: Triggered by the CHANAKYA Agent when it implements the strategic "Invest Before Purchase" plan.

- Educational Products Selling: Triggered by the CHANAKYA Agent offering premium products (e.g., financial games) for FFP redemption or direct purchase.

**Fintech: Build an autonomous financial coaching agent that adapts to real user behavior, spending patterns, and income variability - helping gig workers, informal sector employees, and everyday citizens make smarter financial decisions proactively.**

**Description of your solution**

We propose an autonomous AI agent to manage unpredictable patient surges in hospitals during festivals, pollution spikes, or epidemics. The system begins with a multi-source data pipeline, collecting hospital admissions, environmental metrics (AQI, temperature, humidity), and event/festival calendars, which are preprocessed and transformed into engineered features such as rolling averages, lag variables, and day-of-week flags. Patient load is forecasted using a hybrid approach: XGBoost handles tabular features for fast, accurate short-term predictions, while LSTM and Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT) capture complex temporal dependencies and long-term trends with interpretable attention-based insights. TFT’s multi-horizon forecasting capability further enhances surge prediction accuracy by integrating static, known future, and observed past variables while providing explainability on key temporal and feature-level drivers. Forecasts feed into a Python-based rule engine, which translates predicted surges into actionable recommendations, including staff allocation, supply adjustments, and automated patient advisories. A reinforcement learning module optionally optimizes these decisions over time, balancing staffing, inventory, and patient service efficiency. To generate contextually accurate patient messages, the system integrates RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to reduce hallucinations and NLP transformers to produce concise, actionable advisories. A decoder module converts model outputs into structured actions, and LangGraph orchestrates the end-to-end workflow, automating data ingestion, forecasting, decision-making, message generation, alert delivery, and logging. A dashboard (Streamlit/Dash) visualizes predictions, recommendations, and alerts, while a feedback loop continuously updates models and rules, and optional SHAP-based explainability highlights the factors driving surge predictions. This architecture ensures a robust, autonomous, and interpretable system capable of proactive, data-driven hospital operations.

**Healthtech: Manage unpredictable surges in patients during festivals, pollution spikes, or epidemics with an AI agent that autonomously analyzes data and recommends staffing, supply, and patient advisory actions in advance.**

Our project directly addresses the problem of managing unpredictable patient surges during festivals, pollution spikes, or epidemics by deploying an autonomous AI agent. The system collects and analyzes multi-source data—including hospital admissions, environmental metrics, and event calendars—and uses a hybrid forecasting model (XGBoost + LSTM) to predict patient load in advance. A rule-based decision engine, optionally optimized with reinforcement learning, converts these predictions into actionable recommendations for staffing and supply allocation, while NLP combined with RAG generates context-aware patient advisories. The entire workflow is orchestrated via LangGraph, enabling the agent to autonomously fetch data, run forecasts, execute actions, and log outcomes. This ensures hospitals can proactively plan resources and communicate timely guidance to patients, fully realizing the objectives described in the problem statement.

**Description of your solution**

Aarogya Setu is an innovative medication adherence application crafted exclusively for elderly users, integrating agentic AI at its core to ensure not just reminders but comprehensive, context-aware medication management. Unlike traditional apps that rely on static reminders, this solution deploys intelligent agents capable of dynamically adapting to individual routines, cognitive patterns, and health needs. The agentic AI personalizes every aspect -from reminder modes and timing to medication guidance and adaptive interventions -while leveraging behavioral insights to optimize engagement and safety. Its Hindi-first interface, accessible design, and one-tap navigation ensure seamless use by elders irrespective of their digital literacy.

The app’s impact lies in bridging crucial gaps that persist in current adherence solutions, particularly the lack of objective verification and deep provider collaboration. Incorporating features such as camera-based pill verification, voice-activated assistance, caregivers’ dashboards, and direct API integration with pharmacy and healthcare providers, the app minimizes manual entry, reduces medication errors, and fosters a collaborative support ecosystem. AI-driven analytics not only identify adherence risk proactively but also deliver empathetic nudges, mood-sensitive prompts, and routine health check-ins, supporting elders’ mental and emotional health alongside their physical wellbeing.

For elders, the application means more consistent medication intake, fewer hospitalizations, and greater independence. Unique features - like multi-language voice instructions, personalized motivational content, and real-time emergency alerts for missed doses or adverse events - set it leaps ahead of market competitors. This project demonstrates how blending agentic AI with deeply empathetic design dramatically enhances safety, autonomy, and quality of life for seniors, representing a powerful, scalable advancement for elder care and digital health innovation.

The system continuously adapts to each elder’s behavior, routine, and health status, providing personalized interventions, empathetic nudges, and real-time assistance. By combining AI-driven decision-making, camera-based verification, and caregiver collaboration, it demonstrates how agentic intelligence can proactively enhance patient safety, independence, and health outcomes, making it a strong example of innovation in intelligent healthcare solutions.

**Description of your solution**

In India’s rapidly growing gig and informal economy, millions of workers face one persistent challenge — income uncertainty. From cab drivers and freelancers to small vendors and delivery partners, fluctuating earnings make it nearly impossible to plan savings, manage expenses, or invest wisely.

FinMate is an AI-powered autonomous financial coaching agent built to solve this problem. Using behavioral data, income analytics, and adaptive learning, FinMate understands each user’s earning rhythm, spending patterns, and cash flow cycles. It then provides personalized, real-time financial guidance — from smart budgeting and bill predictions to saving nudges and credit advice — all tailored to the user’s unique financial life.

Unlike static finance apps, FinMate evolves continuously — learning from every transaction, behavior, and goal. Through conversational AI, it interacts naturally with users, translating complex financial insights into simple, actionable steps. Over time, it builds a financial profile and adaptive strategy for each individual, helping them transition from financial instability to long-term growth.

By combining AI-driven intelligence, empathy, and accessibility, FinMate aims to redefine financial inclusion — giving every earner, regardless of background or income variability, the power to make smarter, proactive financial decisions.

The project directly addresses one of India’s most critical challenges — financial instability among gig workers and informal sector earners. By using real-time behavioral data, FinMate transforms passive financial tracking into proactive, autonomous coaching, providing users with personalized budgeting, savings, and investment strategies that evolve with their income variability.

This approach embodies the track’s core purpose — using technology to drive social and economic empowerment — bridging the gap between advanced financial systems and individuals often excluded from them. FinMate uses AI not just for automation, but for human-centric financial empowerment, making smart money management accessible, adaptive, and inclusive for every citizen.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

**Problem Statement**
Detect and Counter Emerging Misinformation Trends
In today’s digital world, misinformation spreads faster than facts. Existing detection systems identify fake news only after it goes viral. There is a critical need for an AI-driven solution that can detect emerging misinformation patterns early, explain why they are false, and help counter them effectively.
________________________________________
**Solution**
VivaraaPulse is an AI-powered system designed to detect, analyze, and counter emerging misinformation trends across social and digital media in real time.
It doesn’t just classify content as true or false — it identifies patterns of misleading information as they start to trend, explains why they might be false, and suggests verified counter-information.
________________________________________
 **Key Features**
1.	AI Trend Detection:
Uses NLP and clustering models (BERT embeddings, K-means) to detect new misinformation clusters before they go viral.
2.	Fact Verification:
Compares claims with trusted databases (Google Fact Check API, PolitiFact, etc.) using semantic similarity search.
3.	Explainable AI:
Generates clear explanations of why a claim might be false and links to verified sources.
4.	Multilingual & Real-Time:
Supports multiple Indian languages for detecting misinformation beyond English.
5.	Interactive Dashboard:
Displays trending misinformation topics, spread rate, and credibility scores.
6.	Counter-Action Module:
Suggests verified articles or generates AI-based counter messages to reduce misinformation impact.
________________________________________
 **Tech Stack**
•	Backend / AI: Python, HuggingFace Transformers, scikit-learn
•	Frontend: React / Streamlit / v0.dev
•	Database: MongoDB / Firebase
•	APIs: Fact Check APIs, Twitter/X API (or datasets)
•	Libraries: LangChain / LlamaIndex for RAG-based chatbot
________________________________________
**AI/ML Techniques**
Function	Model / Method
Text understanding	BERT / RoBERTa embeddings
Trend clustering	K-Means / DBSCAN
Sentiment analysis	Transformer-based classifier
Fact verification	Semantic similarity (cosine)
Explainability	LLM summarization
Counter message	GPT-based generation
________________________________________ **Target Audience
Audience**	Why They Need It
News & Media	Detect trending misinformation early to prevent false reporting
Government Agencies	Monitor and respond to harmful misinformation campaigns
Social Media Platforms	Automatically flag and track misinformation trends
Fact-Checking Organizations	Prioritize what to verify next
Researchers / Educators	Study misinformation spread patterns
General Public	Verify and understand misinformation easily
________________________________________
**Uniqueness**
•	Focuses on emerging trends, not just detection of individual posts.
•	Proactive, not reactive — acts as an early warning system.
•	Offers Explainable AI outputs (why it’s fake).
•	Supports multi-language detection for Indian contexts.
•	Includes counter-action suggestions — not just detection.
•	Evolving system that learns new misinformation patterns over time.
________________________________________
**Use & Impact**
VivaraaPulse enables real-time monitoring and early detection of misinformation, empowering journalists, governments, and social platforms to act before misinformation goes viral.
It promotes digital literacy, combats fake narratives, and strengthens trust in information ecosystems — making AI a force for truth and awareness.

**Misinformation: Create an Agentic AI system that continuously scans multiple sources of information, detects emerging misinformation, verifies facts, and provides easy-to-understand, contextual updates to the public during crises.**

Our project directly tackles the core challenge of the Misinformation track —** identifying, understanding, and countering the rapid spread of false information online.**

Unlike traditional fake-news detectors that only label content as true or false, *VivaraaPulse* focuses on the emerging patterns of misinformation — detecting them before they go viral.

By leveraging AI and NLP, the system continuously analyzes social and digital content to:

Detect new misinformation trends as they form,

Provide explanations and verified sources, and

Help counter the spread through factual insights.

This proactive, AI-driven approach transforms misinformation management from reactive correction to preventive detection, empowering media houses, governments, and fact-checkers to take early action.

In essence, *VivaraaPulse* fits perfectly into the Misinformation track because it uses artificial intelligence for social good — combating the spread of false information, strengthening trust in digital communication, and promoting an informed online community.

**Description of your solution**

CrisisGuard , an Agentic AI system designed to combat misinformation during global or local crises such as pandemics, conflicts, or natural disasters. It acts as an autonomous digital analyst that monitors multiple content streams — including news, social media, and messaging platforms — to detect and verify emerging misinformation in real time.

The system is powered by a network of specialized AI agents:

An Intake Agent extracts text, images, and links from user content.

A Verification Agent cross-checks claims using trusted data sources like Google Fact-Check, Safe Browsing, and open news APIs.

A Reasoning Agent then explains findings in simple, contextual language, helping users understand why something may be misleading.

A Learning Agent continuously improves detection accuracy based on feedback and evolving misinformation patterns.

CrisisGuard empowers citizens to verify information instantly, promotes media literacy, and helps prevent misinformation-driven panic or harm during crises.

**Misinformation: Create an Agentic AI system that continuously scans multiple sources of information, detects emerging misinformation, verifies facts, and provides easy-to-understand, contextual updates to the public during crises.**

CrisisGuard directly aligns with the Agentic AI misinformation track by acting as an autonomous AI agent network that detects and verifies emerging misinformation during global or local crises.

It continuously scans content streams — such as news articles, social media, and messaging platforms — to identify misleading or false information related to pandemics, climate events, or geopolitical issues. Using a combination of verification agents (for fact-checking and source validation) and reasoning agents (for contextual explanations), CrisisGuard provides users with clear, human-understandable insights into why a claim may be false or manipulative.

The system’s agentic behavior enables it to cross-reference data in real time, generate educational explanations, and learn from user feedback — fulfilling the track’s goal of building self-improving, transparent, and accessible AI systems that empower citizens to act on verified information during crises

**Description of your solution**

What We Plan to Build
CredMate is an Agentic AI platform that provides alternative credit scoring and personalized financial coaching for gig workers and individuals with irregular income.
 The system continuously learns from users’ transaction data, wallet behavior, gig payouts, and bill payments, generating a dynamic AI credit score and actionable insights.
 A multilingual financial coach chatbot (powered by LLMs) engages users in simple, local-language conversations, helping them improve creditworthiness, manage cash flow, and build saving habits.

Pain Points Addressed
Unbanked and underbanked gig workers struggle to access loans due to lack of formal income proof.
Existing credit scoring models fail for irregular or multi-source earners (freelancers, delivery agents, etc.).
Financial literacy gap — most users can’t interpret credit terms or manage variable income effectively.

Target Audience
Gig and platform workers (Swiggy, Uber, Zomato, UrbanClap, freelancers).
Informal sector employees and small traders with digital transactions but no formal salary slips.
Fintech lenders and NBFCs looking for better risk profiling of such users.

Core AI Agent (Theme: Agentic AI)
Learning Agent: Continuously adapts to new transaction data to update credit score and detect risk patterns.
Coaching Agent: A multilingual LLM-based chatbot that gives personalized, contextual, and language-appropriate advice.
Example: “आपका खर्चा पिछले हफ्ते 20% बढ़ा है, थोड़ा कम करें ताकि EMI आराम से दे सकें।”

Go-To-Market (GTM) & Revenue Model
Phase 1 (B2C): Freemium app for gig workers – free financial insights, paid “credit health report.”
Phase 2 (B2B): API partnerships with fintechs, NBFCs, and gig platforms to provide alternative credit data.
Revenue Streams:
Subscription for advanced credit insights.
Commission from partner lenders for verified credit-ready users.
Data analytics service for financial institutions (anonymized behavioral data).

It uses Agentic AI agents that autonomously learn from real-world financial behavior wallet transactions, gig payouts, and bill payments  to produce a dynamic, explainable credit score and actionable insights.

The platform’s Learning Agent adapts in real time to changing income patterns, while the Coaching Agent (a multilingual LLM-based chatbot) delivers personalized financial advice and spending alerts in local languages.

This project demonstrates how autonomous, goal-oriented AI systems can bridge the gap between data-driven credit scoring and human financial behavior a perfect intersection of FinTech innovation and Agentic AI.

**Description of your solution**

FinGuru.AI is a next-generation, autonomous, encrypted, and continuously learning financial coaching agent that helps users make smarter, data-driven money decisions through a clean, ChatGPT-style conversational interface.

It functions as both a local private mentor and a cloud-connected AI advisor, powered by Ollama (Phi-3), LangChain, and Flask, with end-to-end encryption (AES-128/Fernet) ensuring total user privacy.

🧠 Core Concept

FinGuru.AI blends financial analytics, AI reasoning, and privacy-first engineering into one chat-based assistant that behaves like a human financial mentor — tracking expenses, forecasting budgets, alerting overspending, and advising in real time.

Users can simply chat with their finances — asking things like:

“Show my last 3 months’ spending,”
“Will this purchase hurt my savings goal?”
“Predict my next month’s budget.”

The AI replies conversationally, visualizes spending trends, and even rebalances budgets dynamically — all within a minimal monochrome chat UI.

⚙️ Tech Stack

Frontend: React + TailwindCSS (ChatGPT-like UI)

Backend: Flask / FastAPI

AI Core: Ollama (Phi-3), LangChain memory & tools

Encryption: Python Cryptography (AES-128, Fernet)

APIs: Google Finance, CoinGecko, Gmail, Sheets

ML Models: Prophet / ARIMA for expense forecasting

🔐 Key Highlights

Fully Encrypted: Every chat, file, and report is protected end-to-end.

Dual Mode: Works offline (Local LLM) or in secure Cloud Mode.

Adaptive Learning: Reinforcement Learning for personalized insights.

Minimal UI: ChatGPT-style interface — white/black theme, zero clutter.

Real-Time Market Intelligence: Fetches live finance & crypto updates.

Dynamic Budgeting: Auto rebalances goals when overspending occurs.

Smart Automation: Alerts for price drops, subscriptions, and bills.

Privacy Dashboard: Decrypt, delete, or export all data anytime.

💎 Feature Summary (32 Total)

End-to-End Encryption (AES-128)

**Description of your solution**

***Locallens – AI-Powered Hyperlocal Discovery Platform***
**Overview:**
Locallens is an Agentic AI-driven hyperlocal discovery platform designed to revolutionize product search, comparison, and purchase from online and nearby stores in real time. By merging AI perception, autonomous decision-making, and community collaboration, Locallens forms a cohesive ecosystem that intelligently guides users to the most efficient and sustainable buying options through multi-modal inputs including links, images, and voice queries.

**Problem Statement:**
Today's shoppers are burdened by fragmented experiences — switching apps, visiting multiple stores, or dealing with outdated inventory information. Small merchants lack digital visibility and inventory accuracy, leading to lost revenue. Locallens solves this via autonomous AI agents that manage product recognition, inventory forecasting, route optimization, and verified discovery, with sustainability and community empowerment at the core.

**Core Features:**

Universal Product Resolver: Uses computer vision and NLP to identify products via pasted links, scanned images, or voice.

Real-Time Comparison Engine: Aggregates data from merchant APIs and scrapers to display stores with price, stock, pickup times, and CO₂ impact.

AI Trip & Bulk Order Planner: Optimizes multi-store bulk orders minimizing travel and carbon emissions while maximizing fulfillment.

Stock Freshness & Community Verification: Allows users to verify stock at local stores, earning reputation and discounts, enhancing data accuracy.

AI Sustainability Engine: Calculates carbon savings for routes and orders, encouraging eco-conscious shopping through green tagging.

Referral & Reward Ecosystem: Double-sided 15% discount rewards for successful referrals tracked dynamically by AI to drive organic growth.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/2a1d4bcb863a4bdcb2a99970d486130e/89d82929-cdca-455a-b39a-c5c7af7f4bd5.png)

**Technical Implementation:**

Frontend: Built with Flutter for cross-platform rich UI featuring search, comparison, planner, and reward modules.

Backend: Python FastAPI and Node.js microservices on Google Cloud, integrating Gemini Vision Pro API, Hugging Face NLP, and Google Maps for routing.

Inventory Module: Combines REST APIs and asynchronous scraping, cached using Redis for data freshness.

Database: Firebase Firestore or MongoDB for user profiles, verification, and referral data.

AI Agent Workflow: Orchestrates intent parsing, data collection, optimization, and verification agents autonomously.

Security: OAuth 2.0 authentication, input sanitization, and AES encryption assure privacy and data security.

Discovery via link, voice, or image input.
Real-time product comparison from local to online stores.
AI-generated route and pick-up planning for efficiency and sustainability.
Post-purchase stock verification and referral rewards.

Dashboard presenting time, cost, and environmental savings.

**Impact & Scalability:**
Locallens saves users time and money, empowers local merchants with digital presence and analytics, and promotes sustainable consumption. The modular API-first architecture ensures scaling into new verticals like groceries, pharmacies, and logistics.

**CareSync: Real-Time Hospital Resource Optimization Ecosystem**
CareSync is a real-time hospital resource optimization system that syncs patients, staff, and equipment into one smart ecosystem. Using IoT tracking and predictive analytics, it makes sure critical care is never delayed—because every second in healthcare counts. Imagine a hospital where every vital sign is heard and every resource moves exactly when needed.

*What We Are Building*
A smart ecosystem that monitors everything—from patient heartbeats to the exact location and status of beds, ventilators, oxygen tanks, and wheelchairs.

*How It Works*
-IoT-Tagged Equipment: Each asset shares its availability, faults, maintenance needs, and location.

-Smart Patient Wristbands: Wearables track pulse, oxygen, and temperature in real time, sending alerts for quick staff action.

-Live Dashboard: Gives staff a real-time overview so they can quickly assign resources and spot shortages.Alerts like “PATIENT #A102 – PULSE EXTREMELY LOW. SEND BED + WHEELCHAIR NOW!” trigger immediate resource allocation and flag shortages.


*Why CareSync Rocks!*
-Detects risks early to prevent critical delays.

-Turns hospitals from reactive places into smart, connected ecosystems.

-Optimizes equipment use and cuts overspending.

-Saves time by removing frantic equipment searches.

-Predicts staffing needs for smarter shift planning.

-Connects patients, staff, and equipment in one efficient system.

*Hackathon Power Play*
CareSync turns hospitals into smart living systems where data talks and seconds save lives—designed to scale, perfect for any hospital ready to level up. Think of CareSync as the "Spotify for hospital resources"—keeping everything in perfect rhythm! Fun, fast, and built to impress.

*Technologies Used*
-We track equipment with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) tags and use Ultra-Wideband (UWB) for super precise location.

-Patients wear smart wristbands that continuously monitor key vitals and send live alerts.

-Data flows securely and quickly using BLE, Wi-Fi, and MQTT protocols from devices to cloud.

-Our apps use React Native and React.js for mobile and web interfaces, with Node.js and Python powering the backend.

-Cloud services like AWS IoT and Azure IoT Hub handle data, with machine learning models predicting urgent needs and emergencies.

-Built on popular, affordable open-source tools, making it scalable and adaptable.

-Responds to hospitals’ urgent need for smarter, safer resource management.

*Challenges & Solutions*
-We take data privacy seriously, following HIPAA and GDPR with strong encryption and secure APIs.

-Change management is tackled with training and intuitive design that eases adoption.

-Hardware reliability is ensured with quality devices and scheduled maintenance.

*Scalability & Future Vision*
CareSync is designed to scale effortlessly from small clinics to large hospitals. As the ecosystem grows, advanced AI and possible telehealth integration will continuously improve care, making every second count even more.

*Closing Statement:*
CareSync is more than just a tool. It’s an evolving healthcare ecosystem connecting every part of patient care. By empowering staff with timely, precise information, we make hospitals more efficient, compassionate, and ready for the future of healthcare.

**Description of your solution**

# Problem

Healthcare systems often struggle with operational inefficiencies that impact patient care and staff productivity. Sudden surges in patient load, caused by festivals, pollution spikes, or epidemics, can overwhelm hospitals. Outdated manual workflows make it difficult to adjust staff schedules, manage supplies, and coordinate patient care in real time.

# Solution: Narada AI

Narada AI is a multi-agent, AI-driven hospital operations system. Each agent specializes in a particular aspect of hospital management (patients, staff, inventory, or external factors), while communicating with other agents to maintain smooth operations. The system autonomously predicts and handles patient surges, dynamically adjusts workflows, and continuously learns from outcomes to improve efficiency over time. A centralized dashboard offers full visibility and human override capabilities.

# Multi-Agent Architecture & Features
1. Data Integration & Monitoring Agent
- Gathers real-time hospital data: patient check-ins, staff availability, and inventory levels.
- Monitors external signals such as local events, pollution spikes, or epidemics.
- Stores data centrally in a PostgreSQL database accessible to all agents.
2. Workflow Automation Agents
- Each operational task is handled by a dedicated agent:
- Staff Agent: Dynamically adjusts schedules, reallocates staff during surges.
- Inventory Agent: Monitors supply levels and triggers restocking of critical items automatically.
- Patient Communication Agent: Sends notifications, advisories, or appointment updates to patients.
- Agents continuously exchange information to ensure cohesive decision-making.
3. Decision-Learning Agent
- Observes outcomes like patient wait times, staff overload, or supply shortages.
- Implements feedback loops to refine actions over time without requiring separate predictive models.
- Integrates reinforcement learning to explore and optimize workflow strategies.
4. Interface & Dashboard Agent
- Provides real-time visibility of hospital operations: patient flow, staff allocation, inventory.
- Allows human overrides for exceptional situations.
- Notifies staff through mobile apps or internal hospital systems.

# Impact
Narada AI transforms hospital operations from reactive to proactive. By autonomously coordinating staff, inventory, and patient workflows through specialized agents, hospitals experience:
- 30-40% reduction in patient wait times during surge periods.
- Optimized staff utilization, minimizing burnout and improving morale.
- Automated inventory management, reducing critical supply shortages.
- Improved patient satisfaction through timely communication and faster service.
- Enhanced decision-making with real-time visibility and adaptive learning.

**Healthtech: Manage unpredictable surges in patients during festivals, pollution spikes, or epidemics with an AI agent that autonomously analyzes data and recommends staffing, supply, and patient advisory actions in advance.**

Our Solution – Narada AI addresses unpredictable patient surges during festivals, pollution spikes, or epidemics through a **multi-agent AI system**. Each agent **specializes in a key operational area** (staff management, inventory, patient communication, or external monitoring) and collaborates to maintain smooth hospital operations. The system integrates real time hospital data with **external signals, autonomously manages workflows, and continuously learns from outcomes to improve efficiency**. A **centralized dashboard** provides full visibility and human override capabilities, ensuring hospitals can proactively handle high demand events and deliver high quality care.

By combining predictive insights with **autonomous multi agent execution**, Narada AI goes beyond traditional advisory systems. Each agent not only recommends actions but also implements them in real time, **helping hospitals reduce wait times, prevent staff overload, and maintain adequate supplies** during critical periods.

**Description of your solution**

During major Indian festivals, seasonal pollution spikes, and epidemic outbreaks, hospitals often face unpredictable surges in patient volume. These sudden increases create shortages in medical staff, essential supplies, and hospital beds, leading to overcrowding and delays in treatment.

This project proposes an Agentic AI-driven predictive hospital management system that proactively analyzes multiple real-time data points—such as air quality index, festival calendars, weather conditions, disease trends, and historical patient inflow—to forecast demand surges in healthcare centers. The AI agent autonomously recommends optimal staffing levels, supply procurement, and patient advisory measures before crises occur.

**The Problem**: When our parents come home from the hospital, they are sent with a doctor's 
prescription, medications, and uncertainty. This uncertainty can lead to missed doses or unsafe 
guesswork, transforming a path to recovery into endless worry for the family. This is the important 
problem at the end of care that technology has never tackled with empathy. 
**Our Solution**: Saral Dawa (Simple Medicine) And this is why we are building Saral Dawa. It’s designed 
to be a trusted friend, in times of need. A family member takes a photo of the prescription, and Saral 
Dawa creates a visual schedule with images of the actual pills. No confusion. 
But the real peace of mind comes from its voice. Our parent can simply ask in Hindi, Marathi, or their 
own language, "I missed my morning pill, what should I do?" and receive an immediate clear, safe 
answer. Instead of making a guess, there is comfort in knowing exactly what to do next. 
**Conclusion:** How It Addresses the Issue Saral Dawa tackles this issue by converting a doctor's 
intricate instructions into uncomplicated, everyday dialogue by eliminating confusion and maximizing 
care. As a result, there is no miscommunication, no worry about medication errors causing re
hospitalization, and ultimately, it is giving our elderly the ability to independently manage their own 
health in a safe manner while providing their families with peace of mind.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Our project, Saral Dawa, fits the Healthtech track by solving the critical "last-mile" problem of patient care: medication safety after hospital discharge. We leverage a multi-agent AI system to bridge this gap. An AI Vision Agent autonomously deciphers handwritten prescriptions, a Scheduling Agent proactively creates a foolproof plan, and a voice-first Interaction Agent provides on-demand, safe advice in the patient's own language. By using Agentic AI to bring clarity and safety to the most confusing part of recovery, Saral Dawa directly prevents the errors that lead to re-hospitalization, making it a core Healthtech solution.

**Description of your solution**

AstraCare is an agentic, self-evolving AI system designed to help hospitals predict and proactively manage patient surges during festivals, pollution peaks, and epidemic outbreaks. Instead of reacting to crises, AstraCare enables data-driven, anticipatory healthcare management.

The platform continuously ingests real-time data from multiple sources — including AQI levels, weather forecasts, festival calendars, hospital occupancy data, and social media trends — and leverages time-series forecasting (LSTM/Prophet) and machine learning models to predict patient inflow and resource demand up to two weeks in advance.

Built on a multi-agent architecture using LangChain, AstraCare autonomously coordinates between specialized agents:

Sentinel Agent: Monitors environmental, social, and hospital data streams in real time.

Oracle Agent: Predicts upcoming surges, disease categories, and severity using ML forecasting.

Maestro Agent: Optimizes hospital operations by recommending staff schedules and automating supply orders (beds, oxygen, medicines).

Empath Agent: Engages with citizens via WhatsApp/SMS (using Twilio API), delivering personalized preventive care advisories to reduce unnecessary hospital visits.

(Optional) Guardian Agent: Runs “what-if” digital twin simulations to evaluate hospital preparedness for different emergency scenarios.

Technically, AstraCare integrates FastAPI, Kafka, PostgreSQL/MongoDB, and a React-based dashboard for hospital administrators. The system is designed as a SaaS solution with scalable tiers (Basic–Pro–Enterprise), enabling API integration with existing Hospital Information Systems (HIS).

By combining predictive analytics, autonomous decision-making, and citizen outreach, AstraCare transforms how hospitals prepare for surges—helping them move from reactive crisis management to proactive, intelligent healthcare operations.

**Healthtech: Manage unpredictable surges in patients during festivals, pollution spikes, or epidemics with an AI agent that autonomously analyzes data and recommends staffing, supply, and patient advisory actions in advance.**

AstraCare perfectly embodies the Healthtech track by transforming how hospitals manage unpredictable patient surges during festivals, pollution spikes, and epidemics. Today, most hospitals react after a crisis begins — AstraCare changes that paradigm by making hospital management predictive, proactive, and autonomous.

At its core, AstraCare is an agentic AI ecosystem that continuously learns from real-time data — AQI, weather, social trends, and hospital occupancy — to forecast upcoming patient inflow, predict disease patterns, and recommend optimized operational strategies. Its multi-agent architecture ensures that every layer of healthcare preparedness is covered:

Sentinel Agent detects early risk signals from multi-source data streams.

Oracle Agent uses ML forecasting to predict surges up to two weeks in advance.

Maestro Agent plans and automates resource allocation — staff, oxygen, beds, medicines.

Empath Agent proactively reduces patient load by sending personalized preventive advisories to citizens via WhatsApp/SMS.

This directly fulfills the track goal — AI-driven hospital management that autonomously analyzes data and recommends staffing, supply, and patient advisory actions in advance.

With its scalable SaaS model, interoperability with existing Hospital Information Systems, and a real-world-ready React-based dashboard, AstraCare represents a next-generation healthcare intelligence platform capable of reshaping how India’s hospitals anticipate and manage crises.

In short, AstraCare aligns with the Healthtech vision of “AI that saves time, resources, and lives.”
