**Description of your solution**

We are building NeuroAid an AI-powered early screening and care coordination tool designed for primary school children (Grades 2–5) to bridge the Specific learning disorder identification gap. It enables teachers, parents, and frontline health workers to conduct preliminary screening using a smartphone, helping identify children who need specialist referral before academic failure occurs. NeuroAid integrates AI-powered screening with agentic, autonomous intervention, serving as a one-stop ecosystem for early learning disability support.

Phase 1: Cognitive Differentiation focuses on distinguishing between slow learners (caused by low IQ) and those with Specific Learning Disorders (normal to high IQ but with learning difficulties) a crucial step often missed by schools and screening tools . Using a non-verbal cognitive assessment based on Raven’s Progressive Matrices principal , the system identifies whether a child’s challenges stem from low general intelligence or selective learning difficulties. NeuroAid employs fluid threshold scoring instead of rigid cut-offs, minimizing misclassification and ensuring that dyslexic children are not wrongly labeled as slow learners.

Phase 2: Handwriting-Based Dyslexia Screening leverages the accessibility of handwriting as an early marker for dyslexia. Parents or teachers upload a photo of the child’s notebook. The CNN model analyzes handwriting for letter reversals (b/d/p/q), inconsistent spacing, mirror writing, and phonetic spelling errors. If specific error patterns are detected, the AI generates a custom sentence containing those letters for re-assessment. After the second upload, NeuroAid computes a risk score and generates a screening report, highlighting whether the child may require professional evaluation. This phase ensures early detection without replacing formal diagnosis.

Phase 3: The Agentic AI Monitoring System transforms NeuroAid from a passive screening tool into an autonomous educational therapist. Once a child is identified as at-risk, the system continuously analyzes handwriting samples uploaded weekly, tracking progress in spacing, reversals, and formation quality. It makes dynamic decisions—increasing exercise difficulty when progress is steady, switching methods when it plateaus, and alerting parents when regression occurs. The agent learns from outcomes, adapting future exercises based on what worked best and refining its algorithms using psychologist feedback. Its autonomous reporting generates weekly and monthly summaries with metrics such as “Reversal errors reduced by X%,” ensuring real-time progress tracking.

Parents and children interact through a Dashboard featuring a Duolingo-style gamified interface with streak counters and progress bars. The dashboard presents a  personalised handwriting exercise plan generated by the AI, reinforcing motivation and measurable improvement through daily engagement.

Phase 4: Professional Integration Bridge connects AI-driven screening with real-world clinical expertise. NeuroAid generates specialist-ready progress reports, which can be shared with psychologists, occupational therapists, or special educators. The referral system tracks professional follow-ups, while the AI improves future predictions by learning from feedback, ensuring a collaborative, evolving model of care.

Hackathon MVP Deliverables will include:
 • Cognitive Gatekeeper UI for non-verbal assessment and SLD/slow learner categorization.
 • Handwriting Upload Interface with CNN-based dyslexia detection and adaptive sentence generation.
 • AI-Generated Screening Report summarizing detection outcomes.
 • Agentic Dashboard with gamified progress and exercise plans.
 • Psychologist Report Template showing improvement charts and handwriting comparisons.

NeuroAid redefines early learning support through accessible screening, personalised care, and autonomous AI intervention — ensuring that every child’s potential is recognised early and nurtured intelligently.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Dyslexia and Specific Learning Disorders (SLD) are neurobiological conditions arising from differences in brain structure and function—not educational weaknesses. This 
positions NeuroAid as a health tech innovation addressing a clinical need that demands structured screening, diagnosis, and therapeutic intervention.

India has an estimated 20–26 million school-aged children with SLD (8–10% of students). Yet, with only 0.07 psychologists per 100,000 population and even fewer trained in learning disabilities—millions of children go undiagnosed. Their struggles are often mistaken for laziness or low intelligence, leading to academic failure, damaged self-esteem, and early school dropout.


Research consistently shows that early identification during the formative years can transform a child’s developmental trajectory. This was powerfully illustrated in Taare Zameen Par, where recognizing Ishaan’s dyslexia at age eight allowed timely intervention when his brain was most adaptable. Early detection between ages 6–9 enables neural rewiring and prevents lifelong setbacks.

NeuroAid aims to bring that possibility to every child. Through AI-powered clinical screening and continuous therapeutic monitoring, it identifies early risk, generates specialist-ready reports, and coordinates ongoing progress tracking.

By combining neuroscience, artificial intelligence, and digital health, NeuroAid bridges the gap between early screening and long-term care—ensuring every child receives timely support, renewed confidence, and the chance to rediscover the joy of learning.

**Description of your solution**

Project **VARUNA** 
*(Virtual Agent for Responsive Unified Networked Assistance)*
“**From Data to Decisions — Instantly**”

- Focus: **Building the “Central Nervous System” for a Hospital.**

At this hackathon, Project VARUNA brings to life the vision of a hospital that can think and act in real time.
Instead of focusing on a single AI model, we’re building the core communication and coordination framework — the system that **allows different intelligent agents to collaborate seamlessly**, like neurons in a living brain.
Our prototype demonstrates this concept through **two essential agents:**

1. **Patient Intake & Triage Agent (PITA)**
2. **Dynamic Scheduling & Logistics Agent (DSLA)**

To test them, we’ll simulate a high-stress Emergency Department (ED) situation — where patients arrive in waves and every second counts. **VARUNA will autonomously manage triage, prioritization, and resource allocation**, showing how it can turn hospital chaos into coordinated action in moments.

- **Core Vision: An Event-Driven Symphony of AI Agents**

VARUNA isn’t just another hospital app — it’s a network of intelligent agents that communicate, reason, and respond together.
Think of it as air traffic control for healthcare — every “flight” (patient, doctor, bed, or ambulance) is tracked and guided through a shared intelligent hub.
This **ensures that critical resources are available exactly when and where they’re needed,** without bottlenecks or miscommunication.

- **A Real-World Scenario**

Imagine this: a local festival and rising pollution levels suddenly flood the ED with patients suffering from chest pain and breathing issues.
Here’s how VARUNA takes charge — autonomously and instantly:

**Patient A**: Reports crushing chest pain and sweating.
PITA flags a CTAS Level 1 (Resuscitation) and suspects STEMI.
DSLA immediately reserves a resuscitation bay, alerts cardiology, and preps the Cath Lab.

**Patient B**: Complains of cough and shortness of breath for three days.
PITA assigns CTAS Level 3 (Urgent) and suggests possible Asthma/COPD.
DSLA secures an ED bed and queues a chest X-ray order.

**Patient C**: Has a minor kitchen injury.
PITA assigns CTAS Level 4 (Less Urgent).
DSLA directs them to the Fast-Track clinic line.

All of this unfolds in **under 10 seconds.**
The **sickest patients are prioritized, critical teams are mobilized, and lower-acuity cases are efficiently routed** — all while maintaining a complete audit trail of every action.

- **Technical Architecture: Designed for Real-Time Intelligence**

1. Communication Hub – The Central Nervous System
**Tech Stack**: Node.js/Express or Python/FastAPI
**Protocol**: REST API + WebSocket for real-time, event-driven updates
**Function**: Serves as a Pub/Sub message router, ensuring all agents are instantly informed of relevant events.
**Data Standard**: **Built on FHIR** (Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources) for seamless medical data exchange.

2. Patient Intake & Triage Agent (PITA)
**Purpose**: Automates triage and urgency assessment based on patient-reported symptoms.
**Interface**: Web input for nurses; optional speech-based entry.
**AI Core**: Natural Language Understanding (NLU): Uses a fine-tuned LLM (like Med-PaLM) to interpret text or speech.
**Triage Logic**: Combines CTAS-based rule sets with LLM reasoning.
**Autonomy**: Publishes structured triage events like NEW_PATIENT_TRIAGED to the Hub.

3. Dynamic Scheduling & Logistics Agent (DSLA)
**Purpose**: Acts as the hospital’s autonomous operations manager, orchestrating resources in real time.
**AI Core**: Uses a Constraint Satisfaction Problem (CSP) solver to model capacity and constraints (e.g, “Cath Lab ready in <90 mins”).
**Database**: Real-time tracking via Firebase or in-memory store.
**Autonomy**: Subscribes to triage events and instantly allocates resources — updating all systems with new status events.

4. Simulation Dashboard – Mission Control
A unified, real-time dashboard that visualizes hospital operations.
**Features:**
- Live patient queue with triage levels and current status
- Resource availability (beds, staff, equipment)
- Event logs showing agent communications
- Manual override console for staff intervention

**Outcome**
We’ll **showcase VARUNA handling a sudden ED surge.**
You’ll see the entire chain — from patient arrival to triage, resource allocation, and care coordination — happening autonomously and in seconds.
- Instant prioritization of critical patients
- Real-time resource allocation across departments
- Transparency and traceability through event logs
- Reduced manual load on emergency staff

**Conclusion:**
VARUNA redefines hospital management by replacing static dashboards with a living ecosystem of intelligent agents.
Instead of waiting for human input, the system acts proactively — predicting needs, allocating resources, and empowering staff to focus on what matters most: saving lives.
With VARUNA, hospitals truly move
*"From Data to Decisions — Instantly."*

**Healthtech: Manage unpredictable surges in patients during festivals, pollution spikes, or epidemics with an AI agent that autonomously analyzes data and recommends staffing, supply, and patient advisory actions in advance.**

The VARUNA solution is a direct and targeted response to the challenge of managing unpredictable patient surges. It moves beyond simple alert systems to create a proactive, unified command center that autonomously translates real-time data into decisive actions.

During a surge from festivals, pollution, or epidemics, the core failure is systemic coordination breakdown, not just patient volume. VARUNA’s "System-of-Systems" architecture solves this by functioning as a central nervous system for the hospital. Specialized AI agents for triage and scheduling collaborate through a central hub, ensuring the entire organization reacts as a single, coordinated organism rather than disconnected parts.

The system excels at autonomously analyzing complex data, a key requirement. It processes both structured data (bed status) and, crucially, unstructured data (a patient's spoken symptoms). The Triage Agent uses Clinical NLP to interpret a complaint like "crushing chest pain," transforming it into an actionable, high-probability diagnosis.

Most critically, VARUNA doesn’t just recommend—it acts in advance. True surge resilience requires pre-emptive action. Upon identifying a high-acuity patient, the system autonomously executes a protocol: reserving the correct bed, alerting the relevant specialist, and pre-allocating critical resources like a catheterization lab. These are executed commands that secure vital resources, shaving critical minutes off response times and implementing a "staffing, supply, and patient advisory" plan instantly.

In essence, VARUNA is a purpose-built surge management platform. It transforms a hospital from a reactive organization, where staff struggle to keep up, into a proactive system that anticipates demand and executes a coordinated defense, ensuring the right care is delivered at the right time, no matter how unpredictable the surge.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/36791ba7a0a34205b344ffd00b9a49ee/db2165a5-dac1-4d6b-ae3e-40d537b5a982.jpeg)

Description of Swasthya AI :-

**Svasthya AI** is a proactive, agentic AI system designed to empower Indian hospitals to move from a reactive to a predictive operational model. It functions as an intelligent, automated operations partner that not only forecasts patient surges but also analyzes the complex needs arising from them and recommends specific, prioritized, and actionable strategies. Our goal is to transform hospital management from a constant state of emergency response into a calm, data-driven, and forward-looking process.

Our solution is built on a sophisticated multi-agent architecture, where each agent has a distinct, collaborative role:

**Data Ingestion Agent (Data Weaver)**: This agent is the foundation of our intelligence. It continuously gathers and synthesizes vast streams of real time and historical data from a wide range of public and private sources. This includes tapping into APIs for environmental data (e.g, CPCB for hyper local Air Quality Index), scraping public health bulletins (NCDC, ICMR), integrating with festival and event calendars, and using Natural Language Processing (NLP) to monitor news and social media trends for early whispers of localized outbreaks or incidents. It also securely connects to anonymized historical hospital admission records to understand facility specific patterns.

**Prediction Agent (Oracle Engine)**: Using the clean, aggregated data from the Data Weaver, this agent employs an ensemble of advanced machine learning models, including Long Short term Memory (LSTM) networks for timen series forecasting and gradient boosting models to weigh the importance of different factors (e.g., pollution levels v/s a festival day). It generates a highly accurate 7 to 14 day forecast, detailing:

Expected patient influx volume, broken down by hour.

A probabilistic breakdown of likely medical conditions (e.g, a 70% chance of a surge in respiratory ailments, a 20% chance of trauma cases).

Predicted peak admission times and potential bottlenecks in the patient journey (e.g, ER registration, radiology).

**Resource Optimization Agent (Strategic Planner):** This is the core agentic component that translates predictions into action. It takes the Oracle Engine's forecast and generates a dynamic "Operational Readiness Plan". This is not just a list of suggestions; it's a prioritized set of clear, justified directives for hospital management. 
For example:
**Staffing:** "Increase ER nurses by 2 and respiratory therapists by 1 for the evening shift from Friday to Sunday. Justification: Predicted 40% increase in asthma-related admissions due to post-Diwali pollution."

**Supplies:** "Pre-emptively order 30% more nebulizer kits, specific antiviral medications, and IV fluids by Wednesday. Justification: Forecasted spike in viral fever cases aligning with seasonal change."

**Facilities**: "Prepare to convert Ward B into a temporary respiratory observation unit, allocating 15 beds for potential overflow. Justification: High probability of patient admissions exceeding standard ER capacity by 25%."

**Communication Agent (ConnectSphere):** This agent ensures the right information reaches the right people at the right time, in the right format. It automates and tailors communications:

**Internal Alerts**: It drafts and disseminates concise daily briefings and real-time alerts to hospital administrators and department heads via an integrated dashboard, email, or secure messaging apps.

**Public Health Advisories**: It generates simple, multi-lingual (English, Hindi, Marathi), and actionable health advice for the local community (e.g., "Mumbai's air quality is severe. The elderly and those with asthma should stay indoors.") to be pushed via the hospital's app, SMS broadcast, or social media channels, helping to manage the surge at its source by empowering the community.

2. **Specific Pain Points Addressed**

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/36791ba7a0a34205b344ffd00b9a49ee/fb91638d-4fa7-463a-b760-9a519c342205.jpeg)
Our solution directly tackles the critical inefficiencies and risks associated with unpredictable patient surges:

**Reduces Overcrowding & Wait Times**: By anticipating demand, hospitals can prepare in advance, ensuring smoother patient flow.

**Prevents Resource Shortages**: Proactive supply chain recommendations prevent critical stockouts of essential medicines and equipment.

**Optimizes Staff Allocation**: Prevents staff burnout by ensuring adequate staffing levels during high-pressure periods and avoiding overstaffing during lulls.

**Improves Patient Outcomes**: Ensures that facilities are prepared and patients receive timely, high-quality care, even during a crisis.

**Shifts Hospitals to a Proactive Model**: Moves operational strategy from "fire-fighting" during a surge to data-driven, forward-looking preparation.

**Healthtech: Manage unpredictable surges in patients during festivals, pollution spikes, or epidemics with an AI agent that autonomously analyzes data and recommends staffing, supply, and patient advisory actions in advance.**

The **Swasthya AI** project focus on managing unpredictable patient surges using an AI agent to recommend staffing, supply, and patient advisories is a direct and perfect match for the Healthtech problem statement.

#PROBLEM STATEMENT
The Financial Crisis Facing 450 Million Indians
India's gig economy and informal sector workers—representing 450 million people (Uber/Ola drivers, delivery partners, daily wage workers, freelancers, small vendors)—face a fundamental financial management crisis that traditional banking and fintech apps completely ignore:
Problem 1: Income Unpredictability

Income varies ₹800-₹3,000 daily with no fixed payday
Traditional monthly budgeting tools are useless for variable income
68% have ZERO emergency savings despite earning adequately
Run out of money by the 25th and borrow at 24-36% annual interest
Cannot plan expenses or save systematically

Real Impact: Rajesh, an Ola driver, earns ₹42K/month but has ₹0 in savings. By day 25, he borrows ₹5K from loan sharks to pay rent.
Problem 2: Cash Economy Invisibility

65% of Indian transactions are cash-based (RBI, 2024)
Manual expense entry is tedious → 98% abandon tracking within a week
No financial records = No creditworthiness for loans/rent
Money "disappears" with no accountability or insights

Real Impact: Meena, a vegetable vendor, lost ₹15K to theft because she couldn't use banks (no financial documentation).
Problem 3: Financial Illiteracy Barrier

76% of Indians lack basic financial literacy (NCFE Survey)
Don't understand SIPs, mutual funds, index funds, or PPF
Complex apps intimidate first-time users
Investment = Fixed Deposits only (3.5% returns vs 7% inflation = losing money)

Real Impact: Priya earns ₹75K/month but saves only ₹10K. Doesn't invest because "it's too complicated."
Problem 4: Reactive, Not Proactive
Existing apps show historical data passively
Users realize overspending AFTER the damage is done
No early warnings when approaching financial trouble
Miss investment opportunities during high-earning months

Real Impact: Users discover they're ₹8K over budget on day 28—too late to fix it.

📊 Problem Scale:
- 450M gig/informal workers underserved by traditional fintech
- ₹4.2 lakh crore consumer debt at predatory interest rates
- Only 27% of Indians invest (vs 55% in developed markets)
- Average savings rate: 12% (need 30%+ for financial security)
- Gig economy growing 15% YoY (fastest in the world)

 Total Addressable Market (TAM):
- 450M potential users × ₹1,200 ARPU = ₹54,000 crore/year
- Serviceable Addressable Market (SAM): ₹15,000 crore
- Serviceable Obtainable Market (SOM - 3 years): ₹200 crore

Problem 1: Income Unpredictability

Income varies ₹800-₹3,000 daily with no fixed payday
Traditional monthly budgeting tools are useless for variable income
68% have ZERO emergency savings despite earning adequately
Run out of money by the 25th and borrow at 24-36% annual interest
Cannot plan expenses or save systematically

Real Impact: Rajesh, an Ola driver, earns ₹42K/month but has ₹0 in savings. By day 25, he borrows ₹5K from loan sharks to pay rent.
Problem 2: Cash Economy Invisibility

65% of Indian transactions are cash-based (RBI, 2024)
Manual expense entry is tedious → 98% abandon tracking within a week
No financial records = No creditworthiness for loans/rent
Money "disappears" with no accountability or insights

Real Impact: Meena, a vegetable vendor, lost ₹15K to theft because she couldn't use banks (no financial documentation).
Problem 3: Financial Illiteracy Barrier

76% of Indians lack basic financial literacy (NCFE Survey)
Don't understand SIPs, mutual funds, index funds, or PPF
Complex apps intimidate first-time users
Investment = Fixed Deposits only (3.5% returns vs 7% inflation = losing money)

Real Impact: Priya earns ₹75K/month but saves only ₹10K. Doesn't invest because "it's too complicated."
Problem 4: Reactive, Not Proactive
Existing apps show historical data passively
Users realize overspending AFTER the damage is done
No early warnings when approaching financial trouble
Miss investment opportunities during high-earning months

Real Impact: Users discover they're ₹8K over budget on day 28—too late to fix it.

📊 **Problem Scale:**
- 450M gig/informal workers underserved by traditional fintech
- ₹4.2 lakh crore consumer debt at predatory interest rates
- Only 27% of Indians invest (vs 55% in developed markets)
- Average savings rate: 12% (need 30%+ for financial security)
- Gig economy growing 15% YoY (fastest in the world)

 **Total Addressable Market (TAM):**
- 450M potential users × ₹1,200 ARPU = ₹54,000 crore/year
- Serviceable Addressable Market (SAM): ₹15,000 crore
- Serviceable Obtainable Market (SOM - 3 years): ₹200 crore

**💡 DESCRIPTION OF OUR SOLUTION**
**FinFlow AI: Your Autonomous Financial Coach**

*"Adapting to YOUR income, YOUR spending, YOUR goals—proactively"*

We're building an AI-powered financial coaching agent that works autonomously in the background, learns from user behavior, predicts financial outcomes, and takes proactive action to prevent problems before they occur.
**
# HOW WE USE AI AGENTS (CORE INNOVATION)

*##Agent Architecture: 3 Autonomous AI Agents Working 24/7
 Agent 1: Voice Understanding Agent (NLP-Powered)*

Capabilities:
- Speech-to-Intent Recognition: Converts natural language to structured financial data.
- Context Awareness: Understands "paid 500 for Uber" = Transport Expense vs "got 1200 from Uber" = Income.
- Multi-lingual Understanding: Handles English-Hindi code-mixing ("Spent 450 rupees on sabzi").

*📊 Agent 2: Behavioral Analysis Agent (Pattern Recognition AI)*

Capabilities:
-Autonomous Monitoring: Runs continuously in background analyzing all transactions.
-Pattern Detection: Identifies spending/income patterns without manual input.
-Anomaly Detection: Flags unusual transactions using statistical models.
-Predictive Modeling: Forecasts future behavior based on historical trends.

*Agent 3: Investment Advisory Agent (Goal-Based Planning AI)*

 Capabilities:
- Dynamic Risk Profiling: Continuously updates user's risk tolerance based on behavior
- Adaptive Asset Allocation: Adjusts recommendations as financial situation changes
- Goal Autopilot: Autonomously monitors goals and intervenes when off-track.

**⚙️ Tech Stack (FinFlow AI**

Frontend: React.js • Tailwind CSS • Rechart
→ Responsive dashboard for income & expense tracking, visual SIP growth simulator, and chat-based financial assistant interface.

Backend: FastAPI • PostgreSQL • Redis (Celery)
→ Handles transaction parsing, data storage, and asynchronous agent processing for real-time financial insights.

AI / ML:  Gemini • LangChain • spaCy • scikit-learn • Proph
→ Powers natural language understanding, spending pattern recognition, anomaly detection, and predictive income/SIP forecasting.

Notifications: Twilio (WhatsApp/SMS) • ReportLab*
→ Delivers proactive financial alerts, SIP reminders, and auto-generated monthly performance reports.

Security: AES encryption • JWT auth • Local SMS parsing

FinBud is an AI-powered financial coaching assistant that helps users make smarter, data-driven financial decisions. It learns from each user’s spending patterns, income flow, and saving behavior, and then provides personalized insights and proactive suggestions almost like a human financial advisor that never sleeps. FinBud doesn’t just track expenses; it anticipates your needs, predicts potential shortfalls, and guides you toward better financial stability.

Built with a modern tech stack, FinBud combines FastAPI for a fast and efficient backend, React + Vite for a responsive and interactive user experience, and GPT4All, a local large language model, for intelligent and privacyfocused AI conversations. Using tools like Pydantic, SQLModel, and Chart.js, FinBud securely handles user data, visualizes financial trends, and makes complex analytics easy to understand.

What makes FinBud stand out is its adaptive intelligence it continuously learns from your behavior, updates its suggestions in real time, and predicts future financial situations before they happen. Users can chat naturally with FinBud, ask for personalized advice, track spending, and even receive alerts when their expenses exceed healthy limits.

By combining the power of AI, data analytics, and smart design, FinBud transforms personal finance from a stressful task into a simple, engaging experience. It’s not just another budgeting tool it’s your Finance Management Buddy, built to make financial wellness accessible, personal, and proactive for everyone.

**Fintech: Bring your own problem in Fintech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

FinBud perfectly aligns with the “Bring Your Own Problem in Fintech” theme by addressing one of the most overlooked challenges in modern financial management  helping individuals with irregular incomes make consistent, informed financial decisions. Gig workers, freelancers, and informal sector employees often face unpredictable earning cycles, making it hard to budget or save effectively.

To tackle this, FinBud leverages the power of Agentic AI a system that doesn’t just respond to inputs but takes initiative on behalf of the user. FinBud continuously analyzes real-time spending data, income variations, and behavioral patterns, then acts autonomously to generate personalized insights, proactive alerts, and financial coaching.

For instance, if the AI detects overspending trends or predicts an upcoming low-income phase, it proactively recommends saving strategies or expense optimizations without waiting for user prompts. This is what makes FinBud agentic it behaves like a self-driven financial assistant, capable of learning, reasoning, and acting independently to support the user’s financial wellness.

By integrating FastAPI, GPT4All (local LLM), and adaptive data analytics, FinBud embodies the essence of Agentic AI in Fintech combining autonomy, intelligence, and empathy to bridge the gap between raw financial data and meaningful financial decisions.

**Description of your solution**

Praxarth — The Science of Purposeful Work

Praxarth is an autonomous AI that aligns what you can do, what you want to do, and what the world actually needs — using rigorous science to turn learning into purposeful, sustainable work.

It is an agentic, science-backed AI platform that reconnects education, work, and wellbeing by turning human potential into reliably measurable, resilient performance. Built on a rigorous synthesis of cognitive science (deliberate practice, spaced learning, cognitive-load management, etc), behavioral design, and classic philosophical accounts of human purpose (Praxis + Purushārtha). 

Praxarth models each person as a compact “skill & purpose fingerprint,”—maps real job roles to task-level demands, and then autonomously creates a tailored, evidence-based pathway from learning to verified work performance — bypassing the “traditional rigmarole” while also factoring-in for mental health and long-term flourishing.

CORE PROPOSITION:
Replace single-shot lotteries and brittle credentialing race with progressive, verifiable pathways.

What Praxarth delivers (CONCISE):
• Personalized Skill Fingerprinting: short, validated psychometric & simulated micro-assessments yielding interpretable metrics. Verifying cognitive traits & task skills — yielding clarity & stability for the aspirant & reliability for the employer.
• Role→Task Mapping: automated decomposition of job descriptions into cognitive and behavioral demands.
• Adaptive training engine: microlearning, deliberate-practice tasks, spaced repetition, and simulated work problems.
• Agentic orchestration: autonomous scheduling, follow-up, and plan adjustment based on user behavior.
• Employer-grade signals: sandboxed performance metrics and micro-credentials that serve as reliable hard signals.
• Wellbeing safeguards: conservative risk thresholds, privacy-first data design, and bias/audit tooling. Adaptive pacing using a fatigue/burnout model and circadian-aware scheduling. The platform’s coaching agent issues humane, contextual interventions (nudges, restorative breaks, rescheduling, escalation to human support) so productivity improves without sacrificing wellbeing.
• Explainability: transparent rationales for recommendations so users and partners understand path selection and outcomes.

Tech & Method summary:
Praxarth combines large-model reasoning for high-level planning with lightweight controllers and rule-based safety layers for predictable, auditable actions. Assessment uses adaptive item-response principles and task simulations; scheduling optimizes for cognitive load, availability, and recovery windows; evaluation uses sandboxed microtasks to produce verifiable, employer-usable metrics. Design priorities: minimal, consented data collection; encryption and privacy by design; continuous fairness audits.

Risks & Mitigations (EXPLICIT):
• Bias & unfairness — mitigated by diverse data, fairness constraints, and audit logs.
• Privacy & sensitivity — mitigated by minimal data collection, encryption, and clear consent.
• Credential gaming — mitigated by performance-based, proctored sandbox tasks and behavioral fraud detection.
• Overmedicalization of stress signals — mitigated by conservative thresholds and human escalation.

Success metrics:
Short term: functioning agent demo, measurable pre/post gain on micro-tests, autonomous scheduling behaviors during demo.

Pilot metrics: engagement retention (30/60/90 days), validated skill gains on task batteries, employer interview/hire uplift.

Impact metrics (6–12 months): placement rate improvement, reduced burnout incidence among participants, and clear employer ROI on hiring.

Positioning & Asks: Praxarth sits at the intersection of EdTech, HealthTech, and Workforce solutions: an ethical, agentic AI that restores meaning to work and makes employability durable. For pilots and partnerships we seek university collaborators, mid-size employers for sandbox trials, and mentors for psychometric validation and fairness auditing.

![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![OpenAi](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenAi-333333?style=flat-square) ![AI/ML](https://img.shields.io/badge/AI/ML-333333?style=flat-square) ![n8n](https://img.shields.io/badge/n8n-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

SHAKTHI is an intelligent multi-agent AI ecosystem that delivers personalized, 24/7 PCOS management via WhatsApp, addressing the critical gap in accessible, affordable, and continuous care for 116 million Indian women suffering from PCOS. The system orchestrates five specialized AI agents built on n8n automation and GPT-4: AAHAR generates glycemic index-optimized Indian meal plans tailored to dietary preferences and budgets; FIT creates adaptive workout routines that sync with Google Fit and adjust based on menstrual cycle phases; AUSHADHI tracks medication adherence with smart reminders and automatically alerts doctors when non-compliance patterns emerge; CHANDRA employs LSTM-based prediction models to forecast periods and ovulation while logging symptoms to detect anovulation patterns; and SANGHA builds location-based support communities with AI-moderated content and arranges local meetups. These agents communicate cross-functionally through n8n workflows stored in PostgreSQL—for example, when CHANDRA detects menstruation, it automatically signals FIT to replace high-intensity workouts with gentle yoga, while AUSHADHI notifies AAHAR to pair medications with yogurt to reduce nausea. Unlike existing telehealth apps requiring expensive consultations or generic fitness trackers lacking PCOS-specific intelligence, SHAKTHI delivers clinically-validated, contextually-aware interventions through a platform already used by 487 million Indians (WhatsApp), with automated weekly progress reports synthesizing nutrition adherence, workout completion, medication compliance, and cycle predictions to generate actionable insights—all implementable within 48 hours using no-code workflows.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

SHAKTHI addresses the critical health tech challenge of chronic disease self-management for the 65.77 million women globally living with PCOS by deploying a multi-agent AI ecosystem that transforms reactive, fragmented care into proactive, personalized 24/7 support. Built on n8n workflows integrated with WhatsApp, SHAKTHI's five specialized AI agents (AAHAR for nutrition, FIT for exercise, AUSHADHI for medication adherence, CHANDRA for cycle tracking, and SANGHA for community support) collaborate intelligently to deliver context-aware interventions—such as cycle-adapted workouts, low-glycemic meal plans, and real-time medication reminders—that adapt continuously based on cross-agent data sharing and machine learning pattern recognition. This fits squarely into the $1.19 billion PCOS digital therapeutics market and addresses the documented gap where women with PCOS report needing accessible, reliable, culturally-sensitive digital self-management tools that go beyond simple tracking apps. By automating comprehensive care coordination through multi-agent systems—which research shows improves early disease diagnosis by 30%, reduces adverse drug events by 26%, and demonstrably improves patient outcomes in chronic disease management—SHAKTHI delivers scalable, affordable precision medicine to underserved populations via existing smartphone infrastructure, embodying the core promise of health tech: democratizing expert-level healthcare through intelligent automation

> “Before You Share It, FactCheckit.”

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

FactCheckit is an Agentic AI-powered misinformation detection and verification platform designed to combat false or misleading claims that emerge during global or local crises  such as pandemics, natural disasters, or geopolitical conflicts.
The system consists of autonomous AI agents that continuously monitor social media, news, and RSS feeds to detect trending or viral claims. These agents coordinate in real time to verify information using cross-referenced trusted sources.

For the hackathon, we plan to build FactCheckit, a system that consists of multiple specialized AI agents that coordinate in real time to monitor social media, news websites, and RSS feeds, detect trending or viral claims, and cross-check them against reliable sources. The platform verifies claims using global APIs like Google Fact Check Tools and NewsData.io, and falls back on verified Indian fact-check sources such as PIB Fact Check Telegram, Alt News, BOOM Live, and Factly.
When a user submits a claim through the web dashboard or via Telegram/WhatsApp chatbot, the agents:
Extract and standardize the factual statement.
Verify the claim through cross-referenced sources.
Generate a verdict (True, False, Misleading, or Unverified) with citation links and confidence scores.
Adapt dynamically, switching to alternative sources if a primary source is unavailable.
By autonomously detecting misinformation, reasoning over multiple sources, and providing clear, context-aware explanations, FactCheckit ensures citizens, students, journalists, and NGOs have access to reliable information during crises.
This platform demonstrates true agentic AI behavior, with self-directed reasoning, autonomous decision-making, and multi-agent coordination, providing a real-time, trustworthy, and scalable solution to combat misinformation.

Technologies, Frameworks, and Tools used -

Multi-Agent Orchestration: LangChain, CrewAI, Python Agents
AI Reasoning & NLP: Flan-T5, Llama-3 8B Instruct
Fact Verification APIs: Google Fact Check Tools API, NewsAPI
Data Ingestion / Scraping: Telethon (PIB Telegram), BeautifulSoup (Alt News, BOOM, Factly)
Backend: FastAPI (Python)
Frontend: React.js (Next.js), TailwindCSS
Chat Integration: Telegram Bot API, WhatsApp Cloud API
Database & Knowledge Layer: Firebase Realtime DB, SentenceTransformers / FAISS
Deployment / Hosting: Vercel (frontend), Render or Hugging Face Spaces (backend & agents)

Specific Pain Points Addressed -
Overload of Crisis Misinformation:
Social media is flooded with unverified posts during pandemics, conflicts, or disasters. FactCheckit’s autonomous AI agents continuously monitor social media, news, and RSS feeds to detect and flag emerging misinformation trends in real time.
Difficulty Verifying Claims Quickly:
Users often don’t know where to check if a claim is real. FactCheckit provides instant, AI-driven verification, cross-referencing multiple trusted global and Indian sources.
Lack of Reliable Indian Fact-Checking Tools:
Global APIs often miss local misinformation. FactCheckit integrates structured data from PIB Fact Check, Alt News, BOOM Live, and Factly via Telegram channel monitoring and RSS feeds to cover Indian-specific content.
Public Confusion Due to Complex Explanations:
Traditional fact-check reports are lengthy and technical. FactCheckit generates short, contextual, and human-readable summaries that are easy to understand and share.

 GTM & Revenue Strategy
Phase 1 - Awareness & Adoption (Launch Stage):
Target Users: Students, journalists, NGOs, fact-check communities.
Strategy:
Launch Telegram and WhatsApp bot versions powered by AI agents for instant fact verification.
Partner with college media clubs and journalism schools for beta testing.
Conduct workshops on misinformation awareness: “Check before you share.”
Leverage social media challenges and highlight a “verified claim of the day” for virality.
Phase 2 - Expansion & Partnerships:
Collaborate with media houses (NDTV, India Today) for backend API integration.
Partner with government fact-check units (PIB) to access verified claim feeds.
Work with NGOs, UNICEF, WHO local offices during crises for on-ground fact distribution.

Phase 3 - Monetization (Sustainable Model):
Freemium Access: Basic verification free, paid plans for unlimited use or advanced analytics.
FactCheckit API-as-a-Service: Provide API endpoints for media platforms and NGOs to auto-verify viral content.
Subscription Dashboard: Advanced analytics on misinformation trends, sources, and geolocation patterns.
Sponsored Awareness Campaigns: Partner with trusted media or government bodies for verified public campaigns.

Phase 4 - Future Ecosystem:
Browser extension to auto-flag misinformation inline.
AI-powered misinformation trend maps for journalists, policymakers, and NGOs.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/cb257cecdd4a4e889fb2fad844a1c039/0c53c766-4215-4348-a9c4-0e39fa6283d5.png)

**Misinformation: Create an Agentic AI system that continuously scans multiple sources of information, detects emerging misinformation, verifies facts, and provides easy-to-understand, contextual updates to the public during crises.**

FactCheckit is built around a true autonomous agentic architecture, rather than functioning as a simple chatbot. It leverages multiple specialized AI agents that work collaboratively to perform key tasks:

Detect: The DetectionAgent autonomously scans social media, news, and RSS feeds to identify trending or viral crisis-related claims.
Verify: The VerificationAgent independently cross-references claims against multiple trusted sources  including Google Fact Check API, NewsAPI, and verified Indian fact-check portals like PIB, Alt News, and BOOM.
Explain: The ExplainAgent generates clear, contextual, and audience-appropriate summaries of verification results.
Adapt: Agents dynamically coordinate; if a data source is unavailable or unresponsive, another agent selects alternative sources without human intervention.

This multi-agent system demonstrates self-directed reasoning, autonomous decision-making, and real-time verification, fulfilling the core criteria of Agentic AI. By actively orchestrating detection, verification, explanation, and adaptive fallback strategies, FactCheckit exemplifies a fully autonomous, reasoning-driven AI solution to combat misinformation.

> Every forward, first verify.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

1. The Problem
India is home to more than half a billion WhatsApp users—making it one of the most connected societies in the world, but also one of the most vulnerable to misinformation. False messages, photos, and videos spread rapidly across social media, often in multiple regional languages, long before fact-checkers can respond. This “infodemic” threatens not only public safety but also social trust.
Current fact-checking systems, while accurate, are often too slow, technical, or inaccessible to everyday users. What’s missing is a fast, simple, and reliable tool that fits naturally into people’s daily communication habits—something they can turn to before forwarding a message, not after the damage is done.

2. Our Solution: SatyaAI (सत्यAI)
SatyaAI is designed to be that first line of defense—an easy-to-use, AI-powered fact-checking assistant built around one core idea:
“Share करने से पहले, SatyaAI से पूछें” (Before you share, ask SatyaAI).
At its heart, SatyaAI functions as an agentic AI system—an intelligent agent capable of reasoning, verifying, and acting proactively. It operates in two main modes that complement each other:
A. Reactive Mode – Instant Fact-Checking
Users can copy and paste any message, link, or post that seems suspicious. SatyaAI instantly analyzes it and delivers a clear, color-coded verdict:
✅True (सत्य) | ❌ False (झूठ) | ⚠️ Misleading (भ्रामक)
Each response includes a numerical Trust Score (0–100) and a short, easy explanation in plain language.
B. Proactive Mode – Early Warning System
Behind the scenes, SatyaAI continuously scans open data sources using semantic trend analysis and anomaly detection. When it identifies a coordinated misinformation campaign or a rapidly spreading false narrative, it issues an alert through an “Emerging Topics” dashboard—helping communities and journalists stay ahead of harmful trends before they go viral.

3. Technical Design & The “Agentic” Framework
SatyaAI’s strength lies in its multi-model verification engine, which combines several AI systems to ensure balanced, evidence-based results. This reduces dependence on any single model and increases overall reliability.
The process works in the following steps:
   1)Language Detection & Translation:
The system automatically detects the language of the input message and converts it into English for consistent processing.
   2)Claim Extraction:
Using a large language model (LLM), SatyaAI identifies and separates individual factual claims from the user’s message.
   3)Parallel Cross-Verification:
Each extracted claim is independently verified through multiple trusted AI tools:
o	Google Gemini with Search: Performs live, evidence-based checks using authoritative online sources.
o	Grok API: Analyzes the spread of the information across X (formerly Twitter), studying virality, public reactions, and the origin of the claim.
   4)Final Verdict Synthesis:
A concluding AI model synthesizes the results into one grounded, fact-based report—translated back into the user’s original language for easy understanding.
This multi-agent structure ensures that the final output is not just an AI opinion but a verified synthesis of real-world evidence.

4. Vision and Impact
SatyaAI’s mission is to strengthen digital literacy and rebuild trust in public information. By giving users a free, reliable tool that they can access instantly, we aim to break the misinformation cycle at its source—the moment before a message is shared.
Looking ahead, we plan to integrate SatyaAI directly into WhatsApp via a chatbot interface, allowing users to fact-check messages inside the same platform where most misinformation spreads. This will make fact-checking as effortless as sending a text.
Our ultimate vision is a digitally empowered India—where every citizen has the means to verify truth from falsehood, helping create a more informed, resilient society.

Team **Runtime Rebels** -- Gaurav Raval, Ritesh Pal, Shrikrishna zade

> Proactive Money Guidance for Gig Workers

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![NumPy](https://img.shields.io/badge/NumPy-333333?style=flat-square) ![pandas](https://img.shields.io/badge/pandas-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

ArthMitra is a proactive, privacy-preserving financial coach that turns raw, permissioned traces (SMS/UPI alerts, bank PDFs/CSVs, gig payout exports, bills, and calendar cues) into a clean, daily cash-flow timeline. On this unified series, the system engineers volatility and liquidity features—rolling means and dispersion, burn rate, days-of-runway, upcoming bill load—and composes a simple Financial Health Score (FHS-360). A probabilistic forecaster produces multi-day, quantile forecasts (P10/P50/P90) to capture downside risk, while a risk classifier flags near-term hazards such as “bill likely to be missed in 7 days” or “runway < 3 days.” A lightweight contextual bandit then chooses the smallest helpful micro-action at the least annoying time, for example, “save ₹300 now,” “auto-split this spend,” or “part-pay this bill,” optimizing tone, timing, and amount from observed outcomes. A tool-using, multilingual LLM “Coach” generates one-tap nudges with why-now, ₹-impact, and a simple risk grade, retrieving plain-language snippets from RBI consumer basics and relevant central/state benefit schemes. Privacy is first-class: parsing and features are computed on-device by default; optional learning across users uses federated learning with differential privacy, so raw data never leaves the phone. Success is measured by more buffer days, fewer missed bills, and reduced emergency borrowing—practical resilience rather than abstract data.

**Fintech: Build an autonomous financial coaching agent that adapts to real user behavior, spending patterns, and income variability - helping gig workers, informal sector employees, and everyday citizens make smarter financial decisions proactively.**

Our project is for gig and informal workers. Their income goes up and down. Usual monthly-budget apps do not help them. We read SMS/UPI alerts, bank PDFs, gig payouts, and bills (with consent). We turn this into a simple daily cash-flow view. We predict near-term cash needs. We warn about missed bills and low balance early. We give one-tap actions like save, split, or reschedule. The app works in many Indian languages. It is easy to use, even on low-cost phones and with weak internet. Your data stays on the phone as much as possible. We keep clear consent records. Our goal is real results: more buffer days, fewer missed bills, and less emergency borrowing.

**Description of your solution**

Most small businesses don't fail because their idea is bad; they fail because they get buried under the day-to-day financial grind, wasting critical hours on bookkeeping instead of making sales. This critical operational gap is precisely what **Charter.ai** is engineered to fill. 

We introduce Charter.ai as an advanced **agentic AI co-pilot**, functioning as an interactive financial forecasting engine for **MSMEs**. Our platform's core capabilities include the **autonomous ingestion and parsing** of all invoices, which are then presented to the user for a simple 'human-in-the-loop' approval to ensure classification accuracy. This verified data is also compiled into **automated tax summary reports**, which perfectly categorize transactions for GST and Income Tax, providing a clean, verifiable document for a human accountant's final review. 

The entire system is accessible through a **multilingual, natural language interface**, allowing proprietors to query complex data and simulate scenarios in their local language. By transforming financial management from a reactive burden into a proactive, interactive simulation, Charter.ai provides the strategic clarity and control entrepreneurs need to focus on core business growth.

**Fintech: Bring your own problem in Fintech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

This project is a perfect fit because it tackles a classic Fintech problem, **helping small businesses stop drowning in invoices, cash flow stress, and tax prep**. But instead of just showing them a dashboard, we're using Agentic AI to build a **smart helper** that does the work with them. It proactively reads their bills, watches their bank balance, and, most importantly, acts like an active partner. The "financial chess" feature, which helps the owner game out different payment scenarios, is pure agentic AI; it's not a passive tool, it's an interactive co-pilot for their finances.

**Description of your solution**

# **Project Name: SIGNET**

### **Tagline: The Mark of Authenticity.**

### **1\. What We Plan to Build**

SIGNET is a foundational **Verification-as-a-Service engine** designed to be the trust layer for the internet. Our solution builds upon essential baselines (reverse image search, deepfake detection) with a proprietary, multi-layered analysis that sets it apart.

Our **Signet Agent**, an agentic AI, integrates into any platform via API to generate a real-time **"Signet Score"** a dynamic 0-100 credibility metric and a contextual brief, delivered as a simple JSON object.

The agent’s advanced verification is built on five pillars:

* **Pillar 1: Source Integrity:** Assesses the source’s historical **Reputation Score** and topic-specific **Bias Meter**.  
* **Pillar 2: Official Triangulation:** Scans for statements from pre-vetted official sources (government bodies, police) to authoritatively confirm or deny claims.  
* **Pillar 3: Satellite Verification:** Cross-references large-scale physical events with near-real-time satellite imagery for objective, visual evidence.  
* **Pillar 4: Coordinated Behavior:** Identifies inauthentic amplification by detecting network patterns typical of botnets or coordinated campaigns.  
* **Pillar 5: The Human Sensor Network (USP):** Crowdsources hyper-local, real-time verification from consenting users on the ground via geo-fenced requests.

### **2\. Pain Points Addressed**

SIGNET is engineered to solve core, systemic failures in current anti-misinformation efforts:

* **Speed:** Provides credibility assessments in seconds, combating misinformation that spreads in minutes.  
* **Context:** Reveals the crucial "who" and "why" behind information, not just the "what."  
* **Unverifiable Content:** Sidesteps AI-generated fakes by relying on physical-world evidence from both ground and orbit.  
* **Trust:** Decentralizes verification by empowering communities while triangulating with official data, building trust from the ground up.

### **3\. Target Audience**

Our B2B model targets platforms that serve millions of users:

* **Social Media & Content Platforms** needing moderation at scale.  
* **News Aggregators & Media Houses** protecting brand credibility.  
* **Government & Crisis Response Agencies** combating life-threatening rumors.

### **4\. Go-to-Market & Revenue Streams**

Our **GTM strategy** is a phased rollout: a focused pilot program, followed by API-led growth with a freemium model, and scaling to direct enterprise sales.

Our **revenue model** is feature-based, creating a clear value ladder for B2B customers:

1. **Developer Tier (Freemium):** Limited API calls to our baseline tools and basic Source Integrity analysis (Pillar 1\) to drive adoption.  
2. **Pro Tier:** Full access to Pillars 1 (Source Integrity), 2 (Official Triangulation), and 4 (Coordinated Behavior) to solve core digital misinformation threats.  
3. **Enterprise Tier:** Unlocks all five pillars, including the premium **Pillar 3 (Satellite)** and **Pillar 5 (Human Sensor Network)**. This tier includes the Premium Analytics Dashboard and dedicated support for critical infrastructure clients.

**Misinformation: Create an Agentic AI system that continuously scans multiple sources of information, detects emerging misinformation, verifies facts, and provides easy-to-understand, contextual updates to the public during crises.**

SIGNET is purpose built to meet the exact requirements of the Agentic AI Misinformation challenge. Our **Signet Agent** is designed as a proactive system that directly addresses each component of the problem statement:

* **Continuously Scans Multiple Sources:** SIGNET's five-pillar system is designed to ingest and analyze a wide array of information streams in real-time from social media posts and official government statements to live satellite feeds and crowdsourced human reports.
* **Detects Emerging Misinformation:** Through our Source Integrity and Coordinated Behavior pillars, the agent doesn't just react to known falsehoods; it proactively identifies emerging narratives from historically biased sources and flags content being amplified by inauthentic botnets.
* **Verifies Facts:** The core of our protocol is multi-layered verification. It triangulates claims against official sources, cross-references them with objective satellite imagery, and, for hyper-local events, validates them with our unique Human Sensor Network on the ground.
* **Provides Easy-to-Understand Updates:** The agent's final output is a simple, actionable **Signet Score** and a contextual brief. This allows our B2B partners, social media platforms, news outlets, and crisis agencies to provide clear, contextual, and easy-to-understand updates to the public, empowering them with verified information when it matters most.

**Heal Connect**

**Problem Statement:**
Many patients and caregivers struggle with isolation, misinformation, and emotional distress while dealing with chronic or severe illnesses. Although numerous apps exist for fitness or doctor consultations, there is no trusted digital space where patients can safely connect, share experiences, and receive emotional support from people who have faced similar challenges.

**Proposed Solution:**
Our project HealConnect is a health-tech platform designed to connect patients, survivors, and caregivers through shared experiences. It provides disease-specific communities where users can join anonymously, share recovery stories, discuss symptoms, and recommend trusted doctors. The platform also allows private messaging for one-on-one support and integrates AI-based moderation to maintain a safe and positive environment.
HealConnect bridges the emotional and informational gap in healthcare empowering individuals through empathy, shared knowledge, and mental well-being.

**Workflow:**

**1. User Login/Sign Up:**
Users register via email, Google, or anonymously ensuring full privacy.
**2. Select Community:**
Choose a health condition (e.g., cancer, diabetes) to join related groups.
**3. Explore & Share:**
Read recovery stories, symptoms, and tips shared by others.
**4. Engage in Community:**
Like, comment, and interact in a positive, AI-moderated environment.
**5. Private Support:**
Chat privately with survivors or peers for guidance and motivation.
**6. Doctor Recommendations:**
Discover and share trusted doctors and treatment experiences.
**7. Continuous Engagement:**
Post recovery updates and inspire others ensuring ongoing positivity.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

HomoSapien  is a detector-powered search engine that filters the synthetic web and elevates verified human writing by default. At its core is an MCP-orchestrated server that unifies multiple signals—stylometry, entropy/burstiness drift, temporal patterns, watermark checks, C2PA/Content Credentials, author graphs, and publisher attestations—to assign each page a transparent **Humanity Score™**, with an explainable provenance trace you can audit. Queries run against a “human-only” index unless you explicitly allow AI, and every result returns proof, not vibes: why we think it’s human, what sources back it, and where it originated. Delivered as a web app, API, and browser extension, HomoSapiens gives researchers, journalists, educators, and enterprises a trustworthy retrieval layer in an increasingly synthetic internet—redefining discovery around authenticity, accountability, and people.

**Misinformation: Create an Agentic AI system that continuously scans multiple sources of information, detects emerging misinformation, verifies facts, and provides easy-to-understand, contextual updates to the public during crises.**

**HomoSapiens** is built to **detect synthetic or misleading content**. It uses a multi-signal approach - like stylometry, entropy drift, watermark checks, and publisher attestations - to **verify the human origin of information**. This ensures that users get **authentic, trustworthy** results, especially during crises when misinformation spreads fast and wide.

Instead of just showing search results, HomoSapiens provides **proof of authenticity** - why we believe the content is human, where it came from, and what backs it. This makes it a powerful tool for journalists, researchers, and the public to fact-check and trust what they read.

HomoSapiens isn’t just a passive tool—it’s an agentic AI system. It actively:

- Scans multiple sources across the web.
- Detects emerging patterns of synthetic content or misinformation.
- Verifies facts using provenance signals and content credentials.
- Responds contextually by surfacing human-authored, verified information.
- Adapts dynamically to user intent—whether they want human-only results or explicitly opt-in for AI content.

In essence, HomoSapiens is a self-directed AI agent that prioritizes human truth over synthetic noise, making it a misinformation firewall for the internet.

“Har arth ka saar, har kharch par vichaar — **Arth Saarthi**: your GPT-powered financial companion guiding you toward mindful money habits and lasting financial health.”

**Project:** **Arth Saarthi** — Autonomous Financial Coach

---
## Problem Statement

* Young professionals and freelancers face irregular income, impulsive spending, and poor savings discipline.
* Existing finance apps only track expenses — they don’t teach or motivate financial behavior change.

---
## Solution Overview

**Arth Saarthi** is a GPT-powered financial companion that understands your money story. It learns income patterns, classifies transactions, gamifies savings, and guides users toward financial wellness — socially, intelligently, and securely.

---
## 1. User Onboarding & Profile Setup

* **Conversational onboarding**: GPT-guided flow via Google/Email/OTP login.
* **Context-aware profiling**: Captures income type, liabilities, risk appetite, and literacy level to auto-create a Personal Budget Blueprint (Essentials / Flex / Savings / Debt).
* **Interactive UX**: Clickable tooltips simplify finance terms; secure contact access enables friend challenges and leaderboards.

---
## 2. AI / ML Intelligence Layer

* **Smart Classifier**: Hybrid rule + ML model auto-tags spends and self-learns from corrections.
* **Predictive Insights**: 30-day cash-flow forecast and a real-time Financial Health Score (0–100).
* **Behavioral AI**: Builds spending personas (Saver, Spender, Planner) to personalize tone and advice. GPT explains why each suggestion is made.

---
## 3. Budgeting & Goal Management

* **Dynamic Budgets**: Auto-generated monthly and category budgets with mid-month rebalancing.
* **Micro-Goals & Simulation**: Daily savings targets and “What-if” scenario testing.
* **Visual Insights**: Progress bars, heatmaps, and GPT summaries turning data into clear takeaways.

---
## 4. Gamification & Leaderboard

* **Karma Economy**: Earn Karma for saving, labeling, learning, and referrals.
* **Leaderboards**: Weekly/monthly friend rankings via contacts, with shareable badges (Smart Saver, Budget Hero, Financial Guru).
* **Retention Loop**: Streaks, tiers, and avatar unlocks reinforce healthy money habits.

---
## 5. **ArthGPT** — Your Financial Companion

* **Conversational Coach**: Chat naturally — “Can I afford this?” “Should I invest or repay?”
* **Contextual Guidance**: Daily digest, overspend alerts, and “Smart Halt” nudges.
* **Modes & Privacy**: “Explain Like I’m 18” / “Pro Mode”; all insights via federated, privacy-first learning.

---
## 6. **Arth Gyaan** — Knowledge Hub

* **Micro-Lessons**: Gamified, bite-sized modules on compounding, credit, taxes, etc.
* **Adaptive Learning**: Adjusts to literacy level; earn Karma and badges for progress.
* **Seamless Integration**: Financial tips and explanations appear in daily summaries.

---
## Impact & Vision

**Arth Saarthi** transforms money management from passive tracking into active learning. By blending GPT intelligence, behavioral finance, and gamification, it builds a generation of financially mindful Indians — informed, motivated, and secure.

**Description of your solution**

“Financial stress doesn’t care who you are — student, hustling professional, or family planner — it finds everyone. Every day, we swipe, spend, and hope our bank balance keeps up. So we asked ourselves: what if managing money wasn’t a headache but felt effortless, smart, and almost invisible? What if an AI could reminds, ‘Hey, maybe skip that extra latte — invest it instead’? That thought became our AI-powered financial companion — a coach that lives inside your payment app.

The challenge is to develop an AI-powered financial companion that integrates seamlessly into payment apps, continuously learns from each user’s financial behavior, analyzes spending and income trends in real time, identifies risks, and delivers smart, personalized reminders and recommendations — helping users make better financial decisions effortlessly and reduce overspending before it happens.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/30782a6489e44267961f9893fa0fb03a/0e1ec595-a9c3-419f-b063-9536cd36a1ab.jpeg) 

The agent meticulously tracks daily and past expenses, automatically forming intuitive data categories—such as food, clothes, and games—to provide clear insight into spending patterns. At the end of each day, the application presents a simple, visual chart of these expenses, making users aware of where their money is going

Sometimes a transaction doesn’t involve actual spending or income—it’s simply an exchange of money. To handle this, our bot asks you to classify each transaction as Exchange or Spending. If you select Exchange, the amount won’t be added to your expenses, and your bank balance will remain accurate.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/30782a6489e44267961f9893fa0fb03a/a56fef8f-7ab3-4509-93c6-bebd67ebd613.jpeg)

By analyzing data from previous months, it can predict a user's approximate monthly income.This historical analysis also allows the agent to proactively suggest when a user is spending too much in a specific category, and it will issue a warning the next day if the user attempts to overspend in that same category again.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/30782a6489e44267961f9893fa0fb03a/912fbc63-0358-4c5b-9431-2cf151095cf1.jpeg)

The strategic purpose of this feature is to interrupt impulsive behavior and engage the user's rational mind.this deliberate friction "will hit the subconscious mind, that, 'May I Really have To spend This Much?'... After This The user will change his/her mindset on spending."

Alongside curbing unnecessary spending, our agent is engineered to make saving a natural and consistent habit through two primary features:

1. Daily Savings Nudge: Users can opt-in to a daily savings reminder. At the beginning of each day, before their first transaction, a pop-up encourages them to "Top-up" their wallet by saving a small amount of money. This simple, proactive prompt helps build the routine of saving first.
2. Automated Transactional Savings: To make saving effortless, users can set a fixed percentage of their spending to be automatically saved. With every transaction they make, that pre-set percentage is instantly transferred to their savings wallet, turning every act of spending into an opportunity to save.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/30782a6489e44267961f9893fa0fb03a/a0225cf3-d52e-49ef-9913-4f406b74e515.jpeg)

Use ML model to classify user type → (student, employee, self-employed).

Chatbot takes queries, answers, and gives insights.

Use NLP for understanding natural language.
Libraries: spaCy / Transformers (Hugging Face).

Add schedule system for EMI, bill, or overspending alerts.
Tools: Python Scheduler / Firebase Cloud Functions / Twilio for SMS.
⦁	  Dashboard & Visualization
Display weekly/monthly expense charts and saving suggestions.
Tools: Streamlit / Flask + Matplotlib / Plotly / React Frontend.
 ⦁          Deployment
Deploy chatbot on web or mobile.
Tools: Firebase / AWS / Render + GitHub for code management.

**Description of your solution**

TriageOne: Connecting Every Step of Care
Solution Overview

TriageOne is a unified AI-powered healthcare automation platform that simplifies and accelerates the entire patient journey — from symptom reporting to doctor assignment and insurance claim processing.
It directly addresses two of the biggest challenges in healthcare:
1️⃣ Inefficient Patient Intake and Triage
2️⃣ Slow and confusing Insurance Claim Settlements

🩺 Part 1: Fixing the Intake & Triage Crisis
⚙️ The Problem

In most Indian hospitals and clinics, patient intake is still manual, slow, and inconsistent.
When a patient calls or messages about symptoms, staff must decide manually:

How urgent the case is

Which doctor or department should handle it

What follow-up questions to ask

How to collect and record medical details

This outdated approach causes:
⏳ Slow responses – Patients wait hours for callbacks or appointments.
⚠️ Inconsistent triage – Different staff interpret symptoms differently.
💸 High admin cost – Staff spend excessive time coordinating manually.
😔 Patient frustration – Misrouted or delayed cases worsen health outcomes.

In short: Hospitals are overloaded with administrative work and risk missing critical emergencies due to inefficient triage.

💡 Our Solution — “TriageOne”

What It Does
TriageOne is an intelligent AI chatbot and voice assistant that communicates directly with patients via WhatsApp, web, or phone, managing the first stage of their medical journey.

How It Works

The AI dynamically asks context-based questions to understand symptoms.

It classifies urgency into Emergency, Urgent, or Routine.

It automatically routes the patient to the correct doctor or department.

All collected information syncs instantly with the hospital’s EHR or appointment system.

Example
Patient: “I have chest pain.”
AI Assistant: “When did it start?” “Do you feel shortness of breath?” “Do you have a history of heart problems?”
If the symptoms sound critical, the AI immediately flags an emergency and alerts the hospital.

Key Features

24/7 virtual availability — no waiting or office-hour limits.

Multi-channel access — chat, call, or website.

Multilingual support — communicates in local languages.

Automatic EHR data sync — no manual entry required.

🗓️ Part 2: Automated Scheduling & Record Management

Once triage is complete, the system seamlessly moves into appointment scheduling and data management.

How It Works

The AI suggests the best available doctors near the patient.

It auto-books the earliest available slot or teleconsultation.

It updates the Electronic Health Record (EHR) with all patient details.

It sends appointment reminders and digital pre-visit forms before the consultation.

Example
After triage, a patient receives:

“Your appointment with Dr. Mehta (Cardiology) is booked for 10:30 AM tomorrow.
Please fill out this short pre-visit form to save time.”

Key Benefits
✅ Frees hospital staff from manual scheduling.
✅ Keeps records accurate and automatically updated.
✅ Reduces no-shows through reminders and preparation.
✅ Works on all devices, in all supported languages.

💳 Part 3: Smarter and Faster Claim Processing — “Mediate”
⚙️ The Problem

Insurance claims remain slow, opaque, and paper-driven, leading to confusion and delayed payments for both patients and hospitals.

💡 The Solution — Mediate Claim Engine

Mediate uses AI and blockchain to simplify, verify, and accelerate the entire claims process.

How It Works
1️⃣ Patient Transparency Dashboard – Patients track claim status, payouts, and deductions in real time with clear explanations.
2️⃣ Standardized Digital Claims – Hospitals upload treatment data in FHIR/HL7 format; AI verifies and categorizes entries automatically.
3️⃣ AI-Powered Claim Review – AI detects anomalies (overbilling, wrong codes) and assigns a Claim Confidence Score, flagging only suspicious cases for manual review — reducing insurer workload by 80%+.
4️⃣ Smart-Contract Settlements – Once approved, blockchain-based contracts trigger automatic, tamper-proof payments between insurer and hospital.
5️⃣ AI Dispute Mediation – A neutral AI assistant compares both sides’ arguments and suggests fair resolutions, minimizing legal or bureaucratic delays.

Key Features

Fast, automated claim verification.

Transparent, easy-to-read claim tracking.

Consistent, data-driven validation to minimize human error.

Seamless integration with hospital billing and insurance APIs.
Why Our Solution Stands Out (USPs)

🌐 End-to-End Automation – One seamless flow from symptom to settlement.
🧠 AI-Powered Clinical Reasoning – Understands symptoms contextually, not by keywords.
🕒 Always Available – 24/7 multilingual virtual assistant.
💬 Transparent Communication – Real-time updates at every step.
❤️ Patient-Centric Design – Human-like interactions that build trust and comfort.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

**How Our Idea Fits into the HealthTech Track**
💡 Overview

TriageOne is a unified AI-powered healthcare automation platform that streamlines the entire patient journey — from symptom reporting to doctor assignment and insurance claim settlement.

- It directly addresses the most pressing HealthTech goals:
- Faster, more accurate care delivery through clinical AI.
- Operational automation for hospitals and staff.
- Transparency and trust in healthcare payments.
By combining AI triage, automation, TriageOne bridges the gap between clinical care and financial settlement, making healthcare smarter, faster, and fairer.
**Why it fits perfectly**:
TriageOne tackles systemic healthcare delays — a problem that affects both clinical outcomes and administrative efficiency, aligning with the HealthTech track’s core goal: enhancing quality of care through intelligent technology.
Agentic AI in Action
Example Flow:

- 1️⃣ Patient reports: “I have chest pain.”
- → Triage Agent: Detects possible cardiac emergency and alerts hospital staff.
- 2️⃣ Ops Agent: Books the nearest cardiologist automatically and updates the EHR.
- 3️⃣ Claim Agent: Pre-authorizes the insurance claim and predicts payout timeline.

Each AI agent operates autonomously but collaboratively — forming a proactive ecosystem that connects care, operations, and claims in real time.

🌟 Why It Fits the HealthTech Track

- Improves Clinical Efficiency: AI reduces triage and scheduling delays by up to 80%.
- Enhances Patient Experience: 24/7 support, multilingual access, and transparent communication.
- Optimizes Operations: Real-time staff management and data-driven decision-making.
- Builds Financial Trust: AI and blockchain ensure transparent, auditable settlements.
- Embodies Agentic Intelligence: AI agents that act, decide, and coordinate — not just respond.

🚀 **Summary**

TriageOne represents the next wave of HealthTech innovation — where Agentic AI doesn’t just assist but acts as an intelligent healthcare team, triaging patients, managing operations, and settling claims autonomously.
It transforms hospitals into smart, self-learning ecosystems, ensuring that no patient waits, no data is lost, and no claim is delayed.

**Description of your solution**

The project, titled 'SmartSaver Agent' , falls under the FinTech Track and proposes an Agentic AI financial coach integrated into a mobile app to address the pain point of unpredictable money flows for individuals with variable and informal incomes, such as gig economy workers. The AI coach autonomously learns a user's income and spending patterns to provide three core functions: forecasting cash flow , creating an adaptive "daily safe-to-spend" budget , and executing automated micro-actions like moving money into savings pots when a new payment is received. This solution removes the guesswork from variable income stress, automates saving , and proactively manages debt. The Go-to-Market (GTM) strategy is centered on a Partnership Strategy by offering the app as a financial wellness perk through major gig economy companies , and the revenue model uses a Freemium structure with a premium tier that unlocks full autonomous AI features like micro-investing and personalized tax assistance.

**Misinformation: Bring your own problem in Misinformation, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Our project, the SmartSaver Agent, directly combats financial misinformation by providing personalized, real-time, and trustworthy advice.

Individuals with variable and informal incomes are often highly susceptible to financial misinformation and scams because:

They lack reliable, traditional financial guidance, which often doesn't suit their irregular income streams.

They are forced to rely on unvetted online sources, social media, or informal advice to manage their complex cash flow, leading to poor decisions, debt, and missed opportunities.

The SmartSaver Agent solves this by being an Agentic AI that acts as a secure, knowledgeable, and unbiased financial coach. It uses the user's actual data and an advanced model to:

Provide accurate, data-driven forecasts: Eliminating the guesswork and fear that often leads to irrational financial choices.

Offer personalized advice: The advice is tailored to their specific income pattern and spending habits, making it reliable and actionable, unlike generic, often misleading, advice found online.

Automate sound financial decisions: By suggesting and automating savings and bill payments, it protects the user from decisions based on hype, fear, or fraudulent schemes.

In essence, we are leveraging Agentic AI to create a highly personalized "single source of truth" for financial guidance, effectively vaccinating our users against prevalent and harmful financial misinformation.

**Description of your solution**

Market Whisperer, an AI-powered insight engine, is designed for individual traders who find it challenging to keep pace with the constant influx of financial news, earnings updates, and social media chatter. In today’s fast-paced world, traders often miss crucial signals about their stocks due to information overload and time constraints, resulting in uninformed or delayed investment decisions.

The platform meticulously aggregates data from reputable financial sources, earnings call transcripts, and social sentiment platforms. It then employs advanced large language models (LLMs) to perform sentiment analysis, thematic extraction, and summarization. Instead of overwhelming users with an overwhelming number of links, Market Whisperer delivers a concise, human-like daily briefing tailored to their portfolio. This briefing highlights the factors driving positive or negative sentiment for each stock and provides insights into the underlying reasons.

It presents the strongest arguments for and against investing in the stock based on real-time data. By presenting both sides of the argument, Market Whisperer empowers traders to make well-informed decisions before taking action.

Market Whisperer transforms noisy data into clear, contextual intelligence, enabling retail investors to make smarter, faster, and more confident trading decisions.
