**Description of your solution**

TruthLens: See the world through facts, not fear.

In times of global crises like pandemics, wars, or climate disasters, people are overwhelmed by a flood of online information—some of it accurate, much of it confusing, conflicting, or deliberately false. This misinformation often spreads faster than the truth, leading to panic, mistrust, and poor decision-making. TruthLens is an AI-powered fact-verification platform designed to tackle this challenge by helping citizens identify what’s real and what’s not. It uses advanced natural language processing and machine learning models to analyze trending news, social media posts, and videos in real time. By cross-verifying claims through trusted sources such as verified news outlets, WHO and UN databases, and global fact-checking APIs, TruthLens assigns each piece of content a transparent “Truth Score” that reflects its reliability. The system also highlights why certain content may be misleading—detecting source bias, manipulated visuals, or factual inconsistencies.

Built using Django for the backend, React for the interface, and AI models like Google Gemini or Hugging Face transformers, TruthLens integrates explainable AI to ensure that users not only receive verified information but also understand why it’s trustworthy. Its “Crisis Mode” dashboard provides curated, verified updates specific to ongoing global events, while a community verification layer allows journalists, NGOs, and verified citizens to contribute credible fact-checks. By combining automation, transparency, and collaboration, TruthLens empowers people to make informed decisions and restores public trust in digital information ecosystems. In a world where misinformation fuels fear, TruthLens ensures that facts lead the way.

**Misinformation: Create an Agentic AI system that continuously scans multiple sources of information, detects emerging misinformation, verifies facts, and provides easy-to-understand, contextual updates to the public during crises.**

This project fits perfectly under the “Misinformation” track because it directly targets the root cause and impact of misinformation during global crises.

Misinformation thrives in moments of uncertainty — such as pandemics, wars, or climate emergencies — when people desperately seek answers online. False or misleading content spreads rapidly through social media, distorting facts, creating panic, and influencing public behavior in harmful ways. TruthLens tackles this challenge by providing an AI-driven verification layer that filters and clarifies information before users act on it.

The project uses machine learning and NLP models to detect fake news patterns, cross-verifies claims with trusted databases and fact-check APIs, and assigns a “Truth Score” to help users understand the reliability of the content they encounter. It doesn’t just flag misinformation — it also explains why something is false, promoting digital literacy and critical thinking among citizens.

By combining AI verification, explainable trust metrics, and community-based fact-checking, TruthLens strengthens the digital information ecosystem. It empowers individuals to make confident, fact-based decisions even in the chaos of global crises. That’s exactly what the misinformation track aims to solve — reducing the spread of false narratives and building a more informed, resilient society.

**Description of your solution**

TruthBot — Empowering Truth, One Message at a Time

TruthBot is an AI-powered conversational assistant that detects, verifies, and explains misinformation shared across digital platforms in real time. It accepts text, images, or links from users and automatically extracts factual claims, evaluates their credibility, and cross-verifies them using trusted global sources like WHO, CDC, and Snopes.

Built with advanced NLP models, LangChain-based retrieval, and multilingual support, TruthBot delivers verified responses with confidence scores and simple explanations. Users can interact through Telegram, WhatsApp, or a web-based chatbot — making fact-checking accessible to everyone, even in regional languages.

Beyond flagging false information, TruthBot educates users by explaining why claims are true or false, encouraging informed digital behavior. Its adaptive feedback system continuously learns from user input, improving accuracy over time.

Goal: To create a trustworthy digital ecosystem that empowers people to verify information instantly and build a more informed, resilient society.

**Misinformation: Create an Agentic AI system that continuously scans multiple sources of information, detects emerging misinformation, verifies facts, and provides easy-to-understand, contextual updates to the public during crises.**

Justification — Alignment with Problem Statement

TruthBot directly addresses the challenge of misinformation surges during global crises such as pandemics, wars, or environmental disasters. The project’s architecture is designed to continuously scan, detect, and verify claims from multiple information sources — precisely aligning with the Agentic AI goal of autonomous misinformation monitoring.

Its multi-agent system extracts factual claims from text, links, or images and uses advanced NLP models to assess their authenticity. Through a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline, TruthBot cross-references these claims with verified global databases (WHO, CDC, UN, PolitiFact) to determine accuracy. It then generates contextual, audience-friendly explanations with confidence scores, ensuring that complex topics are simplified for public understanding.

Unlike traditional static fact-checking tools, TruthBot is interactive, adaptive, and multilingual, making it effective across different communities and crisis contexts. By learning from user feedback and evolving with real-time data, it exemplifies an agentic AI system that not only detects misinformation trends but also educates users — empowering them to act responsibly during critical global events.

**Description of your solution**

Many patients—especially those recovering from surgery, managing chronic illnesses, or living alone—face serious challenges once they leave the hospital. Without continuous monitoring or timely guidance, small issues such as missed medications, rising blood pressure, or unnoticed infections can quickly escalate into medical emergencies, leading to unnecessary hospital readmissions and emotional distress for both patients and families. To address this human problem, **CareBridge** introduces an **Agentic AI-powered post-discharge health companion** that acts as an ever-present care partner. It continuously learns from patients’ wearable data, medical histories, and daily health check-ins to understand their unique recovery patterns. Using reasoning and decision-making capabilities, the AI autonomously detects early signs of health risks, reminds patients in compassionate, human-like language, and even coordinates care by alerting doctors or scheduling teleconsultations when needed. Powered by technologies like **LangChain** and **CrewAI** for agent orchestration, **TensorFlow** for predictive analytics, and **IoT integrations** through Fitbit and Google Fit APIs, CareBridge blends empathy with intelligence — ensuring that no patient ever feels alone or unsupported after leaving the hospital, and that recovery becomes a safer, more connected journey.

Its multi-agent system acts like a team of digital caregivers: diagnosing issues, communicating with users through voice AI, scheduling “treatments,” and ensuring data safety via UEBA. This architecture showcases how Agentic AI frameworks built for predictive maintenance can extend to human health monitoring and medical diagnostics, demonstrating strong cross-domain potential in the HealthTech space.

**Description of your solution**

FinSight is an Agentic AI Financial Future Planner, turning money management into a predictive, self-sustaining habit. We are developing a mobile app (Flutter) with a Duolingo-style animated mascot that serves the user's ongoing financial sidekick.

**Core Features & Agentic AI Challenge Fit (Fintech Track)**:

**Agentic AI Core**: The design is based on a Multi-Agent Collaboration System (LLaMA3/LangGraph) with domain-specific agents (Saver, Investor, Analyst). This system learns continuously from live data, allowing autonomous optimization—automatically detecting financial risks (such as an increasing subscription) and making micro-interventions (such as auto-establishing a safe spending limit) accordingly. This addresses the Agentic AI challenge directly by offering real-time, personalized recommendations.

**Financial Life Simulation Engine (FLSE)**: Our top innovation. The FLSE performs thousands of parallel Monte Carlo simulations to simulate the user's future financial trajectory. It displays the result as an interactive Financial Heatmap of the probability of success for any life goal defined (e.g., "78% chance of saving a $10k down payment in 3 years"). This offers users the predictive certainty they need.

**Habit Formation**: The emotionally interactive mascot and gamification (streaks, team challenges) solve the behavioral gap, making finance a good habit.

**Go-to-Market (GTM) & Revenue Streams**:

**GTM Strategy**: Viral growth focus through the social gamification layer (Team Challenges) and B2B partnerships with gig platforms and universities.

**Revenue**: A Freemium Subscription Model. The FinSight Pro level opens up the advanced Financial Life Simulation Engine (FLSE) and the Investor Agent's complete probabilistic modeling for $5/month.

**Fintech: Bring your own problem in Fintech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

FinSight is an **excellent and very competitive match** for the **Fintech: Leveraging Agentic AI** category. The project revolves around addressing a fundamental financial challenge—the behavioral gap—through a technically advanced, autonomous architecture of AI.

## 1. Fintech Relevance: Solving the Behavioral Gap

FinSight focuses on solving directly a fundamental, yet unmet Fintech problem: the ineffectiveness of generic, static solutions in bringing about sustained behavior change.

* **Problem:** We focus on high-volatility users (Gig Workers, Students) who require tailored, proactive support. Manual discipline and old-fashioned budgeting apps have high churn.
* **Solution:** FinSight substitutes manual discipline with **autonomous optimization**. It doesn't request the user to enter data; the Agentic AI core continuously tracks the financial flow and makes ongoing micro-adjustments, creating financial health as a habit. 

---

## 2. Leverage Agentic AI: The Multi-Agent Core

The whole architecture is characterized by an Agentic AI system that is intended for sophisticated financial reasoning beyond mere chatbot exchanges.

* **Multi-Agent System:** The heart employs **LLaMA3** and **LangGraph** to integrate expert agents (Saver, Investor, Analyst). This illustrates a genuine agentic approach in which individual modules interact through a common memory to provide a comprehensive recommendation.
* **Autonomous Action:** The agents are implemented to **process transactions in real time**. For instance, the Saver Agent maintains an endless loop to identify unusual spending, identify the root cause, and suggest a solution proactively—a pure **reason-think-act** cycle, as mandated by the track.
* **Scalable Technologies:** Through the use of Python's **FastAPI** on the backend, we guarantee the high-performance API gateway can process the ongoing, real-time data stream needed to fuel these autonomous agents.

---

## 3. The Grandest AI Use: Predictive Simulation

The most advanced application of Agentic AI in FinSight is the **Financial Life Simulation Engine (FLSE)**, and it reflects extreme technical maturity.

* **Complex, Multi-Step Reasoning:** As mentioned in the technology plan, FLSE leverages the AI core to handle **complex, multi-step reasoning for Monte Carlo simulations**. The AI is not simply reading data; it employs that data (in addition to market data from **AlphaVantage**) to simulate thousands of probabilistic futures.
* **Generative Prediction:** This feature is an impressive showcase of Agentic AI applied to **generative prediction**—it actually *generates* the user's possible future financial statuses and their **chance of success**, which is much more sophisticated and striking than common financial dashboards.
* **Visual Delivery:** Leverage of **Flutter** and **CustomPainter** to display the interactive **Financial Heatmap** gives a neat, high-performance visual representation for the AI's sophisticated predictive result, making the system easy to understand for the user and visually striking for the judges.

> Reimagining MSME Credit Intelligence with AI

![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB Atlas](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB%20Atlas-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

**Problem Description:**
Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) form the backbone of India’s economy but remain largely outside **formal credit systems** due to a persistent trust gap. Lenders cannot accurately assess businesses without traditional credit histories, leading to lengthy, costly, and uncertain underwriting. MSMEs face opaque loan processes with little feedback or clarity on rejections, while traditional credit bureaus fail to evaluate their real financial health. This disconnect keeps viable businesses underserved and lenders hesitant to engage.

**Background & Market Context:**
The **RBI’s Account Aggregator** framework has enabled consent-based financial data sharing, giving access to bank and GST data. However, the ecosystem lacks intelligent systems that can interpret this data into meaningful credit insights. With digital adoption among MSMEs rising and financial institutions ready for **AI-driven transformation**, there is a strong need for a smart, transparent layer that translates raw financial data into actionable credit decisions.

**Our Solution:**

- Agentic AI Orchestrator processes AA data using specialized AI agents.
- **Financial Health Agent** analyzes transaction data to assess business stability and cash flow patterns.
- **Credit Scoring Agent** develops behavioral credit scores using patterns in business operations instead of traditional history.
- **Guidance Agent** provides explainable insights and improvement recommendations through AI explainability models.
- **Policy Matching Agent** aligns MSME profiles with lender products based on risk and eligibility.
- Unified Dashboard for lenders and MSMEs delivers verified financials, transparent scores, and product recommendations instantly.

**Impact:**
- For Lenders: Reduces manual underwriting, increases speed, and enhances decision confidence.
- For MSMEs: Adds transparency, offers clear improvement paths, and eases access to credit.
- For the Ecosystem: Encourages data-driven lending using existing AA infrastructure.

**Market & Revenue:**
- Target: Banks, NBFCs, and fintech lenders serving MSMEs.
- Revenue: SaaS subscriptions, per-use assessments, analytics add-ons, and loan referral partnerships.
- Go-to-Market: Pilot launches, subscription conversions, and integrations with lending platforms and ecosystem partners.

**Fintech: Bring your own problem in Fintech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

The MSME credit gap is deeply connected to the FinTech space because it stems from limited access to verified financial data and transparency within the lending ecosystem. Despite digital advancements, small businesses still struggle to present reliable financial health information, making credit evaluation slow and uncertain. This gap exists within the same FinTech infrastructure like the Account Aggregator (AA) framework that has the potential to make lending data-driven, inclusive, and efficient.

**Description of your solution**

**ArthSetu: Your AI-Powered Portfolio Partner**

**🧩 The Problem**

In India, over 90% of investors depend on someone else’s advice to make investment decisions — a friend, a YouTube expert, or a random Telegram channel.
Despite growing awareness, only 9.5% of Indian households actually invest in the markets (SEBI Investor Survey 2025).

Why? Because the investment experience today is fragmented and confusing:

Investors juggle multiple apps for portfolios, news, research, and broker trades.

They get generic updates that don’t explain why something matters to their holdings.

Even when they get good advice, execution is broken — switching apps, verifying data, and second-guessing decisions.

This leads to decision fatigue, missed opportunities, and low confidence, especially among Tier 2 and Tier 3 investors who are new to financial markets but eager to grow their wealth.

**🚀 Our Solution: ArthSetu**

ArthSetu is an AI-powered portfolio partner that unifies a user’s entire investment journey — from insight to action — in one intelligent flow.

It connects to all your investment accounts, tracks portfolio performance, interprets market events using AI, and delivers personalized insights, alerts, and education in plain language — even through voice conversations in English or Indian languages.

Our vision is simple yet bold:

To make every Indian investor as informed as an expert, without needing to be one.

**🧠 How ArthSetu Works**

ArthSetu’s AI Agent operates in three layers — Sense, Reason, and Act:

Sense – Continuously tracks your holdings, market news, filings, and fund updates.

Reason – Analyses which events are relevant to your portfolio, classifies them as opportunities or risks, and scores their impact.

Act – Suggests clear, actionable steps — like hold, trim, add, or switch — and enables one-tap execution via your broker.

This ensures that every user always knows:
👉 What’s happening in the market,
👉 Why it matters to them, and
👉 What action to take.

**🌟 Hero Features**

- Voice Agent:
Talk to ArthSetu like a financial friend — “What’s my total portfolio value?” or “Should I worry about the market today?”
It responds instantly with personalized insights.

- AI-Generated Alerts:
Automatic portfolio-specific notifications about market changes, price movements, or risks — so users can act fast.

- AI Learning Module:
A dynamic learning system that adapts to each user’s knowledge level and portfolio composition — making them smarter investors over time.

- Seamless Execution:
Direct integration with brokers for one-tap buy/sell, saving time and eliminating friction.

**⚙️ Other Supporting Features**

1. Multi-broker connection for unified tracking and trading
2. Audio notes & daily digest on WhatsApp and email
3. Critical alerts for urgent actions
4. Portfolio insights dashboard with risk, diversification, and performance metrics

**🧩 Why Now**

Retail participation in markets is exploding, especially beyond metros.

But information overload and app fragmentation make investing harder, not smarter.

AI + personalization can now bridge this gap — turning data into decisions.

With India’s growing digital investor base and the availability of broker APIs, ArthSetu is perfectly timed to simplify investing for millions of users who want clarity, confidence, and control.

**💰 The Vision**

We envision ArthSetu as the financial operating system for every Indian investor —
where AI turns awareness into action, and every rupee invested is guided by intelligence, not impulse.

**Fintech: Bring your own problem in Fintech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

1. Problem Overview
During crises such as pandemics, natural disasters, or conflicts, misinformation spreads faster than verified news—causing panic, confusion, and mistrust. Manual fact-checking cannot keep pace with this information overload.

CrisisVerify is an agentic AI system that autonomously monitors digital channels, detects emerging misinformation, verifies facts using trusted evidence, and delivers clear, real-time updates to the public through multiple communication platforms.
3. Key Features
Continuous Monitoring: Scans social media, news, and government feeds to detect trending or suspicious claims.
Harm-Based Prioritization: Ranks claims by urgency, virality, and public risk to verify critical misinformation first.
Automated Verification: Cross-checks with official sources, performs media forensics, and assigns confidence scores.
Human-in-the-Loop Review: Experts validate high-impact or uncertain claims to ensure accuracy.
Explainable Output: Converts results into simple summaries with evidence and action steps.
Multi-Channel Dissemination: Publishes verified information via web, SMS, and social platforms with an audit trail.
Adaptive Learning: Continuously improves detection strategies from feedback and new misinformation patterns.
4. Innovation
Modular agentic design enabling autonomous, round-the-clock operation.
Transparency through evidence-linked explanations and audit logs.
Real-time, harm-first verification designed specifically for crisis conditions.
5. Impact
CrisisVerify ensures the public, media, and authorities receive accurate, verified, and easy-to-understand information—reducing panic, preventing harm, and strengthening trust during emergencies.

**Misinformation: Create an Agentic AI system that continuously scans multiple sources of information, detects emerging misinformation, verifies facts, and provides easy-to-understand, contextual updates to the public during crises.**

CrisisVerify directly aligns with the misinformation track by building an agentic AI system designed to detect, verify, and clarify information during crises. It continuously scans multiple digital sources — including news outlets, social media, and government feeds — to identify emerging misinformation in real time.

Using automated fact verification, human-in-the-loop review, and explainable AI summaries, CrisisVerify ensures that only verified, easy-to-understand information reaches the public. This not only combats misinformation but also restores trust, reduces panic, and supports decision-making during emergencies.

**Description of your solution**

The Doctor Appointment System is an AI-powered platform designed to simplify how patients interact with healthcare providers. Instead of browsing long schedules or waiting for manual confirmations, users can simply enter their ID and query (like “Is Dr. Sharma available tomorrow morning?”) — and the system instantly provides intelligent, conversational responses.

Our solution combines FastAPI, LangChain, and Streamlit to create a seamless end-to-end experience. The FastAPI backend handles requests efficiently with input validation and structured responses, while the LangChain-based AI agent interprets user queries and returns accurate, human-like answers. On the Streamlit frontend, users get a clean, user-friendly interface for real-time interaction.

This system not only reduces the complexity of managing doctor availability but also demonstrates how AI integration can enhance healthcare efficiency. It can be easily extended for features like booking confirmations, reminders, and patient record access.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Our project addresses a common problem in healthcare — the difficulty and inefficiency in checking doctor availability and managing appointments. Patients often struggle with outdated scheduling systems, long waiting times, or manual confirmations.

To solve this, we built an AI-driven Doctor Appointment System that leverages Agentic AI concepts using LangChain. The system features a DoctorAppointmentAgent that acts as an intelligent intermediary between users and the hospital database.

Instead of static data queries, the Agent understands the user’s natural language request, interprets intent, retrieves the relevant information, and delivers clean, human-like responses. This autonomy and reasoning ability make it a practical example of Agentic AI applied to HealthTech.

By combining FastAPI, LangChain, and Streamlit, the solution demonstrates how AI agents can make healthcare interactions more efficient, accessible, and user-friendly — ultimately improving patient experience and hospital workflow.

**Description of your solution**

# **Khara Kai Mumbai**: Real-Time Truth Guardian

**Tagline:** *"Mumbai’s Reality Check—When Truth Matters Most"*

**Overview:**  
**Khara Kai Mumbai** is an autonomous AI agent designed to combat misinformation during Mumbai's most critical moments—floods, epidemics, riots, or accidents—when false information spreads faster than facts and can cost lives. The system continuously monitors multiple sources including Twitter, Telegram, YouTube, and public groups, autonomously extracting claims and verifying them against official sources like BMC, Mumbai Police, and Indian Railways within seconds. Using multi-modal AI, it doesn't just analyze text—it reverse-searches images to catch recycled flood photos, detects deepfaked audio of politicians, and identifies manipulated videos being shared as "breaking news." 

What makes **Khara Kai Mumbai** truly agentic is its proactive nature: it doesn't wait for users to ask—it hunts down misinformation, prioritizes claims based on viral potential and harm score, and immediately distributes fact-checks in Marathi, Hindi, and English through community networks, Twitter, and a public dashboard. Instead of simply labeling something "false," it explains why the claim is wrong, provides correct information with sources, and tells citizens what action to take—turning panic into preparedness. Built specifically for Mumbai's hyperlocal context, understanding its geography, language patterns, and crisis cycles, **Khara Kai Mumbai** acts as the city's real-time truth guardian when accuracy matters most.

---

## **How It Works:**

**1. Multi-Source Monitoring Agent**  
The system tracks real-time data from various platforms such as Twitter, Telegram, YouTube, WhatsApp, Reddit, and local news channels. It continuously scans for trending hashtags, viral posts, and user-generated content to identify potential misinformation during crises.

**2. Intelligent Claim Extraction Agent**  
Once a claim is identified, it autonomously extracts key information—such as locations, statistics, and statements—from text, images, and videos. Claims are then prioritized based on their viral potential and the harm they might cause if left unchecked.

**3. Multi-Modal Verification Agent**  
This component cross-references claims with official sources like BMC, Mumbai Police, and Indian Railways. It also uses advanced techniques to verify images through reverse searches, metadata extraction, and visual similarity checks. For videos, it performs keyframe extraction and deepfake detection to ensure authenticity.

**4. Contextual Explanation Generator**  
Rather than just labeling claims as "false," **Khara Kai Mumbai** explains why a claim is misleading, providing corrected information along with the sources. This is done in Marathi, Hindi, and English, ensuring maximum reach to Mumbai's diverse population. It also offers actionable advice on what to do, ensuring that the community is not left in panic but is instead informed and prepared.

**5. Proactive Distribution Agent**  
The system automatically distributes verified updates through WhatsApp groups, Twitter, Telegram, and a public dashboard. It ensures that misinformation is countered before it spreads widely, keeping the community informed with real-time, verified information.

---

## **Agentic Features:**

- **Autonomous Decision Making**: The system autonomously determines which claims need immediate attention and the best verification methods to use.  
- **Proactive Action**: **Khara Kai Mumbai** doesn’t wait for users to report misinformation—it actively hunts down false claims and distributes corrections before they go viral.  
- **Multi-Agent Coordination**: The monitoring, extraction, verification, and distribution agents collaborate seamlessly to provide a unified response to misinformation.  
- **Continuous Learning**: The system evolves by learning from feedback, improving its ability to detect and debunk misinformation over time.

---

## **Why Khara Kai Mumbai is Different:**

1. **Hyperlocal Focus**: Designed specifically for Mumbai, the system understands the city's geography, culture, language, and crisis cycles.  
2. **Crisis-Ready**: Built to operate under pressure, when time-sensitive and accurate information is critical.  
3. **Multilingual**: Fact-checks are delivered in Marathi, Hindi, and English to cater to Mumbai's diverse population.  
4. **Proactive**: It doesn’t just react—it finds and debunks misinformation before it has a chance to spread widely.  
5. **Community-Powered**: It collaborates with WhatsApp groups, Twitter, and Telegram to amplify the reach of verified information.

---

**Misinformation: Bring your own problem in Misinformation, leveraging Agentic AI.**

**Khara Kai Mumbai** is a system designed to stop the spread of fake news during emergencies, like floods, accidents, or riots. It constantly monitors social media, messaging apps like WhatsApp and Telegram, and official sources such as Mumbai Police or BMC for any misleading or false claims. When it finds a suspicious post, it uses advanced AI to verify if the information is true by checking text, images, and videos. It cross-references the claim with trusted sources, reverse-searches images, and even detects deepfakes to catch manipulated content. Once a claim is confirmed to be false, the system quickly sends out the correct information through WhatsApp, Telegram, Twitter, and a public dashboard. It also provides an explanation of why the claim was wrong, giving people the right facts to prevent panic and help them make informed decisions. By acting fast and automatically, **Khara Kai Mumbai** ensures that only the truth reaches the public during critical moments.

> Early detection of breast cancer

![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![PyTorch](https://img.shields.io/badge/PyTorch-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

HealthTech – AI for Medical Imaging and Clinical Decision Support

Problem Statement:
Breast cancer is one of the leading causes of mortality among women, and mammography is the most widely used screening tool for early detection. Radiologists face challenges such as overwhelming image volumes, subtle variations in breast density, and microcalcifications that are difficult to interpret consistently. Current AI systems can detect patterns but lack the ability to reason about findings, contextualize them with patient history, and autonomously recommend next steps. This results in fragmented workflows, diagnostic variability, and delays in patient care.

Solution:
We propose an Agentic AI–powered mammography analysis pipeline that combines perception, reasoning, and action in a transparent, auditable workflow. Mammography inputs will be standardized into .png format and analyzed by in-house vision models to detect breast density, calcifications, and suspicious lesions. These outputs will be converted into structured clinical text and passed to a fine-tuned MedGemma reasoning model. Using the ReAct (Reason + Act) paradigm with multi-hop reasoning, the AI agent will iteratively gather evidence, contextualize findings with patient risk factors (age, family history, prior imaging), and refine its reasoning until it reaches a clinically sound recommendation. The system will then suggest next steps such as additional imaging, biopsy, or follow-up, while providing explainability outputs (saliency maps + reasoning traces) for clinician review. By adopting a decision referral strategy, routine negatives can be handled autonomously, while borderline or high-risk cases are escalated to radiologists. This approach reduces workload, improves diagnostic consistency, and accelerates patient care while ensuring safety and trust.

Technologies & Use of Agentic AI
Image Preprocessing: Standardization of mammography inputs into .png.

In-house Vision Models: Deep learning models for density, calcification, and lesion detection.

Text Conversion Layer: Converts structured outputs into interpretable clinical observations.

Fine-tuned Medical LLM: Provides domain-specific medical reasoning.

Reasoning: Alternates between reasoning traces and tool calls, chaining multiple steps (e.g., density check → calcification check → contextual reasoning → action planning).

Multimodal Fusion: Incorporates patient metadata (EHR, risk factors) for richer reasoning.

Explainability Layer: Generates saliency maps and reasoning traces for transparency.

Decision Referral Strategy: Handles routine negatives autonomously, escalates uncertain cases to radiologists.

Integration Layer: Connects with PACS/EHR systems for seamless adoption.

Human-in-the-Loop Oversight: Ensures clinicians validate high-risk recommendations.

We are leveraging Agentic AI in medical field to take premitive actions by fast tracking the process.

**Description of your solution**

The Problem: Lost Records and No Home Help

Imagine your health records are like puzzle pieces scattered everywhere.

1.  Lost History: In India, when you go to a new doctor, they don't have your old reports or prescriptions. You have to carry piles of papers yourself. This makes it hard for the doctor to know your full story, and your treatment might not be safe or effective.
2.  No Home Helper: If you have a long-term sickness (like sugar or high blood pressure), you have to manage your medicines and check-ups all alone at home. There is no smart, digital helper to watch your health for you.


 The Solution: Arogya Locker — Your AI Health Helper

Arogya Locker is a safe, smart place to keep all your family’s medical papers in one spot. It solves the problem by giving you AI Agents smart digital helpers—that actively work for you.

This is not just a digital file cabinet; it's an *Active Co-Pilot*.

How the AI Agents Help:

 The Medicine Agent (The Safety Checker):
    * It automatically *reads all your prescriptions* from every doctor.
    * It puts them together to make *one clear schedule* for when to take your pills.
    * Crucially, it *yells a warning* if different doctors have given you medicines that should not be taken together (dangerous drug mixing). It keeps you safe.

* *The Reports Agent (The Trend Tracker):*
    * It *reads your confusing lab reports* and explains them to you in *simple, easy language*.
    * It watches your numbers over time to show you if your health is *getting better or worse* (your long-term trends). It helps you stay in control.

Why This Fixes Everything

Arogya Locker becomes the "one true source" for your health story. It gives you the power to own your data, and it gives every doctor a *complete, full picture*. The AI Agent does the hard work, connecting the broken parts of the health system and bringing smart, continuous care right into your home.

we are tackling India's most critical healthcare failure: fragmented patient data.

### Forecasting Commodity Markets
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/forecasting-commodity-markets-ac1e) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://colab.research.google.com/drive/1TaOQj-n1JnOnQTWOZrLsPE9jSlJAeejW) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-MumbaiHacks%202025%20--%20Round%201%20(Online)-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://mumbaihacks25-round1.devfolio.co)

> Nickel, Lithium

![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

Our research methodology follows a structured, multi-stage approach to 
ensure a robust and reliable forecast. The process begins with data acquisition 
and preprocessing, where time-series datasets for electric vehicle sales, nickel 
mining output, and key macroeconomic indicators including LME Market 
Prices are collected from reputable sources like the IEA and USGS and 
WestinMetal. This data is then cleaned, normalized, and synchronized to a 
consistent temporal frequency to prepare it for modeling. Following this, the 
framework diverges into three parallel streams, where each specialized model 
is trained independently on its respective domain-specific dataset. The 
Boosting model learns the complex, long-term dependencies in demand data, 
the Prophet captures temporal patterns in supply figures, and the VER model 
identifies statistical trends in the economic data. Finally, the individual 
predictions from these three models are fed into an ensemble layer, which 
uses a weighted-averaging or a simple meta-learning algorithm to synthesize 
them into a single, unified forecast for the nickel market.
The selection of algorithms is central to our cross-domain strategy. We 
employ Long Short-Term Memory (XGBoost) and Gated Recurrent Unit 
(GRU) networks, both of which are advanced recurrent neural networks 
(RNNs) specifically designed to overcome the limitations of traditional 
RNNs in learning long-range dependencies in sequential data. XGBoosts use 
a series of gates to control information flow, making them ideal for modeling 
the non-linear, momentum-driven trends in consumer EV adoption. GRUs, a 
more streamlined variant of XGBoosts, are computationally efficient yet 
powerful, making them well-suited for the less complex but still 
time-dependent patterns found in mining and production data. To anchor our 
forecast in a stable economic context, we utilize the Autoregressive 
Integrated Moving Average (VER) model, a classic and robust statistical 
method proven for its effectiveness in modeling linear trends in established 
economic indicators. This deliberate combination of deep learning and 
statistical models allows our framework to capture a wide array of patterns, 
from volatile, non-linear growth to stable, linear trends.

**Fintech: Bring your own problem in Fintech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

The global transition to electric mobility has rendered the nickel market 
increasingly volatile, creating a need for more sophisticated forecasting 
methodologies. This paper introduces a novel framework, Cross-domain 
Ensemble Learning for Commodity Market Forecasting, to predict nickel price 
dynamics. Our approach decomposes the market into three core domains: 
demand, forecasted using an XGBoost network on EV sales data; supply, 
modeled with a GRU network on mining outputs; and macroeconomic 
conditions, analyzed via a traditional Prophet/XGBoost model. By ensembling 
these specialized models, this research provides a robust, multi-faceted forecast. 
This method uniquely captures the complex, non-linear interactions between 
these distinct domains, a key limitation of traditional, single-variable models. 
The resulting ensemble demonstrates superior predictive accuracy over baseline 
methods. Ultimately, this framework provides actionable intelligence for 
mitigating supply chain risks and guiding strategic investment in the burgeoning 
energy sector.

### Catalina, Null
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/cantina-c7a3) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Spirit-Of-Delphi/Cantina-Null) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Syntax%20Error%202025-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://syntax-error-2025.devfolio.co)

> Number go up

![Unity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Unity-333333?style=flat-square) ![C#](https://img.shields.io/badge/C#-333333?style=flat-square) ![Aseprite](https://img.shields.io/badge/Aseprite-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Catalina, Null tries to solve a prevalent problem in the deckbuilding roguelike genre--it eliminates the "solved game" feel of traditional card combinations (like a poker flush) by introducing a dynamic scoring system where the player defines the rules for every play

It aims to create deep strategic choice not just in what you play, but how you play it, turning every turn into a unique tactical puzzle.

**Challenges we ran into**

The biggest challenge was architectural: creating a truly decoupled system between the game logic and the UI. My initial design had UI components directly calling game managers, which led to timing bugs and "spaghetti code." Midway through, I refactored the entire project to use a centralized event system. This meant rewriting the UI interaction from the ground up to be "commit-based"—firing events only on successful actions—which was a significant challenge but resulted in a far more robust and scalable game.

Also a challenge was designing a core scoring mechanic that felt like a classic deckbuilder without just cloning one. My first few ideas were either too simple (boring flat bonuses) or too complex and unbalanced (math-heavy multipliers). The breakthrough was the "Technique & Potency" system, where a "Base" bottle's color dictates the scoring rules for the other "Infusion" bottles. Balancing the four distinct scoring techniques against each other to ensure all were viable strategies was the most difficult and rewarding design puzzle of the jam.

Team **Spirit Of Delphi** -- Pradhumn Bhati

> Route that care for you

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Google API](https://img.shields.io/badge/Google%20API-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Personal safety in public spaces is a growing concern, especially for vulnerable groups and in unfamiliar environments. During emergencies, people often struggle to notify their contacts or provide a real-time location quickly, and there’s usually no easy way to rate or review street-level safety after an incident.

This responsive web app provides a simple, **mobile-friendly** solution:

**Instant SOS Alerts**: With one tap, users can immediately notify their emergency contacts, making it much easier to request help during distress.

**Effortless Feedback**: Users can rate the safety of streets and share helpful comments for the community, making everyday travel safer for everyone.

**Fastest and Safest Route Suggestions**: The web-app intelligently suggests both the fastest and safest possible routes based on real-time and historical safety data, helping users make informed travel decisions, especially at night.

**No Installation Required**: The website works on any device, removing barriers for those who can’t install traditional apps.

**User-Centric Design**: A clear, fast, and simple interface makes emergency actions possible even under stress.

By streamlining how people ask for help, choose safe routes, and share safety insights, the app empowers safer journeys and helps communities become more aware of local risks.

**Challenges we ran into**

We tried to fulfill all those project objectives, but most of the time we ran into errors. We firstly wrote all the code for the features we wanted to add in a Colab file. It was all good there, but when we moved it to .py file and tried to integrate the frontend and backend, it failed. It contained logical errors. The path that we wanted to show was fixed, we don't know why, even though we tried to find bugs and corrected them in each file we had in our project folder. The pinpoints were moving but the path was still fixed. We couldn't test sos function because twilio is paid. We searched for other alternatives to implement sos function but none of them seemed to be reliable.

### AudioMind
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/audiomind-63b1) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/rith1509/AudioMind) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1MZQ5xIKWPPVbbDGDlvBYu5DMwGNXQooP/view?usp=drive_link) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Syntax%20Error%202025-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://syntax-error-2025.devfolio.co)

> Turn audio into searchable,intelligent archive

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

AudioMind turns audio into an asset for various users, ensuring all data remains secure on your local machine.

For Professionals & Teams: Securely process meeting recordings to create a searchable archive, automate meeting minutes, and track action items without sending sensitive data to the cloud.

For Students & Researchers: Convert lectures and interviews into accurate transcripts. Use the chat feature as an intelligent study partner to review concepts and quickly find key information.

For Content Creators: Instantly repurpose a single podcast episode into summaries, show notes, and blog posts, dramatically cutting down on manual work and maximizing your content's reach.

**Challenges we ran into**

A major challenge during development was getting the local Llama 3 model (running via Ollama) to consistently produce valid JSON for the insight generation task. Unlike commercial APIs, self-hosted models can be "chatty"—they often add conversational text before or after the JSON object (e.g., "Here is the JSON you requested..."). They also frequently made minor formatting errors, such as adding trailing commas or getting cut off before finishing the final closing brace, causing the server to crash during parsing.

The Solution: An Iterative and Robust Strategy
Getting over this hurdle required moving from a simple request to a multi-layered, robust solution:

Initial Failure: Simply asking the model for JSON was unreliable and failed over 50% of the time.

Manual String Cleaning: The first fix involved adding code to manually find the first { and last } in the model's response and to strip out any trailing commas. This improved the success rate but was still brittle and would fail if the model's output was incomplete.

The Breakthrough - Markdown Wrapping: The final, stable solution was to change the prompt to instruct the model to wrap its entire response in a ```json markdown block. We then updated the server code to specifically look for this block and extract its content. This technique cleanly separated the desired JSON from any conversational filler text.

Parameter Tuning: To solve the final "cut-off" issue where the response was incomplete, we added numCtx and numPredict parameters to the Ollama configuration, giving the model a larger memory and output buffer to ensure it could always finish its thought.

Team **AudioMind** -- [Rith Rajak](https://github.com/rith1509)

> Fully Onchain 3d racing game built on Starknet

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Blender](https://img.shields.io/badge/Blender-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Cairo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Cairo-333333?style=flat-square) ![Starknetjs](https://img.shields.io/badge/Starknetjs-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Project Demo : https://docs.google.com/document/d/1I5cHb4mSfL9qb2dnbLcZ4YEIeS_Nsl_F5db5yAbGDCo/edit?usp=sharing

Project Pitch : https://www.canva.com/design/DAG1jNSuUgs/2Oi4Njk6Ve_rj7wd4-jgMw/edit?utm_content=DAG1jNSuUgs&utm_campaign=designshare&utm_medium=link2&utm_source=sharebutton

**Loss of Progress & Ownership:**
- In traditional Web2 games, players lose their achievements, assets, and progress when servers shut down or companies discontinue titles. Over 35 million users from Pixelmon’s Minecraft server lost their progress overnight—showing how centralized systems give players no real ownership.

**Centralized Control:**
- Studios and publishers hold full control over player data, game economies, and progression. Players have no say in how assets are managed or transferred between versions or titles.

**Cheating & Manipulation:**

- Web2 games rely on centralized servers for verification, making them prone to hacks, exploits, and cheating tools that alter game data. This ruins fairness and damages trust among competitive players.

**Player Retention Collapse:**

- When players lose progress or face unfair gameplay due to cheating, they leave. This leads to short-lived titles, fragmented communities, and reduced long-term engagement.

**How Blockza-Horizon Solves This**

**On-Chain Persistence:**

- Every match, stat, and progression record is stored on-chain—ensuring it can’t be lost, altered, or deleted by any central entity.

**Decentralized Asset Ownership:**

- Player items, skins, and progress exist as verifiable on-chain assets, not as entries in a private server. Even if the studio stops operating, players retain access.

**Cheat-Proof Gameplay:**

- By verifying actions and outcomes through blockchain logic, our game eliminates the possibility of client-side manipulation or stat spoofing. Every kill, move, and reward is cryptographically validated

.

**Trustless Competition:**

- The system ensures fairness by removing reliance on centralized servers and human moderators—restoring player trust in competitive gaming.

**Long-Term Retention:**

- With assets, identity, and progress secured permanently, players have strong incentives to stay invested and grow within the ecosystem.

**Challenges we ran into**

- Not enough time to polish features.
- Scope kept expanding.
- Last-minute bugs and regressions.
- Hard-to-integrate third-party services.
- Weird environment/config differences between machines.
- Fragile deployment pipeline.
- Limited playtesting / edge cases missed.
- Poor or no documentation.
- Team coordination / handoff confusion.
- Basic security and abuse vectors left untested.

**Open Track - Development**

we strive to bring fully onchain fps gaming to the common web2 masses

**Walrus Track**

for efficient utilization of storage of our ingame assets

Team **BlockRooms** -- [Suhas Ghosal](https://github.com/suhas-sensei)

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![OAuth](https://img.shields.io/badge/OAuth-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Our complaint tracker web app provides a streamlined platform for citizens or users to report issues within a community or organization. It allows users to submit complaints with detailed descriptions, images, and exact geolocations, ensuring accurate reporting. Administrators and group managers can track the status of each complaint in real time, prioritize tasks, and assign resolutions efficiently. With features like AI-based prediction of complaint type and estimated resolution time, as well as post summarization and recommendation, the app reduces manual effort, increases transparency, and ensures timely responses, ultimately improving civic engagement and accountability.

**Challenges we ran into**

While building the complaint tracker web app, several challenges arose. Integrating real-time updates with Socket.io required careful management of joining and leaving groups to prevent duplicate or missed messages. Implementing geolocation validation using the Haversine formula and OpenStreetMap APIs was tricky, ensuring users could only post within a valid radius. Handling file uploads with previews and connecting them to AI-based prediction models posed both frontend and backend complexities. Managing state across forms, maps, and modals in React while keeping the UI responsive was challenging. Ensuring secure user identification and preventing default values like user_id = 1 also demanded careful debugging.

## 🌟 Overview

**Caravan Stories** is a full-stack web application designed to streamline the process of **reporting, tracking, and resolving community issues**.
The platform supports **three distinct user roles** with dedicated dashboards and functionalities.

---

## ✨ Features

### 👤 For Citizens

* 🎫 Create and track tickets/complaints
* 📊 View ticket status and timeline
* 🔍 Filter tickets by status (pending, in-progress, resolved)
* 📈 Dashboard with personal statistics
* 🔔 Real-time ticket updates

### 👷 For Employees

* 📋 View assigned tickets
* ✅ Update ticket status
* 📝 Add comments and updates
* 📊 Personal performance statistics
* 🎯 Quick action tools

### 🧑‍💼 For Administrators

* 👥 Employee management (create, view, edit)
* 🎫 Ticket oversight and assignment
* 📊 Comprehensive analytics and statistics
* 📈 Category-wise breakdown
* 🏢 Department-based filtering
* ✅ Role request approvals

### ⚙️ General Features

* 🔐 Secure authentication system
* ✉️ Email verification
* 🔑 Password recovery
* 👤 User profile management
* 📱 Responsive design
* 🖼️ File upload support for tickets
* 📧 Email notifications

## 🚀 Getting Started

### **Prerequisites**

* Node.js (v14 or higher)
* MongoDB (local or Atlas)
* npm or yarn package manager

### **Installation**

1. **Clone the repository**

   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/NagarjunaVem/Caravan-Stories
   cd caravan-stories
   ```

2. **Install server dependencies**

   ```bash
   cd server
   npm install
   ```

3. **Install client dependencies**

   ```bash
   cd ../client
   npm install
   ```

4. **Set up environment variables**
   Create `.env` files in both `server` and `client` directories (see [Environment Variables](#-environment-variables)).

5. **Start MongoDB**
   Ensure MongoDB is running locally or configure your Atlas connection string.

6. **Run the application**

   **Server (from server directory):**

   ```bash
   npm start
   # or for development
   npm run dev
   ```

   **Client (from client directory):**

   ```bash
   npm run dev
   ```

7. **Access the application**

   * Frontend: [http://localhost:5173](http://localhost:5173)
   * Backend: [http://localhost:5000](http://localhost:5000)

**Challenges we ran into**

# Challenges We Faced

## Deployment & Integration Issues

The biggest challenge was getting everything to work after deployment. On **localhost, everything ran smoothly**, but when we deployed the frontend to **Vercel** and backend to **Render.com**, things broke.

First, **Users can't verify** as **GMail SMTP** was being blocked by Render's servers, so password resets and account verifications failed. We fixed this by deploying our backend in **Vercel**.

Third, **Dashboard statistics wouldn't fetch from DB** in real-time. Searched a lot in **ChatGPT** and found a fix.

Fourth, **404 error on reloads** fixed by addind **vercel.json**. Got this from **ChatGPT**.

Finally, we faced **random authorization errors** between Vercel and Render because environment variables weren't syncing properly and CORS wasn't configured correctly. After ensuring the JWT secret was identical on both platforms and fixing CORS settings, authentication worked smoothly.

Team **HalfStack** -- [Mettu Shubham](https://github.com/Mettu-Shubham), [Nagarjuna Reddy](https://github.com/NagarjunaVem)

**The problem it solves**

Let’s be real — sharing your art online isn’t always fun. Most platforms aren’t built for artists, they’re built for everyone, which means your work gets lost in the noise.

This project gives artists their own corner of the internet — a place to post, explore, and connect without the clutter.

You can:

1. Show off your art in a clean, simple space that actually focuses on your work.

2. Find other creators who share your vibe and get inspired by their styles.

3. Keep things safe, since your data and login are protected with tools like bcryptjs and JWT.

4. Enjoy a smooth experience thanks to the MERN stack — fast, modern, and reliable.

It basically takes all the messy parts of sharing art online and makes them easy — so you can focus on creating, not dealing with tech stuff.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges I Ran Into

Building this project wasn’t all smooth sailing — a few bumps definitely showed up along the way:

1. Working with Elasticsearch

Getting Elasticsearch to play nicely was harder than expected. My sample data didn’t have proper names, captions, or tags, which made search results look completely random. I had to go back, clean and rename the data, then re-index everything to make it meaningful and usable.

2. Styling with CSS Instead of Tailwind

I decided to write my own CSS instead of relying on Tailwind, which meant doing everything manually — animations, spacing, responsiveness, the whole deal. It was time-consuming, but I learned a lot about fine-tuning layouts and transitions.

3. Frontend - Backend Coordination

Keeping the frontend and backend perfectly synced was tricky — especially with cookies, tokens, and Google Auth. Sometimes, one side worked while the other broke. I fixed it by carefully aligning API responses, authentication flows, and error handling between both sides.

Caravan Chronicle – Grievance Management System
Overview
Caravan Chronicle is a web-based Grievance Management System designed to streamline the process of submitting, tracking, and resolving grievances within an organization or institution.
The platform provides separate dashboards for users, administrators, and managers, ensuring transparency, accountability, and faster grievance resolution.

Features
🧾 User Registration & Login — Secure authentication for all users.
📢 Submit Grievances — Users can file complaints with category, description, and optional attachments.
🕓 Track Status — Real-time updates on complaint status (Pending, In Progress, Resolved).
🛠️ Admin Dashboard — Admins can view, assign, and update grievances efficiently.
📊 Analytics & Reports — Overview of total grievances, resolution rate, and category-wise analysis.
🔔 Email Notifications — Alerts for new submissions or updates (optional feature).
🗄️ MongoDB Database — Secure and scalable data storage for grievances and user data.

![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Express.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Express.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Creative teams in live performance production struggle with scattered workflows — performers capture ideas separately, writers structure scripts offline, directors plan shows manually, and developers work in isolation. Our project solves this by providing an AI-powered collaborative platform where all roles work together in real time — capturing ideas, expanding scripts, sequencing acts, and building interactive elements — all within one integrated, role-flexible system.

**Challenges we ran into**

Real-Time Collaboration: Ensuring smooth, lag-free co-editing and communication between multiple users.

AI Integration: Seamlessly embedding AI tools (summarization, expansion, speech-to-text) without compromising accuracy or speed.

Role Management: Handling dynamic role-switching while maintaining correct permissions and dashboard views.

Data Synchronization: Keeping scripts, ideas, and updates consistent across users and sessions.

User Experience Design: Building an intuitive interface for both creative and technical users.

Scalability: Supporting multiple simultaneous performances, scripts, and teams.

> Your personal medicine companion

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Firebase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Express.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Express.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

CareSphere empowers users—especially performers, chronic patients, the elderly, or caregivers—to manage complex medicine routines effortlessly and safely. Instead of juggling sticky notes or multiple alarms, users simply register and set up their medication schedules (pill name, dosage, time, frequency). The system then handles the rest: sending reminders via browser alerts, email, or even Google Calendar synchronization so the stay-in-your-routine becomes seamless. On the dashboard, users see all upcoming and past reminders, and a log of taken versus missed doses—meaning you don’t have to depend on memory or handwritten journals. Behind the scenes, CareSphere’s AI module studies usage patterns to detect when you’re likely to miss a dose (for example, after dinner), and then proactively nudges you back on track. For inquiries like “Which pill do I need today?” or “Did I miss yesterday’s dose?” the AI chatbot health assistant supports natural-language questions. In the background, data visualizations plot trends over time—adherence rates, missed doses, wellness scores—helping users recognize patterns and adjust their routines. Integrating with Google Calendar ensures that medicine reminders are part of your everyday schedule, reducing friction. In short, CareSphere turns medication management from a burden into a guided, intuitive service—boosting safety, consistency, and peace of mind for users and caregivers alike.

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/resha-1173) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://www.reshaa.xyz/index.html) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/-GQ9kNwNSaw?si=bEXJY01O__oWnvaN) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-EcoCode-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://ecocode.devfolio.co)

> Empowering traditional Artisans

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The Problem It Solves

Resha digitally empowers traditional artisans by removing middlemen, bridging language barriers, and connecting them directly with customers.

How It Helps (Uses & Benefits)

For Customers:

Use AI + AR try-ons to visualize products on themselves before buying.

Get true-to-size previews, reducing wrong fits and returns.

Earn crypto rewards for sustainable purchases.

For Artisans:

Show designs in real-time AR previews to attract buyers.

Communicate in 100+ languages with voice/text translation via encrypted chat.

Receive direct orders with no intermediaries, increasing income.

For the Ecosystem:

Reduces material waste with digital sampling.

Protects authenticity using blockchain and QR-based storytelling.

Revives culture by digitizing handloom heritage and connecting youth to crafts.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges I Ran Into

AR Fit Calibration Issues:
Early AR models distorted clothing proportions on different body types. We solved this by integrating real-body measurement scaling and testing with varied 3D meshes.

Multilingual Chat Sync:
Real-time translation often delayed responses. We implemented asynchronous WebRTC channels and optimized Whisper + GPT translation caching for faster replies.

AI Pattern Consistency:
Initial AI designs lacked cultural accuracy. We fine-tuned the model on Indian textile datasets and integrated human-in-the-loop review for cultural alignment.

Device Compatibility:
WebAR was unstable on low-end phones. We added fallback 2D previews and lightweight Three.js rendering modes to ensure smooth accessibility.

**The Green Metaverse & Future Economies**

Green Metaverse Integration:
Resha creates a virtual marketplace where artisans, designers, and customers interact through 3D immersive spaces. Each product and artisan story exists as a digital asset, verified via blockchain & QR codes for authenticity.

Sustainability by Design:
By replacing physical sampling with AI + AR visualization, Resha reduces fabric waste and carbon emissions from returns and logistics — promoting a greener production cycle.

Future Economy Layer:
Every purchase and engagement earns Resha Coins, a crypto reward system encouraging sustainable choices. These tokens can be used within the platform or exchanged, creating a circular digital economy that empowers artisans financially.

Digital Heritage Economy:
Traditional crafts gain new life in the metaverse, where cultural techniques are tokenized and preserved, letting future generations trade, display, and learn from these creations globally.

> You deserve everything to know!

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Offline Mode for Farmers (Poor Connectivity Areas):
To address connectivity issues in rural regions, we implemented a partial offline system that allows farmers to continue using the application even without internet access. Data such as harvest details and QR code generation can be stored locally and automatically synced to the cloud once the connection is restored. This ensures uninterrupted functionality and inclusivity for farmers in remote areas.

Developing a Reliable Trust Score System:
We created an intelligent Trust Score algorithm that aggregates and analyzes multiple data sources — including government agency testing, private laboratory results, and verified community feedback.

The system evaluates factors like journey time, farming practices, and carbon footprint to determine credibility.

A community verification committee further strengthens this process by validating the data inputs.

This approach promotes transparency, accountability, and trust among all stakeholders — farmers, consumers, and regulatory bodies.

**Challenges we ran into**

1.Offline Accessibility for Farmers:
One of the major challenges was ensuring that the platform remained functional in areas with poor or no internet connectivity. Since many farmers operate in remote regions where network coverage is limited, developing an efficient offline mode became essential. The goal was to allow farmers to access important features and record data even without internet access, and later sync it automatically when connectivity was restored.

2.Creating a reliable trust score system that fairly represents data from various sources like government agency testing, private lab results, and community verifications was complex. Combining these in a transparent and unbiased way was a major challenge.

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/swachhdrishti-e21d) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/pranavgarg502/SwachhSaarthi) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/wtS7dWyWGlo) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-EcoCode-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://ecocode.devfolio.co)

> Swachh bharat ka iraada, ye vaada kardiya hamne

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Cloudinary](https://img.shields.io/badge/Cloudinary-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Despite producing thousands of tons of waste daily, Indian cities struggle with segregation and efficient waste handling:
1)Poor household segregation → Mixed waste & <30% source segregation
2)Unsorted community bins → Recyclables lost & bins overflowing
3)Unsafe warehouse sorting → Labour-intensive, slow & hazardous
4)Fixed truck routes → Fuel wasted & missed hotspots
5)Unreported dumping → Local pollution & health risks
Core challenge → Absence of end-to-end segregation, real-time intelligence & dependence on labour-intensive processes

**Challenges we ran into**

Lack of existing datasets – Publicly available waste segregation datasets were scarce, requiring manual collection and labeling.

Time constraints for model training – Limited time made it hard to train high-accuracy models, especially for deep learning approaches.

Data diversity issues – Variations in lighting, angles, and types of waste made creating a robust model challenging.

Annotation difficulties – Labeling images for supervised learning was labor-intensive and prone to inconsistencies.

Hardware limitations – Training deep learning models on large datasets was constrained by available computing resources.

Integration with real-world application – Ensuring the AI system works accurately in different environments (home, street, industrial) was challenging.

**Intelligent Ecosystems & Circular Economies**

SwachhDrishti leverages AI to enhance urban resilience and support circular economies by combining real-time data collection, optimized waste management, and citizen engagement:

Data-driven route optimization: Using inputs from a WhatsApp bot, CCTV detection, and website reports, the system identifies waste hotspots and plans efficient collection routes, reducing time, fuel, and operational costs.

Automated waste segregation: Collected waste is processed through AI-powered segregation, ensuring recyclables and organic waste are properly separated, facilitating recycling and minimizing landfill usage.

Citizen engagement & awareness: Gamified interactions encourage residents to participate in cleanliness initiatives, fostering behavioral change and community involvement.

Impact: This integrated approach strengthens urban resilience by keeping cities cleaner, promotes circular economy principles through better recycling, and builds citizen awareness for long-term sustainability.

> Safe Missions Start with Smart Detection

![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Space stations are complex and high-risk environments where astronauts must quickly locate and use critical safety equipment in case of emergencies. Mistakes or delays in finding safety tools can lead to serious hazards, including fire, chemical leaks, or medical emergencies.

This AI-powered Space Station Safety Detection system helps by:

Automatically detecting important safety objects such as:

Fire extinguishers

First aid kits

Nitrogen tanks

Space tanks

Emergency phones

Fire alarms

Safety switch panels

Improving emergency response time — astronauts can instantly locate safety equipment through real-time visual alerts.

Enhancing safety and efficiency — reduces the chance of human error in high-stress situations.

Making routine monitoring easier — AI can continuously scan areas and flag missing or misplaced safety objects.

 Use Cases:

Real-time safety monitoring in space stations or laboratories.

Training simulations for astronauts to quickly locate and use safety equipment.

Automated reporting for maintenance teams to ensure all safety devices are functional and in place.

**Challenges we ran into**

During the project, several technical hurdles were encountered, especially related to coding and file management. Syntax errors were frequent, often stemming from missing punctuation, incorrect indentation, or typos in the code. Additionally, "file not found" and "invalid file" errors presented recurring challenges, usually caused by misnamed files, incorrect file paths, or misplaced project assets.

A significant obstacle was managing the project structure and zipping files correctly before uploading or running them. Each time an error was encountered, it required multiple attempts at running the same script, carefully reading the error messages, and systematically addressing each issue—such as re-checking file extensions, ensuring all necessary files were included in the zip, and validating syntax line by line.

By staying persistent, utilizing incremental debugging, and referring to official documentation for error codes, these issues were gradually resolved. This approach not only fixed the immediate bugs but also increased confidence in tackling similar problems in future projects.

**AI**

This project fits perfectly into the AI Track of the hackathon by leveraging artificial intelligence to solve a critical real-world challenge: enhancing safety within a space station using smart object detection. The core aim is to build an AI model capable of recognizing key safety objects—such as oxygen tanks, emergency phones, and fire extinguishers—under varied lighting and visibility conditions, which is a prime example of applying AI to life-saving problem domains.

The project utilizes computer vision and deep learning techniques to process visual data and identify important objects, directly showcasing the power of AI for real-time classification and localization tasks.

> Where space meets the ocean

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Machine Learning](https://img.shields.io/badge/Machine%20Learning-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Data Visualization](https://img.shields.io/badge/Data%20Visualization-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Shark-Sphere fills the gap in real-time shark foraging tracking by combining satellite monitoring with smart bio-logging tags.

Uses :
- Biologists & Conservationists: Identify hotspots, protect habitats, reduce conflicts.
- Fisheries & Policy Makers: Create data-driven regulations, prevent bycatch.
- Global Conservation: Scale across species and oceans, support international efforts.

Easier & Safer :

- Real-time data (no long waits).
- High prediction accuracy (~88%).
- Protects ecosystems & fisheries.
- Reduces human-shark risks.

**Challenges we ran into**

While building Shark-Sphere, I faced multiple challenges. Dataset modeling was complex due to the variability of oceanographic inputs and limited tagged shark data. Developing a reliable mathematical framework to accurately predict foraging habitats required fine-tuning weights and handling uncertainties in real-time conditions. Designing a lightweight, long-duration device that could withstand ocean pressure and be safely fitted on sharks was another hurdle. Finally, identifying and serving the right set of variables such as chlorophyll concentration, sea surface temperature, depth, and distance from shore was difficult since all of them influence shark behavior in different ways. I overcame these challenges by iteratively refining models, reviewing existing literature, and validating predictions with preliminary data correlations.
