> multiple AI models comparison

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB Atlas](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB%20Atlas-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![React.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/React.js-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

1️⃣ Conflicting AI Answers
	•	Different AI models often give different answers to the same prompt.
	•	Fusion Model merges them intelligently so the user doesn’t have to read through multiple responses.

⸻

2️⃣ Overload of Information
	•	Multiple responses can be overwhelming for users.
	•	Fusion Model summarizes and consolidates the information into one coherent answer.

⸻

3️⃣ Improved Accuracy
	•	Individual AI responses may be partially correct.
	•	Fusion Model can pick the most accurate parts from each model to form a more reliable final response.

⸻

4️⃣ Better User Experience
	•	User gets one high-quality answer instead of manually comparing multiple AI outputs.
	•	Reduces confusion and saves time.

⸻

5️⃣ Unique Selling Proposition (USP)
	•	Unlike standard multi-AI platforms that just show all responses, this actively fuses responses for clarity and reliability.
	•	Essentially, it’s a “best of all AI” answer generator.

**Challenges we ran into**

•	Managing API rate limits and free plan restrictions.
•	Ensuring secure API key handling in a Next.js environment.
•	Choosing a metric (like longest response, most complete answer) to decide which AI gave the best output.
•	Handling cases where responses are contradictory or incomplete.
•	Designing a responsive interface where multiple AI cards appear side-by-side.
•	Ensuring the prompt input stays accessible while scrolling.
•	Managing scrolling, overflow, and animations for a clean visual experience.

**The problem it solves**

Emerging artists—such as singers, dancers, musicians, and hosts—struggle to find fair opportunities to showcase their talent. Most rely on informal networks or middlemen who often take large commissions, limit visibility, and reduce earnings. On the other hand, event organizers and venues face difficulty in discovering the right talent quickly and reliably, leading to wasted time, higher costs, and mismatched performances.
 🔹For Artists – Instead of depending on word-of-mouth or costly middlemen, they get a single platform to create profiles, showcase work, set their own prices, and get direct bookings.

🔹 For Organizers – Instead of spending days searching and negotiating, they can browse verified profiles, compare artists, check ratings, and book instantly.

**Challenges we ran into**

1. UI/UX Breakpoints

    Issue: Website looked fine on desktop but broke on mobile screens.
    Solution: Used responsive design (CSS flex/grid and media queries) and tested on different devices.

2. Performance Issues

    Issue: Some pages were loading slowly due to unoptimized queries and images.
    Solution: Optimized queries, compressed images, and cached frequent requests.

3. Integration Bugs

    Issue: Payment gateway / booking module wasn’t integrating properly at first.
    Solution: Went through documentation carefully, tested APIs with sample data, and handled error codes properly.

By doing this, it makes students feel understood, supported, and less alone.

Instead of letting these problems build up, the system offers small and timely support in everyday life. This creates a healthier, more positive learning environment where students can focus better and feel cared for.

Key Benefits

Detects mood in real-time to understand how students are feeling.

Suggests music and activities that improve or balance their mood.

Provides a safe chat board for expression and connection.

Offers quick support before stress becomes a bigger problem.

Encourages a healthier and more supportive learning atmosphere.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges I Ran Into

While building this project, I faced a few challenges that really shaped the way it turned out:

Making mood detection feel real: At first, small things like bad lighting or a faint smile confused the system. I had to test it again and again until it felt more natural.

Music suggestions for everyone: I realized one song can’t fit all moods. To solve this, I created mood-based playlists so students could pick what matched their feelings best.

Creating a safe chat board: I didn’t want it to feel like just another chat box. I worked on privacy and moderation to make it a space where students felt comfortable opening up.

Balancing performance and trust: The system had to run smoothly without making students feel watched. I focused on keeping it fast, friendly, and optional so users felt in control.


In the end, these challenges taught me that building technology isn’t just about solving problems — it’s about creating something that makes people feel supported and understood.

**The problem it solves**

# The Problem It Solves

Students often face challenges such as:

**Information overload**: Too many scattered resources without structure.

**Lack of personalization**: Generic roadmaps that don’t fit individual goals.

 **Limited guidance**: Human teachers and mentors can’t scale to everyone’s needs.

**Low motivation & consistency**: No adaptive tracking or reminders to keep learners on track.

# What People Can Use It For

**Personalized Study Roadmaps**: Automatically generated plans based on goals (e.g., exams, skills, or self-learning).

**AI Subject Teachers**: On-demand explanations, Q&A, and tutoring support.

**Progress Tracking**: Milestones, reminders, and adaptive scheduling to improve consistency.

**Goal Achievement**: Helps students break down long-term objectives into actionable daily/weekly tasks.

**Tiered Features**: Free users get structured plans, while premium users unlock deep analytics, interactive tutors, and advanced strategies.

# How It Makes Tasks Easier & Safer

**Efficiency**: Saves time by generating structured learning paths instantly.

**Clarity**: Reduces confusion from random internet resources by offering focused guidance.

**Adaptability**: Plans evolve with learner progress, ensuring continuous alignment with goals.

**Accessibility**: Provides teacher-like mentorship without geographic or time restrictions.

**Scalability**: Safely supports thousands of learners with AI-driven automation.

**Challenges we ran into**

**Multi-Agent Workflow Development**:
One of the biggest hurdles we faced was building the agentic workflow. Initially, we experimented with CrewAI, but scaling the system proved difficult. We tried multiple SDKs, including OpenAI’s SDK, before finally settling on LangGraph, which provided the flexibility and scalability we needed for multi-agent orchestration.

**Context Management for Users**:
Another challenge has been handling the context size of user interactions. Since LLMs have limitations on input length, ensuring that user history and goals remain relevant without exceeding limits is tricky. To overcome this, we are working on query optimization, response summarization, and efficient context window management to keep interactions smooth and scalable.

**Collaboration & Networking**: Hackathons bring together innovators, mentors, and like-minded builders. This environment allows us to connect with people who share the same passion for solving impactful problems.

**Learning & Growth**: Beyond coding, hackathons offer exposure to new tools, best practices, and real-world challenges. It’s an opportunity to sharpen our skills while getting feedback that will help us grow as a team.

**Real-World Impact**: Our solution addresses a genuine problem—personalized learning and mentorship at scale. By tackling this during the hackathon, we demonstrate how technology can solve meaningful challenges in education.

**Innovation Aligned With Track Goals**: The project uses cutting-edge technologies like LLMs, multi-agent systems, and adaptive workflows, aligning perfectly with hackathon themes of innovation, problem-solving, and future-ready solutions.

**The problem it solves**

The Problem it Solves

Manual or outdated attendance = time-consuming, error-prone, and vulnerable to proxy/fraud.
Teachers waste 5–10 minutes per class just marking attendance.
Students can cheat the system (proxy marking for friends).


Makes Tasks Easier

For Teachers: Attendance becomes instant, automated, and accurate → more time for teaching.
For Students: Fair system, no one can cheat → builds trust.
For Institutes/Admins: Reliable, tamper-proof digital records that are auditable anytime.
For Security: Proxy-proof via liveness detection (blink/smile) + cryptographic QR validation.

**Challenges we ran into**

QR Expiry Management

1.Needed to ensure QR codes expire within seconds.
2.Challenge: balancing security (short expiry) with usability (students need time to scan).
3.Face & Liveness Detection
4.Hard to make it fast yet accurate on mobile devices.
5.Challenge: detecting blink/smile without lag, and avoiding false positives.

Proxy Attempts

1.Students might try screenshotting/forwarding QR.
2.Solved using nonce + signature to make each QR one-time use.

Device Binding

1.Needed to ensure students don’t log in from someone else’s phone.
2.Challenge: securely binding attendance to a registered device ID.

Network & Infrastructure

1.Attendance should work even if internet is slow/unreliable.
2.Challenge: designing a system that’s lightweight and fault-tolerant.
3.Integration with Existing Systems

### Truthguard
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/truthguard-b049) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://truthguard20.netlify.app/login.html) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-NexHack-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://nexhack.devfolio.co)

> Fake news detection system

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

In today’s digital world, news spreads faster than ever before. Unfortunately, so does fake news. A single misleading headline or manipulated post can go viral within minutes, reaching millions of people. This creates serious problems: it misguides public opinion, spreads panic during health crises, damages reputations, and even influences elections and financial markets. Social media platforms are filled with content that looks real but is completely false, and most people don’t have the time or tools to check authenticity. Existing fact-checking methods are either too slow, too technical, or not accessible for everyday users. This gap allows misinformation to grow unchecked. Our project directly tackles this issue by providing an easy, fast, and trustworthy way for anyone to verify the truth before believing or sharing news.

**Challenges we ran into**

One major challenge we faced while building this project was making our AI model accurately detect fake news. At first, the system would sometimes misclassify news that was real but written in a strong or emotional tone as “fake.” This reduced user trust. To fix this, we improved our dataset by including a mix of both factual and opinion-based articles, so the model could learn the difference. Another hurdle was integrating external fact-check APIs — sometimes the APIs were slow or returned incomplete data. We solved this by creating a fallback mechanism: if the API didn’t return a result, our AI model would still give a confidence score instead of leaving the user with no answer. These challenges taught us the importance of balancing accuracy, speed, and user trust in our system.

**$300(Open): Cash Prize**

We’re using Natural Language Processing (NLP) to analyze and classify news content, combining it with fact-check APIs to create a more intelligent system. Fake news directly affects society, politics, and health. By reducing misinformation, our project contributes to a safer and more informed community. TruthGuard helps protect people from misinformation attacks, propaganda, and scams — making online spaces more trustworthy. Our solution isn’t just a model, it’s a complete product—website, app, and browser extension — making it highly usable for real-world adoption. The unique part is transparency. Unlike other tools, we don’t just say “fake”; we show why it’s fake, building real user trust.

> Smart Issue Reportingfor Smarter Cities

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![AI/ML](https://img.shields.io/badge/AI/ML-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Cities today face countless small but critical civic problems — potholes, broken streetlights, overflowing garbage, water leaks, and more. These issues negatively affect public safety, hygiene, and quality of life.
However, there is a major gap between citizens noticing problems and local authorities taking timely action. Most cities lack a unified, intelligent, and transparent platform to manage and resolve public complaints efficiently.

**Challenges we ran into**

One specific hurdle I faced while building the CityFix app was with integrating the interactive map using Leaflet in a Next.js environment. Since Next.js does server-side rendering (SSR) by default, the Leaflet library—which depends on browser APIs like window and document—was throwing errors and breaking the build.

To overcome this:

I used dynamic imports and conditional checks (typeof window !== "undefined") to ensure Leaflet was only initialized on the client side.

I also isolated the map rendering logic inside a useEffect hook so that it only executed after the component mounted.

Finally, I tested multiple configurations to make sure the map markers (complaint locations) loaded correctly from dynamic query params.

This not only fixed the issue but also gave me a deeper understanding of handling SSR challenges in Next.js with client-side libraries.

**$300(Open): Cash Prize**

CityFix is a web-based platform that empowers citizens to report civic issues quickly and easily. Powered by AI, it automatically categorizes problems, prioritizes urgent cases, and routes them to the appropriate municipal department — all while keeping the citizen informed.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

# The Problem ClariFi Solves

Managing personal finances is often messy, time-consuming, and stressful. People struggle with:  

- **Tracking multiple income sources and expenses:** Manually juggling apps, spreadsheets, and bills.  
- **Digitizing and organizing receipts:** Paper bills and invoices get lost or are hard to manage.  
- **Preparing reports for taxes or accounting:** Time-consuming manual calculations and formatting.  
- **Understanding spending habits:** Hard to get actionable insights to improve financial decisions.  

**How ClariFi helps:**  
- Provides a **unified dashboard** to see all finances in one place.  
- **Automates tedious tasks** like bill digitization and report generation.  
- Offers **AI-driven insights** for smarter money decisions.  
- Makes finance management **faster, safer, and stress-free**, helping users focus on their work and goals instead of manual tracking.

**Challenges we ran into**

Our biggest challenge was the inconsistent accuracy of our OCR feature on diverse Indian receipts. Initial tests showed frequent errors in extracting data like **GSTIN** and **total amounts due** due to varied formats and poor image quality. This was a critical issue, as inaccurate data would make the entire app unreliable.

To overcome this, we engineered a smarter, AI-driven solution by building a custom wrapper around the **Gemini API**:

### 1. Image Pre-processing
Our wrapper first runs a lightweight pre-processing step on every uploaded image. It automatically:
- Enhances contrast  
- De-skews the receipt  
- Crops it to the relevant area  

This ensures Gemini receives the cleanest possible input for analysis.

### 2. The Gemini Wrapper & Prompt Engineering
Instead of building a complex recognition model from scratch, we built a dedicated API wrapper. This wrapper:
- Crafts a detailed prompt instructing the Gemini vision model to act as a financial data extractor  
- Specifically asks it to identify key fields—like "Total", "GSTIN", and "Vendor Name"
- Returns the findings in a structured JSON format  

This approach is far more reliable than trying to parse raw text output.

### 3. User Verification and Feedback Loop
After the wrapper receives the structured JSON data from Gemini, it populates a **confirmation screen**. This allows the user to:
- Quickly verify the extracted data for 100% accuracy  
- Provide a crucial feedback loop to refine prompts and image pre-processing for even better performance over time  

By leveraging Gemini's powerful multimodal capabilities through a smart wrapper, we solved a complex engineering problem efficiently, turning our unreliable OCR into a core, **highly accurate and trustworthy feature** of the app.

**$300(Open): Cash Prize**

ClariFi is an AI-Based Personal Finance Manager designed to help users track expenses, budget smartly, and prepare for future investments.  

- **AI-Powered Expense Tracking:** Users can digitize receipts instantly with OCR, and the AI automatically categorizes expenses for seamless tracking.  
- **Smart Budgeting:** An AI chatbot provides actionable insights and personalized tips to optimize spending and savings.  
- **Investment-Ready Financial Profiles:** By tracking income, spending, and savings goals, ClariFi builds structured profiles that can support tailored investment advice in future versions.  

In short, ClariFi leverages AI to transform financial chaos into clarity, empowering users to manage money smarter and achieve their financial goals.

**The problem it solves**

🚩 Problem It Solves

Rural areas → Lack of doctors, limited medical awareness, and delayed emergency help.

Urban areas → High stress, pollution, and late response to emergencies.

Existing apps → Too complex, English-only, or focused only on city users.


This leaves a huge gap in inclusive, simple, multilingual health & safety support.


---

🌍 What People Can Use It For

1. Check Symptoms Easily

Describe health issues in simple words or voice.

Get instant triage: safe at home, need check-up, or emergency alert.



2. Stay Updated with Local Alerts

Real-time alerts for disease outbreaks, pollution levels, extreme weather, accidents.

Example: “High dengue risk in your district this week.”



3. Daily Preventive Care

AI-powered health & wellness tips based on age, occupation, and region.

Delivered in local language for better understanding.



4. Emergency Quick-Connect

One-tap call to nearest hospital, ambulance, or police using location.

Works offline with stored emergency contacts & first-aid guides.





---

⚡ How It Makes Life Easier & Safer

Faster decisions in emergencies → AI tells if a symptom is urgent.

Localized safety awareness → People know risks around them before it’s too late.

Inclusive health support → Voice + regional language makes it accessible for all.

Everyday safety net → Even without doctors nearby, people get guidance & confidence.

**Challenges we ran into**

🛠️ Challenges I Ran Into

1. Symptom Checker Accuracy

Problem: The AI sometimes gave generic or irrelevant health advice.

Fix: Tuned prompts, added risk-level categories, and kept results limited to first-aid + triage guidance, not full diagnosis.



2. Multilingual Support

Problem: Translating medical terms into regional languages (Hindi & local dialects) caused confusion.

Fix: Used simple words + voice support, and fallback to Google Translate API for better coverage.



3. API Limitations

Problem: Weather, pollution, and health APIs had rate limits during testing.

Fix: Cached responses locally and created mock alerts for demo.



4. Emergency Button Integration

Problem: Geolocation sometimes failed in low-network areas.

Fix: Added offline fallback with stored emergency contacts & static first-aid guides.



5. Hackathon Time Crunch

Problem: Too many features to build in 24–36 hours.

Fix: Focused on a minimum viable demo → Symptom checker + mock alerts + emergency connect.

**$300(Open): Cash Prize**

The project aligns with the track by improving health outcomes, enhancing safety, and promoting preventive care using AI and accessible technology. It’s practical, scalable, and judges can experience the impact live, making it a strong candidate for the $300 prize.

> Your Flight To Clarity

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![SQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![OpenAi](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenAi-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tesseract OCR](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tesseract%20OCR-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Millions of students—especially from rural areas and those with learning disabilities like dyslexia or vision impairments—struggle to access and comprehend educational content. Traditional textbooks and PDFs remain text-heavy, inaccessible, and rarely available in regional languages, while most digital platforms focus on urban, English-speaking audiences. This neglect of accessibility features such as dyslexic-friendly modes, audio narration, and simplified explanations widens the educational divide, leaving vulnerable learners disengaged, underserved, and at a severe disadvantage.

We are building an AI-powered inclusive education portal that makes learning accessible, engaging, and personalized for every student. The platform transforms textbooks and PDFs into audio narrations, simplified summaries, and regional language translations, while offering dyslexic-friendly reading modes with customizable fonts, overlays, and read-along highlighting. An integrated AI tutor explains concepts in simple terms, generates adaptive quizzes, flashcards, and interactive story-based games to keep students motivated. Teachers and parents can upload content, monitor progress, and guide learners, while admins manage content and accessibility standards. By combining Generative AI, accessibility tools, and gamification, the portal bridges the digital education divide and empowers students with disabilities and rural learners to access quality education on equal terms.

**Challenges we ran into**

Problem: The initial text extraction from PDFs wasn't working. This was likely an issue with scanned pages.

Solution: They switched to the Tesseract OCR (Optical Character Recognition) method. This method extracts text from images, which was necessary for the scanned pages.

Quiz Answer Matching 

Problem: There was a problem matching quiz answers.

Solution: They modified the prompt for the Gemini API to return a JSON output. This output included the question, options, and the correct answer. For answer checking, the program would normalize the Gemini API's returned answer (e.g., lowercasing) and compare it to the user's selected option to calculate the score.

Database and Data Persistence 

Problem: Some data, such as quiz statistics, were only existing in the current session and were wiped after the session ended.

Solution: They decided to compromise by only storing important data that needed to be accessed later, like student progress, in a way that would persist and not be session-specific. This ensures key information is not lost.

Large File Handling on GitHub 

Problem: Pushing large files to GitHub, such as generated narration audio, was an issue.

Solution:

They prevented these large files from being pushed to the repository by using a .gitignore file.

The generated files are now stored locally on the user's system.

They added a download option for users. This allows users to manually download optional large files, such as audio, only if they want to, preventing the project's storage from becoming too large.

Large PDF Processing Time 

Problem: Processing large PDFs takes a significant amount of time.

Solution: No specific solution was implemented as the team found the issue to be understandable. The process of extracting and translating a large number of pages will naturally take more time.

### SafeCrowd: Smart Stampede Prevention System
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/smart-stampede-prevention-system-07a7) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/DhimanAddyy/SafeCrowd/blob/main/README.md) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-NexHack-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://nexhack.devfolio.co)

> Building a future where every celebration is safe.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![TensorFlow](https://img.shields.io/badge/TensorFlow-333333?style=flat-square) ![Chart.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Chart.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Nodejs](https://img.shields.io/badge/Nodejs-333333?style=flat-square) ![API3](https://img.shields.io/badge/API3-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The Smart Stampede Prevention System addresses the critical issue of deadly stampedes that occur during large gatherings such as religious events, concerts, sports matches, and political rallies. Traditional crowd management relies heavily on manual monitoring and delayed responses, which often fail when every second matters. Our system provides real-time detection and predictive analysis, allowing event organizers, security teams, and government authorities to identify danger zones 3–5 minutes before a stampede occurs. This early warning system enables quick action, such as alerting security personnel, redirecting crowds through dynamic digital signage, and automatically activating emergency protocols. By preventing chaos before it starts, the system saves lives, reduces injuries, and minimizes economic losses from lawsuits and venue shutdowns. It also makes large events safer and more efficient, giving attendees peace of mind while enabling organizers to host bigger and safer gatherings without fear of crowd-related disasters.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the biggest challenges we faced while building the Smart Stampede Prevention System was ensuring Real-time video processing with sub-second latency while handling multiple high-definition camera feeds. Initially, our AI models were too slow, causing delays that could have been life-threatening in real scenarios. We overcame this by implementing edge computing and optimizing our pipelines using TensorFlow Lite and OpenCV, which reduced processing time significantly. Another hurdle was dealing with false positives, where the system would trigger unnecessary alerts. To fix this, we integrated multi-modal data such as audio and environmental sensors, along with a staged alert mechanism to improve accuracy. We also faced privacy concerns around monitoring crowds, which we addressed by anonymizing data and blurring faces to comply with privacy regulations. Lastly, integrating our system with existing CCTV and emergency infrastructure was challenging, so we built a modular API layer to enable seamless integration without requiring costly hardware changes.

**$300(Open): Cash Prize**

Our system uses TensorFlow.js with the BlazeFace model to detect faces, monitor crowd density, movement speed, and exit capacity, and generate real-time alerts to prevent stampedes. Since it applies computer vision and AI for public safety, it naturally fits into the AI/ML Track, and can also be considered under Smart Cities or Social Good tracks, depending on the hackathon’s available categories

> AI-Powered Growth for Every Farmer

![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![scikit-learn](https://img.shields.io/badge/scikit--learn-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![HTML/CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML/CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**What Can Farmers Use It For?**

Our Smart Farming Assistant is designed to make farming smarter, safer, and more sustainable. Farmers can use it for:

- **Yield Prediction** – Get accurate estimates of expected crop yields before harvest.
- **Weather Insights** – Access real-time weather updates tailored to their farm’s location. 
- **Crop Recommendations** – Receive AI-based suggestions on which crops suit the soil, season, and resources.
- **Irrigation Guidance** – Learn when and how much to irrigate, reducing water waste.
- **Soil Health Monitoring** – Track soil pH, nutrients, and organic matter to maintain fertility.
- **Fertilizer Optimization** – Get safe, cost-effective fertilizer recommendations to prevent overuse.
- **Risk Reduction** – Reduce chances of crop failure by acting on AI-powered alerts.
- **Easy Access** – All insights delivered in a simple mobile/web app, available in local languages.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**How It Makes Tasks Easier & Safer**

- Automates data analysis so farmers don’t need complex tools.
- Prevents losses by predicting risks early.
- Saves money on unnecessary water, fertilizer, and pesticides.
- Encourages eco-friendly, sustainable farming practices.

**Challenges we ran into**

***Challenges I Ran Into***

- **Model Integration** – Initially, our trained ML model wasn’t giving predictions inside the Flask app. We fixed this by carefully matching the input features in both training and prediction pipelines.
- **API Issues** – While adding weather data, connecting to the Open Weather API sometimes failed or returned incomplete data. We solved this by adding proper error handling and default fallback values.
- **Frontend Responsiveness** – Embedding YouTube videos and keeping them responsive across devices was tricky. We used flexbox + CSS aspect ratios to make the video gallery clean and mobile-friendly.
- **Connecting Frontend & Backend** – Ensuring smooth data flow between the HTML form and Flask backend caused a few 404 errors. We solved it by carefully aligning routes (@app.route) with the form actions.
- **Environment Setup** – Some packages worked globally but failed in a virtual environment. The fix was properly maintaining a requirements.txt and reinstalling dependencies.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

***How We Overcame Them***

Team collaboration, debugging step by step, and testing frequently helped us overcome these hurdles. Each challenge improved our understanding of Flask, APIs, and ML integration.

> Smart AI-Powered Driver  Safety & Assistance

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flutter](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flutter-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/00fec3794ed745e9ac05640435e95f9c/6e3a4902-12c2-488e-b1fb-9f958b67cee6.png)🚗 **The Problem *SARTHI* Solves**

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/00fec3794ed745e9ac05640435e95f9c/c250d7e3-5ab8-4bbf-8975-b4e092533f1c.png)

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/00fec3794ed745e9ac05640435e95f9c/5600eaff-02b9-466a-84d0-f4a729af64ab.png)
Millions of middle-class and rural families in India cannot afford expensive ADAS-equipped vehicles like Tesla, while governments push to ban or scrap older cars for safety and pollution reasons. This leaves drivers vulnerable to accidents caused by drowsiness, distractions, and poor road conditions.

**SARTHI** solves this by retrofitting any vehicle with affordable, AI-powered driver monitoring, personalized alerts (in loved-one voices), real-time traffic + environmental hazard awareness, and SOS automation — giving middle-class drivers the safety of a luxury car at a fraction of the cost, while also helping governments modernize old vehicles instead of dismantling them.

**Challenges we ran into**

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/00fec3794ed745e9ac05640435e95f9c/37712249-9f6b-4bb5-bfa6-0f6292e6d9f0.png)### Challenges I Ran Into

1. **Hardware Integration Conflicts**

   * Initially, the Arduino Uno pin assignments for the LCD and SoftwareSerial overlapped, which caused the LCD to remain blank. This was tricky to debug because the sensors appeared to work but no feedback was visible. We resolved it by reassigning serial pins and adopting an I2C LCD module for smoother communication.

2. **Ultrasonic Sensor Accuracy**

   * At first, the ultrasonic sensor failed to detect obstacles reliably, especially below 20cm. The issue turned out to be noisy signals and improper placement. We overcame this by adjusting the trigger/echo wiring, adding a small delay filter, and calibrating detection thresholds.

3. **Servo Motor Jitter**

   * The steering servo would jitter and not hold a stable angle. This happened due to power supply inconsistencies when multiple motors were running. We fixed it by isolating the servo’s power supply with capacitors and ensuring a stable current source.

4. **ESP32 Communication Dropouts**

   * Serial communication between the Arduino Uno and ESP32 was unstable at first. Data packets would cut off or corrupt. We solved this by implementing newline-delimited JSON, adding simple error checking, and reducing baud rate for stability.

5. **Software Complexity**

   * Managing multiple features (emotion detection, alcohol sensor, navigation, alerts) quickly became complex. To solve this, we modularized the code — separating motor logic, sensor logic, and communication layers. This made debugging and scaling much easier.

6. **Cost Constraints**

   * With a budget of under ~₹5000(prototype), for future innovating ~₹30k-100k depend on the demand and usage, we couldn’t use advanced hardware like Tesla-grade sensors. Instead, we creatively used affordable modules (Arduino, ultrasonic sensors, MQ gas sensors, etc.) and smartphones/webcams for AI-based face/emotion detection.

7. **Realistic Simulation for Hackathon Demo**

   * Without access to a real car for safety testing, we faced challenges in showing real-world functionality. To overcome this, we built a moveable prototype vehicle with gear motors and wheels, allowing us to simulate scenarios (obstacle detection, SOS, drowsiness alerts) during the hackathon demo.

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/karunanidhan-31b5) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Hadn-t/KarunaNidhan) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-NexHack-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://nexhack.devfolio.co)

> AI helps rescue strays with injury detection & car

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Django](https://img.shields.io/badge/Django-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![REST API](https://img.shields.io/badge/REST%20API-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![React Native](https://img.shields.io/badge/React%20Native-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Stray animals often go unnoticed when injured or in distress. Citizens who spot them usually don’t know the right steps — who to call, how to report, or whether the animal will actually receive help. This leads to suffering, delayed rescues, and poor coordination among volunteers.

Karunanidhan solves this by:

Simplifying reporting: A user just clicks a photo of the animal and uploads it. The app’s ML model analyzes whether the animal is injured and automatically tags the case (e.g., “urgent need of help”).

Creating structured records: Instead of vague messages, each report becomes a card with details like animal type, condition, location, and urgency.

Connecting helpers: Volunteers, NGOs, and shelters can quickly scan reports and prioritize cases that need immediate attention.

Building awareness: Citizens feel empowered because reporting becomes simple, transparent, and impactful — no more confusion about what to do.

In short, Karunanidhan bridges the gap between people who care and animals who need care, creating a faster, tech-enabled rescue ecosystem.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges I Ran Into

While developing Karunanidhan, we faced several challenges, both technical and practical:

Data availability & model training: Getting a reliable dataset of injured vs. healthy stray animals was extremely tough. We had to clean, label, and sometimes manually classify images to train the model effectively.

Accuracy vs. efficiency: Ensuring the model predicts correctly in real-time without requiring heavy hardware was challenging. We needed it to run smoothly on mobile devices, not just high-end servers.

Integration with backend: Building a seamless pipeline where an uploaded photo goes through the model, generates a prediction, and updates the database with appropriate tags/cards required careful optimization.

User experience: Many users of this app may not be highly tech-savvy. Designing an intuitive interface where anyone can click a photo and instantly get results was a design challenge.

Scalability: The platform had to handle different types of reports (injured, missing, adoption, etc.) and still maintain clarity, without overwhelming the users or rescuers.

Real-world reliability: Unlike a controlled dataset, real-world images vary in lighting, angle, and quality. Handling these edge cases was one of the hardest parts of development.

**$300(Open): Cash Prize**

Karunanidhan aligns perfectly with hackathon tracks focused on social good, environment, and AI for impact because:

It uses AI/ML for a compassionate purpose — helping injured and stray animals get timely care.

The project is scalable for NGOs, shelters, and citizens who want to participate in animal welfare but don’t know where to start.

It blends technology + empathy — showing how computer vision, backend systems, and real-time reporting can create meaningful change.

Unlike many prototypes, Karunanidhan has direct on-ground application — from reporting injured animals to connecting with rescue networks.

It contributes to sustainable cities and communities (SDG-11) by promoting coexistence and welfare of stray animals.

This makes it not just a tech project, but a societal solution that’s deeply aligned with the hackathon’s spirit.

* **Counseling Order Guidance** → Get optimized recommendations for filling out your counseling choices.

---

## How It Makes Life Easier

* Saves students from manually searching multiple websites.
* Reduces **stress and uncertainty** in the admission process.
* Provides **clarity and confidence** with transparent, data-driven guidance.
* Turns a **stressful journey into a strategic and simple one**.

---

**Challenges we ran into**

## Challenges I Ran Into

* **Data Accuracy:** Reliable cut-off and placement data was scattered across multiple sources.
  → Solved by using **multi-source collection** and cleaning data before feeding it to the model.

* **Model Inconsistency:** Early AI predictions were giving **unstable results** for certain categories.
  → Fixed by tuning with **historical trends** and applying **normalization**.

* **Integration Bugs:** Frontend–backend communication caused **data mismatches**.
  → Resolved by building **REST APIs with validation** and optimizing queries.

### vartalapAI
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/vartalapai-f968) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://www.canva.com/design/DAGzPHbd5SI/2WgA1ubiO1OONjWpJ9tuVg/edit?utm_content=DAGzPHbd5SI&utm_campaign=designshare&utm_medium=link2&utm_source=sharebutton) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/SLeS7TmzQF8) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-NexHack-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://nexhack.devfolio.co)

> Architect Your Influence.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

VartalapAI is an AI-powered communication coach that analyzes your speech to provide objective feedback on your communication style. It helps you understand not just what you say, but how you say it.

People can use it to make these tasks easier and more effective:

Job Interview Preparation: Record practice answers to get data on your speaking pace, confidence, and use of filler words, helping you sound more professional and prepared.

Sales & Public Speaking: Analyze recordings of pitches or presentations to identify moments of low vocal energy or monotonous delivery, allowing you to refine your speech to be more engaging and persuasive.

Personal Development: Use it as an honest, impartial listener to understand your conversational habits (like interrupting or tone of voice) to improve your daily interactions and relationships.

**Challenges we ran into**

The "Speaker Identity" Hurdle
A major hurdle was accurately distinguishing between different speakers in the audio, a process called speaker diarization. My initial approach of just transcribing the audio resulted in a single block of text, making it impossible to analyze talk-time or attribute feedback correctly. When I tried a basic diarization model, it frequently confused speakers with similar vocal pitches or misattributed lines when they interrupted each other.

This was a critical flaw, as the entire value of the AI coach depends on knowing who said what.

To overcome this, I re-architected the analysis pipeline. Instead of a single step, I created a two-stage process:

Voice Fingerprinting: First, I used a specialized library to process the entire audio file without transcribing it. Its only job was to identify unique "voice fingerprints" and generate a precise timeline mapping out when Speaker A, Speaker B, etc., were talking.

Segmented Transcription: With this timeline, I then programmatically sliced the original audio into small chunks belonging to each identified speaker. I fed these individual segments to the transcription model one by one.

This ensured that every word was correctly attributed to the right person before any analysis took place, resulting in a highly accurate, speaker-labeled transcript that formed a reliable foundation for the entire application.

> Smart Crop Advisory System

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

This project creates a Smart Crop Advisory System to help small farmers. It's
an AI-powered platform that gives personalized, real-time advice to improve
crop yield and income.
• A Multilingual AI Engine will understand and respond to farmers in their
native languages using specialized NLP models, breaking down language
barriers.
• We will integrate diverse data sources like weather APIs and user input
to provide predictive analytics. This helps farmers with crucial decisions
like when to plant or irrigate.
• The system will use Image Recognition to identify pests and diseases
from a photo. It provides instant, actionable solutions for quick crop
protection.
• For users with low digital literacy, we'll offer Voice Support. They can
simply speak their questions to get a response, making the system easy
for everyone to use.
• We'll include a feature for Market and Financial Guidance. Farmers can
track real-time market prices, helping them decide when and where to
sell their crops for the best profit.

**Challenges we ran into**

The Problem: Data Fragmentation and Inconsistency
The core of a smart advisory system is its ability to provide tailored, accurate advice. This requires a variety of data sources, often from different systems and with different formats. I ran into a major bug/hurdle in a previous project where the data from two crucial sources—a weather API and a soil sensor API—didn't play well together.

Weather Data: The weather API provided real-time and forecast data, but it was at a regional or district level. It gave general information about temperature, rainfall, and humidity.

Soil Data: The soil sensors, on the other hand, provided highly localized, real-time data about soil moisture, pH, and nutrient levels for a specific plot of land.

The bug was that the app was sometimes giving contradictory advice. For example, it might recommend less irrigation based on the regional weather forecast predicting rain, even though the soil sensors were reporting critically low moisture levels on the ground. This was happening because there was no robust way to correlate the broad, regional weather data with the hyper-local soil data. The system wasn't "thinking" in an integrated way; it was simply taking inputs from two different streams and applying two different sets of rules, leading to flawed recommendations.


How I Overcame It
I addressed this by implementing a data fusion and prioritization engine. This involved several steps:

Standardization and Cleansing: I first built a data processing pipeline that standardized all incoming data. This meant converting all temperature readings to a single unit (e.g., Celsius), harmonizing time stamps, and creating a unique identifier for each field so that all data could be linked to a specific location.

Creating a "Confidence Score" for Data: I developed a model to assign a "confidence score" to each data source for a specific type of recommendation. For irrigation advice, the soil sensor data was given a much higher confidence score than the regional weather forecast. For pest control advice, a combination of weather and historical pest data was given a high score. This allowed the system to prioritize and weigh different data points based on the specific advice being generated.

Implementing a Decision-Making Hierarchy: I designed a logic layer that created a hierarchy for decision-making. Instead of a simple "if/then" model, it became a more sophisticated system that worked like this:

Level 1 (Direct Sensor Data): Always prioritize real-time, on-site sensor data. If a soil sensor reports low moisture, the app should immediately recommend irrigation, regardless of the weather forecast.

Level 2 (Predictive Models): Combine the sensor data with localized predictive models (e.g., a short-term weather forecast for that specific micro-region) to provide more nuanced advice. So, the app would still recommend irrigation, but it might add a note like, "A small amount of rain is expected in 3 hours, but the soil is currently very dry. Proceed with light irrigation."

Level 3 (General Advisories): Use broader data sources (regional weather, market prices, general crop knowledge) for long-term planning and general advisories.

**$300(Open): Cash Prize**

Direct Financial Impact: The app’s recommendations on optimal irrigation, fertilization, and pest control can help a farmer save a substantial amount of money on resources. The direct financial benefit to the end-user—a farmer—can easily exceed the value of the prize money, demonstrating a powerful and immediate return on investment for the project's development.

Scalability and Market Potential: The problem of inefficient farming practices is global. This app is not a niche solution; it's a scalable platform with a large potential user base. A project that shows this level of market viability and solves a widespread problem is highly valued in a competition.

Technical Sophistication: The project integrates multiple technologies (mobile and AI), showcasing a well-rounded and sophisticated approach. This demonstrates a high level of skill and effort, which is a key criterion for winning a prize.

Social Good: Beyond the financial aspect, the app promotes sustainable farming by reducing water usage and the need for chemical inputs. A project that has a positive social and environmental impact often scores highly in hackathons.

**Ethereum Track**

High-Impact Solution: The project tackles a significant challenge in the agricultural sector, which is a key part of the economy. The app's ability to optimize farming practices, reduce waste, and increase crop yields provides a clear, measurable, and highly valuable benefit to its users. ### QScope
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/qscope-4fcc) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Saketh59/questionanalyzer) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1NImbzH691nbOo_j7RWe2KSVZ7PRDFrJZ/view?usp=sharing) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-UDAYA%201.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://udaya-1-0.devfolio.co)

> bridging doubts with clarity

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![NLP](https://img.shields.io/badge/NLP-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Educators and students often struggle with analyzing question papers effectively. Teachers spend hours manually checking if a paper is balanced in terms of difficulty, topic coverage, and cognitive depth. Students, on the other hand, find it hard to understand the focus of a subject or prepare strategically when they don’t know what type of questions are emphasized.

Our Q-Scope automates this entire process:

1)Difficulty Analysis: Instantly classifies questions as Easy, Medium, or Hard, saving time for educators.
2)Bloom’s Taxonomy Mapping: Identifies whether questions test memory, understanding, application, or higher-order skills, ensuring a balanced cognitive evaluation.
3)Topic Coverage: Breaks down the weightage of topics so teachers can avoid over- or under-representing certain concepts.
Comparison of Papers: Highlights overlaps, difficulty differences, and coverage gaps between two papers, helping in exam design and preparation.
4)Suggestions for Improvement: Gives feedback to refine vague questions and make them more analytical.

By turning raw question papers into visual insights and actionable feedback our project makes exam design easier for teachers, safer against bias or repetition, and more transparent for students preparing strategically.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

For farmers in remote villages, each day brings formidable obstacles. Crippling crop illnesses, a shortage of accessible expertise, and a fundamental lack of timely knowledge frequently lead to devastated harvests and severe financial hardship. This relentless pressure contributes profoundly to farmer distress. Compounding these issues, many farmers find modern technology intimidating; complex websites requiring registrations are unusable for those with limited reading or digital skills. Unreliable internet connections in these areas further block access to vital support, deepening their isolation.

Our response is a single, thoughtfully designed website built specifically for these realities. It functions seamlessly in areas with poor signals by storing essential data directly on the device. It is multilingual and intuitive, deliberately removing barriers like logins to welcome every farmer, regardless of their technical experience.

Its core features are practical. A conversational assistant understands local languages, allowing farmers to speak their questions and hear answers aloud. A disease identification tool analyzes photos of affected plants, offering clear explanations and remedies, with all information saved for offline reference. A smart advisor suggests suitable fertilizer types and quantities to promote healthy crops and efficient spending. It also details relevant government loan programs, displays current crop market values, and provides a direct channel to connect with agricultural specialists for personalized guidance.

This integrated approach delivers crucial agricultural support in the most accessible way possible. By placing actionable knowledge directly into farmers' hands, the platform strives to boost harvest success, strengthen economic security, and foster greater well-being within these essential communities.

**Challenges we ran into**

Making the AI Assistant Reliable:
Our initial integration with the language model was fragile, often leaving users with silence instead of answers. The errors were inconsistent, making it difficult to pinpoint the root cause. To solve this, we built a more resilient system with intelligent fallback procedures. This ensures the assistant remains helpful and stable, providing a consistent and reliable experience for farmers who depend on it.

Streamlining the Disease Detection Tool:
The initial interface for identifying crop diseases was confusing and prone to malfunctions, which undermined its core purpose. Debugging was a challenge due to the interconnected nature of the errors. Our solution involved a two-part approach: first, we redesigned the screen for simplicity and clarity, and then we methodically traced through the code to systematically identify and resolve each underlying issue. The result is a smooth, dependable tool that farmers can trust.

**AI in Agriculture**

Our project leverages artificial intelligence to directly address critical challenges faced by farmers, making agriculture smarter, more efficient, and accessible:

AI-Powered Disease Detection: Using a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), our system can accurately identify crop diseases from images, enabling early diagnosis and treatment. This reduces crop loss and increases yield, showcasing AI’s capability in precision agriculture.

Machine Learning for Fertilizer Recommendations: By analyzing crop conditions and soil data, our ML model provides personalized fertilizer advice, optimizing input use and improving sustainability.

Intelligent Chatbot with Natural Language Processing: The multilingual voice-enabled chatbot harnesses AI-driven speech recognition and generation to provide farmers with real-time guidance in their native languages, overcoming literacy and connectivity barriers.

Data-Driven Financial & Market Insights: AI assists in recommending government loan schemes and providing real-time market prices, empowering farmers to make informed financial and selling decisions.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/042b756dc1da42b382f30e5aca28c141/19b4709e-b5b1-4f9e-897d-8d20dd5ebf37.jpeg)

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/042b756dc1da42b382f30e5aca28c141/a7241222-186c-4e10-9ffa-5905077b9022.jpeg)

AgroAI tackles critical agricultural challenges through AI-powered solutions:

• Water Waste Crisis: Traditional irrigation wastes 30-50% of water. Our AI advisor analyzes soil, weather, and crop data to optimize watering schedules, reducing waste by 40%.

• Crop Disease Losses: Undetected diseases destroy entire harvests. Our computer vision model identifies plant diseases from photos with 90%+ accuracy for immediate treatment.

• Market Information Gap: Farmers lack real-time pricing data, leading to poor selling decisions. We provide live MSP tracking and market intelligence for profit optimization.

• Inaccurate Cost Planning: Poor budgeting reduces farm profitability. Our intelligent calculator factors seeds, fertilizers, labor, and equipment for precise cost estimation.

• Soil Degradation: 33% of global farmland suffers from soil health issues. We deliver personalized soil analysis and fertilizer recommendations based on composition and crop needs.

• Generic Farming Advice: One-size-fits-all solutions ignore local conditions. Our AI provides location-specific, weather-aware recommendations tailored to individual farm requirements.

• Technology Accessibility: Complex agricultural tools exclude small-scale farmers. Our user-friendly, mobile-responsive platform makes advanced farming technology accessible to all.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenge 1: Large Model File Storage
Problem: Our trained plant disease detection model (104MB) exceeded GitHub's 100MB file size limit, causing push failures and deployment issues. Solution: Implemented Git LFS (Large File Storage) for model versioning and created a separate cloud storage solution for model deployment, along with proper documentation for developers to download and place the model file locally.

Challenge 2: Cross-Origin Authentication Issues
Problem: JWT token authentication was failing between our React frontend and Node.js backend due to CORS configuration and cookie handling issues across different ports (frontend: 5173, backend: 3000). Solution: Configured proper CORS settings with credentials support, implemented secure cookie-based authentication, and ensured consistent token handling across all API endpoints.

**AI in Agriculture**

AgroAI is an AI-powered agricultural platform that revolutionizes farming through intelligent crop disease detection, personalized irrigation advisory, and smart crop management solutions. Our system uses deep learning models for instant plant disease diagnosis, machine learning algorithms combined with real-time weather data for optimized irrigation scheduling, and AI-driven insights for fertilization and pest control recommendations. Built with TensorFlow for disease classification, OpenAI GPT for farming advice, and a user-friendly React interface, Smart Krishi empowers farmers with enterprise-level agricultural intelligence that can increase crop yields by 25-30% while reducing resource waste. By making precision farming accessible and affordable, we're bridging the gap between advanced AI research and practical farming applications to create sustainable, data-driven agricultural practices that benefit both farmers and the environment.

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/pixora-55ac) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/devxhunter/Micro-Doppler-target-classification.git) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/7XsUnHCiOus?si=iY7kPRZwzw4r4sau) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-TIC%20Pinnacle%20Hacks%20--%20Edition%201-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://tic-pinnacle-hacks-2025.devfolio.co)

> Enhancing safety and security by radar analysis.

![Django](https://img.shields.io/badge/Django-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![TensorFlow](https://img.shields.io/badge/TensorFlow-333333?style=flat-square) ![PyTorch](https://img.shields.io/badge/PyTorch-333333?style=flat-square) ![MATLAB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MATLAB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flutter](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flutter-333333?style=flat-square) ![Embedded C](https://img.shields.io/badge/Embedded%20C-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The Problem It Solves:
The Micro-Doppler Based Target Classification system addresses the challenge of distinguishing between drones and birds in radar surveillance.
Why it matters:
Conventional radars often confuse drones with birds because both share similar size, flight speeds, and altitudes.
Drones pose serious threats to security, privacy, and safety, while birds are a natural presence in the environment.
How it helps:
Enables accurate drone detection, reducing false alarms caused by birds.
Makes surveillance and monitoring safer and more efficient, especially around:
Airports (preventing accidents with drones in restricted airspace)
Critical infrastructure (power plants, government buildings, military bases)
Public events (crowd safety and anti-drone protection)
Supports search and rescue operations by differentiating real drones (helping teams) from wildlife interference.

**Challenges we ran into**

⚡ Challenges I Ran Into
Building this project came with its own set of hurdles:
Noise in Radar Data
Radar signals often contain environmental noise, reflections, or clutter.
Solution: Applied signal preprocessing (e.g., filtering, windowing) to clean the data before analysis.
Similarity Between Bird and Drone Signatures
Both can generate periodic micro-Doppler features that look somewhat alike.
Solution: Focused on unique patterns—rotating blade harmonics in drones vs. wing-beat modulation in birds—using time-frequency analysis (STFT, spectrograms).
Limited Training Data
Collecting large sets of radar signatures for multiple drone types and bird species is challenging.
Solution: Used data augmentation and simulation of radar signals to improve classifier robustness.
Real-Time Processing Requirement
Classification needs to be fast for real-world use (e.g., airport security).
Solution: Implemented lightweight machine learning models optimized for speed while maintaining accuracy.
💡 Each challenge pushed me to refine the signal processing pipeline and the classification algorithm, ultimately leading to a more reliable system.
Do you want me to also add a “Future Scope” section (e.g., extending to classify different types of drones beyond just bird vs. drone)? That would make it more complete for a project submission.

### PieceOfMind
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/pieceofmind-6a0e) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Nithishreddyyyy/PieceOfMind-DSU-Hack-2.0) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1m55ldQw1J6HMURc12ifTw2bMKRReXous111bqb1hLyQ/edit?usp=sharing) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/SdieydpuA6k) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-DSU%20DevHack%202.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://dsudevhack2.devfolio.co)

> Calm. Clarity. Control.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![PyTorch](https://img.shields.io/badge/PyTorch-333333?style=flat-square) ![scikit-learn](https://img.shields.io/badge/scikit--learn-333333?style=flat-square) ![MySQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/MySQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Anxiety and stress kill people affected by it by an average of 7.9 years earlier
People notice stress late. Physiology (HRV, eye blinks, typing cadence) drifts minutes or hours before we feel “I’m stressed.” That lag quietly erodes deep-work time, decision quality, and mood. Existing apps are reactive (you open them after you feel bad) and single-signal wearables often confuse stress with excitement or exertion.

What our product does:

-Sees early stress signatures from three low-friction channels:HRV, webcam eye metrics (blink/PERCLOS + optional rPPG), and optional EEG.

-Builds a personal baseline in week 1; when your risk rises, we trigger just-in-time micro-interventions (45–120s resonant breathing, a focus mini-game, calming audio).

-Detetcs physological changes as time progresses

->Why it matters

Converts vague “I should relax” into a measurable 60–120-sec recovery (HRV up, blinks normalize), protecting focus without long breaks.

Gives individuals fewer bad afternoons; gives teams a clean ROI story via more deep-work minutes and better micro-break adherence.

We sense early stress signals (watch HRV + webcam eye/typing + optional EEG), then deliver just-in-time 60–120s actions (breathing, mini-games, micro-breaks) that restore calm and focus—privately and on-device.

-->Everyday use cases

Deep-work sprints: Catch rising strain before you feel it; get a 60-second breathing card, then resume in flow.

Meetings & deadlines: Auto-nudges during long calls or last-mile crunch to prevent spirals and preserve decision quality.

Study/exam prep: Pomodoro + recovery cues; reduce mind-wandering with quick focus games between blocks.

Screen-time hygiene: Sit-too-long alerts, posture prompts, and short movement breaks that don’t derail the day.

Sleep-adjacent evenings: Calming audio and low-arousal routines when late-night stress spikes.

->Why it’s easier

No willpower tax: You don’t have to remember to open an app—nudges arrive exactly when physiology drifts.

Personalized: Learns your baseline in week one; thresholds adapt so it’s helpful, not noisy.

Actionable, not just scores: Every alert is paired with a micro-intervention and a visible recovery delta (e.g., HRV up).

->Why it’s safer

Pre-emptive fatigue detection: Eye-blink/PERCLOS and typing-cadence changes flag overload early, reducing error-prone minutes.

Nudge throttle: Max 2 nudges/hour, snoozeable—prevents alert fatigue.

Privacy-by-design: Webcam/keystrokes processed on-device; no raw video stored; only derived metrics with consent.

->Extended applications
1) In cars (Driver State & Wellbeing)

Detect: In-cabin camera (blink/PERCLOS, gaze) + wearable HR/HRV trends to spot drowsiness, distraction, or stress.

Act: Escalating alerts (tone → haptics), route suggestions for safe rest stops, “attentional reset” prompts at red lights, adaptive music that reduces stress without sedation.

Benefit: Fewer microsleeps and lane deviations; calmer, more attentive driving on long commutes and fleet routes.

Privacy: On-car processing by default; only event summaries saved with consent.

2) Post-surgery recovery / rehab support (wellness adjunct; not a medical device)

Track gently: HRV trend, breathing rate, and simple movement goals to encourage gradual autonomic recovery and calm.

Guide: Short, clinician-approved breathing sessions and micro-movement prompts to manage stress and improve adherence.

Inform: Daily “recovery glance” with simple flags (doing fine / take it easier today) and journaling for pain & sleep—shareable with caregivers if the user opts in.

Boundaries: No diagnoses or treatment decisions—wellbeing support only, designed to complement clinical care.

->Who benefits

Individuals: Fewer “bad afternoons,” smoother focus, clearer head before important actions.

Teams/Orgs: More deep-work minutes, healthier break habits, lower error risk—cleaner ROI for wellness budgets.

Fleets/Drivers: Reduced drowsiness events, better attention on monotonous stretches.

Patients/Caregivers: Gentle, objective cues to support calmer recovery days.

->What it’s not

Not a clinical diagnostic tool. We provide wellness & performance support and clear pathways to integrate clinician guidance where appropriate.

**Challenges we ran into**

1) Multi-GPU training vs. our infra reality

What happened: Our EEG model experiments needed CUDA GPUs; Vultr offered single GPU/CPU instances—not a managed multi-GPU cluster like GCP/Azure/AWS.

Impact: Couldn’t scale distributed training or orchestration easily.

What we did: Moved training locally on a CUDA box; used ngrok as a secure tunnel for live demos; applied gradient accumulation + mixed precision to simulate larger batch sizes; scheduled runs to keep thermals stable.

Result: Reliable training/eval loop without cloud cluster complexity.

2) Auth0 session churn

What happened: While inside Auth0, we were being signed out every ~5 seconds.

Root cause (likely): Misaligned callback/allowed origins + an over-eager silent-auth refresh.

Fix: Reset application settings, pruned dev tenants, fixed callback URLs, disabled aggressive refresh in dev, and added a fallback to passwordless email during the demo.

Result: Stable sign-in for judges; we can swap to Clerk later if needed.

3) Early EEG model accuracy (65% at checkpoint-1)

What happened: First pass EEG stress-state classifier plateaued at ~65% on our validation set.

Improvements: Collected and incorporated India-specific samples, added session-wise stratified splits, expanded features (bandpower ratios + entropy), and used per-user calibration at inference.

Result: Accuracy and F1 improved steadily (and, importantly, false-alert rate dropped in live tests).

(Bonus mini-challenges we de-risked:)

Alert fatigue → hard throttle ≤2 nudges/hour + user snooze.

Privacy → all webcam/keystrokes processed on-device; only opt-in derived metrics stored.

**Best Use of Gemini API**

We use Gemini as the real-time wellbeing copilot that turns biosignals into actionable, personalized micro-interventions and explanations—not just a chat bubble.

Why this is compelling

Tone + safety: Style-guardrails keep guidance supportive (no diagnosis, no medical claims).

Personalization:Gemini adapts timing and content.

Explainability: On request, Gemini can summarize why a nudge fired (“HRV down 12%, blinks longer; likely cognitive load”), building user trust.

### NoScroll
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/noscroll-790d) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/5jKBMItPpDI?si=gcHyOIAe23xbpcNR) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/5jKBMItPpDI?si=gcHyOIAe23xbpcNR) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-DSU%20DevHack%202.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://dsudevhack2.devfolio.co)

> Stop the Scroll! Start the Goal.

![Firebase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase-333333?style=flat-square) ![Kotlin](https://img.shields.io/badge/Kotlin-333333?style=flat-square) ![Material Design](https://img.shields.io/badge/Material%20Design-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

We live in a world where endless scrolling on social media, reels, and short-form content eats away our focus, productivity, and study/work time. 

Students plan to study but get lost in Instagram or YouTube for "just 5 minutes" which becomes hours.

Professionals open their phone for one task but get hijacked by notifications and feeds.

Current app blockers only react by blocking apps entirely, which often feels restrictive and annoying  so users uninstall them.

This creates a cycle of distraction -> guilt -> stress -> loss of productivity.

**Challenges we ran into**

1. Automatic Lock System
   Implementing a phone/app lock after detecting blind scrolling was tough because Android requires special permissions (Device Admin, Accessibility Service). Getting this to work seamlessly without frustrating the user was a big challenge.

2. Battery Optimization
   Since the app needs to monitor background activity, We had to design it carefully so that it doesn’t drain the battery. Balancing real-time monitoring with efficiency was tricky.

3. Permission Handling & User Experience
   The app depends on sensitive permissions like Usage Access and Accessibility Services, which can confuse users. Making the onboarding smooth while keeping the functionality intact was a challenge.

4. UI/UX Design for Interventions
   We wanted the reminders and motivational nudges to be engaging, not irritating. Finding the right timing (like every few seconds vs. 3 minutes) required experimentation.

5. Time Constraints
   Building multiple advanced features (real-time detection, motivational nudges, locking, gamification, progress tracking) in a short period was challenging to prioritize and implement.
