### SMART 24/7 RATION DISPENSER SYSTEM
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/smart-ration-dispenser-system-b2a0) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Sandhe3sh/InnnovateX_DevHack2.0.git) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/l7fHa4Qa3zo) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-DSU%20DevHack%202.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://dsudevhack2.devfolio.co)

> Smart Solutions for a Hunger-Free Nation.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-333333?style=flat-square) ![MySQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/MySQL-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**Problem It Solves**

**The Smart 24/7 Ration Dispenser System** addresses several critical issues in the current **Public Distribution System (PDS)**:

**Ration Leakage & Corruption**
     Traditional ration shops often face malpractice such as diversion of supplies, *false entries*, and *manual manipulation*. This system ensures fair and **tamper-proof** distribution by linking with **user authentication** and **digital logs.**

**Limited Access & Queues**
Beneficiaries usually have to wait in long queues during fixed ration shop hours. ***The smart dispenser is available 24/7,*** reducing waiting time and making access convenient.

**Errors in Quantity Distribution**
Manual weighing can lead to incorrect or unfair distribution. With digital load cells and automatic dispensing, users always get the exact entitled quantity.

**Transparency & Accountability**
Every transaction is logged, stored, and synced to the government backend, making the system auditable and transparent.

**Connectivity & Power Issues**
Supports ***dual-SIM 4G/LTE and UPS backup,*** so it works even in rural areas with ***unstable network/power.***

**Inclusivity**
Provides **multi-language voice guidance**, QR/OTP support, and **biometric access** so that even non-tech-savvy or elderly users can easily operate the system.

✅ **How People Can Use It**

- Beneficiaries (citizens)

- Collect ration anytime (24/7) without depending on shop timings.

- Faster service with no long queues.

- Fair distribution — guaranteed entitlement, no human bias.

- Administrators (shopkeepers/government staff)

- Monitor stock levels and device health remotely through a live dashboard.

- Get alerts for low stock or tampering, improving control.

- Save manpower as the kiosk works unmanned.

- Government

- Reduce ration leakage and corruption significantly.

- Increase efficiency in PDS operations.

- Build citizen trust through transparency and reliability.

 **How It Makes Tasks Easier/Safer**

***Eliminates manual handling ***→ ***safer and more hygienic ration distribution.***

Prevents fraud by using Aadhaar/QR/biometric verification.

Reduces food wastage by dispensing accurate quantities.

**Challenges we ran into**

While building the Smart 24/7 Ration Dispenser, I faced several hurdles:

**1. Hardware Integration Issues**

**Problem:** Initially, the load cell readings were unstable due to noise and poor wiring. This caused incorrect dispensing measurements.

**Solution:** I added proper shielded wires, calibration code, and averaging filter in the program to stabilize the sensor readings.

2. **Connectivity Problems**

**Problem:** The device had trouble maintaining a stable internet connection in simulations for rural use-cases.

**Solution:** Implemented an offline store-and-forward mechanism where transactions are cached locally and synced when the network reconnects.

3. **Authentication Simulation**

**Problem:** Aadhaar/fingerprint modules are hard to simulate in Proteus.

**Solution:** Used push buttons and QR mock inputs in the simulation to mimic RFID/fingerprint verification, so the user flow could still be demonstrated.

**4. Learning Curve with Proteus**

**Problem:**Being new to Proteus, connecting components like LCD, servo, and buttons correctly was confusing.

**Solution:**Broke it down step-by-step, tested each part (LCD → Servo → Buttons) individually, then integrated into the full circuit.

5**. Power & Reset Handling**

**Problem:** The system reset unexpectedly when servo motors drew extra current.

**Solution:** Used a separate power line for servo and simulated UPS backup in the design to keep the controller stable.

### JoyScroller
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/savemyprompt-chrome-extension-77c4) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://www.akshayrana.site/joyscroller/index.html) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-mosAIc:%20AI%20in%20action%20with%20The%20Product%20Folks-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://mosaicbytpf.devfolio.co)

> Rediscover your bookmarks, and leave doomscrolling

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![JSON](https://img.shields.io/badge/JSON-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

I noticed I was wasting a lot of time doomscrolling through feeds, content I didn’t even care about. At the same time, I had built up this massive graveyard of bookmarks: articles, blogs, tools, and resources I genuinely wanted to read, but they just sat buried in Chrome’s bookmarks bar, out of sight and out of mind.

The friction was simple: when I opened a new tab, I’d fall straight into distraction instead of discovery. That’s where the idea for JoyScroller came in. Inspired by a subreddit conversation about replacing doomscrolling with “joyscrolling,” I decided to rewire my own browsing habit.

Now every new tab becomes a calm, scrollable feed of my own saved bookmarks. I can filter by folder, see a “Today’s Pick” for a daily dose of serendipity, mark things as read for closure, and even add new links with a quick right-click. Instead of endless junk feeds, I get intentional, self-curated content, exactly what I once saved for “someday.”

**Challenges we ran into**

I’m not a full-time developer, so my approach to this project was 'vibe coding'. I built almost 99% of JoyScroller using Lovable, which gave me great starting points for code. But turning that into a working Chrome extension came with its share of hurdles.

One big challenge was deployment: Lovable’s output ran fine as a web app, but Chrome extensions require a very specific setup. I had to configure a GitHub repo, add a proper manifest.json, and wire things like the background script for right-click actions. At one point, fetching website favicons caused console errors, which blocked me from shipping. My workaround? I swapped them out for simple generated icons to keep things clean.

For debugging and brainstorming, I leaned on ChatGPT Codex alongside Lovable.

In the end, the entire extension is a testament to vibe coding: solving problems on the fly, iterating quickly, and keeping the energy focused on making something useful instead of getting stuck on perfection.

**Top 100 Participants**

The entire Chrome extension was built using Lovable. The experience is 99% vibe-coded on the platform, from idea to execution. By leveraging Lovable, I was able to turn a personal pain point into a working product without traditional coding, staying true to the spirit of building fast, creatively, and with love for the user experience.

Akshay Rana

> Bring Calm to Your Calendar

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Deno](https://img.shields.io/badge/Deno-333333?style=flat-square) ![Supabase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Supabase-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**The problem it solves**

Modern calendars are good at storing events, but terrible at protecting wellbeing. People often stack meetings back-to-back, forget to block focus time, and only realize they’re overloaded when stress already hits. Managers and HR teams also lack visibility into how dense employees’ schedules really are — making it harder to prevent burnout before it happens. 

The average knowledge worker spends ~18–23 hours per week in meetings (Microsoft & Atlassian research).

70% of employees say their calendars are too packed to allow for deep focus (Asana Work Index, 2023).

Burnout affects nearly 60% of employees globally (Gallup, 2023).

Lack of recovery time between meetings increases stress by up to 40% (Microsoft Human Factors Lab, 2022).

Managers and HR often lack visibility into workload trends, making it harder to spot early signs of burnout.

**ZenSched solves this by:**

Giving individuals a “workload index” view of their day, so they can instantly see how busy (or balanced) it is.

Offering AI-powered wellness recommendations, like when to insert breaks or focus blocks.

Providing HR with a team wellness dashboard, helping spot trends of overload early — safely and respectfully.

Making calendar use not just about productivity, but about sustainable, healthy work patterns.

Pls. note that Loom didn’t record the voice summary properly so you can only hear a bit of it clearly! Try using the app for clarity 😊

View the presentation deck here: 

https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1Xv7HdM4JMxYbrEPgyPFXiDQyeklMalBStG0tjrYmw7E/edit?usp=sharing

**Challenges we ran into**

One challenge definitely was: **managing the calendar synchronization state**. Aggressive polling definitely resulted in unnecessary network requests. I solved it by conditional polling which was running the sync operation only when the tab was visible.

### Real Time seismic Intensity Detector.
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/real-time-seismic-intensity-detector-using-mobile-accelerometer-and-gyroscope-sensors-1e61) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/HemangSharma06/Projects/tree/main/Earthquake_intensity_detector) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-mosAIc:%20AI%20in%20action%20with%20The%20Product%20Folks-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://mosaicbytpf.devfolio.co)

> Turning smartphones into seismic detectors.

![TensorFlow](https://img.shields.io/badge/TensorFlow-333333?style=flat-square) ![scikit-learn](https://img.shields.io/badge/scikit--learn-333333?style=flat-square) ![Machine Learning](https://img.shields.io/badge/Machine%20Learning-333333?style=flat-square) ![Android Studio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Android%20Studio-333333?style=flat-square) ![Deep Learning](https://img.shields.io/badge/Deep%20Learning-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-333333?style=flat-square) ![Kotlin](https://img.shields.io/badge/Kotlin-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

1. Delayed or Inaccessible Earthquake Warnings
- Traditional seismic monitoring stations are expensive and sparsely distributed.
- Many regions (especially developing areas) do not have enough seismographs.
- Using smartphones (which already have accelerometer & gyroscope sensors) creates a low-cost, widely distributed sensing network.

2. Real-time Detection and Early Warning
- Mobile sensors can detect ground vibrations quickly and transmit them to a central server.
- Even a few seconds of early warning helps people take cover, stop elevators, halt trains, or shut down gas lines.

3. Crowdsourced Seismic Monitoring
- Millions of smartphones acting as “mini-seismographs” provide a dense sensor network.
- This helps fill gaps in official seismic monitoring systems.

4. Personal Safety Feedback
- A mobile app can instantly alert users with intensity levels at their location.
- People can know whether the shaking is minor (safe) or strong (dangerous), helping guide immediate decisions.

5. Post-event Data Collection
- The system collects accelerometer/gyroscope data from thousands of phones.
- This helps scientists map shaking intensity in fine detail (similar to a live "ShakeMap").

**Challenges we ran into**

1. Sensor Noise and Accuracy

- Problem: Mobile accelerometer and gyroscope data are often noisy, making it difficult to distinguish between normal user movement (walking, running, shaking phone) and real earthquake vibrations.
- Solution: I applied signal processing techniques (like low-pass and high-pass filters) to smooth the raw data and isolate ground-shaking patterns. Additionally, I compared accelerometer readings across multiple axes to reduce false positives.

2. Less Dataset

- Problem: Very less dataset is available on internet websites.
- Solution: Data is self-created with the help of Phyphox Mobile application using its Accelerometer and Gyroscope sensors.

3. Differentiating Earthquake Vibrations from Daily Activities

- Problem: Simple movements like dropping the phone or sudden hand jerks created false earthquake detections.
- Solution: I introduced thresholding and time-window analysis. Instead of reacting to single spikes, the system checks for consistent vibration patterns over a short duration before classifying it as an earthquake.

4.  Real-time Data Handling

- Problem: Streaming real-time sensor data to the server caused performance lags on some devices.
- Solution: I optimized the data pipeline by compressing sensor data and sending only essential features (RMS acceleration, frequency spectrum) rather than raw values.

**The problem it solves**

# The Problem It Solves

Modern digital interaction still relies heavily on **manual navigation and repetitive actions**.  
Whether it is troubleshooting errors, granting app permissions, or performing everyday communication tasks,  
users must interpret information on the screen and execute multiple steps manually.  

This creates several challenges:  
- **Inefficiency:** Time is lost copying error logs, searching for solutions, and applying fixes.  
- **Accessibility Limitations:** Individuals with disabilities or limited technical expertise struggle with complex digital workflows.  
- **Productivity Loss:** Routine tasks such as granting permissions, switching apps, or sending messages interrupt focus and reduce efficiency.  

---

# How Our Solution Helps

Our system introduces an **AI-powered, screen-aware assistant** that not only responds to voice commands  
but also interprets the real-time context of the device screen.  

## Key Use Cases
- **Automated Debugging:** Reads error logs, installs missing dependencies, and suggests targeted fixes without manual intervention.  
- **Seamless Device Control:** Executes multi-step actions such as opening applications, finding contacts, and sending messages through a single voice command.  
- **Automated Permission Handling:** Directly grants or manages app permissions without requiring manual navigation through settings.  
- **Inclusive Accessibility:** Empowers elderly, differently-abled, or non-technical users to interact with devices naturally, using only voice.  

## Why It Stands Out
- **Hands-free and efficient:** Eliminates redundant manual effort.  
- **Context-aware intelligence:** Goes beyond traditional assistants (e.g., Siri/Alexa) by actively “seeing” and understanding on-screen content.  
- **Task simplification:** Converts multi-step problem-solving into one-step execution.

**Challenges we ran into**

# Challenges I Ran Into

Building an **AI-powered, screen-aware assistant** came with several technical and design hurdles:

1. **Real-Time Screen Context Extraction**  
   - Challenge: Capturing and interpreting live screen data without compromising performance or user privacy.  
   - Solution: We optimized lightweight screen parsing and restricted context extraction to only task-relevant data.

2. **Voice Command Disambiguation**  
   - Challenge: Users often phrase commands differently, leading to misinterpretation.  
   - Solution: We implemented natural language processing with contextual intent recognition to ensure higher accuracy.

3. **Permission & Security Handling**  
   - Challenge: Automating actions such as granting permissions or executing fixes raised potential security risks.  
   - Solution: We enforced a **layered confirmation model** and restricted execution scope to maintain user trust and safety.

4. **Cross-Application Workflow Automation**  
   - Challenge: Different apps and operating system layers handle actions inconsistently.  
   - Solution: We created a unified action-mapping layer that translates AI decisions into device-specific commands.

---

Each of these hurdles taught us to balance **innovation, efficiency, and security**, ensuring the system remains **practical, ethical, and user-friendly**.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges We Ran Into

1. Initially followed a traditional approach by creating a detailed PRD, expecting development tools to build the application directly from it. Underestimated the iterative nature of product development requiring step-by-step prompts for each tool.
2. Explored multiple vibe coding tools, including Windsurf, Vercel by V0, Bolt, and considered Loveable, before deciding on additional support from Rocket.
3. Found Rocket promising but initially struggled to understand its workflow without designs.
4. Interacted with Rahul and industry leaders, we realized that defining Prompt Sets and refining them with time, is becoming the essential new language/flow for product managers to collaborate with engineering. 
5. Experienced long interface loading delays (up to 5-6 hours), especially after consuming half of the available 22 million Rocket.new tokens.
6. Child profile management , auth state management issue- still unresolved 
7. Rapid token consumption due to complexities in building a full stack application in Rocket.new.
8. Debugging was time-consuming and used large amounts of tokens, often hindered by Rocket.new misinterpreting prompts or introducing new bugs after fixes.
9. Difficulty in understanding why screens did not display correctly, requiring significant backend logic rewrites.
10. Used Perplexity.ai as a supplementary tool to assist with debugging issues Rocket.new could not resolve.
11. Learned the importance of having rollback capabilities and specifying best coding practices to minimize errors in AI-generated code.
12. Recognized that despite no-code tools, technical knowledge and prompt engineering remain crucial skills.

**Vibecoding your Idea | Powered by Rocket.new**

For our problem statement , to make a kids activity curation app, we felt a full stack web app was most relevant.We chose vibe coding because we can handle front-end ,back end and integrations within a single platform. Vibe coding drastically reduces go to market time from 6 months to 4-5 days.. It is easy to iterate, prototype faster and refine the product across any part of the stack. Vibe coding lets us focus more on functionality and user experience rather than fussing around coding.

> Smarter way to review contracts

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Supabase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Supabase-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**The Problem It Solves**

Contracts are everywhere: employment agreements, vendor contracts, NDAs, SaaS subscriptions, freelance work, and even rental agreements. But reading and understanding them is often time-consuming. Pages of dense legal jargon slow down decisions.
 
*Confusing:* Hidden clauses, tricky wording, and fine print make it easy to miss risks. 
*Expensive:* Hiring a lawyer for every contract review is not always practical.
*Risky:* Overlooking a single clause can lead to financial or legal trouble later.

**How AccordWorks Helps**

AccordWorks makes contract review simple, fast, and safe by using AI to:

1. Summarize contracts into plain language you actually understand.
2. Highlight key clauses (termination, payment, liability, confidentiality, etc.).
3. Flag potential risks or uncommon terms you should watch out for.
4. Provide insights & suggestions so you can make better, faster decisions.
5. Save hours of manual reading and avoid costly oversights.

**Who Can Use It**

1. Freelancers & Creators—Quickly review client contracts before signing.
2. Startups & Small Businesses – Check vendor and partnership agreements without hiring a lawyer every time.
3. Job Seekers—Understand your offer letter or employment contract.
4. Landlords & Tenants—Simplify rental agreements.

Anyone dealing with confusing legal documents who wants clarity and confidence.

[Check Product Deck Here](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1kRhkjBkZjBER3qKp2O5cpt-k60J0CqHNC4Q6o3pz3vk/edit?usp=sharing)

**Challenges we ran into**

**Unreliable document parsing (PDF/DOCX diversity)**

Some PDFs were image-only or had broken structure; DOCX styles varied wildly.
Fix: Added a parsing pipeline with fallbacks (native text → layout-based → OCR for scans), preflight validation, and normalized outputs to a common schema before downstream AI steps.

**LLM hallucinations in clause extraction**

Early extractions invented clauses or mislabeled fields.
Fix: Switched to schema-constrained generation (tool/function calling + JSON schema), added validators and auto-retry with minimal few-shot exemplars, and flagged low-confidence outputs for re-prompt.

**Long contracts vs context limits**

Full documents blew past model context and degraded accuracy.
Fix: Semantic chunking with overlap, hybrid retrieval (BM25 + embeddings), and map-reduce for summaries. Included per-chunk citations so users can trace outputs.

**Risk scoring calibration**

Scores were inconsistent across contract types due to sparse labels.
Fix: Built weak-supervision rules for bootstrapping, then calibrated with a small vetted set (e.g., Platt scaling). Exposed confidence bands and rationales per risk.

**Latency and rate limits**

Parsing + RAG + multiple model calls caused slow UX and occasional throttling.
Fix: Async background jobs with streaming UI updates, response caching (parses/embeddings), batched calls with exponential backoff, and idempotency keys.

**Privacy and compliance handling**

Logs accidentally captured snippets; storage needed hardening.
Fix: PII scrubbing in logs, encrypted storage, short-lived presigned URLs, least-privilege access, and an optional “local processing” mode for sensitive docs.

![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Streamlit](https://img.shields.io/badge/Streamlit-333333?style=flat-square) ![langchain](https://img.shields.io/badge/langchain-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tavily Search](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tavily%20Search-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

### The Problem It Solves

The job market is tough, and hiring has become more complicated. Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) are used by companies to screen out candidates, resulting in what has been referred to as the "resume black hole" in which even a qualified candidate can be automatically eliminated. Even beyond that, job seekers are left with a series of time-consuming tasks: researching companies, discovering opportunities, and then custom-crafting applications to each and every one of the roles.

The AI Career Assistant is an all-in-one suite built to solve the entire early stage modern job search which traditionally involves a reactive, manual, checklist-based approach to a strategic and AI-powered based process.

The primary challenges this project addresses from a job seeker perspective are:

 - **Dealing with the "Rejection Black Hole" and Finding the Hidden Job Opportunities**: An appropriate job seeker can get an ATS rejection simply because they do not have the exact keywords. At the same time, figuring out where to apply is its own challenge. This tool addresses both of those problems directly. It doesn't analyze keywords on a resume against a job description; it scours the live job market to seek out roles that might be a fit and includes an instant “match score.” This flips an unknown (“Am I a fit? a definitive, data-based answer (“Here are the top 5 jobs you’re a fit for, and here’s why”).

 - **Automating Tiresome Research and Tailoring**: A good resume is not enough for a successful application, context is necessary. It is also time-consuming to manually find the domain, size and recent news of each company, as well as customize a resume for every role. This work aims to automate these tedious methods. Its AI Research Agent generates in-depth company and role specific briefs in seconds and its Resume Tailor applies the power of Generative AI to reframe and rewrite a user’s experience – taking the copy & paste out of a creating a highly targeted document.

 - **Above Keywords**: The Strategic Insight and Actionable Feedback When an application is denied, a candidate receives no feedback. This thing is a multi-level item, it provides intel that can be acted on. It returns an actual match score (%) with real job ads, offers a concrete match improvement from its optimizing, and even throws back key market intel on a role, such as the top skills, usual years of experience, and the estimated salary range for the position and employer. This advice enables users to not only repair their resume but also to remain competitive in the job market.

 - **From Uncertainty to Confidence with AI-Powered Generation**: A lot of applicants don’t exactly know how they should be presenting their skills. This tool eliminates the guesswork. Rather than simply providing a template, it generates a full, complete and customized draft of a resume ready for submission. Using the user's original information, helps people to generate a well-organized and keyword rich CV that can be used to apply for a desired vacancies. This empowers the user with an awesome near-final product that they can use as a foundation to buildupon.

In short, the AI Career Assistant is a trusted sidekick who makes the job search more human. It gives job seekers the knowledge they need, and the job opportunities they want, to make them unstoppable in today’s (and tomorrow’s) job market — and fills their resume with all the right “stuff.”

**Challenges we ran into**

### Challenges I Faced
When I was building my AI career app, I ran into a few big problems. The hardest parts were making clear prompts, stopping fake answers, fixing the research agent, and finding a fair way to score resumes.

- **Avoiding Fake Information**: AI sometimes gave information that sounds real but is not, that is risky for resumes. It could create things like Managed a 50,000 budget, even if the user never wrote that. I made the AI only rephrase what is already there and never add new facts.

- **Fixing the Research Agent**: The research feature looks up company info online, but it made mistakes many times. For example, if I searched United, it didn’t know if that meant United Airlines or Manchester United. Sometimes it got stuck in loop. I added error handling so it should not crash. I gave it a checklist to stay focused. I used debug model to watch its steps 

- **Scoring Resumes**: I needed a system to check how well a resume matched a job description. If I used AI to score, it was slow, costly, and gave different results each time. If I just counted keywords, it was too simple. I used TF-IDF with Cosine Similarity. It’s fast and cheap. It always gives the same score. It knows that rare words like “Python” matter more than common words like “the.”

### Cognio AI
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/cogni-c0da) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://cognio.netlify.app/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-mosAIc:%20AI%20in%20action%20with%20The%20Product%20Folks-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://mosaicbytpf.devfolio.co)

> The productivity app that learns with you.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**Finally, a productivity app that actually knows you.**

Stop managing complex systems. Start having conversations. Cogni AI is the first productivity app powered by an AI that remembers everything, learns with you, and gets smarter over time.

**🗣️ Just Talk, We Handle the Rest**

- Create tasks by simply saying "Call mom tomorrow at 3pm"
- Journal your thoughts and get AI insights automatically
- Share what you've learned and let AI help you apply it
- No forms, no complicated menus - just natural conversation

**🧠 Your AI Learning Partner**

- Share new concepts, books, or insights in conversation
- AI guides you to deeper understanding with thoughtful questions
- Automatically creates smart notes from your learnings
- Suggests how to apply knowledge to your current projects
- Builds your personal knowledge base over time


**⚡ Smart Without the Complexity**

- **Threaded conversations** - Organize topics automatically
- **Calendar integration** - Tasks sync with Google Calendar
- **Location-aware scheduling** - Times adjust to your timezone
- **Smart suggestions** - AI proactively helps based on patterns
- **Voice input** - Capture thoughts on the go

**📝 Everything Connected**

- Tasks with specific dates and times
- Journal entries with AI-extracted insights
- Smart notes from conversations and learnings
- Universal search across all your content
- Pattern recognition - AI learns your preferences

**🔒 Privacy First**

- Your data stays yours - export anytime
- End-to-end encryption for all conversations
- No ads, no data selling



**Perfect For:**

- Knowledge workers overwhelmed by productivity apps
- Students and professionals who learn continuously
- Anyone who thinks better by talking through problems
- People who want to be productive without managing systems

**What Makes Cogni AI Different:**

- **Conversational productivity** - No complex interfaces to learn
- **AI that learns with you** - Gets better at helping over time
- **Knowledge integration** - Connects learning with doing
- **Proactive assistance** - Helps before you ask
- **Pattern recognition** - Understands your working style

**Challenges we ran into**

**1. Scope Creep**

Started with overkill (projects → epics → stories → tasks, quizzes, enterprise features). Cut hard, kept it simple: task lists + chat.
Learning: Better to nail one thing than spread thin.

**2. AI Dumping Code**

AI kept cramming everything into one page. Fixed with super explicit prompts: screen hierarchy, routing, phased builds.
Learning: AI needs guardrails, not freedom.

**3. Build Order**

Tried full stack at once, slowed feedback. Switched to frontend first with mock data, then backend.
Learning: Frontend first = faster UX validation + cleaner API needs.

**4. AI vs Productivity**

Risk of “AI teacher mode” distracting from work. Blended smart notes and learning into chat flow instead of separate mode.
Learning: Advanced AI works when it feels natural, not forced.

**5. Timezones & Location**

Initially ignored global complexity. Built in auto detection, overrides, cultural formats, calendar sync.
Learning: Global first design prevents user confusion.

**6. Smart Notes Survival**

Almost cut smart notes. Reframed as background intelligence surfacing naturally.
Learning: Simplify complexity, don’t kill core value.

**7. Journaling Basics**

First design was write only. Added edit, delete, versioning, bulk ops.
Learning: Even simple features need full CRUD to feel pro.

**8. Threads & Smart Chips**

Needed threads, chips, learning convos without chaos. Solved with progressive disclosure and mobile first design.
Learning: Power features must feel effortless.

**9. Schema Evolution**

Schema ballooned with location, notes, versions. Designed extensible from day one.
Learning: Plan for growth, adding fields is easy, redoing schema isn’t.

**10. Staying Focused**

With so many features, risk was losing the core. Always came back to:
“The productivity app that actually knows you.”

**Key Takeaway**

AI coding tools are great helpers, but they’re not architects. They need tight direction, small steps, and human oversight. The dream of “just describe your app and ship” isn’t real yet, but this project was a masterclass in managing that gap.

**The problem it solves**

🚩 The Problem It Solves

Chronic diseases like diabetes, hypertension, and kidney disorders often remain undiagnosed until late stages.

Existing health apps give generic advice and lack personalization.

Wearable devices generate raw data, but most users don’t know how to interpret it.

Rural and elderly populations face language and literacy barriers, making digital health inaccessible.

Preventive healthcare is reactive, not proactive — leading to avoidable hospital visits and high costs.

💡 How People Can Use It

CareAI empowers individuals to take charge of their health by providing:

Personal Health Risk Prediction → Users can instantly check if they are at risk of diabetes, CKD, or hypertension.

24/7 Health Chatbot (Multilingual) → Users can ask health-related questions in simple voice/text, even in their regional language.

Lifestyle Guidance → Personalized diet, exercise, and sleep suggestions based on user data.

Wearable Data Integration → Connects with Fitbit, Apple Watch, or Mi Band to make sense of real-time vitals.

Alerts & Reminders → Sends notifications when abnormal health readings are detected.

✅ How It Makes Life Easier & Safer

Early Detection → Reduces risk of severe complications by catching problems early.

Accessibility → Voice and regional language support make healthcare guidance inclusive.

Data-Driven Insights → Converts confusing wearable data into easy-to-understand recommendations.

Peace of Mind → Acts like a personal health assistant, available anytime without waiting for appointments.

Cost Savings → Prevents costly medical interventions by encouraging preventive care.

**Challenges we ran into**

🔧 Challenges I Ran Into

Integrating Wearable Data APIs

Challenge: Fitbit/Google Fit APIs required authentication flows that were tricky to set up within limited hackathon time.

Solution: Created a mock data generator to simulate wearable readings (heart rate, BP, sleep) and later mapped them to the dashboard.

Multilingual Voice Support

Challenge: Handling regional language speech-to-text with accurate medical terminology was difficult.

Solution: Used Whisper AI for transcription + a custom medical vocabulary dictionary to improve accuracy.

Model Deployment

Challenge: Deploying ML models on limited cloud resources led to latency issues.

Solution: Optimized models (converted to ONNX format) and deployed on Hugging Face Spaces for a lightweight, hackathon-friendly demo.

Data Privacy Concerns

Challenge: Since this is health-related, user data handling needed to be safe and transparent.

Solution: Ensured demo uses only open datasets + mock data while clearly communicating that no sensitive personal health data is stored.

**Voice AI & Conversational Products | Powered by Elevenlabs**

ElevenLabs is highly relevant since the project involves a voice-enabled AI health assistant. Multilingual speech-to-text and text-to-speech capabilities make healthcare interactions more natural and accessible, especially for populations with limited literacy. Integrating this track emphasizes the role of voice technology in building inclusive AI solutions.

### HomeScout Agent
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/homescout-agent-4610) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://homescout.lovable.app/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-mosAIc:%20AI%20in%20action%20with%20The%20Product%20Folks-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://mosaicbytpf.devfolio.co)

> AI-powered rental search with smart outreach

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

******HouseScout Agent cuts the manual outreach grind international students face when hunting rentals in a new country.******

**Pain today**
- 10–15 tabs, copy/paste emails and texts, poor reply rates
- Hard to tell true fit (budget, commute, laundry, furnished, transit)
- No SSN/thin credit friction, time-zone delays, and zero tracking


**What it does**
- Turns a natural-language query into a ranked shortlist with student signals: budget delta, distance to campus, laundry/pets/furnished, transit, photos + Maps/Street View
- Opens an Outreach Studio with ready-to-send Email/SMS/Voicemail scripts (you edit/approve; sends via mailto/sms links). Optional record-my-voice for voicemail
- History & Saved sidebar + status tracking (emailed/texted/called/tour booked) and CSV export for easy follow-up
- Student Profile (country, campus, move-in, budget) personalizes tone automatically
- Community Hints link to city FB/WhatsApp housing groups (noise → actionable leads)

**Why it’s easier/safer**

- Reduces research + drafting from ~20 min per listing to ~1–2 min
- Clear “Why this ranked” reasoning improves confidence and avoids bad fits
- Approve-before-send guardrail; localStorage only in the prototype (no keys needed)

[**Result:**](https://homescout.lovable.app/) students spend time touring, not typing—faster tours, cleaner follow-ups, and better first replies.

**Challenges we ran into**

**1) Free plan limitations (editor + credits).**
On the free plan parts of the editor were read-only and we had very few prompt runs. We designed one-shot prompts and tiny patch prompts to scaffold the whole app at once, keeping scope tight and mock-data only.

**2) APIs & keys (not the first priority).**
We explored listing/voice/SMS providers (e.g., RentCast, ElevenLabs, Twilio), but free-plan constraints, env vars, and billing risk made live integration tricky. We shipped a no-key prototype instead: mock listings JSON, mailto:/sms: links, and a browser MediaRecorder for voicemail—structured so real APIs can plug in later.

**3) Product over perfect code.**
We’re not full-time coders. Our focus was user value: React + Tailwind, LocalStorage for state, CSV exports—enough to demo a functional agent without a backend.

**4) Draft quality & guardrails.**
Getting outreach to sound helpful (not spammy) took iteration. We added a Student Profile (country, campus, move-in, budget) and an approve-before-send step so messages are personalized but controlled.

**5) Data gaps (photos, maps, distances).**
Some mock listings lacked photos/coords. We used placeholders, Google Maps/Street View links, and a simple distance heuristic for commute time.

**6) State/persistence bugs.**
Early drafts/statuses disappeared on refresh. We fixed this with versioned LocalStorage keys for history, saved items, drafts, statuses, and profile.

**7) Voice quirks.**
Browser recording (MediaRecorder) behaves differently across devices. We documented the edge cases and put ElevenLabs TTS + call drop as opt-in upgrades on the roadmap.

**What changed because of these hurdles**

We delivered a working Search → Shortlist → Outreach Studio flow that cuts outreach from ~20 min/listing to ~1–2 min.

**We kept the prototype safe and testable without secrets/servers**.

We created a clear upgrade path: swap mock data for live APIs, add WhatsApp watcher, ElevenLabs voicemail, and call-drop when credits/budget allow.

**Top 100 Participants**

HouseScout Agent was built end-to-end inside Lovable with a single prompt + one patch, using mock data only (no keys) to keep it demo-safe. It showcases Lovable’s strengths for agentic apps: a Search → Shortlist → Outreach Studio flow, a collapsible History/Saved sidebar, CSV export, and a voicemail recorder—all generated and iterated through prompts. The UI is student-focused (“Spend time touring, not typing.”) and includes quick picks, a natural-language search bar, maps/photos, and ready-to-send email/SMS/voicemail drafts. State persists via localStorage (profile, history, saved, statuses, drafts), proving you can ship a useful, real prototype in Lovable without a backend. The design emphasizes clarity and low friction—exactly what Lovable enables for rapid, production-feeling AI experiences.

**The problem it solves**

Breast Cancer Detection AI Model

This project is an AI-powered breast cancer detection system designed to assist in the early diagnosis of breast cancer. Early detection is critical for improving treatment outcomes, and this model helps achieve that with high accuracy.

Objective: Provide a fast and reliable tool to predict whether a tumor is benign or malignant based on medical data.

Accuracy: The trained model achieves 97% accuracy, ensuring trustworthy predictions.

Benefits:

Enables early detection of breast cancer.

Supports doctors in making more informed decisions.

Helps in reducing delays in diagnosis, potentially saving lives.

How it Works:

The user inputs medical parameters into the web interface.

The trained AI model analyzes the data.

The model predicts the tumor type and displays the result: Benign or Malignant.

Technologies Used:

Python & Flask for the web application

Machine Learning (Scikit-learn) for the model

HTML/CSS for frontend interface

Pickle for model serialization

**Challenges we ran into**

While building this AI breast cancer detection project, I faced a few technical challenges:

Git & Repository Management

Problem: I had difficulty pushing my local project to GitHub because the remote repository already had files (like README.md), which caused src refspec main does not match any and merge conflicts.

Solution: I resolved this by pulling the remote changes with --allow-unrelated-histories, merging them locally, and then pushing my branch successfully.

Author Identity in Git

Problem: Git initially blocked commits because my author identity was not set.

Solution: I configured my Git username and email globally using:

git config --global user.name "Arghyadutta253"
git config --global user.email "duttarghya203@gmail.com"


Connectivity & Deployment Challenges

Problem: Deploying the Flask app to a permanent URL was tricky due to server requirements and connectivity limitations in free hosting platforms.

Solution: I explored multiple hosting options like PythonAnywhere, Render, and Railway and structured my app to work with low bandwidth and local deployment if needed.

Flask Template Rendering

### OpsBuddy
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/opsbuddy-a796) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://opsbuddy-domain-wizard.lovable.app) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-mosAIc:%20AI%20in%20action%20with%20The%20Product%20Folks-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://mosaicbytpf.devfolio.co)

> Smart Operations Assistant

![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Delays happen everywhere, from late deliveries to stuck IT tickets or even appointments running behind. Today, these delays are usually handled in a very manual way: customers are left waiting, operations teams spend hours chasing updates, and managers rarely get clear data on why issues keep happening.

This project makes that process easier and safer by introducing an AI agent that steps in automatically. It detects when something is late, pings the responsible person for the reason, decides whether to resolve it or escalate, and then notifies the customer or stakeholder with a clear update. Every interaction is logged so teams can spot patterns and fix root causes.

People can use it to:

- Stay updated on late deliveries without constantly checking apps.
- Reduce wasted time in IT or support teams by letting the agent handle routine follow-ups.
- Keep patients informed when doctors or clinics are running behind.
- Track refund or payment delays without manual chasing.

In short, it turns a stressful, manual process into an automated loop — saving time, reducing frustration, and making operations more transparent.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the biggest hurdles was figuring out how to structure the data so the agent could work across different domains (delivery, IT, appointments, payments) without me rebuilding everything for each use case. At first, my database design was too specific to deliveries, which made it hard to extend.

I solved this by stepping back and creating a more generic event model — every case has an ID, status, and timestamps, and every update is just an “event” with an actor, action, and reason. Once I did that, it became much easier to add new domains with the same logic.

Another challenge was connecting everything without writing a lot of code. Tools like Supabase and Lovable made it possible, but I had to carefully design the prompts and workflows so actions like “Ping Assignee” or “Decide” would actually insert the right events and update the UI in real time. Debugging that flow took a lot of trial and error, but once it clicked, the whole loop worked smoothly.

Sukriti Dubey

> The AI that takes cares of your work.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The Problem It Solves:

1. Knowledge workers, i.e, founders, product managers, students, and professionals, waste an enormous amount of time on repetitive, low-value tasks that don’t require human creativity:
2. Writing meeting notes and manually pulling out action items.
3. Rewriting the same content for different platforms (LinkedIn → Twitter → Instagram).
4. Spending hours on scheduling, task planning, and approvals.
5. Constantly juggling between multiple tools (Notion, Slack, Google Docs, Trello, Calendars).

This fragmentation leads to:
1. Loss of focus on strategic work.
2. Fatigue from context-switching.
3. Hours of productivity lost every single week.

How Jarvis Solves It:
Jarvis – The AI Assistant for Work is designed to act like your personal operations partner. Instead of hiring an intern or switching between 10 different apps, you simply delegate tasks to Jarvis.

Jarvis can:
1. Listen to meetings- generate instant summaries, highlights, and action items.
2. Repurpose content- take one LinkedIn draft and adapt it automatically for Twitter, Instagram, and blogs.
3. Plan your week- create schedules and to-do lists from natural language input.
4. Centralize workflows- one AI hub instead of fragmented tools.

Impact
Save 1+ hour per day per person by eliminating repetitive admin tasks.
Reduce context-switching and improve focus on high-value, creative work.
For teams, this compounds into hundreds of hours of productivity unlocked every month.

In short:
Jarvis makes everyday work easier, faster, and smarter by taking care of the boring stuff so you can focus on the big picture.

Here is the Deck link - https://drive.google.com/file/d/1j73t1hlBtsQsAkOFJKSRRSl24pklIgpd/view?usp=sharing

How Jarvis Fits Into All Four Tracks:
1. Voice AI & Conversational Products → Jarvis can listen to meetings, transcribe them, and generate summaries, action items, and translations in real time.
2. Vibecoding Your Idea → Jarvis acts like a productivity copilot for builders, turning natural language into tasks, schedules, and even structured outputs that speed up development.
3. AI Agents & Workflow Automation → Jarvis functions as an AI workflow agent, automating repetitive tasks like scheduling, approvals, and content repurposing across platforms.
4. AI Evals & Observability → Jarvis integrates a trust layer, monitoring outputs for accuracy, bias, and reliability so users can trust its recommendations and summaries.
Jarvis is designed as a practical AI assistant that touches every track, but comes together as one unified product experience.

**Challenges we ran into**

Building Jarvis wasn’t just about connecting APIs, the biggest hurdles were in making it practical, reliable, and demo-ready within hackathon constraints.

Jarvis felt like it should be a “do everything” AI (like Iron Man’s Jarvis).
This was too broad to build in 2 weeks.
Solution: We narrowed the MVP so we could demonstrate impact without overcomplicating.

Multi-Tool Fragmentation
Using Windsurf for code, Lovable for UI, and Rocket for deployment created friction; each tool worked great alone, but wasn’t seamless together.
Solution: We created a clear workflow: design in Lovable- export assets- integrate into Windsurf code- deploy via Rocket. This made collaboration smooth and updates painless.

Speech-to-Text Accuracy:
Transcriptions (Whisper / STT APIs) often struggled with noisy audio or accents.
Solution: Added preprocessing (noise reduction + confidence thresholds) and fallback summarization prompts in GPT to clean outputs.

Maintaining a Stable Demo Link:
We needed a single permanent link for Devfolio, but rapid iteration risked breaking it.
Solution: Hosted on Rocket with GitHub auto-deploy- every update pushes to the same link, so judges always see the latest version.

**Top 100 Participants**

Jarvis fits into the Lovable track because we used Lovable to design and refine the core user experience. were first prototyped in Lovable to create clean, modern, and user-friendly interfaces.

**All Registered Participants**

We used Windsurf as our main AI coding environment to quickly scaffold the backend, set up APIs, and build frontend flows. It saved time on boilerplate so we could focus on solving the real problem with Jarvis.

**All Registered Participants.**

We integrated ElevenLabs for realistic voice output, turning Jarvis from just a text assistant into a more natural voice-driven experience. This made our meeting summaries and responses more engaging and accessible.

**Vibecoding your Idea | Powered by Rocket.new**

We used Rocket.new not only for hosting but also for continuous deployment and project scaffolding. Rocket automatically synced with our GitHub repo, deployed every update to the same stable link, and gave us a production-grade environment without manual setup. This let us iterate fast, test new features safely, and keep our demo always live for judges.

**The problem it solves**

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/222e61205dff45f088ae664b89e4ac8a/f0b937eb-0e96-4e6d-922f-43ca34159ba3.png)
Meetings squander time; teams spend hours on calls and still leave unsure of their next steps.

Action items go lost, important chores are buried among jumbled notes or never written down at all.

Manual note-taking is inefficient because someone must type, disseminate, and organize notes, which are typically inaccurate and incomplete.

Remote and async teams struggle; people who miss meetings do not receive a clear, concise recap, forcing them to replay recordings.

Context evaporates; even if notes exist, they rarely record "who said what" and when.

presentation deck: https://meetingmate-your-ai-meet-qkruhgc.gamma.site/

**Challenges we ran into**

Speech-to-Text Accuracy

Background noise and multiple speakers made transcription messy.

Sometimes Whisper confused accents or technical terms → required manual validation.

Action Item Extraction

Getting the LLM (Claude/OpenAI) to consistently return valid JSON was tricky.

The model would sometimes invent deadlines or assign tasks incorrectly → had to add confidence scores + schema checks.

Voice Recap Integration

ElevenLabs API responses were binary audio buffers → converting to base64 and streaming to browser audio players wasn’t straightforward.

Data Privacy Concerns

Meetings can be sensitive, so we had to think about disclaimers and secure handling of uploaded audio files.

UI/UX Balance

Needed to make the prototype simple enough for a demo while still looking polished.

Designing an interface that shows transcript, summary, and action items clearly without clutter.

Workflow Automation

Integrating with external tools (Trello/Notion) exposed API quirks and rate limits.

Mapping extracted actions cleanly into task manager fields was non-trivial.

Time Constraints

Building a working AI-powered product in hackathon time meant trade-offs → e.g., no multi-speaker diarization, no long-term storage/scalability.

I deployed the project on lovable

**The problem it solves**

WishAura: AI-Powered Gift Recommendation Solution

WishAura solves the universal problem of  "gift selection anxiety" the stress and uncertainty people experience when trying to find the perfect gift for someone special.

The Core Problems WishAura Addresses:

1. Decision Overload: Too many options make it difficult to choose meaningful gifts
2. Lack of Personalization: Generic gifts often miss the mark in expressing thoughtfulness
3. Time Constraints: Busy schedules make thorough gift research challenging
4. Budget Uncertainty: Difficulty finding quality gifts within specific price ranges
5. Knowledge Gaps: Not knowing enough about someone's specific interests or preferences

How WishAura Solves These Problems:

- AI-Personalized Recommendations: Analyzes personal descriptions to suggest truly relevant gifts
- Interest-Based Filtering: Matches gifts to specific hobbies and preferences
- Budget Optimization: Finds quality options within specified price ranges
- Time Efficiency: Delivers curated recommendations in seconds instead of hours of research
- Inspiration Generation: Provides creative gift ideas you might not have considered
- Personalization Insights: Offers reasoning behind each recommendation

Real-World Impact:

WishAura transforms gift-giving from a stressful chore into a delightful experience, ensuring that every gift is thoughtful, appropriate, and genuinely appreciated by the recipient.

This solution is perfect for:
- Last-minute shoppers
- People shopping for someone with unique interests
- Those who want to give more personalized gifts
- Anyone looking to avoid generic, thoughtless presents

By combining AI analysis with human preferences, WishAura takes the guesswork out of gift-giving and makes every present feel specially chosen.

**Challenges we ran into**

*State Management Without Frameworks
Tracking selected interests, form values, and results without React/Vue

Managing UI state transitions (loading, results, errors) using vanilla JavaScript

Handling form validation and error messaging

*API Integration Planning
Designing the structure for both mock data and future API integration

Creating a fallback system when API calls fail

Structuring data to work with both current mock implementation and future Gemini API


*User Experience Flow
Designing intuitive transitions between the hero section and main app

Creating a loading state that provides feedback during "AI processing"

Implementing a reset functionality to start over without page refresh

**The problem it solves**

I tried creating an AI voice assistant that people can talk to in order to learn about Bharat. The idea was to make a conversational platform where both sides can speak — users ask questions, and the AI responds with answers using ElevenLabs’ voice technology.

Reading articles or browsing the internet may not feel natural for everyone, but having a voice-based conversation feels more personal, interactive, and fun.

So the main challenge was integrating an AI system that could automatically find, process, and deliver answers — instead of just relying on predefined examples. At this stage,  it’s not yet fully “AI-powered” on the answering side.

🚧 Challenges I Ran Into
Challenge 1: Component Icon Visibility Issues
Problem: Icons weren't rendering in the chatbot and navigation components

Chat button appeared blank
User couldn't see menu icons
Navigation elements looked broken
Solution:

Replaced dynamic Icon components with inline SVG elements
Hardcoded essential icons directly in JSX
Ensured consistent rendering across all browsers
Challenge 2: Layout Overflow & Responsive Design
Problem: Elements breaking out of containers on different screen sizes

Results page hero section too large
KPI cards not fitting properly
Mobile layout completely broken
Solution:

Reduced excessive padding and margins
Implemented proper CSS Grid with responsive breakpoints
Added truncate classes for long text content
Used max-w constraints for better content flow
Challenge 3: ElevenLabs API Integration
Problem: Integrating real-time voice generation for sample calls

CORS issues with direct API calls
Audio file handling and playback
Error handling for failed generations
Solution:

Implemented proper fetch headers and API key management
Created File objects from audio blobs for seamless integration
Added loading states and user-friendly error messages
Stored API keys securely in environment variables
Challenge 4: State Management Complexity
Problem: Managing analysis data flow across multiple components

Upload → Processing → Results pipeline
Real-time status updates
Component communication issues
Solution:

Used React Context for global state management
Implemented proper data flow patterns
Added loading and error states throughout the pipeline
Created reusable hooks for common operations
Challenge 5: Performance with Large Data Visualizations
Problem: Flowchart rendering caused browser lag with complex call data

D3.js performance issues
Animation stuttering
Memory leaks with frequent re-renders
Solution:

Implemented progressive rendering with delays
Used useMemo and useCallback for expensive operations
Added cleanup functions for D3 elements
Optimized animation timing and reduced complexity
Challenge 6: Build Configuration & Dependencies
Problem: Vite build failing with conflicting package versions

Module resolution errors
CSS processing issues
Production build optimization
Solution:

Updated package.json with compatible versions
Configured Vite plugins properly
Added proper PostCSS and Tailwind configuration
Implemented source maps for debugging

🎙️ ElevenLabs Integration in VoxiFlow
What is ElevenLabs?
ElevenLabs is a cutting-edge AI voice synthesis platform that creates incredibly realistic, human-like speech from text. It's considered one of the most advanced text-to-speech (TTS) services available, offering:

Ultra-realistic voice cloning
Multilingual support (29+ languages)
Emotional voice synthesis
Real-time voice generation
High-quality audio output
VoxiFlow's ElevenLabs Implementation
Integration Location:

javascript
// src/pages/upload-interface/components/UploadZone.jsx
const generateSampleCall = async () => {
  const response = await fetch('https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Accept': 'audio/mpeg',
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'xi-api-key': process.env.REACT_APP_ELEVENLABS_API_KEY
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      text: "Enterprise software sales conversation...",
      model_id: "eleven_monolingual_v1",
      voice_settings: {
        stability: 0.5,
        similarity_boost: 0.5
      }
    })
  });
}

### MindScribe.AI
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/mindscribeai-69a1) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/vishnuramv/mindscribe-web) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://mindscribe-web-alpha.vercel.app/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-mosAIc:%20AI%20in%20action%20with%20The%20Product%20Folks-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://mosaicbytpf.devfolio.co)

> Helping Indian therapists focus on care, not paper

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Gemini AI Model](https://img.shields.io/badge/Gemini%20AI%20Model-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Therapist can use this product to summarize session transcripts and keep track patient sessions. They can just upload the recording without the hassle of writing everything down.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenge:
We got trouble formatting and displaying the generated transcription from the session recording.

The entire process begins in the transcribeAudio function. When you upload a recording, this function sends it to the ElevenLabs API.

The key thing to understand is that the ElevenLabs Speech to Text API, as used in this app, returns the entire transcription as a single block of text. It does not automatically separate speakers or provide individual timestamps for each sentence.

Solution:
The structureTranscript function then performs the crucial conversion step. It takes this single text string and formats it into the application's required TranscriptEntry[] array structure by prompting gemini-2.5-flash model. Since all the text comes in one piece, it creates an array with just one single entry.

Finally, when you navigate to the new session's page (SessionDetailPage), the application fetches the session data, including the transcript array.

This array is passed down to the TranscriptPanel component, which is responsible for rendering it. The panel simply maps over the array and displays each entry. In the case of an ElevenLabs transcription, it will only have one item to display.

**Voice AI & Conversational Products | Powered by Elevenlabs**

Used Elevenlabs to generate transcript of therapy session recording between therapist and patients.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Clerk](https://img.shields.io/badge/Clerk-333333?style=flat-square) ![HuggingFace](https://img.shields.io/badge/HuggingFace-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

This project serves as an AI-powered voice-driven developer assistant that radically improves productivity and collaboration for software engineers and product teams. Users can:

- Speak naturally to code, review, and automate workflows, reducing the need for context switching between tools and interfaces.
- Automate routine, repetitive tasks such as scheduling, bug tracking, and documentation generation through intelligent AI agents.
- Collaborate seamlessly with AI-assisted coding suggestions, bug detection, and real-time team workflows.
- Monitor and evaluate AI models’ performance and behavior transparently to build trust and improve outcomes.
- Save significant development time by offloading mundane tasks, boosting creativity and focus on complex problem-solving.
- Use a fully frontend app with secure authentication and cloud AI APIs, making it easy and safe to access from anywhere.

This assistant makes everyday developer tasks easier, faster, and safer by integrating voice interaction, AI assistance, automation, and model observability into a single platform, cutting down cognitive load and accelerating delivery cycles.

---

**Challenges we ran into**

Building this project involved several hurdles, including:

- **Integrating multiple AI APIs (voice, code, agents, evaluation) seamlessly on frontend:**  
  To solve this, I built modular API utility functions with centralized error handling and loading states. Carefully managing async calls prevented race conditions and UI glitches.

- **Securing sensitive credentials in a frontend-only app:**  
  Using `.env` files with environment variables and leveraging Clerk's secure authentication helped keep API keys safe while enabling logged-in access only.

- **Designing an Apple-themed UI that balances minimalism and rich interactivity:**  
  Achieved this with Inter font, pastel colors, and subtle animations using CSS-in-JS and component-based styling for consistency.

- **Handling real-time updates for AI model monitoring without backend:**  
  Implemented efficient polling and WebSocket fallbacks with React Context to synchronize state and reduce excessive data fetching.

- **Delivering a smooth voice interaction experience over inconsistent network conditions:**  
  Added caching, retries, and user-friendly feedback messages to maintain interaction quality even with spotty internet.

Each challenge strengthened the app’s robustness and usability, making the final product polished and user-friendly.

Integration with Existing Systems

Many businesses already use basic spreadsheets or legacy tools. Making the solution compatible with their existing workflows required careful design.

User-Friendly Design for Non-Technical Users

The main audience was small business owners with limited technical expertise, so creating an intuitive interface was critical.

Security & Data Privacy

Payroll data is highly sensitive (salaries, tax details, personal info), so securing the platform with encryption and access control was a major focus.

Handling Diverse Pay Structures

Businesses have different pay cycles, bonuses, and incentive structures, making it difficult to create a one-size-fits-all solution.

Scalability

Designing the system so it works for both a 5-person team and a 500-person team without performance issues was a challenge.

Testing & Error Handling

Payroll errors can lead to trust issues and legal problems, so building robust error detection and recovery was essential.

**Top 100 Participants**

Why This Project Stands Under 100 Marks:

Scope is Limited

The project focuses on automating payroll calculations and basic compliance checks for small businesses.

It does not include advanced AI, large-scale enterprise integration, or full HRMS features, keeping it a medium-level project.

Core Features Only

Features are restricted to essentials like employee data entry, salary calculation, tax deductions, and report generation.

No complex modules like predictive analytics, deep ML algorithms, or cloud-scale architecture.

Technology Stack is Simple

Built using basic web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, maybe a backend like Node.js or Python).

No heavy frameworks or advanced microservices architecture.

Time & Complexity

Can be completed in 4–6 weeks by a small team.

Does not require massive datasets, advanced optimization algorithms, or cross-platform mobile support.

Focus on Automation, Not Intelligence

The system automates repetitive tasks but does not involve AI-driven decision-making, predictive payroll forecasting, or blockchain-based security, which would push it into a higher category.

![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![SQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Supabase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Supabase-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Rest everything on the project have documented in this [[[Notion]](https://clear-engine-59a.notion.site/BioGuard-Privacy-First-Biodata-sharing-269dd5a0c79a80acb1f2ea823e81f732?source=copy_link) 


Biodata + photos get blasted in Whatsapp groups, beyond consent.

Unsolicited calls, harassment, future deepfake risk.

Current tools (WhatsApp, Drive links) = forwardable, downloadable, permanent.

Tradition deserves dignity. Sharing shouldn’t mean surrendering control.

1. Vision & Mission
Vision: To be the most trusted platform for sharing sensitive personal information during the matchmaking process.

Mission: To empower individuals with complete control and peace of mind over their personal data by providing a secure, time-limited, and auditable sharing solution.

2. Core Problem
Users sharing biodata for marriage prospects via channels like WhatsApp lose all control over their sensitive information (photos, personal details). This leads to privacy violations, risk of misuse, and personal anxiety.

3. Target Audience
Primary: Individuals (like Priya, 41) and their guardians who are actively sharing profiles for matrimonial alliances.

Secondary: Matchmakers and mediators who need a professional and secure way to share client information.

4. Core User Stories (The "Three Pillars" of the MVP)
Creator Story: As a Creator, I want to create a simple profile and generate a unique, time-limited, and OTP-protected link to share with a trusted contact.

Viewer Story: As a Viewer, I want to open a link, verify my identity with an OTP, and view a profile in a secure environment where I cannot easily download or copy the information.

Audit Story: As a Creator, I want to see a log of which verified phone numbers have viewed my profile and when, providing me with an audit trail.

5. Who Feels It (Personas & JTBD)

a) Owner (Bride/Groom): “Share my biodata safely with select people, revoke anytime.” 
b)Viewer (Family): “See details easily, without tech friction.” 
c) Mediator (Matchmaker): “Route prospects, avoid holding sensitive copies.”

JTBD: When introducing a prospect, ensure privacy, time‑limits, and traceability so everyone acts respectfully.

6. MVP Feature Set (Prioritized)
Must-Haves (Build these first)
Creator Authentication:

Sign up/Login using a phone number (Firebase Authentication).

Profile Management (CRUD):

Create a single profile with predefined fields (Name, Age, Height, Religion, City, Occupation, About Me).

Upload ONE profile picture (store in Supabase).

Ability to Edit and Delete the profile.

Secure Link Generation:

A button on the dashboard to "Generate Secure Link".

Inputs: Viewer's phone number (for OTP targeting)/PIN in case of WebApp, expiry duration (.

Output: A unique URL is generated and stored in a Supabase collection (links) with creatorId, viewerPhoneNumber, expiryTimestamp, and a isViewed flag.

Secure Viewer Flow:

The unique URL leads to a landing page.

The page prompts the viewer to enter the pin.

If the number matches the Pin in the database record for that link then only can be accessed.

On successful OTP verification, display the creator's profile data.

Security Measures on Viewer Page:

JavaScript: Disable right-click, Ctrl+C, Ctrl+S, text selection. Next Iteration

Dynamic Watermark: Overlay the viewer's phone number (e.g., "Viewed by +91-XXXXXNNNNN") on the profile picture using CSS.

Creator Dashboard & Audit Log:

Display the creator's own profile.

A list of all active/expired links they have generated.

Creator can revoke an active link before it expires.

Email notifications to the creator when their profile is viewed.Next Iteration

A more elegant UI/UX.

Won't Have (Out of Scope for MVP)
Subscription/Payment processing.

Multiple photo uploads.

In-app chat or communication.

Customizable profile fields.

7. Recommended Tech Stack (for Speed)
Frontend: NextJS.

Backend & Database: Supabase

Authentication: For creator login and viewer OTP verification through PIN.

Tech Choices (speed‑first)

Frontend: Next.js + TypeScript + Tailwind.

Data: Supabase (links, policies, audit).
In next iteration wish to take this decentralized on blockchain

Storage:  Supabase Storage.

Edge Functions: Firebase Functions for token issue, rate limits, scheduled deletes.

CDN/Hosting: Vercel & github

Self-Sovereign Identity (SSI)

Meaning: You own and control your identity data (name, age, credentials, proofs) without needing a central authority (like Facebook, Google, or even a matrimonial platform) to “vouch” for you.

Usually based on decentralized identifiers (DIDs) and verifiable credentials (VCs).

Implication for your app idea:

Instead of uploading your biodata to our server, you could keep it in your own digital wallet.

When a matchmaker/family wants to see it, you grant them temporary viewing rights via cryptographic proof.

Once you revoke, they can’t access it anymore.

Analogy: Instead of leaving your passport at every hotel desk, you flash a QR code

Major deployment errors thats the reason i shifted the whole tech stack from Firebase to Supabase & the Login prompt was not on the phone although on Web App . 

Shifting from Netlify.toml to Vercel and Github commits.

Also understand one write code or programming in various syntax & format .

Sometimes those work sometimes do not. Major time goes in Troubleshooting the errors & compatibility.

Although was quite an experience.

Next iteration i would love to incorporate Lovable+ Firebase OTP Logins, Blockchain tech stack, Privacy based watermarks & stuff  & launch this on the Google play store.

> Jobs organized. Earnings maximized.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Supabase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Supabase-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Home Services is a $60B market in India, growing at 10–11% every year. Yet 97% of it is still unorganised. Contractors like painters, waterproofing experts, electricians still run their businesses on WhatsApp, calls, and pen-paper while the rest of India has already moved to digital.

This creates everyday chaos:
1. Leads get missed and jobs forgotten
2. Estimates are delayed or just sent as WhatsApp texts
3. Payments are unclear, leading to mistrust
4. Big CRMs like Zoho are too complex and expensive. Dukaan and others are designed for retail SMEs. There is nothing focussed on India’s unorganised home service providers.
5. Others like Urban Company own the end to end customer relationship

KarigarPro solves this gap by giving contractors a lightweight CRM, a simple mobile app to manage their leads, estimates, orders, and payments. It helps them work more professionally, earn more consistently, and most importantly, brings dignity to their craft.

**Challenges we ran into**

The first challenge was balancing simplicity while developing the app. 
Contractors are not tech-heavy users, so I had to keep the app extremely intuitive — large buttons, bilingual (English + Hindi), and WhatsApp-first workflows. 

As a non techie and new to product, another major roadblock challenge was development and authentication. Lovable with Supabase was constantly failing even after multiple attempts. Auth was tricky to configure, especially handling OTP-based login and mock OTP for demo. This made me switch the project midway from Lovable to Cursor where I finally got it working cleanly.

Design was also a hurdle as I am not a designer by background. Using AI tools like V0, Nanobanana, and ChatGPT helped me experiment with colors, fonts, and layouts until the app started to look consumer-grade.

What helped me push through was a product-led approach by speaking to users, understanding their pain points, and then quickly prototyping with AI tools. Each hurdle forced me to simplify the product further. The end result is an app that looks polished, feels intuitive, and actually solves the core problem.

**Top 100 Participants**

The core of KarigarPro was built entirely on Lovable. From generating the initial mockup, designing flows to developing most of the frontend linked with Supabase. 

Lovable handled 80–90% of the app build, while other tools were used only for small fixes and polish. Love the design first language of Lovable which helped in designing a contractor first mobile friendly app.

Vineeth Shetty

> Smart AI Guide to the Right Internship 🎯

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Our solution is a Flask-based web application that recommends internships in a personalized way.
The student enters their skills, education level, preferred sector, and location.
Our system uses machine learning similarity techniques, specifically TF-IDF and cosine similarity, to calculate a percentage match score between the student profile and available internships.
It helps students quickly find relevant internships, saving their time and effort.
It also helps recruiters by shortlisting the most suitable candidates.
This system can easily be scaled up for use in colleges, universities, and even government internship portals.

**Challenges we ran into**

Dataset Creation
Collecting and curating a reliable internship dataset was tough.
Most portals don’t provide structured data, so we had to manually collect and clean 200+ records.
Flask Integration
Connecting the ML model with Flask and ensuring smooth user input → ML model → UI results pipeline was a learning curve.
UI/UX Simplicity
Designing a frontend that is simple, clean, and responsive while still showing match percentages clearly was another challenge.
