> Smart Attendance — Automate, Analyze, Achieve!

![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Socket.IO](https://img.shields.io/badge/Socket.IO-333333?style=flat-square) ![SQLite](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQLite-333333?style=flat-square) ![Express.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Express.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![React Router](https://img.shields.io/badge/React%20Router-333333?style=flat-square) ![React.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/React.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Vite](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vite-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The Problem It Solves

Educational institutions still rely heavily on manual attendance systems, which are:

⏳ Time-consuming — Teachers waste valuable class time marking attendance manually.

❌ Error-prone — Manual tracking often leads to inaccurate records.

💤 Unproductive free time — Students waste their free periods without structured guidance.

🎯 Lack of personalization — Institutions fail to align students’ idle time with their career goals or learning paths.

📉 Limited insights — Administrators lack real-time data on student engagement and productivity.

How Our Solution Helps

SmartAttend provides an automated attendance and personalized productivity planner that simplifies and enhances the student experience:

📌 Automated Attendance
Uses QR codes, Bluetooth/Wi-Fi proximity, or face recognition to mark attendance instantly.

⏱ Saves Time
Teachers can focus more on teaching instead of wasting time on manual roll calls.

📺 Real-Time Dashboard
Displays live attendance updates on classroom screens.

🎯 Personalized Task Suggestions
During free periods, students receive customized academic or career-related tasks based on their interests and goals.

📅 Smart Daily Routine
Generates a personalized daily plan combining classes, free slots, and long-term objectives.

📊 Better Insights
Institutions and administrators can track student engagement and offer targeted support.

With SmartAttend, we save time, boost productivity, and bridge the gap between academic schedules and personal development.

**Challenges we ran into**

While building SmartAttend, we faced several technical and implementation hurdles:

1. Face Recognition Integration 🧠

Challenge: Initially, integrating real-time face recognition for automated attendance caused performance issues on lower-end devices and browsers.

Solution: We optimized the detection pipeline by reducing model size, caching embeddings, and falling back to QR-based check-ins where hardware limitations exist.

2. Real-Time Attendance Updates ⚡

Challenge: Ensuring instant synchronization of attendance data across multiple devices and dashboards was tricky.

Solution: We used Socket.IO for WebSocket-based communication, allowing teachers, students, and admins to view live updates without refreshing.

3. Personalized Task Recommendations 🎯

Challenge: Mapping students’ free time with personalized learning suggestions was complex due to varying timetables and goals.

Solution: We designed a lightweight recommendation engine that uses students’ academic interests, career goals, and strengths to suggest tasks dynamically.

4. Deployment & Compatibility 🚀

Challenge: Hosting both the frontend and backend together while ensuring smooth integration of real-time features was challenging.

Solution: We separated the frontend (Vercel) and backend (Render) deployments and configured CORS + environment variables properly to ensure seamless communication.

**The problem it solves**

# 🌾 CropSaarthi — Your Smart Farming Companion

## 🌟 Inspiration
In India, a majority of farmers still depend on traditional methods and word-of-mouth knowledge. This often leads to crop losses due to undiagnosed diseases, inefficient irrigation, and lack of awareness about government schemes. We were inspired to build a solution that combines **AI, weather data, solar insights**, and **government support** — all in one offline-friendly app — to truly empower the **grassroots of agriculture**.


## 📱 What it does
CropSaarthi is a mobile-first AI assistant designed for farmers. It provides:

- 🧠 **AI Crop Doctor**: Detects plant diseases from images and suggests eco-friendly, natural remedies.
- 💧 **Smart Irrigation Planner**: Uses weather data to recommend ideal watering times, saving water and effort.
- ☀️ **Solar Solutions Guide**: Calculates savings from solar tools and shows related subsidies.
- 🧪 **Soil Testing Portal**: Links to government’s Soil Health Card API to check soil quality.
- 📢 **Welfare Scheme Updates**: Informs farmers about active government & CSR programs for training, tools, and subsidies.
- 🗣️ **Voice + Local Language Support**: Accessible to non-literate farmers.

**Challenges we ran into**

- Integrating image-based disease detection inside a low-code/no-code environment.
- Fetching weather data within platforms that don’t allow direct API calls (worked around using mock inputs).
- Ensuring everything works offline or with low bandwidth.
- Designing a clean, multilingual interface accessible to rural users.

> Where every indian learns about finance

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Today, financial literacy is not accessible to everyone.

Many individuals, especially youth and working-class people, struggle with budgeting, saving, investing, and debt management.

Lack of financial knowledge leads to poor money management, high debt, and low savings for emergencies or retirement.

Traditional financial education is often:

Expensive (paid courses, coaching).

Complex (filled with jargon, not beginner-friendly).

Inaccessible (not everyone has access to good mentors or courses).

👉 Our AI Financial Educator solves this by providing personalized, affordable, and accessible financial education to every individual in simple, interactive language.
It helps users learn, plan, and apply financial concepts in their daily lives.

**Challenges we ran into**

Data Quality: Ensuring financial data and advice are accurate, updated, and region-specific.

Personalization: Tailoring lessons and advice to different income groups, age brackets, and goals.

Integration with APIs: Using financial APIs (stock market, budgeting tools, banking APIs) while ensuring accuracy.

Complex Calculations: Handling financial models (EMI, investment returns, inflation adjustments, etc.) efficiently.

User-Centric Challenges
Trust & Reliability: Users must feel the AI is secure and not misguiding them.

Simplicity vs. Depth: Balancing easy-to-understand lessons with deeper financial insights for advanced learners.

Engagement: Keeping users motivated to continue learning (gamification, progress tracking).

Ethical & Security Challenges

> lets start a study session

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The Study Together app solves the problem of isolation and lack of accountability while studying. Many students struggle with distractions, low motivation, and difficulty coordinating with peers when studying remotely. Our app provides virtual study rooms where students can connect, collaborate in real-time, and stay focused together — just like studying in a library, but online.

**Challenges we ran into**

While building the Study Together app, I ran into a few key challenges:

Real-time Collaboration:
Implementing live study rooms with features like shared notes, chat, and video calls required managing WebRTC and Socket.IO for seamless peer-to-peer communication. Ensuring low latency and stable connections across different networks was tricky.

Time Constraints:
Since hackathons are fast-paced, we had to prioritize features. We initially aimed to add more advanced tools but had to focus on the core study-room functionality first to deliver a working prototype.

UI/UX Balance:
Designing an interface that felt both minimal and engaging was a challenge. We wanted students to feel focused, not distracted, so balancing productivity tools with simplicity took extra iterations.

Team Coordination:
With limited time, dividing work between frontend, backend, and integration was tough. We overcame this by setting small milestones and syncing regularly.

Unexpected Bugs:
Live collaboration brought synchronization bugs (e.g., chat messages or notes not appearing instantly). Debugging under time pressure was stressful, but it taught us to test iteratively instead of waiting until the end.

### Droply
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/droply-d449) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/CODE-HUB07/Droply/) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://droply-01.netlify.app/public/index.html) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/ozP2VX_UJOg) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackOdisha%205.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackodisha-4.devfolio.co)

> Share Your File Using Single Code

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

1. 🔐 Privacy & Anonymity

Problem: Many file-sharing platforms require account creation or collect user data.
Solution: Droply allows sharing without login, ensuring privacy and avoiding data tracking.

2. 🔄 Cross-Platform Compatibility

Problem: Some file-sharing methods (like AirDrop or Nearby Share) are limited to specific devices, OS, or networks.
Solution: Droply works through the browser, so any device, any OS, from anywhere, can access and share files.

3. 🌍 Distance Limitation

Problem: Local sharing tools (e.g., Bluetooth, AirDrop) don't work over long distances.
Solution: Droply uses the internet, so files can be shared globally, not just locally.

4. 🔗 Simple Sharing via Code

Problem: URLs or login-based sharing can be complex or insecure.
Solution: Droply uses a single sharing code, making it quick and user-friendly without needing to manage long links.

5. 🧹 User-Controlled File Deletion

Problem: Many platforms keep user files for a long time or don’t allow deletion.
Solution: Droply lets users delete files manually, giving control and improving security and data ownership.

6. 🛑 No App Install Needed

Problem: Sharing apps often require downloads or extensions.
Solution: Droply is web-based, requiring only a browser — no extra software needed.

**Challenges we ran into**

1. During the prototype phase, setting up and securing a full cloud storage system (like AWS S3, Firebase, or GCP) can be time-consuming and possibly overkill when you're still building and testing features.

✅ Solution:

"For the prototype, I used a private GitHub repository to manage the backend code and local file storage. This allowed me to focus on building the core features of Droply first. For the final version, I plan to integrate cloud storage for scalability, security, and global access."

2. 🌐 Cross-Device & Browser Compatibility

Problem: Ensuring consistent behavior across devices and browsers.
Mobile vs desktop differences (file input, UI rendering).
Browser restrictions (e.g., Safari file handling).

✅Solutions:
Use responsive design (CSS media queries).
Thorough cross-browser testing (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge).

> Smart Farming, Simplified

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![AI/ML](https://img.shields.io/badge/AI/ML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Vercel](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vercel-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Agriculture in India faces a persistent challenge where millions of small and marginal farmers struggle to access timely, reliable, and localized advice on crop health, pest/disease management, weather risks, and market prices. Existing plant recognition tools are limited in scope, often identifying only basic plant species without addressing critical problems such as pest infestations, irrigation scheduling, or government scheme eligibility. Farmers in rural regions, especially those with limited digital literacy, also face barriers with English-only chatbots, text-heavy interfaces, and unreliable internet connectivity. The lack of an integrated, intelligent, and multilingual advisory platform leaves them vulnerable to crop losses, low yields, and missed opportunities for subsidies or fair market prices. This project aims to solve these gaps by transforming a simple plant recognition module into a domain-specific, LLM-powered agriculture assistant—capable of detecting crop diseases via images, retrieving real-time data from trusted sources like IMD and AGMARKNET, providing multilingual and voice-based interaction, and functioning even offline on low-end devices. By combining AI, RAG, and blockchain validation, the solution empowers farmers with actionable insights, improves resilience against climate risks, and ensures inclusive access to government benefits.

### ReWear
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/rewear-18a9) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/AnamikaMaurya-10/rewear-hub.git) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://re.vly.site/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackOdisha%205.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackodisha-4.devfolio.co)

> Swap, Borrow, Restyle

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Express.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Express.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Vite](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vite-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The Problem ReWear Solves
We live in an era of fast fashion, leading to two major problems for both our wallets and the planet:

Hyper-Consumption & Waste: The fashion industry is one of the world's largest polluters. People buy trendy or occasion-specific outfits, wear them once or twice, and then discard them. This creates massive textile waste and drains personal finances.


The Cluttered Closet Paradox: Many people own a closet full of clothes they no longer wear, yet still feel the constant pressure to buy something new for the next event, trip, or season. These unworn clothes are essentially "dead assets" taking up space.

Existing solutions like messy social media groups are disorganized, lack trust, and offer no clear distinction between a permanent swap and a temporary borrow.

What Can People Use It For?
ReWear provides a streamlined, community-driven platform to give every piece of clothing a longer, more useful life.

To Refresh Your Everyday Wardrobe (For Free):
Use the Exchange Mode to permanently swap a shirt you're tired of for a "new-to-you" one from someone else's closet. It's a sustainable and cost-free way to keep your style fresh without buying new.

To Find the Perfect Outfit for a Special Occasion:
Use the Borrow Mode to rent a unique dress, a sharp blazer, or a festive outfit for a few days. It's perfect for:

Weddings and parties

Cultural festivals like Durga Puja or Diwali

College fests and events

Important presentations or interviews

To Declutter and Earn from Your Closet:
List your own high-quality but rarely-used clothes. You can either exchange them for items you'll actually wear or earn a small fee by lending them out to others in your community.

How ReWear Makes It Easier & Safer
ReWear is designed to be more efficient and trustworthy than existing informal methods.

Structured Discovery: Instead of endlessly scrolling through chaotic social media feeds, users can easily filter items by size, category, and—most importantly—by Exchange Only or Borrow Only.

Clear Intentions: The app removes ambiguity. Every user knows upfront whether a transaction is a permanent swap or a temporary, paid borrow.

Simplified Logistics: The entire flow is managed within the app:

Request: A simple button-click to show interest.

Approval: A clear accept/reject step for the owner.

Secure Communication: An in-app chat opens only after a request is approved, so you don't have to share your personal contact details with strangers prematurely.

Building Trust (Future Vision): The platform is built to incorporate trust scores and user reviews, creating a safer and more reliable community than anonymous online marketplaces.

**Challenges we ran into**

The Hurdle: The Silent Frontend & The CORS Error 🐛
While building ReWear, we hit a major roadblock that almost every developer faces when building a modern web app: the frontend and backend refused to communicate.

We had successfully built the first part of our backend API. We could use a tool like Postman to request the /api/items endpoint, and it would correctly send back a list of clothing items from our database. On the frontend, we wrote a fetch request in our React code to call that same endpoint and display the items.

The Bug: When we loaded the webpage, it was completely blank. No items appeared. We checked the browser's developer console and saw a cryptic but critical error message:

Cross-Origin Resource Sharing Error: No 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' header is present on the requested resource.

This meant that even though our backend server was running perfectly and our frontend was sending the request correctly, the user's web browser was actively blocking the connection.

How We Overcame It 💡
The process to solve this involved understanding the root cause and implementing a standard server-side solution.

1. Diagnosing the Problem
We first confirmed the issue wasn't with our code logic.

The backend worked with Postman (an API tool), so the server logic was fine.

The frontend's fetch request was visible in the "Network" tab of the developer tools, so the frontend was trying to communicate.

This isolated the problem to the connection itself. The error message pointed us to CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing). We learned that this is a security feature built into all modern browsers. By default, it prevents a web page from one "origin" (like our frontend at http://localhost:5173) from requesting resources from a different "origin" (like our backend at http://localhost:3001).

2. Implementing the Solution
The solution was to configure our Express.js backend to tell the browser that receiving requests from our frontend's origin is safe and permitted.

We did this by using the official cors middleware package for Express.

Step 1: Install the Package
First, we stopped our backend server and installed the package from the terminal:

Bash

# In the /backend directory
npm install cors
Step 2: Use the Middleware in Express
Next, we added just two lines of code to our main backend file (e.g., server.js or index.js):

JavaScript

// Import the package at the top of the file
const cors = require('cors');

// ... other imports like express, mongoose, etc.

const app = express();

// Use the cors middleware
// This MUST be placed before your API routes
app.use(cors());

// ... rest of the app setup and API routes
app.use('/api/items', itemRoutes);
The Result ✅
After adding the cors middleware and restarting our backend server, we refreshed the frontend. It worked perfectly. The CORS error was gone, and the clothing items fetched from the backend were displayed beautifully on the page.

This hurdle taught us a fundamental lesson about web security and how browsers enforce the Same-Origin Policy. The solution was simple in terms of code but required a solid understanding of why the problem was happening in the first place.

**The problem it solves**

## 🌾 The Problem It Solves

Farming today is becoming more challenging due to:

* ❌ **Unpredictable crop yields** caused by changing weather patterns
* ❌ **Inefficient irrigation** leading to water wastage or crop stress
* ❌ **Overuse or underuse of fertilizers**, reducing soil health and increasing costs
* ❌ **Pest outbreaks** that farmers cannot predict in advance
* ❌ **Wrong crop choices**, resulting in poor productivity and losses

---

## ✅ How Our Solution Helps

Our **AI-Powered Agricultural Platform** makes farming easier, safer, and more profitable by:

* 📊 **Predicting Crop Yields** – helping farmers plan harvests and sales better
* 💧 **Smart Irrigation Scheduling** – ensuring optimal water usage and saving resources
* 🌱 **Fertilizer Recommendations** – balancing NPK needs to maintain soil health and cut costs
* 🐛 **Pest Alert System** – providing early warnings to prevent major crop damage
* 🌾 **Crop Recommendation** – suggesting the best crops to grow based on soil and weather conditions
* 🌍 **Localized Support** – offering insights in regional languages for accessibility

---

## 🌟 The Value

* ⬆️ **10–15% increase in productivity** for small-scale farmers
* 💰 **Lower input costs** through optimized water and fertilizer use
* 🛡️ **Reduced risks** of crop failure from pests and poor planning
* 📱 **Easy-to-use platform** (web/mobile) designed with farmers in mind

---

**Challenges we ran into**

## ⚡ Challenges we Ran Into

### 🚀 Deployment Issues

* **Problem:** Our containerized FastAPI service failed to start properly on GCP (port & timeout errors).
* **Solution:** Fixed by configuring correct environment variables, health checks, and ensuring the service listened on the assigned `$PORT`.

### 🐍 Version Conflicts

* **Problem:** Faced dependency version conflicts between `scikit-learn`, XGBoost, and other ML libraries.
* **Solution:** Resolved by pinning exact versions in `requirements.txt` and rebuilding clean Docker images.

---

### MediNote
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/medinote-308a) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/VhoraZishan/MediNote) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://medinote-livid.vercel.app/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackOdisha%205.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackodisha-4.devfolio.co)

> Turning conversations into care

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![React Router](https://img.shields.io/badge/React%20Router-333333?style=flat-square) ![Vercel](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vercel-333333?style=flat-square) ![Supabase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Supabase-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

This project addresses one of the most persistent challenges in healthcare: the burden of clinical documentation. Doctors and other healthcare professionals often spend a significant amount of time writing or dictating consultation notes, which reduces the time available for direct patient interaction. Manual note-taking not only slows down the consultation process but also increases the risk of incomplete, inconsistent, or poorly structured records, which can compromise both care quality and medico-legal safety. Existing solutions, such as commercial dictation and transcription software, are often expensive, locked into proprietary ecosystems, and lack flexibility for smaller clinics or individual practitioners. Our web application solves these issues by providing a modern, secure, and cost-effective platform for recording consultations, transcribing speech into text, and automatically generating structured SOAP (Subjective, Objective, Assessment, Plan) notes. Built with React, TypeScript, Vite, and Supabase, it leverages serverless edge functions to integrate with transcription services like AssemblyAI while ensuring secure authentication and data management through Supabase Auth and database services. Clinicians can record consultations directly through the browser, upload transcripts or audio files, and instantly generate structured notes that are safely stored for later review or completion. This not only reduces administrative workload but also enhances the accuracy and consistency of medical records, making documentation faster, safer, and more accessible, particularly for clinics and practitioners seeking an affordable alternative to enterprise EHR/EMR systems.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenge: While testing audio transcription in noisy environments, the system struggled to accurately extract text from consultation recordings. Background noise, multiple speakers, and poor audio quality made the transcription unreliable, which affected the quality of the generated SOAP notes.

Solution: To address this, we implemented noise cancellation techniques and optimized audio capture settings. By preprocessing the audio before transcription, we were able to significantly improve the clarity and accuracy of the extracted text, ensuring that the SOAP notes generated from recordings were reliable even in less-than-ideal recording conditions.

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/youtube-summariser-b6b1) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Sallouni17/NightFury) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/R92xGQDpZZE) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackOdisha%205.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackodisha-4.devfolio.co)

> The essence of the video, instantly.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![AWS Lambda](https://img.shields.io/badge/AWS%20Lambda-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![RestAPIs](https://img.shields.io/badge/RestAPIs-333333?style=flat-square) ![ReactHook](https://img.shields.io/badge/ReactHook-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

This platform solves the problem of information overload and inefficiency on YouTube. It's designed for anyone who needs to quickly extract and understand the core value of video content without spending unnecessary time watching a full video.

How People Can Use It
For Students & Researchers:
Efficient learning: Quickly summarize lectures, tutorials, or research presentations to get the main points. This is especially useful for reviewing material before an exam or for a literature review.
Annotating and collaborating: Use the collaborative workspaces to share video summaries, add notes, and discuss key topics with classmates or colleagues on a group project.

For Professionals & Marketers:
Market analysis: Quickly analyze competitor videos, understand market sentiment, and identify emerging trends with the AI-powered sentiment and viral potential analysis.
Content strategy: Use the channel and comparative analytics to see what's working and create more effective video content. The one-click sharing also simplifies distributing insights and summaries across social media.
Internal knowledge sharing: Summarize long team meetings or webinars and share the key takeaways with colleagues through a private workspace, ensuring everyone is on the same page.

For Content Creators:
Audience insights: Use the sentiment analysis and topic extraction to understand what your audience cares about, which can help you refine your content strategy.
Content inspiration: Identify trending topics and viral patterns to spark new ideas for your own videos.
Engagement improvement: Compare your videos side-by-side to understand what makes some content more engaging than others.

**Challenges we ran into**

A significant hurdle I faced was the real-time transcription and analysis of long videos. Initially, I was using a simple approach: downloading the entire video, transcribing it with a single model call, and then running the full text through the AI for summarization. This worked fine for short videos, but for longer content (anything over 30 minutes), it was incredibly slow, memory-intensive, and prone to timeouts.

The primary bug I encountered was a consistent "out of memory" error when processing videos over an hour long. The single transcription task would consume too much RAM, causing the FastAPI server to crash.

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/lifepulse-70a7) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/ArinP7/LifePulse-Team-Invalid) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackOdisha%205.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackodisha-4.devfolio.co)

> Saving Lives with Speed & Emergency Care at Finger

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The Problem It Solves

Limited Tracking in Current Devices

Wearables like smartwatches and fitness bands only track vitals (heart rate, steps, SpO2, etc.) but don’t provide predictive analysis.

They alert after the issue occurs, not before, leading to missed chances for early prevention.

Lack of Real-Time Emergency Response

If a patient collapses, there’s no direct emergency chain (family, hospital, ambulance) triggered automatically.

Delay in response often results in avoidable deaths and complications.

High Costs & Accessibility Gaps

Premium healthcare solutions are expensive (₹20,000+ devices, high subscription costs).

Rural and middle-class families cannot afford such services.

Hospitals in semi-urban areas lack integrated monitoring systems.

No Unified Healthcare Ecosystem

Patients must juggle between hospital apps, insurance apps, and wearable apps—creating inefficiency.

There’s no single AI-powered platform combining:

Vital monitoring

AI-based disease prediction

Doctor/hospital connection

Bed booking & ambulance services

Insurance integration

Lack of AI Predictive Support

Existing solutions are reactive, not proactive.

No strong AI system to detect early warning signs (e.g., heart attack, stroke, diabetes complications) and alert before emergencies.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges I Ran Into

Data Availability & Quality

Getting access to large-scale, clean medical datasets for training AI models was difficult.

Real-world health data is often incomplete, inconsistent, or scattered.

Integration with Hospitals & Ambulance Networks

Building real-time connections with hospital systems, bed availability APIs, and ambulance services posed technical and operational hurdles.

Many hospitals don’t yet have standardized digital systems.

Balancing Cost & Accessibility

Making the solution affordable for rural and semi-urban populations while covering development, AI, and wearable costs was a challenge.

AI Model Accuracy & Trust

Ensuring the AI is accurate, reliable, and explainable in health predictions was challenging.

Users and doctors need to trust the system’s recommendations.

Government & Legal Compliance

Navigating healthcare regulations, data privacy laws (HIPAA, Indian IT Act), and approvals was complex.

User Adoption & Awareness

Convincing people (especially in rural areas) to use AI-driven digital healthcare instead of traditional methods was difficult.

Needed training, awareness campaigns, and partnerships.

> OpenWeatherMapApi

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

A weather dashboard powered by the OpenWeather API provides users with real-time access to accurate and detailed weather information, including temperature, humidity, wind speed, and forecasts. This tool simplifies the process of monitoring weather conditions for daily activities, travel planning, and outdoor events, allowing users to make informed decisions quickly and easily. By presenting data in a clear, user-friendly interface, it enhances understanding of complex weather patterns and offers localized insights, which are crucial for safety and efficient planning. Whether for personal use or professional applications like agriculture, construction, or energy management, the dashboard helps reduce weather-related risks and improves operational efficiency by enabling proactive preparation and response to changing weather conditions. Its responsive design ensures accessibility across devices, making reliable weather information constantly available to users wherever they are.

**Challenges we ran into**

One specific challenge faced while building the weather dashboard was focusing on CSS styling to achieve the trendy glassmorphism effect. Glassmorphism involves creating translucent, frosted glass-like panels that blend seamlessly with vivid backgrounds. The main hurdle was balancing the CSS properties like backdrop-filter for background blur, opacity for transparency, and adding subtle borders and shadows to create depth without compromising readability or performance. To overcome this, careful adjustments were made to the blur level and opacity using RGBA colors, and border-radius was applied to soften the card edges. Testing across different screen sizes and browsers ensured consistent visual appeal. Resources and tutorials on glassmorphism CSS helped fine-tune the effect, ultimately resulting in a sleek, modern glass-style design that enhances the user interface and experience.

### Disease Prediction System(DPS)
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/disease-prediction-systemdps-e72c) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://project1-hqtmnmrdwrupaabwlfsylm.streamlit.app/) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/m7q3Qu7E0hA) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackOdisha%205.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackodisha-4.devfolio.co)

> Prevention Starts with Prediction

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Streamlit](https://img.shields.io/badge/Streamlit-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The Disease Prediction System can be used to:

🧪 Early Diabetes Screening – Quickly check whether a person is at risk of diabetes using basic health details.

⚡ Fast Health Assessment – Enter simple inputs like glucose, BMI, and age to get an instant prediction.

🏥 Support for Doctors & Clinics – Acts as a decision support tool for doctors, helping them screen patients faster before recommending detailed tests.

👨‍👩‍👧 Self-Check for Individuals – Anyone can use it from home to get a preliminary idea of their health condition.

🌐 Accessible Anywhere – Runs online on Streamlit Cloud, so no installation or setup is required.

🔑 How It Makes Tasks Easier & Safer

✅ Saves Time – No need to wait for multiple medical tests just for a first-level check.

✅ Increases Awareness – Encourages people to monitor their health regularly.

✅ Assists Healthcare – Doctors can quickly identify high-risk patients.

✅ Accessible & Safe – Works on any device with internet, making health predictions more inclusive.

**Challenges we ran into**

While building this project, one major hurdle we faced was:

⚡ Mismatch in Features During Prediction

Initially, when we tried to predict the output for a new patient, the app crashed with an error:

ValueError: X has 7 features, but StandardScaler is expecting 8 features as input


This happened because the model was trained on 8 features (Pregnancies, Glucose, Blood Pressure, Skin Thickness, Insulin, BMI, Diabetes Pedigree Function, Age), but during prediction we accidentally passed fewer inputs.

✅ How We Solved It

We carefully checked the dataset columns and matched them with the form inputs.

Added all 8 inputs in the form (Pregnancies, Glucose, BP, Skin Thickness, Insulin, BMI, DPF, Age).

After fixing this mismatch, the model worked correctly and predictions were generated smoothly.

🎯 Learning

Always ensure that the input format for prediction matches exactly with the training data.

Debugging step by step helped us identify where the mismatch occurred.

This taught us the importance of data consistency in ML pipelines.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![React.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/React.js-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

AgriBot solves the problem of farmers lacking timely, localized, and easy-to-understand agricultural guidance. Traditional advisory services are often limited, difficult to access, or not available in local languages, leaving farmers uncertain about what crops to grow, how to manage soil health, when to irrigate, or how to handle pests and diseases. By providing a simple chat-based assistant that delivers weather updates, soil insights, crop recommendations, and pest management tips, AgriBot bridges the gap between expert knowledge and everyday farming decisions, helping farmers increase productivity, reduce risks, and make sustainable choices.

**Challenges we ran into**

A key hurdle while building AgriBot was getting the chatbot to respond without relying on paid APIs. Initially, I tried connecting it to external AI services, but this led to errors like “Error contacting assistant” when the backend couldn’t be reached. To overcome this, I redesigned the assistant to work fully on the frontend with predefined questions and hardcoded answers for common farming queries such as weather updates, pest control, and soil health. This way, the chatbot still feels interactive and useful to farmers without depending on external paid services, ensuring the project remains functional, accessible, and free.

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/earthengine-944d) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Tushardas2663/EarthEngine--LifeSimulator.git) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1TXm1GsZTkhds1j8cuYTJTdOgYsnqzPRS/view?usp=sharing) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackOdisha%205.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackodisha-4.devfolio.co)

> Simulate Life

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![PyTorch](https://img.shields.io/badge/PyTorch-333333?style=flat-square) ![ngrok](https://img.shields.io/badge/ngrok-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The fundamental problem this project solves is the lack of believability and dynamic behavior in traditional digital simulations. Most simulations and game characters rely on heavily scripted, predictable logic, failing to capture the rich complexity of human interaction and decision-making. Earth-Engine: A Life Simulator addresses this by creating a "digital petri dish" where autonomous AI agents, powered by a Large Language Model and grounded in real-world data, can generate emergent social behaviors. People can use this for several purposes:

Social Scientists can use it to safely model and study complex societal phenomena—like the spread of new ideas or the formation of communities—in a controlled, repeatable environment.

Game Developers can leverage this architecture to build incredibly realistic Non-Player Characters (NPCs) that remember interactions, have emotional states, and act in unpredictable, human-like ways, drastically enhancing player immersion.

Urban Planners and AI Researchers can use the simulation as a sandbox to test how populations might interact with new designs or to develop more sophisticated, socially intelligent AI agents without real-world consequences.

**Web3 Track prize**

The integration of Wolfram Language is  a significant component that fundamentally grounds the entire simulation in external reality. I utilize the Wolfram API at the core of each agent's daily cognitive loop to fetch live, real-world weather data, bridging the gap between the generative, abstract world and the factual, computable one. This information is injected directly into the high-level planning prompts, transforming the agents from arbitrary actors into context-aware beings whose daily goals are logically influenced by their environment. This critical link creates emergent behaviors—such as the entire town visiting the park on a sunny day—and demonstrates a sophisticated and powerful application of Wolfram Language as an essential tool for making intelligent agents more knowledgeable and realistic.

> Guardian of Your Financial Goals

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-333333?style=flat-square) ![AI/ML](https://img.shields.io/badge/AI/ML-333333?style=flat-square) ![FastAPI](https://img.shields.io/badge/FastAPI-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**The Problems KuberaAI Actually Solves**

- Tired of being that person still managing investments in Excel like it's 1995? 92% of Indian investors are trapped in spreadsheet hell, manually calculating returns while the market moves faster than their formulas can update. KuberaAI rescues you from the endless cycle of =SUM() and pivot tables, bringing your portfolio into the 21st century.

- SIP Math Made Simple (Finally) - Remember when 57% of millennials couldn't figure out how much to invest monthly for their dream home? Yeah, that's embarrassing. KuberaAI translates your vague financial dreams like "I want ₹1.5 Cr for a house in 5 years" into crystal-clear action: "Invest ₹1.2L/month in these 3 stocks." No more calculator confusion or existential math crises.

- Escape the Commission Trap - Traditional robo-advisors are basically digital snake oil salesmen pushing expensive mutual funds while calling it "personalized advice." KuberaAI gives you actual unbiased recommendations without hidden agendas or commission-heavy fund pushing. Revolutionary concept, we know.

**Multi-Agent AI (Because Regular AI Wasn't Extra Enough)**

-     Goal Parser: Understands your financial dreams (even the unrealistic ones)

-     SIP Calculator: Does the math you've been avoiding

-     Stock Recommender: Picks winners using actual data, not gut feelings

-     Risk Scorer: Tells you how close you are to financial disaster (0-10 scale)

**Challenges we ran into**

**Problem**

Our SIP projection accuracy was initially around 60% - basically a coin flip with extra steps. Clients don't appreciate being told their ₹1.5Cr home fund might actually be ₹90K short.

**Solution**

Revamped the Monte Carlo simulation algorithms by:
-     Incorporating actual market volatility patterns from 2015-2023
-     Adding inflation adjustments for different asset classes
-     Using NumPy's advanced statistical functions for better randomization 
-     Result: 89% accuracy within ±5% error margin

**Problem**

Discovered that giving direct stock recommendations without proper disclaimers could land us in regulatory hot water. Apparently, "trust me bro" isn't SEBI-approved financial advice.

**Solution**
- Integrated SEBI-approved data sources only
- Added comprehensive disclaimers to all recommendations
- Implemented audit trails for all AI decisions
- Built regulatory compliance checks into the core architecture

### CareQ
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/careq-6aa9) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/ankit2872/careq) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-SMF%20Smart%20Make--A--Thon-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://smf-smart-makeathon.devfolio.co)

> Skip the wait, not the care.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![SQLite](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQLite-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Long queues and mismanaged patient flow are a common problem in hospitals and clinics. Patients often spend hours waiting, without clear updates on their position in the queue or the expected consultation time. This not only causes frustration and anxiety but can also delay treatment for critical cases.

CareQ solves this by:

1. **Multi-Hospital Access:** Patients can view and choose hospitals based on location and crowd levels, avoiding overcrowded facilities.
2. **Reducing Waiting Time:** Patients get a digital token and real-time wait-time updates, so they know exactly when their turn is approaching.
3.** AI-Powered Triage:** Symptoms are analyzed automatically, ensuring critical patients are prioritized without manual intervention.
4. **Real-Time Notifications: **Patients receive alerts when their turn is near, making the process stress-free.
5. **Efficient Hospital Management:** Hospitals gain a live dashboard for queue monitoring, better resource allocation, and reduced bottlenecks.

**Challenges we ran into**

While building CareQ, we faced several technical and design hurdles:

**Real-Time Queue Updates**

**Challenge: **Maintaining live updates for patients and hospital admins was tricky because traditional APIs only send static data.

**Solution: **We integrated WebSockets to enable seamless real-time communication between frontend and backend.

**AI-Powered Symptom Triage**

**Challenge: **Designing a lightweight AI model that could analyze symptoms quickly without heavy computation.

**Solution: **We used a Hugging Face zero-shot classification model to classify symptom severity into Low, Medium, Critical without needing large-scale training.

**Multilingual Support**

**Challenge: **Many patients are more comfortable in Hindi or local languages. Implementing translations while keeping the UI clean was challenging.

**Solution:** We implemented i18n (internationalization) support with an easy toggle for English/Hindi.

**Scalable Design**

**Challenge: **Managing multiple hospitals and large patient data without performance issues.

**Solution:** We structured the database efficiently and designed the system to scale across hospitals using modular APIs.

> Beginner Friendly Quantum Simulation ToolKit

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

🎯 Problems QuantumFlow Solves
🚧 Core Problems in Quantum Computing Education & Research
1. Accessibility Barrier
Problem: Quantum computing is extremely complex and intimidating for newcomers

Mathematical formalism (linear algebra, complex numbers, tensor products)
Abstract concepts (superposition, entanglement, interference)
Expensive hardware requirements for experimentation
QuantumFlow Solution:

Visual drag-and-drop interface eliminates coding barriers
Real-time quantum state visualization makes abstract concepts tangible
Interactive interference patterns demonstrate quantum phenomena visually
2. Learning Curve Steepness
Problem: Traditional quantum education requires extensive mathematical background

Students need linear algebra, complex analysis, and quantum mechanics
Textbook examples are static and hard to experiment with
Gap between theory and practical implementation
QuantumFlow Solution:

Immediate visual feedback for every gate operation
Interactive experimentation without mathematical prerequisites
Bridge from visual understanding to actual Qiskit code generation
3. Limited Simulation Tools
Problem: Existing quantum simulators are either too simple or too complex

Basic simulators lack real quantum physics
Professional tools (Qiskit, Cirq) require programming expertise
No unified platform combining education and research capabilities
QuantumFlow Solution:

Full quantum state vector simulation with proper physics
Professional-grade backend using NumPy and complex mathematics
Educational frontend with research-quality results

**Challenges we ran into**

Quantum Physics is Hard: Even "simple" operations like CNOT require careful mathematical implementation
Browser Caching is Persistent: Cache-busting strategies need multiple approaches
API Design Matters: Consistent naming conventions prevent integration headaches
Visual Feedback is Critical: Users need immediate confirmation their actions worked
Error Messages Must Be Clear: Distinguish between network errors and quantum simulation errors
Performance Scales Exponentially: Quantum simulation complexity grows rapidly with qubit count

> Assistive Memory and Intelligent Elderly-care

![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Django](https://img.shields.io/badge/Django-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![React Native](https://img.shields.io/badge/React%20Native-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Despite the rise of elderly care technologies, there is no dedicated digital assistant designed specifically for Alzheimer’s patients.
Current tools are either too generic (normal voice assistants like Alexa, Siri, Google Assistant) or too limited (simple reminder apps), leaving a big gap in personalized, real-time, and context-aware support.

Alzheimer’s patients often face challenges such as:

Forgetting daily tasks (taking medicine, eating, bathing, locking doors).

Losing track of time and place.

Difficulty recognizing people or remembering relationships.

Safety risks (wandering, leaving appliances on, missing medication).

Stress and dependency on caregivers.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges I Ran Into

Adaptive Reminders: Fixed schedules failed → built smart rescheduling with caregiver alerts.

Clear Interaction: Complex commands confused patients → simplified to yes/no + visual cues.

Caregiver Support: Lack of updates → added caregiver dashboard & real-time notifications.

Data Privacy: Sensitive health data → ensured encryption & secure storage.

### Vision Beyond Sight
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/vision-beyond-sight-9b10) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/ananyapaliwal07/VisionBeyondSight.git) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Hack%20Quanta-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hack-quanta.devfolio.co)

> we are not restoring vision , we are redifining it

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![OpenCV](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenCV-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![YOLOv3 Algorithm](https://img.shields.io/badge/YOLOv3%20Algorithm-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Vision Beyond Sight is an assistive technology designed to empower visually impaired individuals by giving them real-time awareness of their surroundings. The system uses a camera to capture the environment and applies artificial intelligence (YOLO object detection) to identify objects, obstacles, and important landmarks. Once detected, this information is converted into audio descriptions that the user can hear, allowing them to understand what’s around them without relying on sight.

In addition to object detection, the project includes navigation support. By integrating mapping data, it can provide directions and guide users safely from one location to another. The combination of visual recognition and audio feedback enables users to move independently, avoid obstacles, and recognize objects in real time.

Overall, Vision Beyond Sight acts as a digital guide, translating visual information into spoken words, making daily navigation and interaction with the environment much safer and more intuitive for visually impaired users.

**Challenges we ran into**

Real-time Object Detection:

Ensuring YOLO could detect objects quickly and accurately in real-time was challenging.

Processing live video feeds without lag required optimization of the model and careful handling of memory.

Integration of Audio Feedback:

Converting detected objects into clear and timely audio instructions was tricky.

Synchronizing object detection with speech output so that it feels natural and not delayed.

Navigation & Mapping:

Integrating maps and providing accurate directions was difficult, especially in areas with limited GPS accuracy.

Parsing map data and converting it into simple instructions that are easy to understand.

Hardware Limitations:

Running heavy AI models on lightweight devices or smart glasses caused performance and heating issues.

Managing battery life while maintaining real-time detection.

Voice Command Recognition (Optional Feature):

Ensuring the system correctly understood user voice commands in noisy environments.

Deployment Issues:

Setting up the backend and frontend to communicate properly and making the app stable during live usage.

> farmer's personal advisor

![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![SQLite](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQLite-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![React Native](https://img.shields.io/badge/React%20Native-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

# Problem Statement
Indian agriculture is the backbone of our economy, yet farmers often operate in the dark—lacking real-time, localized, and reliable information on when to plant, what to use, and which schemes to access.

# For this problem we have implemented

## Smart Chat Advisor

Our core product delivers localized, reliable, and easy-to-access knowledge for farmers. They can ask questions in their own language and instantly receive personalized advice on:

* Weather forecasts and crop recommendations

* Pest and disease management

* Fertilizer selection and usage

* Government schemes and benefits

## Integrated Smart Marketplace

Beyond being a chat assistant, the platform also features a smart marketplace that adapts to farmers’ needs. For example, if a farmer inquires about a specific seed, the system will automatically recommend trusted local vendors offering that product. This creates a seamless, end-to-end solution that connects knowledge with action

**Challenges we ran into**

## Challenges Faced

* LangChain Integration  
Initially, integrating LangChain was quite tricky. On top of that, we had to implement persistent chat memory for continuous conversations, which required a lot of brainstorming and experimentation.

* Socket.IO Connection Issue  
We encountered problems with Socket.IO since it required binding to 0.0.0.0, but we had been using localhost. Resolving this took additional research and debugging.

* Vultr Cloud Hosting  
The final major challenge was with Vultr cloud hosting, where we struggled to correctly configure Nginx and the firewall settings.

**Vultr Cloud Deployment Track**

VULTR Hosting

We have deployed a Flask backend service on a **Vultr VM**. The application provides multiple routes (e.g., Home, Chat, Marketplace, Users) and integrates with **Qdrant**, which is hosted on the same VM using Docker.

### Swar-Guru-AI
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/swarguruai-af7d) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](http://139.84.162.182/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-StatusCode%202-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://statuscode-2.devfolio.co)

> Unite tradition and technology – an AI-powered mus

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Learning Indian classical music or any musical skill requires consistent practice, precise pitch control, and guidance, which is often difficult without a teacher present. Many learners struggle to identify if they are singing or playing the correct notes, maintaining rhythm, or improving over time. Existing tools mostly provide static lessons and lack real-time feedback.

This project solves that problem by providing an AI-powered music tutor that analyzes the user’s performance in real time. It captures both the user’s voice/instrument and system sounds like tanpura and tabla, detects pitch and frequency, and provides instant feedback on accuracy, timing, and improvement areas. It makes learning more accessible, interactive, and effective, even without a physical teacher, helping users progress faster and with confidence.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the biggest challenges we faced was deploying the project smoothly across different platforms. Since the application uses both front-end (React) and back-end (Flask/other framework) components along with real-time audio processing, configuring environments and managing dependencies was tricky. We ran into issues where the recording and audio analysis worked perfectly in the local environment but failed to capture system audio or microphone input correctly after deployment.

Another challenge was hosting the back-end API and ensuring low-latency communication with the front-end while dealing with large audio files. Some platforms did not support the required audio APIs or Web Audio features, which caused compatibility issues.

We resolved this by experimenting with multiple hosting solutions, using proper environment variables, optimizing server-side handling, and testing thoroughly on different devices and browsers to ensure stability.

**Vultr Cloud Deployment Track**

Our AI music tutor application relies on real-time audio processing, data storage, and fast API responses for an uninterrupted user experience. Deploying it on Vultr Cloud ensures scalability, low latency, and high availability, which are crucial for tasks like real-time pitch analysis, system audio recording, and AI-driven feedback.

The project uses both front-end and back-end services, requiring a reliable infrastructure to handle audio processing, model inference, and secure data transfer. By deploying on Vultr, we can leverage their virtual machines, cloud storage, and networking features to provide users with seamless access to our application across devices. This deployment track perfectly aligns with our needs, as Vultr’s environment helps us deliver a robust, production-ready platform for learners worldwide.

### DataVista
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/datavista-1c40) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/K-is-SAD/AUTODATA-) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://c3wsyuxc6rakbo5mtucazr.streamlit.app/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-StatusCode%202-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://statuscode-2.devfolio.co)

> From raw data to clear conclusions.

![NumPy](https://img.shields.io/badge/NumPy-333333?style=flat-square) ![pandas](https://img.shields.io/badge/pandas-333333?style=flat-square) ![SQLite](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQLite-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Plotly](https://img.shields.io/badge/Plotly-333333?style=flat-square) ![Charts.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Charts.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Streamlit](https://img.shields.io/badge/Streamlit-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**🚀 The Problem It Solves**

Working with data is often overwhelming for non-technical users and even time-consuming for analysts. Traditional approaches to data exploration require:

- Manually cleaning and analyzing CSV files using tools like Excel or SQL.

- Writing complex queries to extract meaningful patterns.
 
- Switching between multiple tools (databases, visualization software, notebooks).
 
- Difficulty in drawing actionable conclusions, since most tools focus on raw charts or predictions rather than clear insights.

As a result, people spend more time struggling with data preparation and less time actually understanding what the data is saying.

**✅ How DataVista Helps**

DataVista bridges this gap by making data analysis intuitive, visual, and insight-driven.

- 📂 Upload Your Data – Simply drop in a CSV (historical, categorical, or sales data).

- 📊 Instant Visualizations – Automatically generates charts and plots that highlight patterns, anomalies, and trends.
 
- 🔎 SQL Query Generation – Converts user queries into SQL, helping users learn and apply data exploration without deep technical knowledge.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/f9d9713fb3354dec9d792eed0aac8009/681685c2-d408-4548-9be9-bedbf2cc6588.png)
 
- 💡 Hidden Numerical Insights – Surfaces conclusions and summaries that go beyond charts, giving clarity about what the numbers actually mean.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/f9d9713fb3354dec9d792eed0aac8009/ee3666da-94f2-4cef-8e2a-958f7555f439.png)
 
- 🛠 Self-Service Analysis – Eliminates dependency on data teams for smaller queries, empowering business users and analysts alike.

**🌟 What Can People Use It For?**

*Business Teams → Quickly analyze sales, customer, or operational data without waiting for technical reports.*

*Students & Researchers → Explore datasets visually and understand trends without manually coding.*

*Data Analysts → Save time by auto-generating SQL queries and focusing on deeper insights.*

*Decision Makers → Get clear, actionable conclusions instead of raw numbers.*

**🔑 Why It’s Easier & Safer**

- No need to install heavy BI tools or write complex scripts.

- Reduces human error by automating query generation and visualization.
 
- Encourages data exploration in a safe, guided environment.
 
- Makes insights accessible to everyone, not just data experts.

**✨ In short, DataVista turns raw CSVs into clarity — making data exploration effortless, insightful, and empowering.**

**Challenges we ran into**

**🛠️ Challenges Team Cosmos Ran Into**

Building DataVista was an exciting journey, but not without its hurdles. Some key challenges included:

**1. Handling Large CSV Files**

Problem: Uploading and processing large CSVs caused performance bottlenecks in Streamlit. including financial, sales, historical and categorical CSVs. Some datasets took too long to load or even froze the app.

Solution: Implemented lazy loading and data chunking, along with efficient use of Pandas and caching mechanisms (st.cache_data). This reduced load times significantly and kept the app responsive.

**2. Generating Accurate SQL Queries**

Problem: Translating user-friendly queries into precise SQL statements was tricky. Ambiguous queries often led to incorrect or incomplete results.

Solution: Added a query parser with natural language processing elements, along with validation layers to ensure queries mapped correctly to table schema. Gradually improved accuracy through testing on diverse datasets.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/f9d9713fb3354dec9d792eed0aac8009/dbc47dc9-95b2-41c1-a065-75bc0001a9e6.png)

**3. Balancing Visuals with Insights**

Problem: At first, the app generated too many charts, which overwhelmed users without delivering clear conclusions.

Solution: Introduced a smart insights layer that highlights key numerical findings (e.g., top trends, anomalies, correlations) alongside visualizations, making outputs both clear and meaningful.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/f9d9713fb3354dec9d792eed0aac8009/23e9a078-c937-46b2-af3a-9ebe55f437fc.png)

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/f9d9713fb3354dec9d792eed0aac8009/d8ae1a4d-8373-44db-9987-0546459fecf6.png)

**4. Deployment Issues**

Problem: Deploying the Streamlit app on the cloud had issues with package dependencies and file size limits.

Solution: Cleaned up the requirements file, used lightweight libraries where possible, and optimized dependency versions. Finally, configured deployment on Streamlit Cloud successfully.

**5. UI/UX Simplicity**

Problem: Non-technical users initially found it hard to navigate between raw data, charts, and SQL queries.

Solution: Redesigned the interface with a step-by-step workflow → Upload → Explore → Query → Conclude. This guided structure made it much easier for users to explore data confidently.

**✨ Each of these challenges helped shape DataVista into a more robust, user-friendly, and insightful data exploration tool.**

**Best Use of Gemini API**

**🔑 Role of Gemini API in DataVista**

**1. Insight Generation**

Instead of just plotting data, Gemini API helps us extract hidden numerical insights, trends, anomalies, and summaries directly from the dataset.

This allows users to go beyond surface-level charts and gain clear, data-backed conclusions.

**2. Automated SQL Query Generation**

Users can express queries in plain language.

Gemini API converts these into optimized SQL queries, which users can run directly on their data.

This reduces dependency on technical expertise and makes data querying accessible to everyone.

**3. Plot and Graph Recommendations**

Gemini API intelligently determines the best type of visualization (bar chart, line graph, pie chart, etc.) for a given dataset and query.

This ensures visualizations are not just pretty, but also contextually relevant and insightful.

**4. Comprehensive Data Explanations**

Beyond visualizations, Gemini API generates explanatory narratives to help users interpret the results.

*These explanations make the tool especially useful for non-technical users, students, and decision-makers.*

> Clarity on Campus

![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![fast.ai](https://img.shields.io/badge/fast.ai-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

1. Fragmented Communication in Placements

Currently, placement announcements are made through multiple channels like WhatsApp groups, emails, or notice boards.

Students often miss important updates about deadlines, job descriptions, or eligibility criteria.

Placement officers waste time sending the same information repeatedly.

Pain Point: No centralized hub for placement communication.

2. Manual Eligibility Checks

Placement cells typically receive Google Form submissions or Excel sheets with student data.

Officers manually verify eligibility (CGPA, backlogs, specific subject marks).

This is time-consuming, error-prone, and stressful during busy recruitment seasons.

Pain Point: A tedious, repetitive, and inefficient shortlisting process.

3. Lack of Personalization in Student Preparation

Students know which companies are coming but don’t know how to prepare smartly.

They have to search on their own for past interview questions, test patterns, and required skills.

No structured preparation roadmap tailored to their strengths/weaknesses or the specific company/role.

Pain Point: Students feel unprepared and anxious, leading to lower placement conversion.

4. Difficulty in Application Tracking

Students apply via multiple Google Forms or PDFs.

Placement officers struggle to track who applied, whether applications were complete, and how many students are shortlisted.

Students can’t clearly see the status of their applications across companies.

Pain Point: Lack of transparency and scattered information.

5. Institutional Reputation Challenge

Colleges are judged by their placement success rate.

Inefficient processes → fewer placements → bad reputation among prospective students.

Without data-driven insights, colleges can’t analyze trends (e.g., "which companies reject most students" or "common skill gaps").

Pain Point: Institutions lack tools to systematically improve placements.

**Challenges we ran into**

Hardware restrictions - Running AI models locally was difficult due to limited GPU/CPU power, RAM, and storage. Models often ran slowly, crashed, or overheated the system. Dependency issues and lack of parallel processing further restricted testing. To overcome this, we used lightweight models for local development.
Typescript errors - Frequent TypeScript type mismatches and strict checks slowed development. Small changes often caused cascading errors across multiple files. Working with external libraries lacking proper type definitions was especially frustrating. We resolved this by using custom type declarations, strict linting, and gradually refining the type system.

**The problem it solves**

***The Problem It Solves :***
**1. Inefficient CV & Skill Assessment**

Problem: Manual, subjective, and time-consuming evaluations.

Solution: AI-powered CV analysis, objective skill scoring, instant gap analysis, role match %.

**2. Lack of Personalized Learning Paths**

Problem: Generic courses, no clear progression or tracking.

Solution: AI-generated roadmaps, milestone-based learning, adaptive updates, curated resources.

**3. Time-Intensive Project Setup**

Problem: Slow project setup, weak portfolios, no real-world challenges.

Solution: Automated repo creation, industry-grade templates, AI-generated tasks, portfolio-ready projects.

**4. Limited GitHub Career Insights**

Problem: Basic stats, no career correlation, weak growth visibility.

Solution: Career-focused analytics, skill tracking, dashboards, progress visualization.

**Who Benefits**

**Developers:** Faster upskilling, clear roadmaps, stronger portfolios.

**Organizations:** Efficient hiring, data-driven training, improved retention.

**Institutions:** Personalized curricula, industry-aligned learning, better placements.

***Impact :***

**Speed:** Months of planning reduced to instant AI-driven paths.

**Accuracy :**  Objective, data-driven insights vs guesswork.

**Focus:** Career-aligned learning vs scattered efforts.

**Value:** 2–3x faster career growth, reduced skill gaps, higher industry readiness.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenge 1: Next.js 15 + React 19

Issue: Library incompatibility, peer dependency errors, build failures
Fix: Forced installs, version pinning, library replacements, compatibility testing

Challenge 2: Multi-Agent AI System

Issue: API rate limits, inconsistent responses, high costs
Fix: Fallback hierarchy, response normalization, caching, error handling

Challenge 3: GitHub OAuth

Issue: CORS, state persistence, JWT security, callback flow
Fix: Flask-CORS config, React auth context, secure cookies, error boundaries

Challenge 4: GitHub Data Sync

Issue: Rate limits, stale data, large repo performance, latency
Fix: Batch requests, caching, pagination, background sync

Challenge 5: Aurora Background

Issue: WebGL incompatibility, mobile lag, memory leaks
Fix: Device-based quality scaling, cleanup routines, CSS fallback

Challenge 6: Supabase Schema

Issue: Complex relations, JSON query performance, migration issues
Fix: Normalized schema, indexing, TS type generation, safe migrations

Challenge 7: Production Deployment

Issue: Env mismatch, build size, API timeouts, SSL redirects
Fix: Code splitting, env configs, health checks, HTTPS setup

Challenge 8: AI Workflow Testing

Issue: Non-deterministic AI, flaky tests, API reliance
Fix: Mocked responses, contract testing, test env, snapshot tests

**Best Use of Gemini API**

Multimodal understanding – It can process text, images, code, and structured data together, making it ideal for education, research, and developer tools.

Context-rich reasoning – Handles long, complex inputs better than most models, useful for study assistants, documentation, and report generation.

Efficiency & scalability – Optimized for fast inference with high accuracy, good for real-time applications.

Integration-friendly – Provides clean APIs + Google ecosystem support (Drive, Docs, Classroom, etc.), making it easy to embed in education and productivity apps.

 Best use case in education track:

AI Tutor & Assistant: Explain concepts with both text + diagrams/images.

Homework Helper: Parse a problem statement (screenshot) → explain → generate solution steps.

Research Aid: Summarize long documents + create structured study notes.

Code Companion: Debug or explain code alongside text instructions.

**Open Innovation**

Our solution is built as an open, modular ecosystem combining a Flask backend, Supabase storage, GitHub OAuth, and two AI agents:

**Agent-1:** CV parsing & skill analysis (Gemini + Supabase)

**Agent-2:** Personalized learning roadmaps & project generation (LangChain + Groq)

**Why It Fits Open Innovation**

**Open Architecture:** Monorepo design allows easy extension of agents, APIs, or frontends.

**Interoperability:** Built on open-source tools (Supabase, LangChain, GitHub APIs).

**Transparency:** Users own their data; AI results are accessible through open endpoints.

**Collaboration:** Universities, startups, and communities can adapt agents for their contexts.

**Extensibility**: New models, taxonomies, and project templates can be integrated seamlessly.

** Impact**

**Individuals: **Transparent, AI-powered career growth.

**Organizations:** Shared infrastructure for hiring and training.

**Ecosystem:** A reusable framework bridging academia, industry, and open-source communities.

In essence, **Sloop** is not just a tool but an open innovation platform for skill development and career progression.

### CareQueue
